papers.title: FuseReg: Regularizing Layer Fusion Mitigates the Reconstruction-Generation Gap in Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Representation autoencoders (RAEs) reuse features from a pretrained visual encoder as reconstruction and diffusion latents, integrating strong visual representations into image generation. However, RAEs still need to decide which encoder layers form the shared latent space for the generator and pixel decoder. This choice involves a trade-off. Shallower layers tend to preserve fine pixel details better, while deeper layers tend to yield better generation metrics. A fixed heuristic layer fusion therefore couples two stages that benefit from different information. We introduce FuseReg, which replaces heuristic feature selection with training over random subsets of encoder layers. We theoretically analyze the underlying mechanism: subset sampling explicitly penalizes sensitivity to cross-layer disagreement. On ImageNet-256 with DINOv3-L, a single FuseReg decoder reconstructs from full, sparse, and single-layer fusions without retraining, achieving higher PSNR than decoders specialized to fixed fusions. This flexibility also benefits generation: decoder replacement alone reduces unguided gFID by 27% with an unchanged RAEv2 DiT-XL generator. The same regularization principle extends to diffusion training, with joint regularization of both stages reducing unguided gFID by 29% on DiT-Base. These results show that training downstream models for layer-fusion robustness narrows the reconstruction-generation gap without modifying the pretrained encoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FuseReg 把 Representation Autoencoders 中固定的编码器层融合启发式替换为随机层子集训练，使下游解码器对跨层分歧不敏感。在 ImageNet-256 + DINOv3-L 上，单一解码器无需重训即可处理 full/sparse/single-layer 融合且 PSNR 高于专用解码器；仅替换解码器就让 unguided gFID 降低 27%（DiT-XL），联合正则化两阶段在 DiT-Base 上降低 29%。
Motivation: RAE 需要选定哪些预训练视觉编码器层构成生成器与像素解码器共享的潜空间：浅层保像素细节、深层利于生成指标，固定融合把本应使用不同信息的两个阶段耦合在一起，形成重建-生成差距。
Method: 用随机编码器层子集上的训练替代启发式特征选择（FuseReg），理论分析指出子集采样显式惩罚对跨层分歧 (cross-layer disagreement) 的敏感性；该正则进一步扩展到扩散训练，对重建与生成两阶段做联合正则，且不改动预训练编码器。
Result: ImageNet-256 + DINOv3-L 上，单个 FuseReg 解码器在无需重训的情况下从 full、sparse、single-layer 融合重建，PSNR 高于针对固定融合专门训练的解码器；仅替换解码器使 unguided gFID 下降 27%（RAEv2 DiT-XL 生成器不变）；同一正则扩展到扩散训练后，DiT-Base 上 unguided gFID 下降 29%。
Conclusion: 让下游模型对层融合具备鲁棒性即可收窄重建-生成差距，无需修改预训练视觉编码器；层选择不必是固定启发式，随机子集训练本身即为正则。

papers.title: Learning to Stop without Learning to Stop: Self-Supervised Confidence Training Improves Reasoning Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models often generate very long reasoning traces, making inference computationally expensive. Existing approaches typically improve efficiency either through inference-time early-stopping mechanisms or by explicitly encouraging shorter reasoning during training, for example through reinforcement learning with length penalties. We show that substantial efficiency gains can instead emerge from a different kind of supervision: \textit{confidence}. Using a self-supervised procedure, we fine-tune reasoning models to predict their confidence in the answer at intermediate points along their own reasoning trajectories using only 600 training problems. Confidence is used only as a training target: the loss contains no objective for reasoning length, efficiency, or stopping. At inference, the fine-tuned models use the standard generation procedure, with no confidence elicitation or early-stopping mechanism. Despite this, self-supervised confidence fine-tuning makes reasoning more efficient, reducing generated tokens by up to 25\% at matched accuracy across Gemma, Qwen, Nemotron, and GPT-OSS models on mathematical, scientific, and coding reasoning benchmarks, with efficiency gains comparable to methods that explicitly optimize for shorter reasoning. Analysis of reasoning episodes further shows that confidence supervision largely preserves the base models' high-level reasoning composition rather than selectively suppressing particular behaviors. Our results suggest that efficient reasoning may emerge as a downstream consequence of learning metacognitive signals, without being directly optimized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用自监督置信度微调让推理模型在自身推理轨迹的中间点预测答案置信度，训练目标里不含任何长度、效率或停止项，推理时也用标准生成、不做提前停止。结果在 Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron、GPT-OSS 上于数学、科学、代码基准中在匹配准确率下最多减少 25% 生成 token，效率增益与显式优化短推理的方法相当。
Motivation: 长推理轨迹让推理模型推理开销过高；现有方法要么在推理时加提前停止机制，要么在训练里用长度惩罚显式压缩推理，二者都直接对长度施压。
Method: 自监督置信度训练：只用 600 个训练问题，微调模型在自身推理轨迹的中间点预测最终答案的置信度，损失中不含长度、效率或停止目标；推理时沿用标准生成流程，不额外索取置信度也不做 early-stopping。
Result: 在 Gemma、Qwen、Nemotron、GPT-OSS 系列模型上，数学、科学与代码推理基准中匹配准确率下生成 token 最多减少 25%，效率增益与显式优化短推理的方法相当；推理片段分析显示置信度监督大体保留了基座模型的高层推理构成，而非选择性压制某类行为。
Conclusion: 效率可以作为学习元认知信号（置信度）的下游副产物出现，无需直接优化长度或停止；训练只用 600 个问题即可实现这一点。

papers.title: Gap-free Differentially Private PCA for Gaussian Data
papers.abstract_en: We give a gap-free differentially private algorithm for the principal component analysis (PCA) problem with Gaussian data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高斯数据的主成分分析 (PCA)，给出一个无 gap（gap-free）的差分隐私算法，即在任意特征值间隔下都给出隐私保证与误差界，而不依赖特征值之间存在固定间隔的假设。
Motivation: 差分隐私 PCA 通常需要数据谱满足特征值间隔条件，间隔缺失时保证失效；高斯数据场景需要不依赖间隔假设的隐私算法。
Method: 针对高斯数据设计差分隐私 PCA 算法，目标是 gap-free 的误差保证，具体机制摘要未展开。
Result: 摘要仅陈述给出一个面向高斯数据的 gap-free 差分隐私 PCA 算法，未给出数值指标或对比。
Conclusion: 高斯数据上的差分隐私 PCA 可以在不假设特征值间隔的前提下给出保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: First-Order Stationarity of Reverse Diffusions
papers.abstract_en: Recent literature has shown a strong connection between optimization and sampling. We develop the corresponding first-order theory for diffusion models. First, the SDE-based reverse-time flows of overdamped and underdamped Langevin diffusions contract relative Fisher divergences at explicit exponential rates whenever the stationary potential of the forward process is strongly convex---a condition on the noising process one chooses, not on the data. This is a unique advantage of SDE-based reverse diffusion, absent in the reverse process based on ODEs. Second, we incorporate discretization and establish averaged first-order stationarity bounds---the sampling analog of averaged gradient-norm guarantees in nonconvex optimization---for samplers of both overdamped and underdamped diffusion models. As in nonconvex optimization, the convexity-free certificate is local: it guarantees score consistency, not global mode weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为扩散模型建立一阶平稳性理论：当正向过程的稳态势函数强凸时，过阻尼与欠阻尼 Langevin 的 SDE 反向流以显式指数速率收缩相对 Fisher 散度，且该条件只约束所选加噪过程、不依赖数据，这是基于 ODE 的反向过程不具备的。加入离散化后得到平均一阶平稳性界（类比非凸优化的平均梯度范数保证），但该无凸性证书是局部的，只保证 score 一致性、不保证全局 mode weights。
Motivation: 优化与采样的对应关系已有大量研究，但扩散模型缺少与非凸优化中平均梯度范数保证相对应的一阶平稳性理论，尤其是 SDE 与 ODE 反向流在收敛保证上的差异未被刻画。
Method: 对过阻尼与欠阻尼 Langevin 扩散的 SDE 反向时间流，在正向稳态势强凸的条件下推导相对 Fisher 散度的显式指数收缩率；随后纳入离散化误差，为两类扩散模型采样器建立平均一阶平稳性界，作为非凸优化中平均梯度范数保证的采样类比。
Result: 得到 SDE 反向流相对 Fisher 散度的显式指数收缩率（强凸势条件下），以及过阻尼与欠阻尼扩散模型采样器的平均一阶平稳性界；该证书为局部性质，只保证 score 一致性而不保证全局 mode weights。
Conclusion: SDE 型反向扩散在强凸稳态势下拥有 ODE 反向过程所没有的收缩与一阶平稳性保证，但由此得到的证书是局部的，只能支撑 score 一致性而非全局 mode weights。

papers.title: Statistical attribute alignment for black-box generative AI via output post-processing
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI systems are increasingly used, but aligning their outputs with user requirements poses a continuing challenge. Here, we aim to ensure that the distribution of an attribute of an AI-generated output aligns with a user-specified target. This is motivated by examples such as fairness, where we want to ensure that a protected attribute (e.g., gender, race, or age categories) follows a desired distribution, and synthetic data generation, where we want the generated data to be representative of a target distribution. We study the practically important black-box access setting, where a user can repeatedly query a generative AI model. The goal is to return $m\ge 1$ outputs whose joint attribute distribution is as close as possible to this target. For both exact and approximate alignment, we develop algorithms that minimize the expected number of queries to the generator, and we further demonstrate their optimality as the number of requested outputs $m \rightarrow \infty$. Experiments on text-to-image generation and geocoded persona generation tasks show that our post-processing algorithms improve statistical attribute alignment, complementing prompting-based interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能反复查询的黑盒生成式 AI 场景下，通过输出后处理让 m 个输出的联合属性分布贴近用户指定目标分布。针对精确与近似对齐两种目标，作者给出最小化期望查询次数的算法，并证明当 m→∞ 时算法最优；文本到图像与地理编码 persona 生成实验显示后处理提升了统计属性对齐，可与 prompting 类干预互补。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 输出的属性分布（如性别、种族、年龄等受保护属性，或合成数据对目标分布的代表性）常与用户要求不符，而黑盒访问下无法改模型内部，只能靠查询与后处理来对齐。
Method: 在黑盒可重复查询设定下，把问题形式化为返回 m≥1 个输出使其联合属性分布尽量接近目标；针对 exact 与 approximate alignment 分别设计最小化期望查询数的后处理算法，并给出 m→∞ 时的最优性论证。
Result: 在文本到图像生成与地理编码 persona 生成任务上，后处理算法改善了统计属性对齐，并与基于 prompting 的干预形成互补；算法在 m→∞ 时被证明最优。
Conclusion: 输出层的统计属性对齐可以在不接触模型内部的情况下以尽量少的查询达成，并作为 prompting 之外的独立手段使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified read-write framework that bridges linear and causal probing by learning a compact user representation that can be both decoded and written back into the model. The frozen LLM acts as its own teacher, distilling beliefs from natural conversations without external annotations. Unlike conventional probing, BSD isolates not only information present in activations, but a state whose causal role can be directly tested. Across multiple model families, BSD faithfully recovers user beliefs and enables substantially stronger interventions than matched hidden-state steering. Crucially, we find that refusal depends not only on the request, but on the model's inferred user intent: changing this belief alters refusal while holding the request fixed. We further uncover a striking cross-model regularity: independently trained LLMs converge on a shared geometry for representing their users. Together, these results reveal implicit user models as readable and causally writable internal states with direct implications for AI safety, shaping how models condition safety decisions on whom they believe they are interacting with.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Belief Self-Distillation (BSD)：用冻结 LLM 自己当教师，从自然对话中蒸馏出一个紧凑的用户表征，既能线性解码又能写回模型，从而把用户信念变成可读且可因果写入的内部状态。固定请求不变、只改写这一信念即可改变模型的拒绝行为，且多个独立训练的 LLM 在用户表征上收敛到共享几何结构。
Motivation: LLM 会隐式推断用户属性并据此调整行为，但这些信念难以被检查，也难以做因果操纵；常规 probing 只能读出激活中的信息，无法验证该状态的因果作用。
Method: BSD 是统一的读-写框架，桥接 linear probing 与 causal probing：以冻结 LLM 为教师，从无外部标注的自然对话中蒸馏出紧凑用户表征，既训练解码器读出，也训练写回机制注入；与 matched hidden-state steering 对照以检验因果效应。
Result: 在多个模型族上，BSD 忠实恢复用户信念，且带来的干预强度显著强于 matched hidden-state steering；固定请求、仅改变推断出的用户意图即可改变拒绝行为；独立训练的 LLM 在用户表征上收敛到共享几何结构。
Conclusion: 隐式用户模型是既可读又可因果写入的内部状态，模型的安全决策取决于它认为在与谁交互，因此用户信念是 AI safety 干预的直接着力点。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Belief Self-Distillation (BSD)：用冻结 LLM 自己当教师，从自然对话中蒸馏出一个紧凑的用户表征，既能线性解码又能写回模型，从而把用户信念变成可读且可因果写入的内部状态。固定请求不变、只改写这一信念即可改变模型的拒绝行为，且多个独立训练的 LLM 在用户表征上收敛到共享几何结构。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 会隐式推断用户属性并据此调整行为，但这些信念难以被检查，也难以做因果操纵；常规 probing 只能读出激活中的信息，无法验证该状态的因果作用。
summary_sections.method: BSD 是统一的读-写框架，桥接 linear probing 与 causal probing：以冻结 LLM 为教师，从无外部标注的自然对话中蒸馏出紧凑用户表征，既训练解码器读出，也训练写回机制注入；与 matched hidden-state steering 对照以检验因果效应。
summary_sections.result: 在多个模型族上，BSD 忠实恢复用户信念，且带来的干预强度显著强于 matched hidden-state steering；固定请求、仅改变推断出的用户意图即可改变拒绝行为；独立训练的 LLM 在用户表征上收敛到共享几何结构。

papers.title: New LoRA Skills Should Read but Never Write
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) make it cheap to fine-tune a large language model once per task, but combining several independently trained adapters into one model remains difficult: merging the updates in weight space causes interference, retraining on all task data is expensive, and routing between separate adapters gives up the goal of a single combined model. We trace the difficulty to two choices that every composition method makes implicitly. A LoRA update admits infinitely many equivalent factorizations; the choice among them is invisible while an adapter serves alone, but it determines what a learned interaction between adapters can see. A coupling between an old skill and a new one can likewise point in either direction, and the direction decides whether the old skills keep computing what they computed before. We introduce READ (Read-only Expansion of Adapter Deltas), which fixes both choices: each adapter is rewritten into a balanced canonical form that preserves its update exactly, and the coupling grows in one direction only, so a new skill can read the input subspaces of old skills but cannot write into their output subspaces. The only trainable object at each append is the new skill's row of the coupling matrix, and the composed update folds into the base weights with no inference cost, routing, or task-specific rules. We evaluate READ across four benchmark suites and two model families, adding skills one at a time. Across several families, READ improves every suite average over the strongest published baselines built from the same adapters---by more than twenty points on SuperGLUE and more than seven points on the domain suite---and nearly all complete addition sequences end above every direct baseline. Factor coordinates and coupling direction, which a lone adapter never exposes, are what decide whether composed skills survive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: READ（Read-only Expansion of Adapter Deltas）把每个 LoRA adapter 重写为保持更新完全不变的平衡规范形，并让新旧技能的耦合只单向增长：新技能可读旧技能的输入子空间，但不能写入其输出子空间。每次追加只训练耦合矩阵中新技能那一行，合成更新直接折入基权重，无推理开销、无路由。在四个 benchmark 套件、两个模型族上逐个追加技能，SuperGLUE 套件均值比同 adapter 的最强已发表基线高二十多点，domain 套件高七点多点。
Motivation: 多个独立训练的 LoRA 合成到一个模型里一直很难：权重空间合并会互相干扰，全量重训昂贵，路由则放弃了单一合并模型的目标。作者把困难归因到两个被隐式选择的自由度——LoRA 分解不唯一、新旧技能耦合有方向——而这两者在单个 adapter 单独使用时完全不可见。
Method: READ 固定这两个选择：一是把每个 adapter 改写成精确保持其更新的平衡规范形 (balanced canonical form)，二是让耦合只朝一个方向增长，新技能只能读旧技能的输入子空间、不能写其输出子空间。每次追加时唯一可训练的对象是耦合矩阵中新技能那一行，合成更新折入基座权重，推理阶段无需路由或任务特定规则。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 套件、两个模型族上逐个追加技能的评测中，READ 相对基于同一批 adapter 的最强已发表基线提升每个套件均值：SuperGLUE 提升二十多点，domain 套件提升七点多点；几乎所有完整的技能追加序列最终都高于所有直接基线。
Conclusion: 作者主张，决定组合后技能能否存活的正是单个 adapter 从不暴露的两个量：因子坐标（规范形）与耦合方向，因此新技能应当只读旧技能而不写入。

papers.title: GraphWrit3R: End-to-End 3D Scene Graph Writing
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene graphs provide a structured representation of complex environments by encoding objects, their semantic attributes, and the spatial and functional relationships between them. Current approaches for 3D scene graph generation suffer from several fundamental limitations. They rely on complex multi-stage pipelines with explicit intermediate representations, making systems fragile and prone to error propagation. They assume access to ground-truth object annotations during inference, which deviates from real-world scenarios. They depend on proprietary models, hindering open-source deployment, or incur prohibitively slow inference. We present GraphWrit3R, a simple end-to-end method that takes a 3D point cloud, Gaussian Splats, or a combination of both as input, and directly outputs a complete scene graph as a structured JSON script. The graph lists all objects, their semantic attributes, and the relationships between them, while avoiding all of the above mentioned limitations. The choice of multiple input modalities is purely for versatility, allowing a single set of weights to handle diverse scenarios. Point cloud inputs are encoded via Sonata and Gaussian Splat inputs via Chorus, with both modalities projected onto a shared voxel grid and fused through a novel per-voxel contrastive alignment loss before being decoded by a large language model. As a natural consequence of the LLM, GraphWrit3R also supports open-vocabulary querying. On the 3DSSG benchmark, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on object class, predicate, and triplet recall, outperforming methods that rely on ground-truth object annotations during inference. We further provide qualitative results and analyze different input modality configurations, contrastive loss formulations, and token fusion strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphWrit3R 把 3D 场景图生成做成端到端流程：直接吃点云或 Gaussian Splats（或两者），输出含对象、语义属性与关系的完整 JSON 场景图，无需推理期真值对象标注、无需多阶段中间表示。点云经 Sonata 编码、Gaussian Splats 经 Chorus 编码，投影到共享 voxel grid 后用逐 voxel 对比对齐损失融合，再由 LLM 解码；在 3DSSG 上对象类、谓词、三元组召回均达 SOTA，且顺带支持开放词表查询。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景图生成依赖多阶段流水线与显式中间表示，易误差传播；推理时还假设真值对象标注，或依赖专有模型、推理极慢，偏离真实部署场景。
Method: 输入为 3D 点云、Gaussian Splats 或二者组合：点云用 Sonata 编码，Gaussian Splats 用 Chorus 编码，两种模态投影到共享 voxel grid，经新颖的逐 voxel 对比对齐损失 (per-voxel contrastive alignment loss) 融合后由大语言模型解码为结构化 JSON 场景图；一套权重覆盖多种输入模态，并因 LLM 解码天然支持开放词表查询。
Result: 在 3DSSG benchmark 上，对象类召回、谓词召回、三元组召回均取得 state-of-the-art，且超过推理期依赖真值对象标注的方法；另给出定性结果，并分析不同输入模态配置、对比损失形式与 token 融合策略。
Conclusion: 端到端单阶段的场景图生成可以在不使用真值对象标注的前提下达到 SOTA，多模态输入只需共享 voxel 网格加对比对齐即可由一套权重统一处理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Common-Mode Collapse and Recovery in Direct Feedback Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Direct feedback alignment (DFA) trains hidden layers through fixed random projections of output error. With tanh hidden units and independent sigmoid outputs, plain stochastic gradient descent can stall near the loss of a constant predictor of class frequencies. We trace this stall to the error's common mode, the component shared across inputs. An exact mean-covariance decomposition separates a rank-one update formed by the mean teaching signal and mean presynaptic activity. Its leading component drives tanh units toward saturation. At initialization, random feedback provides no systematic correction of the shared error on average; readout learning limits its duration. A reduced model initialized from the network, without fitted parameters, predicts the concentration of activation sensitivity across 48 settings. On MNIST, class decodability largely survives collapse, but readout learning remains slow at a fixed learning rate. Adam learns faster despite deeper collapse. Calibrating the baseline readout to the class prior suppresses collapse and speeds learning; weaker feedback trades less collapse for slower learning. Replacing errors by their signs sustains collapse; subtracting the signal's batch mean prevents sustained collapse and improves learning in the tested setting. Related effects occur in deeper and convolutional networks and on CIFAR-10, with severity and cost depending on the readout, optimizer and input statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DFA 用固定随机投影回传输出误差时，误差的 common mode（跨输入共享分量）会把 tanh 隐单元推入饱和，使 SGD 在接近常数预测器（类频率）的损失附近停滞。把回传信号减去 batch 均值可阻止持续性坍塌并改善学习，而把基线 readout 校准到类先验同样抑制坍塌、加快学习；仅取误差符号则会让坍塌持续。
Motivation: DFA 中隐层训练依赖固定随机投影，误差的共享分量没有系统性校正机制，导致 SGD 在平凡解附近停滞，且 readout 学习在固定学习率下缓慢。
Method: 用精确的均值-协方差分解把更新拆出由平均教学信号与平均突触前活动构成的秩一分量；构造一个从网络初始化、无拟合参数的约化模型来预测激活敏感度集中现象，并在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 以及更深和卷积网络上考察 readout、优化器与输入统计的影响。
Result: 约化模型在 48 种设置上预测了激活敏感度的集中；MNIST 上坍塌后类别可解码性大体保留，但固定学习率下 readout 学习仍慢，Adam 学得更快尽管坍塌更深；基线 readout 校准到类先验可抑制坍塌并加速学习；较弱反馈以更少坍塌换取更慢学习；误差取符号使坍塌持续，减去 batch 均值则阻止持续坍塌并在所测设置下改善学习。
Conclusion: DFA 的停滞源于误差 common mode 而非随机投影本身，减去 batch 均值或校准 readout 到类先验是抑制坍塌的可行手段；效应在更深、卷积网络与 CIFAR-10 上同样出现，严重程度与代价取决于 readout、优化器和输入统计。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Compact Documentation for Coding Agents: A Benchmark, an Optimizer, and Why It Does Not Transfer
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether natural-language documentation helps coding agents resolve software issues, and we build the tools to construct and evaluate it. We introduce a roundtrip benchmark that scores code descriptions by whether code regenerated from them passes the original tests, and show that completeness, not length, drives a description's fidelity. Using the benchmark as an optimization signal, we discover a description-writing prompt that reaches full fidelity and generalizes to unseen files. We then test the hypothesis that motivated the work: that better documentation helps an agent resolve real repository issues. Across two model families and ten repositories, and against a positive control confirming that our evaluation can detect a genuine improvement, we find that it does not. When the source is present, neither static compact documentation nor retrieved context beats the issue alone. We report this negative result together with the benchmark and the optimizer, and we characterize the boundary at which documentation helps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 roundtrip 基准：用「按描述重新生成代码能否通过原测试」给文档打分，并据此优化出一个能达到完全保真度 (full fidelity) 且泛化到未见文件的描述写作 prompt。但把更好的文档用于真实仓库 issue 解决时无效：在两个模型家族、十个仓库上，当源码可直接获取时，静态紧凑文档和检索式上下文都不如只给 issue 本身。
Motivation: 自然语言文档是否真能帮助 coding agent 解决软件 issue 缺乏可度量的检验手段，且「文档更好→修复更好」这一前提本身未经验证。
Method: 构建 roundtrip 基准，以描述生成的代码能否通过原始测试作为保真度评分；用该基准作为优化信号搜索描述写作 prompt；再在两个模型家族、十个仓库上测试文档对真实 issue 解决的作用，并设置 positive control 验证评测能检出真实改进。
Result: 发现驱动描述保真的是完整性而非长度；优化得到的 prompt 达到完全保真度并泛化到未见文件；issue 解决实验中，源码在场时静态紧凑文档与检索上下文均不优于仅给 issue，positive control 确认评测可检出真实改进。
Conclusion: 文档的价值有边界：源码可获取时紧凑文档和检索上下文都不带来 issue 解决收益，文档只在特定边界条件下才有帮助。

papers.title: Trust Guided Decision Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Decision Transformer performance degrades on long rollouts because the conditioning context drifts out of the training distribution. We show that this drift is visible through the model's own next state prediction error, which rises during rollout and stays elevated, giving a direct signal of when context has become unreliable. We introduce Trust Guided Decision Transformer (TGDT), which selects context before applying value guidance. At each step, TGDT evaluates several recent context suffixes using rolling next state prediction error, calibrated against held out offline data via split conformal prediction. It keeps only suffixes whose error stays within the calibrated threshold, then uses a frozen critic to choose the highest value action among the trusted suffixes. This reverses the order used by value only elastic selection, where the critic may choose an action generated from a context the model itself has flagged as unreliable. Experiments on D4RL navigation and locomotion tasks show that state prediction, critic guidance, and hard context reset each solve only part of the problem. TGDT reduces persistent high error runs and improves return over vanilla Decision Transformer, reset based context control, and value only context selection.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: How Far Can INRs Go? Cross-Domain Parameter-efficient INR-Based Semantic Segmentation for Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical image segmentation is central to medical image analysis, but practical deployment often faces limited annotations, memory constraints, and cross-site distribution shifts. Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have recently emerged as a lightweight alternative for semantic segmentation, achieving competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters than conventional architectures. However, the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and domain generalization abilities of INR-based segmentation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study these questions in the context of cross-domain brain MRI segmentation. We analyze INR-based segmentation across low-parameter regimes, comparing it with conventional pipelines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Surprisingly, we find that INR-based models do not simply improve with increasing parameter budget. Their advantage is most pronounced under low-parameter and limited-augmentation settings, while U-Net-based models benefit more from larger capacity and standard augmentation. We also investigate how INRs encode semantic information in their hidden features and show that complementary segmentation-relevant structure is distributed across multiple INR layers. Building on this insight, we introduce HierINRSeg, a hierarchical INR-based architecture that aggregates multi-layer representations for improved robustness and generalization. Extensive experiments show that HierINRSeg consistently outperforms MetaSeg, a strong recent INR-based segmentation baseline, with an average improvement of 5.6 percentage points in Dice for the in-domain test set and 8.2 percentage points out-of-domain. Overall, our analysis identifies the conditions under which INR-based segmentation is most effective, providing concrete guidance for model selection and future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在脑 MRI 跨域分割中系统比较 INR 与 U-Net 的参数扩展行为，发现 INR 并非随参数预算单调变好，其优势集中在低参数、弱增广设定；据此提出 HierINRSeg，聚合多层 INR 表征，域内 Dice 平均比 MetaSeg 高 5.6 个百分点、域外高 8.2 个百分点。
Motivation: INR 分割被当作轻量替代方案，但其机制、参数扩展规律和跨站点分布偏移下的泛化能力尚不清楚，标注受限与内存约束下的模型选型缺少依据。
Method: 在低参数区间对比 INR 与常规管线（含 U-Net），覆盖 in-domain 与 out-of-domain 设定；分析 INR 隐藏层如何编码语义，发现分割相关结构分布在多个层，进而提出 HierINRSeg 层级架构聚合多层表征。
Result: INR 优势在低参数、有限增广设定下最明显，而 U-Net 更能从更大容量和标准增广中获益；HierINRSeg 相对 INR 基线 MetaSeg 平均提升 5.6 个百分点（域内测试集 Dice）与 8.2 个百分点（域外）。
Conclusion: INR 分割的适用条件是低参数预算与有限增广，跨域鲁棒性要靠聚合多层表征获得，模型选型应按参数预算与增广强度决定。

papers.title: OC-GS: Gaussian Splatting for Irregular Turntable Capture
papers.abstract_en: Uneven rotation and dropped frames make equal-angle assumptions unreliable for turntable reconstruction. We present OC-GS, an object-centric Gaussian splatting that refines each image's angle while maintaining a shared camera, rotation axis, and pivot. This orbit-consistent refinement jointly optimizes image-derived geometry and angles to reconstruct objects from sparse, irregular captures. On rendered objects with 12, 8, and 6 irregularly spaced views, OC-GS achieves mean foreground PSNR scores of 21.26, 19.36, and 15.83dB, respectively, exceeding all four evaluated pose-free Gaussian splatting baselines in each condition. Under a shared trainer, refining image-estimated angles improves mean foreground PSNR by 7.88dB over keeping those estimates fixed. An ablation study shows that both image-derived angle initialization and the shared motion model contribute to the improvement. On real captures, OC-GS's refinement increases mean foreground PSNR by 0.70dB. Results show that refining uncertain angles within a shared motion model improves reconstruction from sparse, irregular turntable captures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OC-GS 针对转台拍摄中旋转不均与丢帧导致的等角度假设失效，提出以共享相机、旋转轴与枢轴约束联合优化图像几何与每张图的拍摄角度。在 12、8、6 个不规则视角的渲染物体上，平均前景 PSNR 分别为 21.26、19.36、15.83dB，均超过四个 pose-free Gaussian splatting 基线；共享训练器下细化角度比固定角度估计提升 7.88dB，真实拍摄上提升 0.70dB。
Motivation: 转台重建依赖等角度间隔假设，但实际拍摄旋转不均、丢帧，直接使用图像估计的角度会使稀疏不规则采集下的物体重建失准。
Method: OC-GS 是 object-centric Gaussian splatting：在共享相机、旋转轴与枢轴的 orbit-consistent 约束下，联合优化图像导出的几何与每张图的角度；用图像导出的角度作初始化，并依赖共享运动模型，另做消融分离两者贡献。
Result: 渲染物体在 12、8、6 个不规则视角下平均前景 PSNR 分别为 21.26、19.36、15.83dB，逐条件超过全部四个 pose-free Gaussian splatting 基线；共享训练器下细化角度比固定角度估计平均前景 PSNR 提高 7.88dB；真实拍摄上细化带来 0.70dB 提升；消融显示角度初始化与共享运动模型均对提升有贡献。
Conclusion: 在共享运动模型内细化不确定角度，能改善稀疏不规则转台采集的物体重建，且角度初始化与共享运动模型缺一不可。

papers.title: Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has substantially accelerated the calibration of complex stochastic-volatility models, but neural point calibration alone does not capture the uncertainty remaining after an implied-volatility (IV) surface has been observed. We develop a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston (rHeston) calibration that learns the posterior distribution of the model parameters conditional on an IV surface. Using neural ratio estimation, we obtain calibrated posterior samples that can be propagated through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers for path-dependent exotic options. The resulting posterior-predictive distributions combine residual parameter uncertainty with conditional surrogate uncertainty and yield uncertainty-aware price intervals. We further introduce Hellinger-SHAP, an information-theoretic explainability method for posterior inference. Rather than attributing a single parameter point estimate, it applies local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional measuring contraction from the prior to the posterior. This identifies maturity--moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for individual rHeston parameters. In a simulation study, posterior-predictive intervals provide calibrated or conservative coverage across forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, while point plug-in prices can be materially unreliable for selected contract regimes. Together, the UQ and XAI analyses provide a transparent framework for uncertainty-aware neural calibration and downstream exotic pricing under the specified prior-predictive model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 rough Heston 校准只给点估计、不给观测隐含波动率面后剩余不确定性的问题，用基于模拟的推断 (simulation-based inference) 学参数后验：神经比值估计 (neural ratio estimation) 产出校准后验样本，再经异方差神经代理定价器传播到期权价格。仿真研究中后验预测区间在 forward-start、barrier、realized-variance 三类奇异期权上覆盖校准或保守，而点插值价格在部分合约区间明显不可靠。
Motivation: 深度学习已加速复杂随机波动率模型校准，但神经点估计无法刻画观测到隐含波动率面之后模型参数仍存的不确定性，奇异期权定价因此缺少可量化的区间。
Method: 构建以隐含波动率面为条件、学习 rHeston 参数后验分布的 simulation-based inference 框架，用 neural ratio estimation 得到后验样本；样本经 heteroscedastic 神经代理定价器传播，合并残余参数不确定性与代理条件不确定性形成价格区间。另提出 Hellinger-SHAP：对先验到后验收缩的信息泛函施加 local-background Kernel SHAP，定位各参数的后验信息增益区域。
Result: 仿真研究中，后验预测区间在 forward-start、barrier、realized-variance 索赔上给出校准或保守覆盖；点 plug-in 价格在选定合约区间可能实质不可靠。Hellinger-SHAP 识别出 maturity–moneyness 上与各 rHeston 参数后验信息增益相关的区域。
Conclusion: 在指定 prior-predictive 模型下，把参数后验与代理不确定性一起传播才能给出可信赖的奇异期权价格区间，单一神经点估计不足以支撑不确定性感知的定价与解释。

papers.title: Adapting for AI: How elementary teachers adjust their practices for an AI-integrated curriculum
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI tools are entering children's everyday experiences, and schools are interested in adopting them. However, successful classroom integration depends not only on the technology but also on the work teachers do to make it usable and appropriate for their students and classroom context. There is little known about how elementary teachers work as they implement conversational AI tools in real classrooms. In this study, we examine three teachers' experiences implementing an AI literacy and English Language Arts (ELA) curriculum built around ToyTalk, a conversational AI toy development platform, over 13 instructional days, a three-week summer camp. Drawing on daily individual reflections, group reflections, and post-camp interviews, we find that teachers' adaptive practices of repair, differentiation, translation, and balancing sit at the intersection of three tensions (technology, learner, and instruction). Teachers' understanding of AI and their role evolved over the camp experiences. From these findings, we contribute design implications and considerations for deploying conversational AI within elementary classrooms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对三名小学教师在 13 个教学日的暑期营中实施基于 ToyTalk 的 AI 素养与 ELA 课程做质性研究，发现教师靠修复 (repair)、差异化 (differentiation)、翻译 (translation) 与平衡 (balancing) 四类适应性实践，处理技术、学习者与教学三重张力的交叉点，且其对 AI 与自身角色的理解随营期推进而演变。
Motivation: 对话式 AI 正进入儿童日常并被学校引入，但教师在真实课堂中如何把这类工具做得可用、适切，几乎无人研究。
Method: 追踪三名小学教师在三周暑期营、13 个教学日中实施围绕 ToyTalk 对话式 AI 玩具开发平台的 AI 素养与英语语言艺术 (ELA) 课程；资料来自每日个人反思、小组反思与营后访谈，按三重张力框架归纳适应性实践。
Result: 识别出四类适应性实践——修复、差异化、翻译、平衡——它们落在技术、学习者、教学三重张力的交汇处；教师对 AI 及自身角色的理解在营期中发生变化。
Conclusion: 课堂引入对话式 AI 的成败取决于教师在三重张力上的持续调适工作，据此给出在小学课堂部署对话式 AI 的设计启示。

papers.title: DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education
papers.abstract_en: AI tutoring could markedly improve learning outcomes for students in developing regions such as Vietnam, yet the two obvious paths both fall short. Cloud assistants such as ChatGPT route sensitive student data to foreign servers---violating data-sovereignty laws such as Vietnam's Decree 53---and, pre-trained on Western-centric corpora, are not organized around the national textbook curriculum, so their knowledge of local content is unsystematic and frequently hallucinated. Self-hosting an open model keeps data on-premise but hits a two-fold wall: post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ) tames the static weight footprint, yet the dynamic KV cache and prefill latency of long tutoring contexts still cause out-of-memory failures and slow responses on consumer GPUs, while the model keeps hallucinating on region-specific material. We present DeepEdu-v1, an AI-tutoring system for Vietnamese education built on SCALE (Self-improving Context-Aware Learning Engine), a framework with two innovations. First, a long-context inference engine amortizes token selection from per-sub-chunk to per-cluster granularity; on long-context retrieval it issues x7.7 fewer retrieval calls than a state-of-the-art selective-attention baseline, cutting prefill latency (TTFT) by roughly 35% while matching or improving task accuracy. Second, a self-improving agentic layer continuously curates a verified playbook from past interactions instead of fine-tuning, a design intended to progressively reduce reliance on dominant-language priors as trustworthy local knowledge accumulates. In its deployed configuration, DeepEdu achieves a nearly x2 TTFT speedup over standard vLLM serving and lifts agentic accuracy from 70.0% to 79.5% on complex tasks, with the strongest per-track gains across financial-reasoning and interactive-agent benchmarks.

papers.title: Weight Pair Encoding: Inducing a Smaller Grammar in Neural Network Weights
papers.abstract_en: We show that neural network weights can be explicilty fintuned to admit a smaller grammar. Weight Pair Encoding (WeightPE) does so by placing a lossy Re-Pair compressor inside a straight-through estimator. The int8 weights of the network are flattened into one string, and near-matching Re-Pair patterns are made exactly equal within a global L2 budget. The network computes with the rewritten weights and trains through them with a straight-through estimator. Unlike a flat codebook of fixed-size entries, a grammar offers variable-length patterns and reuses them hierarchically inside larger ones. On the MLP weights of ViT-B/16 and ViT-L/16 finetuned on CIFAR-10, WeightPE produces a Re-Pair grammar 0.43x and 0.38x the size of the one produced by an equivalent int8 QAT run, at a cost of 1.9 and 1.1 accuracy points. The trend extends to different grammar compressors (LZ78, SEQUITUR), over which the networks has not be finetuned against. To our knowledge, this is the first time grammar size has been used as an explicit training objective for network weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeightPE 把有损 Re-Pair 压缩器嵌进 straight-through estimator，让 int8 权重在全局 L2 预算内被改写成更小的文法。在 CIFAR-10 微调的 ViT-B/16 与 ViT-L/16 MLP 权重上，所得 Re-Pair 文法尺寸仅为同等 int8 QAT 的 0.43x 与 0.38x，代价是 1.9 与 1.1 个准确率点。
Motivation: 固定长度码本无法表达变长、层级复用的权重模式，压缩只能事后进行；作者要让文法尺寸本身成为训练目标。
Method: 将 int8 权重展平为一条字符串，在 straight-through estimator 内放置有损 Re-Pair 压缩器，使近似匹配的模式在全局 L2 预算下变得完全相同；网络用改写后的权重前向计算并反向训练。
Result: CIFAR-10 微调的 ViT-B/16 与 ViT-L/16 MLP 权重上，WeightPE 的 Re-Pair 文法尺寸为同等 int8 QAT 的 0.43x 与 0.38x，准确率代价分别为 1.9 与 1.1 个点；该趋势在未针对其微调的 LZ78、SEQUITUR 文法压缩器上同样成立。
Conclusion: 文法尺寸可以作为网络权重的显式训练目标，且学到的压缩性可迁移到训练时未对抗的其他文法压缩器；据作者所知这是首次。

papers.title: Multi-agent Scaling Across Disjunctive and Compensatory Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems are often expected to improve as team size increases, yet the scaling behavior may depend on task structure. Our central contribution is to introduce Steiner's taxonomy of group tasks as a framework for analyzing multi-agent LLM scaling and focusing the analysis on disjunctive and compensatory tasks. We model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item, which yields their large-team limits: plurality voting converges to the model's modal answer, and averaging converges to the model's item-level bias. Across selected representative benchmarks, 13 open-weight models, and teams of up to 30 agents, we find qualitatively different scaling behavior. On disjunctive tasks, the probability that at least one agent is correct grows by 5-20 points with team size, but plurality voting over agents that answer directly realises almost none of this potential, as the model predicts to within 0.5 points on average. Multi-round revision raises accuracy considerably, yet the gain is nearly the same with one peer as with 29. In contrast, scaling provides little benefit on Fermi estimation, despite its natural suitability for aggregation: item-level biases shared across the samples of a model account for about 87% of the squared error, so averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Combining model families helps on Fermi estimation but does not surpass the strongest member on disjunctive tasks. These results show that task structure, together with the mechanism combining member outputs, is a fundamental determinant of team scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Steiner 群体任务分类引入多智能体 LLM 扩展分析，指出团队规模的收益取决于任务结构与聚合机制：析取任务上至少一人答对的概率随队伍增大 5–20 个百分点，但直接作答的 plurality voting 几乎兑现不了这一潜力（与模型预测平均偏差 0.5 个百分点以内）；Fermi 估计上扩展几乎无收益，因为模型内 item 级偏差占平方误差约 87%，平均只降误差约 6%。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统普遍假设队伍越大表现越好，但缺少刻画何种任务结构与聚合方式下扩展有效的框架，导致 Fermi 估计这类看似适合聚合的任务也扩展失效。
Method: 引入 Steiner 群体任务分类（disjunctive 与 compensatory）作为分析框架；把独立采样的智能体建模为给定题目条件独立，据此推出大团队极限——plurality voting 收敛到模型众数答案，averaging 收敛到模型 item 级偏差；在选定代表性基准、13 个 open-weight 模型、最多 30 个智能体的团队上检验。
Result: 析取任务上至少一个智能体正确的概率随团队规模增长 5–20 个百分点，但对直接作答的智能体做 plurality voting 几乎不兑现该潜力，模型预测平均误差在 0.5 个百分点以内；多轮修订显著提升准确率，但 1 个 peer 与 29 个 peer 的增益几乎相同。Fermi 估计上 item 级共享偏差约占平方误差 87%，averaging 仅降误差约 6%；跨模型家族组合在 Fermi 估计上有帮助，但在析取任务上不超越最强成员。
Conclusion: 任务结构与聚合机制共同决定多智能体团队能否随规模扩展：析取任务的潜在收益需靠修订而非投票兑现，补偿性 Fermi 估计受共享偏差限制，扩展本身不是普适增益。

papers.title: Generalization behavior of OPTQ and the role of regularization
papers.abstract_en: Large neural networks can be compressed by rounding or "quantizing" their weights to numbers that admit representations with fewer bits. One algorithm for quantization, OPTQ, progressively quantizes the weights of a neural network so that the squared quantization error on a specified calibration dataset is as small as possible. We study the performance of OPTQ and a variant algorithm, stochastic OPTQ, in a generalization setting and derive bounds for the expected squared error accrued by the algorithm when a test point is drawn from a fixed distribution. We prove two results. One result relates the generalization error to the error on a calibration dataset comprising independent samples from the same distribution as the test distribution. The other result bounds the generalization error of stochastic OPTQ for all sufficiently nice distributions, regardless of the calibration dataset. In both of these results, the regularization term $λ$ plays an important role. We use insights from these results to make a new recommendation for the choice of $λ$ and see that this choice of $λ$ preforms favorably in experiments when compared to prior recommendations in the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在压缩（量化）神经网络权重的 OPTQ 上做泛化分析：证明测试点期望平方量化误差与校准集误差之间的联系，以及 stochastic OPTQ 对任意足够好分布、与校准集无关的泛化界，并指出正则化系数 λ 在两个结果中起关键作用。据此给出新的 λ 取值建议，实验中该选择相对文献既有建议表现更优。
Motivation: OPTQ 以最小化校准集上的平方量化误差为目标逐步量化权重，但校准集误差小不等于测试分布上误差小；缺少把校准误差与泛化误差联系起来的理论，λ 的选取也缺乏依据。
Method: 研究 OPTQ 及其随机变体 stochastic OPTQ 的泛化行为，推导测试点从固定分布抽取时期望平方误差的界：一个结果把泛化误差与来自同一分布的独立样本校准集误差相联系，另一个对所有足够好 (sufficiently nice) 的分布给出与校准集无关的 stochastic OPTQ 泛化界；再由这两个结果导出 λ 的新选取建议，并在实验中与文献既有建议比较。
Result: 两个理论结果分别给出泛化误差与校准集误差的关系，以及 stochastic OPTQ 对所有足够好分布、与校准集无关的泛化界，正则化项 λ 在两者中都起关键作用；由结果导出的新 λ 选择在实验中相对文献先前建议表现更有利。
Conclusion: λ 的正则化强度是 OPTQ 泛化的关键旋钮，按新建议取 λ 可在实验中胜过文献既有选择。

papers.title: Online Learning via Learned Latent Bayesian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Online learning in non-stationary environments requires models to adapt rapidly from streaming data under strict computational constraints. A principled approach casts online learning as Bayesian state tracking, where model parameters are updated sequentially via Bayesian filtering. However, applying Bayesian filters directly to modern deep models is computationally prohibitive due to the high dimensionality of parameter space, forcing existing methods to rely on restrictive approximations or manually designed low-dimensional subspaces. In this work, we identify the absence of a suitable low-dimensional dynamical representation as the core bottleneck in Bayesian filtering-based online learning. Accordingly, we propose Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation (AURA), a meta-learning framework that learns offline a low-dimensional latent state-space model governing the evolution of optimal model parameters under distribution shift. Online adaptation is then performed via extended Kalman filtering in this learned latent space followed by reconstruction of the full model parameters through a learned lifting map, enabling efficient single-step online adaptation while preserving model expressiveness. Evaluated on online adaptation of neural wireless receivers under time-varying channels and on non-stationary image classification, AURA shows substantial improvements in adaptation speed, accuracy, and computational efficiency over existing online learning and Bayesian filtering baselines, demonstrating that an adaptation-aware latent geometry is beneficial for effective Bayesian online learning in high-dimensional models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AURA 把在线学习重写为贝叶斯状态跟踪，用元学习离线学出支配最优参数演化的低维潜空间状态空间模型，在线在该潜空间做扩展 Kalman 滤波 (EKF)，再经学习到的 lifting map 还原全量模型参数，实现单步在线适配。在时变信道下的神经无线接收机在线适配与非平稳图像分类两类设定中，其适配速度、准确率与计算效率相对现有在线学习和贝叶斯滤波基线均有明显提升。
Motivation: 把贝叶斯滤波直接用于深度模型参数更新因参数维度太高而计算上不可行，现有方法只能依赖受限近似或人工设计的低维子空间；作者把缺少合适的低维动力学表示视为瓶颈。
Method: 提出元学习框架 Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation (AURA)：离线学习一个描述最优模型参数在分布漂移下演化的低维潜状态空间模型，以及把潜状态映回全参数的 lifting map；在线在潜空间内用 extended Kalman filtering 更新，再重建完整参数，实现单步适配。
Result: 在时变信道下的神经无线接收机在线适配与非平稳图像分类两个任务上，AURA 相对现有在线学习与贝叶斯滤波基线在适配速度、准确率和计算效率上均取得实质性提升。
Conclusion: 适配感知的潜空间几何 (adaptation-aware latent geometry) 是高维模型做有效贝叶斯在线学习的关键，低维潜空间滤波加 lifting 重建可以在保持模型表达力的同时让单步在线适配变得可行。

papers.title: Region-Level Black-Box Defense Against Stealthy Embedding-Space Backdoors in CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining (CLIP) has emerged as a dominant vision backbone due to its strong transferability and zero-shot capabilities. However, recent studies reveal a critical vulnerability: embedding-space backdoor attacks. By poisoning only a tiny fraction of image--text pairs, adversaries can implant stealthy triggers that induce targeted shifts in CLIP's joint embedding space. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate classifier logits, these attacks corrupt representations directly, making them highly effective under extremely low poisoning ratios and difficult to detect. Existing defenses require access to model parameters, gradients, logits, or clean validation data---assumptions that rarely hold in realistic black-box deployments. Moreover, current black-box methods struggle to accurately localize small or out-of-distribution triggers. We propose CLIPGuard, a lightweight and fully black-box defense specifically designed to mitigate embedding-space backdoors in CLIP encoders. CLIPGuard identifies malicious regions by measuring segment-wise embedding perturbations and selectively purifies only suspicious segments via semantic inpainting, preserving benign visual content and alignment quality. Extensive experiments on STL-10, ImageNet, and diverse trigger families---including BadCLIP, BadNets, blended, patch-based, and typographic attacks---demonstrate that CLIPGuard reduces attack success rates to as low as 1.05% while maintaining clean accuracy up to 86.34%, consistently outperforming existing black-box defenses, including CleanCLIP and CleanerCLIP. Our code is available https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/CLIPGuard.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIPGuard 是针对 CLIP 编码器嵌入空间后门的全黑盒防御：按段测量嵌入扰动定位恶意区域，只对可疑段做语义修复 (semantic inpainting)。在 STL-10、ImageNet 上覆盖 BadCLIP、BadNets、blended、patch、typographic 等触发器族，攻击成功率降到最低 1.05%，干净精度保持最高 86.34%，优于 CleanCLIP 与 CleanerCLIP。
Motivation: 嵌入空间后门只需投毒极小比例的图像-文本对即可直接污染 CLIP 联合嵌入，且在极低投毒率下仍高效、难检测；现有防御依赖模型参数、梯度、logits 或干净验证数据，黑盒部署中这些假设通常不成立，且现有黑盒方法难以定位小的或分布外触发器。
Method: CLIPGuard 以完全黑盒方式工作，逐段 (segment-wise) 测量嵌入扰动来识别恶意区域，再仅对可疑段执行语义修复以去除触发器，同时保留良性视觉内容与图文对齐质量；实验覆盖 STL-10、ImageNet 与多种触发器族。
Result: 在 STL-10、ImageNet 及 BadCLIP、BadNets、blended、patch-based、typographic 触发器族上，攻击成功率 (ASR) 降至最低 1.05%，干净精度 (clean accuracy) 保持最高 86.34%，在所测黑盒防御中持续优于 CleanCLIP 与 CleanerCLIP。
Conclusion: 只净化被定位为可疑的图像段，可以在不访问参数、梯度或 logits 的前提下同时压低嵌入空间后门的 ASR 并保住 CLIP 的干净精度与对齐质量。

papers.title: MexHat: A Dataset for Hate Speech Detection in Mexican Spanish Videos
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring online safety through content monitoring had raised Hate Speech Detection as a crucial task to be addressed. By essence the task demands the capture of contextual cues, which are essential for a precise understanding of the content's intent. Although automated detection approaches for the task have advanced significantly, the scarcity of non-English resources persists, limiting the ability of models to adapt to the subtle, context-dependent, and culturally related nature of multimodal content. In this paper, we introduce MexHat, a video dataset designed to capture the linguistic and cultural cues for the hate-speech detection task in a Mexican Spanish context. Our dataset comprises around 1k video clips annotated across two tasks: a three-way class evaluation (no negative content, offensive content and hate-speech content), and a fine-grained class evaluation including three hate-speech sub-categories. The dataset statistics and the baseline results highlight the inherent challenges associated with the task. Disclaimer: This paper contains sensitive content that may be disturbing to some readers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MexHat 是面向墨西哥西班牙语仇恨言论检测的视频数据集，约 1k 段视频片段，标注覆盖三分类（无负面内容、冒犯内容、仇恨言论）与含三个仇恨言论子类的细粒度分类两项任务。数据集统计与基线结果共同显示该任务本身难度高，动机是非英语多模态语料稀缺限制了模型对语境与文化线索的适配。
Motivation: 仇恨言论检测依赖语境与文化线索，但非英语多模态资源稀缺，模型难以适配语境依赖、文化相关的视频内容。
Method: 构建约 1k 段墨西哥西班牙语视频片段数据集，按两项任务标注：三分类评测（无负面内容、冒犯内容、仇恨言论）与含三个仇恨言论子类的细粒度评测，并给出数据集统计与基线结果。
Result: 数据集规模约 1k 视频片段，含两项标注任务（三分类与三个仇恨言论子类的细粒度分类）；数据集统计与基线结果共同凸显该任务的固有挑战。
Conclusion: 墨西哥西班牙语语境下的多模态仇恨言论检测本身具有内在难度，需要专门的语境与文化线索资源来支撑。

papers.title: EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregating the two stages, Prefill and Decode, onto separate GPU pools is now a standard optimization for (text-only) LLM serving. However, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), which add a third phase, Encode, pose new challenges for resource allocation. Encode turns images, video, or audio into embeddings that the language model can consume, yielding a three-stage Encode-Prefill-Decode (EPD) pipeline. Existing frameworks offer only partial answers: text-only PD systems lack Encode, while EPD frameworks expose it as a separate service without regulating downstream request flow. The pipeline also carries a structural resource imbalance: every request enters through Encode before downstream work can begin, yet per-request execution leaves the encode GPU severely underutilized even at high loads, starving the downstream Prefill and Decode workers. Addressing this, we reposition Encode as the control point of the EPD pipeline, exposing three tightly coupled dimensions: when work enters downstream, where prefill executes, and how the GPU is shared. We instantiate this in EAServe across two co-designed layers. Its runtime manages load-adaptive micro-batching, rate-controlled partial offload to a co-resident prefill worker, and dynamic SM partitioning for predictable co-location. The configuration layer, Hybrid Auto Selection (HAS), navigates the joint space of GPU allocation, encode batch size, and offload ratio by pruning unbalanced allocations with per-stage capacity profiling and refining the remainder through TPE-based Bayesian optimization. Evaluated on three MLLM architectures spanning image, video, and audio, EAServe delivers up to 4.3x and 1.7x higher goodput than NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM, respectively, under identical SLO constraints, sustains more balanced and higher GPU utilization across the EPD pipeline, and reaches near-optimal configurations faster than baseline search methods.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to PACT 2026
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Parallel Architectures and Compilation Techniques (PACT '26), October 19-22, 2026, Chicago, IL, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EAServe 把多模态大模型的 Encode 阶段当作 EPD (Encode-Prefill-Decode) 流水线的控制点，用运行时微批与 SM 划分加配置层 Bayesian 搜索来分配 GPU。在覆盖图像、视频、音频的三种 MLLM 架构上，同等 SLO 下 goodput 最高达到 NVIDIA Dynamo 的 4.3 倍、vLLM 的 1.7 倍。
Motivation: 文本 LLM 的 PD 分离已成标准，但 MLLM 多出 Encode 阶段：每个请求必须先过 Encode，而单请求执行又让 encode GPU 在高负载下严重闲置，反过来饿死下游 Prefill 与 Decode。
Method: 运行时层做 load-adaptive micro-batching、按速率控制向同驻 prefill worker 的 partial offload，以及可预测共置的动态 SM partitioning；配置层 Hybrid Auto Selection (HAS) 在 GPU 分配、encode batch size、offload ratio 的联合空间中，先用 per-stage capacity profiling 剪掉不均衡分配，再用 TPE-based Bayesian optimization 精调。
Result: 在三种覆盖图像、视频、音频的 MLLM 架构上，同等 SLO 约束下 goodput 最高为 NVIDIA Dynamo 的 4.3 倍、vLLM 的 1.7 倍；EPD 流水线各阶段 GPU 利用率更均衡且更高，达到近最优配置所需搜索时间短于基线搜索方法。
Conclusion: 把 Encode 当作 EPD 流水线的流控入口，联合调度进入时机、prefill 位置与 GPU 共享方式，可以在不放松 SLO 的前提下同时提高 goodput 与 GPU 利用率。

papers.title: BeatGraph: Self-Supervised Heartbeat Graphs for Infant ECG Representations from the Home Environment
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) foundation models typically tokenize the signal into fixed-length patches that ignore cardiac structure, so a patch may split a heartbeat and the number of beats in each patch shifts with heart rate. This matters most for infants, whose heart rates are higher and whose ECG differs from the adult, clinic-recorded 12-lead data these models are built on. A model for infant ECG should therefore reason about heartbeats directly rather than recover them from arbitrary patches. We propose BeatGraph, which makes the heartbeat its unit of representation, modeling each 30-second window as a graph of beats. A shared beat encoder embeds each heartbeat from its waveform and inter-beat intervals, a Transformer with positional encoding orders the beats in time, and residual graph attention layers relate every beat to every other before attention pooling yields a window embedding. We pretrain BeatGraph on our new corpus of unlabeled infant recordings by predicting masked-beat embeddings, then fine-tune it for each task. One backbone supports sleep-wake detection, infant-state classification, activity-source identification (infant- or caregiver-initiated movement), and affect recognition, improving macro-F1 over the strongest baseline on each task by 0.076 to 0.158. It also transfers across age groups, reaching 0.892 AUROC on the ZZU-pECG pediatric benchmark (ages 0 to 14), within 0.001 of the best published self-supervised ECG model, and matching that model under linear evaluation on the adult PTB-XL benchmark despite infant-only pretraining. Finally, to our knowledge, we release the first public infant ECG corpus collected in homes, classrooms, and laboratory settings with state and affect labels. It contains 3,408 hours of single-channel ECG from 143 infants aged 3 to 11 months, with unlabeled pretraining data, benchmark tasks, and subject-level splits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BeatGraph 把 30 秒 ECG 窗口表示成心跳图而非固定长度 patch，用共享心跳编码器加残差图注意力做自监督预训练，在婴儿居家 ECG 上四个任务的 macro-F1 相对最强基线提升 0.076 到 0.158，并在 ZZU-pECG 上达到 0.892 AUROC。
Motivation: 现有 ECG foundation model 按固定长度 patch 切分信号，会把一次心跳劈开且每段内心跳数随心率漂移；婴儿心率更高、波形又不同于成人 12 导联，patch 式表示尤其失配。
Method: 以心跳为表示单元：共享 beat encoder 从波形与 inter-beat intervals 嵌入每次心跳，带位置编码的 Transformer 排序心跳时序，残差图注意力 (residual graph attention) 连接窗口内所有心跳，再经 attention pooling 得到窗口嵌入；在自采无标签婴儿记录上以 masked-beat embedding 预测做预训练，随后按任务微调。
Result: 单一 backbone 支持 sleep-wake detection、infant-state classification、activity-source identification 与 affect recognition 四个任务，macro-F1 相对最强基线各提升 0.076 至 0.158；跨年龄迁移到 ZZU-pECG 儿科基准 (0–14 岁) 达 0.892 AUROC，距已发表最佳自监督 ECG 模型仅 0.001，在成人 PTB-XL 上 linear evaluation 与该模型持平，尽管预训练只用婴儿数据。发布首个公开居家婴儿语料：143 名 3–11 月龄婴儿、3,408 小时单导联 ECG，含无标签预训练数据、基准任务与 subject-level split。
Conclusion: 以心跳为基本单元的图式表示能让一个 backbone 同时覆盖婴儿状态、活动来源与情感识别，并在仅用婴儿数据预训练的条件下迁移到儿科与成人基准。

papers.title: A Flow Matching Framework for Neural Representational Dissimilarity
papers.abstract_en: Neural representational dissimilarity quantifies differences between neural response distributions, and is essential for comparing neural codes across stimuli, brain areas, tasks, and models. Commonly used distance metrics involve different assumptions and are estimated with separate methods. Here, we show that a variety of distance metrics can be unified under a flow matching framework developed in deep generative models. That is, these distances arise as Jeffreys divergences under different velocity constraints. We find that flow matching has advantages for estimating distances involving complicated distributions and continuous variables. Furthermore, this framework enables the design of new distance metrics in a principled way. Together, flow matching provides a unified approach for understanding, estimating, and designing neural representational dissimilarity metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经表征差异度量统一到深度生成模型的 flow matching 框架下：各类距离都可写成不同速度约束 (velocity constraint) 下的 Jeffreys divergence。该框架对复杂分布与连续变量的距离估计更有优势，并能按原则构造新的距离度量。
Motivation: 神经表征差异度量各自依赖不同假设、且需用不同方法估计，缺少统一视角来理解、估计与设计这些距离。
Method: 以 flow matching 统一多种距离度量，将它们表述为不同速度约束下的 Jeffreys divergence，并据此设计新的距离度量。

papers.title: Can You Check That? The Checkability Boundary for Local LLM Network Automation
papers.abstract_en: Sending every network-automation input to a third-party frontier LLM exports sensitive artifacts such as production configurations, topologies, and logs. Querying small language models (SLMs) locally avoids this egress, but SLM outputs can be error-prone for direct use. This work introduces checkability as a criterion for determining which tasks are suitable for local inference. A task is checkable when it exposes a cheap, deterministic test - an intrinsic check - that rejects outputs violating a necessary correctness condition. We instantiate this idea in Touchstone, a local-first pipeline that uses seven off-the-shelf SLMs (1-8B parameters) to generate candidates, uses task-specific intrinsic checks to reject responses, and escalates unresolved inputs to a frontier LLM. On conflict detection and intent translation tasks, Touchstone reaches 98.6% and 93.8% end-to-end accuracy while escalating only 16% and 17% of inputs, respectively. On TeleQnA, a knowledge-only control that has no task-specific intrinsic checks, Touchstone is unable to match the accuracy of the frontier baseline. Our results support a simple deployment rule: keep inference local when task semantics support precise, low-cost checks; escalate the rest.
papers.comment: Correspondence: Maleeha Masood (maleeha2@illinois.edu) or Momina Nofal (mominanofal@hotmail.com)

papers.title: NEXT: Physics-Informed Neuro-Spectral Exponential Time Differencing Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) build neural representations of time-dependent PDE solutions, naturally incorporating physics knowledge and observational data, which makes them well suited to both forward and inverse PDE problems. PINNs, however, are known to suffer from spectral bias and lack of causality. Neuro-Spectral Architectures (NeuSA), a recently proposed alternative to PINNs, mitigate both issues, but their numerical integration becomes unstable for stiff differential equations arising in many relevant physical problems. This study proposes Neuro-Spectral Exponential Time Differencing Architectures (NEXT), which combines the spectral representation of the PDE solution in NeuSA with high-order exponential integrators. Within this approach, the linear stiff part of the vector field induced by the PDE is integrated exactly through matrix exponentials, while the possibly nonlinear remainder is modeled by a neural network. The effectiveness of NEXT is verified through benchmark experiments on a set of stiff PDEs, in which NEXT is stable and accurate while NeuSA diverges numerically. It is also shown that NEXT can be applied to inverse problems, where the model has to learn unknown parameters or boundary conditions from sparse data. All code used in this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/marcioh2m/next.git .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEXT 把 NeuSA 的谱表示与高阶指数时间差分 (exponential time differencing) 积分器结合：PDE 诱导向量场的线性 stiff 部分用矩阵指数精确积分，非线性余项交给神经网络。在一组 stiff PDE 基准上 NEXT 保持稳定且精确，而 NeuSA 数值发散；同一框架也能从稀疏数据反演未知参数或边界条件。
Motivation: PINN 存在谱偏置与缺乏因果性，NeuSA 虽缓解两者，但对许多物理问题中的 stiff 微分方程数值积分不稳定。
Method: NEXT 保留 NeuSA 对 PDE 解的谱表示，将向量场拆为线性 stiff 部分与非线性余项：前者经矩阵指数由高阶指数积分器精确推进，后者用神经网络建模；同时用于正问题与从稀疏数据学习未知参数/边界条件的反问题。
Result: 在一组 stiff PDE 基准实验中 NEXT 稳定且精确，NeuSA 数值发散；NEXT 可用于从稀疏数据学习未知参数或边界条件的反问题。代码开源在 github.com/marcioh2m/next。
Conclusion: 把 stiff 线性部分交给指数积分器、非线性部分交给神经网络，可让谱架构在 stiff PDE 上数值稳定，并同时覆盖正问题与反问题。

papers.title: HySTAR: Anchored Hypergraphs for Stable Credit Assignment in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning under partial observability and shared rewards requires assigning team outcomes to individual agents and high-order coalitions. A MAPPO-style critic compresses joint behavior into one global value, while critics that dynamically reconstruct the grouping topology change the mapping from agents and coalitions to value components as interactions or active agents evolve. We refer to this inconsistency as structural target drift. We introduce HySTAR, a MAPPO-based framework that separates adaptive representation learning from a temporally consistent high-order value-decomposition basis. HySTAR anchors an overlapping sparse hypergraph as a uniformly covered decomposition scaffold, uses a spatiotemporal encoder to represent physical and task-dependent interactions, and combines temporal and structural relevance to construct agent-specific advantages. Experiments on SMAC, GRF, Traffic Junction, and MPE demonstrate consistent improvements over MAPPO-style, value-factorization, and dynamic-grouping baselines. On the hardest SMAC settings, HySTAR achieves relative gains of 16.7\% over MAPPO and 15.6\% over HYGMA, ranks first on all six GRF scenarios, reduces Traffic Junction convergence epochs by up to 40.2\% relative to MAGIC, and obtains the highest MPE episode rewards. Controlled topology, agent-death, neighborhood, and parameter analyses support the benefit of anchoring the decomposition scaffold while adapting the propagated representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HySTAR 把自适应表征学习与时序一致的高阶价值分解基底分开：用一个均匀覆盖的重叠稀疏超图锚定分解脚手架，避免动态重构分组拓扑导致的 structural target drift，再用时空编码器与时间-结构相关性构造 agent 级 advantage。在 SMAC 最难设定上相对 MAPPO 提升 16.7%、相对 HYGMA 提升 15.6%，GRF 六个场景全部第一，Traffic Junction 收敛轮数相对 MAGIC 最多减少 40.2%，MPE episode reward 最高。
Motivation: 部分可观测、共享奖励的合作 MARL 需要把团队回报分摊到个体与高阶联盟；MAPPO 式 critic 把联合行为压成单一全局值，而动态重构分组拓扑的 critic 会随交互与活跃 agent 变化改变 agent/联盟到价值分量的映射，作者称之为 structural target drift。
Method: HySTAR 基于 MAPPO：锚定一个重叠稀疏超图作为均匀覆盖的分解脚手架，用时空编码器表示物理与任务相关交互，并结合时间相关性与结构相关性构造 agent 专属 advantage；受控的拓扑、agent 死亡、邻域与参数量分析用于检验锚定脚手架同时传播表征可自适应这一设计。
Result: 在 SMAC、GRF、Traffic Junction、MPE 上相对 MAPPO 式、价值分解与动态分组基线一致提升：最难 SMAC 设定相对 MAPPO 提升 16.7%、相对 HYGMA 提升 15.6%；GRF 六个场景全部排名第一；Traffic Junction 收敛轮数相对 MAGIC 最多减少 40.2%；MPE 取得最高 episode reward。
Conclusion: 分解脚手架应当被锚定而传播表征保持自适应，这样可以稳定高阶价值分解的映射并同时改善合作 MARL 的收敛速度与最终回报。

papers.title: Structured Reasoning Agentic Framework for Interpretable Critical View of Safety Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Surgical scene understanding is critical for computer-assisted intervention, yet laparoscopic cholecystectomy remains challenged by the complex anatomy of the hepatocystic triangle and the risk of bile duct injury. Existing methods for Critical View of Safety (CVS) assessment typically treat it as a holistic prediction task, mapping visual features directly to criterion-level labels. This black-box paradigm lacks explicit reasoning about anatomical relationships, limiting both interpretability and compositional generalization. To address this, we propose ReasonCVS, a structured reasoning agentic framework empowered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that decomposes CVS assessment into explicit, fine-grained anatomical verification. Specifically, we devise an Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA) that organizes anatomical entities and their spatial relationships into a structured representation. To operationalize this, we introduce a Rationale-Aware Reasoning Agent, powered by a Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuned via rationale distillation. Functioning as a strict central decision-maker, it invokes VLM-driven Sub-criterion Verifier as a specialized perceptual tool to parse the graph and independently evaluate individual sub-criteria. Through calibrated soft reasoning, this agent synthesizes the tool-gathered distributed observations, yielding a final verdict alongside a traceable clinical rationale. Extensive experiments on the Endoscapes-CVS201 benchmark demonstrate that ReasonCVS achieves superior performance (68.1\% mAP) over state-of-the-art while providing interpretable, criterion-level explanations for reliable surgical assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReasonCVS 把腹腔镜胆囊切除术的 Critical View of Safety (CVS) 评估从整体黑盒分类拆成显式细粒度解剖验证：先用 Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA) 把解剖实体与空间关系组织成图，再由经 rationale distillation 微调的 LLM 作为中心决策 agent，调用 VLM 驱动的 Sub-criterion Verifier 逐条核验子标准，经校准软推理汇总出结论与可追溯临床理由。在 Endoscapes-CVS201 上达到 68.1% mAP，超过 SOTA，同时给出准则级可解释说明。
Motivation: 现有 CVS 评估把视觉特征直接映射到准则级标签，缺少对解剖关系的显式推理，可解释性与组合泛化都受限；而腹腔镜胆囊切除术中肝胆三角解剖复杂、胆管损伤风险高。
Method: 提出 ReasonCVS：ASGA 将解剖实体与空间关系编码为结构化场景图；rationale-aware reasoning agent 由经 rationale distillation 微调的 LLM 充当严格中心决策者，把 VLM Sub-criterion Verifier 当作感知工具调用，独立解析图并逐条评估子标准，再以 calibrated soft reasoning 汇总分布式观测。
Result: 在 Endoscapes-CVS201 benchmark 上取得 68.1% mAP，优于 SOTA，并输出准则级、可追溯的临床解释。
Conclusion: 把 CVS 评估分解为图结构化的子标准核验加中心 LLM 决策，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下换来可解释的准则级判定与临床理由。

papers.title: Retrainable physics-integrated neural differentiable modeling of sintering across material systems
papers.abstract_en: Sintering is widely used to manufacture ceramics, but coupled densification and grain growth, material-dependent kinetics, and sparse measurements complicate predictive modeling and process design. We present Sinter-PiNDiff, a retrainable physics-integrated neural differentiable framework for predicting density and grain-size evolution. Two neural networks learn densification and grain-growth coefficients within coupled rate equations, while a smooth saturation factor attenuates densification near theoretical density. The same governing structure, network architecture, and training procedure were fitted independently to published data for MgO, Al-doped ZnO, and CaO-doped ThO2. Tests at held-out temperatures and compositions yielded the lowest mean error in all twelve material-metric comparisons against multilayer perceptron and residual network baselines. For MgO, Al-doped ZnO, and CaO-doped ThO2, respectively, density normalized root-mean-square errors were 14.6%, 10.8%, and 14.4%, and grain-size errors using the same metric were 8.6%, 12.1%, and 19.3%. Removing evolving density from both neural-network inputs increased density and grain-size trajectory errors in all three systems and ten of twelve aggregate errors, supporting density-dependent kinetic feedback. Deep ensembles estimated model disagreement, but empirical coverage showed that the uncertainty bands were not calibrated and did not capture all model-data discrepancies. These results establish Sinter-PiNDiff as a retrainable framework for sparse-data prediction and uncertainty-informed selection of sintering conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可重训练的物理集成神经微分框架 Sinter-PiNDiff：两个神经网络在耦合速率方程中学习致密化与晶粒生长系数，并用平滑饱和因子在接近理论密度时抑制致密化。同一结构与训练流程分别拟合 MgO、Al 掺杂 ZnO、CaO 掺杂 ThO2 的已发表数据，在留出温度与成分上，12 项材料-指标对比中全部取得最低平均误差，密度 NRMSE 分别为 14.6%、10.8%、14.4%，晶粒尺寸为 8.6%、12.1%、19.3%。
Motivation: 烧结过程中致密化与晶粒生长耦合、动力学随材料变化且测量稀疏，难以做预测建模与工艺设计。
Method: Sinter-PiNDiff 把两个神经网络嵌入耦合速率方程分别参数化致密化与晶粒生长系数，加入平滑饱和因子在接近理论密度时衰减致密化项；同一方程结构、网络架构与训练流程独立拟合 MgO、Al-doped ZnO、CaO-doped ThO2 的已发表数据，并在留出温度与成分上测试，对照 MLP 与 ResNet 基线，另用 deep ensemble 估计模型分歧。

papers.title: Forensic Twins: Self-Supervised Residual Learning for AI-Generated Image Forensics
papers.abstract_en: Detectors of AI-generated images are typically trained using samples from all Generative AI architectures they must catch, and struggle as soon as a new architecture emerges. Recent approaches have explored self-supervised pre-training as an alternative solution, yet standard frameworks work against the forensic task, e.g., their augmentations overwrite the micro-statistics of image formation. This paper introduces Forensic Twins, a Self-Supervised Residual Learning (SSRL) framework whose pretext task suppresses macroscopic content availability. Each image is mapped through a frozen, off-the-shelf forensic residual extractor, from which two spatially disjoint crops are drawn. Sharing no pixel, the two views retain minimal semantic structure to align, leaving a redundancy-reduction objective with a predominant common signal: the stationary fingerprint of the image acquisition pipeline. Additionally, Forensic Twins is trained exclusively on real images; no AI-generated image is observed at any stage. Experiments show that Forensic Twins attributes AI generator sources with 56.61% accuracy, i.e., 6.13% above the previous state-of-the-art zero-shot method at 375x lower latency. We also demonstrate that fitting a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) offline using only the real image embeddings extracted from Forensic Twins turns it into a state-of-the-art zero-shot detector, reaching 97.99% AUC across 27 unseen AI generators, including GANs, diffusion models and commercial systems. Code, weights and exact splits will be made publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Forensic Twins 用自监督残差学习 (SSRL) 做 AI 生成图像取证：把图像过一个冻结的取证残差提取器，取两个空间不相交、不共享像素的裁剪，用冗余缩减目标只保留成像管线的稳态指纹，且全程只用真实图像训练。源归因零样本准确率 56.61%，比此前 SOTA 高 6.13 个百分点、延迟低 375 倍；再用真实图像嵌入离线拟合 GMM，对 27 个未见 AI 生成器达 97.99% AUC。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器要见过所有生成架构才能训，新架构一出现就失效；自监督预训练的常规增强又会覆盖成像微统计，反而破坏取证线索。
Method: SSRL 框架 Forensic Twins：每张图先过冻结的现成取证残差提取器，从中取两个空间不相交、不共享像素的裁剪作为两个视图，语义重叠极小，于是预文本任务退化为以成像管线稳态指纹为主导公共信号的冗余缩减目标；训练数据仅含真实图像，任何阶段都不见 AI 生成图。推理侧另用真实图像嵌入离线拟合 Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) 做零样本检测。
Result: AI 生成源归因准确率 56.61%，比此前 SOTA 零样本方法高 6.13 个百分点，同时延迟低 375 倍；仅用真实图像嵌入离线拟合 GMM 后，在 27 个未见 AI 生成器（含 GAN、diffusion 模型与商业系统）上达到 97.99% AUC。
Conclusion: 把宏观内容压掉、只对成像管线稳态指纹做冗余缩减，并且完全不依赖 AI 生成样本，就能同时拿到更强的零样本泛化与低延迟的 AI 生成图像取证。

papers.title: ClearGS: Reliability-Aware Gaussian Splatting from Handheld Videos
papers.abstract_en: We present ClearGS for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) from handheld videos with uneven viewpoint coverage and mixed frame quality. Rather than selecting frames with binary decisions, ClearGS uses Reliability-aware View Allocation (RVA) to assign graded raw-supervision weights based on appearance reliability, degradation risk, and geometric utility, while weakly reactivating useful suppressed frames to maintain trajectory coverage. Since weighting cannot restore details lost to blur or distortion, ClearGS further introduces Render-Guided In-Video Restoration (RIVR). The current 3DGS render provides a pose-aligned structural candidate, a frozen no-reference restoration expert restores the corresponding raw video observation without any clean reference image, and no-reference perceptual scores select among the render, restored observation, and high-frequency fused candidate. ClearGS then applies Full-Trajectory Repair Consolidation to revisit accepted repairs and preserve details introduced early. On GS2E and GSOTM, ClearGS achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with consistent CLIP-IQA and MUSIQ gains and LPIPS reductions in most degradation settings, without paired sharp supervision or matched clean references.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClearGS 面向手持视频重建 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)：用 Reliability-aware View Allocation (RVA) 给每帧打分级监督权重而非二值筛选，再用 Render-Guided In-Video Restoration (RIVR) 借当前渲染做位姿对齐结构候选、由冻结的无参考修复专家恢复原始帧并按无参考感知分数择优。在 GS2E 与 GSOTM 上取得整体 SOTA，多数退化设定下 CLIP-IQA 与 MUSIQ 一致提升、LPIPS 下降，且全程不需要配对清晰监督或匹配的干净参考。
Motivation: 手持视频视角覆盖不均、画质混杂，传统二值选帧会丢掉有用轨迹段，而模糊与畸变造成的细节损失靠加权本身无法恢复。
Method: RVA 按外观可靠性、退化风险与几何效用分配分级 raw-supervision 权重，并弱激活被抑制但仍维持轨迹覆盖的帧；RIVR 用当前 3DGS 渲染作为位姿对齐结构候选，冻结的无参考修复专家在无干净参考下修复对应原始视频帧，再由无参考感知分数在渲染、修复观测与高频融合候选间选择；最后 Full-Trajectory Repair Consolidation 回访已接受的修复以保留早期引入的细节。
Result: 在 GS2E 与 GSOTM 上取得整体 state-of-the-art 表现，多数退化设定下 CLIP-IQA 与 MUSIQ 一致提升、LPIPS 下降，且不使用配对清晰监督或匹配的干净参考。
Conclusion: 分级可靠性加权加无参考渲染引导修复，可以在没有清晰参考图像的条件下同时保住轨迹覆盖与细节，把手持视频 3DGS 的整体质量推到 SOTA。

papers.title: SatNav: A Scalable Benchmark for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation from Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Urban uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions across extended urban spaces, inherently demanding long-term memory and geospatial grounding. However, scaling existing benchmarks remains difficult because of their reliance on costly reconstructed 3D assets, limiting geographic diversity and episode scale. To address this, we introduce SatNav, a scalable, long-horizon UAV VLN benchmark built from high-resolution satellite imagery. SatNav targets city-level navigation missions and uses satellite crops as approximations of UAV nadir views for visual observations. Through an automated cue-to-episode pipeline, SatNav constructs 118K episodes from 59 scenes across 18 cities, with an average trajectory length of 379 m. To stress-test long-horizon memory and geospatial reasoning, SatNav defines three task families: Boundary, Landmark, and Route, targeting loop progress tracking, landmark-based spatial grounding, and route following with counting cues. Benchmarking classical VLN agents and recent agents based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) on SatNav shows that city-scale navigation remains challenging. We further introduce SwiftVLN, a modular framework with switchable memory components, and conduct systematic memory-design ablations. Finally, satellite-to-UAV transfer experiments show that satellite-trained navigation models can operate on real-flight UAV observations, showing the practical relevance of SatNav. Our project page: https://eku127.github.io/SatNav/
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 32 pages, 16 figures. Project page: https://eku127.github.io/SatNav/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SatNav 用高分辨率卫星影像替代昂贵的 3D 重建资产，通过自动化 cue-to-episode 流水线构建城市级 UAV 视觉-语言导航 (VLN) 基准：118K 条 episode、59 个场景、18 座城市，平均轨迹长 379 米，并设 Boundary、Landmark、Route 三类任务压测长时程记忆与地理空间推理。在该基准上评测经典 VLN agent 与基于 LVLM 的近期 agent 后发现城市尺度导航仍然困难；卫星影像训练的模型可直接迁移到真实飞行 UAV 观测上运行。
Motivation: 现有 UAV VLN 基准依赖成本高昂的重建 3D 资产，地理多样性与 episode 规模都难以扩展，长时程记忆与地理空间 grounding 缺少城市级的检验场。
Method: 以高分辨率卫星裁剪图 (satellite crops) 近似 UAV 下视 (nadir) 视觉观测，用自动化 cue-to-episode 流水线生成任务；定义 Boundary（环路进度追踪）、Landmark（地标空间 grounding）、Route（带计数线索的路径跟随）三类任务族。另提出模块化框架 SwiftVLN，记忆组件可切换，并做系统性记忆设计消融。
Result: 构建 118K episodes、覆盖 18 座城市 59 个场景，平均轨迹长度 379 米；在 SatNav 上评测经典 VLN agent 与近期 LVLM agent 显示城市尺度导航仍具挑战；卫星到 UAV 的迁移实验表明卫星训练的导航模型可在真实飞行 UAV 观测上运行。
Conclusion: 用卫星影像近似下视观测可以绕开 3D 资产成本，把 UAV VLN 基准推到城市尺度与十万级 episode，且学到的导航能力对真实飞行观测具备迁移性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Evaluating Cultural Awareness of LLMs for Haitian Creole
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit substantial performance disparities between high- and low-resource languages. Beyond lower task performance, they often fail to capture the cultural norms and values of underrepresented communities. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of cultural awareness in LLMs for Haitian Creole, a language spoken by millions but severely underrepresented in digital resources. We assess cultural awareness along four complementary dimensions---specificity, bias, diversity, and variation---using a benchmark of culturally salient prompts curated by native speakers in a text infilling setting. Our results reveal a clear gap between cultural awareness in Haitian Creole and higher-resource French, with Haitian performance being more uneven across domains and more affected by French linguistic interference. Story generation further reveals recurring portrayals of Haitian characters through hardship and resilience, showing that even positive characterizations can encode stereotypical narratives. Our code, benchmark, and evaluation framework are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首个海地克里奥尔语 (Haitian Creole) LLM 文化意识评测：用母语者整理的文化显著 prompt，在文本填空 (text infilling) 设定下按 specificity、bias、diversity、variation 四个维度衡量。结果显示海地克里奥尔语与高资源法语之间存在清晰差距，海地语表现跨领域更不均衡、更受法语语言干扰影响；故事生成中海地角色反复以苦难与坚韧出现，说明正面刻画也会编码刻板叙事。
Motivation: LLM 在高低资源语言间性能差距大，且常无法捕捉代表性不足群体的文化规范与价值；海地克里奥尔语有数百万使用者但数字资源严重不足，此前没有系统性的文化意识评测。
Method: 由母语者整理文化显著 prompt 构成 benchmark，以文本填空形式评测 LLM，沿四个互补维度打分：specificity、bias、diversity、variation；另用故事生成检查海地角色的刻画方式。代码、benchmark 与评测框架公开。
Result: 海地克里奥尔语的文化意识与高资源法语之间存在清晰差距；海地语表现跨领域更不均衡，且更受法语语言干扰；故事生成中海地角色反复被以苦难与坚韧刻画，正面刻画同样编码了刻板叙事。
Conclusion: 即使面向正面刻画，LLM 仍会把刻板叙事写进海地角色，语言资源不足会同时放大性能差距与文化失真；评测框架与 benchmark 公开可复用。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 首个海地克里奥尔语 (Haitian Creole) LLM 文化意识评测：用母语者整理的文化显著 prompt，在文本填空 (text infilling) 设定下按 specificity、bias、diversity、variation 四个维度衡量。结果显示海地克里奥尔语与高资源法语之间存在清晰差距，海地语表现跨领域更不均衡、更受法语语言干扰影响；故事生成中海地角色反复以苦难与坚韧出现，说明正面刻画也会编码刻板叙事。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 在高低资源语言间性能差距大，且常无法捕捉代表性不足群体的文化规范与价值；海地克里奥尔语有数百万使用者但数字资源严重不足，此前没有系统性的文化意识评测。

papers.title: Prompt Minimization: Reducing Input Redundancy Without Sacrificing Output Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Despite the growing capabilities of large language models (LLMs), prompt design remains largely heuristic and ad hoc. This project will explore $\textit{prompt minimization}$, the process of reducing prompts to their smallest, most information-dense form while preserving output fidelity. Practically, shorter prompts reduce computational overhead and inference latency, especially when large contexts, such as entire documents or codebases, are included unnecessarily. Further, longer prompts can damage LLM reasoning and accuracy. Theoretically, the existence of multiple prompts yielding equivalent outputs suggests a high degree of redundancy in the input space, raising fundamental questions about what information is essential to elicit specific model behaviors. We propose three variant frameworks to identify and evaluate minimal prompts and demonstrate that minimal prompts often produce outputs comparable to those of their longer counterparts. These findings suggest new directions for efficient prompt engineering and deepen our understanding of input compression in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 prompt minimization：把提示压缩到信息最密集的最短形式而保持输出保真度，并给出三个变体框架来识别与评估最小提示。结论是最小提示常能产生与长提示相当的输出，因而可削减上下文冗余带来的计算开销与推理延迟。
Motivation: 提示设计至今 largely heuristic and ad hoc，大上下文（整篇文档或代码库）常被不必要地塞进提示，既抬高计算开销与推理延迟，也会损害 LLM 的推理与准确性；输入空间中存在大量产出等价输出的提示，说明冗余度很高。
Method: 提出三个变体框架 (three variant frameworks) 用于识别并评估最小提示，以输出保真度 (output fidelity) 作为约束，把提示压缩到最小、信息最密集的形式。
Result: 最小提示常产生与其更长对应版本相当 (comparable) 的输出；摘要给出的是定性结论，未附具体数据集或指标数值。
Conclusion: 输入空间存在高度冗余，提示可以在不牺牲输出保真的前提下被压缩，这为高效提示工程与 LLM 输入压缩研究指出新方向。

papers.title: Retail Product Search: A Practical Approach at Target
papers.abstract_en: Search is one of the most important features in e-commerce, directly driving customer engagement and business growth. A good product search system must show both relevant and desirable results. However, retail search presents unique challenges. User intent can range from exact matches to open-ended discovery. Search systems must also balance multiple goals, such as relevance, revenue, and profit, while keeping response times low. Traditional keyword-based methods often fall short in handling natural language or semantic queries. Vector search helps alleviate these issues, but it can miss key intent signals or return low-precision results. In this paper, we present the design of a hybrid search system at Target that combines lexical and vector search. We describe our approach to data processing, embedding training, precision control for the final result set, multi-channel result fusion (where we compared fusion strategies and adopted weighted interleaving), and the performance optimizations used to maintain low latency for production deployment. Our method improves offline evaluation metrics, and in online A/B testing it raised click-through rate by 0.97%, order conversion by 0.98%, and demand per visitor by 1.10% over lexical-only search, while roughly halving zero-result searches. The resulting system is deployed at scale and serves millions of guests daily.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Target 上线了一套词法与向量混合的零售商品搜索系统，通过多通道结果融合（比较后采用 weighted interleaving）与精度控制同时保住相关性和商业目标。在线 A/B 中相对纯词法搜索 CTR 提升 0.97%、下单转化提升 0.98%、人均需求提升 1.10%，零结果搜索约减半，已在生产环境日服务数百万顾客。
Motivation: 零售搜索要同时覆盖精确匹配到开放式发现的意图，并在相关性、营收、利润与低延迟之间取舍；纯关键词方法处理不好自然语言与语义查询，纯向量搜索又会漏掉意图信号或精度偏低。
Method: 构建词法+向量的混合检索：数据处理、embedding 训练、最终结果集的精度控制、多通道结果融合（对比多种融合策略后选用 weighted interleaving），并做性能优化以满足生产延迟要求。
Result: 在线 A/B 相对纯词法搜索：点击率 +0.97%，下单转化 +0.98%，人均需求 (demand per visitor) +1.10%，零结果搜索约减少一半；离线评估指标亦有提升。系统已规模化部署，日服务数百万顾客。
Conclusion: 词法与向量混合加上加权交织融合，能在保持低延迟的生产环境中同时改善搜索相关性与商业指标，并大幅减少零结果查询。

papers.title: UQ-LOB: Uncertainty-Aware Limit Order Book Mid-Price Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting short-horizon mid-price movements from limit order book (LOB) data is central to algorithmic trading, yet most deep LOB forecasters are point predictors: they output a direction or a displacement, but never indicate which of their forecasts can be trusted. We introduce UQ-LOB, a lightweight, encoder-agnostic uncertainty quantification module that attaches to any pretrained LOB encoder and, in the spirit of attentive neural processes, conditions each forecast on a context set of recently completed windows whose outcomes are already realised. The UQ-regression variant outputs a calibrated Gaussian over the future tick displacement, while the UQ-classification variant outputs a categorical distribution over down/up/stationary. Both expose a scalar confidence (predicted signal-to-noise ratio or class probability) that supports selective prediction. On 5.2 billion LOB events across seven cryptocurrency assets and horizons of 5, 10 and 15 seconds, UQ-regression attains near-nominal 68% interval coverage, and restricting to the most confident 10% of predictions raises directional macro F1 by 0.11-0.15 for UQ-regression and 0.05-0.11 for UQ-classification, at every horizon. On large, economically meaningful moves, the tightest confidence tier reaches a directional F1 of 0.88 (down) and 0.83 (up) at the 5-second horizon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UQ-LOB 是一个可挂在任意预训练 LOB 编码器上的轻量不确定性量化模块，用 attentive neural process 式的上下文集（近期已实现结果的窗口）条件化每次预测，输出校准的高斯区间或 down/up/stationary 类别分布，并给出可用于选择性预测的标量置信度。在 52 亿条 LOB 事件、7 种加密资产、5/10/15 秒三个期限上，UQ-regression 达到接近标称的 68% 区间覆盖率；只保留最自信的 10% 预测，方向性 macro F1 在 UQ-regression 上提升 0.11–0.15、UQ-classification 上提升 0.05–0.11，且在所有期限成立。
Motivation: 深度 LOB 预报器普遍是点预测，只给方向或位移，不说明哪些预测可信，交易端无法据此做选择性下单。
Method: UQ-LOB 作为编码器无关的附加模块接入任意预训练 LOB 编码器，借 attentive neural processes 的思路用近期已实现结果的窗口构成 context set 来条件化预测；UQ-regression 输出未来 tick 位移的校准高斯分布，UQ-classification 输出 down/up/stationary 的类别分布，两者都暴露标量置信度（预测信噪比或类别概率）以支持 selective prediction。
Result: 在 52 亿 LOB 事件、7 种加密资产、5/10/15 秒期限上，UQ-regression 达到接近标称的 68% 区间覆盖率；只取最自信的 10% 预测，方向性 macro F1 提升 0.11–0.15（UQ-regression）与 0.05–0.11（UQ-classification），每个期限均如此。对大幅且经济意义显著的价格变动，最紧置信层在 5 秒期限的方向性 F1 为 0.88（down）与 0.83（up）。
Conclusion: 给 LOB 点预测器外挂一个轻量 UQ 头即可把置信度变成可校准、可用于选择性预测的信号，在加密资产短期限上高置信子集的方向准确度显著更高。
Relevance: 4
