papers.title: Scaling Density Functional Theory with Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Density functional theory (DFT) strikes a practical balance between accuracy and computational cost in many problems of computational chemistry and materials science. However, many DFT calculations are limited by fixed atom-centered basis sets, which dictate how accuracy and cost scale with system size. We propose Gaussian Splatting for Density Functional Theory (GS-DFT), which represents molecular orbitals as a cloud of Gaussians whose positions, shapes, and mixing coefficients are optimized jointly by gradient descent to minimize the energy without training data. Conceptually, GS-DFT is 3D Gaussian splatting with the renderer replaced by quantum mechanics. We introduce two key solver components: adaptive density fitting with screening for efficient evaluation of two-electron integrals, and a regularized differentiable orthogonalization of the molecular orbitals. Empirically, the optimized basis reaches the accuracy of the largest conventional basis sets with a fraction of the parameters, converging systematically in energy, density, and nuclear forces. At equal parameter count, it captures the stretched-bond and anion physics that fixed bases only recover with specialized basis augmentation. The resulting solver exhibits quadratic peak memory scaling in the cloud size, allowing us to simulate systems of up to 2,742 atoms (10,406 electrons) without any modifications at triple-zeta scale using a single four-GPU node.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GS-DFT 把分子轨道表示成一团可优化的 Gaussian（位置、形状、混合系数一起用梯度下降调），渲染器换成量子力学，无需训练数据即可最小化能量。优化后的基组以远少于传统基组的参数量达到最大传统基组的精度，并在等参数量下捕捉到通常需要专门基组增强才有的伸缩键与阴离子物理；求解器内存随云规模呈二次方峰值扩展，单节点四 GPU、triple-zeta 精度下可算到 2,742 原子（10,406 电子）。
Motivation: DFT 计算精度与成本随体系大小的标度被固定的原子中心基组锁死，伸缩键与阴离子等难例只能靠专门的基组增强才能描述。
Method: GS-DFT 用 Gaussian 云表示分子轨道，联合优化位置、形状与混合系数以最小化能量（无训练数据）；两个求解器组件是带 screening 的自适应密度拟合 (adaptive density fitting) 用于高效求双电子积分，以及带正则化的可微正交化 (regularized differentiable orthogonalization)。
Result: 优化基组以远少于最大传统基组的参数量达到其精度，并在能量、密度、核力上系统收敛；等参数量下捕捉到固定基组需专门增强才有的伸缩键与阴离子物理；峰值内存随云规模二次方标度，在单个四 GPU 节点、triple-zeta 精度、无任何修改下模拟到 2,742 原子（10,406 电子）。
Conclusion: 把基组本身变成可优化的 Gaussian 云，可以在远小的参数预算下达到传统大基组精度并把 DFT 可达体系推到数千原子规模。

papers.title: "AI is (not) the new...": A Diagnostic Analogy Framework for Generative AI's Cultural Impacts
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI is reshaping the cultural infrastructures through which knowledge is found, synthesized, and held accountable. To make sense of this shift, scholars and policymakers reach for historical analogies of technologies such as the printing press, steam power or electricity. But these comparisons are typically imprecise about which property of the technology carries the comparison, and imprecise analogies produce imprecise governance by designing interventions against the wrong property of the system. This paper offers a diagnostic framework for analyzing how generative AI can transform epistemic and cultural practice. This paper offers a diagnostic framework for analyzing how generative AI can transform epistemic and cultural practice. We decompose each intervention into three coordinates: the epistemic site at which a technology acts, the governing logic by which it organizes its object, and the technical mechanism through which the logic is instantiated. This framework allows us to distinguish between structural cultural consequences, which follow from the mechanism itself, from contingent ones, which remain open to design and institutional choice. Applying the framework to information discovery and knowledge synthesis, we show how the shift from indexicality to inference and from editorial authority to statistical consensus produces specific, traceable cultural effects and reveals governance levers that gestalt analogy obscures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出生成式 AI 文化影响的诊断类比框架，把任何干预拆成三个坐标：技术作用的认识论位置 (epistemic site)、组织其对象的支配逻辑 (governing logic)、以及逻辑落地的技术机制 (technical mechanism)。据此可把由机制本身决定的结构性文化后果，与仍取决于设计和制度选择的偶发后果分开；应用于信息发现与知识合成，指出从 indexicality 转向 inference、从编辑权威转向统计共识会产生可追踪的文化效应并显露出治理杠杆。
Motivation: 学者与政策制定者常用印刷术、蒸汽动力、电力等历史类比理解生成式 AI，但这些类比说不清究竟是技术的哪个属性在支撑比较，不精确的类比会让人针对系统的错误属性设计干预，导致不精确的治理。
Method: 提出诊断框架，把每项干预分解为三个坐标：认识论位置、支配逻辑、技术机制；用该框架区分结构性文化后果与偶发后果，并把它应用于信息发现与知识合成两个场景。
Result: 在信息发现与知识合成的应用中，框架显示从 indexicality 到 inference、从 editorial authority 到 statistical consensus 的转变产生具体、可追踪的文化效应，并揭示被整体式 (gestalt) 类比遮蔽的治理杠杆。

papers.title: Game Arena: Strategic LLM Evaluation in Competitive Environments
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kaggle Game Arena, an open and ever-expanding platform to evaluate large language models (LLMs) through competitive games. Different from static benchmarks, game arena enables models to play head-to-head matchups in structured environments where the gameplay strength naturally increases as models evolve, preventing performance saturation. This technical report details the infrastructure behind Game Arena and describes the three pilot game environments: Chess, Poker, and Werewolf. These environments span perfect information, imperfect information, and multiplayer game settings, enabling a systematic study of models' strategic planning, adaptation, and robustness under uncertainty. For each game, we provide a detailed description of the environment, evaluation metrics, and results from running full competitions across models. Through robust infrastructure and large-scale ground-truth based evaluation, Game Arena ensures reproducibility, transparency and generalizability to new games and variants over time.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 15 figures. Technical report. Project page: https://www.kaggle.com/game-arena
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kaggle Game Arena 是一个用对抗性棋类游戏评测 LLM 的开放平台，模型在 Chess、Poker、Werewolf 三种结构化环境中进行 head-to-head 对抗，随模型迭代游戏强度自然上升，从而避免静态基准的性能饱和。三个环境分别覆盖完全信息、不完全信息与多人博弈，用大规模 ground-truth 评测给出可复现、可扩展到新游戏的策略能力结果。
Motivation: 静态 LLM 基准会随模型进步而饱和，无法持续区分模型在策略规划、适应性与不确定性下鲁棒性的差异。
Method: 构建 Game Arena 基础设施，提供三个 pilot 环境：Chess（完全信息）、Poker（不完全信息）、Werewolf（多人），对每个游戏给出环境定义、评测指标，并运行跨模型的完整竞赛，采用 ground-truth 评测保证可复现与可推广。
Result: 产出三个游戏环境的完整竞赛结果与对应评测指标，覆盖完全信息、不完全信息、多人三类设置；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 对抗式游戏竞技场可作为随模型演进而不饱和的 LLM 策略能力评测方式，并可扩展到新游戏与变体。

papers.title: Beyond Empirical Support: Structured Outlier Generation via Sinkhorn Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Outliers are essential for evaluating and improving the robustness of machine learning systems, especially when future distributions may differ significantly from historical training data. In high-stakes applications, robustness often depends on rare cases that finite datasets fail to capture, making simple resampling or perturbation insufficient for stress scenario generation. Existing outlier synthesis methods typically rely on sparse neighborhoods, low support latent regions, or classifier boundary crossings, which can be heuristic, unstable, and tied to specific modalities or architectures. We therefore propose Sinkhorn Boundary Outlier Generation (SBOG), a structured framework for latent-space outlier generation that couples Sinkhorn optimal transport geometry with distributionally robust boundary modeling. The resulting Sinkhorn-induced support cost guides the sampler toward weakly supported boundary regions, while semantic constraints prevent uncontrolled drift from the intended context, yielding controlled deviations from the in-distribution reference measure rather than arbitrary sparse-region samples. Experiments on time series anomaly generation and image outlier synthesis show that our framework produces informative, semantically controlled outliers and improves downstream robustness evaluation across modalities, providing a foundation for stress scenario generation beyond empirical support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sinkhorn Boundary Outlier Generation (SBOG)，在隐空间用 Sinkhorn 最优传输几何耦合分布鲁棒边界建模，把采样导向弱支撑边界区域，同时用语义约束限制偏离分布内参考测度的幅度。在时间序列异常生成与图像 outlier 合成两类实验上，该框架产出语义受控的 outlier 并改进下游鲁棒性评估。
Motivation: 高风险场景下鲁棒性取决于有限数据集覆盖不到的稀有样本，简单重采样或扰动不足以生成压力场景；现有 outlier 合成依赖稀疏邻域、低支撑隐区域或分类器边界穿越，启发式、不稳定且绑定特定模态或架构。
Method: SBOG 在隐空间做 outlier 生成：Sinkhorn 最优传输几何导出的支撑代价 (Sinkhorn-induced support cost) 引导采样器走向弱支撑边界区域，分布鲁棒边界建模刻画边界，语义约束阻止偏离目标上下文，得到相对分布内参考测度的受控偏离而非任意稀疏区域样本。
Result: 在时间序列异常生成与图像 outlier 合成两类实验上，框架生成信息量高且语义受控的 outlier，并在跨模态的下游鲁棒性评估中带来改进。
Conclusion: 把最优传输几何与分布鲁棒边界建模结合，可以在隐空间生成超出经验支撑但语义受控的 outlier，作为跨模态压力场景生成的基础。

papers.title: LandscapeSHAP: Which Persistent Homology Class Gets the Credit?
papers.abstract_en: Shapley values, a solution concept from cooperative game theory, have recently become a standard tool for feature credit allocation in machine learning. They provide an axiomatically justified method to fairly distribute a model's prediction among the data features. Shapley values have not yet been applied to explain machine learning models trained on features from topological data analysis. We develop what we believe is the first such approach, focusing on the persistence landscape featurization of persistence diagrams. Because each landscape coordinate is a rank statistic, crediting a model's prediction back to individual persistent homology classes (persistence diagram points) is nontrivial. We introduce LandscapeSHAP, a method for fair credit allocation to persistence diagram points based on a model's prediction. For linear models on persistence landscapes, LandscapeSHAP has a closed form expression that gives the exact Shapley value of every persistence diagram point. In particular, there is no coalition sampling required. We further prove that the four Shapley "fairness" axioms uniquely characterize this credit allocation for any model, not only linear ones. For a general nonlinear model, this unique value can only be calculated exactly from its defining coalition averaging formula, which requires considering all $2^N$ many coalitions, where $N$ is the number of points in the persistence diagram. This is computationally intractable for persistence diagrams of realistic size. We complement the exact linear model result with an efficient Monte Carlo sampling of persistence diagram coalitions. We give convergence rates in terms of number of samples needed to approximate to a desired degree of accuracy. We also prove stability results for the LandscapeSHAP credit allocation, for any model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LandscapeSHAP，把 Shapley 值首次用于解释基于 persistence landscape 特征训练的模型，将预测公平地归因到 persistence diagram 的各个持久同调类（单个点）。对线性模型给出闭式精确 Shapley 值、无需联盟采样；对一般非线性模型用 Monte Carlo 联盟采样近似，并给出收敛速率与稳定性结果。
Motivation: Shapley 值已是 ML 特征归因的标准工具，但尚未用于解释以拓扑数据分析 (TDA) 特征训练的模型；而 landscape 每个坐标都是秩统计量，把预测归因回单个持久同调类并不平凡。
Method: 针对 persistence landscape 特征化设计 LandscapeSHAP：线性模型下推导闭式表达，直接给出每个 persistence diagram 点的精确 Shapley 值，免去联盟采样；一般非线性模型下用 Monte Carlo 采样 persistence diagram 联盟近似，并证明四条 Shapley 公平公理对任意模型唯一刻画该归因。
Result: 线性模型上得到精确 Shapley 值的闭式解，无需采样；非线性情形给出近似到给定精度所需样本数的收敛速率，并对任意模型证明归因的稳定性结果；同时证明四条公平公理唯一确定该归因（不限于线性模型）。
Conclusion: persistence diagram 点级的公平信用分配可由 Shapley 公理唯一确定，线性模型可精确闭式求解，非线性模型靠带收敛保证的 Monte Carlo 采样才在现实规模的 diagram 上可行（精确计算需遍历 2^N 个联盟，计算上不可行）。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PriceBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Price, Quality, and Brand Preferences in LLM Booking Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLMs increasingly act as purchasing agents, which makes the LLM, not the user, the one choosing among the options that satisfy a request; its preferences quietly fix what gets bought and what it costs. Hotel booking is a clean instance: a high-volume choice settled on a few comparable attributes, where the pick reveals those preferences. We introduce PriceBench, a diagnostic benchmark that recovers an LLM's price, quality, and brand preferences from its booking choices with a logit choice model, applied to 28 LLMs from 8 providers on 3,600 hotel tasks from 179 real New York City properties. We find that capability is associated with how consistently an LLM chooses, not with what it chooses: more capable LLMs hold stronger, more consistent preferences, while weaker ones either lock onto one position, exploitable by whoever controls listing order, or choose almost indifferently. What those preferences favor varies sharply across providers and even within one family: price sensitivity spans more than an order of magnitude, and the price/quality trade-off moves mean booked nightly price from \$247 to \$393 on identical tasks. What an agent buys must therefore be measured per LLM, not inferred, and we release the tasks, code, and all 28 response sets.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 19 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Pashasan/pricebench-emnlp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PriceBench 用 logit 选择模型从酒店预订选择中反推 LLM 的价格、质量与品牌偏好，在 8 家提供商的 28 个 LLM、179 家纽约真实酒店的 3,600 个任务上测量。发现能力只关联选择的一致性而非所选内容：能力强的偏好更强更稳，弱模型要么锁死单一位置（可被列表排序操纵），要么近乎无差别；价格敏感度跨一个数量级以上，价格/质量权衡使相同任务的平均成交房价从 $247 变到 $393。
Motivation: LLM 作为采购代理时，实际由模型而非用户在满足请求的选项中做选择，其隐含偏好直接决定买什么、花多少钱；此前缺少从选择行为中恢复这些偏好的诊断手段。
Method: 提出诊断基准 PriceBench：构造 179 家真实 NYC 酒店属性上的 3,600 个预订任务，收集 8 个提供商 28 个 LLM 的选择，再用 logit choice model 从选择中反演价格、质量、品牌偏好参数。
Result: 28 个 LLM、8 家提供商、3,600 个任务、179 家真实 NYC 酒店；价格敏感度跨一个数量级以上；价格/质量权衡使相同任务的平均 nightly price 从 $247 到 $393；能力与选择一致性相关而非与所选内容相关，弱模型或锁定单一位置或近乎无差别。
Conclusion: 代理买什么必须逐个 LLM 实测而不能推断；作者公开任务、代码与全部 28 组响应。

papers.title: Scaffold: Support Graph Theory Based Sparsification for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) rely on message passing over graph edges, making their computational and memory costs strongly dependent on graph density. Graph sparsification offers a natural way to reduce these costs, but removing edges indiscriminately can distort important communication structure and degrade predictive performance. We introduce Scaffold, a topology-based, unsupervised graph sparsification framework derived from support graph theory preconditioners. Scaffold explicitly controls two complementary structural quantities: dilation, which measures the length of rerouting paths induced by removed edges, and congestion, which measures how strongly these rerouted paths concentrate on the retained support. By jointly controlling dilation and congestion, Scaffold preserves short communication paths while avoiding structural bottlenecks. To our knowledge, Scaffold is the first scalable GNN sparsification framework to use a joint supporting-path dilation-congestion criterion. Across 19 homophilic and heterophilic benchmarks spanning small to large graphs, Scaffold achieves the best aggregate rank among the evaluated sparsification and related methods. Using only 10%-50% of the original edges per sparse support, Scaffold recovers or closely approaches full-graph GNN performance while using less than half the memory of full-graph training and reducing end-to-end training time, including sparsification overhead. We provide an open-source software package at https://github.com/siddhartha047/Scaffold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scaffold 是基于 support graph theory 预条件子推导的无监督图稀疏化框架，联合控制 dilation（被删边导致的重绕路径长度）与 congestion（重绕路径在保留支撑上的集中度），从而在删边时保住短通信路径、避免结构瓶颈。在 19 个同配与异配基准上取得被评稀疏化方法中的最佳综合排名，仅用原图 10%-50% 的边即可追平或接近全图 GNN 性能，显存不到全图训练的一半，并降低含稀疏化开销的端到端训练时间。
Motivation: GNN 的消息传递开销随图密度增长，但无差别删边会扭曲关键通信结构、损害预测性能，需要在降本与保性能之间给出可控的结构准则。
Method: 从 support graph theory 预条件子出发构造 topology-based 无监督稀疏化框架 Scaffold，联合优化重绕路径的 dilation 与 congestion 两个结构量，按比例保留边构成稀疏支撑后再跑标准 GNN 训练；在同配与异配、小到大规模图上与相关稀疏化方法对比。
Result: 在 19 个 homophilic 与 heterophilic 基准上取得所评稀疏化及相关方法中的最佳综合排名；每个稀疏支撑仅用原图 10%-50% 的边，即可恢复或接近全图 GNN 性能，显存低于全图训练的一半，端到端训练时间（含稀疏化开销）下降。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Infant Movement Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Infant movement analysis provides valuable biomarkers for the early identification of neurodevelopmental disorders. Recent advances in deep learning have enabled automated analysis of infant movements from video-derived skeletal representations, achieving performance comparable to expert assessment for tasks such as General Movement Assessment (GMA). However, most existing approaches rely on centralized training, requiring data from multiple institutions to be collected and stored at a single site. Such assumptions are often impractical in clinical settings due to privacy, governance, and data-sharing constraints. To address these challenges, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first federated learning framework for automated infant movement analysis and General Movement Assessment using skeletal motion data. As a clinically relevant use case, the proposed framework is evaluated on fidgety movement classification. To quantify model confidence, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout is employed to estimate predictive uncertainty during inference. Building upon this, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Federated Averaging (UA-FedAvg) strategy that incorporates predictive entropy derived from MC-Dropout into the federated aggregation process, enabling client contributions to be adjusted according to their predictive uncertainty. Experiments were conducted using a cross-subject evaluation protocol under a three-client federated learning setting. Results demonstrate that federated learning substantially improves classification performance compared with independently trained local models while achieving performance approaching that of centralized training. Furthermore, UA-FedAvg and its variant incorporating validation loss generally outperform conventional FedAvg across the evaluated data-split configurations.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个面向婴儿动作分析与 General Movement Assessment (GMA) 的联邦学习框架，用 MC-Dropout 估计预测不确定性，并把预测熵并入聚合得到 Uncertainty-Aware Federated Averaging (UA-FedAvg)，按客户端不确定性加权其贡献。在三客户端、跨受试者协议的 fidgety movement 分类上，联邦训练显著优于各客户端独立训练，性能接近集中式训练，UA-FedAvg 及其加入验证损失的变体在所评估的数据划分配置上总体优于常规 FedAvg。
Motivation: 现有婴儿骨骼动作分析依赖把多机构数据集中到单点训练，而临床场景受隐私、治理与数据共享限制无法这样做。
Method: 以骨骼序列为输入做 fidgety movement 分类；推理阶段用 MC-Dropout 得到预测熵作为不确定性，UA-FedAvg 据此调整各客户端聚合权重，并含一个引入验证损失的变体；实验采用三客户端联邦设置与跨受试者评估协议。
Result: 联邦学习相比各客户端独立训练的本地模型显著提升分类性能，且达到接近集中式训练的水平；UA-FedAvg 与其加入验证损失的变体在所评估的各数据划分配置上总体优于常规 FedAvg。
Conclusion: 在无法集中临床数据的条件下，按预测不确定性加权的联邦聚合可以在保住隐私的同时把 GMA 分类性能推到接近集中式训练。

papers.title: KneePreM: Towards 3D Knee MRI Foundation Models via Large-Scale Unlabeled Pretraining and Label-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Background: Large volumes of unlabeled knee MRI scans are available across repositories but remain insufficiently leveraged. We developed KneePreM, a knee-specific 3D self-supervised model, and evaluated transfer and label efficiency for classification and segmentation. Methods: A 3D U-Net masked autoencoder was pretrained on 19,011 unlabeled Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) MRI series from 4,791 participants. Downstream fine-tuning used full and reduced training sets for fastMRI+ two-label classification (1,172 examinations), Arthroscopic Partial Meniscectomy (APM) eight-target classification (1,716 examinations), SKM-TEA segmentation (155 examinations), and APM segmentation (25 examinations). Baselines were random initialization and SuPreM. Deployment workflow was implemented with a Model Context Protocol interface. Evaluation metrics included balanced accuracy, F1 score, ROC AUC, PR AUC, and Dice score. Statistical analysis used bootstrap confidence intervals and paired bootstrap tests for classification and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests for segmentation. Results: KneePreM achieved higher full-data macro ROC AUC than both baselines for fastMRI+ and APM (all p < .001). For fastMRI+ classification, KneePreM achieved a ROC AUC of 0.722 using 50% of the training data, exceeding both full-data baselines. In APM classification, KneePreM reached a ROC AUC of 0.740 with 70% of the data, matching the full-data random baseline and outperforming SuPreM. For SKM-TEA segmentation, its 70%-data Dice of 0.838 exceeded the full-data random baseline (0.835) and both same-budget comparators. In APM segmentation, its 75%-data Dice of 0.746 exceeded the full-data random baseline (0.731) and both same-budget comparators. Conclusion: KneePreM improves transfer performance and label efficiency across knee MRI classification and segmentation tasks, particularly when labeled training data are limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KneePreM 是膝关节专用 3D 自监督基础模型：用 3D U-Net masked autoencoder 在 19,011 条无标注 OAI MRI 序列（4,791 名参与者）上预训练，再做标签高效微调。在 fastMRI+ 二分类上用 50% 训练数据即达 ROC AUC 0.722，超过两个全量基线；SKM-TEA 分割 70% 数据 Dice 0.838 超过全量随机初始化 0.835。
Motivation: 各库中大量无标注膝 MRI 未被充分利用，而下游分类与分割任务标注昂贵，尤其在标注受限时需要能迁移且省标签的预训练表示。
Method: 以 3D U-Net masked autoencoder 在 19,011 条无标注 OAI MRI 序列（4,791 名参与者）上自监督预训练；下游用全量与缩减训练集微调，覆盖 fastMRI+ 二标签分类（1,172 例）、APM 八目标分类（1,716 例）、SKM-TEA 分割（155 例）与 APM 分割（25 例），基线为随机初始化与 SuPreM，指标含 balanced accuracy、F1、ROC AUC、PR AUC、Dice，统计用 bootstrap 置信区间、paired bootstrap 与 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验；部署工作流经 Model Context Protocol 接口实现。

Conclusion: 大规模无标注预训练能在膝 MRI 分类与分割上同时提升迁移性能与标签效率，标注越少收益越明显。

papers.title: Segment-Level Agentic Topic Modeling for Improved Data Exploration and Resource Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Topic modeling is an effective technique for discovering hidden themes within documents and is widely used in text mining and data analysis across a variety of industry sectors. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based topic models have been emerged that prompt LLMs to generate topics then assign the topics to documents, producing more natural and human-readable topics than conventional topic modeling algorithms. However, the nature of topic assignment process causes certain drawbacks, such as the incapability to produce topic distributions over a document, too broad or narrow topics, and high resource consumption, which increases with the number and length of of documents being assigned topics. These issues are particularly critical for industrial applications, which require high-quality, in-depth analysis and the processing of large volumes of documents. In this context, this paper introduces a framework called SeLATM, which addresses these concerns by employing segment-level topic generation and topic refinement through agentic feedback loops. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that SeLATM significantly reduces the LLM resources compared to methods based on topic assignment process, while maintaining superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SeLATM：把 LLM 主题建模从整篇文档一次性指派主题改为分段 (segment-level) 生成主题，再用 agentic 反馈循环做主题精炼。在多个数据集上，相比基于主题指派流程的方法，SeLATM 显著降低 LLM 资源消耗，同时保持更优性能。
Motivation: LLM 主题模型靠先生成主题再把主题指派给文档，导致无法给出文档上的主题分布、主题过宽或过窄，且资源消耗随文档数量与长度增长，难以支撑工业级大规模文档的深入分析。
Method: SeLATM 框架采用分段主题生成 (segment-level topic generation)，并以 agentic 反馈循环 (agentic feedback loops) 迭代精炼主题，替代整篇文档的主题指派流程。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验中，SeLATM 相比基于主题指派流程的方法显著减少 LLM 资源消耗，同时保持更优性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 分段生成加反馈精炼可以在压低 LLM 资源开销的同时保住主题质量，是对整篇文档主题指派范式的一条更省资源的替代路径。

papers.title: Nonparametric In-Context Learning under Growing Geometric Complexity: Minimax Optimality and Local Geometry-Adaptivity of Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have become a central architecture for in-context learning (ICL), particularly through their state-of-the-art performance in large language models. This success motivates understanding how transformers exploit task-relevant structure in geometrically heterogeneous data. However, existing nonparametric ICL theory has largely focused on Euclidean domains or single-manifold models. To address this gap, we study the prediction problem under unknown local geometry, modeled by sample size-dependent mixtures of manifolds with heterogeneous dimensions, smoothness, and sampling masses. Under local separation and small-perturbation conditions, we establish a minimax lower bound capturing the aggregate difficulty of the components and construct an oracle tangent local-polynomial estimator with a matching upper bound. This estimator is connected to a structure-informed, two-stage softmax transformer with a geometric preconditioner and chartwise reduced local-polynomial solvers. The transformer achieves negligible approximation error relative to the minimax rate with logarithmic depth and polynomial size. Finally, we derive an in-context generalization bound for near empirical risk minimizers over this class. Together, these results identify conditions under which the resulting predictor exploits local geometry and attains the aggregate minimax rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在由异质维数、光滑度与采样质量的流形混合构成的未知局部几何下，给出非参数上下文学习 (ICL) 的 minimax 下界，并构造与之匹配的 oracle 切向局部多项式估计器，再把它对应到带几何预条件器 (geometric preconditioner) 与逐 chart 局部多项式求解器的两阶段 softmax Transformer。该 Transformer 以对数深度、多项式规模达到相对 minimax 率可忽略的逼近误差，并对近经验风险最小化类给出上下文泛化界。
Motivation: 现有非参数 ICL 理论多限于欧氏域或单流形模型，无法刻画样本量依赖的多流形混合这种几何异质数据下预测难度如何聚合。
Method: 在局部可分与小扰动条件下，先对流形混合预测问题推导捕捉各成分聚合难度的 minimax 下界，构造 oracle 切向局部多项式 (oracle tangent local-polynomial) 估计器并证明匹配上界；再将该估计器接到结构化两阶段 softmax Transformer，含几何预条件器与逐 chart 简化的局部多项式求解器，最后对该类近 ERM 推导上下文泛化界。
Result: Transformer 的逼近误差相对 minimax 率可忽略，深度为对数级、规模为多项式级；泛化界针对该函数类上的近经验风险最小化 (near ERM) 建立。
Conclusion: 在局部可分与小扰动条件下，结构化 Transformer 能利用数据的局部几何并达到聚合 minimax 率，把非参数局部多项式估计与 ICL 理论连了起来。

papers.title: Diagnosing the Sources of Compositional Failure in Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle with compositional reasoning tasks, but the reasons for this underperformance remain unclear. A common hypothesis is that models struggle to integrate multiple components, leading to training interventions to improve compositional binding. However, this assumption has never been directly quantified. Existing benchmarks evaluate captions only in their composed form, making it impossible to separate the cost of joint reasoning from the cost of recognizing individual components under increasing load. We introduce COMPASS (COMPositional Analysis of SkillS), a controlled evaluation framework designed to isolate and measure the distinct factors underlying compositional failure. By comparing performance on composed captions with their decomposed counterparts , we directly quantify the cost of compositional integration across 87K image-caption pairs. Across multiple VLMs, this gap is real but partial, accounting for only part of the observed degradation. This motivates a finer-grained investigation into what additional factors govern model behavior. We analyze performance at the level of individual skills: object detection, attribute binding, and relation reasoning, using skill-targeted perturbations across 274K image-caption pairs. We find a consistent skill-specific pattern: each skill degrades primarily with the count of its own primitive type (self-load), while cross-load effects are predominantly positive, suggesting that primitives of different types provide useful grounding context. This pattern holds across standard contrastive encoders, explicitly trained compositional reasoning models, and non-contrastive architectures. These findings show that compositional degradation reflects multiple separable factors that cannot be reduced to joint reasoning alone.

Conclusion: 组合退化反映多个可分离因素，不能还原为联合推理单一原因；跨技能的正向效应意味着不同原语类型反而提供有用的 grounding 上下文。

papers.title: Different Corruptions, Different Signals: Uncertainty and Loss in Federated Data Quality
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) data corruption can affect either inputs or labels, but it remains unclear whether input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss expose these corruption modes equally. This paper compares two corruption-detection signals in FL: input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss. The uncertainty signal is characterised using a learned aleatoric variance estimate together with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout variance and entropy measures, while the loss is computed against the supplied label. We test these signals against additive image noise and persistent random label flips. On ResNet-20 with CIFAR-10 and SVHN under Dirichlet partitions with data that are not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), the two corruption types behave differently. For persistent random label flips, the within-client per-sample area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) is 0.85 on CIFAR-10 and 0.95 on SVHN for prediction-label loss, while every uncertainty estimator stays at chance (0.49--0.50). This pattern is consistent with the model remaining confident in the underlying image despite the supplied label being wrong. For image noise, expected-entropy uncertainty rises above chance (0.67 on CIFAR-10 and 0.66 on SVHN), while loss responds comparably (0.64 on both). Each signal is therefore the stronger detector for a different corruption: the prediction-label loss for persistent label flips, and expected-entropy uncertainty for image noise, with its advantage becoming apparent as federation-wide corruption prevalence increases. Robust FL data-quality assessment should match the signal to the corruption rather than rely on uncertainty alone across corruption types.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE The 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在联邦学习中对比两种数据质量检测信号：输入条件不确定性（学到的 aleatoric 方差、MC dropout 方差、熵）与对给定标签的预测损失。在 ResNet-20、CIFAR-10/SVHN、Dirichlet non-IID 划分下，持续随机标签翻转由预测-标签损失检出（within-client 每样本 ROC-AUC 0.85/0.95），所有不确定性估计器都停留在随机水平 0.49–0.50；图像加性噪声则由 expected-entropy 不确定性检出（0.67/0.66），损失为 0.64。作者主张按 corruption 类型匹配信号，而不是跨类型只依赖不确定性。
Motivation: 联邦学习的数据损坏可能发生在输入或标签上，但输入条件不确定性与预测-标签损失这两类信号是否同等暴露两种 corruption 模式尚不清楚，单一信号的数据质量评估会漏检。
Method: 在 CIFAR-10 与 SVHN 上用 ResNet-20、Dirichlet non-IID 客户端划分，注入加性图像噪声与持续随机标签翻转两类损坏；不确定性信号由学到的 aleatoric 方差、MC dropout 方差与熵（含 expected-entropy）刻画，损失按客户端提供的标签计算，用 within-client 每样本 ROC-AUC 比较两信号。
Result: 持续标签翻转下预测-标签损失的 within-client 每样本 AUC 为 CIFAR-10 0.85、SVHN 0.95，而所有不确定性估计器停在 0.49–0.50；图像噪声下 expected-entropy 不确定性为 0.67（CIFAR-10）与 0.66（SVHN），损失在两个数据集上均为 0.64，且其优势随联邦全局 corruption 流行度上升而显现。
Conclusion: 两种信号各是不同 corruption 的更强检测器：标签翻转用预测-标签损失，图像噪声用 expected-entropy 不确定性；鲁棒的 FL 数据质量评估应按 corruption 匹配信号，而非跨类型只依赖不确定性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Vision-Based 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation for Robot Cloth Unfolding
papers.abstract_en: Cloth manipulation is a challenging task due to the deformable and high-dimensional nature of cloth, which leads to complex interaction dynamics and perceptual ambiguity arising from frequent occlusions of critical visual cues such as folds, edges, and grasp points. In this work, we tackle cloth unfolding using a regrasping-in-the-air strategy, where one manipulator holds the cloth while the other grasps it at an optimally selected point to unfold it. To this end, we propose CeDiRNet-6DoF, a deep learning framework that jointly predicts effective grasp points and the complete 6-DoF grasp pose from the observed cloth configuration. By integrating dense 3D grasp regression with segmentation and sine-cosine-encoded Euler angles, the proposed method reliably estimates the grasp configuration that maximizes the unfolded cloth area. We extensively evaluated CeDiRNet-6DoF on a bimanual robotic setup within the ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance. An ablation study further validates the benefits of key design components, including joint segmentation, background randomization, and image cropping. These results establish CeDiRNet-6DoF as a robust and versatile foundation for reliable robotic cloth manipulation in unstructured environments.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CeDiRNet-6DoF 联合预测布料的有效抓取点与完整 6-DoF 抓取位姿，用稠密 3D 抓取回归、分割和 sine-cosine 编码的欧拉角，在空中再抓取 (regrasping-in-the-air) 策略下选出使展开面积最大的抓取配置。在 ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition 框架的双臂机器人设置上达到 state-of-the-art，消融验证了联合分割、背景随机化与图像裁剪的贡献。
Motivation: 布料可变形、维度高，褶皱、边缘和抓取点等关键视觉线索频繁被遮挡，导致感知歧义与复杂交互动力学，空中再抓取需要可靠估计最优抓取位姿。
Method: 提出深度学习框架 CeDiRNet-6DoF：从观测布料构型联合回归有效抓取点与完整 6-DoF 抓取位姿，融合稠密 3D 抓取回归、分割分支与 sine-cosine 编码的欧拉角；双臂设置中一臂持布、另一臂在最优选定点抓取以展开。
Result: 在 ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition 框架的双臂机器人设置上取得 state-of-the-art 表现；消融研究验证了联合分割、背景随机化 (background randomization) 与图像裁剪 (image cropping) 等关键设计组件的收益。
Conclusion: 联合预测抓取点与 6-DoF 位姿、配合分割与数据增强，可使空中再抓取在非结构化环境中可靠估计最大化展开面积的抓取配置，成为机器人布料操作的稳健基础。

papers.title: TemplateCraft: Agentic Visual Template Generation
papers.abstract_en: The growing popularity of short videos has driven demand for one-click content creation. Visual templates turn uploaded images into personalized content with preset effects, but reusable template generation still requires substantial manual effort in asset preparation and tool orchestration. We propose TemplateCraft, a multi-agent system that converts natural-language instructions into client-executable templates through planning, material generation, effect-workflow generation, and protocol compilation. Its Planner-Evaluator loop uses execution feedback for targeted rollback, while stage-level and long-term memory support revision without parameter updates. We evaluate TemplateCraft on TemplateBench, derived from 60 real-world templates. With the same Qwen3-VL backbone, TemplateCraft raises image/video generation success rates from 56.7%/30.0% to 66.7%/50.0% over Planner-only (best-of-three) and improves template adherence and style consistency. With additional evaluation and revision, it matches or exceeds a GPT-4o Planner-only baseline on selected metrics. Persistent assets further improve cross-input style consistency.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TemplateCraft 把自然语言指令经规划、素材生成、效果工作流生成与协议编译四阶段转成客户端可执行的视觉模板，Planner-Evaluator 环利用执行反馈做定向回滚，阶段级与长期记忆支持免参数更新的修订。在由 60 个真实模板构成的 TemplateBench 上，同为 Qwen3-VL 骨干时图像/视频生成成功率从 Planner-only (best-of-three) 的 56.7%/30.0% 升到 66.7%/50.0%。
Motivation: 短视频一键创作依赖可复用视觉模板，但模板制作在素材准备与工具编排上仍需大量人工，难以从自然语言直接得到可执行模板。
Method: 多智能体流水线依次做 planning、素材生成、效果工作流生成与协议编译；Planner-Evaluator 环依据执行反馈定向回滚，阶段级与长期记忆使修订无需更新模型参数，骨干为 Qwen3-VL。
Result: 在 TemplateBench（源自 60 个真实模板）上，同 Qwen3-VL 骨干下图像/视频生成成功率由 Planner-only (best-of-three) 的 56.7%/30.0% 提升至 66.7%/50.0%，模板贴合度与风格一致性同步改善；加入额外评估与修订后，在选定指标上追平或超过 GPT-4o Planner-only 基线；持久化素材进一步提升跨输入风格一致性。
Conclusion: 带执行反馈回滚与记忆的多智能体编排能在不改参数的前提下显著提高模板生成成功率与一致性，使自然语言到可执行模板的路径接近强闭源规划器水平。

papers.title: From Reward Signal to Visual Utility: A Controlled Audit of Medical VLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language model (VLM) post-training is commonly evaluated through answer accuracy. We examine how changes in accuracy and training objectives relate to image-conditioned decisions in a controlled Qwen2.5-VL-3B study on PMC-VQA. We compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) restricted to the language model, expanded multimodal adaptation scopes, standard answer-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and a counterfactual evidence objective. On 2,000 clean-test questions, language model LoRA SFT changes correct-image accuracy by +1.10 percentage points (95% paired bootstrap CI:-0.85 to +3.05), while visual-benefit events decrease by 2.40 points and image sensitivity decreases by 5.60 points. Paired records reveal 155 acquired and 203 lost visual-benefit events. Broader adaptation yields lower correct-image accuracy than language-model LoRA SFT. Standard GRPO produces mixed-reward groups and parameter updates, with an uncertain clean test accuracy change. A generation audit reveals that canonical option scores can follow a different token path from generated answers. With scores taken along the greedy generation path, the evidence target improves on the training set; its gains over standard GRPO remain inconsistent on validation data at matched training doses. Sample-level analyses trace how evidence scores, decision margins, and generated answers change during post-training. This empirical and measurement audit identifies gaps between optimization activity, target acquisition, and useful held-out visual behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B、PMC-VQA 的 2,000 道干净测试题上做受控审计：语言模型侧 LoRA SFT 让正确图像准确率仅 +1.10 个百分点（95% 配对 bootstrap CI −0.85 至 +3.05），却使 visual-benefit events 降 2.40 点、图像敏感度降 5.60 点。结论是准确率指标掩盖了图像条件决策的退化，且 GRPO 与 counterfactual evidence 目标在验证集上的增益不稳定。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 后训练普遍只看答案准确率，无法反映优化活动是否真的转化为有用的图像条件行为；需要在受控设置下把准确率变化与图像依赖决策拆开审计。
Method: 以 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 在 PMC-VQA 上做受控对比：语言模型 LoRA SFT、扩展到多模态的适配范围、标准 answer-only GRPO，以及一个 counterfactual evidence 目标；用配对记录统计 visual-benefit events 的获得与丢失，并对生成过程做 audit，比较 canonical option 打分路径与实际生成答案的 token 路径（greedy generation path 打分）。
Result: 2,000 道干净测试题上，语言模型 LoRA SFT 的正确图像准确率 +1.10 个百分点（95% 配对 bootstrap CI −0.85 至 +3.05），visual-benefit events −2.40 点，图像敏感度 −5.60 点；配对记录显示获得 155 个、丢失 203 个 visual-benefit events。更宽的适配范围正确图像准确率低于语言模型 LoRA SFT；标准 GRPO 产生 mixed-reward groups 与参数更新，干净测试准确率变化不确定；沿 greedy generation path 打分时 evidence 目标在训练集上改善，但在相同训练剂量下其对标准 GRPO 的增益在验证数据上不一致。
Conclusion: 答案准确率不足以表征医学 VLM 后训练的效果：优化活动、目标获取与留集视觉行为之间存在系统性缺口，评估必须显式审计图像条件决策而非只看 accuracy。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ViSTA 是一个紧凑 adapter，把不规则临床时间序列数值注入预训练视觉-语言模型的图表 token 表示，只学习对视觉 token 的修正、不改动任何预训练参数。在 MIMIC-IV 上，2B 模型用 0.516M 可训练参数达到急性肾损伤预测 AUC 0.7376，几乎追平 GPT-5.6 Sol 文本输入加高推理努力的 0.7380；4B 模型时序问答准确率 69.27%，可训练参数比用图表或数值文本的 LoRA 少 90% 以上，准确率差距 2.82–4.88 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 的语言能力并不保证能从结构化、高维、时间不规则的临床序列中准确预测风险，风险估计与关于患者病情演变的灵活提问之间缺少连接。
Method: ViSTA 作为紧凑 adapter，把不规则数值测量编码进预训练 vision-language model 已有的图表 (chart) 表示，学习对视觉 token 的修正量，全部预训练参数保持冻结；在 MIMIC-IV 上比较多种 adaptation，覆盖 2B–9B 参数模型，任务为急性肾损伤与死亡预测以及 temporal question answering。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上，ViSTA 在急性肾损伤与死亡预测的全部四项指标上，于所比较的各种 adaptation 中、在 2B–9B 参数模型上均取得最高均分；2B 模型以 0.516M 可训练参数达到 AKI 的 ROC AUC 0.7376，对照 GPT-5.6 Sol 文本输入加高推理 effort 的 0.7380。时序问答在 4B 参数下训练后准确率 69.27%，可训练参数比用图表或数值文本的 LoRA 少 90% 以上，准确率差距为 2.82–4.88 个百分点。
Conclusion: 只修正视觉 token 的轻量 adapter 就能把预训练多模态模型扩展到数值预测与时序问答，在 MIMIC-IV 上以极小可训练参数量接近大模型的临床预测水平。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Implicit Neural Representation for Hyperspectral Video Compression
papers.abstract_en: With the advent of snapshot cameras, hyperspectral video is becoming more readily available. In recent years, new applications have emerged which have led to increasingly larger datasets. However, hyperspectral video compression remains in the early stages. In this study, we explore the use of implicit neural representation as a candidate solution. We propose a novel extension of an existing RGB video compression model, achieving Bjøntegaard Delta PSNR gains of +4.99 dB and Bjøntegaard Delta rate of -88.88% compared to traditional hyperspectral image compression methods applied frame-by-frame. In addition to reconstruction quality, the effects on downstream task performance are measured in the form of object tracking success. Compared to video compressed with methods based on principal component analysis and JPEG2000 in low data regimes, our proposed method improves tracking area under the curve by up to 23.42% and distance precision by up to 35.56% on examples from the HOT2026 dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把隐式神经表示 (implicit neural representation) 扩展到高光谱视频压缩，在逐帧套用传统高光谱图像压缩方法的对照下取得 BD-PSNR +4.99 dB、BD-rate -88.88%，且在低数据量条件下用 HOT2026 样例把目标跟踪 AUC 最多提高 23.42%、distance precision 最多提高 35.56%。结论是压缩不只保重建质量，也保下游跟踪性能。
Motivation: snapshot 相机让高光谱视频数据集越来越大，但高光谱视频压缩仍处早期，逐帧套用图像压缩方法浪费帧间冗余，且只看 PSNR 不反映下游任务损失。
Method: 提出对既有 RGB 视频压缩模型的新扩展，用 implicit neural representation 表示高光谱视频；与逐帧应用的传统高光谱图像压缩方法比较 BD-PSNR 与 BD-rate，并以目标跟踪成功率度量下游任务性能，对照基于 PCA 与 JPEG2000 的压缩。
Result: 相对逐帧传统高光谱图像压缩，BD-PSNR +4.99 dB、BD-rate -88.88%；在低数据量条件下，相对 PCA 与 JPEG2000 类方法，HOT2026 数据集样例上跟踪 AUC 最多提升 23.42%、distance precision 最多提升 35.56%。
Conclusion: 把 RGB 视频压缩模型以 INR 形式扩展到高光谱视频，可同时拿到显著码率节省与下游目标跟踪性能保持，压缩评价应连同下游任务一起看。

papers.title: AxonSynth: Domain-Randomized Synthetic Data for Zero-Shot 3D Axon Segmentation in Light-Sheet Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of axons in 3D microscopy data is important for analyzing white-matter organization, but dense ground truth labels are expensive to obtain. Existing supervised axon segmentation methods rely on target-domain annotations and can be brittle when tissue type, species, modality, or acquisition conditions change. We present AxonSynth, a domain-randomized synthetic-data framework for training 3D axon segmentation models without manually annotated real training volumes. AxonSynth generates dense synthetic axon labels with orientation priors that reflect realistic fiber configurations and renders them with randomized density, contrast, bias fields, blur, and noise. A three-class 3D U-Net is trained to predict background, axon sheath and intra-axonal space. We evaluate zero-shot transfer on 10 held-out light-sheet microscopy (LSM) patches from macaque and human brain samples labeled with one of three axonal markers, comparing against calibrated thresholding and Frangi filtering using overlap, corrected detection, false-positive, and topology metrics. On macaque samples, AxonSynth achieved the best corrected Dice and corrected precision (0.826 and 0.851), compared with 0.765 and 0.754 for thresholding and 0.685 and 0.762 for Frangi. On human samples, corrected Dice was comparable to thresholding (0.857 vs. 0.868), while component-count error decreased from 22,504 to 3,377. Across all held-out patches, AxonSynth reduced component-count error in 10/10 patches and Euler-characteristic error in 8/10. These results show that synthetic-label domain randomization can reduce dependence on manual axon annotation while supporting synthetic-to-real 3D segmentation.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held with MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AxonSynth 用域随机化合成标签训练 3D 轴突分割网络，完全不需要人工标注的真实训练体数据：先生成带方向先验的稠密轴突标签，再随机化密度、对比度、bias field、模糊与噪声渲染成图像，用三类 3D U-Net 预测背景、轴突鞘与轴内空间。在 10 个留出的光片显微 (LSM) patch 上零样本迁移，猕猴样本 corrected Dice 0.826、corrected precision 0.851，均高于阈值法 (0.765/0.754) 与 Frangi (0.685/0.762)；人样本 Dice 与阈值法相当 (0.857 vs 0.868)，但 component-count error 从 22,504 降到 3,377。
Motivation: 轴突分割需要稠密 3D 标注，成本高；已有监督方法依赖目标域标注，一旦组织类型、物种、模态或采集条件变化就失效。
Method: AxonSynth 先生成反映真实纤维构型的方向先验稠密合成轴突标签，再以随机化的密度、对比度、bias field、模糊和噪声渲染成图像；用三类 3D U-Net 学习背景、axon sheath、intra-axonal space 三类分割，训练全程不含人工标注的真实体数据。
Result: 在 10 个留出的 LSM patch（猕猴与人脑样本，三种轴突标记之一）上零样本评测，对比 calibrated thresholding 与 Frangi filtering，用 overlap、corrected detection、false-positive、topology 指标。猕猴：corrected Dice 0.826、corrected precision 0.851，阈值法 0.765/0.754，Frangi 0.685/0.762。人：corrected Dice 0.857 vs 阈值法 0.868，component-count error 由 22,504 降至 3,377。全部 patch 中 component-count error 在 10/10 改善，Euler characteristic error 在 8/10 改善。
Conclusion: 合成标签加域随机化可以替代人工轴突标注，支撑 synthetic-to-real 的 3D 分割；其优势主要体现在拓扑与检测精度上，人样本的重叠指标与阈值法基本持平。

papers.title: Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool observations dominate the context of software-engineering agents, making long interaction histories costly to maintain. Existing context compression methods can discard information needed by later actions, while adapting agents to soft-token representations can compromise their original behavior. To reduce context while preserving action-critical information and agent behavior, we combine Latent Observations, Hard Actions (LOHA), a context layout that separates compressed history from text needed for exact reference, with Anchored Context Distillation (ACD), a training method that enables latent reading while constraining behavioral drift. LOHA compresses older tool observations into soft tokens while retaining the agent's own turns and the last K observations in text, providing compact access to historical information and exact access to recent content. To enable the agent to use this representation, ACD distills the base model's full-text predictions into the latent view while anchoring its behavior on plain-text inputs to the same base model. On SWE-bench Verified, K=3 reduces context per call by 43% for Qwen3-4B and 57% for SWE-Master-4B-RL, with resolve rates of 12.1% and 21.8% versus 14.5% and 27.5% for their uncompressed bases. A single-run recency sweep reaches 14.4% and 23.0% at K=8, with larger windows generally favoring task performance over compression. Under a 32K-token limit, Qwen3 with K=3 resolves 21.1% of a 199-instance subset versus 11.1% for the same adapted agent using full text. In concurrent single-GPU serving, it achieves 1.9 times that full-text agent's instance throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向软件工程 agent 的上下文压缩方法：LOHA 把较早的工具观测压成 soft token、保留 agent 自身轮次与最近 K 条观测的原文，ACD 用蒸馏让模型在 latent 视图上读历史、同时用纯文本输入锚定行为。SWE-bench Verified 上 K=3 使单次调用上下文对 Qwen3-4B 减 43%、对 SWE-Master-4B-RL 减 57%，resolve rate 分别为 12.1% 与 21.8%（未压缩基座 14.5% 与 27.5%）；32K 上限下 Qwen3 K=3 在 199 题子集上解出 21.1%，同款适配模型用全文本仅 11.1%，单卡并发吞吐为其 1.9 倍。
Motivation: 软件工程 agent 的长交互历史被工具观测撑满，维护成本高；已有压缩方法会丢掉后续动作所需信息，而把 agent 适配到 soft-token 表示又会损害其原有行为。
Method: LOHA 上下文布局把压缩历史与需精确引用的文本分开：较早工具观测压成 soft token，保留 agent 自身轮次与最近 K 条观测的原文。ACD 训练方法把 base model 在全文本上的预测蒸馏进 latent 视图，同时用指向同一 base model 的纯文本输入锚定其行为，抑制行为漂移。
Result: SWE-bench Verified 上 K=3 时单次调用上下文减少 43%（Qwen3-4B）与 57%（SWE-Master-4B-RL），resolve rate 12.1% 与 21.8%，对应未压缩基座 14.5% 与 27.5%。单次运行的 recency sweep 在 K=8 达到 14.4% 与 23.0%，窗口越大通常越利于任务性能而非压缩。32K token 上限下 Qwen3 K=3 在 199 题子集解出 21.1%，同一适配模型用全文本为 11.1%；单卡并发服务下吞吐为该全文本 agent 的 1.9 倍。
Conclusion: 把压缩限制在较早工具观测、保留精确引用所需的原文，能在可接受的 resolve rate 代价下大幅压缩上下文并提高吞吐；在 32K 上限下压缩反而优于全文本，且窗口取 K=8 时任务性能更高。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: LOHA 上下文布局把压缩历史与需精确引用的文本分开：较早工具观测压成 soft token，保留 agent 自身轮次与最近 K 条观测的原文。ACD 训练方法把 base model 在全文本上的预测蒸馏进 latent 视图，同时用指向同一 base model 的纯文本输入锚定其行为，抑制行为漂移。
summary_sections.result: SWE-bench Verified 上 K=3 时单次调用上下文减少 43%（Qwen3-4B）与 57%（SWE-Master-4B-RL），resolve rate 12.1% 与 21.8%，对应未压缩基座 14.5% 与 27.5%。单次运行的 recency sweep 在 K=8 达到 14.4% 与 23.0%，窗口越大通常越利于任务性能而非压缩。32K token 上限下 Qwen3 K=3 在 199 题子集解出 21.1%，同一适配模型用全文本为 11.1%；单卡并发服务下吞吐为该全文本 agent 的 1.9 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把压缩限制在较早工具观测、保留精确引用所需的原文，能在可接受的 resolve rate 代价下大幅压缩上下文并提高吞吐；在 32K 上限下压缩反而优于全文本，且窗口取 K=8 时任务性能更高。

papers.title: Towards Mitigating Fabricated Consensus: The Active Provenance Gate for Multi-Agent Debate Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based multi-agent debate (MAD) systems are being increasingly used as complex decision pipelines in distributed processes. However, their final synthesis phase still remains inadequately controlled. Even with detailed debate logs, summarizing models are prone to fabricating smoothly written debate consensus that is not grounded in the debate's history. To address this safety gap, this paper presents empirical research and studies if the introduction of active post-debate verification can mitigate the production of such factually unsupported summaries, while still providing valuable information. Furthermore, it is examined whether explicitly signalling divergence is preferable in the absence of a reliable compromise. The Active Provenance Gate (APG) is introduced as a post-debate verification layer that treats the source as a hard constraint, analysing the debate logs, auditing each claim, and applying self-correction. In crisis simulations, the self-healing mechanism more than doubles the average data Provenance Fidelity in difficult condition scenarios, before the strict gate blocks unsupported claims and generates divergence reports. In the human study, a vast majority of the users (over 75%) preferred a report explicitly stating failure in critical scenarios, despite most of them perceiving fabricated consensus from the baseline system as more fluent. Our main contribution is the transition of data origin tracing from passive logging to active conditional blocking before publication.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体辩论 (MAD) 的最终综述阶段会生成看似流畅、实则无辩论日志支撑的虚假共识。提出 Active Provenance Gate (APG)：把来源当硬约束，逐条审计声明并自纠错，再由严格门禁拦截无据声明、生成分歧报告。危机仿真中自愈机制使困难场景的平均数据来源保真度 (Provenance Fidelity) 提升一倍以上；人类研究中超过 75% 用户在关键场景下更偏好明确报告失败的版本。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体辩论被用作分布式决策管线，但综述阶段缺乏控制：即便有完整辩论日志，总结模型仍会编造未被历史支撑的流畅共识。
Method: APG 作为辩论后验证层，把来源设为硬约束：分析辩论日志、逐条审计每个声明并应用自纠错，随后严格门禁拦截无据声明并生成分歧报告；在危机仿真中检验，并做人类研究对比基线系统的综述。
Result: 危机仿真中，自愈机制在困难条件场景下使平均数据来源保真度 (Provenance Fidelity) 提升一倍以上 (more than doubles)；人类研究中超过 75% 的用户在关键场景下偏好明确声明失败的报告，尽管多数人认为基线系统的虚假共识更流畅。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是把数据来源追踪从被动日志转变为主动的发布前条件拦截；在无可靠折中时显式标示分歧优于强行给出共识。

papers.title: Evaluating the accuracy of KV cache reuse techniques
papers.abstract_en: Position-independent KV cache reuse aims to reduce latency in retrieval-augmented generation by reusing chunk-level KV caches across prompts. We show that current evaluations of KV cache reuse techniques rely on measurements that fail to faithfully capture the loss of accuracy attributable to reuse, often artificially inflating the reported effectiveness. We also show that existing datasets do not exhibit the reuse dynamics needed to thoroughly evaluate such techniques. To address these issues, we propose an evaluation methodology that measures this accuracy loss without ambiguity and we introduce Boxoffice, a tool that programmatically generates evaluation datasets that exercise challenging KV cache reuse patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 位置无关 KV cache 复用（position-independent KV cache reuse）在 RAG 中复用 chunk 级 KV cache 以降延迟，但现有评测指标无法忠实刻画复用本身导致的精度损失，往往虚报收益；作者提出无歧义的评测方法，并发布 Boxoffice 工具，程序化生成能触发困难复用模式的评测数据集。
Motivation: KV cache 复用技术的现有评测所用度量不能忠实反映复用带来的精度损失，常人为抬高报告效果；同时现有数据集缺少检验这类技术所需的复用动态。
Method: 提出一套无歧义测量复用所致精度损失的评测方法，并开发 Boxoffice，以程序化方式生成覆盖困难 KV cache 复用模式的评测数据集。
Result: 论文给出两项定性结论：当前 KV cache 复用评测所依赖的度量无法忠实捕捉可归因于复用的精度损失，且现有数据集不具备充分评测所需的复用动态；并据此产出评测方法与 Boxoffice 数据生成工具。
Conclusion: KV cache 复用的精度代价必须用专门设计的度量与专门构造的数据集来测，否则报告的收益会被高估。

papers.title: Sorry Robot, Happy Human: Vision-Language Models Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs), despite their success in optical character recognition (OCR) tasks, are vulnerable to typographic attacks and have a fragile structure for images with multiple text layers. In this study, the DecoyBench dataset was created using the Decoy Font method. The dataset consists of 300 images, each containing text with sharp contour lines superimposed on another text with soft shading. Six recent closed-source models from three different model families were evaluated using this dataset under two different prompting conditions (naive and guided) and at two different resolutions ($512\times512$ and $64\times64$). A validation study showed that human participants could read both text layers with high accuracy. In contrast, the models, with most variants and both prompting methods, read the contour text with near-human accuracy at high resolution, but almost never fully extracted the shading text. At low resolution, the contour text could not be read by either the models or humans, while the shading text could be extracted with high accuracy. The findings indicate that the evaluated VLMs exhibit a consistent behavioral limitation when processing typographic structures containing multiple spatial frequency layers.
papers.comment: Accepted to the First Workshop on Document Intelligence and Understanding (DocInsights 2026), co-located with the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Decoy Font 构造 DecoyBench：300 张图各含一层锐利轮廓文字叠加一层柔和阴影文字。六个闭源 VLM 在 512×512 下几乎只读出轮廓层、几乎从不完整提取阴影层，而人类两层都能高准确读出；降到 64×64 后轮廓层人机都读不出，阴影层反而可高准确提取。
Motivation: VLM 在 OCR 上表现强却对排版攻击脆弱，面对多文字层图像时结构脆弱；需要一个可控数据集来判定模型到底读了哪一层。
Method: 提出 Decoy Font 方法并据此构建 DecoyBench（300 张图，锐利轮廓文字叠加柔和阴影文字）；对三个模型家族的六个近期闭源模型，在 naive 与 guided 两种提示条件、512×512 与 64×64 两种分辨率下评测，并做人类可读性验证研究。
Result: 高分辨率下多数模型变体与两种提示方式读轮廓文字接近人类准确率，但几乎从不完整提取阴影文字；低分辨率下轮廓文字模型与人类都读不出，阴影文字可高准确提取；人类参与者能高准确读出两层文字。
Conclusion: 被评 VLM 在处理含多个空间频率层的排版结构时存在一致的行为局限：注意力被锐利轮廓层吸走，且该偏向随分辨率反转而改变可读层。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AFA-Net: A Differential Attention Approach for Auditory Attention Detection
papers.abstract_en: Auditory Attention Detection (AAD) utilizes electroencephalographic (EEG) signals to identify a target speaker in a multi-speaker environment. Despite considerable progress, existing deep learning architectures often lack explicit mechanisms for handling noisy EEG data. To address this limitation, we propose Auditory Focus Attention Networks (AFA-Net), a machine learning framework that replaces vanilla attention with a simple yet flexible differential attention mechanism to help focus on task-relevant neural activity. AFA-Net achieves an upward accuracy of 96.8% at the 2s decision window, while using substantially fewer parameters than most existing methods. To the best of our knowledge, AFA-Net is among the first frameworks to explicitly try to combat EEG noise to improve AAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AFA-Net 用差分注意力 (differential attention) 替换普通注意力，显式抑制含噪 EEG 中与任务无关的活动，用于多说话人环境下的听觉注意力检测 (AAD)。在 2 秒决策窗口上准确率达 96.8%，参数量显著少于多数现有方法。
Motivation: 现有深度学习 AAD 架构缺少显式处理含噪 EEG 的机制，噪声会干扰目标说话人识别。
Method: 提出 Auditory Focus Attention Networks (AFA-Net)，以差分注意力机制替代 vanilla attention，聚焦任务相关神经活动；框架以较少参数实现，面向 EEG 信号的多说话人目标识别。
Result: 在 2s 决策窗口上准确率 96.8%，同时参数量显著少于多数现有方法。
Conclusion: 差分注意力是显式对抗 EEG 噪声以提升 AAD 的可行路径，AFA-Net 据作者所知是最早明确针对 EEG 噪声的框架之一。

papers.title: Decodable In-Context State and Model Output Across Training
papers.abstract_en: Prior work established that a probe can decode an in-context binding on model errors and that probe-guided steering can repair some of them. We follow probe accuracy, model output, and steering response across public pretraining and post-training checkpoints. Probe accuracy rises during Pythia pretraining, while probe-guided steering moves from negligible all-trial benefit to a larger benefit at two model sizes. Saved scores distinguish probe-correct errors with low and above-uniform model probability for the correct candidate. Oracle-target steering already repairs many early errors, but saved aggregates cannot separate target quality from intervention sensitivity. A held-out comparison of decoders trained on the final state or candidate logits finds no detected final-state advantage on late-checkpoint model errors. An information-theoretic counterexample explains why decodability on errors alone cannot establish discarded output information. The connection to downstream omissions remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Pythia 预训练与后训练检查点上追踪探针解码 in-context 绑定的准确率、模型输出与探针引导 steering 的响应：探针准确率随预训练上升，steering 的全试验收益从可忽略变为在两个模型规模上明显增大；但用最终状态或候选 logits 训练的解码器在后期检查点错误上未检出最终状态优势，并给出信息论反例说明仅凭错误上的可解码性不能证明被丢弃的输出信息。
Motivation: 先前工作只证明探针能在模型错误上解码 in-context 绑定、且探针引导 steering 可修复部分错误，但可解码性是否意味着模型丢弃了输出信息、以及与下游遗漏的关系仍未确定。
Method: 在公开的 Pythia 预训练与后训练检查点上同时跟踪探针准确率、模型输出与 steering 响应；用保存分数区分探针判对但模型给正确候选低于均匀概率的错误；对比在最终状态与候选 logits 上训练的解码器，并给出一个信息论反例。
Result: 探针准确率在 Pythia 预训练期间上升；探针引导 steering 从可忽略的全试验收益变为在两个模型规模上更大的收益；oracle-target steering 已能修复许多早期错误，但保存的聚合量无法区分目标质量与干预敏感性；在后期检查点模型错误上，最终状态解码器相对候选 logits 解码器未检出优势。
Conclusion: 仅凭错误上的可解码性不能推出模型丢弃了输出信息，与下游遗漏的联系仍待解决。

papers.title: Differential Attention Unlocks Complementary EEG and Speech Fusion for Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) increasingly pairs EEG with speech, treating internal neural signals and external vocal expression as informative views of affect. In practice, naive fusion underperforms the stronger single modality, because EEG artifacts inject noise that corrupts the shared representation. We introduce EmoSpeechBrain, a multimodal framework built on the insight that noise suppression is a precondition for effective fusion. Its EEG encoder uses differential attention, taking the difference between two attention maps to cancel shared noise and isolate discriminative neural activity. An attention-based gating adapter aligns both modalities in a shared space and weights each one's contribution to the prediction. On two datasets - PME4 and EAV, EmoSpeechBrain improves MER accuracy by up to 12.9% over other state-of-the-art (SOTA) EEG encoders, and surpasses unimodal speech and EEG baselines by up to 13.1% and 23.1%. These results show that once EEG noise is suppressed, fusion delivers gains that naive combination cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmoSpeechBrain 用差分注意力 (differential attention) 取两张注意力图之差抵消 EEG 共享噪声，再用基于注意力的 gating adapter 把 EEG 与语音对齐到共享空间并加权各自贡献。在 PME4 与 EAV 两个数据集上，MER 准确率较其他 SOTA EEG 编码器最高提升 12.9%，较单模态语音与 EEG 基线分别最高提升 13.1% 与 23.1%。
Motivation: EEG 与语音做多模态情感识别时，朴素融合常输给更强的单模态，因为 EEG 伪迹引入噪声、破坏共享表示。
Method: EEG 编码器采用差分注意力，用两张注意力图的差消去共享噪声、保留判别性神经活动；基于注意力的 gating adapter 将两种模态对齐到共享空间，并按各自对预测的贡献加权。
Result: 在 PME4 与 EAV 两个数据集上，MER 准确率较其他 SOTA EEG 编码器最高提升 12.9%，较单模态语音基线最高提升 13.1%，较单模态 EEG 基线最高提升 23.1%。
Conclusion: 先抑制 EEG 噪声再融合能带来朴素拼接无法获得的增益，即噪声抑制是有效融合的前提。

papers.title: Intent2Tc: Automated Intent-to-Traffic Control Translation with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Automated and highly usable Quality-of-Service (QoS) enforcement requires translating high-level service intents into deployable traffic-management policies. Although intent-based networking (IBN) has simplified policy specification, bridging the gap between business-level intents and executable network configurations remains complex, error-prone, and difficult to automate. This paper presents Intent2Tc, a closed-loop language-model-driven framework that translates business-level traffic-shaping intents into declarative sub-intents and subsequently into validated, executable Linux traffic control (tc) configurations. The framework integrates an Active Queue Management (AQM)-based digital twin (DT) semantic model, automated metadata extraction, critique-driven refinement, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based knowledge reuse to improve semantic consistency and configuration reliability. We evaluate multiple open-source large language models (LLMs) and small language models (SLMs), together with Claude Sonnet-4.6, on 100 Request for Comments (RFC) 9315-compliant traffic-shaping intents. Across both translation stages, Intent2Tc achieves high semantic fidelity, configuration accuracy, and deployment readiness, with Claude Sonnet-4.6 reaching 0.98 semantic similarity, 1.0 semantic unit coverage, and 0.045 normalized edit distance. Furthermore, RAG reduces token consumption and inference latency while enabling compact models such as Phi-4-mini to approach the performance of substantially larger models. Linux tc serves as the target configuration platform, demonstrating the practical applicability of the proposed framework.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, Accepted to IEEE Conference on Future Communications and Networks (FCN) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Intent2Tc 是一个由语言模型驱动的闭环框架，把业务级流量整形意图先翻译成声明式子意图，再翻译成可执行且经校验的 Linux tc 配置，中间用 AQM 数字孪生语义模型、自动元数据抽取、批评驱动精炼 (critique-driven refinement) 和 RAG 知识复用来保证语义一致。在 100 条符合 RFC 9315 的流量整形意图上，Claude Sonnet-4.6 两阶段翻译达到 0.98 语义相似度、1.0 语义单元覆盖、0.045 归一化编辑距离；RAG 降低 token 消耗与推理延迟，让 Phi-4-mini 这类小模型逼近大模型表现。
Motivation: 意图驱动网络 (IBN) 已简化策略书写，但业务级意图到可执行网络配置之间仍复杂、易错、难以自动化，QoS 强制执行缺少可靠的自动翻译路径。
Method: 闭环两阶段翻译：业务意图先转声明式子意图，再转 Linux tc 配置；集成 AQM-based digital twin 语义模型、自动元数据抽取、critique-driven refinement 与 RAG 知识复用，评测多个开源 LLM/SLM 加 Claude Sonnet-4.6，任务集为 100 条 RFC 9315-compliant traffic-shaping intents。
Result: 在 100 条 RFC 9315 合规流量整形意图的两阶段翻译上，Claude Sonnet-4.6 取得 0.98 语义相似度、1.0 语义单元覆盖、0.045 归一化编辑距离；RAG 降低 token 消耗与推理延迟，并使 Phi-4-mini 等紧凑模型接近远大于它的模型的表现。
Conclusion: 以数字孪生语义模型加 RAG 的闭环翻译可以把业务意图直接落到可部署的 Linux tc 配置，且 RAG 让小模型在该任务上可用。

papers.title: ActKV: Efficient LLM Agents through Action-Guided KV Cache Management
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLM inference accumulates long KV caches across iterative observation-reasoning-action loops, imposing substantial memory overhead and limiting serving throughput. Existing compression methods emphasize overall output quality, overlooking the asymmetric importance of actions in driving task progress. Our key idea is to establish a compression criterion that values KV entries by their contribution to action generation and prioritizes action quality. However, iterative execution, dynamic memory demands, and scattered action-critical entries pose challenges to eviction policies, budget allocation, and paged memory integration. To this end, we propose ActKV, the first KV cache compression framework tailored for agentic LLM inference. (i) Action-oriented KV cache eviction exploits stable action access patterns to retain entries critical to future actions, supporting reliable task progress under compression. (ii) Confidence-driven adaptive budget allocation uses LLM's intrinsic confidence to adapt the budget to evolving action-critical memory demands. (iii) Page-aware compression management standardizes compression into three primitives with customized kernels, realizing practical throughput gains. On long-trace tasks, ActKV retains an average of 98.53% of FullKV's accuracy with only 25.98% of its peak KV cache memory. It also achieves 3.97 times and 3.58 times FullKV's token and task throughput, delivering state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActKV 是首个面向 agentic LLM 推理的 KV cache 压缩框架，按 KV 条目对动作生成的贡献来取舍，而非按整体输出质量。动作导向驱逐利用稳定的动作访问模式保留对未来动作关键的条目，置信度驱动的自适应预算随动作关键内存需求调整，页感知压缩把流程标准化为三个原语并配定制 kernel。在长轨迹任务上以 25.98% 的峰值 KV cache 内存保留 FullKV 平均 98.53% 的准确率，token 吞吐达 FullKV 的 3.97 倍、任务吞吐 3.58 倍。
Motivation: Agentic LLM 推理在观察-推理-动作循环中累积长 KV cache，内存开销大并限制服务吞吐；现有压缩方法只顾整体输出质量，忽视动作在推进任务上的不对称重要性。
Method: 三个组件：动作导向 KV cache 驱逐，利用稳定的动作访问模式保留对后续动作关键的条目；置信度驱动的自适应预算分配，用 LLM 内在置信度随动作关键内存需求调节预算；页感知压缩管理，把压缩标准化为三个原语并配定制 kernel。
Result: 在长轨迹任务上，ActKV 平均保留 FullKV 98.53% 的准确率，峰值 KV cache 内存仅为 FullKV 的 25.98%；token 吞吐为 FullKV 的 3.97 倍，任务吞吐为 3.58 倍。
Conclusion: 按动作生成贡献而非整体质量来压缩 KV cache，可在大幅削减内存的同时保住任务准确率并带来实际吞吐收益，作者称其达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: InternW0-$Δ$: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model visual dynamics and action generation for generalist robot manipulation. A central challenge is to integrate priors from large-scale pretrained models---including visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry, and motion---into a unified framework for robot action generation. We introduce InternW0-$Δ$, a unified WAM pretrained on a heterogeneous corpus that outperforms prior methods across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. InternW0-$Δ$ combines pretrained visual dynamics, scene-level semantics, 4D geometric and motion priors, and action generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) framework. A pretrained video expert and an action expert interact under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. We further introduce Causal Imprint, which learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision and provides predictive representations directly to the action expert without future-video rollout at inference. For large-scale joint training, we construct a heterogeneous corpus of robot demonstrations, UMI data, egocentric human demonstrations, and Ego2Robot data, curated and aligned under a common state-action representation. The resulting corpus contains over 20K hours of processed training data, to our knowledge the largest open-source corpus of its kind. We pretrain InternW0-$Δ$ on this corpus and demonstrate strong performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. We will open source the training code, model weights, infrastructure, data-processing pipeline, and processed data where licenses permit. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InternW0-Δ 是一个把视觉动态、场景语义、4D 几何与运动生成统一进 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 的机器人操作 World Action Model：预训练 video expert 与 action expert 在冻结 VLM 的语义引导下交互，4D foundation model 通过仅训练期蒸馏注入几何先验，Causal Imprint 用仅训练期的未来监督学出未来相关场景变化并直接喂给 action expert，推理时无需未来视频 rollout。在超过 20K 小时的异构开源语料（机器人演示、UMI、第一人称人类演示、Ego2Robot）上预训练后，在仿真基准与真实机器人平台上均超过既有方法。
Motivation: 机器人操作的 World Action Model 需要把大规模预训练模型中的视觉动态、场景语义、几何与运动先验整合进统一的动作生成框架，而这些先验此前分散在不同模型中难以联合使用。
Method: 在 Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) 框架内组合预训练视觉动态、场景级语义、4D 几何与运动生成：预训练 video expert 与 action expert 在冻结 VLM 的语义引导下交互，预训练 4D foundation model 通过 training-only 蒸馏注入先验；Causal Imprint 用 training-only 未来监督学习未来相关场景变化，直接向 action expert 提供预测表征，推理时不做未来视频 rollout。训练语料为机器人演示、UMI 数据、第一人称人类演示与 Ego2Robot 数据，统一到共同的 state-action 表示并对齐。
Result: 语料含超过 20K 小时处理后训练数据，作者称其为同类最大的开源语料；InternW0-Δ 在仿真基准与真实机器人平台上均超过既有方法。
Conclusion: 把视觉动态、语义、4D 几何与动作生成放进统一 MoT 并用仅训练期的未来监督提供预测表征，可在不增加推理期视频 rollout 的前提下提升机器人操作的通用性；训练代码、模型权重、基础设施、数据处理管线与许可允许的处理后数据将开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multivariate conformal uncertainty propagation in multitask atomistic simulation: Successes and pitfalls
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has become the standard tool for the design of interatomic potentials which balance efficiency and accuracy, but uncertainty quantification remains an open problem. Multiscale simulations introduce an additional challenge: robust uncertainty quantification across scales. Even within one scale, computations are often multistage, producing a sequence of target quantities, each dependent on the previous, and each with some uncertainty. Conformal methods have emerged as a model agnostic framework for recalibrating surrogate predictions to produce sets which contain the truth at a user-specified rate. For multistage workflows, we require uncertainty calibration for multiple chemical properties and atomistic configurations, and we want to propagate uncertainty sets to downstream quantities of interest. Such propagation should capture the error cancellations which occur in many downstream targets in materials science; for instance, an approximate energy difference is often more accurate than individual energy predictions. We present the first exploration of multivariate conformal methods for chemical properties, including Bonferroni-corrected hyperrectangles, hyperellipsoidal sets based on the Mahalanobis distance, and custom loss functions within conformal risk control. Calibration is applied directly to predicted energies, atomic forces, and virial stresses, then propagated to elastic constants and vacancy formation energies employing a variety of commonly considered approximate protocols in materials modeling. We highlight the benefits of building correlation predictions into the conformal procedure, making it possible to build sets which capture near symmetries and error cancellation. We conclude with a discussion of the interplay of the employed approximate computational protocol and conformal guarantees.
papers.comment: main: 17 pages, 7 figures + appendix: 9 pages, 10 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在原子间势多级模拟中首次引入多变量 conformal 方法，对能量、原子力、virial 应力同时做校准并把不确定性集合传播到弹性常数与空位形成能。把相关性写进 conformal 程序（基于 Mahalanobis 距离的超椭球集、conformal risk control 的自定义损失）能捕捉误差抵消与近对称性，从而得到比逐分量 Bonferroni 超矩形更紧的集合；作者同时讨论近似计算协议与 conformal 保证之间的相互作用。
Motivation: 多级材料模拟中每个中间量都带不确定性并逐级依赖，单变量 conformal 校准既无法跨多个化学性质与原子构型给出联合覆盖，也捕捉不到下游目标中常见的误差抵消（如能量差常比单个能量预测更准）。
Method: 提出面向化学性质的多变量 conformal 方法：Bonferroni 校正的超矩形、基于 Mahalanobis 距离的超椭球集，以及 conformal risk control 框架内的自定义损失函数。校准直接施加于预测能量、原子力与 virial 应力，再用材料建模中常见的近似协议把集合传播到弹性常数与空位形成能。
Result: 在能量、原子力、virial 应力上完成校准并传播至弹性常数与空位形成能；把相关性预测纳入 conformal 程序后，所构造的集合能捕捉近对称性与误差抵消。摘要给出的是方法框架与定性结论，未列具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 多变量 conformal 校准应显式建模各分量相关性，才能在多级原子模拟中得到既覆盖又紧的不确定性集合；最终保证与所采用的近似计算协议相互纠缠，需一并讨论。

papers.title: Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution. Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track. We observe that these inconsistencies concentrate primarily at intermediate waypoints, while the predicted endpoint remains comparatively reliable. Based on this observation, we introduce Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO), a lightweight postprocessing layer that anchors the trajectory to the vehicle's executed history, preserves the policy's predicted endpoint, and reshapes the intermediate waypoints to improve feasibility. ECO requires no map, privileged simulator state, or additional training, and can be inserted between a broad range of waypoint-emitting policies and their controllers. Across two closed-loop simulators, it improves the aggregate closed-loop score of all six evaluated generative and regression-based driving policies, and the gains tend to increase with how often the base plans violate motion limits. On HUGSIM, ECO improves VaVAM from 18.1 to 31.0 HD-Score (+71%), achieving 1st place on the HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge. Similarly, on AlpaSim, ECO increases the scene scores of VaVAM and DiffusionDrive by 123% and 22%, respectively. These results show that for a broad collection of end-to-end driving models, repairing the intermediate geometry of predicted trajectories without changing the policy's predicted endpoint can substantially improve closed-loop performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端到端驾驶策略用开环行为模仿训练、闭环部署，ECO 这一轻量后处理层把轨迹锚定到车辆已执行历史、保留策略预测的终点、只重塑中间 waypoint 以提升可跟踪性。在 HUGSIM 与 AlpaSim 两个闭环模拟器上，六个生成式与回归式策略的聚合闭环分数全部提升：VaVAM 的 VaVAM 指标从 18.1 升到 31.0 HD-Score（+71%），AlpaSim 上 VaVAM 与 DiffusionDrive 场景分数分别 +123% 与 +22%。
Motivation: 开环行为模仿与闭环执行之间存在训练-部署错配；除 covariate shift 与 causal confusion 外，waypoint 监督与位移指标并不保证中间轨迹物理可行、易于控制器跟踪，且不一致主要集中在中间 waypoint 而非终点。
Method: 提出 Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO)：一个无需地图、无需特权模拟器状态、无需额外训练的轻量后处理层，插在各类输出 waypoint 的策略与其控制器之间，锚定车辆执行历史、保留预测终点、重塑中间 waypoint 以改善可行性。
Result: 在两个闭环模拟器上，ECO 提升全部六个被评估的生成式与回归式驾驶策略的聚合闭环分数，且基础策略违反运动约束越频繁、增益越大。HUGSIM 上 VaVAM 的 VaVAM 从 18.1 提到 31.0 HD-Score（+71%），并获 HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge 第一名；AlpaSim 上 VaVAM 与 DiffusionDrive 场景分数分别提升 123% 与 22%。
Conclusion: 对端到端驾驶模型，只修复预测轨迹的中间几何而不改动策略预测的终点，就能显著改善闭环表现；ECO 可插入广泛的 waypoint 输出策略与控制器之间。

papers.title: Highlight-Then-Summarize: Learning to Compress Evidence for Long-Context Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-context understanding requires large language models (LLMs) to reason over lengthy documents, conversations, and code, yet task-relevant evidence is often sparse and scattered amid substantial irrelevant and redundant content. We propose Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S), a compress-then-reason paradigm that first identifies source-grounded, question-relevant evidence and then integrates it into a compact, question-conditioned summary before producing the final answer. To train this behavior, we construct H2S-Dataset, comprising 6,647 examples from 11 benchmark families with an average context length of 43.9K tokens, and introduce H2S-RL, which provides process-level rewards for evidence selection and summary construction in addition to final-answer correctness. We evaluate on H2S-Bench, a seven-task long-context suite. Under a shared 128K input and 4K output budget, H2S-14B achieves an average score of 32.60, outperforming Qwen3.8-27B by 10.17 points and obtaining the strongest overall result among the evaluated open-source models. H2S-14B also achieves the highest Evidence-Summary Quality score and retains 97.1% of its 16K-budget performance with only a 4K output budget. These results show that explicitly selecting and integrating evidence improves long-context reasoning while enabling more compact generation.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 13 figures. Zhaoyuan Xia and Qinghongbing Xie contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Dai Dai, Tong Mo, and Long Zeng. Code and data are available at https://github.com/X-Luffy/Highlight-Then-Summarize
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S)：先定位与问题相关的源证据，再压成紧凑摘要，最后作答。用 H2S-Dataset（6,647 例、11 个基准族、平均 43.9K token）和带过程奖励的 H2S-RL 训练，在 H2S-Bench 七任务、128K 输入/4K 输出预算下，H2S-14B 平均 32.60，超 Qwen3.8-27B 10.17 分。
Motivation: 长上下文中任务相关证据稀疏且分散在大量冗余内容里，直接推理既贵又容易漏证据。
Method: H2S 采用 compress-then-reason 两段范式：先做源绑定的证据选择，再生成问题条件化摘要后作答；训练用 H2S-Dataset（6,647 例、11 个基准族、平均 43.9K token）与 H2S-RL，后者在最终答案正确性之外对证据选择和摘要构建给过程级奖励。
Result: 在 H2S-Bench 七任务长上下文套件、共享 128K 输入与 4K 输出预算下，H2S-14B 平均分 32.60，比 Qwen3.8-27B 高 10.17 分，为所评开源模型中最强；其 Evidence-Summary Quality 分数最高，且在仅 4K 输出预算下保住 16K 预算性能的 97.1%。
Conclusion: 显式先选证据再整合能同时提升长上下文推理并压缩生成长度，H2S-14B 在所评开源模型中总体最优。

papers.title: Completed Pairs Hide Capped Failures: A ReVerPi Case Study of Selective Context Projection
papers.abstract_en: Context projection replaces older tool observations with compact, addressable excerpts, reducing repeated input while potentially adding evidence-retrieval turns. We study this trade-off in ReVerPi, a Pi extension with archived observations and matched full/projected continuations. In an 86-run source-reading campaign with 641 model requests, the 15 completed pairs show identical success: 12/15 per arm. Twelve further boundary runs stop, with the runner suppressing the companion whenever the first arm fails to complete. Restoring all 27 boundary runs bounds projected-minus-full success between $-$9 and +1 tasks. One omitted, selector-chosen projected continuation successfully retrieves archive text yet exhausts twelve requests; its full counterpart answers in three. The eleven jointly correct pairs form a fully observed success stratum within this recorded frame: projection reduces aggregate logical tokens by 25%, while increasing the median pair's tokens by 29% and total suffix requests from 35 to 55. Separating fitting from evaluation changes the selector's apparent tie: outside its four fitting pairs, it incurs one extra failure and 8.6% more logical tokens over thirteen comparable runs. This methodological case study connects stopping rules, known bounded failures, unexecuted companions, and resource aggregation. Its findings concern the recorded campaign, rather than population noninferiority or superiority over unrestricted Pi. Evaluations should retain every intervention boundary, execute both allocated arms independently of the first arm's completion, and report completion alongside interaction and token expenditure.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 12 tables, 5 figures. Project code: https://github.com/timwhitez/ReVer_Pi. Source archive includes anc/ analysis data and reproduction scripts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ReVerPi（带归档观测的 Pi 扩展）上做选择性上下文投影 (selective context projection) 的方法学案例：86 次运行、641 次模型请求中，15 对完成的配对两臂成功率完全相同（各 12/15），但投影把聚合逻辑 token 降低 25%，同时中位配对 token 增加 29%、后缀请求从 35 升到 55。作者主张评估必须保留每个干预边界、独立执行两臂，并同时报告完成率与交互/token 开销。
Motivation: 上下文投影用紧凑摘录替换旧工具观测以省 token，却可能多出证据检索轮次；而停止规则会让失败臂的伴随臂被抑制，使配对比较只留下“完成的配对”，掩盖有界失败。
Method: 在 ReVerPi（Pi 扩展，含归档观测与配对的 full/projected 续跑）上做 86 运行、641 请求的源码阅读 campaign；按干预边界恢复 27 个 boundary runs，并把 selector 的 4 个拟合配对与评估分开统计。
Result: 15 个完成配对两臂成功数同为 12/15；恢复全部 27 个 boundary runs 后 projected−full 成功差被界定在 −9 到 +1 之间；一个被省略的 projected 续跑成功取回归档文本但耗尽 12 次请求，其 full 对应只用 3 次；11 个双方均正确的配对中，投影使聚合逻辑 token 减 25%，但中位配对 token 增 29%、总后缀请求由 35 增至 55；剔除 4 个拟合配对后 selector 多 1 次失败、逻辑 token 多 8.6%（13 次可比运行）。
Conclusion: 作者明确其结论只针对这次记录的 campaign，而非总体非劣或优于 unrestricted Pi；评估应独立执行两臂并同时报告完成率与交互、token 开销。

papers.title: ContraFM-S2O: Flow Matching-Based One-step SAR-to-Optical Image Translation Model with Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, diffusion models and GAN-based models have become the mainstream approaches for SAR-to-optical image translation, owing to their advantages, such as high-quality generation and stable training. However, they have shortcomings such as high inference latency and the generated optical images suffer from low detail fidelity, often resulting in blurred edges and loss of fine textures. Thus, we propose ContraFM-S2O, which is a flow matching-based model for SAR-to-optical image translation. Unlike conventional diffusion models, ContraFM-S2O learns to predict the velocity field in training and solves ODE instead of SDE during inference to improve the sampling efficiency. In addition, ContraFM-S2O replaces instantaneous velocity with average velocity along the interpolation path to realize one-step SAR-to-optical image translation and uses contrastive learning to improve the quality of the generated optical images. Experiments show our model achieves state-of-the-art on SAR2Opt and QXS datasets, outperforming baselines, and reduces inference latency via one-step generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContraFM-S2O 用 flow matching 学速度场、推理解 ODE 而非 SDE，并以插值路径上的平均速度替代瞬时速度，实现单步 SAR-to-optical 图像翻译，再加对比学习提升生成质量。在 SAR2Opt 与 QXS 数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，优于基线并靠单步生成降低推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 SAR-to-optical 翻译主流是 diffusion 与 GAN，推理延迟高，生成的光学图像细节保真度低，边缘模糊、细纹理丢失。
Method: 基于 flow matching：训练时预测速度场，推理时解 ODE 而非 SDE 以提高采样效率；用沿插值路径的平均速度取代瞬时速度，实现单步翻译；并引入对比学习 (contrastive learning) 提升生成光学图像质量。
Result: 在 SAR2Opt 与 QXS 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art，优于各基线，并通过单步生成降低推理延迟。
Conclusion: 以 flow matching 的平均速度场做单步生成，可以在保持生成质量的同时把 SAR-to-optical 翻译的推理延迟压下来。
Relevance: 1
