papers.title: Towards Whole-Study Screening for Congenital Heart Disease in Fetal Ultrasound Using Multiple Instance Learning
papers.abstract_en: Congenital heart disease (CHD) is the most common birth defect, yet a large fraction of cases remain undetected on prenatal ultrasound, in part because current artificial-intelligence methods assume that the key diagnostic frames have already been isolated from a study, by a clinician or by a view classifier. We remove that assumption and address CHD screening directly at the level of the whole ultrasound study. We propose a two-stage framework that first learns transferable frame representations by self-supervised masked-autoencoder pre-training on unlabeled fetal ultrasound, then identifies cardiac frames with a disease-robust module and aggregates them with a transformer-based multiple instance learning (MIL) model that produces a case-level diagnosis from study-level labels alone. The model further returns its highest-scoring frames for clinician review, and a hierarchical head separates critical from non-critical CHD. On the internal test set of our multi-source development cohort (FUSE), the proposed cardiac-gated MIL model reaches an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.985 with a specificity of 0.990, outperforming the reproduced NATMED ensemble (AUC 0.861, specificity 0.600) and the FetalCLIP foundation model (AUC 0.867, specificity 0.710). On an independent external cohort, all models initially perform near chance, but label-free CORAL adaptation raises the proposed model from an AUC of 0.513 to 0.944, whereas whole-study and view-dependent baselines do not recover. These results indicate that whole-study MIL with disease-robust cardiac-frame identification is an accurate and deployable route to prenatal CHD screening.

papers.title: RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop driving simulation requires rendered observations to remain reliable as the ego vehicle and surrounding actors move beyond their recorded trajectories, exposing views absent from the source log. Existing data-driven simulators reconstruct dynamic actors from sparse observations, which can result in rendering artifacts under these viewpoint changes. We introduce RECAST (REconstructing Controllable Actors for Simulation and Testing), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that generates a view-complete actor from a single segmented vehicle observation in a driving log and registers the generated actor in the reconstructed scene. RECAST supports planner-in-the-loop rendering under controlled ego-actor interactions. To adapt an image-to-3D prior to real vehicles, we further introduce RECAR, a dataset of approximately 20K real vehicles with 600K background-free RGBA images spanning diverse vehicle colors and types. We use two-stage adaptation to improve vehicle generation from real driving-log observations. At the actor level, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 9.788 to 7.992 relative to unadapted TRELLIS. At the scene level, under actor motion beyond logged trajectories, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 129.35 to 112.10 and increases $\mathrm{CLIP}_{\mathrm{margin}}$ ($\times1000$) from 0.14 to 3.47 relative to Street Gaussians. We demonstrate planner-in-the-loop simulation with the image-conditioned planner GTRS-Dense. Compared with native Street Gaussians actors, RECAST increases the no-collision (NC) rate from 22.2% (12/54) to 63.0% (34/54) and the mean minimum predicted time-to-collision (TTC) from 0.798 s to 2.150 s. These experiments show that RECAST supports closed-loop planner evaluation under controlled ego-actor interactions beyond log replay. Visit our project page at https://zijunkr.github.io/RECAST/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECAST 用 3D Gaussian Splatting 从驾驶日志中单帧分割车辆生成视角完备 (view-complete) 的可控 actor 并注册回重建场景，使闭环驾驶仿真在 ego 与 actor 越出记录轨迹时仍能渲染。相对 Street Gaussians，场景级 FD_incep 从 129.35 降到 112.10，CLIP_margin(×1000) 从 0.14 升到 3.47；配合 GTRS-Dense planner，无碰撞率从 22.2% (12/54) 提到 63.0% (34/54)，平均最小 TTC 从 0.798 s 提到 2.150 s。
Motivation: 闭环驾驶仿真要求渲染在 ego 与周围 actor 越出记录轨迹后仍可靠，而现有数据驱动仿真器只能从稀疏观测重建动态 actor，视角变化下会出现渲染伪影，无法支撑日志回放之外的 planner 评估。
Method: RECAST 框架从单帧分割车辆观测生成视角完备 actor 并配准到重建场景，支持 planner-in-the-loop 渲染；为把 image-to-3D 先验迁移到真实车辆，构建 RECAR 数据集（约 20K 真实车辆、600K 无背景 RGBA 图像，覆盖多种颜色与车型），并用两阶段适配改进真实日志观测下的车辆生成。
Result: actor 级 FD_incep 相对未适配 TRELLIS 从 9.788 降到 7.992；场景级在 actor 越出日志轨迹时，FD_incep 相对 Street Gaussians 从 129.35 降到 112.10，CLIP_margin(×1000) 从 0.14 升到 3.47；用图像条件 planner GTRS-Dense 做 planner-in-the-loop 仿真，无碰撞率相对原生 Street Gaussians actor 从 22.2% (12/54) 升到 63.0% (34/54)，平均最小预测 TTC 从 0.798 s 升到 2.150 s。
Conclusion: 把日志重建换成视角完备的生成式 actor，可在受控 ego-actor 交互下做超越日志回放的闭环 planner 评估，同时显著降低视角外推的渲染伪影。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Towards Understanding LLM-Based Log Anomaly Detection: An Empirical Study of Performance, Efficiency, and Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance in log anomaly detection, yet how their adaptation strategies, architectures, and deployment configurations affect detection effectiveness remains insufficiently understood. To investigate these factors, we conduct a systematic empirical analysis across three public log datasets, examining different adaptation strategies, model architectures, parameter scales, and quantization settings. Our results reveal substantial performance differences across adaptation strategies, while model scaling yields varying detection gains across datasets. We further observe that models with comparable detection accuracy can exhibit markedly different computational costs, and that low-bit quantization largely preserves detection performance in the evaluated configurations. Finally, we examine detection robustness under structural, semantic, and label noise at different perturbation levels. These findings provide empirical insights into the performance, efficiency, and robustness of LLM-based log anomaly detection, highlighting practical considerations beyond conventional accuracy-oriented evaluation.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对基于 LLM 的日志异常检测做系统实证比较：在三个公开日志数据集上扫描适配策略、模型架构、参数规模与量化设置，并在结构、语义、标签三类噪声下检验鲁棒性。发现适配策略之间性能差异显著、模型扩展的收益随数据集而异；检测精度相近的模型计算成本可相差很大，而低比特量化在所评测配置下基本保持检测性能。
Motivation: LLM 已在日志异常检测上展现潜力，但适配策略、架构与部署配置如何影响检测有效性、计算成本与抗噪能力仍缺乏系统认识，仅看准确率的评测掩盖了效率与鲁棒性差异。
Method: 在三个公开日志数据集上做受控实证分析，变化四个维度：适配策略、模型架构、参数规模、量化位宽；鲁棒性部分在结构噪声、语义噪声、标签噪声三种扰动下按不同扰动强度测试。
Result: 适配策略之间存在显著性能差异；模型扩展在不同数据集上带来的检测增益不一致；检测精度相当的模型计算成本差异明显；在所评测配置下低比特量化基本保持检测性能；结构、语义与标签噪声在不同扰动强度下均被用于检验鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 日志异常检测的 LLM 选型不能只看准确率，适配策略、部署成本与抗噪能力需要一起权衡，且扩展规模的收益依赖具体数据集。

papers.title: Equation discovery with Bayesian tree-adjoining grammars
papers.abstract_en: Tree-Adjoining Grammars (TAGs) have recently been introduced to Nonlinear System Identification (NLSI) as a means of encoding an entire model class as a finite set of grammatical rules, from which candidate models are assembled as trees. Existing TAG-based identifiers rely on evolutionary optimisation and return point estimates of the model structure. This paper instead proposes the TAG framework within a Bayesian setting. A generative prior is defined over tree structures and their parameters, and a Reversible-Jump MCMC sampler with structure-preserving tree moves is used to infer the joint posterior over model structure, parameters and predictions. Two training objectives are considered; that is, a one-step-ahead objective with conjugate parameter proposals, and a simulation-based objective handled by likelihood-free inference. The approach is validated on a simulated polynomial NARX system, the Silverbox benchmark, and wave-loading data from the Christchurch Bay Tower, where embedding Morison's equation as a fixed initial tree yields a grey-box model that outperforms the physics-driven baseline. The results demonstrate that Bayesian TAGs are well suited to quantifying uncertainty in equation discovery for dynamical systems and to fitting physics-informed models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Tree-Adjoining Grammar (TAG) 的方程发现放进贝叶斯框架：对树结构与参数定义生成式先验，用带保结构树移动的 Reversible-Jump MCMC 推断结构、参数与预测的联合后验。在模拟多项式 NARX、Silverbox 与 Christchurch Bay Tower 波浪载荷数据上验证，以 Morison 方程为固定初始树的灰箱模型优于物理驱动基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 TAG 的非线性系统辨识依赖进化优化，只给出模型结构的点估计，无法量化方程发现中的不确定性。
Method: 定义树结构与参数上的生成式先验，用 Reversible-Jump MCMC 配合保结构树移动推断结构、参数与预测的联合后验；比较两种训练目标——带共轭参数提议的 one-step-ahead 目标，以及用 likelihood-free inference 处理的 simulation-based 目标。
Result: 在模拟多项式 NARX 系统、Silverbox 基准和 Christchurch Bay Tower 波浪载荷数据上验证；将 Morison 方程嵌入为固定初始树得到的灰箱模型优于 physics-driven 基线。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯 TAG 适合量化动力系统方程发现的不确定性并拟合 physics-informed 模型，灰箱初始化（固定物理方程为初始树）能带来优于纯物理基线的拟合。

papers.title: OpenVAM: Open-World Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Predicting human gaze is a core capability for applications ranging from web/UI design analysis to robotics and human-computer interaction. Yet, most visual attention modeling methods output only a dense saliency map, which is often insufficient for action: practitioners need to connect attention peaks to discrete elements in the scene (what) and understand the drivers of those peaks in context (why), while remaining robust to domain shift across natural images, commercial content, and UI/web layouts. We, therefore, introduce OpenVAM (Open-world Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs), a unified framework that jointly addresses universality and explainability across heterogeneous domains (natural scenes, commercial imagery, and UI/web layouts) and supervision modalities. OpenVAM adopts a decoupled-but-aligned design: a dedicated dense visual pathway provides stable, spatially precise localization, while an instruction-following vision--language semantic head generates grounded what/why explanations conditioned on the same image and data-type prompts. A three-stage training strategy preserves strong localization priors while progressively introducing language grounding and improving explanation alignment via parameter-efficient adaptation without perturbing the saliency branch. We further propose a scalable pipeline to generate multi-domain saliency-reason annotations for training and systematic evaluation. Experiments across diverse datasets show that OpenVAM improves robustness under domain shift while producing image-grounded explanations that make saliency predictions more interpretable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenVAM 用解耦但对齐的双通路把视觉注意力建模从稠密显著图扩展到可解释输出：稠密视觉通路负责空间精确的注视定位，指令跟随的视觉-语言语义头在同一图像与数据类型提示下生成 grounded 的 what/why 解释。三阶段训练先保住定位先验，再逐步引入语言 grounding，用参数高效适配改进解释对齐且不扰动显著性分支。跨数据集实验显示它在域偏移（自然图像、商业图像、UI/web 版式）下更稳健，同时给出图像 grounded 的解释。
Motivation: 现有视觉注意力模型大多只输出稠密显著图，无法告诉实践者注意力峰值对应场景中哪个离散元素（what）以及为何在此（why），且在自然图像、商业内容与 UI/web 版式之间的域偏移下不稳健。
Method: OpenVAM 采用解耦但对齐的设计：专用稠密视觉通路提供稳定、空间精确的定位；指令跟随的 vision-language 语义头在同一图像与数据类型提示下生成 grounded what/why 解释。训练用三阶段策略，先保留强定位先验，再逐步引入语言 grounding，通过参数高效适配 (parameter-efficient adaptation) 改进解释对齐而不扰动显著性分支；另提出可扩展 pipeline 生成多域 saliency-reason 标注用于训练与系统评估。
Result: 跨多个多样数据集的实验显示 OpenVAM 在域偏移下提升稳健性，并产出图像 grounded 的解释，使显著性预测更可解释；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把定位与解释拆成对齐的双通路并配合三阶段训练，可在不牺牲显著性定位的前提下让注意力预测跨域更稳、更可解释。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Brenier Meets Adversarial Training: Optimal Transport Geometry for Robust Learning
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled framework for learning under distribution shift, but its practical use is hindered by the difficulty of evaluating worst-case risks for nonconvex loss functions. We study a penalized DRO formulation in which the adversary may choose any distribution but incurs a Wasserstein penalty for deviating from the empirical distribution. We show that the adversary's problem can be reformulated as an optimization problem over transport maps that push empirical samples to adversarial ones, and we prove that optimal maps are cyclically monotone. We also show that standard adversarial training---based on per-sample local optimization---violates cyclical monotonicity and wastes transport costs unless the adversary is severely restricted. We propose two remedies. First, we introduce multi-start particle ascent, which alternates parallel gradient ascent with reassignment to enforce cyclical monotonicity across samples. Second, we parameterize adversarial maps as gradients of input-convex neural networks, which guarantees cyclical monotonicity by construction. Experiments on robust regression, image classification, and robust control show that our methods consistently outperform standard adversarial training and state-of-the-art baselines, achieving improved robustness and better generalization under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带 Wasserstein 惩罚的 DRO 中，最优对抗传输映射必为循环单调 (cyclically monotone)，而基于逐样本局部优化的标准对抗训练违反该性质、浪费传输代价。作者提出 multi-start particle ascent（并行梯度上升加样本重分配）与基于输入凸神经网络 (ICNN) 梯度的映射参数化两种补救，前者显式、后者按构造保证循环单调。
Motivation: 非凸损失下 DRO 的最坏情形风险难以评估，标准对抗训练的逐样本局部优化与最优传输几何不一致，导致在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。
Method: 把对抗者的分布选择问题改写为推送经验样本到对抗样本的传输映射优化，并证明最优映射循环单调；补救一是 multi-start particle ascent，交替做并行梯度上升与样本重分配以跨样本强制循环单调，补救二是用输入凸神经网络的梯度参数化对抗映射，按构造保证循环单调。
Result: 在 robust regression、image classification 与 robust control 三类实验上，两种方法一致优于标准对抗训练与 state-of-the-art baselines，在分布偏移下取得更好的鲁棒性与泛化。
Conclusion: 把对抗训练对齐到 Brenier 意义下的最优传输几何（循环单调）能同时提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性与泛化，逐样本局部对抗在传输代价上是浪费的。

papers.title: Programs-of-Layers in LLMs through the Lens of Cortical Areas
papers.abstract_en: Inference in LLMs is conventionally a fixed-depth, fixed-order forward pass through every layer, regardless of how difficult the input is. The human brain does not work this way: using the thalamus as a central hub, it routes information flexibly to all regions of the cortex according to demand. Li et al. (2026) recently showed, with a system they call program-of-layers (PoLar), that transformers can be given an analogous flexibility if their layers are treated as a library of functions rather than a fixed sequence. Performance improves over the standard forward pass when each input is dynamically routed through an adaptive sequence of skipped or repeated contiguous layer blocks. We reconstructed PoLar's diagnostic MCTS in more detail than the original paper and applied it across 5 models. We reproduced several of PoLar's findings: skipping outperformed the standard pass, repeating outperformed skipping, and combining both outperformed either alone. Shorter programs sufficed for easier questions, while harder questions required more layer repeats. However, we failed to replicate the main claim regarding their learned router for single-shot inference: its top-ranked prediction consistently collapsed back to the standard pass, even though its top-k predicted programs, taken together, did show a real accuracy gain. Beyond reproduction, we find that a small number of generic programs are enough to solve most of the questions. We also provide a much deeper analysis of these programs' structure and robustness: for example, we found that programs that correct errors are highly brittle: undoing even a single edit inside a program typically breaks the correction. Connecting this to the brain's routing mechanisms, PoLar mirrors principles of thalamo-cortical coordination between cortical-area-like transformer layers. We publicly release the code at https://datexis.github.io/RE-PoLar/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 复现并扩展 PoLar（program-of-layers）：把 transformer 层当作函数库，用 MCTS 诊断式搜索为每个输入动态跳过或重复连续层块。在 5 个模型上复现了跳过优于标准前向、重复优于跳过、两者结合最优，且简单问题用更短程序；但其单次推理学习式 router 的 top-1 预测一致退化回标准前向，只有 top-k 候选合起来才有真实精度增益。
Motivation: LLM 推理固定深度、固定顺序，不随输入难度调整；PoLar 声称可用学习式 router 实现按需路由，其单次推理主结论需要独立复现检验。
Method: 更细致地重建 PoLar 的诊断式 MCTS，在 5 个模型上运行，比较跳过、重复及其组合的层块程序；分析程序结构与鲁棒性（如撤销程序内单个 edit 是否仍能纠错），并对照丘脑-皮层协调的路由机制。
Result: 在 5 个模型上复现：跳过优于标准前向，重复优于跳过，二者结合优于任一单独；简单问题用更短程序、难题需要更多层重复。学习式 router 的 top-1 预测一致坍缩回标准前向，但 top-k 预测合起来有真实精度提升。另发现少量通用程序即可解掉大部分问题，纠错型程序高度脆弱——撤销程序内单个 edit 通常就破坏纠错。
Conclusion: PoLar 的层块复用与按需路由有效，但其单次推理 router 的主结论未被复现；纠错程序脆弱，说明这类程序化层路由的鲁棒性有限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Safety-Bounded SDC-to-MCP Gateway for Medical AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a common interface through which AI applications discover and use external resources and tools. It allows language-model agents to ground their reasoning in current system state and interact with heterogeneous services. In medical environments, however, exposing device state and action affordances requires deterministic constraints on possible effects. We present an IEEE 11073 Service-Oriented Device Connectivity (SDC)-to-MCP gateway that exposes metrics, alarms, context references, and semantic metadata as read-only resources, while representing selected action affordances as policy-validated dry-run tools. The term safety-bounded denotes a narrow no-execution property: agent-facing requests dispatch no SDC device operation. A Python prototype supports simulated fault and lifecycle experiments, a software-reference protocol path spanning independent Java and Python implementations, deterministic baselines, representation ablations, and multi-model agent evaluation. The results show semantically explicit resource exposure, visible rejection of invalid or outdated state, and preservation of the no-execution boundary across resource, proposal, and authorization paths. Explicit semantic metadata improved conformity to required metric identifiers in structured alarm outputs relative to a generic representation, while retained structured-output failures reveal a distinction between plausible narrative answers and task-compliant machine-readable results.
papers.comment: 18 pages. Code: https://github.com/fischesn/sdc-mcp-gateway . Software and evaluation artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22960634
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 IEEE 11073 SDC 到 MCP 的安全受限网关：设备指标、告警、上下文引用与语义元数据以只读资源暴露，动作能力只作为经策略校验的 dry-run 工具，agent 请求不派发任何 SDC 设备操作。Python 原型在模拟故障与生命周期实验、Java/Python 双实现协议路径和多模型 agent 评测中保持 no-execution 边界；显式语义元数据比通用表示提升了结构化告警输出对必需指标标识符的符合度。
Motivation: 医疗环境中向 AI agent 暴露设备状态与动作能力需要对可能效果的确定性约束，而 MCP 本身不提供这种安全边界。
Method: 构建 SDC-to-MCP 网关：指标、告警、上下文引用、语义元数据映射为只读资源，选定动作能力表示为策略校验的 dry-run 工具，agent 侧请求不派发设备操作；用 Python 原型做模拟故障与生命周期实验，配合 Java 与 Python 独立实现的协议路径、确定性基线、表示消融与多模型 agent 评测。
Result: 结果显示语义显式的资源暴露、对无效或过期状态的可见拒绝，以及 resource、proposal、authorization 三条路径上 no-execution 边界均被保持；显式语义元数据相对通用表示提升了结构化告警输出对必需 metric 标识符的符合度，同时保留的结构化输出失败显示了貌似合理的叙述性回答与任务合规的机器可读结果之间的区别。
Conclusion: 安全受限的只读加 dry-run 映射足以让医疗 agent 接触设备语义而不触发操作，但叙述性回答合规不等于结构化输出合规，语义元数据的显式程度直接决定机器可读结果的可执行性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Open Vocabulary Domain Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization, yet they often encode unwanted or hazardous stylistic domains such as idealized textbook diagrams in medical AI or cartoon vehicles in autonomous driving. Approximate Domain Unlearning (ADU) aims to selectively erase a model's recognition of a target visual domain while preserving accuracy on the remaining domains. However, existing ADU methods operate under a flawed closed-vocabulary assumption: they evaluate unlearning solely on the specific object classes seen during the unlearning fine-tuning phase. Consequently, these methods do not unlearn the domain itself; they merely overfit to seen class-domain pairs, leaving the domain easily recognizable for unseen classes and providing a false sense of removal. We argue that true domain erasure must be class-agnostic. To address this, we formalize Open-Vocabulary Domain Unlearning (OVDU), a rigorous protocol that mandates domain forgetting must transfer to held-out classes. To solve the OVDU challenge, we propose a surgical parameter-editing framework. First, a Fisher Information mask isolates domain-sensitive weights, mathematically protecting foundational zero-shot generalization. Second, our Targeted Manifold Scattering (TMS) objective uses preference-based mining to locally scatter the forget domain's stylistic geometry. Evaluated across PACS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet, our method vastly improves open-vocabulary generalization over existing baselines. Crucially, it delivers exceptional sample efficiency, outperforming peak 8-shot baseline results with only 4 shots.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有近似域遗忘 (ADU) 只在微调时见过的类上评测，导致域本身未被抹除、换类即可重新识别。本文形式化开放词表域遗忘 (OVDU)，要求遗忘迁移到 held-out 类，并提出手术式参数编辑框架：Fisher 信息掩码隔离域敏感权重，Targeted Manifold Scattering (TMS) 目标用偏好挖掘散射遗忘域的风格几何，在 PACS、OfficeHome、DomainNet 上以 4 shot 超过既有基线的 8 shot 峰值结果。
Motivation: VLM 会编码不希望或有害的风格域（如医学 AI 中的理想化教科书图示、自动驾驶中的卡通车辆），而现有 ADU 方法建立在封闭词表假设上，只在见过的类-域对上过拟合，对未见类仍能轻易识别该域，给出虚假的移除效果。
Method: 提出 OVDU 协议，规定域遗忘必须迁移到 held-out 类；求解采用手术式参数编辑框架：先用 Fisher Information mask 隔离域敏感权重以保护基础零样本泛化，再用 Targeted Manifold Scattering (TMS) 目标，通过 preference-based mining 局部散射遗忘域的风格几何。
Result: 在 PACS、OfficeHome、DomainNet 上评测，该方法在开放词表泛化上大幅超越既有基线；样本效率突出，仅用 4 shot 即超过基线 8 shot 的峰值结果。
Conclusion: 真正的域抹除必须是类无关的：只在见过的类上评测会高估遗忘效果，而参数级编辑加风格几何散射可以在保护零样本能力的同时把遗忘迁移到未见类。

papers.title: Mutable Transcripts: Mitigating Context Pollution through Editable Conversation State
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary large language model (LLM) chat systems treat conversation history as an immutable sequence of turns that defines the model's working context. However, user intent in real interactions is not static: it evolves through correction, refinement, and shifting constraints. This mismatch between dynamic intent and static transcripts can result in context pollution, where outdated or irrelevant information persists and continues to influence subsequent responses. We introduce mutable transcripts, a new interaction paradigm that enables users to revise prior turns through natural language edit requests, allowing the conversation history itself to be updated rather than appended. This reframes the transcript from a passive record into an editable representation of conversational state. We present a working prototype that integrates transcript-level revision into a standard chat interface and evaluate its feasibility through a controlled user study (n=17) and an illustrative transcript analysis of representative interaction scenarios. Participants significantly preferred mutable transcripts over standard chat across measures of clarity, confidence, and ease of use, with reduced intent to restart conversations. Transcript analysis of representative user study conversations shows that mutable transcripts can reduce conversation length and eliminate obsolete retained context. These findings provide initial evidence that user-driven revision of conversational history can improve interaction quality and help maintain a more current representation of user intent. papers.title: Progressive Memory Transformer: Memory-Aware Attention for Time-Series
papers.abstract_en: Time-series carry structure simultaneously at multiple scales (fine-grained variation, mid-range motifs, and global properties) and downstream tasks operate at correspondingly different scales. Most existing self-supervised learning approaches supervise representations globally via instance-level contrastive losses and limited temporal neighborhood supervision, but do not explicitly exploit the structural hierarchy. We propose a learning framework that explicitly enforces a structural hierarchy across three scales independently: a local objective for token continuity, a mid-range objective for window-level motifs, and a global objective for sequence-level agreement. Realizing this framework requires the backbone to expose a representation at each scale; we introduce \textbf{Progressive Memory Transformer} (PMT), which augments a transformer with writable, window-aligned memory that exposes the mid-range scale alongside the token and sequence-level representations conventional transformers already provide. Across seven UCR/UEA/UCI classification benchmarks, a cue-retention probe, and forecasting benchmarks, PMT learns representations that probe well at the global, mid-range, and local scales---strong low-label classification (1--5\% labels), competitive forecasting performance across multiple horizons, and quantitative and qualitative evidence that memory states capture mid-range motifs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PMT 在 Transformer 上加可写、与窗口对齐的 memory，使中程尺度表示与 token、序列级表示并存，并用局部 token 连续性、窗口级 motif、序列级一致性三个独立目标强制结构层级。在七个 UCR/UEA/UCI 分类基准与 cue-retention probe 上，1–5% 标签下低标签分类表现强，多预报时效上 forecasting 具竞争力，且 memory 状态定量与定性地捕获中程 motif。
Motivation: 现有自监督时序表征多用实例级对比损失加有限的时序邻域监督做全局监督，没有显式利用细粒度变化、中程 motif、全局性质这一结构层级，而下游任务本就在不同尺度上运作。
Method: 提出分层自监督框架，在三个尺度上各自独立施加目标：局部目标管 token 连续性，中程目标管窗口级 motif，全局目标管序列级一致性。骨干需在每个尺度暴露表示，故引入 Progressive Memory Transformer (PMT)，为 Transformer 增加可写、窗口对齐的 memory，从而在 token 与序列表示之外提供中程尺度表示。
Result: 在七个 UCR/UEA/UCI 分类基准、一个 cue-retention probe 以及 forecasting 基准上评测：PMT 在 1–5% 标签设置下取得强的低标签分类结果，在多个预报时效上 forecasting 表现有竞争力，并给出 memory 状态捕获中程 motif 的定量与定性证据。
Conclusion: 把结构层级显式拆成三个尺度的独立目标、并让骨干在每个尺度暴露表示（PMT 的窗口对齐 memory 提供中程尺度），可以学到在全局、中程、局部三个尺度上都能探针出信息的时序表征。

papers.title: DyMD: Preserving Interaction Dynamics through Distribution Matching Distillation in Few-Step Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large video diffusion models offer expressive priors for embodied prediction and learning, yet their many-step sampling remains costly for interactive downstream use. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables few-step video generation, but can suppress robot--object motion while preserving visual quality. Examining DMD's teacher and fake-score signals, we find that weak re-noising keeps the teacher posterior concentrated near motion-deficient rollouts, limiting motion-restoring guidance. Meanwhile, stronger-motion rollouts tend to incur larger fake-score fitting errors, which can hinder the generator's learning of interaction dynamics. We propose DyMD, a DMD framework that adapts both teacher supervision and critic fitting to the evolving student. Temporal affinity--conditioned re-noise sampling adapts the timestep distribution to each rollout's current interaction fidelity by mixing the base schedule with a teacher prior motivated by local posterior variation, thereby balancing motion recovery and appearance refinement. To better track stronger-motion rollouts, dynamics-guided fake-score tracking uses a noise-conditioned predictor to estimate noise-relative fitting difficulty from latent temporal dynamics, then upweights predicted-hard rollouts in the critic loss. Using DyMD, we distill a 14B teacher into a four-step 1.3B student with no auxiliary modules at inference. On embodied-video benchmarks, the student improves R-Bench task adherence by $9.6$ percentage points and PAI-Bench-G Domain score by $5.1$ points over Base DMD while maintaining comparable visual quality. As a backbone for downstream action planning, our student achieves 34% mean success across two WorldArena tasks, compared with 16% for Base DMD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyMD 把 14B 视频扩散教师蒸馏成推理时四步、1.3B 的学生，通过按当前交互保真度自适应重加噪调度、以及按潜在时序动力学加权 critic 损失来保住机器人-物体运动。在具身视频基准上，学生相对 Base DMD 把 R-Bench 任务遵从提高 9.6 个百分点、PAI-Bench-G Domain 提高 5.1 分点，视觉质量相当；作为动作规划骨干在两个 WorldArena 任务上平均成功率 34% 对 16%。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型多步采样代价高，难以交互式使用；现成的 Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) 虽能做少步生成，却会压掉机器人-物体运动，只保住画面质量。
Method: DyMD 同时改造 DMD 的教师监督与 critic 拟合：temporal affinity-conditioned re-noise sampling 按每条 rollout 当前的交互保真度，把基础加噪调度与由局部后验变化导出的教师先验混合，以平衡运动恢复与外观精修；dynamics-guided fake-score tracking 用噪声条件预测器从潜在时序动力学估计相对拟合难度，在 critic 损失中上调预测为难的 rollout。
Result: 将 14B 教师蒸馏为四步 1.3B 学生，推理时无附加模块；在具身视频基准上相对 Base DMD，R-Bench 任务遵从提升 9.6 个百分点，PAI-Bench-G Domain 提升 5.1 分点，视觉质量相当；作为下游动作规划骨干，在两个 WorldArena 任务上平均成功率 34%，Base DMD 为 16%。
Conclusion: 作者主张 DMD 的运动退化源于弱重加噪使教师后验困在缺运动轨迹、以及强运动轨迹的 fake-score 拟合误差更大；让教师监督与 critic 拟合随学生演化而自适应，可在少步蒸馏中保住交互动力学并提升规划成功率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Right Information Extraction Pipeline Depends on the Document: Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs for Small, Local Models
papers.abstract_en: Whether an information extraction pipeline should process page images or parsed text depends on the document, and the answer flips across the layout spectrum. We study this trade-off under a constraint that rules out (closed) cloud services: privacy-sensitive documents processed on-premise by small ($\le 8\mathrm{B}$ parameter) text-only and vision--language models, evaluated on both accuracy and energy over a design space spanning input representation, model family, and inference configuration. Benchmarking on the near-plain-text Kleister-NDA contracts and the layout-rich VRDU forms, we find that batching is the dominant energy lever, cutting energy per page by 38-85% at no cost in accuracy, while FP8 quantization saves 27-32% when requests are served one at a time but less than 1mWh per page (9-19%) once batching is applied. Preprocessing dominates what remains: neural OCR costs $17\times$ more energy per page than classical OCR and never reaches the Pareto frontier. Which representation wins flips with the type of document: vision--language models on layout-rich documents and small text-only models with a cheap parser on near-plain text, where they are both more accurate and cheaper than any vision--language configuration. Our work yields concrete guidelines for energy-efficient, privacy-compliant local information extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在隐私约束下本地部署 ≤8B 小模型做信息抽取时，最优管线随文档版式翻转：版式复杂的 VRDU 表单用 vision-language model，近纯文本的 Kleister-NDA 合同用便宜解析器加纯文本小模型（更准且更省电）。批处理是主导节能手段，每页能耗降 38–85% 且精度不掉；神经 OCR 每页能耗是传统 OCR 的 17 倍且从不上 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 隐私敏感文档只能本地处理，无法用闭源云服务；在小模型上选图像输入还是解析文本输入缺乏同时考虑精度与能耗的判据，而版式差异可能让结论翻转。
Method: 在输入表示、模型族与推理配置的设计空间上做基准评测，同时度量精度与每页能耗；对比近纯文本的 Kleister-NDA 合同与版式丰富的 VRDU 表单两类文档，覆盖纯文本小模型加解析器与 vision-language model 两条管线，并测试批处理、FP8 量化与神经/传统 OCR 预处理。
Result: 批处理使每页能耗下降 38–85% 且精度无损失；FP8 在逐条请求时省 27–32%，批处理后仅省不到 1mWh/页（9–19%）；神经 OCR 每页能耗是传统 OCR 的 17 倍且从未进入 Pareto 前沿；近纯文本上纯文本小模型加解析器比任何 vision-language 配置都更准更省。
Conclusion: 能效优先的本地信息抽取应按文档版式选管线：版式丰富用 VLM，近纯文本用解析器加小文本模型，且先上批处理再谈量化，神经 OCR 不值得用。

papers.title: ChronoFuseGS: Multi-Temporal Gaussian Fusion with Per-Splat Persistence and Change Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing environments where parts of the scene change between captured image sets poses a challenge for 3D scene reconstruction. We present ChronoFuseGS, a multi-temporal Gaussian Splatting approach that addresses this issue by taking multiple separately trained Gaussian Splatting models, each representing a distinct timestep and partially overlapping in geographic coverage, and merging them into a single combined model. By allowing Gaussians from one timestep to contribute to the reconstruction at other timesteps, our approach leverages data across all captured timesteps to refine persistent parts of the scene. The model supports incremental extension, allowing new timesteps to be added while preserving the existing merged reconstruction. It encodes, for each Gaussian primitive, at which timesteps it contributes to the reconstruction. To support visual exploration of the reconstructed scene, we present a change-aware visualization approach that highlights the parts of the scene that have changed across a user-defined time selection, while preserving the color of persistent parts. Since the persistence encoding operates at the Gaussian primitive level, changes are visualized at sub-object granularity rather than being limited to object-level changes. We evaluate our approach on a real-world outdoor dataset of a flood management area, captured over 7 months across eight recording days and covering seasonal vegetation changes, snow cover, and flooding events, which we make publicly available. Our results demonstrate that the combined model consistently outperforms individually trained single-timestep models in novel-view synthesis quality, recovers structural details absent in the individual reconstructions, and reliably highlights changes in fine details and sub-parts of objects and natural structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChronoFuseGS 把多个分别训练、地理覆盖部分重叠的 Gaussian Splatting 模型按时间步合并成单一模型，允许某时间步的高斯参与其他时间步的重建，从而用全部时间步的数据精修场景中持久不变的部分。在 7 个月、8 个拍摄日的真实户外洪水管理区数据集上，合并模型的新视角合成质量稳定优于单时间步独立训练，并能以亚对象粒度标出跨时间变化。
Motivation: 同一场景在不同拍摄批次之间会发生季节植被变化、积雪与洪水等局部改变，单时间步 Gaussian Splatting 只能各自重建，持久部分缺少跨批次信息，也难以可视化哪些部分变了。
Method: 对每个时间步单独训练 Gaussian Splatting，再合并为单一模型，允许跨时间步的高斯参与重建；为每个高斯原语编码其参与的时间步（persistence encoding），支持增量加入新时间步而不破坏已有合并结果；配套 change-aware 可视化在用户选定的时间范围内高亮变化区域并保留持久部分颜色。
Result: 在公开的真实户外洪水管理区数据集上检验：7 个月、8 个拍摄日，覆盖季节植被变化、积雪与洪水事件；合并模型的新视角合成质量一致优于各自训练的单时间步模型，并恢复出单步重建中缺失的结构细节，可靠高亮细节与对象/自然结构亚部件的变化。
Conclusion: 把多时间步 Gaussian Splatting 合并并按高斯原语记录时间持久性，可以在不牺牲新视角合成质量的前提下做亚对象粒度的变化可视化；该数据集被公开发布。

papers.title: Bridging Body and Brain: Gene-Driven Morphology--Control Co-Design
papers.abstract_en: Morphology--control co-design jointly optimizes an agent's body structure and control policy as an integrated embodied system. However, existing methods typically model morphology design and control with separate networks coupled only indirectly through a shared task objective, limiting explicit high-level coordination. Inspired by natural genes that coordinate biological development, we introduce \textbf{Morphogene}, a compact latent blueprint that bridges an agent's body and brain. Through AdaConcat, Morphogene jointly conditions morphology and control generation at the limb level, allowing its variations to induce coordinated changes in both components. Building on this representation, we propose \textbf{GeCode}, which formulates co-design as exploration in the compact Morphogene space. Each Morphogene anchors a local design region in which nearby body--brain designs are explored, while performance-guided updates move these anchors toward promising regions for more efficient exploration of the broader design space. This process combines local refinement with global exploration while preserving body--brain compatibility. Extensive experiments across diverse 2D and 3D co-design tasks demonstrate that GeCode consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving substantially faster convergence and higher final performance.

papers.title: CG-HAF: An Interpretable Global-Local Lesion-Burden Fusion Framework for Ordinal Acne Severity Grading in Agentic Skincare Support
papers.abstract_en: Ordinal acne severity grading requires distinguishing visually similar neighboring grades while jointly weighing holistic facial appearance and localized lesion burden - evidence that most existing approaches collapse into a single opaque representation. We introduce CG-HAF, a global-local fusion framework that instead keeps this evidence explicit: averaged holistic severity probabilities from independently trained classifiers are combined with structured lesion-burden descriptors from an object detector (lesion count, detection confidence, lesion area) into a compact representation, from which a lightweight, interpretable classifier produces the final grade. On a widely used benchmark, this fusion yields a clear, statistically supported improvement over global-evidence-only baselines, with the largest gains on the most severe cases. Testing on an independent dataset with a different grading standard shows that strong within-dataset performance does not transfer automatically, and a follow-up diagnostic attributes much of this gap to mismatched grading criteria rather than detection failure alone. These findings support interpretable global-local fusion as an effective strategy for ordinal acne grading while highlighting criterion alignment as key to cross-dataset portability, with a further illustration of how the resulting severity signal can support transparent, non-diagnostic decision-making in skincare applications.

TL;DR: CG-HAF 把多个独立训练分类器的整体严重度概率均值，与目标检测器给出的结构化病灶负担描述子（病灶计数、检测置信度、病灶面积）拼成紧凑表示，再由轻量可解释分类器输出痤疮等级。在常用基准上该融合相对仅用全局证据的基线有统计显著提升，最严重等级增益最大；换到采用不同分级标准的独立数据集后性能不自动迁移，诊断归因于分级标准不匹配而非单纯检测失败。
Motivation: 序数痤疮分级要区分视觉上相近的相邻等级，同时权衡整脸外观与局部病灶负担，而现有方法多把这两类证据压进单一不透明表示，跨数据集迁移也因分级标准不一致而失效。
Method: 独立训练的整体严重度分类器输出概率取均值，与目标检测器的病灶计数、检测置信度、病灶面积三类结构化描述子融合成紧凑表示，再由轻量、可解释的分类器给出最终等级；另在独立数据集上做迁移测试并诊断性能差距来源。
Result: 在广泛使用的基准上，全局-局部融合相对仅全局证据基线有清晰且统计显著的提升，最严重病例增益最大；在采用不同分级标准的独立数据集上测试显示数据集内强表现不自动迁移，后续诊断把差距很大一部分归因于分级标准不匹配而非仅检测失败。
Conclusion: 可解释的全局-局部融合是序数痤疮分级的有效策略，而跨数据集可移植性的关键是分级标准对齐；所得严重度信号可用于护肤场景中透明、非诊断性的决策支持。

papers.title: More Sensors Only One Field: Rethinking Continual Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Continual spatio-temporal forecasting supports traffic management and environmental monitoring under evolving dynamics and expanding sensor networks. However, conventional graph-based continual learning methods tie forecasting representations to the current sensor layout, so sensor expansion can alter the representation of learned spatial relationships. Our key insight is that sensor expansion changes the evidence available about a process without necessarily changing the dynamics to be learned. We propose STFO (Spatio-Temporal Field Operator), which parameterizes forecasting knowledge as a shared field-evolution operator and handles changing sensor layouts through observation and query interfaces. Normalized coordinate-based aggregation lifts irregular sensor histories onto a fixed latent grid, enabling reuse of learned spatial maps across observation sets without sensor-specific parameters. To accommodate process drift, a spectral descriptor summarizes variation across spatial scales and conditions Fourier propagation and attention to adapt operator responses to the current spatial regime. Coordinate-based decoding queries the evolved field at sensor locations and combines spatial corrections with local-history predictions. Experiments on PEMS-Stream, CA-Stream, and AIR-Stream demonstrate state-of-the-art average forecasting performance. STFO-Large reduces average MAE over DOL by 8.4% on PEMS-Stream and 4.7% on CA-Stream. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xielewei/Spatio-Temporal-Field-Operator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STFO 把时空预报知识参数化为共享的场演化算子 (field-evolution operator)，用归一化坐标聚合把不规则传感器历史抬到固定隐网格，使传感器扩容只改变观测证据而不改变要学的动力学。在 PEMS-Stream 与 CA-Stream 上达到 SOTA 平均预报性能，STFO-Large 相对 DOL 的平均 MAE 分别降低 8.4% 与 4.7%。
Motivation: 图式持续学习把预报表征绑死在当前传感器布局上，传感器扩容会改写已学到的空间关系表征，而交通与环境监测中传感网还在不断扩张。
Method: STFO 由观测与查询接口构成：归一化坐标聚合把不规则传感器历史映射到固定隐网格，避免传感器专属参数；谱描述子 (spectral descriptor) 汇总各空间尺度的变化，条件化 Fourier 传播与 attention 以适配当前空间机制；坐标解码在传感器位置查询演化后的场，把空间修正与局部历史预测相加。
Result: 在 PEMS-Stream、CA-Stream、AIR-Stream 上取得 SOTA 平均预报性能；STFO-Large 相对 DOL 的平均 MAE 在 PEMS-Stream 上降低 8.4%，在 CA-Stream 上降低 4.7%。
Conclusion: 把预报知识写成与传感器布局无关的场演化算子，可在传感网扩容与过程漂移下复用已学到的空间图，而不必随布局重训。

papers.title: AgentXploit: Autonomous Repository-to-Runtime Red-Teaming for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents combine language models with external data and tools that can modify files, call APIs, or execute code. Security failures can arise when adversarial content changes an agent's tool use or when the surrounding software contains vulnerabilities such as path traversal or command injection. We study authorized white-box pre-deployment auditing, where the auditor has access to the target repository and a controlled runtime, but successful attacks must still act through the task-defined attacker interface and be confirmed by an external verifier. We present AgentXploit, a two-role auditing system that separates repository-level attack-path discovery from runtime exploitation. The Analyzer Agent traces attacker-controlled inputs to sensitive operations and records code-supported candidate attack paths; the Exploiter Agent turns these paths into concrete attacks and revises them using runtime feedback. We also introduce AgentXploit-Bench, containing 72 reproducible vulnerabilities across 12 open-source AI-agent systems and frameworks. Across three runs, AgentXploit reaches 59.3% end-to-end success, compared with 38.4% for Codex. Under a token-budget-matched comparison, Codex reaches 46.3%. On AgentDojo, where injection points are provided, the Exploiter Agent reaches 79.2% attack success versus 52.7% for AgentVigil. These results highlight repository discovery and runtime exploitation as distinct challenges in end-to-end agent security auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentXploit 把 AI agent 的授权白盒预部署红队拆成两角色：Analyzer Agent 在仓库层追踪攻击者可控输入到敏感操作、记录有代码依据的攻击路径，Exploiter Agent 再把这些路径变成具体攻击并按运行时反馈改写。在自建的 AgentXploit-Bench（12 个开源 agent 系统、72 个可复现漏洞）上三次运行端到端成功率 59.3%，对比 Codex 的 38.4%（token 预算对齐后 Codex 为 46.3%）；在注入点已给出的 AgentDojo 上，Exploiter Agent 攻击成功率 79.2% 对 AgentVigil 的 52.7%。
Motivation: AI agent 会改文件、调 API、执行代码，对抗性内容或仓库自身的路径遍历、命令注入漏洞都能改变其工具使用；现有审计缺少在部署前对整个仓库到运行时链路做可复现验证的手段。
Method: 两角色系统：Analyzer Agent 做仓库级攻击路径发现，追踪攻击者可控输入到敏感操作并记录代码支持的候选路径；Exploiter Agent 承担运行时利用，把路径转成具体攻击并依据运行时反馈迭代修订。攻击须经任务定义的攻击者接口并由外部验证器确认；同时提出 AgentXploit-Bench，含 12 个开源 AI-agent 系统与框架的 72 个可复现漏洞。
Result: 三次运行端到端成功率 59.3%，Codex 为 38.4%；token 预算对齐比较下 Codex 为 46.3%。在注入点已提供的 AgentDojo 上，Exploiter Agent 攻击成功率 79.2%，AgentVigil 为 52.7%。
Conclusion: 仓库级发现与运行时利用是端到端 agent 安全审计中两个可分开处理的挑战，分角色处理能显著抬高成功率。

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery in Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Unobserved common causes are pervasive in real-world time series and can induce spurious associations that causal discovery methods mistake for direct edges. We propose LUCID (Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery, a regime-adaptive deconfounding layer that first estimates the confounding regime from data using a Marčenko--Pastur spectral router, then applies a deconfounding strategy matched to that regime. When the spectrum indicates pervasive factor confounding, LUCID attenuates factor-dominated variation and recovers contemporaneous (lag-$0$) structure from the resulting innovations, with edge selection calibrated against a data-driven edge-free null. Rather than being tied to a particular discovery algorithm, it can wrap existing discovery engines; we demonstrate consistent improvements across three such methods. On a diverse synthetic out-of-distribution benchmark spanning changes in confounder strength and sparsity, loading density, lag structure, volatility dynamics, edge heterogeneity, persistence, intermittency, and tail behavior, LUCID achieves the best family-weighted directed, lag-resolved graph $F_1$ ($0.60$), improving over the strongest baseline by $0.19$ absolute ($\approx\!46\%$ relative). Its advantage widens relative to looser lag-collapsed scoring, and remains robust under intermittent and heavy-tailed confounding. Code reproducing the method, the benchmark generators, and every reported experiment is available at https://github.com/bloomberg/causal-ts.

TL;DR: LUCID 是一个可包裹现有因果发现引擎的去混淆层：先用 Marčenko–Pastur 谱路由从数据判定混淆体制，再按体制选择去混淆策略，在因子混淆普遍时衰减因子主导变异并从残差中恢复 lag-0 同期结构，边选择用数据驱动的无边零假设校准。在覆盖混淆强度、稀疏度、滞后结构、间歇性与重尾等变化的合成 OOD 基准上，其 family-weighted lag-resolved 图 F1 达 0.60，比最强基线高 0.19 绝对（约 46% 相对）。
Motivation: 未观测共同原因在真实时间序列中普遍存在，会制造伪关联，使因果发现方法把混淆路径误判为直接边；固定单一去混淆策略难以同时应对不同混淆体制。
Method: LUCID（Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery）分两步：用 Marčenko–Pastur 谱路由器估计数据所处的混淆体制，再套用与该体制匹配的去混淆策略；当谱显示因子混淆普遍时，衰减因子主导变异并从所得 innovations 恢复 lag-0 结构，边选择对照数据驱动的 edge-free null 校准。该层与具体发现算法解耦，可包裹已有引擎，作者在三种发现方法上演示。
Result: 在合成 OOD 基准（覆盖混淆强度与稀疏度、载荷密度、滞后结构、波动动态、边异质性、持续性、间歇性与尾部行为的变化）上，LUCID 取得最佳 family-weighted directed、lag-resolved 图 F1 0.60，较最强基线提升 0.19 绝对（约 46% 相对）；相对更宽松的 lag-collapsed 评分优势扩大，且在间歇性与重尾混淆下保持稳健。
Conclusion: 先按谱判定混淆体制再匹配去混淆策略，能在体制变化的 OOD 条件下稳定提升滞后分辨的因果图恢复，且作为通用包裹层对三种发现引擎均有一致改进。

papers.title: CytoSPM: Open-Vocabulary Cytopathology Detection with Structured Prompt Bank
papers.abstract_en: Cytopathology detection requires open-vocabulary recognition because cellular categories are fine-grained, long-tailed, and continuously evolving across different organ systems. However, existing cytology detectors are mostly single-domain and closed-set, and there is still no unified benchmark for evaluating open-vocabulary cytopathology detection. We present PentaCyto, a multi-domain benchmark covering cervical, urinary, respiratory, serous fluid, and thyroid cytology, with 24 base categories and 9 held-out novel categories. Each category is associated with structured cytomorphology prompts that describe diagnostic morphological attributes and provide clinically grounded textual knowledge. We further propose CytoSPM, an efficient detector based on a decoupled two-stage design. It first extracts reusable class-agnostic visual representations, and then performs class-aware structural prompt matching with class names and cytomorphology prompts. On PentaCyto, CytoSPM outperforms existing methods in novel-category detection and open-vocabulary detection while maintaining efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CytoSPM 用解耦两阶段设计做开放词汇细胞病理检测：先抽类无关的可复用视觉表征，再用类名与结构化形态学提示做类感知的结构提示匹配 (structural prompt matching)。在自建五域基准 PentaCyto（24 个 base 类 + 9 个 held-out novel 类）上，其 novel 类与开放词汇检测均超过现有方法，同时保持高效推理。
Motivation: 细胞类别细粒度、长尾且随器官系统不断演化，需要开放词汇识别；但现有细胞学检测器多为单域闭集，且没有统一的开放词汇细胞病理检测评测基准。
Method: 提出 PentaCyto 多域基准，覆盖宫颈、尿液、呼吸、浆液与甲状腺细胞学，每类配结构化形态学提示 (structured cytomorphology prompts)；检测器 CytoSPM 为解耦两阶段：第一阶段提取类无关视觉表征，第二阶段以类名和形态学提示做类感知的结构提示匹配。
Result: PentaCyto 含 5 个域、24 个 base 类与 9 个 held-out novel 类；CytoSPM 在 novel 类检测与开放词汇检测上均优于现有方法，并保持高效推理。
Conclusion: 结构化形态学提示加解耦两阶段检测，可在多域细胞学上同时拿到开放词汇检测精度与推理效率。

papers.title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), while showing strong potential for robot control, require massive amounts of high-quality imitation learning data. Moreover, the absence of an explicit world model casts further doubt on their control capabilities. In this concept paper, we propose a novel architecture that addresses sample efficiency in VLAs by training a predictive world model on the embedding space of the VLA's vision encoder. We hypothesize that these embeddings are action-relevant and usable for future prediction. To this end, we propose using the suggested architecture to investigate how well these embeddings predict the future based on actions, as the inability to do so would mark a key limitation of VLA architectures: the lack of a non-lossy implicit world model to simulate real-world dynamics. The proposed architecture differs from the standard world model dynamics as the loss comes from the embedding space rather than the pixel space, similar to joint embedding predictive architectures. Furthermore, the trained world model can be utilized for short-term planning tasks by sampling VLA actions given goal images. We intend to examine the richness of vision embeddings in VLAs and reduce their high data requirements through a world model that can also generate plans during inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-Dreamer 概念论文提出在 VLA 视觉编码器的 embedding 空间上训练预测式 world model，损失取自 embedding 空间而非像素空间（类似 JEPA），以检验这些 embedding 是否对动作相关、能否按动作预测未来。若预测失败，即说明 VLA 缺少非有损的隐式世界模型；若成功，则可用该 world model 在给定目标图像时采样 VLA 动作做短期规划，从而降低 VLA 对海量模仿数据的依赖。
Motivation: VLA 机器人控制依赖大量高质量模仿学习数据，且缺少显式 world model，控制能力与样本效率都受限。
Method: 在 VLA 视觉编码器的 embedding 空间上训练预测式 world model，损失来自 embedding 空间而非像素空间，结构上接近 joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)；训练后可在给定 goal image 时采样 VLA 动作用于短期规划。
Result: 论文为概念论文，提出架构与检验假设：VLA 的视觉 embedding 是动作相关且可用于未来预测的；拟检验 embedding 按动作预测未来的能力，并借此降低 VLA 的高数据需求。
Conclusion: 若 VLA embedding 无法按动作预测未来，就构成 VLA 架构缺少非有损隐式世界模型的关键局限；作者意图用该 world model 同时做短期规划以缓解数据饥渴。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Benchmarking Attention for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular in-context learners such as TabPFN, Mitra, or ConTextTab rely on alternating row and column attention over 2D sequences of latent embeddings. These attention patterns differ markedly from the one-dimensional case in language models: row attention involves longer sequences while column attention operates on much shorter ones, and the strided memory layout of tabular data makes producing contiguous tensors costly. Moreover, the hidden dimensions used in current models are small compared to recent language models. Yet efficient attention has been studied mostly for one-dimensional sequences, leaving the two-dimensional tabular setting unexplored. To this end, we create a reproducible benchmarking setup and study the unique characteristics of tabular attention across several backends -- Torch SDPA (efficient and cuDNN), FlashAttention-2/3/4, and the inference-only backends vLLM and SageAttention -- measuring forward and backward throughput across realistic tabular shapes on three GPU generations (A100, H100, B200). We find that the optimal backend choice differs between column and row attention and varies across hardware as well as model specifics: While the FlashAttention implementations tailored for each GPU generation perform overall best, they are at times outperformed by CuDNN in the case of column attention at longer sequences with cross-over points depending on the head dimension. Among inference-only backends, SageAttention performs well for row attention and large sequences beyond 16\,k rows. Our reproducible benchmark lays the foundation for future improvements to table-native attention. The self-contained benchmarking and evaluation code is openly available at: https://github.com/SAP-samples/tabular-attention-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对表格基础模型 (TabPFN、Mitra、ConTextTab) 中行列交替注意力的二维序列特性，建立可复现的注意力后端基准，在 A100、H100、B200 三代 GPU 上测前向与反向吞吐。最优后端随行列注意力类型、硬件和 head dimension 变化：按 GPU 定制的 FlashAttention 整体最好，但列注意力在长序列上 cuDNN 时有反超，交叉点取决于 head dimension；纯推理后端中 SageAttention 在超过 16k 行的大序列行注意力上表现好。
Motivation: 高效注意力研究几乎都针对语言模型的一维序列，而表格模型的行注意力序列长、列注意力序列短，且 strided 内存布局使连续张量构造开销大、hidden dimension 偏小，这一二维设定此前未被系统考察。
Method: 搭建可复现的基准框架，覆盖 Torch SDPA（efficient 与 cuDNN 两种实现）、FlashAttention-2/3/4，以及仅推理的 vLLM 与 SageAttention；在贴近真实的表格形状上测前向与反向吞吐，硬件覆盖 A100、H100、B200 三代 GPU。
Result: 最优后端在列注意力与行注意力之间不同，且随硬件与模型细节变化：面向各代 GPU 定制的 FlashAttention 整体最优，但列注意力在较长序列上会不时被 cuDNN 反超，交叉点位置取决于 head dimension；在仅推理的后端中，SageAttention 于行注意力且序列超过 16k 行时表现良好。
Conclusion: 表格原生注意力不存在单一最优后端，选型必须按行列注意力类型、序列长度、head dimension 与 GPU 代际分别决定；该基准与开源代码为后续改进 table-native attention 提供可复现的起点。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Geometric Moment Contraction for Stochastic Nesterov Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: We study geometric moment contraction (GMC) of the constant-parameter stochastic Nesterov recursion \[ Y_k=Θ_k+β(Θ_k-Θ_{k-1}),\qquad Θ_{k+1}=Y_k-γG(Y_k,X_{k+1}). \] Under mean strong monotonicity and stochastic $L^p$ Lipschitz continuity, an explicit Perron comparison proves synchronous $L^p$ contraction when $βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p})$. This direct criterion includes infinite-variance gradients for $1<p<2$, but its small-step regime requires $β<μ/(μ+L_p)$. A complementary power-Lyapunov argument establishes a positive, generally much smaller, step-size interval for every fixed $β<1$ and every $p>1$, using only a finite $p$th gradient moment. At $p=2$, a simpler explicit certificate gives \[ 0<γ<\frac{2μ(1-β)^2}{L_2^2(1-β+2β^2)}. \] Its quadratic high-momentum scaling is a limitation of the chosen metric, not a sharp stability boundary. We quantify this loss, provide a general mean-only quadratic $S$-procedure, and exploit endpoint Lyapunov inequalities under stronger samplewise sector information. Verified endpoint certificates can be orders of magnitude less conservative than the explicit metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在均值强单调与随机 L^p Lipschitz 条件下，为常参数随机 Nesterov 递推给出几何矩收缩 (GMC) 判据：显式 Perron 比较证明当 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p}) 时同步 L^p 收缩，且该判据覆盖 1<p<2 的无穷方差梯度。p=2 时给出显式步长上界 0<γ<2μ(1-β)^2/(L_2^2(1-β+2β^2))，其高动量下二次标度被作者认定为所选度量的保守性而非真实稳定边界，经端点 Lyapunov 不等式与 S-程序验证的证书可比显式度量小若干个数量级。
Motivation: 随机 Nesterov 加速在无穷方差梯度（1<p<2）下缺少可直接使用的收敛步长判据，而已有显式界在高动量时过于保守，掩盖真实稳定区间。
Method: 对递推 Y_k=Θ_k+β(Θ_k-Θ_{k-1}), Θ_{k+1}=Y_k-γG(Y_k,X_{k+1})，先用显式 Perron 比较得同步 L^p 收缩判据 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p})（小步长区间要求 β<μ/(μ+L_p)）；再用 power-Lyapunov 论证对任意固定 β<1 与 p>1 给出仅需有限 p 阶梯度矩的正步长区间；p=2 另给显式证书，并提供一般均值二次 S-程序与更强逐样本扇区信息下的端点 Lyapunov 不等式。
Result: 显式判据 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p}) 覆盖 1<p<2 无穷方差梯度，但小步长区间要求 β<μ/(μ+L_p)；power-Lyapunov 对每个固定 β<1、p>1 给出正步长区间（通常远小于前者），仅需有限 p 阶梯度矩；p=2 显式证书为 0<γ<2μ(1-β)^2/(L_2^2(1-β+2β^2))，其二次高动量标度是所选度量的保守性；经验证的端点证书可比显式度量保守若干个数量级。
Conclusion: 随机 Nesterov 的 GMC 可用显式 Perron 判据与 power-Lyapunov 两条互补路线刻画，p=2 的二次高动量步长界应视为度量选择的产物，实际可用步长区间应以端点 Lyapunov 与 S-程序证书为准。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 对递推 Y_k=Θ_k+β(Θ_k-Θ_{k-1}), Θ_{k+1}=Y_k-γG(Y_k,X_{k+1})，先用显式 Perron 比较得同步 L^p 收缩判据 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p})（小步长区间要求 β<μ/(μ+L_p)）；再用 power-Lyapunov 论证对任意固定 β<1 与 p>1 给出仅需有限 p 阶梯度矩的正步长区间；p=2 另给显式证书，并提供一般均值二次 S-程序与更强逐样本扇区信息下的端点 Lyapunov 不等式。
summary_sections.result: 显式判据 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p}) 覆盖 1<p<2 无穷方差梯度，但小步长区间要求 β<μ/(μ+L_p)；power-Lyapunov 对每个固定 β<1、p>1 给出正步长区间（通常远小于前者），仅需有限 p 阶梯度矩；p=2 显式证书为 0<γ<2μ(1-β)^2/(L_2^2(1-β+2β^2))，其二次高动量标度是所选度量的保守性；经验证的端点证书可比显式度量保守若干个数量级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随机 Nesterov 的 GMC 可用显式 Perron 判据与 power-Lyapunov 两条互补路线刻画，p=2 的二次高动量步长界应视为度量选择的产物，实际可用步长区间应以端点 Lyapunov 与 S-程序证书为准。

papers.title: Beyond Approved Actions: Runtime Validation of Persistent Outcomes in Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly act on software systems, no longer merely generating text but also changing databases and online services. However, an approved database update may succeed yet leave an unapproved notification because execution can produce persistent effects beyond the requested change. Current safeguards can approve an action or record its aftermath, but without checking the persistent result before continuation, an unapproved outcome can be accepted as success and propagated to later steps. We present EffectMatch, a runtime that collects persistent changes within a controlled execution boundary and compares them with what the application approved for the current state and execution. The comparison governs commit and dependent execution. In comparative evaluation on 206 public business tasks, EffectMatch preserved all clean executions and prevented all tested incorrect commits. Six 20-run ablations exposed the failure caused by each removed mechanism, while 80 task-topology cases preserved truthful handoffs and blocked invalid continuation. Together, these results show that EffectMatch blocks the silent acceptance and downstream propagation of persistent outcomes inconsistent with application approval.
papers.comment: 22 pages including 7 pages of supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EffectMatch 在受控执行边界内收集 LLM agent 产生的持久化变更，并与应用在当前状态和执行下批准的预期结果比对，据此决定是否 commit 以及是否允许后续依赖步骤执行。在 206 个公开业务任务的对比评测中保留了全部干净执行并阻止了全部被测的错误提交；六组各 20 次的消融显示去掉任一机制都会导致失败，80 个任务拓扑用例保持了真实交接并拦截了无效续执行。
Motivation: LLM agent 已从生成文本转向改数据库和在线服务，一次被批准的更新可能执行成功却留下未被批准的副作用；现有防护只审批动作或记录后果，不在继续执行前核对持久化结果，未批准的结果会被当作成功并向后传播。
Method: EffectMatch 是一个运行时：在受控执行边界内收集持久化变更，与应用针对当前状态和该次执行所批准的内容做比对，比对结果直接决定 commit 与依赖执行是否放行；评测含 206 个公开业务任务的对比实验、六组各 20 次的机制消融，以及 80 个任务拓扑用例。
Result: 在 206 个公开业务任务上保留了全部干净执行（clean executions），并阻止了全部被测的错误提交；六组各 20 次的消融分别暴露了移除每个机制所导致的失败；80 个任务拓扑用例中保持了真实交接（truthful handoffs）并拦截了无效续执行。
Conclusion: 仅审批动作或记录后果不足以保证正确性，必须在继续执行前核对持久化结果与应用批准是否一致，才能阻断不一致结果被静默接受并向下游传播。

papers.title: UniAR: A Unified Framework for Autism Recognition Enhanced by Multi-View Prompt Learning
papers.abstract_en: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder for which early and accurate diagnosis is critical to improving long-term developmental outcomes. However, existing ASD recognition methods are often constrained by the scarcity of diagnostic text data, forcing them to rely mainly on visual analysis and limiting their ability to model clinically meaningful semantic reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose UniAR, a unified framework enhanced by multi-granularity prompt learning for robust ASD recognition under heterogeneous data variations. Specifically, UniAR leverages a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical diagnostic descriptions at the word, phrase, and sentence levels, compensating for the lack of paired clinical reports. To align the generated semantics with visual evidence, we further design a Mixture-of-Experts-based Multi-Scale Alignment Module, which dynamically matches vector-quantized visual prototypes with semantic representations at corresponding granularities. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks covering brain MRI and facial expression scenarios show that UniAR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving average accuracies of 75.9\% on MRI benchmarks and 91.6\% on facial benchmarks, while improving average Accuracy on MRI benchmarks by 1.5 percentage points and average Accuracy on facial benchmarks by 1.2 percentage points over baselines. These results demonstrate that UniAR offers a robust and interpretable framework for ASD screening under semantic scarcity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniAR 用大模态模型生成词、短语、句子三级诊断描述来补足稀缺的临床文本，再用基于 Mixture-of-Experts 的多尺度对齐模块把向量量化视觉原型与对应粒度的语义表示动态匹配，做 ASD 识别。在覆盖脑 MRI 与面部表情的四个基准上，MRI 平均准确率 75.9%、面部 91.6%，较基线分别提升 1.5 和 1.2 个百分点。
Motivation: ASD 识别缺少配对临床报告，现有方法只能依赖视觉分析，无法建模有临床意义的语义推理。
Method: UniAR 以大模态模型生成 word、phrase、sentence 三级层次化诊断描述补足文本；Mixture-of-Experts-based Multi-Scale Alignment Module 动态匹配向量量化 (vector-quantized) 视觉原型与对应粒度的语义表示，在异构数据变化下做多粒度提示学习。
Result: 在覆盖脑 MRI 与面部表情的四个基准上，MRI 基准平均准确率 75.9%，面部基准 91.6%；相对基线，MRI 平均 Accuracy 提升 1.5 个百分点，面部平均 Accuracy 提升 1.2 个百分点，且一致优于现有 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 在语义稀缺条件下，用生成式层次描述加 MoE 多尺度对齐即可让 ASD 筛查同时保持稳健性与可解释性。

papers.title: Softmax Reparameterization for Output-Head Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Large vocabularies make output heads a substantial inference cost in small language models. We propose softmax reparameterization, a post-training method that selects a functionally equivalent output head before quantization. The method subtracts a scalar multiple of the vocabulary-row mean from every output row and selects the coefficient by validation KL separately for RTN, activation-weighted MSE, and full-Hessian GPTQ. This one-dimensional search includes the original head and fixed mean-centering, preserves the full-precision softmax distribution, and leaves the trained decoder unchanged; a rank-one correction handles nonlinear logit paths such as soft-capping. Across seven heads, W4 gains concentrate where baseline quantization substantially distorts predictions: on Phi-4-mini, AW-MSE KL falls from 0.936 to 0.256. The gains survive stronger GPTQ calibration and remain complementary to exact per-channel scaling and affine quantization. Across four heads and three W4 quantizers, frozen WikiText-selected coefficients also transfer to C4 and OpenWebMath, outperforming mean-centering in all 18 comparisons where the frozen coefficient differs from $1$ and matching it in the remaining six. At W2, used as a compression stress test, benefits broaden across nearly the full model--quantizer matrix. Matched residual analysis shows that improved fidelity can accompany greater logit reconstruction error while reducing the residual's Fisher-weighted cost. For shift-compatible heads, reparameterization adds no inference operation and preserves packed W4 execution: with the decoder held in BF16, quantizing the Phi output head reduces batch-one generation latency by 10.8% relative to the BF16-head baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 softmax reparameterization：量化前从每个词表输出行减去词表行均值的标量倍数，用验证集 KL 在一维搜索里选系数，从而在不改解码器、不加推理算子的前提下保住全精度 softmax 分布。在 Phi-4-mini 上 W4 AW-MSE 的 KL 从 0.936 降到 0.256，解码器保持 BF16 时批量为 1 的生成延迟相对 BF16-head 基线下降 10.8%。
Motivation: 大词表让输出头成为小语言模型推理成本的主要来源，而直接量化会明显扭曲输出分布。
Method: 后训练方法：对每个输出行减去词表行均值的标量倍数，系数按 RTN、activation-weighted MSE、full-Hessian GPTQ 三种量化器分别用验证 KL 做一维搜索，搜索空间包含原头与固定 mean-centering；对 soft-capping 等非线性 logit 路径用 rank-one correction 处理。
Result: 七个输出头上，W4 增益集中在基线量化明显扭曲预测处：Phi-4-mini 的 AW-MSE KL 由 0.936 降至 0.256；增益在更强的 GPTQ 校准下仍保持，并与 exact per-channel scaling、affine 量化互补。四个头 × 三个 W4 量化器上，冻结的 WikiText 系数迁移到 C4 与 OpenWebMath：在系数不同于 1 的全部 18 组比较中胜过 mean-centering，其余 6 组与之持平。W2 压缩压力测试下增益扩展到几乎整个模型–量化器矩阵。匹配残差分析显示保真度提升可伴随更大的 logit 重建误差，同时降低残差的 Fisher 加权代价。shift-compatible 头上量化 Phi 输出头（解码器 BF16）使批量 1 生成延迟比 BF16-head 基线降 10.8%。
Conclusion: 在量化前对输出头做一维功能等价重参数化，就能在不增加推理算子、不改训练解码器的情况下显著降低 W4/W2 词表头的量化失真与延迟，且所选系数可跨语料冻结迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: G2MAF: Test-Time Gradient Guidance for Multi-Agent Flow Policies
papers.abstract_en: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) learns cooperative policies from fixed datasets without further environment interaction and a learned policy is frozen at deployment. Such a frozen policy typically proposes a single joint action and executes it directly at deployment time. However, this one-shot deployment often commits to a suboptimal proposal, even when better nearby alternatives remain consistent with the behavior data. To address this issue, we propose Gradient Guided Multi Agent Flow (G2MAF), a refinement framework for optimizing joint policies at test-time. G2MAF applies one globally normalized, projected critic gradient to guide and coordinate all agents' corrections while keeping the action both feasible and close to the frozen policy proposal. Across 24 MPE and SMAC settings, its canonical variant improves 20 frozen settings, with mean relative gains of 9.2% on MPE and 8.9% on SMAC, with model inference latency increased by about 6% only.
papers.comment: 24 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://g2maf.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: G2MAF 在部署时对冻结的多智能体策略做测试时精修：用一个全局归一化、投影后的 critic 梯度同时引导所有智能体的联合动作修正，使动作既保持可行又贴近原策略提议。在 24 个 MPE 与 SMAC 设定中，其 canonical 变体改善了 20 个冻结设定，MPE 平均相对增益 9.2%、SMAC 8.9%，推理延迟仅增加约 6%。
Motivation: 离线多智能体强化学习 (offline MARL) 训练出的策略部署时被冻结，只输出单一联合动作并直接执行；即便行为数据附近存在更优且仍与数据一致的方案，一次性部署也常锁定在次优提议上。
Method: G2MAF 是测试时联合策略优化框架：对冻结策略的动作提议施加一个全局归一化并投影 (projected) 的 critic 梯度，统一引导所有智能体的修正量，同时用约束保证动作可行且不偏离原提议太远。
Result: 在 24 个 MPE 和 SMAC 设定上，canonical 变体改善了 20 个冻结设定；MPE 平均相对增益 9.2%，SMAC 平均相对增益 8.9%；模型推理延迟仅增加约 6%。
Conclusion: 冻结的离线 MARL 策略在部署时仍留有可挖的性能空间，用单个投影 critic 梯度做测试时协调修正即可在几乎不增延迟的代价下稳定获益。

papers.title: MoTop: Motion-Topological Model For Micro AU Detection
papers.abstract_en: Facial micro-expressions are spontaneous, brief, and subtle facial movements that reveal suppressed emotions in high-stakes environments. In contrast to classic expression analysis, detecting action unit (AU) yields a finer representation of facial movements, serving as a preliminary step before defining expression classes and other downstream tasks. Therefore, it represents a crucial upstream task in facial analysis, and improving an AU detection module increases the precision of facial analysis. Despite that, detecting AU is challenging because of the constrictive nature of the AU activation regions, leading to confusion among different AUs known as AU ambiguity. To model the fine-scale changes, we propose \textbf{MoTop}, a motion-topological model that is augmented with a learnable motion context, yielding regional soft guidance for facial activity, followed by facial landmarks that capture the fine-scale topological changes of micro AUs. To increase the micro facial landmark representations, we amplify the encoded facial landmark transitions via linear extrapolation, thereby increasing the spatial proximity of landmarks and enhancing the low-intensity landmark dynamics. In addition, we design anatomical facial clusters that enhance the hierarchical representation, facilitating multi-scale modelling of facial geometry and improving micro-topological representations. With these contributions, we have achieved state-of-the-art performance on the CD6ME protocol for the micro AU detection task.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Resource-Optimized and Energy-Aware Agentic AI Framework Anchored on Blockchain for Secure Software Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a blockchain-backed agentic security framework designed to safeguard the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) while also securing the agentic AI components responsible for monitoring it. The framework coordinates a set of specialised security agents, covering source integrity, dependency and SBOM analysis, CI configura tion auditing, artifact verification, and runtime policy evaluation, each supported by a large language model (LLM) that interprets artefacts, reasons over tool outputs, and produces structured security reports. To ensure agent trustworthiness, every agent generates a cryptographically signed attestation that is recorded in a permissioned blockchain via smart contracts, including an agent registry, an immutable attestation log, and an enforceable release-policy module. Communication among agents and with blockchain nodes is secured using a consortium-operated certificate authority, ensuring authenticated and tamper-resistant interactions. A detailed use-case and sequence flow demonstrate how a source code security agent performs analysis, anchors its attestation on-chain, and triggers a verifiable allow/block deployment decision. The proposed framework of fers decentralised integrity transparent provenance, uninterrupted security assurance and a generalisable architecture to incorporate the agentic AI into the modern software supply chain security.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the International Journal of Energy, Environment, and Economics. 27 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个由区块链锚定的 agentic 安全框架，用一组 LLM 驱动的安全 agent 覆盖 SDLC 全流程，每个 agent 产出密码学签名的 attestation 并写入许可链，最终触发可验证的 allow/block 部署决策。与天气、降水、数据同化无关。
Motivation: 软件供应链与 agentic AI 自身的安全性都需要可追溯、不可篡改的证据链，而现有 SDLC 监控缺少可验证的 agent 信任机制。
Method: 多个专职安全 agent 分别负责源码完整性、依赖与 SBOM 分析、CI 配置审计、制品校验、运行时策略评估，各由 LLM 解释制品并产出结构化报告；agent 生成签名 attestation，经智能合约写入许可链（含 agent registry、不可变 attestation 日志、可执行发布策略模块），通信由联盟运营的 CA 保障。
Result: 给出一个用例与序列流程，演示源码安全 agent 完成分析、将 attestation 锚定上链并触发可验证的 allow/block 部署决策；摘要未给出定量实验指标。
Conclusion: 作者主张该架构可为软件供应链提供去中心化完整性、透明溯源与持续安全保障，并可泛化地把 agentic AI 纳入现代软件供应链安全。

papers.title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent cooperative tasks require different agents to execute a joint action simultaneously, and each agent's action affects both the observations and responses of the other agents. Hence, a world model is needed to predict the team return resulting from the joint actions of all agents. A naive extension directly applies a single-agent world model to each agent's action when predicting the team return step by step. However, such an extension fails to capture the dependencies among the simultaneous actions of multiple agents. We propose Multi-Agent World-Action Model (MA-WAM), a test-time planning framework that enables a frozen multi-agent flow policy to evaluate futures of candidate joint actions. To our knowledge, MA-WAM is the first test-time world-model planner for multi-agent flow policies. MA-WAM predicts the consequences of each joint action according to cross-agent dependencies and enables efficient candidate scoring. Across 30 offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings on MAMuJoCo, SMAC, and MPE, MA-WAM achieves mean relative gains of 22.0% over direct execution and 25.6% over uniform action selection. Under the standard evaluation protocol on an A100 GPU, MA-WAM adds 12.1 ms, accounting for 2.5% of the measured generation-and-scoring time.
papers.comment: 40 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://ma-wam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-WAM 把单智能体 world model 改造成按跨智能体依赖预测联合动作后果的测试时规划器，让冻结的多智能体 flow policy 在执行前给候选联合动作打分。在 MAMuJoCo、SMAC、MPE 共 30 个离线 MARL 设置上，相对直接执行平均提升 22.0%，相对均匀随机选动作提升 25.6%；在 A100 上仅增加 12.1 ms，占生成与打分时间的 2.5%。
Motivation: 多智能体协同中各智能体同时决策且互相影响观测与响应，把单智能体 world model 直接套到每个智能体动作上会丢失同时动作之间的依赖，导致团队回报预测失真。
Method: 提出 Multi-Agent World-Action Model (MA-WAM)：作为测试时规划框架，对每个候选联合动作按跨智能体依赖预测其后果并高效打分，驱动一个冻结的多智能体 flow policy，不改动策略本身。
Result: 在 30 个离线 MARL 设置（MAMuJoCo、SMAC、MPE）上，相对直接执行平均相对增益 22.0%，相对均匀动作选择 25.6%；标准评估协议下 A100 GPU 上额外开销 12.1 ms，占测得的生成与打分时间 2.5%。
Conclusion: 作者称 MA-WAM 是首个面向多智能体 flow policy 的测试时 world-model 规划器，说明在冻结策略外挂联合动作后果预测即可在几乎不增加延迟的前提下抬高团队回报。

papers.title: Cognitive Skills in the Age of AI: Computing Students and Experts Perceptions
papers.abstract_en: AI is becoming increasingly integrated into daily workflows, especially in computing. We are gradually shifting towards an AI-rich future, an impending yet unknown one. One important emerging concern is whether we are accordingly preparing our future computing workforce. Further, we need to know what the important cognitive skills are to remain relevant in the computing workforce and if there are changes in cognitive skill importance. To investigate this direction, we conducted a mixed-methods study, collecting perceptions from computing students and computing experts regarding the importance of cognitive skills in the past, present, and future. We report that the perceived importance of most cognitive skills will decrease in the future, with an AI-rich environment, but critical thinking skills remain important. Further, we report reasons collected through interviews on why the importance of cognitive skills will change and how future computing students can prepare for it.
papers.comment: This article is accepted at the 26th IEEE International Conference on Advanced Learning Technologies, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对计算专业学生与从业者做混合方法研究，收集其对认知技能在过去、现在、未来重要性的看法：多数认知技能在 AI 富集环境下被认为未来重要性下降，唯独批判性思维 (critical thinking) 被认为仍然重要，并通过访谈给出重要性变化的原因及学生应对方式。
Motivation: AI 正快速嵌入计算领域日常工作流，但未来计算劳动力所需的关键认知技能是什么、其重要性是否在变化，尚缺乏来自学生与专家双方的系统证据。
Method: 混合方法研究 (mixed-methods study)，同时收集计算专业学生与计算专家的问卷式看法，覆盖认知技能在过去、现在、未来三个时间点的重要性，并辅以访谈收集重要性变化的原因与学生准备建议。
Result: 报告多数认知技能在 AI 富集的未来被感知重要性下降，而批判性思维被认为仍然重要；访谈给出这些技能重要性将变化的原因，以及未来计算专业学生如何为此做准备。
Conclusion: AI 时代不必同等看待所有认知技能：多数技能的感知价值会走低，但批判性思维是需要保住的核心，学生应据此调整准备方向。

papers.title: Learning Aerosol Coagulation Dynamics in Latent Space with a Scale-Covariant Neural ODE
papers.abstract_en: Particle-resolved aerosol models preserve the joint size-composition structure that governs cloud activation, optical properties, and freezing, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale atmospheric models. We extend AeroMELD from a compact representation of aerosol populations to a prognostic model of coagulation. The resulting AeroMELD-Coag advances nine learned coordinates for population shape and one for total particle number through a scale-covariant neural ordinary differential equation that incorporates the known concentration dependence of coagulation. Across 2,000 held-out trajectories spanning 48 h, median symmetric errors are 3.5% for latent shape and 0.52% for total number. This ten-coordinate state also retains the evolving size-resolved composition and associated cloud-condensation-nuclei (CCN) activation, optical properties, and frozen fraction. Compared with the evaluated 20-bin sectional model with 320 prognostic coordinates, AeroMELD-Coag lowers pooled mean CCN activation error from 1.98% to 1.38% and frozen-fraction error from 1.72% to 0.56%. In a matched integration benchmark, GPU integration time per trajectory, amortized over a batch, is more than three orders of magnitude lower than for both single-core CPU references. These coagulation results provide a proof of concept for advancing aerosol microphysics efficiently in a compact learned state while retaining information about aerosol mixing state. They establish a foundation for future large-scale atmospheric models to represent aerosol microphysics with greater mixing-state detail within practical computational budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AeroMELD 从气溶胶群体的紧凑表示扩展为凝聚 (coagulation) 预报模型 AeroMELD-Coag：用 scale-covariant neural ODE 推进 9 个群体形状隐坐标加 1 个总粒子数坐标，并把凝聚的浓度依赖写进方程。在 2,000 条 48 小时留出轨迹上，隐形状中位对称误差 3.5%、总数 0.52%；相对 20-bin、320 坐标的 sectional 模型，CCN 活化误差从 1.98% 降到 1.38%，冻结分数误差从 1.72% 降到 0.56%，GPU 单轨迹积分时间摊销后比单核 CPU 参考低三个数量级以上。
Motivation: 粒子解析气溶胶模型能保 size-composition 联合结构，从而决定活化、光学与冻结，但计算代价太高，无法放进大尺度大气模式；而凝聚过程此前未被 AeroMELD 这类紧凑表示覆盖。
Method: 扩展 AeroMELD 为凝聚预报模型：十维状态（9 个群体形状隐坐标 + 1 个总粒子数）由 scale-covariant neural ODE 推进，方程中显式纳入凝聚的浓度依赖；状态同时保留随时间演化的按尺寸分解的组成，并据此计算 CCN 活化、光学性质与冻结分数。评测对照 20-bin sectional 模型（320 个预报坐标）与单核 CPU 参考的积分基准。
Result: 在 2,000 条留出轨迹、跨度 48 小时上，隐形状中位对称误差 3.5%，总粒子数 0.52%。相对 20-bin/320 坐标 sectional 模型，pooled mean CCN 活化误差 1.98% → 1.38%，冻结分数误差 1.72% → 0.56%。匹配积分基准中，按 batch 摊销的 GPU 每轨迹积分时间比两个单核 CPU 参考低三个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 作者把结果定位为 proof of concept：十维学习状态可在保留 mixing state 信息的同时高效推进气溶胶微物理，为大尺度大气模式在实际计算预算内表示更细 mixing state 的气溶胶微物理奠定基础。

papers.title: MoSAR: Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes for Learning Adaptive and Approximable Attention Geometries
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic complexity of dense self-attention remains a central bottleneck for long-context language modeling. Many efficient alternatives address this cost by deciding in advance where attention should be sparse or local. We argue that attention approximation should instead be approached as a geometric problem, with the relevant interaction geometry learned from data: natural-language dependencies are input-dependent and difficult to prescribe in advance, so the model should learn where positional relevance can decay and where broader interactions must be preserved. We introduce Mixture of Semantic Attention Regimes (MoSAR), which learns such an adaptive, controlled-decay geometry over query--key interactions. Input-conditioned query and key routers, applied after positional encoding, select mixtures over short, medium, and global regimes, inducing a continuous distance-dependent attention field rather than a fixed sparsity pattern. This geometry is learned during training and can subsequently be discretized through top-1 routing. In controlled pre-training experiments with matched 500M-parameter models, MoSAR learns a substantially lower-reach attention geometry without degrading language-modeling quality, improving perplexity over dense RoPE at the training context length. Under length extrapolation, MoSAR achieves the best perplexity among all evaluated variants, including strong baselines such as ALiBi. Moreover, the learned geometry remains stable under deterministic top-1 discretization, suggesting that it is not only adaptive, but also amenable to low-cost approximation at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSAR 把长上下文注意力近似当作几何学习问题：用输入条件化的 query/key 路由器在位置编码之后混合短、中、全局三种注意力 regime，学出连续的距离相关注意力场，再用 top-1 路由离散化。在 500M 参数受控预训练中，它学到 reach 明显更低的注意力几何而不损语言建模质量，训练上下文长度上困惑度优于 dense RoPE，长度外推下在所有变体（含 ALiBi）中困惑度最好。
Motivation: dense self-attention 的二次复杂度是长上下文语言建模的核心瓶颈，而现有高效替代方案预先规定稀疏或局部位置，但自然语言依赖是输入相关、难以事先指定的。
Method: MoSAR 在位置编码之后放置输入条件化的 query 与 key 路由器，对短、中、全局三种 regime 做混合选择，诱导连续的距离相关注意力场；该几何在训练中学得，随后可用 top-1 路由离散化。
Result: 在匹配的 500M 参数受控预训练实验中，MoSAR 学到 substantially lower-reach 的注意力几何且不降低语言建模质量，训练上下文长度上困惑度优于 dense RoPE；长度外推下困惑度在所有评估变体（含 ALiBi 等强基线）中最佳；学到的几何在确定性 top-1 离散化下保持稳定。
Conclusion: 注意力近似应作为从数据学习的几何问题而非预先规定的稀疏模式，且该几何既自适应又可用 top-1 路由做低成本推理近似。

papers.title: Agentic Limit Order Books: Phase Transitions and Market Impact
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the systemic macroscopic dynamics emerging from Limit Order Books (LOBs) populated exclusively by autonomous reinforcement-learning agentic traders. By formalizing agent interactions within a microscopic order-matching engine, we examine two fundamental quantitative phenomena: equilibrium phase transitions in order flow regime shifts, and the structural dynamics of market impact. We show that agentic LOBs exhibit distinct phase boundaries separating orderly price discovery from hyper-volatile cascade states, governed by critical thresholds in the number of agents and observable market depth. Furthermore, we demonstrate that market impact under agentic liquidity provision deviates from classical square-root dynamics, exhibiting distinct dissipative, balanced, and non-dissipative regimes under non-linear feedback loops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只由自主强化学习交易智能体构成的限价订单簿 (LOB) 中，微观撮合引擎会产生两类宏观现象：随智能体数量与可观测市场深度出现临界阈值，把有序价格发现与超波动级联状态分隔开的相变边界；以及在非线性反馈回路下，市场冲击偏离经典的平方根律，分裂为耗散、平衡与非耗散三个区制。
Motivation: 把 LOB 全部交给 RL 智能体后，订单流区制切换与市场冲击的宏观规律是否仍服从经典标度律并不清楚，需要在微观撮合层面给出可判定的相变边界与冲击区制。
Method: 将智能体交互形式化到微观订单撮合引擎 (order-matching engine) 中，用自主强化学习交易智能体填充限价订单簿，考察订单流区制的平衡相变与市场冲击的结构动力学。
Result: 识别出分隔有序价格发现与超波动级联状态的相变边界，其由智能体数量与可观测市场深度的临界阈值决定；市场冲击在非线性反馈下偏离经典平方根动力学，呈现耗散、平衡与非耗散三个区制。
Conclusion: 智能体化的 LOB 会跨越明确临界点在有序与级联状态间切换，且市场冲击不再服从单一平方根标度，而按反馈回路分成三种区制。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Deterministic Regime Switching and Feasibility Inversion in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization
papers.abstract_en: We report fine-grained, deterministic instability in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR), an online eviction policy for memory-constrained DNN training, measured on the reference DTR simulator (simrd) using public execution traces. On an LSTM trace, memory budgets differing by 0.10% of unconstrained peak memory select fast and slow execution regimes whose overheads differ by as much as 7.3x; the slow regime is driven by broadly repeated re-eviction of the same storages (evictions per storage rise from 1.33 to 8.27 while the set of distinct evicted storages is essentially unchanged: 5,233 vs 5,236, with the two sets overlapping at Jaccard 0.999). On a ResNet-32 trace, a fine budget sweep reveals a deterministic feasibility inversion: the run is feasible at ratio 0.101, infeasible (OOM) across 0.102-0.106, and feasible again from 0.107. We trace the immediate cause of the OOM to a fully pinned recursive rematerialization frontier that exceeds the budget after every evictable tensor has been evicted. Ablations using the DTR authors' own variants implicate the joint size-staleness scoring term in the observed LSTM instability. We argue these are at least two distinct budget-sensitive pathologies rather than one mechanism, and we separate what is demonstrated from what remains hypothesised. All results concern the reference simulator; reproduction in a production runtime is future work. Code, instrumentation, and raw results accompany this preprint.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/lonewolf15116/dtr-regime-switching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在参考 DTR 模拟器 (simrd) 上用公开执行轨迹测得 Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization 的细粒度确定性不稳定：LSTM 轨迹上仅差 0.10% 未约束峰值内存的预算就切换快慢执行态，开销相差最多 7.3x；ResNet-32 轨迹上出现可行性反转，预算比 0.101 可行、0.102–0.106 OOM、0.107 起又可行。作者判定这是两种不同的预算敏感病理，而非单一机制。
Motivation: DTR 这类在线逐出策略在内存受限 DNN 训练中对预算极其敏感，但细粒度预算扰动如何确定性地触发性能崩溃或 OOM 缺少刻画，且两种现象容易被误当成同一机制。
Method: 在参考模拟器 simrd 上对公开执行轨迹做细粒度预算扫描：LSTM 轨迹比较快慢态的逐出统计（evictions per storage、distinct evicted storages、Jaccard 重叠），ResNet-32 轨迹定位 OOM 的直接成因，并用 DTR 作者自己的变体做 ablation 指认打分项。
Result: LSTM 轨迹上预算差 0.10% 未约束峰值内存即切换快慢态，开销差最多 7.3x；慢态由同一批 storage 反复再逐出驱动，evictions per storage 从 1.33 升到 8.27，而 distinct evicted storages 几乎不变（5,233 vs 5,236，Jaccard 0.999）。ResNet-32 上 ratio 0.101 可行、0.102–0.106 OOM、0.107 起可行，OOM 直接成因是完全钉住的递归 rematerialization frontier 在所有可逐出张量都被逐出后仍超预算。Ablation 指认 size-staleness 联合打分项是 LSTM 不稳定的成因。
Conclusion: 预算敏感的 DTR 至少存在两种不同病理：反复再逐出导致的慢态与钉住 frontier 导致的可行性反转；全部结果限于参考模拟器，生产运行时复现是后续工作。
Relevance: 1
