papers.title: Gauss What You Need: Compact Gaussian Splatting Across Scene Scales
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene as a collection of Gaussian primitives from a set of posed photographs called the capture. The number of primitives used to represent the scene affects reconstruction quality, storage, and rendering cost. How to select this number automatically across capture scales remains unresolved: configurations effective on standard benchmarks can leave larger captures with too few Gaussians to reconstruct fine details. We observe that the surface to represent, given by the capture's extent and resolution, is known before training, whereas its content complexity becomes apparent during training, through the reconstruction quality on the training views. We introduce TangoGS, which combines capture-derived model sizing with training-based adaptation: the capture determines the scale of the model, and training feedback determines its final size within that scale. Before training, TangoGS derives a learning allowance for model growth from the capture's total pixels after discounting views that re-observe the same scene points. During training, reconstruction quality guides how many Gaussians to add and remove. On 13 standard benchmark scenes, TangoGS matches the mean PSNR of the best-performing evaluated baseline, LeGS, with $48\%$ fewer Gaussians. On eight large captures, the same configuration automatically scales to larger models when necessary, achieving the highest mean PSNR among evaluated methods: $0.54$ dB above the runner-up with $2.3\times$ as many Gaussians. Together, capture-derived learning allowances and training-quality guided density control enable a state-of-the-art quality--size compromise across scene scales without retuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TangoGS 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的高斯数量选择拆成两步：训练前用 capture 总像素（扣除重复观测同一场景点的视角）算出模型增长额度，训练中用重建质量决定增删多少高斯。在 13 个标准 benchmark 场景上以比 LeGS 少 48% 的高斯达到其平均 PSNR；在 8 个大尺度 capture 上同一配置自动放大模型，平均 PSNR 比次优方法高 0.54 dB，而次优方法用了 2.3 倍高斯。
Motivation: 高斯数量同时决定重建质量、存储与渲染开销，但如何随 capture 规模自动选取一直没有解决：在标准 benchmark 上有效的配置放到大 capture 上会因高斯不足而丢失细节。
Method: TangoGS 结合 capture 派生的模型定标与训练期自适应：训练前从 capture 总像素出发、扣除重复观测相同场景点的视角后得到学习额度 (learning allowance)，确定该尺度下模型规模上限；训练中以训练视角的重建质量引导高斯的增删（density control），在该尺度内确定最终数量。
Result: 在 13 个标准 benchmark 场景上，TangoGS 以比最佳评测基线 LeGS 少 48% 的高斯匹配其平均 PSNR；在 8 个大 capture 上，同一配置自动扩展到更大模型，取得所评测方法中最高平均 PSNR，比次优方法高 0.54 dB，而次优方法高斯数为其 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: capture 派生的学习额度加上训练质量引导的密度控制，可以在无需重新调参的前提下跨场景尺度取得 state-of-the-art 的质量-尺寸折中。

papers.title: Geometric Inconsistency Localization in Multi-View Image Sets
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) models can produce realistic new views of the same scene from different viewpoints. However, these generated views are not always geometrically consistent with one another. Multi-view (MV) consistency has shown promise as a tool for evaluating these NVS models. Its potential for multimedia forensics, however, remains largely unexplored, particularly for localizing geometric inconsistencies across wide-baseline image pairs. To enable research in this direction, we introduce DeformView, a wide-baseline MV dataset with pixel-level annotations of geometric inconsistencies. Using DeformView, we evaluate state-of-the-art MV consistency-scoring methods and show that approaches developed for NVS evaluation transfer poorly to the forensic task of geometric inconsistency localization. To address this limitation, we propose DEFECt3R, a lightweight learning-based classifier that uses cross-view feature relationships to localize geometric inconsistencies at the pixel level. By learning from explicit supervision, including hard negatives from geometrically consistent yet deformed views, DEFECt3R improves localization performance and substantially reduces false positives compared to existing consistency-scoring methods. Ablation experiments further show that both feature representations and correspondence quality contribute to localization performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that MV geometric consistency is a promising yet underexplored signal for multimedia forensics and establish a benchmark and baseline for geometric inconsistency localization in wide-baseline MV image pairs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R
papers.comment: 8 pages, accepted at the Deepfake Forensics Workshop (DFF 2026) at ACM Multimedia 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向多媒体取证的宽基线多视图几何不一致定位任务：发布像素级标注数据集 DeformView，并给出轻量分类器 DEFECt3R，用跨视图特征关系与显式监督（含几何一致但形变的困难负样本）定位不一致像素。在 DeformView 上评测现有面向 NVS 评估的一致性打分方法迁移到取证任务表现差，DEFECt3R 提升定位性能并大幅降低误报。
Motivation: 多视图一致性已被用于评估 NVS 模型，但其在多媒体取证中的潜力——尤其在宽基线图像对上定位几何不一致——基本未被探索，缺少数据集与基准。
Method: 构建 DeformView：宽基线多视图数据集，带几何不一致的像素级标注；提出 DEFECT3R 这一轻量学习式分类器，利用跨视图特征关系做像素级定位，以显式监督训练并纳入几何一致却形变的困难负样本；用 DeformView 评测现有 MV 一致性打分方法并做消融。
Result: 面向 NVS 评估开发的一致性打分方法迁移到几何不一致定位这一取证任务时表现差；DEFECt3R 提升定位性能并相比现有一致性打分方法大幅降低误报；消融显示特征表示与对应关系质量都对定位性能有贡献。
Conclusion: 多视图几何一致性是多媒体取证中一个有前景但欠开发的信号，DeformView 与 DEFECt3R 为宽基线多视图图像对的几何不一致定位建立了基准与基线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 多视图几何一致性是多媒体取证中一个有前景但欠开发的信号，DeformView 与 DEFECt3R 为宽基线多视图图像对的几何不一致定位建立了基准与基线。

papers.title: Purin: A Biology-inspired Mechanism for Artificial Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) usually represent neural transmission with fixed trainable weights during a training batch, which omits short-term changes in synaptic efficacy. In addition, the discrete time-step simulation requires additional temporal processing that many conventional ANN architectures do not use. To overcome these challenges, we propose Purin, a biology-inspired and ANN-compatible mechanism, that introduces synaptic efficacy modulation into conventional convolutional neural networks. Purin uses a time-interval-based abstraction for neural activities, which allows Purin to introduce short- and long-term synaptic efficacy changes without using discrete time-steps. Purin introduces a bounded factor to represent temporary synaptic efficacy changes, together with two weight matrices that represent input-side and output-side efficacy. The weight matrices are updated by backpropagation and interpreted as the long-term synaptic efficacy changes. Experimental results show that after removing the confounding factors in the AlexNet, VGG11, and GoogLeNet architectures, Purin improves the classification accuracies in all three models across the evaluated datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Purin 提出一种与 ANN 兼容的突触效能调制机制：用时间间隔抽象替代离散时间步，以一个有界因子表示短期突触效能变化，配合输入侧与输出侧两个权重矩阵表示长期效能变化，两者都由反向传播更新。在去除 AlexNet、VGG11、GoogLeNet 的混杂因素后，Purin 在所评测的全部数据集上都提升了三个模型的分类准确率。
Motivation: 常规 ANN 在一个训练 batch 内用固定可训练权重表示神经传递，忽略了突触效能的短期变化；离散时间步仿真又需要许多传统架构并不具备的额外时序处理。
Method: Purin 把突触效能调制引入常规卷积神经网络：用基于时间间隔 (time-interval-based) 的神经活动抽象，从而不依赖离散时间步即可引入短、长期效能变化；结构上由一个表示临时效能变化的有界因子加两个权重矩阵（输入侧、输出侧）组成，权重矩阵经反向传播更新并解释为长期突触效能变化。
Result: 在 AlexNet、VGG11、GoogLeNet 三个架构上移除混杂因素后，Purin 在所评测的全部数据集上均提升分类准确率；arXiv comment 标注 8 pages、2 figures、8 tables。
Conclusion: 把短期有界效能因子与长期双权重矩阵一起纳入常规 CNN 并用反向传播训练，可以在多个经典分类架构与数据集上一致提高分类准确率。

papers.title: WeaveAgent: A Two-Stage Tool-Routing Agent for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Problem. Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing with vague user intents has two bottlenecks: visual tokens are expensive, and tool calling must be format-reliable (pretrained models emit zero tool calls zero-shot). Method. WeaveAgent, a two-stage tool-routing agent, decouples routing from visual perception. Stage A is routing-first: emission is trained, not elicited. Stage B executes conditionally: intrinsic queries enter visual answering (full-scene thumbnail; a WeaveEarth-style evidence board as an optional fixed-budget, approx. 5k-token compression interface); extrinsic queries execute tool call on original full-resolution imagery, answering from tool observations in a second, observation-masked round. Training: alignment SFT, then GRPO under reward R_WA2. Results. Alignment SFT lifts extrinsic routing from 0% to 80.75% (323/400); GRPO suppresses 9 intrinsic mis-emissions while tool selection is unchanged. The trained 2B system does not beat the zero-shot 8B baseline overall (0.263 vs. 0.250), a diagnostic contribution. Oracle attribution separates two repair ingredients: loading the observation into context lifts extrinsic answer accuracy from 0.025 to 0.425 under marker-free cross-mode returns, and the two-turn SFT stage adds a further +9.3 points to 0.518 at a small routing cost. A +/- image ablation shows emission suppression is visually grounded, and a query-register matrix shows LLM-rewritten queries cost trained checkpoints 2-11 points. Scope. All training and evaluation use the 5,000 / 3,273 / 1,000-record VagueUHR corpus (600 intrinsic + 400 tool-requiring; the base seeds synthesis and is not used for optimization). Single-pass evidence construction runs at 7.31 s per image on an RTX 4090. Code, data, and evaluation protocols will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeaveAgent 把超高分辨率遥感的工具路由与视觉感知解耦成两阶段：Stage A 先训练路由发射（alignment SFT + GRPO，奖励 R_WA2），Stage B 按 intrinsic/extrinsic 分流到全图缩略图问答或在原始分辨率影像上执行工具调用并做第二轮 observation-masked 回答。SFT 把 extrinsic 路由从 0% 提到 80.75%（323/400），GRPO 压掉 9 次 intrinsic 误发射；但 2B 训练系统整体 0.263 并未超过 zero-shot 8B 基线的 0.250。
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感影像下用户意图模糊时有两个瓶颈：视觉 token 昂贵，且预训练模型 zero-shot 时工具调用发射为零、格式不可靠。
Method: 两阶段工具路由：Stage A routing-first，用 alignment SFT 训练发射，再用 GRPO 配合奖励 R_WA2；Stage B 条件执行，intrinsic 查询走全场景缩略图（可选 WeaveEarth 式 evidence board，约 5k token 固定预算压缩），extrinsic 查询在原始全分辨率影像上调用工具，并在第二轮 observation-masked 中依据工具观测作答。训练与评测全部在 VagueUHR 语料（5,000/3,273/1,000 条记录，含 600 intrinsic + 400 tool-requiring，base seed 合成且不参与优化）上进行。
Result: Alignment SFT 将 extrinsic 路由从 0% 提升到 80.75%（323/400）；GRPO 抑制 9 次 intrinsic 误发射且工具选择不变。训练后的 2B 系统整体 0.263，未超过 zero-shot 8B 基线的 0.250。Oracle 归因显示：把观测载入上下文使 extrinsic 答案准确率在 marker-free cross-mode 返回下从 0.025 升到 0.425，两轮 SFT 再加 +9.3 个百分点到 0.518（路由代价很小）。加减图像消融表明发射抑制是视觉 grounding 的；query-register 矩阵显示 LLM 改写查询使训练后 checkpoint 掉 2–11 分。单次证据构建在 RTX 4090 上为每图 7.31 秒。
Conclusion: 路由与感知解耦并显式训练发射，能可靠解决 zero-shot 零工具调用问题，但整体性能未必胜过更大的 zero-shot 模型；把工具观测载入上下文才是 extrinsic 答案质量的主要修复来源，且查询措辞改写会显著侵蚀训练收益。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Acoustic-to-Text KV Compression for Full-Duplex Speech Models
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech language models continuously accumulate acoustic key-value (KV) states, making long-running interactions memory-intensive. During listening, the model can finish processing an audio unit before the next arrives; we term the remaining interval listening-time slack. We propose acoustic-to-text KV compression, which introduces a transcription side channel to convert incoming speech into compact textual memory within this interval. When the cache exceeds a target budget during inference, older acoustic states are evicted while transcripts and recent acoustic context remain. We train the side channel with LoRA using cross-entropy on transcription segments. To preserve listening and speaking behavior, we apply knowledge distillation to the original model's token-level output distributions at native prediction positions. On ten-minute LongSpeech sessions, our MiniCPM-o 4.5 implementation reduces peak streaming KV-cache size by 64.6% compared with the same model without eviction. The proposed method also improves transcription, temporal question answering, and summarization over the baseline. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluations further show comparable pause-handling, turn-taking, and interruption performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 全双工语音模型的声学 KV 状态随对话无限累积，本文利用听音间隙 (listening-time slack) 把已处理语音转写成紧凑文本记忆：缓存超预算时驱逐旧声学状态、保留转写与近期声学上下文。在 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的十分钟 LongSpeech 会话上，峰值流式 KV-cache 较不驱逐的同模型下降 64.6%，且转写、时序问答与摘要均提升。
Motivation: 全双工语音语言模型持续累积声学 key-value 状态，长时交互内存开销大；而听音阶段模型常在下一个音频单元到达前就处理完当前单元，存在可利用的空闲区间。
Method: 提出 acoustic-to-text KV 缓存压缩：引入转写 side channel，在 listening-time slack 内把输入语音转为文本记忆；推理时缓存超过目标预算即驱逐较旧声学状态，保留转写与近期声学上下文。side channel 用 LoRA 以转写片段的交叉熵训练，并对原模型在原生预测位置的 token 级输出分布做知识蒸馏以保持听说行为。
Result: 在 MiniCPM-o 4.5 实现上，十分钟 LongSpeech 会话的峰值流式 KV-cache 较无驱逐同模型减少 64.6%；转写、时序问答 (temporal question answering) 与摘要均优于基线；Full-Duplex-Bench 上 pause-handling、turn-taking 与 interruption 表现相当。
Conclusion: 把声学记忆降级为文本记忆可以在不损害全双工听说行为的前提下大幅压缩 KV-cache，说明听音空闲区间足以支撑在线转写式缓存压缩。

papers.title: Budgeted Quotient-Residual Guidance for Frozen Pocket-Conditioned Molecular Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Pocket-conditioned molecular diffusion updates ambient atom coordinates, but many lead-optimization objectives are expressed on quotient features such as distances, contacts, and anchored substructures. We introduce budgeted quotient-residual guidance (QRG), an inference-time correction that makes these quotient objectives active without retraining the molecular generator. QRG lifts quotient covectors to metric-horizontal ambient directions and delivers them through a trust budget set by the frozen sampler's own step norm: quotient geometry chooses the direction, while sampler motion bounds the scale. We derive the horizontal lift, closed-form sampler-budget update, KL/kinetic interpretation around a frozen reverse step, equivariance conditions, and a product-budget split for budget-capped section and residual controls. Controlled quotient tasks confirm that sampler-relative delivery activates signals that raw local quotient gradients leave dormant. On frozen TargetDiff backbones, official seed-0 CBGBench ligand-generation/editing sweeps show practical quality-runtime gains: Local-QRG improves validity from 0.815 to 0.864 on fragment growing, 0.664 to 0.707 on scaffold hopping, and 0.681 to 0.712 on linker design, while PredNext-QRG improves fragment/scaffold and remains near-neutral on linker. Novelty remains 1.000 and diversity is preserved in the matched multi-seed molecular slice, giving task-dependent improvements without sampler retraining or backbone modification. Overall, QRG provides a lightweight route to quotient-aware inference for frozen molecular samplers with explicit runtime accounting.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Includes theoretical proofs and supplementary experimental results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QRG 是一种推理时的商流形引导修正：把商特征（距离、接触、锚定子结构）的余切向量提升到环境空间的水平方向，再用冻结采样器自身的步长范数作为信任预算限制更新幅度，从而在不重训生成器的前提下激活这些目标。在冻结 TargetDiff 上的 CBGBench seed-0 扫描中，Local-QRG 把 fragment growing 的 validity 从 0.815 提到 0.864，scaffold hopping 从 0.664 到 0.707，linker design 从 0.681 到 0.712。
Motivation: 口袋条件分子扩散只更新环境原子坐标，而先导优化目标多定义在商特征上，二者不匹配导致原始局部商梯度在冻结采样器中失效。
Method: QRG 在推理时把商余切向量提升为水平方向，按冻结采样器步长范数设定信任预算；推导水平提升、闭式采样器预算更新、冻结反向步附近的 KL/动能解释、等变条件，以及预算受限下的乘积预算分配（section 与 residual 控制）。
Result: 在冻结 TargetDiff 上、官方 seed-0 CBGBench 生成/编辑扫描：Local-QRG validity 在 fragment growing 0.815→0.864、scaffold hopping 0.664→0.707、linker design 0.681→0.712；PredNext-QRG 提升 fragment 与 scaffold，linker 上接近中性。匹配的多种子分子切片中 novelty 保持 1.000、diversity 保留。
Conclusion: 商几何决定方向、采样器运动决定幅度的预算化引导，可在不改动骨干与采样器的情况下带来任务相关的质量-运行时收益。

papers.title: DIAL: Position-Debiased LLM Judges with Adaptive Human Preference Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) as a judge enable scalable evaluation, but their judgments can be sensitive to response order and, even after removing such position effects, can still diverge systematically from human preferences.We introduce DIAL, a unified framework that combines abundant LLM comparisons with limited human comparisons to separate judge-specific position effects, learn shared structure in position-debiased LLM preferences, and adaptively calibrate that structure toward the human preference target. Theoretically, we study three aspects of DIAL: (i) identification of latent LLM preferences, position effects, and human calibration; (ii) adaptive estimation that balances LLM anchoring against limited human evidence; and (iii) fixed-weight uncertainty quantification for the calibrated human preference. Empirically, we evaluate position debiasing and human alignment separately in controlled simulations and on three human-preference benchmarks, showing that DIAL remains robust to unbalanced response order, achieves strong human-aligned rankings with limited labels, and adapts toward human evidence when LLM information is imperfect. Our real-data study collects over 410K judgments from 21 LLM judges in both display orders, providing a resource for future studies of LLM-judge bias, heterogeneity, and human alignment.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Which Influence Are We Estimating? The Role of Counterfactual Specifications in Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the influence of training examples on model behavior is essential for data debugging, valuation, and attribution. Existing influence estimators often produce incompatible rankings, which are commonly ascribed to approximation error. We argue that a more fundamental source of disagreement is specification mismatch: influence depends on the behavior being attributed, the intervention applied to each training example, and the counterfactual training process that maps the intervention to a model response. These choices are especially important when the target behavior requires a tractable surrogate, such as query loss, a logit, or a margin. We formalize influence as a counterfactual estimand, distinguish specification mismatch across estimands from approximation error in estimating a fixed estimand, and organize representative estimators by their implied specifications. We further derive a local decomposition that exposes how behavior signals, training signals, and counterfactual parameter responses interact. Controlled experiments show that exact estimands under different specifications can induce different rankings, whereas approximation error grows as perturbations move farther from their linearization points. Experiments on noisy label detection and LLM attribution show that specification choices significantly affect attribution quality, especially for the choice of behavior surrogate. Behavior-aligned specifications can identify target-specific training examples obscured by default loss-based or similarity-based specifications. These results establish specification analysis as a necessary first step for interpreting and comparing data influence estimators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把数据归因中的 influence 形式化为反事实 estimand，指出不同估计器排名不一致的根源是 specification mismatch（归因哪种行为、对训练样本施加何种干预、用哪个反事实训练过程），而非近似误差。受控实验显示不同 specification 下的精确 estimand 本身就会给出不同排名，而近似误差随扰动偏离线性化点而增大；行为对齐的 specification 能找出默认 loss-based 或 similarity-based specification 掩盖的目标训练样本。
Motivation: 现有 influence 估计器常给出互不相容的排名，通常被归咎于近似误差，导致归因结果难以解释和比较。
Method: 将 influence 形式化为反事实 estimand，区分跨 estimand 的 specification mismatch 与固定 estimand 下的 approximation error，并按隐含 specification 组织代表性估计器；进一步推导一个局部分解，揭示 behavior signals、training signals 与 counterfactual parameter responses 的交互。
Result: 受控实验表明不同 specification 下的精确 estimand 会产生不同排名，而近似误差随扰动远离其线性化点而增长；在 noisy label detection 与 LLM attribution 实验中，specification 选择显著影响归因质量，尤其是 behavior surrogate 的选择，行为对齐的 specification 能识别出被默认 loss-based 或 similarity-based specification 遮蔽的目标特定训练样本。
Conclusion: specification 分析是解释和比较数据 influence 估计器的必要前置步骤，归因差异应先归因于 estimand 定义而非数值近似。

papers.title: Enabling a Unified Cross-Domain Representation for Two-Finger Gripper Manipulation via Interaction-Centric Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Achieving robust cross-embodiment generalization in imitation learning demands overcoming a critical representation flaw that inextricably entangles task semantics with hardware-specific visual geometry. We propose an interaction-centric framework that leverages the shared structure of two-finger grippers via a parameterized universal gripper abstraction, yielding a canonical gripper-frame representation. Given language and RGB-D observations, a VLM infers the subtask and grounds an interaction triplet (gripper, held, target), while SAM~2.1 tracks masks to reduce VLM queries. We design concise hybrid features that combine target/collision artificial potential fields for global guidance with segmented gripper-frame point clouds for local geometry, and use a Flow-Matching Transformer to predict smooth 7-DoF action chunks. Experiments in simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that ours is the first imitation learning approach to simultaneously achieve competitive benchmark scores and extreme cross-embodiment/cross-viewpoint zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to completely distinct, heterogeneous robot platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以交互为中心的两指夹爪模仿学习框架：用参数化通用夹爪抽象得到规范夹爪坐标系表征，VLM 推断子任务并定位 (gripper, held, target) 交互三元组，SAM 2.1 跟踪掩码以减少 VLM 查询，混合人工势场全局引导与夹爪系点云局部几何，再由 Flow-Matching Transformer 输出 7-DoF 动作块。仿真与真机实验中该方法首次同时做到有竞争力的基准分数与跨具身、跨视角的零样本 sim-to-real 迁移到完全异构的机器人平台。
Motivation: 模仿学习的跨具身泛化受制于表征缺陷：任务语义与硬件特有的视觉几何纠缠在一起，换平台或换视角即失效。
Method: 以两指夹爪的共享结构构造参数化通用夹爪抽象，得到规范夹爪坐标系表征；输入语言与 RGB-D，由 VLM 推断子任务并 grounding 交互三元组 (gripper, held, target)，SAM 2.1 跟踪掩码以降低 VLM 查询次数；混合特征为目标/碰撞人工势场 (artificial potential fields) 提供全局引导、分割后的夹爪系点云提供局部几何，Flow-Matching Transformer 预测平滑的 7-DoF 动作块 (action chunks)。
Result: 在仿真与真实任务实验中，该方法被报告为首个同时取得有竞争力的基准分数、并实现极端跨具身/跨视角零样本 sim-to-real 迁移到完全不同的异构机器人平台的模仿学习方法。
Conclusion: 把任务语义从硬件几何中解耦、以交互三元组加夹爪系规范表征为核心，是让两指夹爪模仿学习跨具身零样本迁移可行的路径。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning: From Spectral Foundation Models to Auroral Emission Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Auroral spectrographs such as the Auroral Spectrograph In Skibotn (ASIS) record hundreds of thousands of emission spectra, but only a few hundred can be labelled by an expert. To exploit the rest, we pretrain a 1D Vision Transformer with a masked autoencoder on 223,000 unlabelled spectra. Without labels, its representation recovers the emission-line intensity ratios that physicists use to diagnose the precipitating particles (R^2 0.91 vs. 0.77 for an untrained control) and, under one linear probe, classifies as well as 13 features designed by experts. Fine-tuned, the model outperforms the previous supervised auroral classifier on its own benchmark (macro-AP 88.5 vs. 77.8), reaches 0.870 mAP, and exceeds the same architecture trained from scratch by +0.159 with 10% of the labels; attribution shows that it uses both N2+ bands. Could an existing pretrained model replace it? Two astronomical spectral foundation models and a time-series model transfer according to their spectral window: SpectraFM, trained in the infrared, falls below the untrained control, whereas SpecFormer, trained in the optical, approaches in-domain pretraining without reaching it.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 223,000 条未标注极光光谱预训练 1D Vision Transformer masked autoencoder，无标签即可恢复物理学家诊断沉降粒子所用的发射线强度比（R² 0.91，未训练对照 0.77），线性探针分类达到 13 个专家设计特征的水平。微调后在原监督分类器基准上 macro-AP 88.5 vs 77.8、mAP 0.870，且只用 10% 标签比同架构从零训练高 +0.159；跨域迁移取决于光谱窗口——红外的 SpectraFM 低于未训练对照，光学的 SpecFormer 接近域内预训练但未达到。
Motivation: ASIS 极光光谱仪记录数十万条发射光谱，但专家只能标注几百条，监督分类器受标注量限制；同时需要判断现成光谱基础模型能否替代专用预训练。
Method: 在 223,000 条未标注光谱上以 masked autoencoder 预训练 1D Vision Transformer；用线性探针与微调两种读出方式评估，并与未训练对照、专家 13 特征、原监督分类器、同架构从零训练比较；再测试 SpectraFM（红外）、SpecFormer（光学）与时序模型的迁移。
Result: 发射线强度比恢复 R² 0.91（未训练对照 0.77）；单次线性探针分类与 13 个专家特征相当；微调 macro-AP 88.5 vs 原监督分类器 77.8，mAP 0.870；10% 标签下比从零训练同架构 +0.159；归因显示模型使用两条 N2+ 带；SpectraFM 低于未训练对照，SpecFormer 接近域内预训练但未达到。
Conclusion: 域内自监督预训练可用极少量标签超越既有监督极光分类器，而现成光谱基础模型能否替代取决于其训练光谱窗口与目标域是否对齐。

papers.title: FlatClip: A Geometry-Aware Surface-Level Baseline for fMRI Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent fMRI foundation models differ substantially in the spatial scale at which they represent brain activity. ROI- and connectivity-based models are efficient but coarse, whereas voxel-level models preserve fine-grained spatial structure but require specialized 3D/4D architectures and costly fMRI-specific pretraining. We ask how effectively an image-pretrained encoder can reuse the spatial organization of cortical activity. Motivated by evidence that macroscale brain activity is strongly constrained by brain geometry, we introduce FlatClip, a frozen-encoder surface-level baseline that renders cortical activity as geometry-aware flatmap sequences and reuses a frozen SigLIP2 image encoder with only a lightweight downstream probe. Across resting-state benchmarks, FlatClip serves as a competitive middle-ground representation, outperforming ROI-level baselines on HCP and ADNI tasks while remaining weaker on PPMI and below the strongest voxel-level models overall. On visual-fMRI decoding, restricting the input to visual or NSD-provided task-active cortex improves performance, highlighting the value of task-relevant cortical coverage. Spatial perturbation controls reduce the predictive performance of flatmap features under both retrained and fixed readouts, and anatomy-linked arrangements consistently outperform vertex permutations across three colormaps. Together, these results position surface-level flatmap sequences as a practical middle-ground baseline between ROI and voxel models, and support the utility of anatomy-linked spatial organization for reusing image-pretrained features. Code is available at https://github.com/OneMore1/FlatClip.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlatClip 把皮层活动渲染成几何对齐的 flatmap 序列，直接喂给冻结的 SigLIP2 图像编码器，只训一个轻量下游探针，作为 ROI 级与 voxel 级 fMRI 基础模型之间的中间表示。在静息态基准上它胜过 ROI 级基线（HCP、ADNI），但在 PPMI 上更弱、整体仍低于最强 voxel 级模型；空间扰动对照（重训与固定读出两种设定）会降低 flatmap 特征的预测性能，且解剖绑定的顶点排布在三种 colormap 下一致优于顶点随机置换。
Motivation: 现有 fMRI 基础模型在表征尺度上两极分化：ROI 与连接性模型高效但粗糙，voxel 级模型保细节却需要专门的 3D/4D 架构和昂贵的 fMRI 专用预训练，中间缺少一个能复用图像预训练编码器的低成本方案。
Method: 冻结的 surface-level 基线：把皮层活动按脑几何渲染为 flatmap 序列，复用冻结的 SigLIP2 图像编码器，仅训练轻量下游探针；在视觉 fMRI 解码中把输入限制到视觉皮层或 NSD 提供的任务激活皮层，并做空间扰动对照（重训读出与固定读出）与顶点置换对照，跨三种 colormap 检验。
Result: 静息态基准上 FlatClip 在 HCP 与 ADNI 任务上超过 ROI 级基线，在 PPMI 上更弱，整体仍低于最强 voxel 级模型；视觉 fMRI 解码中限定到视觉或 NSD 任务激活皮层可提升性能；空间扰动在重训与固定读出两种设定下都降低 flatmap 特征的预测性能，解剖绑定排布在三种 colormap 下一致优于顶点置换。
Conclusion: surface-level flatmap 序列是介于 ROI 与 voxel 模型之间的实用中间基线，解剖绑定的空间组织对复用图像预训练特征确实有用，但整体表征能力尚不及最强 voxel 级模型。

summary_sections.method: 冻结的 surface-level 基线：把皮层活动按脑几何渲染为 flatmap 序列，复用冻结的 SigLIP2 图像编码器，仅训练轻量下游探针；在视觉 fMRI 解码中把输入限制到视觉皮层或 NSD 提供的任务激活皮层，并做空间扰动对照（重训读出与固定读出）与顶点置换对照，跨三种 colormap 检验。
summary_sections.result: 静息态基准上 FlatClip 在 HCP 与 ADNI 任务上超过 ROI 级基线，在 PPMI 上更弱，整体仍低于最强 voxel 级模型；视觉 fMRI 解码中限定到视觉或 NSD 任务激活皮层可提升性能；空间扰动在重训与固定读出两种设定下都降低 flatmap 特征的预测性能，解剖绑定排布在三种 colormap 下一致优于顶点置换。

papers.title: Preserve-and-Compose Training for Composed Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve images that satisfy a user-specified modification while preserving relevant visual content from a reference image. Collecting target images for this purpose is costly, motivating zero-shot CIR methods that instead use target captions as supervision. However, target captions may omit source details that should be preserved. We therefore propose, Preserve-and-Compose Training, which complements target-caption supervision with visual evidence from the source image. PACT learns from image--text--text (ITT) triplets without target images or gallery updates, aligning composed queries with target captions while preserving source evidence through visual supervision. We further introduce Chord scoring, which combines target similarity with source-relative directional agreement in the frozen image space. Results across four ZS-CIR benchmarks show that combining target-caption supervision with source-image evidence leads to strong retrieval performance across datasets, backbone scales, and external galleries. The code is available on https://github.com/sehyunkwon/PACT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 用源图像的视觉证据补上目标描述遗漏的应保留细节，在无目标图像、无 gallery 更新的零样本 CIR (ZS-CIR) 设定下做 Preserve-and-Compose 训练，并提出 Chord 打分：在冻结图像空间中把目标相似度与相对源图的方向一致性结合。四个 ZS-CIR benchmark 上，目标描述监督叠加源图证据在不同数据集、backbone 规模与外部 gallery 下都取得强检索性能。
Motivation: 零样本 CIR 依赖目标描述作监督，但目标描述常漏掉源图中本应保留的细节，导致检索结果丢内容；收集目标图像成本又太高。
Method: PACT 从 image-text-text (ITT) 三元组学习，不需要目标图像或 gallery 更新：训练时用目标描述对齐组合查询，同时用源图的视觉监督保住源证据；推理用 Chord 打分，融合目标相似度与冻结图像空间中相对源图的方向一致性 (source-relative directional agreement)。
Result: 在四个 ZS-CIR benchmark 上，目标描述监督与源图证据结合在多个数据集、多个 backbone 规模和外部 gallery 条件下均带来强检索性能；代码发布于 github.com/sehyunkwon/PACT。
Conclusion: 零样本 CIR 的监督不应只来自目标描述，补上源图视觉证据并用方向性打分能同时保住应保留内容与满足修改，且无需目标图像或 gallery 更新。

papers.title: Samples, Sources, Space: Decomposing Data Scale in Spatially Structured Representation Learning of Human Brain Microarchitecture
papers.abstract_en: Scaling studies typically represent training data by a single count of samples. For hierarchically and spatially structured data, however, the same number of samples can be drawn from few or many sources and distributed differently across the underlying domain. We therefore study data scaling as an allocation problem, separating unique sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage. We study this decomposition in microscopic whole-brain histology, where a source is an individual brain, and a sample is an image patch at a specific spatial location. Across 93 controlled pretraining runs of a contrastive model that uses spatial proximity for supervision, we vary data allocation, compute, and model capacity over 11.6 million spatially anchored image patches from 21 human brains. Performance improves with more unique samples, broader spatial coverage, additional compute, and larger model capacity. At fixed sample count, distributing samples across one to 18 subjects produces no detectable improvement, even though representations generalize substantially better to subjects encountered during pretraining. Inter-subject variation therefore strongly affects generalization, but additional subjects provide no benefit when a fixed sample budget is distributed across more sources. These results establish sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage as distinct axes of data scaling in spatially structured representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把空间结构化表征学习的数据规模拆成唯一样本数、来源多样性和空间覆盖三条独立轴，在全脑显微组织学上做受控消融：性能随唯一样本数、空间覆盖、算力和模型容量上升，但在固定样本预算下把样本从 1 个受试者摊到 18 个受试者没有可检测的提升。结论是样本数、来源多样性、空间覆盖必须分开核算，多来源在预算固定时不带来收益。
Motivation: 标准 scaling 研究用单一的样本计数表示训练数据，对分层、空间结构化数据无法区分同样数量的样本是来自少数还是多个来源、在空间域上如何分布，导致数据分配决策缺少依据。
Method: 在微观全脑组织学（source 为单个人脑，sample 为空间位置上的图像 patch）上做受控预训练：用空间邻近性作为监督的对比模型，93 次受控预训练运行中系统改变数据分配、算力与模型容量，数据为 21 个人脑的 1160 万（11.6M）个空间锚定图像 patch。
Result: 性能随唯一样本数增加、空间覆盖变广、算力增加和模型容量增大而提升；在固定样本数下，把样本分布在 1 到 18 个受试者之间没有可检测的提升，尽管表征对预训练期间见过的受试者泛化明显更好。
Conclusion: 样本数、来源多样性和空间覆盖是空间结构化表征学习中三条互不等价的数据规模轴；受试者间差异强烈影响泛化，但在固定样本预算下增加来源不产生收益。

papers.title: Enhancing Photogrammetric Digital Surface Models with Pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale Digital Surface Models (DSMs) can be produced cost-effectively from satellite images via stereo-photogrammetry. However, the resulting 3D maps are often contaminated by noise, outliers, and voids. On the other hand, aerial LiDAR provides high-accuracy elevation measurements at a substantially higher cost. In this work, we study diffusion models conditioned both on photogrammetric DSMs and Pléiades imagery to refine vertically co-registered DSMs. We introduce a modified Stable Diffusion 3 architecture with a pruned text stream and a patch-wise normalization strategy, enabling stable training on LiDAR data and transfer from natural images to elevation maps. Experiments in French cities demonstrate that multimodal conditioning improves elevation accuracy, reducing Dense Urban RMSE from 6.00 to 3.45 m in the in-context cities and from 4.16 to 2.77 m in the held-out city of Bordeaux.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用改造过的 Stable Diffusion 3（剪掉文本流、加 patch-wise 归一化）同时以摄影测量 DSM 和 Pléiades 影像为条件，对垂直配准的 DSM 做扩散模型精修，把噪声、离群点和空洞压下去。在法国城市实验中，多模态条件使 Dense Urban RMSE 从 6.00 m 降到 3.45 m（in-context 城市），留出的 Bordeaux 从 4.16 m 降到 2.77 m。
Motivation: 卫星立体摄影测量能低成本产出大范围 DSM，但结果常被噪声、离群点和空洞污染；航空 LiDAR 精度高但成本高得多，需要在不加 LiDAR 采集的前提下提升 DSM 高程精度。
Method: 改造 Stable Diffusion 3 架构：剪除文本流 (pruned text stream)，加入 patch-wise normalization，使模型能在 LiDAR 高程数据上稳定训练并从自然图像迁移到高程图；以摄影测量 DSM 与 Pléiades 影像双模态条件对垂直配准的 DSM 做精修。
Result: 法国城市实验中，多模态条件将 Dense Urban RMSE 从 6.00 m 降至 3.45 m（in-context 城市），在留出的 Bordeaux 城市从 4.16 m 降至 2.77 m。
Conclusion: 预训练扩散模型配合摄影测量 DSM 与卫星影像的多模态条件，可在未见过的城市上提升高程精度，说明从自然图像到高程图的迁移是可行的。

papers.title: Light Field Primitive for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present Light Field Primitives (LFP), a formulation for novel view synthesis that replaces the dense ray database with a compact set of differentiable primitives in the classical two-plane parameterization. Each primitive condenses a group of rays into one learned record, and its response to a query is governed by how closely that query belongs to the group. Rendering a camera ray then reduces to compositing all responses it elicits, and a scene can be optimized directly from posed images and rendered in real time with rays. Beyond its competitive performance on standard benchmarks, the main advantage of LFP is structural: its primitives reside directly in the 4D ray space, so optical and appearance effects that are already operations on the light field become behaviors of a single shared renderer. With minimal changes to that renderer, LFP supports multi-scale anti-aliasing, defocus deblurring with refocusing, rendering for fisheye cameras, and even transparent object reconstruction with ray refraction, matching specialized frameworks that devote substantial machinery to these effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Light Field Primitives (LFP) 用两平面参数化 (two-plane parameterization) 下的一组可微图元替代稠密光线数据库，每条查询光线的渲染退化为对其所激发的各图元响应做合成，可直接从带位姿图像优化场景并实时渲染。图元本身驻留在 4D 光线空间，因此抗锯齿、去模糊重对焦、鱼眼渲染与透明物体折射重构只需对同一渲染器做最小改动即可支持。
Motivation: 新视角合成 (novel view synthesis) 依赖稠密光线数据库，存储开销大，且散景、鱼眼、折射等光学效果各自需要专门框架与大量机制，难以统一到一个渲染器中。
Method: LFP 把一组光线压缩为单个学习记录（primitive），查询与该组的归属度决定其响应；渲染一条相机光线即合成全部响应，场景直接从 posed images 优化。渲染器以最小改动扩展到多尺度抗锯齿、带重对焦的 defocus deblurring、fisheye 相机渲染与含 ray refraction 的透明物体重构。
Result: 在标准基准上性能具竞争力（competitive），并以单一共享渲染器匹配那些为各类光学效果投入大量专门机制的框架；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把图元直接放进 4D 光线空间，可让原本属于光场操作的光学与外观效果变成同一渲染器的内在行为，从而用一套结构覆盖多种专用效果。

papers.title: ALF: An Active Learning Framework for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning for scientific discovery is almost systematically data bound. Producing relevant high quality data, under budget constraints, is amongst the most promising ways to advance the field. Active learning (AL) offers promise wherever labelling requires expensive experiment, measurement, or simulation. Most existing tools cover only part of the data acquisition loop, and typically focus on either offline benchmarking or online deployment, but not both. We present ALF, a modular AL Framework that runs the full data acquisition loop via five modular components. One clear API for both settings: offline, against an existing dataset for controlled and reproducible experimentation; and online, against an oracle for acquiring new candidates in real-world deployments. ALF is open-source and available at https://github.com/instadeepai/alf.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALF 是一个开源的主动学习 (active learning) 框架，用五个模块化组件跑完整数据获取循环，并以同一套 API 同时支持离线（对既有数据集做可控可复现实验）与在线（对 oracle 实时采集新候选）两种模式。它针对的是现有工具只覆盖采集循环一部分、且离线基准与在线部署二选一的问题。
Motivation: 科学发现中的机器学习几乎系统性地受数据量束缚，而标注往往需要昂贵的实验、测量或仿真；现有 AL 工具通常只覆盖数据获取循环的一部分，且离线基准评测与在线部署不能兼得。
Method: 提出模块化框架 ALF，由五个模块化组件构成完整数据获取循环；提供单一清晰 API，离线模式在既有数据集上做受控可复现的基准实验，在线模式对接 oracle 在真实部署中实时采集新候选；框架开源发布于 GitHub。
Result: 提出并开源 ALF 框架，覆盖离线与在线两种数据获取设置的统一 API 与五个模块化组件；摘要给出的是框架设计与发布本身，未附带定量指标。
Conclusion: 数据获取循环的离线基准与在线部署可以用同一套模块化 API 统一起来，ALF 以此作为可复现主动学习实验与真实部署的共同基础设施。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.result: 提出并开源 ALF 框架，覆盖离线与在线两种数据获取设置的统一 API 与五个模块化组件；摘要给出的是框架设计与发布本身，未附带定量指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 数据获取循环的离线基准与在线部署可以用同一套模块化 API 统一起来，ALF 以此作为可复现主动学习实验与真实部署的共同基础设施。

papers.title: Who Says What: Symbolic Trimodal Binding Mechanisms in Audio-Visual LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current Audio-Visual LLMs (AVLLMs) struggle with reasoning over videos featuring multi-speaker dialogues. In such videos, resolving "who says what" is crucial, which necessitates trimodal (text-audio-visual) binding. Motivated by these challenges, we systematically investigate how this trimodal binding is achieved in AVLLMs. Specifically, we identify emergent symbolic trimodal binding mechanisms in AVLLMs that utilize modality-specific symbolic variables. By encoding auditory and visual components into symbolic variables-capturing temporal utterance sequences and spatial entity coordinates, respectively-the model establishes cross-modal linking within this abstract space. Crucially, we reveal that when trimodal binding fails, the breakdown predominantly stems from misaligned audio-visual connections. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce an audio-visual prompting method utilizing an off-the-shelf Active Speaker Detection (ASD) model. By simply overlaying visual bounding boxes on active speakers, this training-free approach yields immediate performance gains across four conversation-centric benchmarks. Moreover, lightweight fine-tuning of fewer than 300 steps on these ASD-prompted-videos extends these gains to three general AV benchmarks, suggesting the generalizability of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统考察 Audio-Visual LLM 如何在多说话人视频中完成文本-音频-视觉三模态绑定 (trimodal binding)，发现模型把听觉话语的时间序列与视觉实体的空间坐标编码成模态专属符号变量，在抽象空间建立跨模态链接；绑定失败主要源于音画连接错位。用现成 Active Speaker Detection (ASD) 模型在活跃说话人上叠加可视边界框的免训练提示，在四个对话类基准上立即带来性能提升，再经少于 300 步轻量微调可把增益扩展到三个通用 AV 基准。
Motivation: 多说话人对话视频中，Audio-Visual LLM 需要判定“谁说了什么”，即完成文本-音频-视觉三模态绑定，而现有 AVLLM 在该任务上推理困难。
Method: 先识别 AVLLM 中利用模态专属符号变量的涌现式符号三模态绑定机制：听觉编码为话语时间序列、视觉编码为空间实体坐标，并在抽象空间建立跨模态链接；再针对音画连接错位这一主要失效点，引入基于现成 ASD 模型的音画提示（在活跃说话人上叠加边界框），配合少于 300 步的轻量微调。
Result: 绑定失效主要来自错位的音画连接；叠加 ASD 边界框的免训练提示在四个对话类基准上立即带来性能提升；在 ASD 提示视频上少于 300 步轻量微调后，增益扩展到三个通用 AV 基准。
Conclusion: 三模态绑定的瓶颈在音画连接而非符号编码本身，用现成 ASD 提示补齐活跃说话人定位即可跨对话与通用 AV 任务带来可迁移的增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking Data Quality for AI-Driven Systems: Evidence from Practitioner Interviews
papers.abstract_en: Data quality research has usually treated data as an input that is stored, processed, and validated. In AI-driven software-intensive systems, data also shapes model behavior, evaluation, and lawful use. Empirical evidence remains limited on how practitioners define, assess, and manage quality under these conditions. We interviewed 16 practitioners from nine organizations and analyzed the transcripts using reflexive thematic analysis and developed six themes from participants' accounts. In AI systems, traceability shifted from modular debugging to attributing model behavior, while using models as quality assessors introduced circularity. Agent context and memory became data objects, and synthetic and pseudo-labeled data made authenticity a quality concern. In foundation-model development, lawfulness became a gate for training data, while representativeness was judged through coverage of situations in which the system must behave safely. Prior ML research examines many of these problems separately. Our study provides a practitioner-grounded account of how they are encountered together as an engineering and organizational concern. We also interpret five recurring conditions as helping explain how the themes relate to reduced trust in data and AI outcomes. We synthesize these findings through lifecycle assurance: a conceptual framing focused on producing evidence that data can support a specific AI claim when its influence may be embedded in model behavior, model-based judgments, or agent actions.
papers.comment: This is a preprint version and the final version will appear in the proceedings of PROFES 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 9 家组织的 16 名从业者做半结构访谈，用反身主题分析 (reflexive thematic analysis) 归纳出 AI 驱动系统中数据质量的六个主题，并把五个反复出现的条件解释为导致对数据与 AI 结果信任下降的机制。核心论断是：在 AI 系统里数据质量从「输入是否合规」转为「数据是否支撑某个具体 AI 主张」，作者据此提出 lifecycle assurance 这一概念框架。
Motivation: 既有数据质量研究把数据当作存储、处理、验证的输入，而 AI 系统中数据同时塑造模型行为、评估与合法使用；从业者如何在这一新条件下定义、评估、管理数据质量，实证证据仍然很少。
Method: 对 9 个组织的 16 名从业者开展访谈，对转录文本做反身主题分析，从受访者叙述中提炼六个主题，并把五个反复出现的条件解释为与信任下降相关；最后综合为 lifecycle assurance 概念框架，聚焦在数据影响可能嵌入模型行为、模型判断或 agent 行动时，产出数据能支撑特定 AI 主张的证据。
Result: 六个主题包括：可追溯性从模块级调试转向归因模型行为、用模型做质量评估引入循环性、agent 上下文与记忆成为数据对象、合成与伪标注数据使真实性成为质量问题、基础模型开发中合法性 (lawfulness) 成为训练数据的门槛、代表性通过系统须安全行为的情境覆盖来判断；另有五个反复出现的条件被解释为与对数据和 AI 结果的信任下降相关。
Conclusion: 数据质量问题在 AI 系统中是工程与组织层面同时出现的整体性问题，应以 lifecycle assurance 的方式为「数据支撑特定 AI 主张」产出可审查的证据，而非逐项孤立处理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Evolutionary Safety of Recursive Self-Improving AI: Taxonomy, Risk Discovery, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly, with increasingly capable systems taking larger roles in reasoning, decision-making, scientific discovery, and autonomous development. As AI begins to participate in its own improvement, from model training and experience accumulation to agent evolution and automated AI development, the prospect of recursive self-improvement (RSI) is becoming increasingly relevant. This transition raises a fundamental safety question: how can safety be maintained when the system, its accumulated experience, and even the process producing its successors continue to change? We introduce Evolutionary Safety as a perspective for studying safety under persistent and recursive self-improvement. It concerns not only whether an AI system is safe at a particular moment, but how safety properties change, persist, accumulate, and propagate throughout evolution. We characterize recurring manifestations, including intent drift, error accumulation, experience contamination, safety-property erosion, evaluator drift, and risk propagation. We then develop a taxonomy spanning persistent agent state, model state, evaluation and environmental feedback, computational substrate, and meta-level update mechanisms. Building on this taxonomy, we examine how evolutionary risks can be discovered and evaluated across states, updates, trajectories, and lineages, and derive governance principles for modification, selection, authorization, provenance, and recovery. Finally, we outline open problems toward maintaining safety guarantees as AI systems become increasingly persistent, adaptive, and recursively self-improving. Project resources and proposed evaluation systems are available at https://chaunceykung.github.io/evolutionary-safety-rsi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Evolutionary Safety 视角，把递归自我改进 (RSI) 下的安全性视为随演化变化、累积与传播的性质，而非某一时刻的静态属性。归纳 intent drift、error accumulation、experience contamination、safety-property erosion、evaluator drift、risk propagation 等反复出现的风险表现，并按持久 agent 状态、模型状态、评估与环境反馈、计算基底、元级更新机制五层给出分类法。
Motivation: 当系统本身、其累积经验乃至产生后继者的流程都在持续变化时，一次性安全评估失效：需要刻画安全性质如何在演化中变化、保持、累积与传播。
Method: 提出 Evolutionary Safety 概念框架：先刻画六类反复出现的风险表现，再构建覆盖持久 agent 状态、模型状态、评估与环境反馈、计算基底、元级更新机制的分类法；据此讨论跨状态、更新、轨迹与谱系的风险发现与评估方式，并导出针对修改、选择、授权、溯源与恢复的治理原则。
Result: 给出六类风险表现（intent drift、error accumulation、experience contamination、safety-property erosion、evaluator drift、risk propagation）与五层分类法，以及跨 states、updates、trajectories、lineages 的风险发现与评估路径和五条治理原则；配套项目资源与拟议评估系统发布在项目页面。
Conclusion: RSI 时代的安全必须按演化过程来度量与治理，覆盖修改、选择、授权、溯源与恢复；论文同时列出维持安全保证的开放问题。

papers.title: Accounting for Bias Enables Sustainable LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge has become the de facto standard for scalable, subjective evaluation, yet current leaderboards compensate for systematic measurement bias by running ever more comparisons, an approach that is both statistically unsound and computationally wasteful. The root cause is an incomplete measurement model, treating LLM judges as neutral, interchangeable instruments ignores documented biases like position bias, verbosity bias, judge severity, and self-enhancement, that no volume of additional data can eliminate. We propose a unified latent variable framework that jointly models pairwise and ordinal data while explicitly correcting for these confounders, recovering reliable rankings from substantially fewer comparisons. Because fitting this model costs negligible compute relative to a single round of LLM inference, bias correction is not only more statistically rigorous but also a more sustainable approach to trustworthy evaluation.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures; SuRE'26: Workshop on Sustainability and Resource-Efficiency of Artificial Intelligence at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM-as-a-judge 排行榜用增加比较次数来抵消位置偏置、冗长偏置、评审严厉度与自我偏好等系统性测量偏差，既统计上不成立又浪费算力。论文提出统一潜变量框架，联合建模 pairwise 与 ordinal 数据并显式校正这些混淆因子，用远少的比较次数恢复可靠排名；拟合成本相对一轮 LLM 推理可忽略，因此偏差校正同时是更可持续的评估路径。
Motivation: 把 LLM 评审当作中性可互换的测量工具是不完整的测量模型，由此产生的位置偏置、冗长偏置、评审严厉度与自我偏好无法靠堆更多比较消除，导致排行榜既统计不可靠又计算浪费。
Method: 提出统一潜变量 (latent variable) 框架，联合建模 pairwise 与 ordinal 两类评审数据，并在模型中显式校正位置偏置、冗长偏置、judge severity、self-enhancement 等混淆因子，从带偏观测中恢复排名。
Result: 该框架能以远少于现有做法的比较次数恢复可靠排名；模型拟合的计算成本相对单轮 LLM 推理可忽略不计。
Conclusion: 系统性评审偏差应通过补全测量模型来校正，而不是靠增加比较数据量；偏差校正既更统计严谨，也是更可持续的可信评估方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BAT-CLIP: Trimodal Alignment of Brain, Audio and Text
papers.abstract_en: Decoding and interpreting naturalistic speech from the brain increasingly relies on alignment to pretrained speech and language representation spaces. However, current CLIP-style brain-speech alignment ground neural activity to a single anchor modality-audio or text-despite the brain's inherently multimodal speech processing. This induces a trade-off: audio anchoring preserves temporal structure but weakens linguistic separability, while text anchoring captures semantics yet discards acoustic detail. We propose BAT-CLIP, the first CLIP-style trimodal alignment framework for iEEG that jointly aligns neural embeddings to both pretrained audio and text anchors in a shared, frozen audio-text manifold. On the naturalistic Podcast benchmark, BAT-CLIP yields more robust representations than bimodal CLIP baselines. We also highlight the importance of using self-supervised foundation models for CLIP training.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BAT-CLIP 首次把 iEEG 神经嵌入同时对齐到冻结的音频与文本两个预训练锚点（trimodal CLIP-style alignment），摆脱单锚点权衡：音频锚点保时序但语言可分性弱，文本锚点有语义却丢声学细节。在 Podcast 自然语音基准上，其表示比双模态 CLIP 基线更稳健。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP 式脑-语音对齐只用单一锚点（音频或文本），造成时序结构与语言语义不可兼得的权衡，无法反映大脑本身多模态的语音加工。
Method: 提出 BAT-CLIP：在共享且冻结的 audio-text 流形上，把 iEEG 神经嵌入与预训练音频锚点、文本锚点做三模态联合对齐（CLIP-style contrastive alignment），并强调 CLIP 训练中使用自监督基础模型的重要性。
Result: 在自然语音 Podcast 基准上，BAT-CLIP 生成的表示比双模态 CLIP 基线更稳健；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 脑语音解码的对齐应同时锚定音频与文本两个预训练空间，且 CLIP 训练需依托自监督基础模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SPO: Discovering Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Operators via Stackelberg Program Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large neighborhood search (LNS) relies critically on destroy and repair operators, whose effectiveness depends on both adaptation to the evolving LNS state and interaction between the two roles. We introduce Stackelberg Program Optimization (SPO), an LLM-based framework for discovering adaptive executable destroy-repair programs. SPO conditions operator decisions on a compact LNS state, allowing state-dependent behavior to emerge through program discovery, and organizes destroy-repair discovery as a Stackelberg interaction over program space that reflects their asymmetric dependency. Role-specific credits evaluate destroy programs as leaders and repair programs as conditional follower responses, guiding a coupled optimization process that combines LLM generator learning with population-based evolutionary search over programs. Experiments on the traveling salesperson problem and capacitated vehicle routing problem show that SPO outperforms strong baselines across a broad range of settings and generalizes beyond the discovery scale to larger instances and benchmark sets. Behavioral analyses further demonstrate state-dependent operator behavior and coupled destroy-repair improvement during discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPO 用 LLM 在程序空间里发现自适应的 destroy-repair 算子：把算子决策绑定到紧凑的 LNS 状态上，并按 Stackelberg 主从结构组织两者的非对称依赖，用角色信用 (role-specific credits) 引导 LLM 生成学习与种群进化搜索的耦合优化。在 TSP 与 CVRP 上，SPO 在广泛设置中超过强基线，并能泛化到发现规模之外的更大实例与基准集。
Motivation: LNS 的 destroy 与 repair 算子效果取决于对演化中 LNS 状态的适应以及两者之间的交互，而现有算子设计难以同时做到状态依赖与角色耦合。
Method: 提出 Stackelberg Program Optimization (SPO)：以紧凑 LNS 状态为条件，通过 LLM 程序发现生成可执行的 destroy-repair 程序；把发现过程组织为程序空间上的 Stackelberg 交互，destroy 作为 leader、repair 作为条件 follower，用角色信用分别评估，耦合 LLM 生成学习与基于种群的程序进化搜索。
Result: 在 traveling salesperson problem (TSP) 与 capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) 上，SPO 在广泛设置中优于强基线，并泛化到发现规模之外的更大实例与基准集；行为分析显示算子行为随状态变化，且 destroy 与 repair 在发现过程中耦合改进。
Conclusion: 把 destroy-repair 发现形式化为程序空间上的 Stackelberg 主从优化并以状态为条件，可以得到状态依赖且相互耦合的 LNS 算子，并跨问题规模泛化。

papers.title: Semantic Navigation for Issue Localization in Code Repository
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level issue localization aims to identify and rank the files and functions relevant to resolving a reported issue. LLM agents approach this task iteratively: they identify a set of potentially relevant locations, inspect the corresponding code, and revise their judgments about these candidates as new evidence is acquired. Existing environments, however, provide limited support for this loop: agents must search for unresolved relation targets, reconstruct entity semantics from raw source code, and revise candidates without evidential basis. To address these limitations, we present SemNav, a framework that leverages deterministic retrieval to seed a broad candidate set and an LLM agent to continually refine that set, thereby combining initial coverage with evidence-guided revision. SemNav supports this process through three key components. A Semantic Navigation Graph resolves program relations on demand through a language server, enabling direct navigation to related entities across files. Issue-conditioned Semantic Cards provide compact, source-grounded interpretations of each entity's role and relevance to the issue. A persistent Candidate Workspace records each candidate together with its evidential basis, enabling grounded verification, revision, and ranking. Across SWE-bench Lite and PLocBench, SemNav outperforms existing baselines, improving File Hit@10 from 68.33\% to 82.67\% with Gemma 4B. Component ablations and trajectory analysis support the complementary roles of all three components, while Semantic Cards reduce working-context load by 48.2\% relative to full-source reading. SemNav further ranks first on all seven evidence-quality metrics on SWE-Explore and improves downstream issue resolution from 44.00\% to 52.33\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemNav 用确定性检索铺开候选集、再让 LLM agent 依据证据持续精炼，把仓库级 issue 定位做成可核查的迭代过程。在 SWE-bench Lite 与 PLocBench 上 File Hit@10 从 68.33% 提到 82.67%（Gemma 4B），下游 issue 解决率从 44.00% 提到 52.33%，Semantic Cards 相对通读源码减少 48.2% 的工作上下文负载。
Motivation: 现有环境不支持 LLM agent 的迭代定位循环：agent 要自己搜未解析的关系目标、从原始源码重建实体语义，且在没有证据的情况下修改候选判断。
Method: SemNav 三个组件：Semantic Navigation Graph 通过 language server 按需解析程序关系、跨文件直连相关实体；Issue-conditioned Semantic Cards 给出与 issue 相关的紧凑且溯源的实体角色解读；persistent Candidate Workspace 记录每个候选及其证据依据，支撑验证、修订与排序。整体由确定性检索播种候选集、LLM agent 持续精炼。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Lite 和 PLocBench 上，File Hit@10 由 68.33% 提升至 82.67%（Gemma 4B）；Semantic Cards 相对通读源码减少 48.2% 工作上下文负载；在 SWE-Explore 的七项证据质量指标上全部排名第一；下游 issue 解决率由 44.00% 提升至 52.33%。组件消融与轨迹分析支持三个组件的互补作用。

papers.title: TaskIR: Task-Driven Image Restoration via Degradation Adaptation and Task Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Task-driven image restoration aims to improve both image quality and downstream task performance. However, existing methods predominantly focus on single degradation type and struggle to handle the diverse degradations encountered in real-world scenarios. Different degradations impose distinct restoration demands, and insufficient restoration may leave residual degradations and artifacts that impair object boundaries and semantic cues, thereby compromising downstream task performance. To address these challenges, we propose TaskIR, a two-stage task-driven unified image restoration framework that integrates degradation-adaptive restoration with task feedback refinement. In Stage I, a Degradation Representation Module (DRM) extracts degradation representations, enabling a Degradation-Guided Transformer Block (DGTB) to dynamically modulate feature transformations for adaptive restoration. In Stage II, a Task-to-Restoration Feedback Generation module (TRFG) transforms heterogeneous task features into restoration feedback by modeling task-representation discrepancies associated with the current restoration. Subsequently, a Selective Task Feedback Refinement module (STFR) assesses feedback relevance and selectively refines intermediate restoration features to mitigate interference with well-restored content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaskIR achieves competitive restoration quality and downstream task performance across diverse degradations and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TaskIR 是两阶段任务驱动图像复原框架：先用退化表征模块 (DRM) 与退化引导 Transformer 块 (DGTB) 按不同退化动态调制特征做自适应复原，再由任务到复原反馈生成模块 (TRFG) 把异构任务特征转成复原反馈，选择性任务反馈精炼模块 (STFR) 挑选相关反馈精炼中间特征。实验显示它在多种退化与多种任务上同时取得有竞争力的复原质量与下游任务性能。
Motivation: 现有任务驱动复原方法多针对单一退化类型，难以应对真实场景的多样退化；复原不足会留下残余退化与伪影，破坏目标边界和语义线索，进而拖累下游任务表现。
Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 由 DRM 提取退化表征，驱动 DGTB 动态调制特征变换实现退化自适应复原；Stage II 的 TRFG 建模当前复原结果与任务表征间的差异，把异构任务特征转为复原反馈，STFR 评估反馈相关性并选择性精炼中间复原特征，避免干扰已复原良好的内容。
Result: 在多种退化与多种任务上的大量实验中，TaskIR 取得有竞争力的复原质量与下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 把退化自适应复原与任务反馈精炼分成两阶段串起来，可以在统一框架内同时兼顾图像质量和下游任务表现，覆盖多类退化而非单一退化。

papers.title: Improving Visual Sensitivity of LLMs on Multimodal Machine Translation with Metric-based Loss Weighting
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Machine Translation aims to incorporate additional signal from non-textual modalities to improve translations by resolving ambiguities. While models, through multimodal fusion, are able to accept images related to the source text, they can ignore this information. Therefore, increasing their visual sensitivity remains an active research area. In this work, we introduce a training method, Metric-based Loss Weighting, that improves visual grounding of translations by increasing the loss function for tokens that benefit from the accompanying image. We identify these tokens using the Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI) metric, which compares the model's output probabilities with and without visual context. We introduce a Congruency-based PCXMI metric and experimentally show that both metrics working in combination yield the best results. We evaluate our method by fine-tuning three pretrained Multimodal Large Language Models on the task of Image-guided Machine Translation for three language directions. Metric-based Loss Weighting outperforms other tested methods on the CoMMuTE contrastive dataset, improving accuracy by up to more than 7 percentage points compared to standard fine-tuning, while maintaining strong general translation performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态机器翻译 (MMT) 中模型常忽略图像，本文提出 Metric-based Loss Weighting：用 Point-wise Cross-mutual Information (PCXMI) 及其 Congruency 变体识别真正受益于图像的 token，对这些 token 加大损失权重。在三个预训练多模态大模型、三个语言方向的 Image-guided Machine Translation 微调中，CoMMuTE 对比数据集准确率较标准微调最高提升超过 7 个百分点，同时保持通用翻译性能。
Motivation: 多模态融合模型能接收与源文本相关的图像，却往往直接忽略该信息，视觉敏感性 (visual sensitivity) 因此成为开放问题；标准微调的损失对所有 token 一视同仁，无法区分哪些词真正需要图像消歧。
Method: 训练方法 Metric-based Loss Weighting：先用 PCXMI（比较有/无视觉上下文时模型输出概率）与新提出的 Congruency-based PCXMI 标记受益于图像的 token，再对这些 token 提高损失函数权重；在三个预训练 Multimodal Large Language Models 上做 Image-guided Machine Translation 微调，覆盖三个语言方向。
Result: 在 CoMMuTE 对比数据集上，两种指标组合使用效果最佳，较标准微调准确率最高提升超过 7 个百分点，且通用翻译性能保持强劲；评测覆盖三个 MLLM、三个语言方向。
Conclusion: 按 token 级视觉依赖度加权损失能提升翻译的视觉 grounding，PCXMI 与 Congruency-based PCXMI 组合是最有效的加权依据，且不以牺牲通用翻译质量为代价。

papers.title: Audio emotion recognition for atypical hearing
papers.abstract_en: My doctoral work aims to explore Audio Emotion Recognition (AER) in the context of atypical listening. This research focuses on auditory hypersensitivity in people with autism, a phenomenon that is often difficult to evaluate and unique to each individual. Our core idea is to leverage our understanding of affect from acoustic traits, relying on the possibility of generalizing affective responses from a small amount of annotated data. As a first step, we fine-tune a large foundation model, Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), trained on a valence and arousal dataset of neurotypical listeners.
papers.journal_ref: ACII : Affective Computing and Intelligent INteraction 2026, Enrique Sucar; Nadia Berthouze; Gary McKeown, Sep 2026, Puebla (Mexico), Mexico
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对自闭症听觉过敏这一难以评估的非典型听音场景，用 LoRA 微调音频基础模型 CLAP，在神经典型听者的情感标注数据上学 valence/arousal 表征，主张少量标注即可把声学特征到情感的映射迁移到非典型听音者。
Motivation: 自闭症人群的听觉过敏难以评估且个体差异大，直接采集大规模标注数据不可行，需要借助少量标注把情感响应泛化过去。
Method: 以 Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) 为基础模型，用 low-rank adaptation (LoRA) 做参数高效微调，训练数据为神经典型听者的 valence 与 arousal 标注数据集。
Result: 给出的是博士工作路线与第一步：在神经典型听者的 valence/arousal 数据上以 LoRA 微调 CLAP，摘要未给出数值指标。
Conclusion: 核心假设是声学特征到情感的映射可由少量标注数据泛化到非典型听音场景，第一步先在神经典型听者上验证 CLAP 微调。

papers.title: Neural State Prediction: Obstructing Shortcut Learning in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: EEG foundation models increasingly use masked prediction to learn from unlabeled recordings, but optimizing this objective does not ensure transferable neural representations. A central challenge is that stable positional cues and local correlations can make masked regions predictable without integrating distributed neural context. To reduce this reliance on low-information prediction paths, we introduce Neural State Prediction (NSP), a latent-predictive framework that constrains both the prediction target and the available context. NSP uses a Target Encoder updated by an exponential moving average (EMA) to define latent supervision. Identity residualization removes additive effects associated with channel identity and relative time from the targets, while topology-separated context excludes their immediate spatial and temporal neighborhood from the visible input. We pretrain NSP on 2.2 million EEG segments from TUEG and evaluate it across 30 downstream datasets spanning clinical diagnosis, sleep staging, emotion recognition, motor imagery, event-related potentials, cognitive-state decoding, and language retrieval. Under full-parameter multi-task fine-tuning on EEG-FM-Bench, NSP achieves 63.94 macro balanced accuracy across 14 datasets, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.35 percentage points. Controlled component ablations assess the contribution of each mechanism, while matched context controls and held-out interventions characterize the role of context geometry, signal content, and positional information. Jointly designing latent targets and their context offers a promising direction for EEG foundation models that learn from distributed signal structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EEG 基础模型的掩码预测会被稳定位置线索和局部相关性走捷径，NSP 同时约束预测目标与可见上下文：EMA 更新的 Target Encoder 给出潜变量监督，identity residualization 去掉通道身份与相对时间的加性成分，topology-separated context 把目标的时空邻域从可见输入中排除。在 EEG-FM-Bench 全参数多任务微调下，NSP 在 14 个数据集上宏平均平衡准确率 63.94，比最强评估基线高 2.35 个百分点。
Motivation: 掩码预测目标本身不保证学到可迁移的神经表征：位置线索与局部相关性让被掩区域无需整合分布式神经上下文即可被预测，形成低信息量捷径。

Result: 在 EEG-FM-Bench 全参数多任务微调下，NSP 在 14 个数据集上取得 63.94 宏平均平衡准确率，超出最强评估基线 2.35 个百分点；预训练数据为 TUEG 的 220 万段 EEG，评测覆盖 30 个下游数据集（临床诊断、睡眠分期、情绪识别、运动想象、事件相关电位、认知状态解码、语言检索）。
Conclusion: 潜变量目标与其可见上下文需要联合设计，才能让 EEG 基础模型从分布式信号结构而非位置捷径中学习。

papers.title: AgentRecommender: LLM Agents Enable Customizable Recommender Systems on the User Side
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems have traditionally been developed for platforms. However, this has given rise to many phenomena that may be advantageous for platform lock-in but are a nuisance to users, such as clickbait, filter bubbles, and the spread of fake news. Recently, user-side recommender systems have been proposed as a new paradigm for solving this problem. If users deploy their own recommender systems, they are no longer at the mercy of the platform's interests. However, building a user-side recommender system is not trivial; in particular, customizing one for oneself requires additional data. We propose AgentRecommender, a method that leverages the investigation capability and internal knowledge of LLM agents to flexibly build user-side recommender systems without additional data. AgentRecommender allows users to easily create recommender systems tailored to their own preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentRecommender 用 LLM agent 的调查能力与内部知识，在不引入额外数据的前提下为用户侧推荐系统做个性化定制，使用户能自行搭建贴合个人偏好的推荐器，摆脱平台锁定。
Motivation: 平台侧推荐系统催生点击诱饵、过滤气泡与假新闻扩散等利于平台锁定却损害用户的问题；用户侧推荐是新范式，但自行定制需要额外数据，构建门槛高。
Method: 利用 LLM agent 的调查 (investigation) 能力与内部知识，灵活构建用户侧推荐系统，无需额外数据即可按用户偏好定制。
Result: 提出 AgentRecommender 方法，使用户能轻松创建贴合自身偏好的推荐系统，且不需要额外数据。
Conclusion: 用户侧推荐系统的个性化定制可以靠 LLM agent 的调查与知识完成，绕开额外数据这一主要障碍。

papers.title: BreathGRU: A Novel Semi-Supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit Framework for Speech and Breath Segmentation for Respiratory Audio
papers.abstract_en: Speech-breath segmentation is a fundamental preprocessing step in respiratory audio analysis, enabling applications such as respiratory acoustic biomarker extraction, lung function prediction and disease monitoring. Existing approaches, including threshold methods, Fourier Transform-based techniques, and unsupervised and pretrained voice activity detection (VAD) models, primarily focus on speech detection and often classify breathing events as non-speech or silence, limiting their applicability for precise breath detection. To address this limitation, we propose BreathGRU, a semi-supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) framework specifically designed for speech-breath segmentation. The proposed framework combines frame-level acoustic feature extraction with bidirectional recurrent modelling, pseudo-label refinement and duration-constrained Segmental Viterbi decoding to produce speech and breath segmentation. BreathGRU was evaluated against the existing approaches, using manually annotated recordings. Performance was assessed using event-based, time-based, overlap-based, duration-based and boundary-based segmentation metrics. Experiment results demonstrated that BreathGRU achieved the highest breath event recall (0.83), the lowest onset-localisation error (0.14s) and the highest Mean Match Intersection over Union (0.81), with competitive overall segmentation performance compared to large pretrained VAD models like Silero. Qualitative evaluation on manually annotated recordings further showed close agreement between BreathGRU and manual annotation, with better breath detection compared to Silero. These findings demonstrate that explicit breath event modelling provides advantages over general-purpose VAD models and establish BreathGRU as an effective speech-breath segmentation framework which can be applied for respiratory audio analysis and pulmonary healthcare applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BreathGRU 用半监督双向 GRU 加伪标签精修与时长约束的 Segmental Viterbi 解码，显式建模呼吸事件而非把呼吸归为静音。在人工标注录音上，呼吸事件召回 0.83、onset 定位误差 0.14s、Mean Match IoU 0.81，呼吸检测优于通用 VAD 模型 Silero。
Motivation: 阈值法、傅里叶方法与预训练 VAD 主要检测语音，常把呼吸事件判为非语音或静音，无法做精确的呼吸检测，限制了呼吸声生物标志提取与肺功能预测的可用性。
Method: 帧级声学特征提取接双向循环建模 (BiGRU)，配合伪标签精修 (pseudo-label refinement) 和带时长约束的 Segmental Viterbi 解码，输出语音/呼吸分割；在人工标注录音上评测，覆盖 event-based、time-based、overlap-based、duration-based、boundary-based 五类指标。
Result: 呼吸事件召回 0.83（最高），onset 定位误差 0.14s（最低），Mean Match Intersection over Union 0.81（最高）；整体分割性能与大型预训练 VAD（Silero）相当，人工标注录音上的定性评估显示与人工标注高度一致且呼吸检测优于 Silero。
Conclusion: 显式对呼吸事件建模比通用 VAD 更适合呼吸音频分割，BreathGRU 可用于呼吸音频分析与肺部医疗场景。

papers.title: SPADE: Escaping the Popularity-Similarity Frontier to Measure Serendipitous Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems engineer serendipity to foster active exploration and break predictable consumption cycles. The problem with existing offline beyond-accuracy metrics is that they often either isolate historical similarity or global popularity. We aim to design an evaluation metric that examines similarity, popularity, and actual user relevance. To achieve this, we introduce SPADE (Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation). SPADE maps all items into a two-dimensional space to directly calculate a user-specific Pareto frontier of maximally popular and historically similar items. The final serendipity score is then computed by averaging the minimum Euclidean distance from this boundary strictly for the correctly recommended test-set items. Evaluating SPADE across five datasets and five baseline algorithms confirms its effectiveness; our results show that the metric successfully prevents algorithms from exploiting beyond-accuracy measures with irrelevant or non-personalized recommendations, reliably isolating serendipitous discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPADE 把每个用户的历史相似度与全局流行度两个维度上的物品映射到二维空间，直接算出该用户的 Pareto 前沿，再对测试集中被正确推荐的物品取到该边界的最小欧氏距离并平均，得到 serendipity 分数。在五个数据集、五个基线算法上评测，该指标能阻止算法用不相关或非个性化推荐钻 beyond-accuracy 指标的空子，可靠分离出真正的 serendipitous 发现。
Motivation: 现有离线 beyond-accuracy 指标往往只隔离历史相似度或只隔离全局流行度，二者不能同时刻画，导致推荐算法可以用不相关或非个性化的结果刷分。
Method: SPADE（Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation）把物品映射到（历史相似度，流行度）二维空间，逐用户计算最大化流行度与相似度的 Pareto 前沿；serendipity 分数只对测试集中正确推荐的物品，取其到该边界的最小欧氏距离后平均。
Result: 在五个数据集、五个基线算法上评测 SPADE，结果确认其有效性：该指标成功阻止算法用不相关或非个性化推荐利用 beyond-accuracy 度量，并可靠隔离 serendipitous 发现。
Conclusion: 把相似度、流行度与真实用户相关性放进同一个用户级 Pareto 边界距离里，可以在离线评测中同时保留 serendipity 信号并堵住刷分路径。

papers.title: WorldTS: World Modeling for Multimodal Covariate-aware Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting is typically framed as learning a direct mapping from historical to future observations in the observation space. However, sequences of observations generally provide only a partial view of the dynamics of the underlying system, with future observations being shaped by latent dynamics. Recent latent-space forecasting methods thus achieve improved performance by predicting future observations from latent-space representations of historical observations rather than directly forecasting future observations in the observation space. Next, while future observations are also shaped by external factors, how to incorporate external, often multimodal, information into forecasting, so that it can shape latent-state formation and evolution directly, remains underexplored. We propose WorldTS, a world-modeling based forecasting framework that integrates multimodal covariates directly into the forecasting to further improve forecasting performance. Specifically, WorldTS employs a two-stage training strategy. First, it learns forecasting-relevant latent state dynamics conditioned on multimodal covariates, yielding encoded future states. Next, the learned state dynamics are frozen, and an observation decoder is trained to map the predicted future states back to future observations. Extensive experiments on 21 real-world datasets offer insight into WorldTS and its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldTS 把多模态协变量直接注入潜空间世界模型，先在协变量条件下学习与预报相关的潜状态动力学并冻结，再训练观测解码器把预测的未来状态还原为未来观测。在 21 个真实数据集上的实验表明该框架能进一步提升预报性能。
Motivation: 观测序列只反映底层系统的部分动力学，未来观测还受潜在动力学与外部多模态因素共同塑造；现有潜空间预报方法未让外部信息直接参与潜状态的形成与演化。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段在多模态协变量条件下学习与预报相关的潜状态动力学，得到编码的未来状态；第二阶段冻结已学状态动力学，只训练观测解码器将预测的未来状态映射回未来观测。
Result: 在 21 个真实世界数据集上的大量实验给出对 WorldTS 的认识及其有效性证据，摘要未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把多模态协变量直接整合进世界模型式的预报框架可以进一步提升时间序列预报性能，且两阶段冻结策略是其可行训练路径。

papers.title: I Act Therefore I Am: When Is JEPA's Action-Conditioning Enough to Learn Causal Mechanisms?
papers.abstract_en: Recent empirical and theoretical advances suggest that joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) may learn meaningful representations for action-conditioned prediction of future outcomes, thus becoming one of the foundational structures for world models. However, accurate prediction does not, in general, necessarily imply recovery of underlying causal states that give rise to the observed dynamics. This work investigates when and how JEPAs can recover the underlying causal states from observations. We first introduce a latent variable model, in which high-dimensional observations are generated from latent causal states whose dynamics are governed by action-conditioned transition mechanisms. Based on this formulation, we develop a general information-theoretic objective that combines conditional likelihood maximization for learning transition dynamics with entropy maximization for preserving latent state information. We then establish identifiability conditions under which representations learned by this general objective recover the underlying latent causal states up to component-wise invertible transformations and permutation. One key condition for such identifiability is sufficient action-induced variation in the transition mechanisms. Guided by this finding, we instantiate the general objective with an action-modulated Gaussian additive-noise model, yielding action-modulated JEPA (A-JEPA). Experiments on synthetic environments verify the theoretical findings under the identifiability conditions and robustness to moderate violations, while visual benchmarks demonstrate improved state recovery and transfer to unseen transition mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在动作条件 JEPA 中，预测准并不等于恢复了隐因果状态；作者给出一个结合条件似然最大化与熵最大化的通用信息论目标，并证明当转移机制有足够动作诱导变化 (action-induced variation) 时，学到的表示可在分量可逆变换与置换意义下恢复真实隐因果状态。据此实例化出 action-modulated JEPA (A-JEPA)，合成环境验证了可辨识条件成立时的理论结论及中等违反下的稳健性，视觉基准上状态恢复更好并能迁移到未见的转移机制。
Motivation: JEPA 被当作世界模型的基础结构，但准确的动作条件预测一般并不蕴含对产生观测动力学的隐因果状态的恢复，缺少何时能恢复的判据。
Method: 先建立隐变量模型：高维观测由隐因果状态生成，其动力学由动作条件转移机制支配；再提出通用信息论目标，把学习转移动力学的条件似然最大化与保留隐状态信息的熵最大化结合起来；由可辨识条件（关键是转移机制具备充分的动作诱导变化）实例化为动作调制的高斯加性噪声模型，即 A-JEPA。

papers.title: ReG-SAM: Reference Graph-Driven SAM for 2D Foundational Vessel Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Vessel segmentation in medical images is essential for many clinical tasks, ranging from diagnosis to treatment planning. However, it remains challenging due to complex vascular morphology and diverse imaging conditions. Existing deep learning methods rarely aim at building a generalizable vessel segmentor across anatomies and modalities. While the Seg- ment Anything Model (SAM) has shown promise for med- ical image segmentation, its original design does not fully exploit vascular morphology and struggles with fine-grained vascular structures, leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose ReG-SAM, a SAM-based framework tailored to 2D vessel segmentation that leverages reference graph set for enhancing vascular representations. Specifically, we introduce two modality-aware representations derived from the reference masks: graph prompt embeddings (GPEs) that encode global spatial features from graphs, and vascu- lar prototype embeddings (VPEs) that capture fine-grained modality-specific vessel characteristics from multi-scale fea- ture maps and vascular masks. Since both require vascular masks that are unavailable during inference and require robust modality-aware vascular feature representations, we construct a modality-wise vascular database and develop two reference graph-guided representation learning schemes for estimating GPEs and VPEs using samples from the database rather than ground-truth masks. Extensive experiments across 19 datasets demonstrate that ReG-SAM consistently outperforms existing baselines, even those using manual prompts, particularly on challenging thin vessels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReG-SAM 是面向 2D 医学血管分割的 SAM 框架，用参考图集合 (reference graph set) 增强血管表征：从参考掩膜导出图提示嵌入 (GPEs) 与血管原型嵌入 (VPEs)，再用模态化血管数据库和两种参考图引导的表示学习方案在推理时估计二者，替代不可得的真值掩膜。在 19 个数据集上一致优于现有基线，包括使用人工提示的方法，在细小血管上优势尤其明显。
Motivation: 现有深度学习血管分割方法很少追求跨解剖部位与跨模态的通用性；SAM 原始设计未利用血管形态，对细粒度血管结构表现不佳。
Method: 基于 SAM 构建 2D 血管分割框架：由参考掩膜导出两种模态感知表征——GPEs 编码图的全局空间特征，VPEs 从多尺度特征图与血管掩膜捕捉细粒度模态特异血管特征；因推理阶段无真值掩膜，构建模态化血管数据库 (modality-wise vascular database)，并设计两种参考图引导的表示学习方案，用库中样本估计 GPEs 与 VPEs。
Result: 在 19 个数据集上的大量实验中，ReG-SAM 一致优于现有基线（包括使用人工提示的基线），在具有挑战性的细小血管上提升尤为突出。
Conclusion: 用参考图驱动的提示与原型表征替代人工提示和真值掩膜，可让 SAM 在跨解剖、跨模态的 2D 血管分割上取得一致更优表现，尤其是细小血管。

papers.title: Momentum-Guided Federated Split Distillation for Personalized Temporal Edge Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We propose a momentum-guided federated split distillation framework for personalized, efficient, and autonomous temporal edge intelligence. We introduce TeRR-SAtt, our novel temporal reservoir student attention design that combines fixed reservoir representations, a lightweight temporal student, and personalized output modules. We also present AMGF, our anticipatory momentum-guided fusion mechanism that clusters clients through learning momentum and derives specialized teacher updates. On real-world smart-building data, TeRR-SAtt reduces edge training latency by 65.50%, inference latency by 44.70%, training memory usage by 18.40%, and inference CPU usage by 33.10% over the considered baselines. At the same time, AMGF improves local learning by up to 35.31% in RMSE compared to global updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向时序边缘智能的动量引导联邦分裂蒸馏框架：TeRR-SAtt 用固定 reservoir 表示加轻量时序学生网络与个性化输出模块做边缘侧模型，AMGF 按学习动量聚类客户端并派生专门化教师更新。在真实智能楼宇数据上，相对所考虑基线边缘训练延迟降 65.50%、推理延迟降 44.70%、训练内存降 18.40%、推理 CPU 占用降 33.10%，AMGF 相对全局更新最多把本地学习 RMSE 改善 35.31%。
Motivation: 时序边缘智能要在资源受限设备上做个性化学习，直接全局联邦更新会拖累本地精度，而完整模型在边缘的训练与推理开销过高。
Method: 框架由两部分组成：TeRR-SAtt 学生端结合固定 reservoir 表示、轻量时序学生网络与个性化输出模块；AMGF 机制依据学习动量 (learning momentum) 对客户端聚类，并据此派生专门化的教师更新，通过联邦分裂蒸馏下发。
Result: 在真实智能楼宇数据上，相对所考虑基线：边缘训练延迟降低 65.50%，推理延迟降低 44.70%，训练内存占用降低 18.40%，推理 CPU 占用降低 33.10%；AMGF 相对全局更新最多改善本地学习 RMSE 35.31%。
Conclusion: 把个性化学生结构与按动量聚类的教师更新结合，可在智能楼宇时序任务上同时压低边缘开销并提升本地 RMSE，效率与精度不必二选一。

papers.title: Bayesian Tensor Autoencoder with Physics-informed Predictive Prior for Multi-dimensional Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multi-dimensional time series, inherently tensorial, are common in practice. Despite great progress in time series anomaly detection, most existing methods are confined to uni-/multi-variate time series. When handling multi-dimensional time series using these methods, reshaping operations are required, which inevitably break the intrinsic correlations and thus lead to performance degradation. In uni-/multi-variate time series anomaly detection, AutoEncoders (AEs) are widely adopted and generally categorized into reconstruction-based and prediction-based AEs. The reconstruction-based AE utilizes the current observation for reconstruction, while the prediction-based AE utilizes the historical information to predict the current observation. Thus, the two AEs utilize different information. To bridge the gap between reconstruction-based and prediction-based AEs, so as to fully leverage the available information and thus further enhance performance, we propose a predictive prior and incorporate it into the reconstruction-based AE. It may not be very difficult to conceive this idea, but designing the predictive prior so that it can work for tensor anomaly detection is non-trivial. Specifically, to avoid breaking the intrinsic correlations within the multi-dimensional time series, we use the tensor AE as the backbone. To incorporate the predictive prior into the reconstruction-based AE, we propose a Bayesian fusion approach and our analysis reveals that this approach can enhance the modeling capability of the model for normal data. To mitigate the over-generalization problem of AE, we incorporate physical laws, i.e. tensor low-rank decomposition rules, into the neural networks in the predictive prior, leading to the Physics-informed Predictive Prior Tensor AE (PPPTAE) framework. Experimental results on real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPPTAE 把预测式 AE 的历史信息做成重建式 tensor AE 的先验，用 Bayesian fusion 融合，并把 tensor 低秩分解这一物理律嵌入先验网络，以缓解 AE 过泛化。在真实数据集上验证有效，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Motivation: 多维时间序列本质是张量，现有异常检测方法多局限于单/多变量序列，处理时需 reshape，破坏内在相关性并导致性能下降；同时重建式与预测式 AE 各自只用一部分信息。
Method: 以 tensor AutoEncoder 为骨干保持多维相关性；提出 predictive prior 并通过 Bayesian fusion 融入重建式 AE，分析表明该融合增强对正常数据的建模能力；在 predictive prior 的网络中嵌入 tensor 低秩分解规则作为物理律，构成 PPPTAE。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明所提方法有效；摘要未给出具体数据集名称、指标或与基线的数值对比。
Conclusion: 把预测信息作为先验与重建式 tensor AE 融合，并以低秩物理约束抑制过泛化，可提升多维时间序列异常检测效果。

papers.title: Teacher-Anchored Selection of Post-Training Quantized Models under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: Compressing a trained model yields a family of deployment candidates, and under domain shift the most compressed one need not be the one to deploy. We study selection over such a family, with candidates and teacher fixed and target labels absent or scarce. Two findings organize the label-free case. Minimum teacher distortion behaves almost as a constant rule, selecting the same eight-bit, per-channel, unclipped configuration in every run, which does not minimize empirical target cross-entropy. Established estimators divide sharply: in the overconfident-collapse regime of the CNN families, confidence-based estimators order the family close to backwards, and the diagnostics that identify it need the labels the setting denies, while output-distribution estimators match the teacher-relative anchor and on one architecture beat it. Distortion is nonetheless stable, so a supervised term can move selection away from it. Combining the two, we give exact quadratic identities for a canonical quadratic analogue of the family. We also show that under symmetric corruption the label-dependent part of a criterion linear in the label indicator is multiplied by one common factor whenever its coefficient sums are candidate-invariant, a class holding teacher contrasts and accuracy but not cross-entropy. These characterize the score's components without bounding selection regret. Across one hundred and thirty-four candidate families, one per independently trained convolutional or Vision Transformer teacher, anchoring reduces mean regret at the smallest label budget in every setting, an advantage that fades beyond twenty-five labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在目标域标签缺失或极少时，用教师模型作为锚点在量化候选族中选部署模型：最小教师失真近似恒定规则（每次运行都选 8-bit、per-channel、unclipped 配置），置信度类估计器在 CNN 的 overconfident-collapse 体制下几乎把候选族排反，而输出分布类估计器能对齐教师相对锚点、在一种架构上超过它。在 134 个候选族（每个对应独立训练的 CNN 或 ViT 教师）上，锚定选择在最小标签预算下每个设置都降低平均 regret，但超过 25 个标签后优势消失。
Motivation: 模型压缩产生一族部署候选，域偏移下最压缩的未必该部署；候选与教师固定、目标标签缺失或稀缺时，如何从这族里选模型，现有无标签估计器在某些体制下会给出近乎相反的排序。
Method: 研究候选族选择问题，固定候选与教师、目标标签缺失或稀缺；对比最小教师失真规则、置信度类估计器与输出分布类估计器，以教师相对锚点为参照；对族的二次型类比给出精确恒等式，并证明当系数和候选不变时，线性于标签指示的准则中标签相关部分被同一公共因子缩放（涵盖教师对比与 accuracy，不含 cross-entropy）。
Result: 最小教师失真在每次运行都选出同一 8-bit、per-channel、unclipped 配置，但并不最小化经验目标 cross-entropy；CNN 族的 overconfident-collapse 体制下置信度估计器排序接近反向，输出分布估计器对齐教师锚点并在一种架构上超过它。在 134 个候选族上，锚定在最小标签预算下每个设置都降低平均 regret，超过 25 个标签后优势消失。
Conclusion: 教师锚定选择在标签极少时稳健降低 regret，但标签预算超过 25 后不再有优势；这些刻画说明分数各组成部分的性质，但不给出选择 regret 的界。
