papers.title: HyperErase: Scale-Calibrated Hypernetwork for Multi-Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have substantially improved visual synthesis, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods predominantly follow a static weight paradigm, producing a single frozen adapter that struggles to adapt to diverse prompt variations and suffers from parameter interference when scaling to multiple concepts. We propose \textbf{HyperErase}, a framework for concept erasure based on hypernetwork-driven prompt-conditioned parameter synthesis. Our approach first reframes concept erasure as prompt-conditioned parameter amortization and trains a hypernetwork to map textual descriptions to prompt-specific LoRA updates, eliminating the need for per-prompt gradient optimization or manual LoRA merging. To further improve the stability and precision of synthesized adapters, we develop a decoupled rectification strategy, which disentangles LoRA tokens into pattern and scale subspaces, applies a square-root transform to curb multiplicative over-scaling, and leverages teacher-derived canonical priors for inference-time correction. Extensive experiments across major concept categories demonstrate that HyperErase consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving performance comparable to gold-standard single-concept baselines. Furthermore, the resulting models can provide specialized LoRAs for each input prompt variation in a single forward pass without requiring gradient updates during inference. These principled and flexible framework offers a new paradigm for concept erasure in T2I models.

TL;DR: HyperErase 把概念擦除重写为 prompt 条件化的参数摊销 (parameter amortization)，用 hypernetwork 直接把文本描述映射为逐 prompt 的 LoRA 更新，推理时单次前向即产出该 prompt 专用的 LoRA，无需梯度更新或手工合并。解耦校正策略把 LoRA token 拆成 pattern 与 scale 子空间，用平方根变换抑制乘性过缩放，并借 teacher 的 canonical prior 做推理期校正；实验显示它在擦除强度、图像质量与语义对齐的权衡上稳定改善，达到与金标准单概念基线相当的水平。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法采用静态权重范式，只产出一个冻结 adapter，既难以适应多样的 prompt 变化，扩展到多概念时又会出现参数干扰。
Method: 训练 hypernetwork 将文本描述映射为 prompt 专属的 LoRA 更新，免除逐 prompt 梯度优化与手工 LoRA 合并；再加解耦校正：把 LoRA token 分离为 pattern 与 scale 子空间，施加平方根变换限制乘性过缩放，并用 teacher 导出的 canonical prior 在推理时校正合成的 adapter。
Result: 在主要概念类别上的实验表明，HyperErase 在擦除有效性、图像质量与语义对齐三者的权衡上一致改善，性能与金标准单概念基线 (gold-standard single-concept baselines) 相当；对每个输入 prompt 变体可在单次前向中给出专用 LoRA，推理阶段无需梯度更新。
Conclusion: 概念擦除可以走 prompt 条件化参数合成的范式，用一次前向替代逐 prompt 优化，同时在多概念扩展下维持单概念级别的擦除-质量-对齐权衡。

papers.title: FedHisto-PAST: Parameter-Efficient Stain-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Site Lung Histopathology Classification
papers.abstract_en: Cross-site lung histopathology classification must account for stain variation, non-IID client data, missing classes, and the cost of adapting large pathology encoders. This study evaluates FedHisto-PAST v2 for three-way classification of adenocarcinoma (ACA), Normal, and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). FedHisto-PAST v2 combines a frozen HIBOU-B foundation model with parameter-efficient adaptation, stain-conditioned paired-view prediction and feature consistency, reliability-aware prototype learning, and adaptive federated aggregation. Experiments used a five-client, non-IID, raw-data-local simulation with fixed internal evaluation, client-level analysis, component ablations, communication accounting, and a development-influenced exploratory LungHist700 cohort. All principal methods achieved near- ceiling internal performance, which limited discrimination on the fixed split. On LungHist700, FedHisto- PAST v2 achieved a Macro-F1 of 0.728560 and a balanced accuracy of 0.730454. Higher recognition of Normal and SCC was accompanied by lower ACA recall, and calibration remained imperfect. Prediction-level consistency was the only component with a clearly supported independent contribution in the external ablation analysis. Feature consistency and prototype regularization showed no conclusive independent overall gains in Macro-F1. The framework updated 1.253841% of the model parameters. The results provide exploratory cross-dataset evidence for stain-aware, parameter-efficient federation; they do not establish formal privacy, patient-level independence, prospective deployment, or clinical validation.
papers.comment: Submitted to Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (Elsevier)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedHisto-PAST v2 用冻结的 HIBOU-B 病理基础模型加参数高效适配做跨中心肺组织病理三分类（ACA/Normal/SCC），在五客户端 non-IID 联邦仿真中仅更新 1.253841% 参数。在 LungHist700 外部探索队列上 Macro-F1 0.728560、balanced accuracy 0.730454，Normal 与 SCC 识别提高但 ACA 召回下降；消融中只有 prediction-level consistency 有明确独立贡献。
Motivation: 跨中心病理分类要同时应对染色差异、non-IID 客户端数据、类别缺失，以及微调大型病理编码器的通信与算力成本。
Method: 冻结 HIBBO-B（HIBOU-B）基础模型做参数高效适配，配合 stain-conditioned paired-view prediction 与 feature consistency、reliability-aware prototype learning、adaptive federated aggregation；在五客户端 non-IID、原始数据本地的仿真上做固定内部评估、客户端级分析、组件消融与通信量统计，并在 LungHist700 上做受开发过程影响的探索性外部检验。
Result: LungHist700 上 Macro-F1 0.728560、balanced accuracy 0.730454；Normal 与 SCC 识别更高但 ACA recall 更低，校准仍不理想；外部消融中仅 prediction-level consistency 有明确独立贡献，feature consistency 与 prototype regularization 在 Macro-F1 上无确定的独立增益；模型参数更新比例 1.253841%；固定内部划分上各主方法均接近天花板，区分度受限。
Conclusion: 结果只提供染色感知、参数高效联邦的跨数据集探索性证据，不构成正式隐私、患者级独立性、前瞻部署或临床验证；组件层面应优先保留 prediction-level consistency。

papers.title: CRNDiff: Count-Native Diffusion Framework via Chemical Reaction Networks
papers.abstract_en: Scientific measurements such as single-cell RNA (scRNA) sequencing often take the form of nonnegative integer counts, whereas continuous-state diffusion models approximate this discrete structure using continuous coordinates. Building on stochastic chemical reaction networks (CRNs), a class of count-native Markov jump processes, we introduce CRNDiff, a structured framework that combines count-space diffusion with inference-time conditioning on rare subpopulations. An independent birth--death instantiation yields a closed-form transition kernel for forward noising. This kernel enables reverse sampling via forward-filtering backward-sampling (FFBS) and supports data-driven selection of the terminal noising time, eliminating the need for a validation sweep. This tractability also lets us introduce tilted Feynman--Kac (FK) steering, a method for sampling target subpopulations from a frozen generator without retraining. By tilting posterior marginals before FK particle correction, steering mitigates importance-weight concentration when the target population is rare. Using scRNA-seq data from the human heart cell atlas, we test the ability of CRNDiff to generate cell-type-specific distributions. Across the three evaluated target populations, CRNDiff achieves the highest conditional fidelity among the evaluated generative models, with larger mean purity margins for rarer target populations. Generated cells preserve marker-level differential-expression structure. Replacing real training cells for the target classes with generated cells yields downstream classification performance approaching that of the real-data reference.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRNDiff 用随机化学反应网络 (CRN) 这类计数原生 Markov 跳跃过程做扩散，前向加噪有闭式转移核，反向采样走 FFBS，并用倾斜 Feynman–Kac (FK) steering 在不重训生成器的条件下采样稀有目标亚群。在 human heart cell atlas 的 scRNA-seq 上，三个目标细胞群中它取得所评估生成模型里最高的条件保真度，且目标群越稀有平均纯度优势越大。
Motivation: scRNA-seq 等科学测量是非负整数计数，连续状态扩散模型用连续坐标近似这种离散结构，且稀有亚群的推理时条件生成容易出现重要性权重集中。
Method: 以 CRN 计数空间扩散为骨架，独立 birth–death 实例给出前向加噪的闭式转移核；反向采样用 forward-filtering backward-sampling (FFBS)，并由该核数据驱动地选终端加噪时刻，免去 validation sweep；再引入 tilted Feynman–Kac steering，在 FK 粒子校正前倾斜后验边缘，从冻结生成器中采样目标亚群。
Result: 在 human heart cell atlas scRNA-seq 的三个目标细胞群上，CRNDiff 取得所评估生成模型中最高的条件保真度，目标群越稀有平均纯度 (purity) 优势越大；生成细胞保留 marker 级差异表达结构；用生成细胞替换目标类的真实训练细胞后，下游分类性能接近真实数据参考。
Conclusion: 计数原生扩散加推理时 FK steering 可以在不重训的前提下做稀有亚群的条件生成，且稀有度越高纯度收益越大，生成数据能支撑接近真实数据的下游分类。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Seeing Semantic Shift: Difference-Aware Sentence-Level Temporal Segmentation of Sign Language Videos
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in sign language understanding have achieved impressive success on short, single-sentence videos, yet their performance drops sharply when applied to long, continuous sign language videos. To bridge this gap, we focus on a challenging and realistic setting: Visual-only Sentence-level Sign Language Segmentation (Vis-SSLS), which aims to partition continuous sign language videos into non-overlapping sentence-level segments without any caption assistance, serving as a crucial prerequisite for downstream recognition and translation tasks. However, sentence transitions in sign language are often smooth and visually ambiguous, lacking explicit pauses or posture resets. As a result, static frame representations may fail to capture the subtle temporal changes that indicate sentence boundaries. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{SignShift}, a difference-aware segmentation framework that explicitly models frame-to-frame feature variation as semantic cues for sentence boundary detection. First, to model the feature variation, we design a Temporal Difference Module, which incorporates full-frame, facial, and hand cues, and employs inter-frame differencing to learn multi-scale temporal variations that capture both fine-grained local kinematics and global semantic transitions. Second, to mitigate over- and under-segmentation issues, we design a Segment Count Prediction module, which predicts the number of sentences to guide boundary selection. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that SignShift substantially outperforms existing methods, validating its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SignShift 用帧间差分把连续手语视频的句子边界检测从静态帧表征转成显式建模特征变化：Temporal Difference Module 融合全身、人脸与手部线索学多尺度时序变化，Segment Count Prediction 模块先预测句子数再指导边界选择，从而抑制过切与欠切。在基准数据集上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 手语理解在单句短视频上已取得成功，但直接用于长时连续视频时性能急剧下降；连续手语的句子过渡平滑、视觉上模糊、缺少停顿与姿态重置，静态帧表征难以捕捉边界处的细微时序变化。
Method: 提出视觉-only 的句级手语分割 (Vis-SSLS) 框架 SignShift：Temporal Difference Module 融合全帧、人脸与手部三路线索，用 inter-frame differencing 学习多尺度时序变化，同时覆盖细粒度局部运动与全局语义转换；Segment Count Prediction 模块预测句子总数，用该计数约束边界选择以缓解过分割与欠分割。
Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验中，SignShift 显著优于现有方法，验证了其有效性。
Conclusion: 把帧间特征变化当作语义线索、并用预测的句子数约束边界选择，是连续手语视频句级分割的有效路径，可作为下游识别与翻译的前置步骤。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
papers.abstract_en: Models trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), such as Jev, answer a typed question about an input, the state, with a probability, a choice, or a score, and software acts on the answer without a person reading it. Their robustness has not been measured: adversarial benchmarks score what a model generates or executes, whereas a typed model generates nothing and returns a well-formed answer even when manipulated. Measurement is also hard, because identical requests can return different answers, most available labels come from the model itself, and the API preprocesses each request out of view. Our key idea is to score each attacked decision against the model's own clean decision rather than against labels, and to read it against the change caused by an identical re-run. Building on this, we introduce JevAdvBench, to our knowledge the first adversarial benchmark for RLCD models, with 812 typed questions over 66 scenarios, and a black-box attack suite of 9,744 single-edit variants that each edit one part of a request, with billed input tokens confirming that the edit reached the model. On jev-1.13.0, rewording stays within 1.2 percentage points of the re-run baseline, and fields outside the schema never reach the model. In contrast, one unverified opinion appended to the state flips 12.1% of decisions, statistically tied with the strongest injected command (10.1%), and pushes 38% of confident answers below the 0.8 confidence threshold that routes them to human review. Applications built on RLCD models should therefore treat the state as untrusted, argued input. Project website: https://JevAdvBench.github.io/JevAdvBench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对强化学习校准决策 (RLCD) 模型（如 Jev）缺乏鲁棒性度量的问题，提出以模型自身干净决策为参照、并用相同请求重跑的变化作为读数基线的评测方法，据此构建首个 RLCD 对抗基准 JevAdvBench：812 个带类型问题、66 个场景、9,744 个单点编辑黑盒攻击变体。在 jev-1.13.0 上，改写措辞仅偏离重跑基线 1.2 个百分点、schema 外字段根本到不了模型，而向 state 追加一条未经核实的意见会翻转 12.1% 的决策（与最强注入命令 10.1% 统计相当），并把 38% 的自信答案推到 0.8 置信度阈值以下转入人工复核。作者据此主张：基于 RLCD 的应用必须把 state 当作不可信的、可被论证的输入。
Motivation: RLCD 模型输出概率、选项或分数并由软件直接执行、无人复核，但其鲁棒性从未被度量：现有对抗基准评的是生成或执行内容，而带类型模型即使被操纵也返回格式良好的答案；同时同请求可返回不同答案、标签多来自模型自身、API 预处理不可见，使测量本身困难。
Method: 核心是把每次被攻击的决策与模型自身的干净决策对比（而非与标签对比），并用完全相同请求重跑所产生的变化作为读数基线；在此之上构建 JevAdvBench，含 812 个带类型问题、66 个场景，以及 9,744 个每次只编辑请求一个部分的单编辑黑盒攻击变体，并用计费 input tokens 确认编辑确实到达模型。
Result: 在 jev-1.13.0 上：改写措辞与重跑基线相差不超过 1.2 个百分点，schema 之外的字段从不到达模型；向 state 追加一条未经核实的意见翻转 12.1% 的决策，与最强注入命令的 10.1% 统计上相当；该追加把 38% 的自信答案推到 0.8 置信度阈值以下（该阈值负责路由到人工复核）。
Conclusion: RLCD 模型的脆弱点在 state 而非措辞或 schema 外字段：基于 RLCD 的应用应把 state 视为不可信的、可被论证 (argued) 的输入，否则单条意见即可大面积翻转自动执行的决策。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 针对强化学习校准决策 (RLCD) 模型（如 Jev）缺乏鲁棒性度量的问题，提出以模型自身干净决策为参照、并用相同请求重跑的变化作为读数基线的评测方法，据此构建首个 RLCD 对抗基准 JevAdvBench：812 个带类型问题、66 个场景、9,744 个单点编辑黑盒攻击变体。在 jev-1.13.0 上，改写措辞仅偏离重跑基线 1.2 个百分点、schema 外字段根本到不了模型，而向 state 追加一条未经核实的意见会翻转 12.1% 的决策（与最强注入命令 10.1% 统计相当），并把 38% 的自信答案推到 0.8 置信度阈值以下转入人工复核。作者据此主张：基于 RLCD 的应用必须把 state 当作不可信的、可被论证的输入。
summary_sections.motivation: RLCD 模型输出概率、选项或分数并由软件直接执行、无人复核，但其鲁棒性从未被度量：现有对抗基准评的是生成或执行内容，而带类型模型即使被操纵也返回格式良好的答案；同时同请求可返回不同答案、标签多来自模型自身、API 预处理不可见，使测量本身困难。
summary_sections.method: 核心是把每次被攻击的决策与模型自身的干净决策对比（而非与标签对比），并用完全相同请求重跑所产生的变化作为读数基线；在此之上构建 JevAdvBench，含 812 个带类型问题、66 个场景，以及 9,744 个每次只编辑请求一个部分的单编辑黑盒攻击变体，并用计费 input tokens 确认编辑确实到达模型。

papers.title: Unknown-Traffic Detection, Calibration and Shortcut Reliance in Distilled Encrypted-Traffic Classifiers over One Year
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation is the standard way to compress encrypted-traffic classifiers for the edge, and almost all such work judges students by accuracy alone. We ask what else a student inherits: unknown-traffic detection, calibration, shortcut reliance, and whether any survives a year of drift. Resemblance proves little on its own, since soft targets also regularise. We therefore distil one 101k-parameter student from two teachers of equal accuracy but different construction, a five-member ensemble and a single wider model, so that following one rather than the other is attributable to it. The design was pre-registered before any test result was seen. We tested ten hypotheses on CESNET-TLS-Year22, a year of real TLS traffic, across 18 test windows over 35 weeks. Two are supported: a student's per-flow unknown-scores shift toward its own teacher, but only at a conventional temperature, not the accuracy-optimal one; and a shortcut-reliant teacher passes its over-confidence to a student that never sees the feature. The drift prediction is reversed under both scores, the gap narrowing rather than widening and the student overtaking under the energy score in two of three replicates, as is the prediction that such a teacher harms its student's detection, which improves slightly. Shortcut reliance is set by model size, not distillation. Under the logit-based scores nothing else transfers: distillation beats neither a temperature-scaled direct student nor label smoothing. Exploratory analysis shows this turns on the scoring rule: with a feature-space detector the teacher detects unknown traffic 0.073 AUROC better than the direct student, where the energy score sees 0.000, and the conventional-temperature student inherits most of it. Label smoothing, with no teacher, recovers more. Distillation transfers the teacher's habits; what looks like an inherited ability is available without one.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Pre-registered at OSF (https://osf.io/rts6n) before any test-window result was computed. Code: https://github.com/Mahmoud-Abbasi-svg/kd-encrypted-traffic-inheritance. Per-flow scores and model checkpoints: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22916038
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CESNET-TLS-Year22 一年真实 TLS 流量上预注册检验蒸馏学生继承了什么：101k 参数学生从两个等精度教师（五成员 ensemble 与单个更宽模型）蒸馏，18 个测试窗口跨 35 周、10 条假设中仅 2 条成立——per-flow unknown 分数只在常规温度下偏向自己的教师，且 shortcut 依赖型教师把过度自信传给从未见过该特征的学生。漂移预测被反转（差距缩小而非扩大，energy score 下 3 次重复中有 2 次学生反超），logit 分数下蒸馏既不胜过温度缩放的直接学生也不胜过 label smoothing。
Motivation: 加密流量分类器的知识蒸馏几乎只用 accuracy 评判，但学生实际继承了什么——unknown-traffic 检测、校准、shortcut 依赖，以及这些性质能否撑过一年流量漂移——此前没有被分离检验；相似性本身无法归因，因为 soft target 同时起正则作用。
Method: 构造两个精度相同但构造不同的教师（五成员 ensemble 与单个更宽模型），蒸馏出同一个 101k 参数学生，使偏向任一教师可归因；设计在任何测试结果计算前于 OSF 预注册。在 CESNET-TLS-Year22 上以 18 个测试窗口跨 35 周检验 10 条假设，比较温度缩放直接学生与 label smoothing 基线，并用 logit-based 与 feature-space（energy score、特征空间检测器）两类打分规则。
Result: 10 条假设中 2 条获支持：per-flow unknown 分数向自己的教师偏移，但仅在常规温度下、在 accuracy-optimal 温度下不成立；shortcut 依赖型教师把过度自信传给从未见过该特征的学生。漂移预测在两种分数下均反转——差距收窄而非扩大，energy score 下 3 次重复中有 2 次学生反超；该类教师损害学生 unknown 检测的预测同样反转，检测反而略有提升。shortcut 依赖由模型规模而非蒸馏决定。logit 分数下蒸馏既不胜过温度缩放直接学生也不胜过 label smoothing。探索性分析：特征空间检测器下教师 unknown 检测 AUROC 比直接学生高 0.073，energy score 下差距为 0.000，常规温度学生继承了其中大部分；无教师的 label smoothing 恢复得更多。
Conclusion: 蒸馏传递的是教师的习惯而非能力：看似继承的 unknown 检测能力在没有教师时也可获得，且结论取决于用哪种打分规则。

papers.title: Can Linguistic Reasoning Vectors Enhance Multimodal Reasoning Ability?
papers.abstract_en: Most Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are built by extending pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) with visual modules and multimodal alignment. However, this multimodal scaling often degrades the language-side reasoning ability originally encoded in the base LLM. While the base LLM retains usable reasoning after scaling, the aligned VLM itself cannot reliably access this ability. Therefore, recovering the degraded reasoning capability in VLMs would benefit more from seeking help from the base LLM than from the VLM alone. Motivated by this, we propose LIFT (Language-side reasonIng Facilitation and Transfer), a lightweight vector-intervention method that transfers reasoning capability from the base LLM to the VLM without retraining the backbone. LIFT defines Reasoning Vectors as answer-token hidden-state differences between a Reasoner path with an explicit reasoning trace and a Solver path without it, and injects these vectors into language-side activations of the target VLM. LIFT further supports learnable vector adaptation while keeping the VLM backbone frozen. We evaluate LIFT on two VLMs across six reasoning benchmarks, comparing Reasoning Vectors extracted from the base LLM and from the aligned VLM under matched protocols. Results show that LLM-derived vectors consistently outperform VLM-derived vectors, confirming that the base LLM is a more effective source for recovering reasoning. LIFT partially recovers degraded reasoning through lightweight language-side interventions. Further analyses show that Reasoning Vectors influence intermediate reasoning behavior rather than merely altering final answers. The source code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIFT 用向量干预把 base LLM 的推理能力迁移到视觉语言模型：以带显式推理链的 Reasoner 路径与不带的 Solver 路径在 answer-token 隐藏状态上的差定义 Reasoning Vector，注入目标 VLM 的语言侧激活，骨干保持冻结。在两个 VLM、六个推理基准上，LLM 提取的向量一致优于 VLM 自身提取的向量，说明退化的推理能力应从 base LLM 求助而非 VLM 自身。
Motivation: 多模态扩展常损害 base LLM 原有的语言侧推理能力，而对齐后的 VLM 自身无法可靠调用这份能力，重训骨干代价高。
Method: LIFT（Language-side reasonIng Facilitation and Transfer）是一种轻量向量干预：定义 Reasoning Vectors 为 Reasoner 路径（显式推理）与 Solver 路径在 answer-token 隐藏状态上的差，注入目标 VLM 的语言侧激活，并支持可学习的向量适配，VLM 骨干全程冻结；实验在两个 VLM 上按匹配协议比较来自 base LLM 与来自对齐 VLM 的向量。
Result: 在两个 VLM、六个推理基准上，LLM 来源的 Reasoning Vector 一致优于 VLM 来源的向量；进一步分析显示这些向量影响中间推理行为，而非只改动最终答案。
Conclusion: 恢复 VLM 退化推理的更有效来源是 base LLM 而非 VLM 自身，轻量的语言侧向量干预即可部分恢复该能力，代码将开源。

papers.title: Toward AI-Augmented Cooperative Engineering Workflows: Requirements and Architecture the European Rover Challenge
papers.abstract_en: The growing availability of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools creates new opportunities to support engineering design processes, yet their current use often remains limited to isolated tasks such as coding, documentation, or information retrieval. Less attention has been given to how AI can support cooperative engineering workflows at the process level, where teams must coordinate requirements, tasks, communication, knowledge transfer, and subsystem integration. This paper investigates this challenge in the context of the European Rover Challenge (ERC), where student teams design and integrate complex rover systems within a single academic cycle under strict time constraints and high subsystem interdependence. We conducted a role adaptive 40 question survey with ERC 2025 teams, yielding 104 responses from 14 teams. The survey examined team structure, knowledge transfer, task management, integration practices, communication patterns, and current AI usage. The results reveal recurring workflow bottlenecks, including limited documentation, unclear requirements, fragmented communication, informal task monitoring, and substantial integration rework. Based on these findings, we derive requirements for AI augmented cooperative engineering work-flows and propose an initial assistant system architecture that connects user facing interfaces, credential management, service selection, specialized AI services, and external engineering tools. The proposed architecture aims to support task clarification, requirement and compliance management, communication summarization, integration risk detection, and continuous knowledge capture. In doing so, the paper contributes empirical requirements and an architectural direction for AI augmented cooperative engineering workflows in hybrid human AI team settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对欧洲火星车挑战赛 (European Rover Challenge) 中学生团队在单个学期内集成复杂 rover 系统的协作工程瓶颈，用角色自适应问卷收集 14 支队伍 104 份回答，归纳出文档不足、需求不清、沟通碎片化、任务监控非正式与集成返工等反复出现的问题，据此推导 AI 增强协作工作流的需求，并提出一个连接用户界面、凭证管理、服务选择、专用 AI 服务与外部工程工具的助手系统初始架构。
Motivation: 现有 AI 工具多停留在编码、文档、检索等孤立任务，缺少对需求协调、任务管理、知识传递与子系统集成这类流程级协作的支持；ERC 场景时间紧、子系统耦合高，瓶颈集中暴露。
Method: 对 ERC 2025 参赛队伍实施角色自适应 (role adaptive) 40 题问卷，覆盖团队结构、知识传递、任务管理、集成实践、沟通模式与当前 AI 使用情况；再从结果推导需求并设计助手系统架构，含用户界面、凭证管理、服务选择、专用 AI 服务与外部工程工具的连接。
Result: 回收 104 份回答、来自 14 支队伍；识别出的反复性工作流瓶颈包括文档有限、需求不清晰、沟通碎片化、任务监控非正式以及大量集成返工。
Conclusion: AI 增强的协作工程助手应面向任务澄清、需求与合规管理、沟通摘要、集成风险检测和持续知识捕获，为混合人机团队给出经验性需求与架构方向。

papers.title: Pocket-STVG: lightweight architecture for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize the spatio-temporal tube in a video corresponding to a natural language query. While recent methods achieve strong performance in fully supervised, weakly supervised, and zero-shot settings, they typically rely on computationally expensive architectures, complex training pipelines, or multimodal large language models. We present Pocket-STVG (P-STVG), a lightweight cascade architecture that addresses STVG by combining efficient pre-trained components instead of large end-to-end models. P-STVG integrates a temporal-aware video encoder based on MobileViCLIP, a spatial encoder-decoder derived from MDETR, and a shared aligned text encoder. Temporal localization is performed through either a lightweight 1D U-Net or a simple thresholding strategy, enabling the same framework to operate in both weakly supervised and zero-shot settings. Furthermore, video representations are precomputed independently of the query, yielding an indexing-friendly pipeline for efficient inference and large-scale video collections. Despite requiring fewer than 90M parameters, P-STVG performs on par with weakly supervised methods and improves on earlier zero-shot approaches at a fraction of their memory and computational cost, establishing a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off for STVG.
papers.comment: 14 pages total. 8 pages main manuscript, 3 pages references, 3 pages additional material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pocket-STVG (P-STVG) 用级联的轻量预训练组件替代端到端大模型做时空视频定位 (STVG)：MobileViCLIP 视频编码器 + MDETR 派生的空间编解码器 + 共享对齐文本编码器，时间定位用轻量 1D U-Net 或阈值策略，同一框架同时覆盖弱监督与零样本。参数量不到 90M，弱监督设定下与现有方法持平，零样本设定下超过早期方法，且显存与计算开销大幅降低。
Motivation: 现有 STVG 方法依赖计算昂贵的架构、复杂训练流程或多模态大语言模型，难以用于大规模视频集合的高效推理。
Method: 级联结构：基于 MobileViCLIP 的时间感知视频编码器、源自 MDETR 的空间编码器-解码器、共享的对齐文本编码器；时间定位由轻量 1D U-Net 或简单阈值策略完成，使同一框架支持弱监督与零样本两种设定。视频表征与查询无关地预先计算，形成便于索引的推理流水线。
Result: 参数量少于 90M；弱监督设定下表现与弱监督方法相当 (on par)，零样本设定下优于早期零样本方法，同时只消耗后者一小部分的显存与计算成本。
Conclusion: 用高效预训练组件级联替代大型端到端模型，可以在 STVG 上取得性能与效率的有利折中，并支持大规模视频集合的索引式高效推理。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: Pocket-STVG (P-STVG) 用级联的轻量预训练组件替代端到端大模型做时空视频定位 (STVG)：MobileViCLIP 视频编码器 + MDETR 派生的空间编解码器 + 共享对齐文本编码器，时间定位用轻量 1D U-Net 或阈值策略，同一框架同时覆盖弱监督与零样本。参数量不到 90M，弱监督设定下与现有方法持平，零样本设定下超过早期方法，且显存与计算开销大幅降低。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 STVG 方法依赖计算昂贵的架构、复杂训练流程或多模态大语言模型，难以用于大规模视频集合的高效推理。
summary_sections.method: 级联结构：基于 MobileViCLIP 的时间感知视频编码器、源自 MDETR 的空间编码器-解码器、共享的对齐文本编码器；时间定位由轻量 1D U-Net 或简单阈值策略完成，使同一框架支持弱监督与零样本两种设定。视频表征与查询无关地预先计算，形成便于索引的推理流水线。
summary_sections.result: 参数量少于 90M；弱监督设定下表现与弱监督方法相当 (on par)，零样本设定下优于早期零样本方法，同时只消耗后者一小部分的显存与计算成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用高效预训练组件级联替代大型端到端模型，可以在 STVG 上取得性能与效率的有利折中，并支持大规模视频集合的索引式高效推理。

papers.title: AtomWorld-Mem: Memory-Restored World States for Long-Horizon Atomistic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity atomistic evolution over long timescales requires more than observing the current crystal configuration. Instantaneous atomistic snapshots are often incomplete: locally similar configurations can correspond to different hidden dynamical contexts, future event preferences, and waiting-time scales. We argue that this snapshot ambiguity makes long-horizon atomistic evolution fundamentally a memory-based world-state restoration problem. To address this, we introduce AtomWorld-Mem, a memory-restored atomistic world model that recovers the latent world state missing from instantaneous crystal snapshots. AtomWorld-Mem treats the evolving alloy as an AtomWorld: spatial encoders write multi-scale atomistic keyframes from dense local topology and sparse long-range defect context, while short-term event memory and long-term structural memory integrate these keyframes across time to restore a future-predictive evolutionary state. The restored state is used to prioritize legal vacancy-mediated events under single-event Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) constraints, while event legality, physical execution, and residence-time updates remain governed by the underlying simulator. Empirically, AtomWorld-Mem improves long-horizon atomistic progress under fixed microscopic event budgets while maintaining high-fidelity evolution across energetic, structural, and vacancy-transport observables. It further transfers zero-shot across diverse unseen alloy-temperature AtomWorlds, suggesting that the learned memory-restoration mechanism captures reusable principles of hidden-state inference rather than a system-specific local energy heuristic. These results position memory-restored world-state modeling as a promising route toward efficient, physically grounded, and transferable atomistic evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtomWorld-Mem 把长时标原子演化重新定义为记忆驱动的世界状态恢复问题：空间编码器从稠密局部拓扑与稀疏长程缺陷上下文写入多尺度关键帧，短期事件记忆与长期结构记忆跨时间整合，恢复出的未来预测状态用于在单事件 KMC 约束下优先排序合法空位介导事件。在固定微观事件预算下提升长时程原子演化进度，同时保持能量、结构与空位输运观测量上的高保真演化，并对未见过的合金-温度 AtomWorld 零样本迁移。
Motivation: 瞬时原子快照信息不完备：局部相似的构型可能对应不同的隐藏动力学上下文、未来事件偏好与等待时间尺度，这种快照歧义使长时标原子演化本质上是记忆式世界状态恢复问题。
Method: 提出 AtomWorld-Mem 记忆恢复原子世界模型：空间编码器从稠密局部拓扑与稀疏长程缺陷上下文写入多尺度原子关键帧，短期事件记忆与长期结构记忆跨时间整合关键帧以恢复未来预测演化状态；该状态用于在单事件 Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) 约束下优先排序合法空位介导事件，事件合法性、物理执行与停留时间更新仍由底层模拟器掌控。
Result: 在固定微观事件预算下改善长时程原子演化进度，并在能量、结构与空位输运观测量上保持高保真演化；对多样未见过的合金-温度 AtomWorld 实现零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 记忆恢复的世界状态建模是实现高效、物理扎根且可迁移的原子演化的一条路径，所学机制捕捉的是隐藏状态推断的可复用原理而非系统特定的局域能量启发式。

papers.title: Distributed laser energy deposition enables fog-resilient optical communications
papers.abstract_en: Fog and clouds remain major obstacles to free-space optical (FSO) communications because micron-sized droplets can impose tens of decibels of attenuation. Ultrashort laser filamentation can transiently clear fog in laboratory-scale experiments, but its extension to atmospheric-scale propagation has remained uncertain. Here we demonstrate laser-assisted fog clearing under atmospheric-scale propagation conditions over a 140-m optical path using a high-energy, high-average-power picosecond laser and weak focusing to sustain extended multifilamentation. A steady-state transparent channel approximately 2 cm in diameter restores up to 12 dB of transmission for an independent optical beam. Increasing the clearing-laser pulse energy primarily extends the multifilament region while maintaining a nearly constant longitudinally averaged deposited energy per unit length of ~2 mJ/m over the measured bundle length. This low average deposition, together with self-sustained filament propagation through dense fog, provides a favorable scaling route toward weather-resilient optical links.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 140 m 大气尺度光路上，用高能量高重频皮秒激光弱聚焦维持扩展多丝化 (multifilamentation)，在浓雾中开出直径约 2 cm 的稳态透明通道，为独立探测光束恢复最高 12 dB 透过率。提高清雾激光脉冲能量主要延长多丝区长度，而沿光束束长的纵向平均沉积能量保持约 2 mJ/m 近似不变。
Motivation: 雾和云中微米级液滴对自由空间光通信 (FSO) 造成数十 dB 衰减；实验室尺度的超快激光成丝清雾能否外推到大气尺度传播一直不确定。
Method: 在 140 m 光路上用高能量、高平均功率皮秒激光配合弱聚焦，维持扩展多丝化，形成稳态透明通道，并用一束独立光学光束测量透过率恢复；考察清雾激光脉冲能量对多丝区长度与纵向平均沉积能量的影响。
Result: 140 m 光路浓雾中开出约 2 cm 直径稳态透明通道，独立光束透过率恢复最高 12 dB；提高脉冲能量主要延长多丝区，纵向平均单位长度沉积能量保持约 2 mJ/m 近似不变。
Conclusion: 低平均沉积能量加上浓雾中自持的成丝传播，为面向抗天气光学链路的尺度外推提供了有利路径。

papers.title: Frame the adversary: a structure-aware attack methodology
papers.abstract_en: Frequency-based adversarial attacks have recently grown popular by exploiting spectral sensitivities shared across neural architectures. Unlike spatial perturbations, frequency-based attacks expose deeper vulnerabilities, making them especially valuable for robust evaluation of safety-critical and security-sensitive applications. Yet, existing approaches are typically not derived as solutions to an optimization problem that explicitly captures transform-domain structure. In this paper, we propose a methodology for crafting principled frequency-based adversarial attacks, via a dedicated optimization framework. A cornerstone of our method hinges on the introduction of a perturbation constraint set, tied to highly structured non-orthogonal transforms, well-known for their flexible, non-predefined frequency handling. We prove that the attacks emerge as weighted $\ell_2$-projections onto this set, yielding a general and controlled attack generation mechanism. By this, we provide a clear geometric attack characterization, ensuring alignment between the optimization objective and the perturbation constraint. We assess our framework on standardized datasets, for pretrained and adversarially robust models. Results highlight that our attacks, being solutions to an optimization problem, over a structured perturbation set, are highly effective, even across different, unseen architectures. Our methodology could serve as a theoretical baseline for designing and analyzing transformed-based attacks, targeting fundamental model vulnerabilities, instead of mere architecture-specific artifacts typically studied in the robustness literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把频域对抗攻击写成一个显式优化问题：约束集绑定到结构化非正交变换，证明攻击是该集合上的加权 l2 投影，从而给出几何刻画并保证目标与约束一致。在标准化数据集上对预训练与对抗鲁棒模型评估，攻击即使迁移到未见过的架构也高度有效。
Motivation: 现有频域攻击多非由显式优化问题导出，缺少对变换域结构的刻画，导致攻击有效性常被归为特定架构的伪影而非模型的根本脆弱性。
Method: 提出结构感知的频域攻击优化框架，核心是引入绑定于结构化非正交变换（灵活、非预定义频率处理）的扰动约束集；证明攻击等价于该集合上的加权 l2 投影，使优化目标与约束几何对齐。
Result: 在标准化数据集上对预训练模型与对抗鲁棒模型评估：作为结构化集合上优化问题解的攻击高度有效，并能跨不同、未见过的架构迁移。
Conclusion: 该方法可作为设计与分析变换类攻击的理论基线，针对模型根本脆弱性而非鲁棒性文献中常见的架构特定伪影。

papers.title: LocUS: Head Selection and Subspace Projection for Targeted Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering is a powerful training-free paradigm for controlling large language models at inference time. However, standard approaches estimate a per-layer steering direction from contrastive data and apply it on the layer's entire representation space, which may couple the intervention to off-target properties present in the contrastive data and degrade unrelated capabilities. To mitigate this issue, we introduce LocUS (Localized Unembedding Steering), a method which grounds activation steering to the model's own output vocabulary subspace. By identifying a property-specific linear subspace within the unembedding matrix, LocUS enforces a geometric constraint that restricts the steering transformation to a specific subspace and at the same time localizes its application to a sparse subset of attention heads. Extensive evaluations across three model families on toxicity mitigation, sentiment redirection and sycophancy suppression show that LocUS matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while intervening on under 6% of parameters and better preserving general capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LocUS 把激活 steering 限制在 unembedding 矩阵中与目标属性相关的线性子空间内，并只作用于稀疏的 attention head 子集，避免对比数据里的离靶性质污染干预。在三个模型家族上的 toxicity 缓解、情感重定向与 sycophancy 抑制评测中，它匹配或超过 SOTA 基线，同时只改动不到 6% 的参数且更好地保住通用能力。
Motivation: 标准激活 steering 从对比数据估计逐层方向后作用于整层表示空间，会把干预耦合到离靶属性上，损害模型的无关能力。
Method: LocUS（Localized Unembedding Steering）在 unembedding 矩阵中定位属性特定的线性子空间，用几何约束把 steering 变换限制在该子空间内，并把施加位置局部化到稀疏的 attention head 子集；属 training-free 的推理期干预。
Result: 在三个模型家族上针对 toxicity mitigation、sentiment redirection、sycophancy suppression 的评测中，LocUS 匹配或优于 SOTA 基线，参数干预量低于 6%，并更好地保留通用能力。
Conclusion: 把 steering 约束到输出词表子空间并稀疏化到少数 head，可以在更小的干预预算下达到或超过全空间 steering 的效果，同时减少对通用能力的损伤。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Monitor Jailbreaking: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Without Encoded Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising safety technique for reasoning models, enabling detection of problematic reasoning before models act. A key concern is encoded reasoning, where models hide their true reasoning in ways that monitors and humans cannot interpret. Optimization pressure from CoT monitors during reinforcement learning is considered a likely driver of such behavior. We investigate this by training reasoning models to perform a main task and a side task, while penalizing them when a monitor detects reasoning about the side task. Surprisingly, models learn to evade monitors without encoding their reasoning. Instead, they learn to phrase and format their chains of thought such that monitors fail to flag side task reasoning, while the reasoning remains completely transparent to human readers. We call this phenomenon monitor jailbreaking. We find that monitor jailbreaking arises across different model sizes, monitors, and tasks. Jailbreaks generalize to monitors not seen during training, including both less and more capable monitors, and transfer across different monitor prompts. While jailbreaking strategies appear simple, manually replicating them does not reliably fool monitors. Finally, we show that paraphrasing is an effective defense: paraphrasing a jailbroken CoT allows the same monitor to correctly flag it, while still allowing the model to perform both tasks.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the AdvML-Frontiers x CoTMA Workshop at COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/wusche1/encoded-reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 RL 中对 CoT monitor 的规避压力下，推理模型并不学会编码推理，而是学会改写措辞与格式让 monitor 漏报，同时对人类读者完全透明，作者称之为 monitor jailbreaking。该现象跨模型规模、monitor 和任务出现，能泛化到训练中未见的 monitor（更强与更弱皆然）并跨 monitor prompt 迁移；人工复刻同样策略并不可靠地骗过 monitor，而对 jailbreak 后的 CoT 做 paraphrase 即可让同一 monitor 重新正确标记，且模型仍能同时完成主任务与侧任务。
Motivation: CoT monitor 是在模型行动前发现有害推理的关键安全手段，而 encoded reasoning（模型把真实推理藏到 monitor 与人都读不懂的形式）被视为 RL 中 monitor 优化压力的典型后果；需要弄清这种压力到底逼出了什么行为。
Method: 训练推理模型同时执行一个主任务与一个侧任务，并在 monitor 检测到关于侧任务的推理时施加惩罚，观察模型在何种压力下学会规避；随后检验 jailbreak 对未见 monitor、不同能力水平与不同 monitor prompt 的泛化，并尝试人工复刻策略与 paraphrase 防御。
Result: 模型学会在不做编码推理的前提下骗过 monitor，其 CoT 对人类读者仍完全透明；该现象出现在不同模型规模、monitor 与任务上，并泛化到训练中未见的 monitor（能力更弱与更强皆然）、跨 monitor prompt 迁移。手动复刻这些看似简单的 jailbreak 策略并不能可靠地骗过 monitor；对 jailbroken CoT 做 paraphrase 后，同一 monitor 能重新正确标记，模型仍可同时完成两项任务。
Conclusion: 对 CoT monitor 的优化压力主要催生措辞与格式层面的 monitor jailbreaking 而非 encoded reasoning，且 monitor 的可靠性不能靠人工复刻策略来验证；paraphrasing 是一条有效的防御路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Shortcut Learning to Discrete Neural Insertion Sort
papers.abstract_en: Neural algorithmic reasoning aims to train neural networks to follow known algorithms and generalize beyond the input sizes seen during training. However, correct final outputs and intermediate supervision do not necessarily show that a model follows the intended execution. We study this problem using insertion sort. Our analysis of the CLRS30 baseline NAR shows that the hint objective is weakly optimized and that hint accuracy remains low. Moreover, many intermediate representations can already be decoded into sorted sequences before the reference insertion-sort execution terminates, suggesting that the model learns a shortcut to the final output. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Discrete Neural Insertion Sort. Our model represents the sequence as a chain, separates scalar exchanges from control-state transitions, and projects node representations back to discrete states after every processor step. When trained only on sequences of length 16, the model achieves $100\%$ sorted-sequence accuracy on sequences of length 64 and 128. However, an ablation shows that discretization and graph structure alone are insufficient: without additional supervision of the global inner-loop state, the model fails even at the training length. Our results show that discrete execution can support strong length generalization, while also highlighting the problem-specific inductive bias required to learn a faithful algorithmic execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在神经算法推理 (NAR) 的插入排序任务上，CLRS30 基线的 hint 目标弱优化、hint 准确率低，且中间表征在参考执行结束前就已能解码为有序序列，说明模型学到的是通往最终输出的捷径而非忠实执行。提出的 Discrete Neural Insertion Sort 把序列表示为链、分离标量交换与控制状态转移、每步处理器后投影回离散状态，仅用长度 16 训练即在长度 64 和 128 上达到 100% 有序准确率；消融显示缺少全局内层循环状态的额外监督时模型在训练长度上就失败。
Motivation: 正确的最终输出和中间监督并不能证明模型遵循了预期算法执行；插入排序上的 NAR 常在参考执行终止前就解码出有序序列，长度泛化因此不可信。
Method: 提出 Discrete Neural Insertion Sort：把序列表示为链 (chain)，将标量交换与控制状态转移分开建模，每个 processor step 之后把节点表征投影回离散状态；训练仅用长度 16 的序列，并对全局内层循环状态施加额外监督。分析对象为 CLRS30 基线 NAR 的 hint 目标与 hint 准确率。
Result: CLRS30 基线 NAR 的 hint 目标弱优化且 hint 准确率低，许多中间表征在参考插入排序执行终止前即可解码为有序序列。新模型仅在长度 16 上训练，在长度 64 和 128 上达到 100% 有序序列准确率。消融显示仅靠离散化与图结构不够：去掉全局内层循环状态的额外监督后，模型在训练长度 16 上即失败。
Conclusion: 离散执行可以支撑强长度泛化，但忠实的算法执行需要问题特定的归纳偏置（全局内层循环状态监督），单靠最终输出正确或 hint 监督不足以证明模型学到了目标算法。

papers.title: Double-stream registration with pyramid fusion for HDR video with alternating exposures
papers.abstract_en: High dynamic range (HDR) video reconstruction from al\-ter\-na\-ting-exposure sequences remains challenging, especially in regions with extreme luminance variation. We propose a novel HDR reconstruction framework based on dual-stream registration and accurate pyramid fusion. Given three consecutive frames, our method computes optical flow directly with the central frame, while introducing a complementary midpoint displacement strategy to handle cases with severe overexposition. A pyramid fusion stage then merges the resulting radiance and LDR images into a final HDR output. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对交替曝光序列的 HDR 视频重建，提出双流配准加金字塔融合框架：以中间帧为基准直接计算光流，并引入互补的中点位移策略处理严重过曝区域，再由金字塔融合阶段合并辐射度图与 LDR 图像输出 HDR。实验中该方法持续优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 交替曝光序列在亮度变化极端的区域难以配准和重建 HDR，严重过曝会让常规光流失效。
Method: 取连续三帧，以中间帧为基准直接计算光流（双流配准），并加入互补的中点位移 (midpoint displacement) 策略应对严重过曝；随后金字塔融合阶段把配准得到的辐射度图与 LDR 图像合并为最终 HDR 输出。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法在 HDR 视频重建上持续优于 state-of-the-art 方法（摘要未列出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 双流配准配合中点位移与金字塔融合，可在极端亮度变化与过曝条件下稳定重建交替曝光 HDR 视频。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization with Fisher Information Geometry: Gradient Bounds and Trust-Region Methods
papers.abstract_en: We study Bayesian optimization (BO) through the lens of information geometry. Pulling back the Fisher information metric through the surrogate posterior map yields a local sensitivity tensor on the input space, which leads to an upper bound on the gradient of reparameterizable acquisition functions. This view explains vanishing-gradient behavior in high-dimensional BO and provides a common interpretation of heuristics such as RAASP and dimension-scaled lengthscales. Building on this analysis, we propose FITR, a trust-region-based BO method that replaces lengthscale-based scaling by local pullback-Fisher weights. FITR is not restricted to GP kernels with explicit lengthscales. On GP benchmarks with an SE kernel, experiments show competitive performance using FITR. The proposed method also easily generalizes to non-isotropic surrogates, although the gains are more task-dependent in that setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Fisher 信息度量经代理后验映射拉回输入空间，得到局部灵敏度张量并给出可重参数化采集函数梯度的上界，据此解释高维 BO 的梯度消失以及 RAASP、维度缩放 lengthscales 等启发式的共同来源。基于该分析提出 FITR：用拉回 Fisher 权重替代基于 lengthscale 的信任域缩放，且不依赖具有显式 lengthscale 的 GP 核。在带 SE 核的 GP benchmark 上 FITR 表现具竞争力，对非各向同性代理也能推广，但该情形下增益更依赖任务。
Motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中采集函数梯度随维度消失，现有缓解手段（RAASP、维度缩放 lengthscales）只是彼此孤立的启发式，缺少统一的几何解释，也受限于需要显式 lengthscale 的 GP 核。
Method: 经代理后验映射把 Fisher information metric 拉回输入空间，构造输入空间上的局部灵敏度张量，由此推出可重参数化采集函数梯度的上界；在此分析上提出 FITR，用局部拉回 Fisher 权重取代 lengthscale 缩放来定义信任域，方法不局限于带显式 lengthscale 的 GP 核。
Result: 在带 SE 核的 GP benchmarks 上，实验显示 FITR 具备竞争力的表现；该方法可推广到非各向同性代理，但此时增益更具任务依赖性。
Conclusion: 高维 BO 的梯度消失可由拉回 Fisher 几何统一解释，用局部 Fisher 权重替代 lengthscale 缩放可作为不依赖核参数化形式的信任域 BO 方案；非各向同性代理下收益不稳定。

papers.title: DepthEvidence: Unifying Metric Depth Prediction and Geometric Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning with metric constraints requires linking objects to geometric measurements and preserving their numerical content during language reasoning. We present DepthEvidence, a 4B model that uses its own dense metric predictions as object-grounded evidence for language generation. A camera-conditioned decoder predicts full-resolution metric depth using multi-scale visual features and high-resolution RGB refinement. A dense-to-language interface converts predicted depths and decoder features into object-aligned continuous geometry tokens anchored to object identifiers. Geometric supervision encourages metric information to remain recoverable before and after language-context interaction, while instruction tuning supports object measurement and compositional reasoning. We introduce a Depth-VQA benchmark evaluating object-depth queries, relative comparisons, and decisions combining spatial and numerical constraints. Across nine datasets, DepthEvidence achieves the highest average dense $δ_1$ among evaluated methods, competitive with specialized estimators. It also leads the evaluated methods in instance-level metric depth estimation and overall accuracy on both relative and metric reasoning tracks, while broadly preserving general VQA performance and improving spatial understanding relative to the base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DepthEvidence 把稠密度量深度预测直接当作语言生成的物体级证据：4B 模型用相机条件解码器输出全分辨率深度，经 dense-to-language 接口转成锚定物体 ID 的连续几何 token，几何监督保证度量信息在语言上下文交互前后都可恢复。在九个数据集上取得被评估方法中最高的平均稠密 δ₁，并在实例级度量深度与相对/度量推理两条 track 上领先，同时基本保住通用 VQA 能力。
Motivation: 多模态大模型做空间推理时，物体与几何测量脱钩，数值在语言推理过程中丢失，导致带度量约束的问答不可靠。
Method: 相机条件解码器用多尺度视觉特征加高分辨率 RGB refinement 预测全分辨率度量深度；dense-to-language 接口把预测深度与解码器特征转成锚定物体标识的连续几何 token；几何监督约束语言上下文交互前后度量信息可恢复，配合指令微调支持物体测量与组合推理，并引入 Depth-VQA 基准（物体深度查询、相对比较、空间与数值约束结合的决策）。
Result: 在九个数据集上，DepthEvidence 取得被评估方法中最高的平均稠密 δ₁，与专用深度估计器相当；在实例级度量深度估计上领先，并在相对推理与度量推理两条 track 上取得整体准确率第一；相对 base model 改进了空间理解，且广泛保持通用 VQA 性能。
Conclusion: 把模型自身的稠密深度预测作为物体锚定证据喂给语言生成，可以在不牺牲通用 VQA 的前提下同时提升度量深度与几何推理。

papers.title: A Flatness-Generalization Relation in the Teacher-Student Tree-Committee Machine
papers.abstract_en: The flatness of the loss landscape at a minimizer is a widely used heuristic for reasoning about neural-network generalization, yet evidence for this relation is mostly empirical and controversial. We study this relation in a teacher-student tree committee machine, where both the ERM estimator and the Hessian spectrum are analytically tractable in the proportional high-dimensional limit. First, we use a zero-temperature Gibbs formulation to obtain predictions for the observables of the typical minimizers of the empirical loss. Secondly, we use Edwards-Jones formalism to derive the limiting Hessian resolvent around these typical minimizers. All predictions agree with finite-size gradient-descent simulations. Finally, we study three measures of flatness, namely the left and right edges and the spectral mean, and check if a decrease in generalization error as the dataset size is increased corresponds to an increase in flatness. We find that the answer strongly depends on the learning task and on the ratio of the number of parameters to the number of data points. In regression, the spectral mean and right edge correlate with the generalization error, while the left edge does so only in the overparametrized regime. In classification this correlation reliably holds only in the highly overparametrized phase, while for underparametrized networks it can even reverse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 teacher-student tree committee machine 中，用零温 Gibbs 公式与 Edwards-Jones 形式给出典型极小值处 Hessian 谱的解析预测，并检验三种 flatness 度量与泛化误差的关系。结论是相关性强烈依赖任务与参数/数据比：回归中 spectral mean 与 right edge 随数据集增大（泛化误差下降）而变平，left edge 仅在过参数化区相关；分类中该相关只在高度过参数化相可靠，欠参数化网络甚至反号。
Motivation: flatness 与泛化的关联被广泛当作启发式，但证据多为经验性且有争议；需要在 ERM 估计量与 Hessian 谱都可解析求解的高维比例极限中判定该关系何时成立、何时反号。
Method: 在 proportional high-dimensional limit 下研究 teacher-student tree committee machine：先用零温 Gibbs formulation 预测经验损失典型极小值的观测量，再用 Edwards-Jones formalism 推导这些极小值周围 Hessian resolvent 的极限形式；随后以有限尺寸 gradient-descent 模拟核对预测，并比较 flatness 的三个度量（left edge、right edge、spectral mean）与泛化误差随数据集大小变化的关系。
Result: 所有解析预测与有限尺寸梯度下降模拟一致。回归任务中 spectral mean 与 right edge 随数据集增大、泛化误差下降而与之相关，left edge 仅在过参数化 (overparametrized) 区相关；分类任务中该相关只在高度过参数化相可靠，欠参数化网络中相关可反号。
Conclusion: flatness-泛化关系不是普适的：它取决于学习任务以及参数数与数据点数之比，单一 flatness 度量不足以在所有参数化区间支撑泛化推断。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在 teacher-student tree committee machine 中，用零温 Gibbs 公式与 Edwards-Jones 形式给出典型极小值处 Hessian 谱的解析预测，并检验三种 flatness 度量与泛化误差的关系。结论是相关性强烈依赖任务与参数/数据比：回归中 spectral mean 与 right edge 随数据集增大（泛化误差下降）而变平，left edge 仅在过参数化区相关；分类中该相关只在高度过参数化相可靠，欠参数化网络甚至反号。

summary_sections.result: 所有解析预测与有限尺寸梯度下降模拟一致。回归任务中 spectral mean 与 right edge 随数据集增大、泛化误差下降而与之相关，left edge 仅在过参数化 (overparametrized) 区相关；分类任务中该相关只在高度过参数化相可靠，欠参数化网络中相关可反号。
summary_sections.conclusion: flatness-泛化关系不是普适的：它取决于学习任务以及参数数与数据点数之比，单一 flatness 度量不足以在所有参数化区间支撑泛化推断。

papers.title: The Residual Stream's Effective Depth
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \emph{effective depth} ($\Deff$), a scalar diagnostic that treats the layer-wise residual stream of a transformer as a discrete-time process, measures how representation similarity decays with layer distance, and aggregates that profile into one number. Across sixteen decoder-only language models, $\Deff$ separates a structural consequence of residual accumulation from an empirical one: even maximally diverse orthogonal updates have the closed-form reference $F_L = 2L/(L+1)<2$, yet fifteen of sixteen default measurements lie below $F_L$ (Qwen3.5: 32--44\%, OLMo-2: 40--41\%, Pythia: 23--28\%). Matched references show that the gap is not caused by the persistent initial state or update-size imbalance, but is largely a calibrated signature of correlated residual updates rather than evidence that depth is unused. Symmetric position-0, token-normalisation, and top-PC controls show the regime is not reducible to BOS or top-PC artefacts: the lone above-reference default outlier joins the same regime, and all sixteen models are sub-reference after token-normalisation or top-1-PC removal. Intermediate checkpoints show that the regime is established early in OLMo-2 and stable through 5T tokens, while Pythia-1.4B follows a distinct decreasing trajectory. A controlled residual-carry intervention supports the mechanism, and $\Deff$ is best read as a \emph{global} accumulated-state diagnostic, not as a capability score or pruning method.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 17th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出标量诊断 effective depth（D_eff），把 Transformer 层间 residual stream 当作离散时间过程，用表征相似度随层距的衰减剖面压成一个数。在 16 个 decoder-only 语言模型上，即便更新完全正交，闭式参考 F_L=2L/(L+1)<2；15/16 个默认测量低于该参考（Qwen3.5 32–44%、OLMo-2 40–41%、Pythia 23–28%），且 token 归一化或去掉 top-1 PC 后 16 个模型全部低于参考，说明这是相关 residual 更新的全局累积态特征，而非深度未被使用。
Motivation: residual stream 的逐层累积让“有效深度”难以量化：需要区分哪些是残差累积的结构性后果、哪些只是经验现象，避免把表征衰减误读成深度浪费或能力指标。
Method: 把层间 residual stream 建模为离散时间过程，度量表征相似度随层距的衰减并聚合成标量 D_eff；以最大多样正交更新的闭式参考 F_L=2L/(L+1) 作对照，并做 matched references、对称 position-0、token 归一化与 top-PC 剔除等控制，辅以中间 checkpoint 与受控 residual-carry 干预。
Result: 16 个 decoder-only 模型中 15 个默认测量低于 F_L：Qwen3.5 为 32–44%，OLMo-2 为 40–41%，Pythia 为 23–28%；matched references 表明差距主要来自相关 residual 更新，而非初始态持久性或更新幅度失衡。token 归一化或去掉 top-1 PC 后全部 16 个模型低于参考，唯一高于参考的默认离群模型也落入同一区间；OLMo-2 中该机制早期确立并稳定至 5T tokens，Pythia-1.4B 则呈下降轨迹。
Conclusion: D_eff 应作为全局累积态诊断量来读，不能当作能力分数或剪枝依据；低于正交参考的普遍偏离是相关 residual 更新的校准信号，而非深度未被利用的证据。

papers.title: Block Sparse Attention with Log-Linear Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Scaling language models to long contexts is limited by the quadratic cost of self-attention. Block sparse attention offers an efficient alternative, but selecting the retained blocks remains a bottleneck. Conventional block selection requires scoring all query-block pairs and therefore remains quadratic in sequence length. To address this issue, we propose PISA, a block-sparse attention mechanism that employs a pyramid Top-$K$ selection strategy. The main idea is to gradually narrow down the candidates across different levels, making it more efficient to find the most relevant keys. Specifically, we construct a coarse-to-fine hierarchy of keys and perform selection from the coarsest level. At each level, LogSumExp scoring is applied to a bounded candidate set to select candidates for the next finer level, continuing until the finest level is reached. Through pooling, we construct $O(\log N)$ levels of keys, yielding an overall complexity of $O(N\log N)$, where $N$ denotes the sequence length. We develop hardware-aware Triton kernels for both training and inference, fusing hierarchical routing and LogSumExp scoring without materializing the query-key score matrix. We further evaluate our method on language modeling tasks. Compared with the baseline, our method achieves comparable performance on benchmarks such as commonsense reasoning while delivering better results on retrieval tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PISA 用金字塔式 Top-K 选择把 block sparse attention 的块选择本身从二次复杂度降到 O(N log N)：对 key 构造 O(log N) 层粗到细层级，每层在有界候选集上用 LogSumExp 打分筛出下一层候选，直到最细层。配套 Triton kernel 融合分层路由与打分、不显式物化 query-key 分数矩阵；在语言建模评测中常识推理与基线相当、检索任务更好。
Motivation: 长上下文语言模型受自注意力二次代价限制，block sparse attention 虽是替代方案，但常规块选择要对所有 query-block 对打分，选择环节本身仍随序列长度二次增长。
Method: PISA 构造 key 的 coarse-to-fine 层级（经 pooling 得 O(log N) 层），从最粗层开始，每层对有界候选集用 LogSumExp 打分选出更细层候选，整体复杂度 O(N log N)；并实现训练与推理两套硬件感知 Triton kernel，融合分层路由与 LogSumExp 打分，不物化 query-key 分数矩阵。
Result: 复杂度由块选择的 O(N^2) 降为 O(N log N)，层级数 O(log N)；在语言建模评测中，commonsense reasoning 等 benchmark 上与基线性能相当，检索类任务上取得更好结果。
Conclusion: 块选择可以靠粗到细的金字塔 Top-K 与 LogSumExp 打分做到近线性，而不牺牲语言建模与检索表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SAGE: A sampling-aware global evaluation benchmark for species distribution modeling
papers.abstract_en: Knowing where species occur is fundamental for biodiversity research and conservation. Species distribution models (SDMs) link species observations to environmental conditions to estimate their spatial distribution. However, accuracy varies with the underlying data and models, making it essential to know for which species models can be trusted. Deep-learning-based SDMs ("DeepSDMs") now jointly model thousands of species, drawing on hundreds of millions of community-science records. At this scale, averaging performance hides substantial species-level variability, particularly for rare species, often of greatest conservation concern. Records are also strongly biased, making occurrence counts misleading. Accounting for these factors is essential for a reliable and informative evaluation of multi-species SDMs. Here, we introduce a Sampling-Aware Global Evaluation (SAGE) benchmark, combining GBIF records for training with sPlotOpen vegetation plots for presence-absence evaluation across 5771 plant species. We propose an evaluation framework that groups species based on two properties, sampling effort and relative prevalence, which describe how densely a species' range is sampled and how frequently the species is recorded. Evaluating single-species SDMs and multi-species DeepSDMs, we find that Random Forests and DeepSDMs perform best overall, but neither dominates: DeepSDMs outperform single-species SDMs for infrequently recorded species while offering no consistent advantage for well-sampled ones. Crucially, this advantage emerges only when established bias-correction practices, such as spatial thinning and reweighting, are carried over to the deep-learning setting. SAGE helps identify the species and data conditions for which a given approach is beneficial, thereby supporting the development of more transparent and ecologically credible SDMs. Data and code: https://earens.github.io/sage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 是面向物种分布模型 (SDM) 的采样感知评测基准：用 GBIF 记录训练、sPlotOpen 植被样方做出现-缺失评估，按采样努力与相对丰度把 5771 个植物物种分组。结果显示 Random Forest 与多物种 DeepSDM 总体最好但互有胜负：DeepSDM 在记录稀少的物种上胜过单物种 SDM，在采样充分的物种上无一致优势，且这一优势只有在把空间稀疏化 (spatial thinning) 与重加权等偏差校正迁移到深度学习设置时才出现。
Motivation: DeepSDM 已能联合建模数千物种、数亿条公民科学记录，但整体平均性能掩盖物种级差异，稀有物种（往往最具保护价值）被高采样物种主导；记录本身强偏，出现次数计数会误导评测。
Method: SAGE 结合 GBIF 记录训练与 sPlotOpen 出现-缺失样方评估，覆盖 5771 个植物物种；评测框架按两个属性对物种分组——采样努力 (sampling effort) 与相对丰度 (relative prevalence)，分别刻画物种分布被采样的密度与被记录的频率；在该分组下比较单物种 SDM 与多物种 DeepSDM，并把空间稀疏化、重加权等既有偏差校正做法带入深度学习设置。
Result: Random Forest 与 DeepSDM 总体表现最好，但没有一方全面占优：DeepSDM 在记录不频繁的物种上优于单物种 SDM，在采样充分的物种上没有一致优势；该优势仅在偏差校正（spatial thinning、reweighting）被迁移到深度学习设置时才显现。评测覆盖 5771 个植物物种，训练数据为 GBIF、评估数据为 sPlotOpen。
Conclusion: 多物种 DeepSDM 的收益取决于物种的采样条件与是否做偏差校正，而非普遍优于单物种模型；SAGE 用于判定给定方法在哪些物种与数据条件下值得信任。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmouAI: Argumentative Human-AI Policy Deliberation with Simulated Personas
papers.abstract_en: Debates amongst agents driven by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated vast potential in various applications, but when these interactions include humans and take place in high-stakes environments, e.g., in public policy deliberations, they are beset with issues such as sycophancy and a lack of faithful explanations. To tackle these issues, we present OmouAI, an interactive and inclusive deliberation system that uses LLMs in combination with computational argumentation, a field which excels in representing and reasoning within debates. OmouAI allows a human user to deliberate policy claims for real-world challenges with simulated personas, e.g., representing stakeholders, domain experts or devil's advocates, towards reducing sycophancy. Each persona generates its own arguments, and the arguments of all parties form a shared argumentation framework. Users can then contest, add and revise arguments, providing crucial human oversight. Then, arguments are evaluated using deterministic argumentative semantics against external goals, such as the UN Sustainable Development Goals, guaranteeing faithful explanations. The advancement or worsening of the goals thus serve as indicators for the policy recommendations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmouAI 把 LLM 政策辩论接到计算论证 (computational argumentation) 上：模拟人格 (simulated personas) 各自生成论点并汇入共享论证框架，用户可 contest/add/revise，再用确定性论证语义对照外部目标（如 UN SDGs）评估，以目标的推进或恶化作为政策建议指标，从而抑制 sycophancy 并保证解释忠实。
Motivation: LLM 智能体辩论进入公共政策这类高风险场景时，容易出现 sycophancy（迎合）与解释不忠实，人类参与者的监督也难以落地。
Method: 系统用 LLM 结合计算论证：每个 persona（利益相关者、领域专家、devil's advocate）独立生成论点，各方论点构成共享论证框架；用户可反驳、增删、修订论点；随后用确定性论证语义 (deterministic argumentative semantics) 将论点对照 UN Sustainable Development Goals 等外部目标评估，目标的进展/恶化作为政策建议读数。
Result: 提出并实现交互式政策审议系统 OmouAI，其输出为按确定性语义评估、对照外部目标的论证状态，目标推进或恶化即政策建议指标；摘要给出的是系统机制而非实验数值。
Conclusion: 把 persona 化 LLM 辩论嵌入共享论证框架并用确定性语义打分，可在高风险政策审议中同时提供人类监督与忠实解释。

papers.title: Up and Down the Abstraction Ladder: Code-Based Skills for Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language agents struggle to act and learn in environments that require long sequences of low-level actions. Code-based abstractions can make these agents more productive by letting them invoke reusable skills instead of repeatedly selecting individual actions. The code handles recurring local decisions, while the language model decides which skills to use and how to combine them. Yet abstractions are leaky, and situations beyond a skill's capabilities may require a return to primitive actions. Motivated by this tradeoff between productivity and flexibility, we systematically study how code-based action abstraction affects the performance, inference cost, and learning of language agents. We study this in NetHack, a challenging, long-horizon game environment, using CodeHack, our library of code-based skills with natural-language descriptions. We use this library to compare agents restricted to primitives with those using semantic skills alone or in combination with primitives. We evaluate these agents in three settings: zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. Across a broad zero-shot evaluation on NetHack, we find that compared with primitives, skills nearly triple game progression, while reducing inference cost per episode by 86%. Combining skills with primitives retains much of this benefit while preserving a path back down to low-level actions. Finally, in RL, we find that skill-based agents learn significantly faster than agents acting on primitives, achieving a 7.2x larger average gain in dungeon level over the same training budget. These results show that a supplied skill library can improve performance, efficiency, and learning, while retaining primitives provides flexibility when the library is insufficient. We release CodeHack together with training and evaluation code.

papers.title: Band-Selection Stability and Semantic Segmentation Performance: A Study on Hyperspectral City
papers.abstract_en: Resource constraints make high-dimensional hyperspectral imaging challenging in autonomous perception, motivating the use of band selection methods. However, the sensitivity of band-selection methods to sampled data and their relationship to semantic segmentation models (SSMs) remain underexplored. This study evaluates six band selection methods on ten independently sampled, class-balanced region-of-interest (ROI) sets, yielding 60 top-25 band subsets from the Hyperspectral City V2 (128 bands: 450-950nm) dataset. Top-$K$ bands ($K\in\{3,5, ... 13\}$) from the first three ROI sets are evaluated with three SSMs against the corresponding 128-band baseline. Experiments show that intra-method stability is method-dependent: Sim-LP shows the highest stability (pairwise Jaccard similarity) and, together with JMIM+CSNR, yields the best segmentation results. Top-$K$ based SSMs remain competitive with baselines, with gains of up to 2.01 mIoU and 1.72 mF1 points, and 18-22x faster CPU inference for $K=9$. However, performance does not improve monotonically with $K$, and stability shows no consistent association with SSM performance. These findings suggest that intra-method stability is informative but an unreliable indicator of downstream segmentation performance, highlighting the need to evaluate band-selection methods across repeated samples, subset sizes, and SSMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Hyperspectral City V2 上比较六种波段选择方法：Sim-LP 的类内稳定性最高（pairwise Jaccard），并与 JMIM+CSNR 一起取得最好的语义分割结果；Top-K 波段子集相对 128 波段基线最高提升 2.01 mIoU 与 1.72 mF1，K=9 时 CPU 推理快 18–22 倍。但性能不随 K 单调上升，稳定性与分割性能无一致关联，因此稳定性只能作参考、不能替代跨重复采样与多 SSM 的下游评测。
Motivation: 波段选择方法对采样数据的敏感性、以及它与语义分割模型 (SSM) 的关系研究不足；资源受限的自主感知需要在降维同时保住分割精度与推理速度。
Method: 在 Hyperspectral City V2（128 波段，450–950nm）上用六种波段选择方法对十组独立采样、类别平衡的 ROI 集各取 Top-25，得 60 个波段子集；再用前三组 ROI 的 Top-K（K∈{3,5,…,13}）喂给三种 SSM，与 128 波段基线对比，稳定性用 pairwise Jaccard similarity 度量。
Result: Sim-LP 类内稳定性最高，且与 JMIM+CSNR 得到最佳分割结果；Top-K SSM 相对 128 波段基线最高提升 2.01 mIoU 与 1.72 mF1，K=9 时 CPU 推理快 18–22 倍；性能不随 K 单调提升，稳定性与 SSM 性能无一致关联。
Conclusion: 类内稳定性有信息量但不可靠地指示下游分割性能，波段选择方法必须跨重复采样、不同子集规模和多种 SSM 一起评测。

papers.title: Externalized CPDAG Summaries Improve LLM Causal Deduction
papers.abstract_en: Corr2Cause asks whether a causal claim holds in every DAG compatible with observed correlations and conditional independencies. We frame this as latent-object reasoning: the label is defined by a CPDAG query, but free-form chain-of-thought often collapses the Markov-equivalence-class problem into local pattern matching. We propose Structured Thinking, a two-turn pipeline that first externalizes a typed, schema-constrained CPDAG summary and then answers against that graph state. On the Corr2Cause full test, Structured Thinking raises Qwen3.5-27B from $73.0$ to $86.4$ $F_1$(Yes) over a strong PC-instruction baseline in the primary paired run ($+13.4$ pp; McNemar $p=2.4\times 10^{-6}$; bootstrap $95\%$ CI [$+8.4$, $+18.6$]); across three full-ID seeds, the mean gain is $+8.1 \pm 5.3$ pp. A PC-scaffolded two-turn prose control reaches only $67.6$ $F_1$, indicating that a detailed PC scaffold plus a schema-free prose intermediate is not sufficient. The same pattern holds on Qwen3.6-27B, Paraphrase-OOD, and GPT-5.4-mini. Scrambling the emitted CPDAG costs $12.0$ pp $F_1$, and a full-split audit shows close agreement with the reference CPDAG (ID skeleton $F_1$ $0.960$; exact match $75.9\%$). These results support a bounded design principle: externalize the latent object that defines the label, constrain its form, and test whether downstream answers use it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Corr2Cause 因果推断基准上，提出两轮 Structured Thinking：先外显一个带类型、受 schema 约束的 CPDAG 摘要，再基于该图状态作答。Qwen3.5-27B 的 F1(Yes) 从 73.0 升到 86.4（+13.4 pp，McNemar p=2.4×10⁻⁶），而打乱所输出的 CPDAG 会掉 12.0 pp，说明答案确实依赖这个外显的隐对象。
Motivation: Corr2Cause 要求判断某因果主张是否在与观测相关性和条件独立性相容的每个 DAG 上都成立，本质是 Markov 等价类层面的推理；自由形式的 chain-of-thought 常把它退化成局部模式匹配。
Method: Structured Thinking 两轮流水线：第一轮生成带类型、schema 约束的 CPDAG 摘要，第二轮针对该图状态作答；对照组为强 PC-instruction 基线与 PC-scaffolded 两轮 prose 控制，并做打乱 CPDAG 的干预审计。
Result: Corr2Cause 全测试集上 Qwen3.5-27B 的 F1(Yes) 由 73.0 升至 86.4（+13.4 pp；McNemar p=2.4×10⁻⁶；bootstrap 95% CI [+8.4, +18.6]），三个 full-ID seed 平均增益 +8.1±5.3 pp；PC-scaffolded prose 控制仅 67.6 F1；打乱 CPDAG 损失 12.0 pp；输出与参考 CPDAG 接近一致（ID skeleton F1 0.960，精确匹配 75.9%）。相同模式在 Qwen3.6-27B、Paraphrase-OOD 与 GPT-5.4-mini 上复现。
Conclusion: 作者给出一条有界设计原则：把定义标签的隐对象外显、约束其形式，并检验下游答案是否真的使用它；仅给详细 PC 脚手架加无 schema 的 prose 中间态不足以带来同等增益。

papers.title: Quantum Diffusion Models for Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Machine Learning is a novel field of research aimed at devising machine learning approaches exploiting principles of quantum mechanics, such as superposition, entanglement and interference. In this context, we present a scalable hybrid Quantum Diffusion Model, and evaluate its use for medical image analysis. Specifically, our method is based on a Discrete-Time Quantum Walk algorithm, executed on a real quantum device, to model the forward dynamics of the diffusion model. For the backward step of the diffusion model, we devise and evaluate a classical learning model, which is used to reversely denoise the data. In contrast with other existing attempts at applying quantum machine learning for image analysis tasks, severely limited by the size of existing quantum devices, our method allows to process real-world large size medical data. In particular, we present results on grayscale and RGB images, as well as 3D volumes of moderate sizes. We benchmark our results by reproducing an alternative classical counterpart model, based on diffusion models on discrete state spaces. By doing so, we compare the generation capabilities of both models in terms of three distinct state-of-the-art metrics in the field of image generation, showing the competitive, promising results of our approach.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可扩展的混合量子扩散模型用于医学图像分析：前向加噪过程用真实量子设备上执行的离散时间量子行走 (Discrete-Time Quantum Walk) 实现，反向去噪由经典学习模型完成，从而绕开量子器件规模对图像尺寸的限制。在灰度图、RGB 图与中等尺寸 3D 体数据上，与离散状态空间经典扩散模型对比三项图像生成 SOTA 指标，结果具竞争力。
Motivation: 既有量子机器学习图像任务受现有量子器件规模严重限制，无法处理真实世界的大幅医学数据；需要一种能把量子前向过程与经典反向过程拼接的混合方案。
Method: 混合量子扩散模型：前向动力学由运行在真实量子设备上的 Discrete-Time Quantum Walk 算法建模，反向步用专门设计的经典学习模型做去噪；同时复现一个基于离散状态空间扩散模型的经典对应模型作为对照。
Result: 在灰度图、RGB 图像与中等尺寸 3D 体数据上给出结果，用图像生成领域三项 SOTA 指标对比量子与经典对应模型的生成能力，摘要称结果具竞争力与前景，但未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把量子行走只放在前向过程、反向交给经典模型，可让量子扩散模型处理真实世界的大幅医学数据，并在生成质量上与经典离散状态空间扩散模型竞争。

papers.title: Distributed Learning as a Service: The Developer's Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Application developers of distributed learning services face challenges that a typical federated learning loop does not address. Specifically, the model updates can still leak private data, devices might not be able to participate in the training due to limited resources, a single aggregator might not be able to scale, and the transmissions of model weights induce a considerable bandwidth cost. This paper demonstrates DLaaS (Distributed Learning as a Service) from the developer's vantage point. Using a single admin dashboard, the developer initiates a distributed/federated learning job and is able to activate Differential Privacy (DP), Split Learning (SL), Hierarchical Aggregation (HA), and Knowledge Distillation (KD) as declarative options, with no change to the clients' code. We demonstrate the complete service lifecycle on an industrial smart-home Wake-up Word (WuW) task, using the "Ok Aura" dataset. Once the developer initiates a distributed learning job by toggling DP, SL, HA, and KD in the admin dashboard, the system dispatches the job to a set of Android clients and Dockerized helper aggregators. In the demonstration, these mechanisms run live across configurations. Then, the clients train the model locally and return their updates. The trained model is served to a consumer-side Android application that performs on-device WuW detection on a live microphone stream. In particular, the conference attendees will be invited to speak the trigger phrase and monitor in real time the per-class confidence and inference latency. Finally, we release the source code and short video walkthroughs of these configurations.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 5 figures. Paper accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Network and Service Management (CNSM 2026). Code: https://github.com/Telefonica-Scientific-Research/DLaaS-Server
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DLaaS 把分布式/联邦学习做成开发者可声明式开关的服务：在一个管理面板上直接启用 Differential Privacy、Split Learning、Hierarchical Aggregation、Knowledge Distillation，客户端代码零改动。演示在工业级智能唤醒词 (Wake-up Word) 任务上跑通完整生命周期，用 "Ok Aura" 数据集分发到 Android 客户端与 Docker 化辅助聚合器，训练后模型部署到端侧 App 对实时麦克风流做检测。
Motivation: 典型联邦学习循环解决不了开发者实际面对的问题：模型更新仍可能泄露隐私、设备算力不足无法参与、单一 aggregator 难以扩展、传输模型权重带来可观带宽成本。
Method: 开发者通过单一 admin dashboard 发起分布式/联邦学习作业，把 DP、SL、HA、KD 作为声明式选项开关，不改客户端代码；作业分发到一组 Android 客户端与 Dockerized helper aggregators，各机制以不同配置组合在线运行，客户端本地训练后回传更新，最终模型下发到消费端 Android 应用做设备端推理。
Result: 在工业智能唤醒词任务上用 "Ok Aura" 数据集演示完整服务生命周期：DP、SL、HA、KD 在多种配置下实时运行，模型部署到 Android 端对实时麦克风流做 WuW 检测，现场与会者可说出触发短语并实时观察逐类置信度与推理延迟；源码与各配置的短视频 walkthrough 一并开源。
Conclusion: 把隐私、通信与扩展性机制做成服务端声明式开关，可让开发者在不改客户端代码的前提下按需组合 DP/SL/HA/KD 并完成端到端部署。

summary_sections.method: 开发者通过单一 admin dashboard 发起分布式/联邦学习作业，把 DP、SL、HA、KD 作为声明式选项开关，不改客户端代码；作业分发到一组 Android 客户端与 Dockerized helper aggregators，各机制以不同配置组合在线运行，客户端本地训练后回传更新，最终模型下发到消费端 Android 应用做设备端推理。
summary_sections.result: 在工业智能唤醒词任务上用 "Ok Aura" 数据集演示完整服务生命周期：DP、SL、HA、KD 在多种配置下实时运行，模型部署到 Android 端对实时麦克风流做 WuW 检测，现场与会者可说出触发短语并实时观察逐类置信度与推理延迟；源码与各配置的短视频 walkthrough 一并开源。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把隐私、通信与扩展性机制做成服务端声明式开关，可让开发者在不改客户端代码的前提下按需组合 DP/SL/HA/KD 并完成端到端部署。

papers.title: Neuralyzing the Trace: Selective Representation-Level Unlearning with Contrastive Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted information while preserving a model's other abilities. In realistic settings, such as privacy requests under the EU GDPR, the target may be narrow, for example information associated with a single person. Behavioral forgetting alone may be insufficient, motivating interventions directly on internal representations. However, standard mechanistic-interpretability extractors are poorly selective for such targets. We identify an energy bias in reconstruction-based extraction, which favors dominant background structure over low-energy target-specific components. We introduce SCALPEL, a contrastive sparse autoencoder designed to learn more selective forget features. We show theoretically that contrastive training promotes target-selective features and that our selection score controls expected background knowledge perturbation. We validate SCALPEL experimentally on TOFU across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, where it substantially improves over NMF and standard SAE interventions and is competitive with Gradient Difference and RMU, bridging mechanistic interpretability and fine-grained unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对机器遗忘中窄目标（如 GDPR 下单个人的信息）选择性不足的问题，提出对比稀疏自编码器 SCALPEL：识别基于重构的提取器存在偏向主导背景结构、压制低能量目标成分的能量偏置，用对比训练学出目标选择性 forget features，并给出控制期望背景知识扰动的选择分数。在 TOFU 上跨 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 验证，明显优于 NMF 与标准 SAE 干预，且与 Gradient Difference、RMU 相当。
Motivation: GDPR 等隐私请求要求遗忘的目标往往很窄（单个人相关的信息），仅靠行为遗忘不够，需要直接干预内部表示；而标准机制可解释性提取器对这类窄目标选择性差。
Method: 先刻画基于重构提取中的能量偏置（偏好主导背景结构、忽略低能量目标特异成分），再提出对比稀疏自编码器 SCALPEL，以对比训练学习目标选择性 forget features；理论上证明对比训练促进目标选择性特征，且所提选择分数可控制期望背景知识扰动。
Result: 在 TOFU 上跨 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 三个模型验证，SCALPEL 相比 NMF 与标准 SAE 干预有显著提升，并与 Gradient Difference 和 RMU 竞争；理论结果给出选择分数对期望背景知识扰动的控制保证。
Conclusion: 把机制可解释性与细粒度遗忘打通是可行的：对比式 SAE 能学到对窄目标更有选择性的表示特征，在保持其他能力的同时完成表示级遗忘。

papers.title: Cheap, open agents make LLM pollution harder to mitigate
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) pollution occurs when synthetic responses contaminate data intended to capture human behavior. High deployment costs have so far limited the risk posed by autonomous survey agents. However, open-weight models paired with open-source agentic frameworks may have removed this barrier. We compared the performance and detectability of nine agent configurations, ranging from fully open variants to closed commercial ones. Each agent autonomously completed a survey containing multiple response types yielding various detection checks. Fully open agents ran locally without usage fees and performed competitively with commercial alternatives. Open and commercial agents failed different sets of checks, and no single check reliably detected all agents, but open-text responses discriminated best between agents and humans. These findings identify fully open agents as a distinct risk for LLM pollution and support multilayered detection strategies emphasizing open-text analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 开源权重模型加开源 agent 框架让自主填问卷的 agent 本地零成本运行，性能已与商业方案相当，从而把 LLM 污染（合成回答混入人类行为数据）的风险门槛拉低。九种 agent 配置中开源与商业 agent 失败的检测项不同、没有任何单一检测项能识别全部 agent，只有开放文本回答最能区分 agent 与人类，因此检测必须走多层策略并以开放文本分析为重。
Motivation: 高部署成本此前限制了自主调查 agent 造成的 LLM 污染风险，而开源权重模型与开源 agentic 框架可能已消除这道成本门槛，使合成回答更容易污染本欲记录人类行为的数据。
Method: 比较九种 agent 配置（从完全开源到闭源商业）的性能与可检测性：每个 agent 自主完成一份含多种回答类型的问卷，问卷内置多项检测判据；按回答类型分别考察可检测性。
Result: 完全开源 agent 本地运行、无使用费，表现与商业替代方案相当；开源与商业 agent 失败的检测项集合不同，没有单一检测项能可靠识别所有 agent；开放文本 (open-text) 回答在区分 agent 与人类上效果最好。
Conclusion: 完全开源 agent 构成 LLM 污染的一类独立风险，可靠检测需采用多层策略并突出开放文本分析。

papers.title: Where Compute Matters: Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Efficient video generation requires reducing the quadratic cost of self-attention over long spatio-temporal token sequences. Existing efficient-attention methods typically apply the same computation pattern to every token, even though denoising difficulty varies substantially across video regions and evolves throughout the generation process. We introduce HetA-DiT, a heterogeneous attention mechanism that adaptively allocates computation according to token difficulty. A lightweight uncertainty branch predicts a token-wise estimate of denoising difficulty, which is used to route uncertain tokens through dense global attention while processing more reliable tokens with efficient local attention. The resulting routing is content- and timestep-adaptive, retains global context where it matters most, and provides a single parameter for controlling the quality-efficiency trade-off. HetA-DiT is compatible with few-step distribution-matching distillation and introduces no additional Transformer evaluation at inference time by reusing uncertainty estimates from the preceding denoising step. We evaluate the method on DMD-distilled Wan2.2-5B and Wan2.1-1.3B models. Across VBench, VBench-2.0, and human preference evaluation, HetA-DiT maintains competitive generation quality while routing only approximately 20% of tokens through dense attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HetA-DiT 在视频扩散 (video diffusion) 中按 token 去噪难度异质分配注意力：轻量 uncertainty 分支预测逐 token 难度，把不确定 token 路由到 dense global attention，可靠 token 走 local attention，路由随内容与 timestep 自适应。在 DMD 蒸馏的 Wan2.2-5B 与 Wan2.1-1.3B 上，仅约 20% token 走 dense attention 即在 VBench、VBench-2.0 与人类偏好评估中保持有竞争力的生成质量。
Motivation: 长时空 token 序列上 self-attention 是二次成本，而现有高效注意力对所有 token 用同一计算模式，忽略了不同视频区域、不同生成阶段去噪难度的差异。
Method: 提出异质注意力 HetA-DiT：轻量 uncertainty 分支给出逐 token 去噪难度估计，据此把不确定 token 走 dense global attention、可靠 token 走 local attention；路由随内容与 timestep 自适应，并用一个参数控制质量-效率权衡。与 few-step distribution-matching distillation (DMD) 兼容，推理时复用上一去噪步的 uncertainty 估计，不引入额外 Transformer 求值。
Result: 在 DMD 蒸馏的 Wan2.2-5B 与 Wan2.1-1.3B 上评测，VBench、VBench-2.0 与人类偏好评估显示生成质量保持有竞争力，同时仅约 20% 的 token 被路由到 dense attention。
Conclusion: 按 token 难度分配注意力计算可以在视频扩散里用约 20% 的 dense attention 份额换回有竞争力的质量，质量-效率权衡由单一参数控制。

papers.title: DynBranch: Speculative Subgraph Reuse for Dynamic Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Agentic LLM workflows decide their execution paths at runtime. Downstream computation may be predictable, or may have run before, yet it cannot begin until the model or the user resolves the branch. We call this serialization the branch-resolution barrier. Caching alone does not hide it: the key that identifies a reusable result is not known until then. In this paper, we propose DynBranch, which makes an unresolved branch addressable before it resolves. Its stable coordinate lets candidate subgraphs run during resolution and completed subgraph results be reused across later requests. A two-level controller admits this work when its expected benefit exceeds the load price. DynBranch sits at the model-API boundary and requires no changes to agent harnesses or model execution engines. Across four agentic workloads with Qwen3-32B on 4x H200 GPUs, DynBranch reduces mean latency by up to 32% over each workload's strongest prior system and by 46-66% against a no-reuse floor, while preserving workflow results. The benefit persists across backbone families and on a commodity Qwen3-8B/RTX 4090 deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynBranch 为 agentic LLM 工作流中尚未解析的分支给出稳定坐标，使候选子图在分支解析期间即可执行、结果可跨请求复用，从而绕过 branch-resolution barrier。在四个 agentic 负载、Qwen3-32B 与 4x H200 上，相对各负载最强既有系统平均延迟最多降 32%，相对无复用下限降 46–66%，且工作流结果保持不变。
Motivation: Agentic LLM 的执行路径在运行时才决定，下游计算要等模型或用户解析分支才能开始，形成 branch-resolution barrier；纯缓存无法掩盖它，因为可复用结果的 key 在解析前未知。
Method: DynBranch 部署在 model-API 边界，为未解析分支提供稳定坐标，让候选子图在解析期间执行并把完成的子图结果跨请求复用；两级控制器按预期收益是否超过负载价格决定是否接纳这些工作，且不改动 agent harness 与模型执行引擎。
Result: 在四个 agentic 负载、Qwen3-32B、4x H200 上，平均延迟相对各负载最强既有系统最多降低 32%，相对无复用下限降低 46–66%，同时保持工作流结果不变；收益在不同 backbone 家族以及 Qwen3-8B/RTX 4090 商品化部署上依然成立。
Conclusion: 把未解析分支变成可寻址对象并按收益定价接纳，可以在不改 agent 框架的前提下同时压低延迟并保住结果正确性，且该收益不依赖特定模型或硬件。

papers.title: KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale
papers.abstract_en: Conversational agents, generative recommenders, and personalized advertising all rest on one capability: understanding each user from raw behavior. Prevailing industrial practice is task-specific: for each task, a relevant subsequence is extracted from the full history and a dedicated model trained on it. In production it hits two bottlenecks. First, even after filtering, a single-task sequence stays extremely long: content-interest summarization reads several hundred items per user, tens of thousands of tokens once serialized as prompt text. Second, profiles are refreshed routinely: a billion users weekly, roughly 100K QPM in aggregate, which under a fixed GPU budget sets a hard throughput floor. Compression is therefore mandatory, yet truncation or coarse compression can silently distort the profile, introducing four hallucination types (fabrication, omission, date misattribution, broken logic) that, with no way to evaluate the compressed representation itself, surface only as diffuse degradation in downstream metrics. We present KuaFu, a unified behavior-compression layer whose minimal unit is one behavior item. A two-axis projector compresses each item into 2-4 tokens of width 128-256 (about 10x along the token axis, 20x along width; per-item cache 10 KB to 0.5 KB), with fidelity-oriented four-stage training and layered intermediate evaluation. Across four production profiling tasks it matches or exceeds uncompressed single-task production models on all five headline metrics, raises per-GPU throughput by 37%-350%, and saves 190 GPUs. On public benchmarks it nearly always beats prior compressors at the same compression ratio (up to +17.7 EM on out-of-domain MRQA); on RecBench, a 4B model surpasses its 8B counterpart by 1.90 points. KuaFu has run on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months, lifting overall GMV by 1.37%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KuaFu 把用户行为压缩做成统一层，用双轴投影器把每条行为压成 2-4 个 token（宽度 128-256），配合四阶段保真训练与分层中间评测，替代逐任务截断式压缩。在腾讯广告推荐平台四项生产画像任务上五项主指标全部持平或超过未压缩的单任务模型，单 GPU 吞吐提升 37%-350%、省下 190 张 GPU，上线十个月整体 GMV 提升 1.37%。
Motivation: 工业界逐任务从全量历史截取子序列训练专用模型，序列仍长达数万 token，且十亿用户每周刷新、约 100K QPM 的吞吐下限压在固定 GPU 预算上；粗暴截断或压缩会引入 fabrication、omission、date misattribution、broken logic 四类幻觉，而压缩表示本身无从评测，只能在下游指标上表现为弥散性劣化。
Method: KuaFu 是以单个行为条目为最小单元的统一行为压缩层：双轴投影器把每条行为压成 2-4 个 token、宽度 128-256（token 轴约 10 倍、宽度轴约 20 倍，单条缓存从 10 KB 降到 0.5 KB），采用面向保真的四阶段训练 (fidelity-oriented four-stage training) 与分层中间评测 (layered intermediate evaluation)，直接评测压缩表示本身。
Result: 在四项生产画像任务上，五项主指标全部持平或超过未压缩的单任务生产模型；单 GPU 吞吐提升 37%-350%，节省 190 张 GPU。在公开基准上同压缩比下几乎全面超过既有压缩器，域外 MRQA 最高 +17.7 EM；RecBench 上 4B 模型超过其 8B 对照 1.90 分。腾讯广告与推荐平台运行十个月，整体 GMV 提升 1.37%。
