papers.title: IDM-Net: A Lightweight Illumination-Decoupled Modulation Network for Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) remains challenging for lightweight models because illumination restoration and color fidelity are difficult to optimize simultaneously in the RGB color space. Although recent color-decoupled methods separate luminance and chrominance representations, they primarily optimize luminance as an enhancement target, leaving its potential as an explicit guidance prior largely unexplored during feature reconstruction. To address this limitation, we propose IDM-Net, a lightweight Illumination-Decoupled Modulation Network for low-light image enhancement. IDM-Net adopts a dual-encoder architecture consisting of a structure encoder that extracts multi-scale appearance features from the RGB image and a lightweight illumination encoder that learns illumination priors from the decoupled luminance (Y) channel. To effectively exploit these priors, we introduce an Illumination-Guided Modulation (IGM) module that injects multi-scale illumination cues into the decoder through spatially adaptive affine modulation, enabling accurate brightness restoration while preserving natural color consistency. Furthermore, we design a lightweight Feature Refinement Block (FRB) to progressively suppress degradation artifacts and recover fine-grained image details during reconstruction. Extensive experiments on multiple standard low-light image enhancement benchmarks demonstrate that IDM-Net achieves competitive performance among lightweight LLIE methods while maintaining an excellent balance between restoration quality and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IDM-Net 用双编码器把 RGB 结构特征与解耦后的 Y 通道光照先验分开提取，再通过 Illumination-Guided Modulation (IGM) 以空间自适应仿射调制把多尺度光照线索注入解码器，配合轻量 Feature Refinement Block (FRB) 逐步抑制退化伪影。在多个标准低-light 图像增强基准上，它在轻量级 LLIE 方法中取得有竞争力的性能，并保持恢复质量与计算效率的平衡。
Motivation: 轻量级低光图像增强 (LLIE) 中亮度恢复与色彩保真难以在 RGB 空间同时优化；现有颜色解耦方法只把亮度当增强目标，未把光照作为特征重建阶段的显式引导先验。
Method: 双编码器架构：结构编码器从 RGB 图像提取多尺度外观特征，轻量光照编码器从解耦的 luminance (Y) 通道学习光照先验；IGM 模块以空间自适应仿射调制 (spatially adaptive affine modulation) 将多尺度光照线索注入解码器，FRB 在重建过程中逐步抑制退化伪影并恢复细节。
Result: 在多个标准 LLIE 基准上的实验显示 IDM-Net 在轻量级 LLIE 方法中性能有竞争力，并在恢复质量与计算效率之间保持良好平衡（摘要未列出具体数值指标）。
Conclusion: 把亮度从增强目标提升为显式引导先验、用仿射调制注入解码器，是轻量级 LLIE 同时兼顾质量与效率的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Understanding Momentum Acceleration in River-Valley Loss Landscape
papers.abstract_en: The empirical success of pretraining large language models has inspired a deeper investigation into the underlying loss landscapes and the optimization dynamics. Recent empirical and theoretical study suggest that the training loss landscape often exhibits a "river-valley" structure, which features a low-loss manifold (river) flanked by sharp orthogonal directions with higher loss (mountains). In the long term, the optimization progress is determined primarily by the progress along the river. Within such a landscape, gradient descent with large learning rates can move faster along the river despite high apparent loss due to vertical oscillations, while a subsequent sharp decay in the learning rate suppresses these oscillations, revealing genuine optimization progress. This explains the recent success of warmup-stable-decay (WSD) learning rate scheduler which, unlike cosine scheduling, keeps stable high learning rate and decays before producing intermediate checkpoints. Building on this foundation, in this work we take a step further and study the role of momentum within such a loss landscape. We establish theoretical analysis that characterizes how momentum accelerates optimization by stabilizing large learning rates that can not be tolerated by vanilla GD without deviating significantly from the river. The enabled large learning rate in-turn gives greater speed along the river and makes faster essential progress in the long run. Another intriguing observation from theory is that for a river-valley landscape with very flat and slow-spinning river, the momentum itself does not contribute directly to acceleration in terms of the speed of tracking the river, while the main acceleration comes from the admissible larger learning rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 预训练的 river-valley 损失景观（低损失 river 被陡峭正交方向夹持）下，给出 momentum 加速优化的理论刻画：动量通过稳定 vanilla GD 无法承受的大步长、且不显著偏离 river，从而间接加速。理论还指出，对极平坦且缓慢旋转的 river，动量本身不直接贡献沿 river 的跟踪速度，加速主要来自被允许的大步长。
Motivation: WSD 调度相对 cosine 的成功说明沿 river 的长期进展才是关键，但既有分析集中在学习率，momentum 在该景观中究竟通过何种机制起作用缺少理论说明。
Method: 在 river-valley 景观设定下做理论分析，刻画 momentum 如何稳定大步长并保持优化轨迹不显著偏离 river；对照 vanilla GD 与 WSD 调度的讨论，并给出极平坦、缓慢旋转 river 的特例分析。
Result: 理论结论：momentum 使原本 vanilla GD 无法承受的大步长可用，进而提升沿 river 的速度与长期进展；在 river 极平坦且缓慢旋转时，momentum 对跟踪 river 的速度无直接贡献，加速主要来自被允许的更大步长。
Conclusion: 在 river-valley 景观中，momentum 的加速本质上是「容许更大步长」的间接效应，而非直接推动沿 river 的运动；这一效应在极平坦缓慢旋转的 river 上消失。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FTB Graph: Determining and Validating First-token Broadcasters and Language-Identity Head Circuits in Multilingual Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models operating in multilingual contexts must resolve target response languages early in generation, yet the causal circuitry governing first-token language identity decisions remains poorly mapped. We present an end-to-end structural circuit analysis across six model architectures spanning four families: GPT-2, BLOOM-560M, Pythia-1B/2.8B, and Qwen2.5-1.5B Base/Instruct. Using Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) with FP16 active clamping, followed by exact activation patching verification with a 2,000-candidate-edge search ceiling, we extract directed acyclic graphs driving first-token language broadcasting. Across the standalone models, we observe deep or mid-to-deep broadcasting hubs, though the evidence is strongest for Pythia-2.8B and BLOOM-560M because GPT-2 and Pythia-1B leave few out-of-graph heads for comparison, while both Qwen2.5-1.5B variants invert the necessity check. Scaling from Pythia-1B to 2.8B expands node participation while maintaining a similar verified edge budget, producing sparser topology. The Qwen2.5-1.5B base and instruct circuits retain 84.7% Jaccard similarity, including the Layer 27 hub, indicating that first-token routing is largely established during pretraining and preserved by instruction tuning. Finally, EAP scores correlate weakly with exact patching deltas across most models, showing that linear gradient approximations can diverge from causal interventions in FP16 and motivating exact-patching verification for reliable circuit discovery.
papers.comment: 14 pages including supplementary material, 13 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个多语言 LLM 做首 token 语言身份的结构电路分析：用 Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) 加 FP16 active clamping 提取有向无环图，再用 2000 候选边上限的精确 activation patching 验证。发现深层/中深层广播枢纽，Qwen2.5-1.5B base 与 instruct 电路 Jaccard 相似度 84.7%，且 EAP 分数与精确 patching delta 在多数模型上仅弱相关，因此线性梯度近似必须配精确验证。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 在生成极早期就要决定目标响应语言，但支配首 token 语言身份的因果电路结构尚不清楚，且线性归因近似是否可信缺少因果核验。
Method: 覆盖四个模型家族六个架构（GPT-2、BLOOM-560M、Pythia-1B/2.8B、Qwen2.5-1.5B Base/Instruct），先用 EAP 加 FP16 active clamping 提取驱动首 token 语言广播的 DAG，再以 2000 候选边搜索上限做精确 activation patching 验证，并做必要性检查。
Result: 独立模型中观察到深层或中深层广播枢纽，证据在 Pythia-2.8B 与 BLOOM-560M 上最强（GPT-2 与 Pythia-1B 图外头太少，两个 Qwen2.5-1.5B 变体反转了必要性检查）；Pythia-1B→2.8B 扩大节点参与但验证边预算相近，拓扑更稀疏；Qwen2.5-1.5B base 与 instruct 电路保留 84.7% Jaccard 相似度，含 Layer 27 枢纽；EAP 分数与精确 patching delta 在多数模型上仅弱相关。
Conclusion: 首 token 路由主要在预训练期确立并被指令微调保留，线性梯度近似在 FP16 下会偏离因果干预，可靠电路发现需要精确 patching 验证。

summary_sections.motivation: 多语言 LLM 在生成极早期就要决定目标响应语言，但支配首 token 语言身份的因果电路结构尚不清楚，且线性归因近似是否可信缺少因果核验。
summary_sections.method: 覆盖四个模型家族六个架构（GPT-2、BLOOM-560M、Pythia-1B/2.8B、Qwen2.5-1.5B Base/Instruct），先用 EAP 加 FP16 active clamping 提取驱动首 token 语言广播的 DAG，再以 2000 候选边搜索上限做精确 activation patching 验证，并做必要性检查。
summary_sections.result: 独立模型中观察到深层或中深层广播枢纽，证据在 Pythia-2.8B 与 BLOOM-560M 上最强（GPT-2 与 Pythia-1B 图外头太少，两个 Qwen2.5-1.5B 变体反转了必要性检查）；Pythia-1B→2.8B 扩大节点参与但验证边预算相近，拓扑更稀疏；Qwen2.5-1.5B base 与 instruct 电路保留 84.7% Jaccard 相似度，含 Layer 27 枢纽；EAP 分数与精确 patching delta 在多数模型上仅弱相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 首 token 路由主要在预训练期确立并被指令微调保留，线性梯度近似在 FP16 下会偏离因果干预，可靠电路发现需要精确 patching 验证。

papers.title: MVVBench: Benchmarking 4D Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view video understanding requires integrating spatial and temporal evidence across multiple, often non-overlapping camera streams: tracking entities as they transition between viewpoints, aligning events across time, and reasoning about latent 4D continuity rather than any single visible frame. We introduce MVVBench, a benchmark for multi-view video reasoning built from real world multi camera datasets. Questions are curated to be monocular-ambiguous along both the view and the temporal axis: each question is unanswerable from any single view in the designated input set, and the majority are further unanswerable from any single moment. Each question becomes uniquely solvable only by jointly reasoning across views and across time. MVVBench spans diverse dynamic scenes and probes six capabilities: implicit/explicit attribute identification, implicit/explicit relative distance, relative camera pose, and compositional counting, with human-authored QA and rigorous verification. Beyond benchmarking, we provide an extensive analysis of when and why current vision language models succeed or fail, characterizing errors due to temporal mis-localization, cross-view identity breaks, and brittle multi-hop reasoning. We then study inference-time elicitation strategies that unlock latent multi-view competence---task-specific chain-of-thought scaffolds and structured cross-view evidence aggregation---yielding substantial gains without retraining. Finally, we present preliminary evidence that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can elicit some latent multi-view competence in the base model, pointing to training-time approaches as a promising direction for future work. Together, MVVBench offers a rigorous evaluation of 4D multi-view reasoning and a foundation for future progress toward reliable embodied perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVVBench 是一个多视角视频 4D 推理基准：问题沿视角轴和时间轴都刻意做成单目不可解，只有联合跨视角、跨时间推理才能唯一作答。它覆盖六类能力并诊断出 VLM 的三类失败模式，推理时的 chain-of-thought 脚手架与结构化跨视角证据聚合在不重训的前提下带来显著提升，RLVR 初步证据显示基础模型中已潜藏部分多视角能力。
Motivation: 多视角视频理解要求跨不重叠相机流整合时空证据，而现有 VLM 缺少能隔离“单视角/单时刻不可解”这一 4D 推理能力的评测集。
Method: 从真实多相机数据集构建问题，按视角与时间双重单目歧义筛选（多数问题连单时刻也无法作答），配人工撰写 QA 与严格校验；评测六类能力：隐式/显式属性识别、隐式/显式相对距离、相对相机位姿、组合计数；并分析推理时策略（任务特定 CoT 脚手架、结构化跨视角证据聚合）与 RLVR。
Result: 定量对比以“substantial gains without retraining”表述，摘要未给出具体数值；错误被归因为时间定位错乱、跨视角身份断裂、脆弱的多跳推理；RLVR 提供了可激发基础模型部分潜在多视角能力的初步证据。
Conclusion: 跨视角跨时间的 4D 推理能力在现有 VLM 中部分潜藏、可通过推理时提示激发，训练时方法（如 RLVR）是值得投入的下一步方向。

papers.title: Low-Bit Recurrent States in Hybrid Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid language models maintain fixed-size recurrent states, but existing quantizers typically use eight bits or more. Quantization errors persist according to channel decay rates. We derive distortion weights from the observability Gramian and combine them with normalized state ranges for mixed-precision bit allocation, without calibration data, rotation, or training. We also quantize decay rates logarithmically. With per-token state quantization, a four-bit mean payload reduces excess negative log-likelihood by factors of 3.3--27.9 relative to the best of seven baselines across three hybrid models; metadata costs vary. At six bits, negative log-likelihood differs from the FP32-state baseline by less than 0.005 nats. Ablations separate gains from variable bit widths, decay weighting, and range normalization. With less frequent write-backs, gains diminish and depend on the model and budget.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对混合语言模型 (hybrid language model) 中固定尺寸循环状态的量化，提出用可观测性 Gramian 导出失真权重、结合归一化状态范围做混合精度比特分配，并对衰减率做对数量化，全程无需校准数据、旋转或训练。四位元有效载荷下，per-token 状态量化使三个混合模型上的超额负对数似然相对七个基线中最好者降低 3.3–27.9 倍；六位时 NLL 与 FP32 状态基线相差小于 0.005 nats。
Motivation: 混合语言模型的循环状态量化器通常用八位以上，而量化误差会按通道衰减率 (channel decay rates) 持续累积，需要在不依赖校准数据的前提下更省位宽地压低状态量化失真。
Method: 从可观测性 Gramian (observability Gramian) 导出失真权重，与归一化状态范围结合做混合精度比特分配；衰减率单独做对数量化；采用 per-token 状态量化，整个流程不需要校准数据、旋转或训练；并用消融分离可变位宽、衰减加权与范围归一化的贡献。
Result: 四位元平均载荷下，超额负对数似然 (excess NLL) 相对七个基线中最好者降低 3.3–27.9 倍，覆盖三个混合模型，元数据开销另计；六位时 NLL 与 FP32 状态基线之差小于 0.005 nats。消融显示收益分别来自可变位宽、衰减加权与范围归一化；降低写回频率 (write-back) 时收益减弱，且依赖具体模型与位宽预算。
Conclusion: 无需校准或训练的 Gramian 加权混合精度状态量化即可把混合语言模型的状态位宽压到四位仍大幅降失真，六位已接近 FP32；但收益随写回频率降低而衰减，取决于模型与预算。

papers.title: PORL: Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem
papers.abstract_en: The Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem in industrial optimization. This work introduces Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning (PORL), a hybrid approach that combines simulation-based online pretraining with offline fine-tuning on production-specific data. Reinforcement learning through online interaction enables exploration of general scheduling strategies, but typically relies on simulation environments and may suffer from a simulation-to-reality gap. In contrast, offline RL avoids direct interaction with the environment by learning from historical data, but its performance is strongly influenced by dataset quality and coverage. PORL combines the strengths of both paradigms by first learning a general scheduling policy through online interaction and subsequently adapting it offline to a target distribution. A KL-divergence-based policy constraint is introduced to limit deviations from the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. The approach is evaluated on JSSP instances with distribution shift and datasets generated from heuristic, noisy-expert, and random behavioral policies. The results show that PORL consistently achieves lower optimality gaps than standalone offline RL and the considered general scheduling baselines. Furthermore, its advantage over standalone offline RL increases as dataset quality decreases, indicating reduced sensitivity to the quality and coverage of the available offline data. The results suggest that offline adaptation of pretrained policies is a promising approach for industrial scheduling environments where direct online exploration is impractical.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE 10th International Conference on Computational Systems and Information Technology for Sustainable Solutions (CSITSS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PORL 把仿真在线预训练与生产数据离线微调结合，用 KL 散度策略约束限制微调时对预训练策略的偏离。在带分布偏移的 JSSP 实例上，其 optimality gap 一致低于单独的离线 RL 与所比较的通用调度基线，且数据质量越差优势越大。
Motivation: 在线 RL 依赖仿真环境、存在 sim-to-real gap；离线 RL 免交互但性能强依赖数据质量与覆盖度，工业调度中直接在线探索往往不可行。
Method: 两阶段 PORL：先在仿真中在线交互学出通用调度策略，再在生产特定数据上离线微调；微调时引入基于 KL 散度的策略约束，限制相对预训练策略的偏离。评测用带分布偏移的 JSSP 实例，离线数据由 heuristic、noisy-expert、random 三类行为策略生成。
Result: 在带分布偏移的 JSSP 实例上，PORL 的 optimality gap 一致低于单独的离线 RL 与所考虑的通用调度基线；相对单独离线 RL 的优势随离线数据质量下降而扩大，表明对数据质量与覆盖度的敏感性降低。
Conclusion: 对无法在线探索的工业调度环境，先在线预训练再带约束地离线微调是可行路径，且在离线数据质量差时相对单独离线 RL 更有利。

papers.title: DAPEVO: Deep Adaptive Patch Frame-Event Visual Odometry
papers.abstract_en: Visual odometry is essential for autonomous navigation in GPS-denied environments, yet RGB-based methods remain vulnerable to motion blur, challenging illumination, and dropped frames. Event cameras complement conventional cameras with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but their asynchronous measurements complicate reliable correspondence estimation. We present DAPEVO, a learned visual odometry system that estimates image and event correspondences independently at shared patch locations and fuses their correlation evidence before motion refinement. Each tracked patch maintains image and event descriptors, and a learned scalar gate combines modality-specific correlation embeddings for each patch--frame edge before a shared recurrent refinement and bundle-adjustment update. DAPEVO also supports event-only observations, enabling continued tracking when RGB frames are sparse or unavailable, while modality-aware keyframe culling preserves scarce frame constraints. On UZH-FPV, when retaining only one in six RGB frames, DAPEVO's mean absolute trajectory error (ATE) increases by only 36%, from 1.00 to 1.36m, whereas the ATE of DPVO and RAMP-VO rises by factors of $3.7\times$ and $3.1\times$, respectively. On TartanEvent, DAPEVO similarly remains below 1m ATE at 3Hz RGB input, while DPVO and RAMP-VO exceed 9m. Under degraded RGB input on TartanEvent, DAPEVO achieves an ATE of 0.60m, compared with more than 4m for both DPVO and RAMP-VO, while also outperforming event-only DEVO at 0.87m.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAPEVO 在共享 patch 位置上分别估计图像与事件的相关性证据，用学习到的标量门控融合后再做循环精修与 bundle adjustment，从而在 RGB 稀疏或缺失时靠事件模态维持跟踪。在 UZH-FPV 只保留六分之一 RGB 帧时 ATE 仅从 1.00m 升到 1.36m（+36%），而 DPVO 与 RAMP-VO 分别恶化 3.7× 和 3.1×。
Motivation: GPS 拒止环境下的视觉里程计依赖 RGB，但运动模糊、光照剧变和掉帧会破坏对应估计；事件相机时间分辨率与动态范围高，其异步测量又让可靠对应难以做。
Method: 在共享 patch 位置独立估计图像与事件对应，各自维护描述子，把两路 correlation embedding 经学习的标量门控按 patch-frame 边融合，再送入共享的循环精修与 bundle adjustment 更新；支持 event-only 观测，并用 modality-aware keyframe culling 保留稀缺帧约束。
Result: UZH-FPV 上只保留六分之一 RGB 帧时 DAPEVO 的 ATE 仅升 36%（1.00→1.36m），DPVO 与 RAMP-VO 分别恶化 3.7× 与 3.1×；TartanEvent 上 3Hz RGB 输入时 DAPEVO ATE 低于 1m，DPVO 与 RAMP-VO 超过 9m；TartanEvent 退化 RGB 输入下 DAPEVO ATE 0.60m，两个基线均超过 4m，且优于 event-only 的 DEVO（0.87m）。
Conclusion: 把图像与事件的相关证据在 patch 级门控融合，可在 RGB 稀疏或退化时把轨迹误差压在 1m 量级，明显稳于纯帧方法并胜过纯事件方法。

papers.title: OneWorld: Learning Consistent Physics Across Actions in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned video world models aim to predict scene evolution under different actions, a capability that is essential for reliable planning, decision-making, and interaction in dynamic environments. However, futures generated independently from the same initial scene may each appear plausible while implying incompatible physical properties, such as friction or mass. This inconsistency can lead to contradictory predictions across interventions, making it difficult for the model to maintain a coherent understanding of the underlying world and limiting its reliability for planning and decision-making. To address these issues, we propose OneWorld, a shared-mechanism counterfactual generation framework that jointly models multiple action-conditioned futures under a common latent physical mechanism. A physical mechanism interpreter first infers a distribution over latent mechanisms from each action-outcome branch. These distributions are then aggregated into shared-world evidence, which captures whether the branches admit a common physical explanation while accounting for uncertainty in less informative branches. This evidence constrains flow training and guides sampling, encouraging consistency in the underlying physical mechanism while preserving the distinct outcomes induced by different actions. We further introduce a multi-intervention evaluation protocol in controlled environments, following the interaction settings of ACWM-Phys, to assess whether generated futures can be jointly explained by the same physical parameters, alongside standard measures of single-rollout prediction quality. Experiments in these environments show that OneWorld improves cross-intervention physical consistency while maintaining competitive single-rollout prediction quality.

papers.title: LogicTree-RAG: Logic Tree-guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-form Patent Drafting
papers.abstract_en: Long-form technical text generation underpins knowledge-intensive workflows, yet remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to the need for globally consistent logical structuring and faithful technical reasoning beyond local coherence. Patent drafting is a canonical instance of this challenge, demanding holistic generation of a legally compliant and technically exhaustive document through sustained multi-expert collaboration. Existing approaches often focus on partial section generation or rely on manually crafted outlines, limiting scalable automation in realistic settings. In this work, we propose LogicTree-RAG, a logic tree-guided retrieval-augmented generation framework that induces a hierarchical logic tree as a global organizational backbone to organize and ground technical disclosures, without relying on expert-defined drafting priors. Each node in the logic tree represents a technical element and is constructed through evidence-guided recursive generation. A hybrid traversal mechanism then maps the logic tree into patent sections, enabling controllable and section-balanced generation. Extensive experiments show that LogicTree-RAG consistently improves content quality and language conformity over strong LLM-based baselines and achieves longer structured generation with high token efficiency, demonstrating the effectiveness of logic-centric generation for complex technical document drafting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LogicTree-RAG 用层次化逻辑树作为全局组织骨架来做长篇专利撰写：每个节点代表一个技术要素，经证据引导的递归生成构建，再由混合遍历机制把树映射到专利各节，实现可控且章节均衡的生成。实验显示其在内容质量与语言合规性上稳定优于强 LLM 基线，并以更高的 token 效率产出更长的结构化文本。
Motivation: 长篇技术文本生成要求全局逻辑一致与忠实的技术推理，而不仅是局部连贯；现有专利撰写方法多局限于分节生成或依赖人工大纲，难以在真实场景中规模化自动化。
Method: 提出 LogicTree-RAG：先归纳出层次化逻辑树作为全局组织骨架，每个节点对应一个技术要素，通过证据引导的递归生成 (evidence-guided recursive generation) 构建节点；再用混合遍历机制 (hybrid traversal) 将树映射为专利章节，实现可控、章节均衡的生成，全程不依赖专家定义的撰写先验。
Result: 在实验中，LogicTree-RAG 相对强 LLM 基线在内容质量与语言合规性上一致提升，并实现更长的结构化生成且 token 效率高。
Conclusion: 以逻辑树为中心的生成范式对复杂技术文档撰写有效，可在不依赖人工大纲的前提下支撑全局一致、章节均衡的长篇专利生成。

papers.title: Spackle: Completing Large View Single Image NVS with Adaptive Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Single-image novel view synthesis (NVS) enables photorealistic rendering of un- observed viewpoints from a single input. Practical NVS systems require two key capabilities: robust reconstruction of occluded regions and high inference effi- ciency. While hybrid decoupled frameworks combining feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and diffusion models show promise for large-view-deviation NVS, they suffer from capacity competition: a fixed number of Gaussians forces resource shifts from visible to newly disoccluded areas, degrading original scene fidelity when the target view deviates significantly from the input. To address this, we propose Spackle, a lightweight residual learning framework that mit- igates capacity competition without sacrificing efficiency. Spackle operates in three stages: predicting base 3DGS attributes from given views, automatically identifying poorly reconstructed regions, and learning a residual 3DGS optimized exclusively for these areas. At inference, we combine the baseline and aug- mented Gaussians for NVS. We conduct comprehensive experiments and show that Spackle achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-view-deviation cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spackle 用三阶段残差学习解决单图大视角偏差 NVS 中的容量竞争：先从给定视角预测基础 3DGS 属性，再自动定位重建差的区域，只对这些区域学习一份残差 3DGS，推理时把基础与增补高斯合并。摘要称其在大视角偏差场景达到 state-of-the-art，且保持轻量推理效率。
Motivation: 前馈 3DGS 与扩散混合的解耦框架中高斯数量固定，目标视角偏离输入大时资源被迫从可见区转向新显露 (disoccluded) 区，导致原场景保真度下降。
Method: 三阶段残差学习框架：从给定视角预测基础 3DGS 属性；自动识别重建差的区域；仅针对这些区域学习优化的残差 3DGS，推理时合并 baseline 与 augmented 高斯完成 NVS。
Result: 在大视角偏差 (large-view-deviation) 案例上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，同时以轻量残差方式避免容量竞争、不牺牲推理效率。
Conclusion: 把新增高斯作为只覆盖重建差区域的残差来分配容量，可以在不增加固定高斯预算竞争的前提下支撑大视角偏差的单图 NVS。

papers.title: Financial Fragility in Societies of LLM Agents: Coordination Failures and Stabilizing Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Individually protective decisions can produce avoidable collective failures. As large language model (LLM) agents take on greater roles in financial decision-making, financial AI safety must therefore be considered not only at the level of individual agents, but also at the level of the systems they jointly create. We study this problem with FRAIL, a controlled experimental framework that places LLM agents in three dynamic financial environments---bank runs, debt rollover, and reward crowdfunding---where agents' decisions reshape the financial conditions faced by others. Across seven leading LLMs, we find widespread collective fragility even when no agent is instructed to destabilize the system: 77\% of baseline bank-run episodes and 83\% of debt-rollover episodes end in failure. We then compare three interaction mechanisms based on compensated commitments, centralized commitment agreements, and participant-led coalitions. All three improve aggregate outcomes, but no single mechanism performs best across all financial structures. Across mechanisms, successful stabilization shares a common temporal pattern: broad commitment forms early, before defensive behavior becomes self-reinforcing. Our findings show that individually capable agents do not automatically form safe financial systems, highlighting system-level evaluation and interaction design as central problems for financial AI safety. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinFrail-CF26.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRAIL 框架把 LLM agent 放进银行挤兑、债务展期、奖励众筹三类动态金融环境中，77% 的基线银行挤兑回合和 83% 的债务展期回合以系统失败告终，即使没有任何 agent 被指示破坏稳定。补偿性承诺、集中式承诺协议、参与者自组织联盟三种交互机制都能改善总体结果，但没有一种在全部金融结构上最优；成功稳定的共同时间模式是广泛承诺在防御行为自我强化之前早期形成。
Motivation: 个体层面稳健的 LLM agent 决策可能合成集体性金融失败，而现有金融 AI 安全评估只看单个 agent，缺少对 agent 共同构成的系统层面的实验评估与交互设计。
Method: 提出受控实验框架 FRAIL，设置银行挤兑、债务展期、奖励众筹三类 agent 决策会相互重塑他人所处金融条件的动态环境，跨七个主流 LLM 测试基线行为，并对比三种交互机制：补偿性承诺、集中式承诺协议、参与者自组织联盟。
Result: 跨七个领先 LLM，77% 的基线银行挤兑回合与 83% 的债务展期回合以失败告终，且无 agent 被指示破坏稳定。三种机制均改善总体结果，但无单一机制在所有金融结构上最优；跨机制的成功稳定共享同一时间模式——广泛承诺在防御行为自我强化之前早期形成。
Conclusion: 个体能力强的 agent 不会自动构成安全的金融系统，系统层面评估与交互设计应成为金融 AI 安全的核心问题；稳定的关键在于抢在防御行为自我强化之前早期形成广泛承诺。

papers.title: MACBT: A Multi-Agent Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Decision Support System with Longitudinal Memory
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) is an evidence-based first-line treatment for depression, yet its scale is constrained by the time clinicians spend on pre-session preparation, post-session documentation, and longitudinal cognitive-pathology tracking. We present a clinician-facing AI decision-support system that combines a multi-agent CBT framework (MACBT) with a CBT-specific longitudinal memory module (CD Memory). MACBT encodes the five-stage CBT workflow (assessment, Socratic questioning, cognitive restructuring, behavioral experiments, and treatment monitoring) into five collaborative agents. CD Memory tracks cognitive-distortion type, frequency, severity, and restructuring efficacy across sessions to generate pre-session pathology reports and intervention-priority recommendations. We construct a Chinese CBT dialogue corpus via dual-role large language model simulation and train a Qwen3-14B backbone with supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Evaluation with GPT-4 judges shows MACBT outperforms MeChat, SoulChat, PsyChat, and CPsyCounX in professionalism (2.62) and clinical authenticity (2.25). The full memory-augmented system further improves session quality by 12.6% and achieves a longitudinal mean of 2.29 on cross-session continuity, intervention progression, and personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MACBT 把 CBT 五阶段流程（评估、苏格拉底式提问、认知重构、行为实验、治疗监测）拆成五个协作智能体，配合 CD Memory 跨会话追踪认知扭曲的类型、频率、严重度与重构疗效，自动生成会前病理报告与干预优先级建议。用 GPT-4 评判时其专业性 2.62、临床真实性 2.25，高于 MeChat、SoulChat、PsyChat、CPsyCounX；加记忆后会话质量再提升 12.6%，跨会话连续性等三项纵向均值 2.29。
Motivation: CBT 是抑郁一线疗法，但规模受限于临床医生的会前准备、会后记录与纵向认知病理追踪耗时，需要面向医生的决策支持系统来压缩这些环节。
Method: 多智能体框架 MACBT 编码五阶段 CBT 工作流为五个协作智能体；CD Memory 记录认知扭曲类型、频率、严重度与重构疗效以产出会前报告和干预优先级。用双角色 LLM 模拟构建中文 CBT 对话语料，对 Qwen3-14B 做 SFT 与 DPO 训练，评测由 GPT-4 担任评判。
Result: GPT-4 评判下 MACBT 在专业性上得 2.62、临床真实性 2.25，优于 MeChat、SoulChat、PsyChat 与 CPsyCounX；加入记忆的完整系统会话质量再提高 12.6%，在跨会话连续性、干预推进与个性化三项上纵向均值 2.29。
Conclusion: 把 CBT 工作流结构化为多智能体并配以纵向认知病理记忆，可在医生侧同时提升单次会话质量与跨会话的连续性、干预推进和个性化。

papers.title: Self-Play Search Distillation for Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Improving reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires high-quality data that exposes difficult decisions, competing alternatives, and their consequences. Data scarcity is driven by the low quality of synthetic data and the cost of human labeling. We introduce Self-Play Search Distillation (SPSD), a framework for generating superhuman synthetic data via self-play of MuZero-like networks trained on board games. SPSD uses executable environments to turn search into structured reasoning problems. At each state, the expert identifies a preferred decision, plausible alternatives, plausible opponent replies, and value estimates. By converting the self-play search records into superhuman chains-of-thought, we train LLMs with environment-grounded supervision. Although trained only on self-play search records, SPSD transfers to unseen mathematics. On Qwen3-4B-Base, it raises the mean over six mathematics benchmarks from 24.1 to 36.6 while increasing the held-out-game win rate from 15% to 45%. SPSD offers an annotation-efficient way to create high-quality synthetic data for improving LLM performance in reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Play Search Distillation (SPSD)：用在棋类上自博弈训练的 MuZero 式网络做搜索，把每个状态的首选决策、备选、对手回应与价值估计转成超人级 chain-of-thought，作为环境可验证的监督去训练 LLM 推理。在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，六个数学基准均值从 24.1 提到 36.6，留出棋局胜率从 15% 升到 45%，且训练数据只来自自博弈搜索记录。
Motivation: LLM 推理训练缺少能暴露困难决策、竞争性备选及其后果的高质量数据：合成数据质量低、人工标注昂贵，造成数据稀缺。
Method: SPSD 框架在棋类可执行环境上训练 MuZero 式网络并做自博弈搜索，把搜索记录（首选决策、备选走法、对手回应、价值估计）转换为超人级 chain-of-thought，用这种环境落地的监督微调 LLM；训练数据仅由自博弈搜索记录构成。

papers.title: Estimating and Orthogonalizing Unknown Pre-training Gradients for Continual Fine-tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continual fine-tuning is essential for large language models (LLMs) to dynamically adapt to real-world environments, yet it inevitably suffers from catastrophic forgetting, particularly the performance degradation of previous tasks and LLMs' general-purpose knowledge. Although existing methods, such as orthogonal gradient projection, mitigate the forgetting across various fine-tuning tasks, they fundamentally fail to preserve pre-training LLMs' inherent general-purpose knowledge because the original data and gradients of off-the-shelf pre-training LLMs required by these methods are strictly unknown and highly diverse. To bridge this critical gap, we propose EoupCT, a novel framework designed to Estimate and Orthogonalize Unknown Pre-training gradients for Continual LLM fine-Tuning. Specifically, EoupCT estimates pre-training gradients by dynamically generating pseudo data that is most susceptible to forgetting for new tasks through a learnable soft prompt equipped with Gumbel-Softmax relaxation. Furthermore, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem and introduce a first-order efficient Pareto optimizer that jointly optimizes LLM parameters and the soft prompt, rigorously enforcing orthogonality between new task updates and the estimated pre-training gradients. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs demonstrate that EoupCT effectively preserves both task-specific proficiency and inherent general-purpose knowledge, successfully mitigating the catastrophic forgetting.
papers.comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/wangbing1416/EoupCT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EoupCT 针对 LLM 持续微调中的灾难性遗忘：用带 Gumbel-Softmax 松弛的可学习 soft prompt 动态生成最易被遗忘的伪数据，据此估计原本不可知的预训练梯度，再以一阶高效 Pareto 优化器联合优化模型与 prompt，强制新任务更新与估计梯度正交。在多个 LLM 上的实验表明该框架同时保住任务能力与通用知识，缓解灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 正交梯度投影类方法需要原始预训练数据与梯度，而现成 LLM 的这些信息严格未知且高度多样，导致它们无法真正保护预训练阶段的通用知识。
Method: 提出 EoupCT：以可学习 soft prompt 配合 Gumbel-Softmax 松弛动态生成对新任务最易遗忘的伪数据来估计预训练梯度；构造多目标优化问题，用一阶高效 Pareto 优化器联合优化 LLM 参数与 soft prompt，强制新任务更新与估计梯度正交。
Result: 在多个 LLM 上的大量实验显示 EoupCT 同时保持任务特定能力与内在通用知识，成功缓解灾难性遗忘（NeurIPS 2026 接收，29 页 3 图，代码已开源）。
Conclusion: 预训练梯度虽不可直接获取，但可通过针对性伪数据估计并做正交约束，从而在持续微调中同时守住新任务表现与通用知识。

papers.title: ManiVid: Unified and Explainable Forensic Analysis of Manipulated Videos
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advances in AI-generated video (AIGV) have increased the risks posed by deceptive video manipulation. Unlike fully synthetic videos, manipulated videos retain most source content and alter only localized regions, making forensic analysis particularly challenging. Existing video forgery research faces two limitations in both data and methodology: (1) High-quality datasets and benchmarks tailored for manipulated videos remain scarce. (2) Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend forgery analysis beyond binary classification but struggle to use low-level forensic cues and provide precise pixel-level grounding. Specifically, we introduce ManiVid, a unified forensic analysis task covering forgery detection, artifact grounding, and anomaly explanation for manipulated videos. We construct ManiVid-38K, the first dataset to combine paired, open-vocabulary localized manipulations of general videos with authenticity labels, forgery masks, and anomaly explanations. It comprises about 19K manually verified real-fake video pairs, mostly at 1080P resolution, generated under 2 paradigms with 15 powerful generation models. We sample 1K pairs for ManiVidBench, balanced across six manipulation types and generation models for fair evaluation. We further propose ManiVidLens, a unified framework for explainable video forgery analysis. Its Forensic Evidence Router supplies shared low-level forensic evidence for multimodal reasoning and video segmentation. Its Prompt Distill Module converts grounding states into semantic and geometric prompts and distills spatial priors for mask decoding and full-video propagation. ManiVidLens achieves relative gains over the strongest comparison methods in artifact grounding (+21.1% mIoU; +21.3% J&F) and anomaly explanation (+131.3% ROUGE-L; +9.9% CSS). Its forgery detection remains comparable to dedicated classifiers (0.914 Acc; 0.913 F1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManiVid 把被篡改视频的取证统一成检测、伪影定位、异常解释三项任务，并构建 ManiVid-38K 数据集与 ManiVidLens 框架。ManiVidLens 在伪影定位上相对最强对比方法 mIoU +21.1%、J&F +21.3%，异常解释 ROUGE-L +131.3%、CSS +9.9%，检测达 0.914 Acc / 0.913 F1。
Motivation: 被篡改视频只改动局部区域、保留大部分原始内容，现有取证研究既缺面向此类视频的高质量数据集与基准，多模态大模型也难以利用低层取证线索做像素级定位。
Method: 构建 ManiVid-38K：约 19K 对人工核验的真伪视频对，多为 1080P，覆盖 2 种生成范式与 15 个生成模型，附真实性标签、伪造掩码与异常解释；从中采样 1K 对构成 ManiVidBench，按 6 种篡改类型与生成模型平衡。提出 ManiVidLens：Forensic Evidence Router 为多模态推理与视频分割提供共享低层取证证据，Prompt Distill Module 将定位状态转成语义与几何 prompt 并蒸馏空间先验，用于掩码解码与全视频传播。
Result: 在 ManiVidBench 上，ManiVidLens 相对最强对比方法：伪影定位 mIoU +21.1%、J&F +21.3%；异常解释 ROUGE-L +131.3%、CSS +9.9%；伪造检测 0.914 Acc、0.913 F1，与专用分类器相当。
Conclusion: 共享低层取证证据加 prompt 蒸馏可让单一框架同时完成检测、像素级定位与解释，且定位与解释显著超过最强对比方法而检测不掉点。

papers.title: EPOC: Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction With Compressed Residual State for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Completed multi-horizon forecasts provide residual feedback for a fixed forecaster, but retaining full residual blocks increases auxiliary state. We propose Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction (EPOC) with a compressed residual state. It stores low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients and the final value of the preceding residual block. Within each channel, the endpoint is shared across component-wise online ridge regressions that also use current-forecast coefficients. The fitted DCT correction is blended with the base forecast. We evaluate eight multivariate series with DLinear and PatchTST, three seeds, and two training variants, yielding 96 matched fixed-base conditions at a 24-step horizon. EPOC achieves mean condition-wise reductions in mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.40% and 9.35% from the uncorrected base, respectively, with a median of 6,352 B in retained auxiliary arrays. It has lower paired MSE than the $δ$-Adapter, COSA, FAC, and OMPB in a majority of conditions and uses less state than each. Full ELF achieves the largest mean MSE reduction, 19.29%, but its median retained state is 474,048 B ($\times$75 relative to EPOC). Equal-size summary controls favor the endpoint by 1.65--2.20% in paired MSE; a coefficient-reconstructed endpoint yields similar accuracy to the observed endpoint, highlighting its role as a shared input. Increasing the retained DCT component count from 4 to 8 adds 1.00 percentage point of MSE reduction for 5,728 B. On jointly trained bases, EPOC lowers MSE by 16.69--20.15% relative to globally blended TEFL-style adapters applied to the same base. The code and numerical records are available at https://github.com/keiotakmin/endpoint-preserving-residual-correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EPOC 用压缩残差状态做多步时间序列的在线修正：只存前一残差块的低阶 DCT 系数与末值，末值在各分量的在线岭回归间共享，拟合出的 DCT 修正与基预报混合。在 8 条多变量序列、DLinear 与 PatchTST、3 个种子、2 种训练变体共 96 个固定基条件下（24 步时域），相对未修正基线 MSE 平均降 15.40%、MAE 降 9.35%，中位保留状态仅 6,352 B。
Motivation: 已完成的多步预报能为固定预报器提供残差反馈，但保留完整残差块会显著膨胀辅助状态；需要在修正精度与状态开销之间取得可量化的折中。
Method: EPOC 存储残差块的低阶 DCT 系数与末值；末值在同一通道内被各分量级在线岭回归 (component-wise online ridge regression) 共享，并结合当前预报系数，拟合出的 DCT 修正与基预报加权混合。评测覆盖 8 条多变量序列、DLinear 与 PatchTST、3 个种子、2 种训练变体，共 96 个匹配的固定基条件，时域 24 步。
Result: 相对未修正基，EPOC 的条件平均 MSE 降 15.40%、MAE 降 9.35%，保留辅助数组中位 6,352 B；在多数条件下配对 MSE 低于 δ-Adapter、COSA、FAC、OMPB 且状态更小。Full ELF 平均 MSE 降幅最大为 19.29%，但中位状态 474,048 B（为 EPOC 的 75 倍）。等大小摘要对照中末值带来 1.65–2.20% 的配对 MSE 优势；用系数重构的末值与观测末值精度相近。DCT 分量数从 4 增到 8，多花 5,728 B 换来 1.00 个百分点的 MSE 降幅。在联合训练的基上，EPOC 相对同基的全局混合 TEFL 式 adapter 降低 MSE 16.69–20.15%。
Conclusion: 把残差块压缩为低阶 DCT 系数加一个跨回归共享的末值，就能在远小于完整残差或 ELF 状态的开销下拿到大部分在线修正收益；末值作为共享输入是关键，且增加保留 DCT 分量数可继续换取精度。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: UltraG-Bench: A Multi-task Benchmark for assessing Large Vision-Language Models on Pixel-level Evidence Grounding in Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound is one of the most widely used medical imaging modalities, and recent large vision-language models(VLMs) have shown increasing capabilities in ultrasound image understanding. However, these models fail to provide pixel-level visual evidence aligned with their semantic predictions, and their fine-grained grounding capability in ultrasound remains largely unclear. We introduce UltraG-Bench, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for evaluating pixel-level evidence grounding in ultrasound. UltraG-Bench is built by annotating 40 public ultrasound segmentation datasets spanning 13 anatomical categories, and comprises three progressive tasks: instruction-guided segmentation, evidence-grounded VQA, and evidence-grounded report generation, with 331125, 666779, and 138832 annotations, respectively. Comprehensive evaluation of 14 state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial gap between semantic understanding and fine-grained pixel-level localization. We further propose UltraG-Agent, which combines the semantic reasoning capabilities of a VLM with the ultrasound-specific segmentation capability of UltraSAM3. Experiments show that UltraG-Agent substantially improves both semantic prediction and pixel-level visual grounding. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/zhuqh19/UltraG-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraG-Bench 是超声像素级证据定位 (pixel-level evidence grounding) 多任务基准，由 40 个公开超声分割数据集标注而成，含指令引导分割、证据引导 VQA、证据引导报告生成三项递进任务，标注量分别为 331125、666779、138832。对 14 个前沿 VLM 的评测显示语义理解与像素级定位之间存在明显落差；提出的 UltraG-Agent 把 VLM 语义推理与超声专用分割模型 UltraSAM3 结合，同时提升了语义预测与像素级视觉定位。
Motivation: VLM 在超声图像理解上能给出语义预测，却无法提供与预测对齐的像素级视觉证据，其细粒度定位能力缺乏可评测的基准。

Conclusion: 超声场景下 VLM 的语义理解不能自动转化为像素级定位，把 VLM 推理与超声专用分割模型组合是弥合该落差的可行路径；数据集与代码已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: JevSoup: System-One Routing for Training-Free LoRA Composition
papers.abstract_en: Building adaptable AI systems requires effective coordination of specialized capabilities across diverse tasks. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables modular expertise, but existing routing approaches may require auxiliary data, additional training, or autoregressive decoding. We propose JevSoup, a training-free framework separating System One expert routing from System Two execution. Using only the input and expert descriptions, Jev selects two experts through structured probabilities. JevSoup retains the leading expert's update, projects the second onto the orthogonal complement of the first update's row space, and combines them with equal weights. Across 14 PorTAL tasks and three Qwen3 scales, JepSoup achieves absolute gains of up to 1.19\% in task-macro and 1.21\% in sample-micro accuracy over the strongest evaluated external baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Leowang980/JevSoup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JevSoup 是免训练的 LoRA 组合框架：System One 只凭输入与专家描述用结构化概率选出两个专家，System Two 执行时保留首位专家的更新，把第二位投影到首位更新行空间的正交补上再等权相加。在 14 个 PorTAL 任务与三档 Qwen3 规模上，相对最强外部基线 task-macro accuracy 绝对提升最高 1.19%，sample-micro 最高 1.21%。
Motivation: LoRA 让能力模块化，但现有路由方案需要辅助数据、额外训练或自回归解码，难以在部署时即插即用地组合专家。
Method: 将路由与执行分离为 System One / System Two：Jev 仅依据输入和专家描述，通过结构化概率选出两个专家；组合时保留 top-1 专家更新，把第二个专家的更新投影到第一个更新行空间的正交补 (orthogonal complement) 中，再以等权重相加，全程免训练。
Result: 在 14 个 PorTAL 任务、三档 Qwen3 规模上，相对所评估的最强外部基线，task-macro accuracy 绝对增益最高 1.19%，sample-micro accuracy 绝对增益最高 1.21%。
Conclusion: 免辅助数据、免额外训练的结构化双专家路由加正交投影组合，即可在多任务 LoRA 组合上取得正向绝对增益。

papers.title: Robust to Which Model Change? A Unified Evaluation of Robust Counterfactual Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Robust counterfactual explanations promise recourse that still works after the model behind it changes. Whether they keep that promise depends on what the change is. A small perturbation of the parameters, retraining on new data, and a new architecture are different events, and each existing method is evaluated against the one it was built for. Reported robustness scores, therefore, answer different questions and cannot be compared. We propose a unified cross-family evaluation protocol that holds factual instances and generated counterfactuals fixed while testing every method against the same eight types of model change. The benchmark compares six robust methods and two standard baselines on four tabular datasets. It characterizes every changed classifier through its outputs and reports empirical robustness together with coverage, base validity, and proximity. We find that relative performance and failure modes vary across change families. Bounded parameter perturbations change 0.95\% of test predictions on average, compared with 4.9\% for bootstrap retraining. Methods with guarantees for these perturbations do not necessarily transfer to other changes. RobX transfers most consistently in our experiments, although greater stability can require larger interventions. We argue that robust CFE methods should be evaluated through a common protocol that specifies the model changes, measures their realized behavioral magnitude, and keeps generation performance separate from robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的反事实解释 (counterfactual explanation) 跨家族评测协议：固定事实样本与已生成的反事实，用同一套八类模型变更测试所有鲁棒方法。在四个表格数据集上比较六个鲁棒方法与两个标准基线，发现有界参数扰动平均只改变 0.95% 的测试预测，而 bootstrap 重训练改变 4.9%；针对前者给出保证的方法未必迁移到其他变更，RobX 在实验中最一致，但更强稳定性需要更大干预。
Motivation: 鲁棒反事实解释声称在模型变更后仍提供有效救济 (recourse)，但现有方法各自只在自己针对的那类变更下评测，报告的鲁棒性分数回答的是不同问题，彼此不可比较。
Method: 提出统一跨家族评测协议：固定事实实例与已生成的反事实，让每个方法面对同样八类模型变更；通过变更后分类器的输出刻画变更本身，并同时报告经验鲁棒性、coverage、base validity 与 proximity，把生成性能与鲁棒性分开。
Result: 在四个表格数据集上比较六个鲁棒方法与两个标准基线：有界参数扰动平均改变 0.95% 的测试预测，bootstrap 重训练为 4.9%；相对性能与失败模式随变更家族变化，针对有界扰动给出保证的方法不必然迁移到其他变更；RobX 在实验中迁移最一致，但更大稳定性可能需要更大干预。
Conclusion: 鲁棒 CFE 方法应在统一协议下评测：明确指定模型变更、测量其实际行为幅度，并把生成性能与鲁棒性分开报告。

papers.title: Training Graph Foundation Models on The Web Graph
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Acacia, a graph foundation model, trained on the web graph. Acacia (i) supports arbitrary feature dimensionalities and semantics without additional training, (ii) supports a wide range of tasks, including node classification, link prediction, node clustering, and graph generation, without additional training, (iii) has in-context learning capabilities, and (iv) does not rely on pretrained LLMs. In particular, existing graph foundation models often require training additional classification heads or feature projectors to accommodate new graphs or new labels, whereas Acacia does not. Moreover, existing graph foundation models often gain their capabilities by being stitched together with pretrained LLMs, whereas Acacia is trained from scratch using only the Common Crawl web graph. This is also an important result because it provides evidence that graph models can acquire emergent capabilities from scratch like LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Acacia 是一个只用 Common Crawl web graph 从零训练的图基础模型，不依赖预训练 LLM，即可在任意特征维度与语义的新图上直接支持节点分类、链接预测、节点聚类与图生成，并具备 in-context learning 能力。作者据此主张：图模型也能像 LLM 一样从零训练获得涌现能力。
Motivation: 现有图基础模型换新图或新标签时往往要额外训练分类头或特征投影器，且能力多靠与预训练 LLM 拼接获得，缺少从零训练即可泛化的证据。
Method: 在 Common Crawl web graph 上从零训练图基础模型 Acacia，不接入任何预训练 LLM；设计上支持任意特征维度与语义，无需为新图或新标签追加训练分类头或特征投影器，并支持 in-context learning。
Result: Acacia 无需额外训练即可覆盖节点分类、链接预测、节点 clustering、图生成四类任务，并支持任意特征维度与语义；训练仅用 Common Crawl web graph，不依赖预训练 LLM。
Conclusion: 只用 web graph 从零训练的图模型可以像 LLM 一样获得涌现能力，从而免去为新图、新标签追加分类头或投影器的步骤。

papers.title: Adaptive Pilot Selection for Unified Semantic Communication and Semantic Sensing in ISAC
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) are promising technologies for future 6G wireless networks. Existing studies have applied semantic technology to either the communication module or the sensing module of ISAC. In this work, we propose SemISAC, which performs both SemCom and semantic sensing within a single dual-function waveform. SemISAC uses a joint semantic encoder that extracts task-specific information for both communication and sensing. We evaluate SemISAC in a vehicular scenario in which vehicles share pixel-wise segmentation of the road environment and, through sensing, classify surrounding objects and estimate their ranges. On the transmitter side, a deep learning encoder converts the input road-scene image into semantic symbols and places them on the data cells of an OFDM grid, while the remaining cells serve as pilots for channel state information estimation and sensing. The pilot configuration is adaptively optimized based on the channel conditions to balance communication and sensing requirements. At the receiver, a deep learning model reconstructs the segmentation from the received waveform, while the transmitting vehicle captures the reflected waveforms from surrounding objects and uses task-specific deep learning decoders for target recognition and range estimation. Simulation results show that SemISAC achieves a segmentation accuracy close to that of the dedicated SemCom module while outperforming both conventional and semantic baselines in target recognition and range estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SemISAC，在单一 OFDM 双功能波形里同时做语义通信与语义感知：联合语义编码器把道路场景图像压成语义符号放进数据子载波，剩余子载波作导频并按信道条件自适应配置，以平衡通信与感知。仿真中分割精度接近专用 SemCom 模块，目标识别与测距同时优于传统与语义基线。
Motivation: 现有 ISAC 研究只把语义技术用在通信或感知一侧，通信与感知无法在同一波形内共享任务相关信息并按信道条件权衡。
Method: 深度学习编码器将道路场景图像转为语义符号映射到 OFDM 数据格，其余格作导频用于 CSI 估计与感知；导频配置按信道条件自适应优化；接收端用深度模型从接收波形重建分割，发射车用反射波形加任务专用解码器做目标识别与距离估计。
Result: 仿真结果：SemISAC 的像素级分割精度接近专用 SemCom 模块，同时在目标识别与距离估计上优于传统基线与语义基线。
Conclusion: 单一双功能波形配合自适应导频选择即可让语义通信与语义感知共存，且分割几乎不损失、感知任务反而更好。

papers.title: From Tapping to Hopping: Augmenting Mobile GUI Agents with App-Native Deeplinks
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents complete tasks using GUI actions like taps and swipes. These actions are broadly applicable across applications, but reaching a navigation interface. A single deeplink call can replace a sequence of screen-by-screen GUI actions. We therefore introduce hybrid interaction, using deeplinks for direct navigation and GUI actions for other on-screen operations and fallback. To enable this, we discover candidate deeplinks through static analysis, validate them on real devices, and describe their observed landing screens. This process creates a verified and grounded deeplink catalog that pairs each working deeplink with a description of its landing screen. Using this catalog, we introduce GUI-Hopper, a improves task success in commercial applications on real devices, further demonstrating the benefits of hybrid interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI-Hopper 为移动 GUI agent 引入混合交互：用静态分析挖掘候选 deeplink、在真机上验证并描述其落地页，形成带落地页描述的已验证 deeplink 目录，导航用一次 deeplink 调用替代逐屏点击，其余屏上操作仍走 GUI 动作并保留回退。作者称该方法在真机商用应用上提升了任务成功率。
Motivation: 移动 GUI agent 依赖逐屏 tap/swipe 到达目标导航界面，路径长且易失败，而一次 deeplink 调用本可替代整段逐屏操作。
Method: 三步构建 deeplink 目录：静态分析发现候选 deeplink，在真实设备上验证可用性，并记录每个 deeplink 的落地屏描述；GUI-Hopper 据此混合调用 deeplink 直达导航与 GUI 动作完成其余操作及回退。
Result: 在真机上的商用应用任务中，GUI-Hopper 提升了任务成功率，作者以此说明混合交互（deeplink + GUI 动作）的收益；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把经真机验证、带落地页描述的 deeplink 目录接入 agent，可让导航从逐屏点击变为单次跳转，从而提高真实商用应用上的任务完成率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal Prediction under Exponential-Tilt Joint Shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction can lose coverage when the data distribution changes after deployment. We study adaptation using labeled source data and unlabeled target inputs, allowing both the input distribution and its relationship with outcomes to change. We use Exponential Tilt Reweighting Alignment (ExTRA), introduced for classification by Maity et al. (2023), to estimate structured distribution shifts. We compare using its estimated weights in conformal calibration with additionally tilting the source predictive distribution. Shared learned predictors, estimated weights, calibration samples, and test observations isolate the effect of tilting. Existing theory gives both procedures target coverage with true weights and a common coverage bound with estimated weights. Identification calculations and an analysis of how scoring interacts with weight estimation error help explain why their performance can nevertheless differ. In a synthetic regression setting where the assumed models match the data-generating process and target inputs are informative about the shift, tilting reduces mean set length by about $30\%$ relative to weighting alone, with both methods attaining coverage near nominal. Tilting can instead cause substantial coverage losses in synthetic classification and in regression when target inputs provide little information about the response shift. Real-data experiments also show no consistent benefit. Good coverage from weighted calibration alone does not ensure that adding predictive tilting will preserve coverage. Deciding when to apply this additional adjustment using only source labels and target inputs remains an open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在指数倾斜联合分布偏移 (exponential-tilt joint shift) 下，把 ExTRA 估计的权重既用于 conformal 校准、又进一步倾斜源预测分布，在模型匹配且目标输入对偏移有信息时把平均预测集长度压低约 30%，覆盖率仍接近名义值；但当目标输入对响应偏移信息很少时，tilting 会造成显著覆盖损失，真实数据实验也没有一致收益。作者据此提醒：仅凭加权校准的良好覆盖，不能保证叠加预测倾斜后仍保覆盖。
Motivation: 部署后数据分布变化会让 conformal prediction 丢失覆盖率；现有理论只在真权重下保证两种程序的目标覆盖、在估计权重下给出共同的覆盖界，无法解释二者实际表现为何不同。
Method: 沿用 Maity et al. (2023) 的 Exponential Tilt Reweighting Alignment (ExTRA) 用有标签源数据与无标签目标输入估计结构化偏移权重，对比两条路线：仅把估计权重用于 conformal 校准，以及在校准之外再倾斜源预测分布；共享学习到的预测器、估计权重、校准样本与测试观测以隔离 tilting 的作用，并辅以识别性计算与打分同权重估计误差交互的分析。
Result: 合成回归中（假设模型与数据生成过程匹配、目标输入对偏移有信息）：tilting 相对仅加权使平均集合长度减少约 30%，两者覆盖率都接近名义值。合成分类、以及目标输入对响应偏移信息很少的回归中，tilting 导致显著覆盖损失；真实数据实验同样没有一致收益。
Conclusion: 预测倾斜只在目标输入确实携带响应偏移信息时才缩短集合且不伤覆盖，否则反而破坏覆盖；何时叠加这一调整，仅凭源标签与目标输入判定仍是 open problem。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Retraction-Based Gradient Projection Algorithms on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a framework for retraction-based convex optimization on Riemannian manifolds, which includes a notion of retraction-specific convex sets and retraction-based gradient projection algorithms. The standard theory of gradient projection algorithms generalizes easily to this framework. Within this framework, we establish convergence results for retraction-based gradient projection algorithms with various stepsize rules. As an application, we use our framework to study the weighted low-rank approximation. We also provide numerical validation of our convergence results on the image completion task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黎曼流形上的 retraction-based 凸优化框架，定义 retraction-specific 凸集并把梯度投影算法整体推广过去，对多种步长规则给出收敛性结果。作为应用用该框架研究加权低秩逼近，并在图像补全任务上数值验证收敛结论。
Motivation: 标准梯度投影理论建立在欧氏凸性上，换到流形后凸集与投影依赖所选 retraction，原有收敛分析不能直接搬用。
Method: 定义 retraction-specific 凸集，把梯度投影算法改写为 retraction-based gradient projection 形式，将标准梯度投影理论推广到该框架，并对多种步长规则 (stepsize rules) 建立收敛结果；应用对象为加权低秩逼近 (weighted low-rank approximation)。
Result: 对多种步长规则给出收敛性结果，并在图像补全 (image completion) 任务上对这些收敛结果做了数值验证；应用案例为加权低秩逼近。
Conclusion: 梯度投影的收敛理论可以按 retraction 重新表述并推广到黎曼流形，且该框架能落到低秩逼近这类具体问题上并被数值检验。

papers.title: CacheReforge: Bounded Recovery for Stale KV Caches under Evolving Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Large language models rely on KV caching to reduce repeated prefill computation in long context and interactive applications. As lightweight adapters evolve, cached states reflect earlier versions, so stale reuse distorts current model outputs, while complete affected suffix recomputation restores fidelity at substantial cost. We seek minimal recomputation that recovers current adapter behavior. Existing systems track token, context, or stable adapter identity, but neither represent caches from earlier adapter versions nor distinguish update propagation from the recomputation required for behavioral recovery. To address these gaps, we introduce CacheReforge, which represents stale KV caches as layerwise mixed-version objects. It combines per-layer adapter anchors, calibrated sensitivity, accumulated drift, and executable restart boundaries to select direct reuse, bounded recomputation, or complete affected-suffix recovery. We distinguish dependency depth from the functional recomputation horizon and use cumulative tail influence to characterize when bounded recovery preserves current-model behavior. We evaluate CacheReforge on Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B with continual LoRA updates, including 16K HotpotQA and 2WikiMQA workloads. CacheReforge reduces mean KL divergence by 92.4% relative to stale reuse, while recomputing only 5.44% of layers and reducing cache-maintenance time by 93.2% relative to fresh full prefill. These results show that version-aware recovery preserves model fidelity and most KV caching gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheReforge 把过期 KV cache 表示为逐层混合版本对象，用逐层 adapter anchor、校准敏感度、累积漂移与可执行重启边界，在直接复用、有界重算、完整受影响后缀恢复三者间选择。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 的持续 LoRA 更新（16K HotpotQA、2WikiMQA）上，相对过期复用平均 KL 散度下降 92.4%，仅重算 5.44% 的层，缓存维护时间相对全新全量 prefill 下降 93.2%。
Motivation: adapter 持续更新后缓存状态对应旧版本，直接复用会扭曲当前输出，而全量重算受影响后缀代价高；现有系统按 token、上下文或稳定 adapter 身份追踪，既不表示旧版本缓存，也区分不了更新传播与行为恢复所需的重算。
Method: CacheReforge 将过期 KV cache 建模为逐层混合版本对象，组合逐层 adapter anchor、校准敏感度 (calibrated sensitivity)、累积漂移与可执行重启边界，决定直接复用、有界重算或完整受影响后缀恢复；并区分依赖深度与功能重算视界 (functional recomputation horizon)，用累积尾部影响刻画有界恢复何时保持当前模型行为。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 的持续 LoRA 更新、含 16K HotpotQA 与 2WikiMQA 负载上：相对过期复用平均 KL 散度下降 92.4%，仅重算 5.44% 的层，缓存维护时间相对全新全量 prefill 下降 93.2%。
Conclusion: 版本感知的恢复能在持续 adapter 更新下保住模型保真度与大部分 KV caching 收益，只需有界重算而非完整后缀重算。

papers.title: Warned alike, AI agents avoid the less-crowded road while people take it
papers.abstract_en: AI agents built on a few shared models increasingly act for many people. A shared forecast about others can align their choices and change how scarce capacity is allocated. We tested this feedback in a two-road congestion game. Adding one sentence warning that others might follow a routing tip made populations of 50 GPT agents crowd one road while avoiding the nearly empty alternative. Average travel time rose from 64 to 95 min, although any crowded-road agent could have saved 69 min by switching alone. The warning discouraged the very move it predicted. The pattern persisted for 100 rounds. Two other model families shifted the same way without locking onto one road. Twelve all-human groups (240 participants) stayed near balance under numerical reports or the tip and warning. In 24 mixed groups with a further 240 participants, imbalance grew with the share of agents in the registered analysis, while people increasingly took the road the agents avoided. Collective costs stayed below the allagent reference, but with 15 agents and 5 humans, agent seats averaged 80 min, compared with 44 min for human seats. Shared forecasts can thus sustain collective inefficiency among similar agents. A better group average can also hide an unequal burden. Evaluations of AI agents that share resources should test populations, treat messages as interventions and report who bears the costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在双路拥堵博弈中，给 50 个共享模型的 GPT 智能体加一句「别人可能照抄路线提示」的警告，反而让它们集体挤上一条路、避开近乎空闲的另一条：平均出行时间从 64 分钟升到 95 分钟，而任何单个智能体改道本可省 69 分钟。警告抑制了它所预测的那个行为，且该模式持续 100 轮；人与智能体混合时，智能体占比越高失衡越大，人则越来越多地走智能体避开的那条路。作者主张评估共享资源的 AI 智能体时必须以群体为单位、把消息当作干预处理，并报告成本由谁承担。
Motivation: 少数共享模型驱动的 AI 智能体同时为许多人做选择，一条关于他人行为的共享预报就能对齐群体决策并改变稀缺资源分配；但智能体群体是否会因这种反馈陷入集体低效、以及群体平均值是否掩盖负担不均，此前缺少受控证据。
Method: 在双路拥堵博弈中做干预实验：给 50 个 GPT 智能体加入一句警告（他人可能跟随路线提示），持续 100 轮；另用两个其他模型家族做稳健性检验，并设置 12 个全人组（240 名参与者）与 24 个混合组（另 240 名参与者）作对照，混合组分析中失衡随智能体份额变化。
Result: 加入警告后 50 个 GPT 智能体的平均出行时间从 64 分钟升至 95 分钟，而单个智能体改道本可节省 69 分钟；该模式持续 100 轮，另两个模型家族出现同样偏移但不锁定同一条路。全人组在数值报告或提示加警告下都保持近似均衡。混合组中失衡随智能体份额增长（注册分析），人 increasingly 走智能体避开的路；集体成本低于全智能体参照，但 15 智能体 + 5 人组中智能体席位平均 80 分钟、人类席位 44 分钟。
Conclusion: 共享预报能在相似智能体之间维持集体低效，而更好的群体平均值可能掩盖不平等负担；对共享资源的 AI 智能体的评测应以群体为对象、把消息当作干预，并报告成本承担者。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: EXAONE Demand 1.0: A Time Series Foundation Model for Demand Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are pretrained on series from diverse domains, where demand series make up only a small fraction. Demand data has properties that such corpora rarely contain: Short histories, frequent zeros, censoring by stock-outs, and exogenous events that the series does not record. To this end, we propose EXAONE Demand, built on 1) a demand-specific corpus and 2) a demand-aware adapter. For the corpus, we assemble 11.3M series and 48.4B observations from 73 sources, and a synthetic generator supplies the behaviour that open demand data under-represents. For the adapter, we attach low-rank branches to a frozen general-domain backbone, one for each of the four demand classes (smooth, intermittent, erratic, and lumpy), and a router that reads eight scale-free statistics of the input series decides how much each branch contributes. We build EXAONE Demand in two versions, one trained on real-world and synthetic demand together and one trained on the synthetic corpus alone. On 22 held-out datasets, both versions outperform 36 TSFMs, and real-world demand adds a gain over synthetic data alone.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: TISD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Trajectory Intervention
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense teacher targets, but evaluates them only along student-sampled rollouts. When the privileged teacher favors an alternative action at a visited prefix, OPSD can provide a target for the branch decision but cannot supervise the successor contexts induced by that action unless the student samples it. This creates a training-time data-collection bottleneck and suggests a different role for teacher-student disagreement: proposing a trajectory branch rather than identifying a sufficient local repair. Our diagnostic framework using controlled token interventions reveals that a teacher-preferred token at peak disagreement can improve student continuation success, while its local corrective value is limited. Motivated by this finding, we introduce a simple branch-regenerate-distill algorithm, Trajectory-Intervention Self-Distillation (TISD). TISD forces a teacher-selected branch action, returns suffix generation to the student, and distills the full trajectory under the privileged-context-conditioned teacher. Across the coding models, TISD improves average Avg@4 over SDPO by 1.2 percentage points. Across the science domains, it improves average Avg@128 by 0.8 points under an equal-step budget and by 0.3 points under an equal-time budget. These results support teacher-guided branching as a way to expose useful successor contexts for self-distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TISD 指出 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 只在学生自己采样的 rollout 上取教师目标，教师偏好的分支动作若未被采样，其后继上下文就得不到监督。做法是 branch-regenerate-distill：强制执行教师选中的分支 token，把后缀生成交还学生，再在 privileged-context-conditioned teacher 下蒸馏整条轨迹。在 coding 模型上平均 Avg@4 比 SDPO 高 1.2 个百分点，science 域等步数预算下平均 Avg@128 高 0.8 点、等时间预算下高 0.3 点。
Motivation: OPSD 的教师目标只沿学生采样轨迹评估，教师在已访问前缀上偏好的替代动作无法监督其诱导出的后继状态，形成训练期数据采集瓶颈；受控 token 干预诊断显示峰值分歧处的教师偏好 token 能提升续写成功率，但局部纠正价值有限。
Method: 先用受控 token 干预 (controlled token interventions) 做诊断，区分教师偏好 token 的分支价值与局部修复价值；再提出 Trajectory-Intervention Self-Distillation (TISD)，即 branch-regenerate-distill：强制注入教师选中的分支动作，后缀交回学生生成，最后在 privileged-context-conditioned teacher 下对完整轨迹做蒸馏。
Result: 在 coding 模型上，TISD 平均 Avg@4 比 SDPO 高 1.2 个百分点；在 science 域上，等步数预算下平均 Avg@128 提升 0.8 点，等时间预算下提升 0.3 点。
Conclusion: 教师-学生分歧更适合用来提议轨迹分支而非给出局部修补，教师引导的分支能暴露对自蒸馏有用的后继上下文。

papers.title: Tight Stochastic Condition-Number Dependence in Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study whether the linear condition-number dependence in the stochastic complexity of SAPD+ is necessary for nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization. For jointly $L$-smooth objectives with dual strong-concavity parameter $μ$, we prove a lower bound that matches the SAPD+ upper bound under the same Moreau-envelope stationarity criterion and the same primal-dual initialization gap. Specifically, when $σ\ge\varepsilon$, the worst-case complexity of zero-respecting algorithms is $Θ(κLGσ^2\varepsilon^{-4})$ in the stated accuracy regime, where $κ=L/μ$, $G$ bounds the initial primal-dual gap, and $σ^2$ bounds the variance of a general unbiased first-order oracle. The lower bound is realized on a smooth problem class with a bounded dual box. Our construction routes each link of a nonconvex zero-chain through a dual gradient of magnitude proportional to $\varepsilon/\sqrtκ$, while an undiscovered primal coordinate prevents stationarity. It also yields the primal-gradient lower bound $Ω(LΔ(\sqrtκ\varepsilon^{-2}+κσ^2\varepsilon^{-4}))$ after combination with the known deterministic bound, where $Δ$ bounds the initial primal function gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明非凸-强凹极小极大优化中随机复杂度对条件数 κ 的线性依赖不可去：在 σ≥ε 时，零尊重算法的最坏情形复杂度为 Θ(κLGσ²ε⁻⁴)，与 SAPD+ 上界在相同 Moreau 包络平稳性判据和相同原始-对偶初始间隙下匹配。构造把非凸零链的每一环经由量级为 ε/√κ 的对偶梯度传递，未被发现的原始坐标阻止平稳性达成。
Motivation: SAPD+ 的随机复杂度含 κ 的线性依赖，但这一依赖是否必要尚无下界回答；在联合 L-光滑、对偶强凹参数 μ 的极小极大问题上需要同判据、同初始化的匹配下界。
Method: 在有界对偶盒的光滑问题类上构造零链下界：每环经由量级 ε/√κ 的对偶梯度传递，未被发现的原始坐标阻止 Moreau 包络平稳性；再与已知确定性下界组合得到原始梯度界。
Result: σ≥ε 时零尊重算法最坏情形复杂度 Θ(κLGσ²ε⁻⁴)，κ=L/μ，G 界初始原始-对偶间隙，σ² 界一般无偏一阶 oracle 方差，与 SAPD+ 上界匹配；组合后得原始梯度下界 Ω(LΔ(√κε⁻²+κσ²ε⁻⁴))，Δ 界初始原始函数间隙。
Conclusion: 在该平稳性判据与初始化条件下，随机极小极大优化中对条件数的线性依赖是零尊重算法的固有代价，SAPD+ 的 κ 依赖不可改进。

papers.title: Universal Drift Correction for Multidimensional Scanning Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: In scanning microscopy, drift causes the specimen to be sampled at positions displaced from the nominal probe positions. This displacement alters the spatial assignment of the recorded signals and biases quantitative measurements across two-dimensional imaging, channel-resolved spectroscopic mapping, and scan-position-resolved diffraction analysis. Here, we extend orthogonal-scan drift correction from 2D images to spectrum images and diffraction datasets. We demonstrate how to recover probe positions using either differently oriented multidimensional scans or structural reference images. The recovered positions are used either to resample the multidimensional data onto a regular grid or to assign each recorded signal to its corrected coordinate. Our method combines affine and non-rigid correction, requires no prior structural model, and is implemented as open-source, GPU-accelerated software that reduces processing times by two to three orders of magnitude, enabling routine and automated drift correction for quantitative multidimensional microscopy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把正交扫描漂移校正从 2D 图像推广到 spectrum image 与衍射数据集：用不同取向的多维扫描或结构参考图恢复探针真实位置，再把信号重采样到规则网格或改写到校正坐标。方法结合仿射与非刚性校正、无需先验结构模型，作为开源 GPU 加速软件实现，处理时间降低两到三个数量级。
Motivation: 扫描显微镜的漂移使探针落在偏离标称位置处，改变信号的空间归属，系统性地偏置二维成像、通道分辨谱学 mapping 与扫描位置分辨衍射分析的定量测量；原有正交扫描校正只覆盖 2D 图像。
Method: 通过不同取向的多维扫描或结构参考图恢复探针位置，再将多维数据重采样到规则网格，或把每条记录信号指派到校正后的坐标；校正同时包含 affine 与 non-rigid 两部分，不依赖先验结构模型，实现为开源 GPU 加速软件。
Result: 处理时间降低两到三个数量级（two to three orders of magnitude），使多维显微数据的漂移校正可常规化、自动化运行；校正覆盖二维成像、通道分辨谱学 mapping 与扫描位置分辨衍射数据。
Conclusion: 正交扫描漂移校正可以不靠先验结构模型推广到 spectrum image 与衍射数据，配合 GPU 加速后足以支撑定量多维显微镜的日常自动校正。

papers.title: Reliability-Regulated Trajectory Optimization for Progressive COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: COLMAP-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) bypasses computationally expensive structure-from-motion (SfM) pipelines, yet progressive camera pose tracking remains fundamentally vulnerable to error compounding---early pairwise tracking inaccuracies both corrupt subsequent frame initializations and remain permanently frozen in the scene representation. Rather than relying on heavyweight external neural priors or treating progressive tracking through isolated heuristic fixes, we propose a unified reliability-regulated trajectory optimization framework for progressive COLMAP-free 3DGS. At its core, our framework establishes an intrinsic, self-supervised bidirectional cycle-consistency mechanism that systematically regulates progressive camera trajectory estimation across two complementary temporal horizons: (1) Forward Motion Propagation, where the online reliability signal adaptively gates first-order kinematic warm-starts of rigid motion into upcoming pairwise registrations, supplying informed directional search priors while safely intercepting untrusted transitions; and (2) Retrospective Trajectory Correction, where the same reliability signal dynamically weights relative-pose consistency constraints within a sliding window of neighboring camera poses. By governing both prospective state initialization and retrospective trajectory consolidation through a unified reliability regulator, our self-contained framework resolves progressive drift without external priors or offline preprocessing. Extensive evaluations on Tanks and Temples and CO3D-V2 benchmarks show that our method substantially improves camera trajectory accuracy and novel-view rendering quality, outperforming existing unposed baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Zijian1026/RRTO-CF3DGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 COLMAP-free 3D Gaussian Splatting 中渐进式相机位姿跟踪的误差累积，提出可靠性调控的轨迹优化框架：用自监督双向环路一致性生成可靠性信号，向前门控刚体运动一阶运动学热启动、向后加权滑动窗口内的相对位姿一致性约束。在 Tanks and Temples 与 CO3D-V2 上显著提升相机轨迹精度与新视角渲染质量，超过现有 unposed 基线。
Motivation: COLMAP-free 3DGS 跳过昂贵的 SfM，但渐进式位姿跟踪会误差累积：早期成对跟踪误差既污染后续帧初始化，又被永久冻结进场景表示；现有做法依赖重型外部神经先验或零散启发式修补。
Method: 核心是自监督双向环路一致性 (bidirectional cycle-consistency) 机制，产生统一的可靠性信号，同时调控两个时间尺度：Forward Motion Propagation 用该信号门控刚体一阶运动学热启动进入后续成对配准，拦截不可信跳变；Retrospective Trajectory Correction 用同一信号动态加权滑动窗口内相邻相机位姿的相对位姿一致性约束。整体自包含，不依赖外部先验与离线预处理。
Result: 在 Tanks and Temples 与 CO3D-V2 基准上评测，相机轨迹精度与新视角渲染质量均显著提升，并超过现有 unposed 基线。
Conclusion: 用一个统一的可靠性调控器同时管住前瞻初始化与回溯轨迹固化，即可在无外部先验、无离线预处理的条件下解决渐进式漂移。

papers.title: Persistent Negatives for Adversarial Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Black-box On-Policy Distillation (OPD) seeks to improve a student from its own generations when the teacher provides sampled responses but not token probabilities. Adversarial distillation offers one route: it learns a discriminator over prompt-matched teacher and student responses and uses its score as the policy reward. However, sampling discriminator negatives from the latest student at each step couples the learned reward to a negative distribution that changes after every policy update. We address this moving-target problem with persistent-negative adversarial distillation, a live-pool method that replaces a fraction of each discriminator batch with historical, prompt-matched teacher--student comparisons. Under matched discriminator compute, historical comparisons train the discriminator, while GRPO remains on-policy with fresh student responses. Our analysis identifies the Bayes-optimal reward as a teacher-to-negative log-density ratio and, under explicit assumptions, shows how persistent negatives anchor the discriminator and reduce reward-estimation MSE relative to fresh-negative training. Across two student families, three judges, and four judged-chat benchmarks, persistent-negative adversarial distillation consistently improves performance over current methods at matched discriminator compute. It also yields smoother fresh-policy discriminator trajectories, with fewer below-chance dips. These findings identify the discriminator's negative distribution as an important design axis in black-box on-policy distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 黑盒 on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 中，判别器负样本每步都从最新学生采样，奖励随策略更新漂移。persistent-negative 对抗蒸馏用历史、prompt 匹配的师生对比替换每批一部分负样本，在判别器算力相同下降低奖励估计 MSE，并在两个学生族、三个 judge、四个 judged-chat 基准上稳定优于现有方法。
Motivation: 黑盒 OPD 里教师只给采样回复、不给 token 概率，对抗蒸馏用判别器打分当奖励；但负样本分布随每次策略更新变化，学到的奖励耦合到一个 moving target，估计不稳。

papers.title: Developing a Roadmap to an AI-first Organization: A Case Study in Embedded Software Development
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of AI agents is expected to reshape software engineering by moving beyond AI as assistants towards systems capable of planning, executing, and evaluating development tasks with increasing autonomy. This transition is particularly significant for embedded software organizations, where strict requirements for quality, traceability, verification, and long-term maintainability often apply. This paper presents a case study of a large embedded systems company and its transition toward becoming an AI-first organization. Through a mixed method, we analyzed data collected from a semi-structured workshop with 40 participants, including scrum masters, architects, management, and product owners. The findings show that the participants expect agentic AI to affect team structure, required competencies, organizational strategies, and developers' roles within the organization. Based on these findings, the paper discusses implications for federated AI team formation, human-in-the-loop practices in such an organization, and the sustainable adoption of AI agents in embedded software engineering. We also present a concrete roadmap for the organization towards becoming an AI-first organization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对一家大型嵌入式系统公司的案例研究显示，参与者预期 agentic AI 会改变团队结构、所需能力、组织战略与开发者角色，并据此给出该组织走向 AI-first 的具体路线图。
Motivation: 嵌入式软件组织对质量、可追溯性、验证与长期可维护性有严格要求，从 AI 助手转向具备规划、执行、评估自主性的 AI agent 时，团队与流程如何转型缺少实证依据。
Method: 混合方法案例研究：对一家大型嵌入式系统公司开展半结构化工作坊，40 名参与者涵盖 scrum master、架构师、管理层与产品负责人，分析其对 agentic AI 影响的预期。
Result: 工作坊 40 名参与者预期 agentic AI 将影响团队结构、所需能力、组织战略与开发者角色；基于这些发现讨论联邦式 AI 团队组建、human-in-the-loop 实践与 AI agent 的可持续落地，并给出面向该组织的具体路线图。
Conclusion: 在嵌入式软件组织中引入 agentic AI 需要同步调整团队组建、人在环路实践与采纳节奏，论文以路线图形式给出该公司的转型路径。

papers.title: SkillEvoReg: Regularizing Agent Skill Evolution Against Overfitting
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly improve by converting execution experience into reusable external skills. Yet repeated skill updates form a learning process of their own: locally useful edits can accumulate into redundant or task-specific instructions, while new updates can disrupt behavior that previously worked. We study this problem as skill-evolution overfitting and introduce SkillEvoReg, a general regularization framework for skill evolution inspired by anti-overfitting techniques in neural-network training. SkillEvoReg combines training-time skill dropout, which perturbs update generation, and complexity-aware local regularization, which controls unnecessary structural growth, with causal counterexample validation (CCV), which provides targeted behavioral validation of candidate-specific regressions. We instantiate the framework across heterogeneous skill-evolution systems while retaining each system's native skill evolver and task evaluator. Across SkillOpt, SkillEvolBench, and ContinualSkillBench, SkillEvoReg consistently controls skill-state growth while preserving competitive downstream capability, improves several transfer and later-stage evolution outcomes, and identifies update-level regressions that structural metrics alone cannot reveal. These results suggest that explicit regularization is a useful complement to increasingly capable skill updaters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillEvoReg 把神经网络的防过拟合思路搬到 LM agent 的技能演化上：训练时技能 dropout 扰动更新生成、复杂度感知局部正则抑制结构膨胀，再用因果反例验证 (CCV) 定位候选更新造成的行为回归。在 SkillOpt、SkillEvolBench、ContinualSkillBench 三个异构技能演化系统上，该框架在保持下游能力有竞争力的同时稳定控制技能状态规模，并识别出仅靠结构指标看不到的更新级回归。
Motivation: agent 把执行经验写成外部技能后，反复更新本身构成一个学习过程：局部有用的编辑会累积成冗余或任务专属的指令，新更新还会破坏此前有效的行为，即技能演化过拟合。
Method: 提出通用正则框架 SkillEvoReg，含三部分：训练时 skill dropout 扰动更新生成、complexity-aware local regularization 控制不必要的结构增长、causal counterexample validation (CCV) 对候选更新做定向行为验证；实例化时保留各系统原生的 skill evolver 与 task evaluator。
Result: 在 SkillOpt、SkillEvolBench、ContinualSkillBench 上一致地控制 skill-state 增长，同时保持有竞争力的下游能力，并改善若干迁移与后期演化结果；CCV 识别出结构指标 alone 无法揭示的更新级回归。
Conclusion: 显式正则是日益强大的技能更新器的有用补充：结构度量不足以发现行为回归，需要配合行为级验证与复杂度约束。

papers.title: AC Power Flow Contingency Analysis Using a Single Deep Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Contingency analysis using the AC power flow (AC-PF) model is a critical tool for accurate grid security assessment, but its computational burden increases with the number of operating scenarios and outage configurations to evaluate. Recent ML-based approaches typically require outage-specific training data, leading to offline training costs that scale with the number of contingencies. This work proposes a framework that reuses a single ML model trained solely on basecase AC-PF data to estimate post-contingency operating states under arbitrary single-line outages. The proposed approach formulates post-contingency state prediction as a fixed-point iteration. If the ML model is a deep neural network (DNN), we derive sufficient conditions that guarantee convergence and develop semidefinite programming (SDP) formulations to certify these conditions for a given DNN. Numerical tests on the IEEE 118-bus system demonstrate that the proposed SDP formulations are tight, that the certified conditions hold for all tested contingencies, and that the resulting method produces accurate post-contingency state estimates within only a few iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用单一深度神经网络做交流潮流 (AC power flow) 的 N-1 故障分析：模型只在 basecase 数据上训练一次，把故障后状态预测写成不动点迭代，并用半正定规划 (SDP) 认证 DNN 的收敛充分条件。在 IEEE 118-bus 系统上，SDP 认证条件对全部测试故障成立且松弛紧致，故障后状态估计在少数几次迭代内即收敛到准确结果。
Motivation: 交流潮流故障分析的计算量随运行场景与停运组合数增长；现有 ML 方法需要按每个故障单独准备训练数据，离线训练成本随故障数线性膨胀。
Method: 训练一个仅吃 basecase AC-PF 数据的 DNN，把任意单线路停运后的状态预测表述为不动点迭代；对 DNN 推导保证收敛的充分条件，并构造 SDP 形式来针对给定 DNN 认证这些条件。
Result: 在 IEEE 118-bus 系统的数值测试中，所提 SDP 认证问题是紧的；认证条件对所有测试故障均成立；最终方法在仅少数几次迭代内给出准确的故障后状态估计。
Conclusion: 单一 basecase 训练的 DNN 配合可认证的不动点迭代，足以覆盖任意单线停运的故障后状态估计，从而摆脱按故障逐一训练的离线成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Chance-Constrained MDPs with Bellman Distributional Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) commonly enforces expected-cost constraints, but such expectation safety may fail to control the probability of rare high-cost trajectories. Chance-constrained MDPs (CCMDPs) impose a stronger probability-level requirement, but are widely viewed as harder because the chance constraint is nonconvex and depends on the full trajectory rather than a Bellman-linear expectation. In this paper, we reveal that this computational difficulty does not necessarily imply a higher statistical price. For tabular discounted CCMDPs with fixed bounded successor support and access to a certified planning oracle, we establish a model-based upper bound, with a matching lower bound up to logarithmic terms. Technically, our key idea is the \emph{Bellman distributional certificate}, which constructs a Bellman recursion for constraint violation probabilities before policy selection. The certificate can be reused across candidate policies; combined with shared row-wise reverse-KL confidence sets, it gives a policy-uniform trajectory-KL transfer without a union bound over policies or time--budget Bellman tables. For stochastic policies, we give a model-free variance-reduced policy-gradient algorithm with a finite-sample expected KKT-residual guarantee and independent validation of every accepted policy. Numerical experiments on synthetic CCMDPs and an IEEE 14-bus energy storage control benchmark illustrate the safety and mechanism behavior of the proposed algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在表格型折扣 CCMDP 上证明机会约束的计算难度不等于更高的统计代价：先在策略选择前用 Bellman distributional certificate 递推约束违反概率，再配合共享的逐行 reverse-KL 置信集，得到对所有策略一致的 trajectory-KL 转移而无需对策略或时间-预算做 union bound，模型化上界与匹配下界仅差对数项。随机策略另给方差缩减的免模型策略梯度算法，带有限样本期望 KKT 残差保证与逐策略独立验证。
Motivation: 安全 RL 常用期望代价约束，但期望安全无法控制罕见高代价轨迹的发生概率；机会约束 MDP 虽更强，却因非凸且依赖整条轨迹而非 Bellman 线性的期望而被普遍认为更难。
Method: 核心是 Bellman distributional certificate：在策略选择前为约束违反概率构造 Bellman 递归，该证书可跨候选策略复用；结合共享的逐行 reverse-KL 置信集，给出 policy-uniform 的 trajectory-KL 转移，避免对策略或时间-预算 Bellman 表做 union bound。随机策略部分给出免模型、方差缩减的策略梯度算法，附有限样本期望 KKT 残差保证与对每个被接受策略的独立验证。
Result: 对固定有界后继支撑、可访问认证规划 oracle 的表格型折扣 CCMDP 建立模型化上界，并给出仅差对数项的匹配下界；随机策略算法有有限样本期望 KKT 残差保证。数值实验在合成 CCMDP 与 IEEE 14-bus 储能控制基准上展示所提算法的安全性与机制行为。
Conclusion: 机会约束 MDP 的计算困难并不必然带来更高的统计代价：借助策略无关的 Bellman 分布式证书与共享 KL 置信集，可以在不付出策略 union bound 的情况下达到匹配的样本复杂度。
Relevance: 3
