summary_sections.conclusion: 机会约束 MDP 的计算困难并不必然带来更高的统计代价：借助策略无关的 Bellman 分布式证书与共享 KL 置信集，可以在不付出策略 union bound 的情况下达到匹配的样本复杂度。

papers.title: MDSkin-Net: Multi-Task Skin Lesion Analysis Driven by Pattern Analysis Priors and Spatial Alignment Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Reliable skin lesion segmentation and classification are central to dermoscopic computer-aided diagnosis. Existing multi-task frameworks couple the two tasks architecturally without clinical knowledge, while knowledge-injecting approaches rely on the macroscopic ABCD rule, which was not designed for dermoscopy. Dermoscopic diagnosis is grounded in Pattern Analysis, a microscopic framework structured around dermoscopic features. We propose MDSkin-Net, which incorporates cue-level Pattern Analysis priors into a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture. At its core is a Pattern Analysis-Guided Attention Module (PAGAM) comprising three priors motivated by distinct dermoscopic cues: an improved Efficient Channel Attention (iECA), a Multi-Scale Spatial Attention (MSSA), and a Biased Asymmetry Attention (BAA). We further introduce a multi-scale spatial alignment regularization (MSAR) that uses the segmentation ground-truth mask as hierarchical soft supervision, confining the classification head to lesion-localized evidence and coupling both task pathways through a shared spatial prior. Trained exclusively on the ISIC 2017 training split without external dermoscopy data, the MDSkin-Net ensemble transfers robustly under zero-shot evaluation, reaching a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) of 92.38% and a melanoma AUC of 97.84%on PH2, and a DSC of 88.92% on the ISIC 2018 Task 1 test set. On the in-domain ISIC 2017 benchmark, the ensemble attains a mean Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 91.60% across the two classification tasks (melanoma and seborrheic keratosis vs. rest), and a DSC of 84.72% for segmentation. Classification remains competitive with baselines; in-domain segmentation trails single-task specialists, yet the proposed priors and alignment regularization yield representations that generalize consistently across cohorts of different scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MDSkin-Net 把皮肤镜 Pattern Analysis 的线索级先验注入 CNN-Transformer 混合架构，用分割真值掩膜做层级软监督约束分类头只看病灶区域。仅在 ISIC 2017 训练集上训练、零样本迁移时，PH2 上 DSC 92.38%、黑色素瘤 AUC 97.84%，ISIC 2018 Task 1 测试集 DSC 88.92%；域内分割仍落后单任务专家模型。
Motivation: 现有皮肤镜多任务框架只是在结构上耦合分割与分类，缺乏临床知识；而知识注入方法依赖为肉眼宏观设计的 ABCD 规则，不适用于皮肤镜下的微观 Pattern Analysis。
Method: 混合 CNN-Transformer 架构中加入 Pattern Analysis-Guided Attention Module (PAGAM)，含三个由不同皮肤镜线索驱动的先验：改进的 Efficient Channel Attention (iECA)、Multi-Scale Spatial Attention (MSSA)、Biased Asymmetry Attention (BAA)。另提出 multi-scale spatial alignment regularization (MSAR)，以分割真值掩膜作层级软监督，把分类头限制在病灶定位证据上，通过共享空间先验耦合两条任务通路；仅用 ISIC 2017 训练集训练，不用外部皮肤镜数据。
Result: 零样本迁移：PH2 上 DSC 92.38%、melanoma AUC 97.84%，ISIC 2018 Task 1 测试集 DSC 88.92%。域内 ISIC 2017 上集成模型两项分类任务（melanoma 与 seborrheic keratosis vs. rest）平均 AUC 91.60%，分割 DSC 84.72%；分类与基线相当，域内分割落后单任务专家模型。

papers.title: The KV Cache Is the New Memory Wall
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive LLM inference at long context is bounded by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic throughput, and the binding resource shifts from model weights to the Key-Value (KV) cache as sequence length grows. For Llama-3-70B in BF16, the 140 GB weight footprint exceeds the 80 GB HBM of a single accelerator, and one 128k-token sequence adds 42 GB of KV cache. Techniques that compress, evict, page, share, or offload KV state have proliferated, but reported gains use inconsistent workloads, hardware, and quality metrics, preventing cross-paper comparison. This SoK paper unifies the field analytically, with a protocol that strictly separates derived and reported claims. We derive closed-form arithmetic intensity as a decaying function of context length, parameterized by hardware topology for NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA B200, and AMD MI300X, including per-die bandwidth partitioning and the crossover lengths where KV traffic overtakes weight traffic. We classify the literature into five domains, quantization, token eviction, KV paging, prefix caching, and heterogeneous tiering, evaluating one method per domain at 128k context under a single protocol. The central finding is a three-regime structure: below a hardware-specific crossover, weight traffic dominates and KV compression yields negligible speedup; beyond it, KV traffic dominates and each domain trades quality for bandwidth savings approaching the roofline bound. Paging and prefix sharing are lossless but address capacity, not bandwidth. Quantization and eviction cut bandwidth directly, with degradation that accelerates below 4-bit precision and turns discontinuous for eviction on position-sensitive tasks. Tiering converts the bandwidth wall into an interconnect problem bounded by PCIe or NVLink rather than HBM. We close with design rules for selecting a compression domain given hardware, context length, and quality budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于长上下文 LLM 推理 KV cache 内存墙的 SoK：推导出随上下文长度衰减的闭式 arithmetic intensity，按 H100/B200/MI300X 硬件拓扑给出 KV 流量超过权重流量的 crossover 长度，并在统一协议下每域评一个方法。核心发现是三段式结构：crossover 以下权重流量主导、KV 压缩几乎无加速；以上 KV 流量主导、各域用质量换带宽并逼近 roofline；paging 与 prefix caching 无损但只解决容量不解决带宽。
Motivation: 长上下文自回归推理受内存带宽而非算力限制，且瓶颈随序列增长从权重转移到 KV cache；现有 KV 压缩/驱逐/分页/共享/卸载工作负载、硬件与质量指标不一致，无法跨论文比较。
Method: SoK 论文：推导闭式 arithmetic intensity 作为上下文长度的衰减函数，按 NVIDIA H100、B200、AMD MI300X 的硬件拓扑参数化（含 per-die 带宽划分与 crossover 长度）；把文献分为 quantization、token eviction、KV paging、prefix caching、heterogeneous tiering 五个域，并用单一协议在 128k 上下文下每域评一个方法，严格区分推导结论与转述结论。
Result: Llama-3-70B BF16 权重 140 GB 超出单加速器 80 GB HBM，一条 128k-token 序列额外增加 42 GB KV cache。三段式发现：crossover 以下 KV 压缩加速可忽略，以上各域以质量换带宽并逼近 roofline bound；paging 与 prefix sharing 无损但只解决容量；quantization 与 eviction 直接砍带宽，低于 4-bit 精度时质量退化加速，eviction 在 position-sensitive 任务上退化不连续；tiering 把带宽墙转为受 PCIe/NVLink 而非 HBM 约束的互连问题。
Conclusion: 选 KV 压缩域必须同时看硬件、上下文长度与质量预算：先判断是否越过该硬件的 crossover，再决定用无损的 paging/prefix 还是用质量换带宽的 quantization/eviction。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Why Jailbreaks Succeed in Diffusion Language Models: An Energy Landscape Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Existing attacks and defenses for diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) target specific vulnerabilities but lack a shared framework explaining why attacks succeed. We propose one by interpreting safety alignment as shaping the denoising energy landscape: a well-aligned model routes harmful queries toward safe outputs through an energy barrier that separates the two regions. Current jailbreak attacks reduce to two strategies for circumventing this barrier: obscuring the query's safety disposition at initialisation, or intervening mid-trajectory to force the denoising path across the energy barrier. From this perspective and the result that masked diffusion models minimise kinetic energy during denoising, we derive three complementary, training-free detection signals: a step-0 ratio that reads the initial safety disposition from the logit distribution before generation begins, and two trajectory-velocity signals that track kinetic energy in complementary subspaces of the logit space. An attack must either reveal its intent at initialisation or expend kinetic energy to cross the barrier in at least one monitored subspace, so the three signals cover each other's blind spots in the energy budget by construction. Evaluation across three dense dLLMs (LLaDA-8B, LLaDA-1.5, Dream-7B) and a sparse mixture-of-experts dLLM (LLaDA-MoE-7B) confirms this complementarity. In stress tests of known attacks, every configuration that evades detection also fails to produce harmful content, suggesting that the detection and barrier-crossing thresholds are hard to separate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的安全对齐解释为去噪能量地形：有害查询被能量势垒挡在安全输出一侧，越狱只有两条路——在初始化时掩盖查询的安全属性，或在轨迹中途强行跨过势垒。据此推出三个免训练检测信号（step-0 比率 + 两个轨迹速度信号），在 LLaDA-8B、LLaDA-1.5、Dream-7B 与 LLaDA-MoE-7B 上验证互补性：能躲过检测的攻击配置同时也产生不出有害内容。
Motivation: 现有针对扩散式大语言模型的攻击与防御各自针对特定漏洞，缺少一个能统一解释攻击为何得手的共享框架，检测信号也因此难以系统设计。
Method: 将安全对齐建模为去噪能量地形中的势垒，把越狱归为两类策略（初始化时混淆安全属性、轨迹中途干预跨垒）；结合掩码扩散模型在去噪中最小化动能这一结果，推导三个免训练检测信号：读取生成前 logit 分布的 step-0 比率，以及在 logit 空间互补子空间上跟踪动能的两个轨迹速度信号，三者按构造互相覆盖盲区。
Result: 在三个稠密 dLLM（LLaDA-8B、LLaDA-1.5、Dream-7B）和一个稀疏 MoE dLLM（LLaDA-MoE-7B）上验证三信号互补性；已知攻击的压力测试中，每一个既躲过检测又未产生有害内容的配置都不存在，即逃逸检测的配置同时生成失败。
Conclusion: 检测阈值与跨垒阈值似乎难以分离：攻击必须在初始化暴露意图或在被监控子空间中消耗动能跨垒，因此三信号在能量预算上互相补位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Aligning One-Step Generative Models with Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation
papers.abstract_en: One-step generators enable high-quality visual generation with a single network evaluation, but their post-training is difficult: general implicit generators provide neither tractable likelihoods nor denoising trajectories, and many rewards are non-differentiable. We introduce Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation (RWTD), a post-training method that requires only generated samples and scalar reward evaluations. Rather than aligning solely to the conventional reward-tilted reference distribution, RWTD constructs an adaptive target that mixes separately tilted current and reference distributions. The current component incorporates improvements discovered during training, while the reference component anchors the target to the pretrained generator. RWTD realizes this target through feature-space optimal transport and fixed-point regression. Theoretical analysis shows that the fixed-point distributions of RWTD interpolate between off-policy reward tilting of the reference and on-policy tilting of the current model, providing a principled approach to balancing reward adaptation with retention of prior knowledge. Empirically, RWTD substantially improves the GenEval score of the one-step SANA Sprint 1.6B backbone from 0.73 to 0.80, while separate preference alignment experiments demonstrate strong cross-reward generalization that yields balanced improvements and preservation of compositional capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RWTD 是一步生成器的后训练方法：只用生成样本和标量奖励，通过混合当前与参考的奖励倾斜分布构造自适应目标，再用特征空间最优传输与不动点回归实现。在一步 SANA Sprint 1.6B 上 GenEval 从 0.73 提到 0.80，偏好对齐实验显示跨奖励泛化且保持组合生成能力。
Motivation: 一步生成器单次网络评估即可出图，但后训练困难：隐式生成器没有可解似然也没有去噪轨迹，且许多奖励不可微。
Method: RWTD 只需生成样本与标量奖励评估；构造混合了分别做奖励倾斜的当前分布与参考分布的自适应目标（当前分量吸收训练期改进，参考分量锚定预训练模型），通过特征空间最优传输 (feature-space optimal transport) 与不动点回归 (fixed-point regression) 实现该目标。
Result: 一步 SANA Sprint 1.6B backbone 的 GenEval 分数从 0.73 提升到 0.80；单独的偏好对齐实验显示强跨奖励泛化，带来均衡改进并保持组合 (compositional) 能力。理论上 RWTD 的不动点分布在参考模型的 off-policy 奖励倾斜与当前模型的 on-policy 倾斜之间插值。
Conclusion: 把目标定为当前与参考倾斜分布的混合，可以在奖励适配与保留预训练知识之间给出有原则的平衡，且不依赖可微奖励或可解似然。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention-Based Adaptive Policies for Simultaneous Speech-to-Text Translation
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous speech-to-text translation (Simul-S2TT) consists of generating partial translations while the incoming audio frames are processed by the system. However, the streaming nature of this setup creates the challenge of deciding the best moment to perform an accurate translation while minimizing the delay. To address this challenge, we utilize the cross-attention mechanism of the encoder-decoder architecture to find the right alignment between the input speech frames and the target text tokens. In this paper, we propose the Recent Frame Attention Policy (RFAP) and the Dual-Condition Attention Policy (DCAP) that allow offline trained speech-to-text translation models to be used in streaming scenarios without requiring additional training. Results on three different language translation pairs over the CVSS-C corpus show that the RFAP is able to surpass other policies with gains of up to 4.0 BLEU while reducing the translation delay by almost 1 second. Moreover, the DCAP is able to preserve a high translation quality when the latency is very low.

papers.title: Peer-Grounded Counterfactual Path Planning for Chronic Health Management
papers.abstract_en: Effective behavioral intervention in chronic disease management requires not a single prescription but a sequence of incremental steps, each grounded in what real, similar individuals have demonstrably achieved. Counterfactual explanation offers a natural computational route to such guidance, answering what change in behavior would have produced a better outcome. But existing methods return a target state without a route to it, guarantee no monotone health improvement along the way, and draw no evidence from peer behavior -- asking a patient to close a wide gap in one move, which is precisely the recommendation structure least likely to be attempted. We propose POROS (Peer-Grounded Optimal Routes Over States), a domain-agnostic framework rooted in Bandura's self-efficacy theory and Festinger's social comparison theory that constructs a Behavioral Progression Graph -- a directed acyclic graph over observed patient states in which every edge requires both peer-grounded behavioral proximity and strict health outcome improvement. Every edge is therefore a behavioral change that individuals in the cohort have demonstrated is achievable within a single period. Minimum-cost paths through this graph decompose otherwise inactionable behavioral gaps into incremental, peer-grounded steps. We evaluate POROS on two independent longitudinal cohorts of patients with diabetes. For patients below the 70% clinical threshold for time in range (TIR, blood glucose within 70-180 mg/dL), it reduces the mean gain required per step from 26.3 percentage points (pp) to 5.5 pp on one cohort and from 31.1 pp to 5.7 pp on the other, decomposing large behavioral jumps into the incremental steps that self-efficacy requires. Across both cohorts, 97-98% of multi-hop paths cross patient boundaries, embedding social comparison by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POROS 把反事实解释从“单步目标状态”改成可执行的多步路径：在观测到的患者状态上建有向无环图（Behavioral Progression Graph），每条边同时要求同伴行为邻近与健康结果严格改善，再用最小费用路径把大缺口拆成单期内可达成的增量步骤。在两个糖尿病纵向队列中，对 TIR 低于 70% 阈值的患者，单步所需平均增益从 26.3 pp 降到 5.5 pp、另一队列从 31.1 pp 降到 5.7 pp；两队列中 97–98% 的多跳路径跨越患者边界。
Motivation: 现有反事实方法只给目标状态不给路径，不保证沿途健康单调改善，也不利用同伴行为证据，等于让患者一步跨过大缺口，正是最不可能被执行的建议结构。
Method: POROS（Peer-Grounded Optimal Routes Over States）以 Bandura 自我效能理论与 Festinger 社会比较理论为基础，构建以观测患者状态为节点的有向无环图，边需同时满足同伴行为邻近与健康结果严格改善；随后在图上求最小费用路径，把行为缺口分解为增量步骤。
Result: 在两个独立的糖尿病患者纵向队列上：对 TIR（血糖 70–180 mg/dL 占比）低于 70% 临床阈值的患者，单步所需平均增益由 26.3 pp 降至 5.5 pp（队列一）、由 31.1 pp 降至 5.7 pp（队列二）；跨两队列 97–98% 的多跳路径跨越患者边界。
Conclusion: 把同伴可达性与严格单调改善同时写进边约束，可把不可执行的单步反事实建议拆成自我效能理论所要求的增量路径，且社会比较由构造内嵌而非事后附加。

papers.title: MOPD-Router: Rethinking Teacher Routing in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates specialized capabilities into a single student, but existing practice typically hard-routes each prompt to a domain-matched teacher for the entire rollout. This dependence on prompt-level domain labels restricts using unlabeled training mixtures and leaves complementary signals from other teachers unused. We introduce MOPD-Router, a framework that routes supervision over the full teacher pool at each token, without domain labels or training a separate routing model. Its plug-in interface supports different metrics for selecting and weighting teacher-specific OPD signals. Within this interface, we propose ExpertAlign, which scores each teacher by whether its correction to the student at the current token expresses the specialization that teacher acquired during post-training, and compare it against two reference metrics built on teacher confidence (Entropy) and teacher-student discrepancy (Novelty). Experiments on unlabeled and domain-labeled training mixtures under strong-to-weak and same-size distillation scenarios show that ExpertAlign achieves the strongest overall performance in all four settings. On unlabeled data, it improves the overall score by 5.88 (+12.3%) points over Mean aggregation; on domain-labeled data, it outperforms standard MOPD by 3.95 (+7.8%) points without using available domain labels. These results demonstrate token-level routing can exploit cross-domain complementary supervision, and reduce exclusive reliance on prompt-level domain assignment. Code is available at: https://github.com/TURLEing/MOPD-Router.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOPD-Router 把多教师 on-policy 蒸馏的监督从 prompt 级硬路由改为逐 token 在全体教师池上路由，无需领域标签也无需训练路由模型。核心打分器 ExpertAlign 按教师在当前 token 的纠正是否体现其后训练专长来选权重，在无标签混合数据上比 Mean 聚合高 5.88 分（+12.3%），在有标签数据上比标准 MOPD 高 3.95 分（+7.8%）。
Motivation: 现有 MOPD 依赖 prompt 级领域标签把整条 rollout 硬路由给单一教师，既限制了无标签训练混合数据的使用，也浪费了其他教师的互补信号。
Method: 提出 MOPD-Router 插件式接口，在每个 token 上对全体教师的 OPD 信号做选择与加权，不需领域标签或独立路由模型。接口内提出 ExpertAlign：按教师在当前 token 的纠正是否表达其 post-training 获得的专长打分，并与基于教师权重的 Entropy、基于师生差异的 Novelty 两个参考指标对比。
Result: 在无标签与有标签训练混合、strong-to-weak 与 same-size 四种设定下，ExpertAlign 均取得最强整体表现；无标签数据上比 Mean 聚合高 5.88 分（+12.3%），有标签数据上比标准 MOPD 高 3.95 分（+7.8%），且未使用可用的领域标签。
Conclusion: 逐 token 路由能利用跨领域互补监督，可减少对 prompt 级领域分配的排他性依赖。

papers.title: PTC-Decoder: Towards Intelligent SLMs on Offline Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Deploying small language models (SLMs) on offline, resource-constrained edge devices such as remote sensing satellites presents a fundamental challenge: their limited reasoning capacity hinders reliable execution of multi-step agent tasks requiring complex tool orchestration. Existing plan-solve paradigms rely on prompt-based enforcement, which our experiments show SLMs almost entirely disregard: weak models fail to invoke the plan. We propose PTC-Decoder (Plan-Tool Constrained Decoder), a training-free, plug-and-play decoder framework that combines (1) a Plan-to-Act paradigm, which elevates planning to an atomic tool and forces its invocation at the first inference step, and (2) TC-Decoder, a deterministic finite automaton that imposes token-level hard constraints on tool names while preserving freedom over parameter generation, thereby retaining SLM reasoning capability. Evaluated on 200 real remote-sensing satellite tasks across 7 SLMs, PTC-Decoder yields a statistically significant mean overall score gain of +1.21 (p<0.01), 95% CI [+1.13, +1.29]), with consistent improvements across models and other datasets. An ablation study that removes TC-Decoder causes substantial performance degradation across all quality metrics without reducing computational cost, confirming TC-Decoder as the primary driver. PTC-Decoder thus offers a lightweight yet effective solution for improving step-level reliability, with final-answer accuracy remaining an open challenge. In essence, we enforce plan adherence by constraining the permissible output vocabulary during inference, without requiring retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PTC-Decoder 是面向离线资源受限边缘设备（如遥感卫星）上 SLM 多步 agent 任务的免训练解码框架：把规划提升为原子工具并在首步强制调用 (Plan-to-Act)，再用确定性有限自动机 TC-Decoder 对工具名施加 token 级硬约束、参数生成保持自由。在 200 个真实遥感卫星任务、7 个 SLM 上平均总分提升 +1.21（p<0.01，95% CI [+1.13, +1.29]），消融去掉 TC-Decoder 后各项质量指标大幅退化。
Motivation: 离线、算力受限的边缘设备上 SLM 推理能力弱，plan-solve 范式依赖 prompt 强制，实验显示弱模型几乎完全无视、根本不调用 plan，多步工具编排不可靠。
Method: 两部分：Plan-to-Act 把规划升为原子工具并在第一次推理步强制调用；TC-Decoder 用确定性有限自动机对工具名输出词表施加 token 级硬约束，参数生成保持自由，全程免训练、即插即用。
Result: 在 200 个真实遥感卫星任务、7 个 SLM 上平均总分 +1.21（p<0.01，95% CI [+1.13, +1.29]），各模型与其他数据集上一致改善；消融移除 TC-Decoder 后所有质量指标显著退化且计算开销不降。
Conclusion: 通过推理期约束允许输出词表即可强制 plan 遵循、无需重训，TC-Decoder 是主要增益来源；最终答案准确率仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Decoding of Perceived Speech from Brain Recordings
papers.abstract_en: Perceived speech decoding based on non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) signals has been extensively studied in recent years. Research in this field primarily faces two challenges: extracting neural representations with rich spatiotemporal information and achieving cross-subject generalization. Although separate studies have proposed methods to cope with these issues, a unified approach that simultaneously tackles both challenges remains lacking. To fill this gap, we propose the Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Perceived Speech Decoding (SICMD) method, which integrates functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and magnetoencephalography (MEG). We conduct comprehensive analyses of the fusion method, fusion position, encoder architecture, and model inputs. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method improves Top-1, Top-10, and Rankacc by more than 10.6%, 10.1%, and 1.7%, respectively, compared to baseline methods in cross-subject perceived speech decoding tasks, while reducing training costs by 88.8% and 60.5% compared to multi-subject and intra-subject decoding settings. Further visualization experiments also confirm the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SICMD（Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Perceived Speech Decoding），把 fMRI 与 MEG 融合做跨被试的感知语音解码，同时解决神经表征时空信息不足与跨被试泛化两个难题。在跨被试感知语音解码任务上 Top-1、Top-10、Rankacc 相对基线分别提升超过 10.6%、10.1%、1.7%，训练成本较多被试与单被试设定分别降低 88.8% 与 60.5%。
Motivation: 非侵入式 BCI 的感知语音解码面临两个并存难题：提取富含时空信息的神经表征，以及跨被试泛化；已有方法各自应对其一，缺少同时解决两者的统一方案。
Method: SICMD 融合 fMRI 与 MEG 两种模态，并对融合方法、融合位置、编码器架构与模型输入做系统分析；以跨被试设定训练与评测，指标为 Top-1、Top-10 与 Rankacc。
Result: 跨被试感知语音解码任务上，Top-1、Top-10、Rankacc 相对基线方法分别提升超过 10.6%、10.1%、1.7%；训练成本相对多被试设定降低 88.8%、相对单被试设定降低 60.5%；可视化实验进一步支持该方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 把跨模态融合与被试不变设计放进同一框架，可以在跨被试感知语音解码上同时拿到精度提升与训练成本下降。

papers.title: Adaptive Interaction Graphs for Particle Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Learned particle simulators based on graph neural networks achieve strong one-step accuracy, but errors compound over long horizons. An underexplored variable is the interaction graph: existing methods fix its topology via k-nearest neighbors or a static radius rule, regardless of local model confidence. We propose making this graph adaptive: a per-particle variance head, trained jointly with the acceleration head under a heteroscedastic Gaussian NLL loss, drives a trajectory in which high-uncertainty particles receive an expanded neighborhood. This is done at little extra inference cost by using the previous step's uncertainty estimate. A key discovery is that the variance head learns a meaningful notion of uncertainty: high-variance particles concentrate near complex regions, such as splash zones or free surfaces. When this signal drives graph topology, the resulting AdaptGNS simulator achieves a strict Pareto improvement on WaterDrop and a modest gain on Sand. Given the model's stronger performance on WaterDrop, we hypothesize that adaptive graphs are most useful when complexity is concentrated in space. Our code can be found at https://github.com/aidenzhou8/AdaptGNS.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Presented at ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Physics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptGNS 在图神经网络粒子模拟器上加一个与加速度头联合训练的逐粒子方差头（异方差 Gaussian NLL），用上一步的不确定性估计动态扩展高不确定性粒子的邻域，从而让交互图拓扑自适应。在 WaterDrop 上取得严格 Pareto 改进、Sand 上小幅提升，高方差粒子集中在 splash 区与自由面等复杂区域。
Motivation: GNN 粒子模拟器单步精度高但长时域误差累积，而交互图拓扑通常被 k-NN 或静态半径规则固定，不随局部模型置信度调整。
Method: 逐粒子方差头与加速度头在异方差 Gaussian NLL 下联合训练；推理时用上一步的不确定性估计驱动邻域扩展，几乎不增加推理开销，得到 AdaptGNS 模拟器。
Result: 在 WaterDrop 上实现严格 Pareto 改进，在 Sand 上小幅提升；高方差粒子集中于 splash 区与自由面等复杂区域，作者据此假设自适应图在复杂度空间集中的场景最有用。
Conclusion: 让不确定性信号直接决定交互图拓扑可在低开销下改善长时域粒子模拟，且收益依赖复杂度在空间上的集中程度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Quantizing Looped Transformers: Feedback Exposure and Calibration Blindness
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers reuse weights across recurrence steps, making low-bit quantization especially attractive. We identify two distinct failure modes of standard post-training quantization. On Huginn-3.5B, per-channel INT4 fails primarily at the non-residual loop-entry adapter, while quantizing the residual core is much less damaging. We call this feedback exposure: a quantized layer perturbs the recurrent state without an identity path, and the resulting error is fed back at later steps. Controlled experiments on linear filters and Mamba state-space models show that feedback exposure also occurs outside transformers. Grouped INT4 reveals a separate failure, calibration blindness: our one-step GPTQ baseline builds its Hessian from step-0 activations, leaving input directions used later in the recurrence nearly unweighted. Across nine checkpoints from seven looped architectures, one-step GPTQ is worse than round-to-nearest (RTN) on the primary task metric for five checkpoints. Accumulating the GPTQ Hessian across recurrence steps outperforms both one-step GPTQ and RTN on all nine checkpoints and recovers bf16-level accuracy on Huginn. These results separate two questions for PTQ on looped models: where quantization error enters the recurrence, and which states calibration sees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 循环 Transformer 的低比特 PTQ 有两种独立失效：非残差的 loop-entry adapter 被量化后扰动递归状态且无恒等通路，误差被后续步反馈放大（feedback exposure）；一步 GPTQ 只用 step-0 激活建 Hessian，漏掉后续递归步使用的输入方向（calibration blindness）。把 GPTQ 的 Hessian 沿递归步累积后，在七个循环架构的九个 checkpoint 上全部超过一步 GPTQ 与 RTN，并在 Huginn 上恢复 bf16 精度。
Motivation: 循环复用权重的模型（如 Huginn-3.5B）对低比特量化本应更划算，但标准 PTQ 在这类递归结构上有两个未被区分的失效来源：误差进入递归的位置，以及校准实际覆盖到哪些状态。
Method: 在 Huginn-3.5B 上做受控量化实验，分别量化非残差 loop-entry adapter 与残差核心；用线性滤波器与 Mamba 状态空间模型做对照以检验 feedback exposure 是否超出 Transformer；以一步 GPTQ（Hessian 取自 step-0 激活）为基线，并提出沿递归步累积 GPTQ Hessian 的校准方式，跨七个循环架构的九个 checkpoint 比较。
Result: Huginn-3.5B 上 per-channel INT4 主要败在非残差 loop-entry adapter，量化残差核心损害小得多；grouped INT4 下一步 GPTQ 在九个 checkpoint 中的五个上主任务指标差于 RTN；累积 Hessian 的 GPTQ 在全部九个 checkpoint 上同时超过一步 GPTQ 与 RTN，并在 Huginn 上恢复 bf16 级精度。
Conclusion: 循环模型的 PTQ 要分开处理两个问题：量化误差从递归的哪个位置进入，以及校准看到了哪些状态；沿递归步累积校准统计即可同时解决二者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Provable Neural Network Observer for Uncertain Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: In many safety-critical applications, control of uncertain dynamical systems relies on observers that estimate states and external disturbances. Neural network observers can improve estimation accuracy, but certifying their Lyapunov stability via Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) constraints leads to large-scale semidefinite programs (SDPs) that are difficult to solve for large networks. To overcome this scalability bottleneck, we propose a novel two-stage training framework for provably stable neural network observers. Our approach decouples the optimization into a point-guided Lyapunov pre-training phase, which rapidly achieves high estimation accuracy and local stability over sampled states, followed by an LMI fine-tuning phase that efficiently satisfies a strict global Lyapunov stability certificate. We provide formal theoretical guarantees for local stability radii and probabilistic coverage over a prescribed compact error-state domain under specified regularity and sampling assumptions. Experiments on nonlinear control benchmarks and X-29 aircraft ablations show that our LMI-certified neural network observers train significantly faster than direct LMI-based methods and generalize robustly across diverse systems, achieving improved tracking accuracy over a range of observer baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Berry-Myon/LearningNeuralNetworkObserver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段训练框架，先用点引导的 Lyapunov 预训练快速获得高估计精度与采样态上的局部稳定，再用 LMI 微调满足严格的全局 Lyapunov 稳定证书，绕开大规模半定规划 (SDP) 的求解瓶颈。在非线性控制基准与 X-29 飞机消融实验中，训练速度显著快于直接 LMI 方法，并在多个观测器基线上提升跟踪精度。
Motivation: 安全攸关的不确定动力系统控制依赖同时估计状态与外部扰动的观测器；用 LMI 约束认证神经网络观测器的 Lyapunov 稳定性会生成大规模 SDP，网络一大就难以求解。
Method: 两阶段训练：点引导 Lyapunov 预训练阶段在采样状态上快速达到高估计精度与局部稳定，随后 LMI 微调阶段满足严格的全局 Lyapunov 稳定证书；在给定正则性与采样假设下，给出局部稳定半径与规定紧致误差状态域上概率覆盖的形式化理论保证。
Result: 在非线性控制基准与 X-29 飞机消融实验中，LMI 认证的神经网络观测器训练速度显著快于直接 LMI 方法，并在一系列观测器基线上取得改进的跟踪精度，跨多样系统稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 把稳定性认证拆成预训练加 LMI 微调两步，可以在保留全局 Lyapunov 证书的同时解决大网络 SDP 难解的扩展性问题。

papers.title: Evaluation Is All You Need for Multi-Modal Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal planning is promising for autonomous driving by representing multiple plausible behaviors in ambiguous and long-tail scenarios. Existing methods mainly focus on improving trajectory multi-modality, enhancing trajectory representations, or reshaping the candidate distribution. Nevertheless, we identify a pronounced generation-evaluation asymmetry in multi-modal planning: despite strong oracle performance, existing planners often fail to reliably select the best available candidate, leaving substantial planning potential unrealized. To address this challenge, we propose iDriveVLA, a multi-modal planning framework that improves the candidate trajectory space while enabling more reliable and context-aware trajectory evaluation. Specifically, iDriveVLA introduces a unified trajectory evaluator comprising a Safety-aware Scorer for quality and risk estimation, together with a VLM-guided Modulator for scene-adaptive criterion weighting. We further develop an oracle-aligned progressive training strategy consisting of candidate imitation pretraining, candidate space refinement, and semantic ranking alignment. On the public NAVSIM v1 leaderboard, iDriveVLA achieves a new state-of-the-art performance of 94.95 PDMS, surpassing the human-expert reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自动驾驶多模态规划存在生成-评估不对称：候选轨迹里已有接近 oracle 的解，但规划器选不出最好的那条。iDriveVLA 用统一轨迹评估器（Safety-aware Scorer 打质量与风险分，VLM-guided Modulator 按场景自适应调权重），配合候选模仿预训练、候选空间精化、语义排序对齐三阶段训练，在 NAVSIM v1 公开榜达到 94.95 PDMS 的新 SOTA，超过 human-expert 参考线。
Motivation: 多模态规划已有较强 oracle 表现，但现有方法只在轨迹多模态性、轨迹表示和候选分布上做文章，规划器无法可靠选出最优候选，规划潜力被浪费。
Method: iDriveVLA 框架包含统一轨迹评估器：Safety-aware Scorer 负责候选质量与风险估计，VLM-guided Modulator 按场景自适应调整评价准则权重；训练用 oracle-aligned 渐进策略，依次做 candidate imitation pretraining、candidate space refinement、semantic ranking alignment。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 公开榜上取得 94.95 PDMS 的新 state-of-the-art，超过 human-expert 参考表现。
Conclusion: 多模态规划的瓶颈在评估而非生成：把候选空间改进与上下文感知的可靠评估绑定训练，就能把已有的 oracle 潜力兑现成实际选点性能。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: A Benchmark and Diagnostic Study of Epistemic Admission in Shared Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating claim admission in shared agent memory is challenging because repeated claims may be mistaken for independent evidence. An agent may copy or paraphrase a retrieved belief, while admitting a false claim exposes subsequent agents to it. To study this problem, we introduce the Correlated Promotion Benchmark (CPB), which evaluates whether candidate claims should be admitted to shared memory.CPB-Static constructs a frozen test split from publicly annotated sources with fixed gold actions. CPB-Live runs multi-agent teams over a shared store, records all writes and retrievals, and tracks source lineage defined by each scenario. A separate consumer answers from the store alone. We evaluate eight admission policies across four agent families. Our results show that policies which deduplicate sources reject many true claims alongside false ones, whereas policies preserving answer coverage admit nearly as many false claims as unrestricted sharing. Gating on declared source type reduces false adoption to 0.06--0.09, compared with 0.22--0.47 for other answering policies. Once an uncontested false belief enters memory, the consumer asserts it in 0.97--0.99 of probes across all families. No non-oracle policy consistently rejects false claims across verbatim copies, paraphrases, and paraphrases declared authoritative. These findings reveal the limitations of admission policies without access to source lineage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共享 agent 记忆中，重复或改写的主张会被误当成独立证据，导致假主张进入记忆。CPB 评测显示，按声明的来源类型做门控可把错误采纳率降到 0.06–0.09（其他答题策略为 0.22–0.47），而一旦无争议的假信念入库，consumer 在 0.97–0.99 的探针中会直接断言它；没有任何非 oracle 策略能在逐字复制、改写、以及被声明为权威的改写三种情形下稳定拒绝假主张。
Motivation: 共享记忆里 agent 可能复制或改述检索到的信念，重复主张被当作独立证据，而放行假主张会污染后续 agent；现有准入策略缺少来源谱系 (source lineage) 信息，难以区分真重复与假重复。
Method: 提出 Correlated Promotion Benchmark (CPB)：CPB-Static 从公开标注来源构造冻结测试划分并固定 gold action；CPB-Live 让多 agent 团队在共享存储上运行，记录全部写入与检索并追踪每个场景定义的来源谱系，另设一个只读存储作答的 consumer；在四个 agent 家族上评测八种准入策略。
Result: 去重来源的策略在拒绝假主张的同时也大量拒绝真主张，保答案覆盖的策略则几乎放行与无限制共享同样多的假主张；按声明来源类型门控使错误采纳率降到 0.06–0.09，其他答题策略为 0.22–0.47；假信念入库后 consumer 在 0.97–0.99 的探针中断言它，跨全部 agent 家族一致。
Conclusion: 没有来源谱系访问权的准入策略无法在逐字复制、改写与被声明为权威的改写之间稳定区分真假主张，去重与保覆盖两种思路各有系统性代价。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 去重来源的策略在拒绝假主张的同时也大量拒绝真主张，保答案覆盖的策略则几乎放行与无限制共享同样多的假主张；按声明来源类型门控使错误采纳率降到 0.06–0.09，其他答题策略为 0.22–0.47；假信念入库后 consumer 在 0.97–0.99 的探针中断言它，跨全部 agent 家族一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 没有来源谱系访问权的准入策略无法在逐字复制、改写与被声明为权威的改写之间稳定区分真假主张，去重与保覆盖两种思路各有系统性代价。

papers.title: Counterfactual Online Conformal Prediction Under Adaptive Logging
papers.abstract_en: Online conformal prediction can fail when predictions shape actions and actions determine which outcomes enter calibration. Standard adaptive methods may retain marginal coverage while systematically miscovering the counterfactual outcomes of rarely selected actions. This paper formalizes the failure through counterfactual coverage and introduces Propensity-Weighted Online Conformal Prediction, an inverse-propensity-weighted recursion that debiases calibration. A doubly robust variant further reduces nuisance bias to the product of outcome-model and propensity errors. Under positivity, the resulting coverage rate matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Experiments on synthetic decision tasks, open bandit data, and financial rebalancing show that PW-OCP and DR-OCP improve counterfactual coverage and downstream regret without sacrificing prediction-set sharpness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当预测会驱动动作、而动作又决定哪些结果进入校准时，在线保形预测 (online conformal prediction) 会对极少被选动作的反事实结果系统性失覆盖。提出逆倾向加权递推 PW-OCP 去偏校准，其 doubly robust 变体 DR-OCP 把 nuisance 偏差降到结果模型误差与倾向误差之积；在 positivity 下覆盖率逼近信息论下界（仅差对数因子），并在合成决策任务、open bandit 数据与金融再平衡上同时改善反事实覆盖与下游 regret，且不牺牲预测集锐度。
Motivation: 预测决定动作、动作决定校准数据来源时，标准自适应方法虽保住边际覆盖，却对极少被选动作的反事实结果系统性失覆盖。
Method: 形式化 counterfactual coverage，提出 Propensity-Weighted Online Conformal Prediction (PW-OCP)：用逆倾向加权递推对校准去偏；再给出 doubly robust 变体 DR-OCP，把 nuisance 偏差降为结果模型误差与倾向误差之积，并在 positivity 条件下分析覆盖率。
Result: 在合成决策任务、open bandit 数据与金融再平衡三类实验中，PW-OCP 与 DR-OCP 同时改善反事实覆盖与下游 regret，且不牺牲预测集锐度；在 positivity 下覆盖率与信息论下界仅差对数因子。
Conclusion: 反事实失覆盖来自校准数据被动作选择所偏，逆倾向加权与 doubly robust 校准能在不损失锐度的前提下修复它，且理论达到信息论下界（差对数因子）。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Deep-Learning Solvers and Surrogates for Infinity and p-Laplace Problems
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the use of neural network solvers for infinity and $p$-Laplace problems, which are fundamental in nonlinear analysis and have practical applications. Our approach employs Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) to address computational challenges associated with large $p$ values, ranging from $2$ to $1000$, on various 2D and 3D domains. Our method offers advantages over traditional physics-based solvers, especially in three dimensions where mesh-based solvers become very costly for these problems. We also establish conditional convergence results for PINN approximations of both problems and a universal approximation result for DeepONet on the parametric $p$-Poisson problem. We demonstrate the effectiveness of these neural network solvers through numerical experiments and compare their performance with conventional methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 PINN 与 DeepONet 求解 infinity-Laplace 与 p-Laplace 问题，覆盖 p 从 2 到 1000 的 2D/3D 域，绕开大 p 与三维网格法的高昂代价；同时给出 PINN 的条件收敛结果与 DeepONet 在参数化 p-Poisson 问题上的万有逼近结果，并用数值实验与传统方法对比。
Motivation: p-Laplace 与 infinity-Laplace 问题在大 p 值和三维域上，基于网格的传统物理求解器计算代价极高，需要更省算力的替代求解途径。
Method: 采用两类神经网络求解器：Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) 直接以物理残差为损失逼近解，Deep Operator Networks (DeepONet) 学习参数化 p-Poisson 问题的算子映射；在多种 2D 与 3D 域上处理 p 取值 2 至 1000 的情形，并配套建立理论结果。
Result: 数值实验显示神经网络求解器有效并与常规方法作了性能对比；理论上建立了 PINN 对这两类问题的条件收敛结果，以及 DeepONet 对参数化 p-Poisson 问题的万有逼近结果；方法优势在三维、网格求解器代价高的情形最明显，p 覆盖 2 至 1000。
Conclusion: 神经网络求解器可作为大 p、三维 infinity/p-Laplace 问题的可行替代，并有收敛与逼近理论支撑。

papers.title: XPhysICS: Cross-Physical-Domain Threat Grounding for Industrial Control Systems Security
papers.abstract_en: Industrial control system (ICS) threats documented for one plant can express cyber-physical effects relevant to another, but semantic similarity alone does not establish whether those effects are structurally admissible or evaluable on a target. We present XPhysICS, a provenance-aware, target-conditioned method that separates analyst-guided source abstraction from deterministic grounding into target-specific validation slices. Given a fixed source abstraction, vocabulary and schema, and machine-validated target contract, XPhysICS evaluates candidate mappings using five eligibility criteria: role compatibility, implemented type compatibility, stage coherence, slice viability, and rule-surface applicability. Grounding acceptance, slice adequacy, dynamic realizability, consumer applicability, and consumer outcome remain distinct evidence layers. We evaluate 83 structured source-threat abstractions across water treatment, water distribution, hydro/water-energy, and chemical-process targets. Controlled target-side studies of SWaT-to-water-treatment and WADI-to-water-distribution groundings produce clean, nominal-confounded, and near-threshold consumer outcomes; nine Hydro/GRFICS cases extend bounded validation-slice execution. We also evaluate bounded predictive, state-aware, and phase-aware consumer lanes, the unmodified upstream GeCo implementation, and a paper-derived reproduction of a physics-guided search method over three frozen groundings. Results show that cross-domain ICS threat reuse requires traceable source semantics, explicit target-conditioned grounding criteria, and careful separation of subsequent target-side evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XPhysICS 把一个厂站记录的 ICS 威胁迁移到另一类目标系统时，先做可溯源的源侧抽象，再用五条目标条件化的资格判据（角色兼容、已实现类型兼容、阶段一致性、切片可行性、规则面适用性）做确定性 grounding，把接受、切片充分性、动态可实现性与消费方结果拆成独立证据层。在 83 条结构化源威胁抽象与 SWaT、WADI、Hydro/GRFICS 目标上的受控研究显示，跨域 ICS 威胁复用必须同时具备可溯源源语义、显式 grounding 判据与目标侧证据的严格分离。
Motivation: 一个厂站文档化的 ICS 威胁对另一厂站往往具有可类比的网络-物理效应，但仅靠语义相似无法判定该效应在目标系统上是否结构可容、可被评估，跨域复用因此缺少可审计的准入依据。
Method: XPhysICS 采用 provenance-aware、target-conditioned 的两段式流程：固定源侧抽象、词表与 schema，加上机器校验的目标契约；候选映射按五条资格判据评估（role compatibility、implemented type compatibility、stage coherence、slice viability、rule-surface applicability），并把 grounding acceptance、slice adequacy、dynamic realizability、consumer applicability、consumer outcome 保持为相互独立的证据层。
Result: 在 water treatment、water distribution、hydro/water-energy、chemical-process 四类目标上评估 83 条结构化源威胁抽象；SWaT→water-treatment 与 WADI→water-distribution 的受控目标侧研究产出 clean、nominal-confounded 与 near-threshold 三类 consumer outcome；9 个 Hydro/GRFICS 案例扩展了有界的 validation-slice 执行；另在三个冻结 groundings 上评估了 bounded predictive、state-aware、phase-aware 三种 consumer lane、未改动的上游 GeCo 实现，以及一个从论文复现的 physics-guided 搜索方法。
Conclusion: 跨域 ICS 威胁复用成立的条件是：源语义可溯源、目标条件化的 grounding 判据显式给出，且其后的目标侧证据必须分层独立，不能与 grounding 接受混为一谈。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Evaluating Real-Time Voice Agents: From Component Quality to Grounded Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Real-time voice agents have moved from research prototypes to production deployments, yet the literature describing them is fragmented across three communities that rarely cite one another: speech foundation modelling, turn-taking psycholinguistics, and agentic evaluation. Architecture papers report latency, turn-taking papers report prediction accuracy, and agentic benchmarks report task success, so no single number describes whether a deployed agent is actually good. We address that gap with three evidence-based claims, each traceable to a corpus of 38 primary sources organised into an application-centric taxonomy of six categories. First, architecture choice is a deployment constraint rather than a settled verdict: a 2026 enterprise tutorial reports that no fully self-hostable end-to-end system yet meets production constraints, while a chunked cascade independently reaches state-of-the-art duplex behaviour, showing duplex behaviour is separable from duplex architecture. Second, evaluation has shifted decisively from component quality toward grounded outcomes, with recent benchmarks verifying backend state rather than trusting what the agent claims to have done. Third, the dyadic assumption in most models and benchmarks is breaking down: multiparty turn-taking and multi-speaker reasoning benchmarks show that deciding when not to speak, and reasoning about who may be told what, are first-class capabilities two-participant framings cannot measure. For each source we state the problem it targets, its mechanism, and its reported evidence, alongside the search strategy, inclusion criteria, and a verification step that caught a misattributed arXiv identifier in circulation. We propose TRG (Timing-Recovery-Grounded), a reporting standard characterising an agent by timing, post-disruption recovery, and state-verified outcome together, with a conditional fourth axis for multiparty deployments.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Corpus metadata, SHA-256 provenance hashes, and TRG reporting-standard tooling available at https://github.com/shivamnegi92/voice-agent-eval-corpus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把实时语音 agent 评测的碎片化文献整理成 38 篇一手来源的应用中心分类（六类），并提出 TRG 报告标准：用 timing、post-disruption recovery、state-verified outcome 三个轴联合刻画 agent，多方部署再加条件性第四轴。核心论断是评测重心已从组件质量转向可核验的 grounded outcome，且双人假设正在失效——多方场景下“何时不该说话”和“谁可以被告知什么”是双参与者框架测不到的一等能力。
Motivation: 语音基础建模、轮次转换心理语言学、agentic 评测三个社区互不引用：架构论文报延迟、轮次论文报预测准确率、agentic benchmark 报任务成功率，没有任何单一数字能说明一个已部署 agent 到底好不好。
Method: 以 38 篇一手来源构建应用中心的六类 taxonomy，逐篇标注其针对的问题、机制与报告证据，并给出检索策略、纳入标准与一步验证（该验证抓到一个流传中的错误 arXiv 标识符）；在此基础上提出 TRG 报告标准，把 timing、post-disruption recovery、state-verified outcome 一起报告，多方部署加第四轴。
Result: 三条证据性论断：2026 年企业教程报告尚无完全可自托管的端到端系统满足生产约束，而 chunked cascade 独立达到 SOTA 双工行为，说明双工行为与双工架构可分离；近期 benchmark 直接核验后端状态而非采信 agent 自述；multiparty 轮次与多说话人推理 benchmark 显示多方能力无法由双参与者框架测量。语料含 38 篇来源，论文 11 页、1 图、1 表。
Conclusion: 实时语音 agent 的评测应以 TRG 三轴联合报告取代单一延迟或任务成功率数字，架构选择按部署约束而非定论处理；多方部署需额外加一条条件性轴。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HasMem: Hard-Origin Adaptively Softened Memory for Long-Term LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Text-based memory and context compression support reuse of past interactions. Resizing continuous memory changes the input to a frozen LLM, coupling capacity allocation with readout. We propose Hard-Origin Adaptively Softened Memory (HasMem). Frozen hard-prompt embeddings provide a verifiable initial state. A controller adjusts memory widths, a Writer re-encodes resized entries, and Reader and Global provide readout adaptation and cross-turn state. On all $535$ questions in a reconstruction probe derived from the Multi-Session Chat (MSC) development split, the main configuration achieves lexical F1 of $95.3$ ($+4.4$ percentage points) at $93.6\%$ of the hard reference's framed memory positions. With approximately matched per-question target body budgets, six configurations at mean per-entry retention around $0.83$--$0.91$ exceed rule-based re-encoding by $8.0$--$23.6$ exact-match (EM) percentage points. With fixed model parameters and rule target width ratio $0.75$, Global's EM gain passes a user-level exact paired test with Bonferroni correction over eight comparisons. On all $500$ LongMemEval-S questions, local lexical F1 rises from the hard reference's $3.4$ to $8.9$, and answer negative log-likelihood (NLL) falls from $12.257$ to $5.274$. F1 gains accompany lower EM on both evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HasMem 针对长程 LLM agent 的连续记忆压缩：以冻结 hard-prompt 嵌入为可校验初始状态，由 controller 调整记忆宽度、Writer 重编码条目、Reader 与 Global 做读出适配。在 MSC 重建探针 535 题上 lexical F1 达 95.3（+4.4 个百分点），在 LongMemEval-S 500 题上 F1 从 3.4 升到 8.9、NLL 从 12.257 降到 5.274，但两次评测中 F1 上升都伴随 EM 下降。
Motivation: 文本记忆与上下文压缩可复用历史交互，但调整连续记忆尺寸会改变送入冻结 LLM 的输入，使容量分配与读出耦合，缺少可校验的初始状态。
Method: 以冻结 hard-prompt 嵌入作为可校验初始状态；controller 调整记忆宽度，Writer 重编码被缩放的条目，Reader 与 Global 分别负责读出适配与跨轮状态；对比 rule-based re-encoding，并在固定模型参数、rule target width ratio 0.75 下做 user-level 精确配对检验（Bonferroni 校正，八次比较）。
Result: MSC dev 派生重建探针全部 535 题：主配置 lexical F1 95.3（+4.4 个百分点），占用 hard reference framed memory positions 的 93.6%；在每题 target body 预算近似匹配、mean per-entry retention 约 0.83–0.91 时，六种配置的 exact-match (EM) 比 rule-based re-encoding 高 8.0–23.6 个百分点；Global 的 EM 增益通过 Bonferroni 校正的 user-level 精确配对检验。LongMemEval-S 全部 500 题：local lexical F1 从 3.4 升至 8.9，answer NLL 从 12.257 降至 5.274；两项评测中 F1 增益都伴随 EM 下降。
Conclusion: 以冻结 hard-prompt 为起点的自适应软化记忆能在压缩预算下显著抬高词汇级 F1 并降低答案 NLL，但 F1 与 EM 在两个评测上呈反向权衡，读出适配的收益需按指标分别核对。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ConsultMind:Towards Automated Diagnostic Consultation via Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic consultation is an online sequential decision-making process in which clinicians gather evidence through patient interaction until a diagnosis is sufficiently supported. Automating this process requires adaptive inquiry and interpretable decisions. Bayesian networks offer a natural foundation by updating diagnostic posteriors as evidence accumulates, but their use in open-ended consultation raises two challenges: linking diagnostic hypotheses to potential inquiries and translating evolving posteriors into consultation decisions. We introduce AutoDisym, an automated pipeline that integrates diagnostic knowledge with heterogeneous diagnosis-labeled clinical narratives to construct a Disorder--Symptom Bayesian Network (DSBN). Building on the DSBN, we propose ConsultMind, an uncertainty-aware framework that updates disorder posteriors after each response and uses posterior uncertainty to guide inquiry and diagnosis. We evaluate both methods across psychiatry, respiratory medicine, fever clinics, and three public datasets. The results show that AutoDisym can automatically construct high-quality DSBNs and that ConsultMind consistently improves diagnostic performance and explanation soundness. For example, AutoDisym achieves macro-averaged F1 scores of 81.37 for canonical symptoms and 72.19 for manifestations using GPT-5.6-Sol. ConsultMind improves Top-1 and Top-3 diagnostic accuracy by up to 22.15 and 37.89 percentage points, respectively. Physician evaluation further shows that ConsultMind improves the quality of ranking explanations, differential diagnoses, and diagnosis rationales across LLMs of different scales. This work offers a promising approach to automatic diagnostic consultation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConsultMind 把自动构建的 Disorder–Symptom Bayesian Network (DSBN) 用作不确定性感知的诊断问诊框架：每轮回答后更新疾病后验，用后验不确定性决定下一个问题与最终诊断。在精神病学、呼吸科、发热门诊及三个公开数据集上，Top-1 与 Top-3 诊断准确率最多分别提升 22.15 和 37.89 个百分点，医生评审确认排序解释、鉴别诊断与诊断理由质量提升。
Motivation: 开放式诊断问诊需要边问边判，但 Bayesian networks 缺少把诊断假设映射到候选询问、以及把演化中的后验转成问诊决策的机制，人工建网也难规模化。
Method: AutoDisym 流水线融合诊断知识与带诊断标签的异质临床叙事，自动构建 Disorder–Symptom Bayesian Network (DSBN)；ConsultMind 在其上逐轮更新疾病后验，并以后验不确定性引导询问与诊断；用 GPT-5.6-Sol 等不同规模 LLM 评测，并由医生评审解释质量。
Result: AutoDisym 用 GPT-5.6-Sol 构建的 DSBN 上，canonical symptoms 的 macro-averaged F1 为 81.37，manifestations 为 72.19；ConsultMind 使 Top-1 与 Top-3 诊断准确率最多提升 22.15 与 37.89 个百分点；医生评审显示排序解释、鉴别诊断与诊断理由质量在不同规模 LLM 上均改善。
Conclusion: 自动构建的 DSBN 加上以不确定性驱动的逐轮后验更新，能在多个专科与公开数据集上稳定提升诊断准确率与解释可信度，为自动诊断问诊提供可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Motion Style Slider: Endpoint-Supervised Continuous Style Control for Human Motion Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing human motion diffusion methods provide strong motion generation quality, and recent style transfer models can inject target style cues, but fine-grained continuous control of style intensity remains underexplored. In production, style intensity is subjective across artists and directors, so the practical requirement is not a universal absolute unit, but a reliable monotonic control axis. We propose Motion Style Slider, a motion-to-motion style transfer framework for endpoint-supervised continuous control. Given a content motion and a style motion, we construct a style direction in a learned motion-style embedding space and condition diffusion generation with a scalar intensity. The training objective combines diffusion denoising with latent intensity regularization to encourage smooth and monotonic style scaling without requiring intermediate-intensity ground-truth motions. Our framework is compatible with pretrained motion diffusion backbones and supports heterogeneous style datasets, including the multi-actor style motion dataset. To test out-of-range usability, we additionally introduce a small real-capture over-reaction extension and evaluate large-intensity behavior against these unseen targets. Experiments measure controllability, interpolation/extrapolation behavior, content preservation, and motion realism, with ablations on direction construction and loss design.
papers.journal_ref: Liao, CC. et al. (2026). Motion Style Slider: Endpoint-Supervised Continuous Style Control for Human Motion Diffusion. In ECCV 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17026. Springer, Cham
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Motion Style Slider 把风格强度做成可连续调节的标量滑杆：在学到的 motion-style 嵌入空间里由内容动作与风格动作构造风格方向，再以标量强度条件化扩散生成，训练用扩散去噪加 latent 强度正则强制风格随强度平滑单调缩放，无需中间强度的真值动作。评测覆盖可控性、插值/外推行为、内容保持与动作真实度，并在真实采集的 over-reaction 扩展上检验大强度外推。
Motivation: 现有人体动作扩散与风格迁移能生成高质量动作、注入目标风格，但风格强度的细粒度连续控制基本空白；生产中风格强度因美术与导演而异，需要的不是统一绝对单位，而是可靠的单调控制轴。
Method: 给定内容动作与风格动作，在学到的 motion-style 嵌入空间中构造风格方向，以标量强度条件化扩散生成；训练目标为扩散去噪加 latent 强度正则，鼓励平滑单调的风格缩放且不需中间强度真值动作。框架兼容预训练 motion diffusion backbone，支持异构风格数据集（含 multi-actor style motion dataset），并做方向构造与损失设计的 ablation。
Result: 实验测量可控性、插值/外推行为、内容保持与动作真实度，并对方向构造与损失设计做 ablation；为检验越界可用性，另采集小型真实 over-reaction 扩展，用这些未见目标评估大强度行为。
Conclusion: 端点监督加强度正则即可在无需中间强度真值的前提下得到单调、可外推的风格强度控制轴，且可挂到预训练动作扩散骨干上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Universal Representation-Based Process Control
papers.abstract_en: Many temporal process learning and monitoring pipelines operate in local windows, making window-level decisions unavoidable in practice. In such settings, classical statistical tests can be applied to individual windows, but they typically evaluate predefined parametric hypotheses-such as unit-root or moment-based conditions-thereby limiting flexibility when reference behavior is defined empirically from task- or domain-specific data. In this work, we view window-level monitoring as a process control problem and reformulate it as reference-based hypothesis testing, where the null hypothesis is specified by an empirical reference distribution rather than a fixed parametric model. We operationalize this perspective through a representation-based, nonparametric framework that combines pretrained time series encoders, kernel density estimation, and conformal calibration, yielding finite-sample valid inference in learned representation space. Classical notions such as stationarity and cyclostationarity arise as natural instantiations of empirical reference sets within this framework. Through experiments, we demonstrate sensitivity to window-level distributional deviations while maintaining well-calibrated inference under stable reference regimes, highlighting the applicability of the proposed approach to a broad class of time series process control and monitoring tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把窗口级时序监控重构为以经验参考分布为零假设的参考式假设检验，用预训练时序编码器、核密度估计 (KDE) 与 conformal 校准在学习表示空间中做非参数推断，得到有限样本有效性的结论。平稳性与循环平稳性成为该框架下参考集的特例；实验显示它对窗口级分布偏移敏感，同时在参考分布稳定时保持良好校准。
Motivation: 窗口级监控里经典检验只能针对单位根、矩条件等预设参数化假设，当参考行为由任务或领域数据经验定义时灵活性不足。
Method: 将窗口监控表述为参考式假设检验：零假设由经验参考分布而非固定参数模型给出；用预训练时序编码器把窗口映射到表示空间，在该空间用 KDE 估计参考分布，再用 conformal 校准保证有限样本有效推断。
Result: 实验表明该方法对窗口级分布偏移具有敏感性，同时在参考分布稳定的 regime 下保持校准良好的推断；平稳性与循环平稳性作为经验参考集的自然实例被纳入同一框架。
Conclusion: 以经验参考分布加 conformal 校准替代参数化假设，可把一大类时序过程控制与监控任务统一到表示空间的非参数检验中。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Interpretable-by-Design Descriptor Portfolios Match a 2048-Dimensional Foundation Embedding on Low-Data Molecular Assays
papers.abstract_en: In low-data structure-activity prediction, the choice of molecular representation can matter more than the choice of predictor, and tabular foundation models sharpen that effect. We ask whether a portfolio of compact, semantically named descriptor blocks can reach the accuracy of a 2048-dimensional CheMeleon embedding while staying auditable at the feature level, meaning that every input dimension carries a model name and a recorded training provenance. Starting from a fixed 11-dimensional physicochemical base, we greedily concatenate provenance-screened blocks using the labelled context alone. Across nine ADME/Tox assays and 50 evaluation cells, scored on common-coverage subsets restricted to the molecules that every representation covers, the portfolio reaches a mean test AUC of 0.762, against 0.764 for CheMeleon and 0.756 for Mordred. The pooled gap to CheMeleon is +0.003 AUC (task-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.020, +0.030]), which satisfies our predeclared pooled parity gate but not the per-assay gate. At 25 context labels the headline rule again satisfies the pooled gate; at 10 labels it does not. We also report four predeclared candidate-selection rules that we falsified. Post-freeze checks over ten seeds and three previously unseen assays support pooled competitiveness for compact, auditable representations; a same-width random-bundle control does not establish that greedy membership itself adds accuracy. Assay-level differences remain unresolved.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 8 appendices. Under review. Code: https://github.com/ersilia-os/chemicl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在低数据结构活性预测中，用可审计的紧凑描述符组合（从 11 维理化基座出发、按标注上下文贪心拼接带来源记录的语义命名块）在 9 个 ADME/Tox assay、50 个评估单元上达到平均测试 AUC 0.762，与 2048 维 CheMeleon 嵌入的 0.764 基本持平、高于 Mordred 的 0.756。合并差距 +0.003 AUC（task-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.020, +0.030]）满足预声明的合并平价门槛，但不满足逐 assay 门槛；25 个标注时仍满足合并门槛，10 个标注时不满足。
Motivation: 低数据场景下分子表示的选择比预测器本身更关键，而表格基础模型放大了这一效应；黑盒高维嵌入（如 2048 维 CheMeleon）精度高但特征层不可审计，需要检验紧凑、语义命名且带训练来源的描述符组合能否在保持可审计性的同时匹配其精度。
Method: 从固定的 11 维理化基座出发，仅用标注上下文（labelled context）贪心拼接经过来源筛查（provenance-screened）的描述符块，使每个输入维度都带有模型名与记录的训练来源；在 9 个 ADME/Tox assay、50 个评估单元上评测，评分限定在所有表示共同覆盖的分子子集（common-coverage subsets）；另预声明四条候选选择规则并加以证伪，做冻结后检查（十个种子、三个未见 assay），并设置同宽度随机捆绑（random-bundle）对照。
Result: 组合平均测试 AUC 0.762，CheMeleon 0.764，Mordred 0.756；合并差距 +0.003 AUC，task-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.020, +0.030]，满足预声明合并平价门槛但不满足逐 assay 门槛。25 个 context labels 时头条规则仍满足合并门槛，10 个标签时不满足。冻结后检查覆盖十个种子与三个先前未见 assay，支持紧凑可审计表示的合并竞争力；同宽度随机捆绑对照未能证明贪心成员选择本身带来精度提升。四条预声明候选选择规则被证伪，assay 级差异仍未解决。
Conclusion: 紧凑、特征级可审计的描述符组合在合并层面可与 2048 维基础嵌入持平，但逐 assay 平价未达成，且贪心成员选择的增益未被随机捆绑对照证实。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skip the Talk, Re-Focus on Vision: Latent Reasoning for Reasoning Segmentation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation aims to interpret implicit textual queries and enable fine-grained visual perception, which is critical for applications such as human-computer interaction and embodied agents. Existing methods typically generate explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) before localizing the target. Although intuitive, such explicit verbal reasoning introduces substantial attention interference: redundant textual tokens disrupt attention during perception-token generation and also increase the effective distance between visual tokens. To address this issue, we propose LIRSeg, which fully replaces explicit CoT with a compact set of learnable latent tokens for reasoning segmentation. LIRSeg is trained in two stages: spatial alignment grounds the latent tokens in object-relevant visual evidence, and GRPO further optimizes them with segmentation rewards. To make these compact latent tokens more informative, we introduce three complementary mechanisms from an information perspective: extreme-advantage sampling for selecting informative training signals, decoupled exploration-stability updates for learning complementary representations, and latent diversity amplification for preventing representational collapse. Extensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that LIRSeg consistently improves both segmentation accuracy and reasoning efficiency. Compared with the VisionReasoner baseline, LIRSeg achieves absolute gIoU improvements of 4.9% on ReasonSeg, 7.1% on MUSE, and 4.7% on MMR, while achieving a approximately 16x reduction in reasoning tokens. Code is available in supplementary materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIRSeg 用一组可学习的 latent tokens 完全取代 MLLM 推理分割中的显式 CoT，先做空间对齐把 latent tokens 落到物体视觉证据上，再用 GRPO 以分割奖励优化。相比 VisionReasoner 基线，gIoU 在 ReasonSeg、MUSE、MMR 上分别绝对提升 4.9%、7.1%、4.7%，同时推理 token 减少约 16 倍。
Motivation: 显式 CoT 的冗余文本 token 会在感知 token 生成时干扰注意力，并拉大视觉 token 之间的有效距离，既拖慢推理又削弱细粒度定位。
Method: 两阶段训练：spatial alignment 把 latent tokens 对齐到物体相关视觉证据，GRPO 用分割奖励继续优化；辅以 extreme-advantage sampling 选取有信息量的训练信号、decoupled exploration-stability 更新学习互补表示、latent diversity amplification 防止表示坍缩。
Result: 相对 VisionReasoner，gIoU 绝对提升 ReasonSeg 4.9%、MUSE 7.1%、MMR 4.7%，推理 token 约减少 16 倍；摘要称在多个 benchmark 上同时改善分割精度与推理效率。
Conclusion: 在推理分割任务中，用紧凑 latent tokens 替代显式语言推理可以同时提高分割精度并大幅压缩推理 token 开销。

papers.title: Missingness-Aware Conformal Prediction Under Cross-Hospital Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Clinical measurements are recorded for some patients but not others, at rates that differ across hospitals, and marginal conformal coverage does not ensure coverage within groups defined by missingness. We propose a missingness-aware conformal calibration procedure for mortality prediction under cross-hospital distribution shift. It selects a measurement on an independent sample, groups patients by whether that measurement is recorded, and applies Mondrian calibration within each group, so no calibration outcome is reused. We evaluate the procedure across hospitals in eICU and across care units within one MIMIC-IV hospital, using three predictors. Relative to pooled calibration, it reduces the average worst-group coverage gap on its selected groups in all six settings, with a median reduction of 1.9 percentage points; paired site-bootstrap intervals exclude zero in five. These gains do not extend uniformly. Calibration by predicted risk achieves smaller gaps on a broader panel of missingness groups, and when eICU hospitals are evaluated separately, the gain shrinks for all three predictors and reverses in sign for one. We explain this discrepancy with a hospital-level decomposition. Pooling reweights hospitals through a covariance between group shares and coverage errors, and lets errors of opposite sign cancel: weighting explains the reversal, and cancellation accounts for most of the attenuation for the other two predictors. Constructed population distributions show that pooled and within-hospital evaluations can rank calibration methods oppositely even without sampling noise. Pooled improvement alone therefore cannot establish better coverage within hospitals, even when the calibration groups are fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向缺失模式的 conformal 校准：在独立样本上选一个临床测量，按该测量是否被记录分组，再在组内做 Mondrian 校准，用于跨医院分布偏移下的死亡预测。在 eICU 跨医院与 MICU-IV 单院内 care unit 共六个设置中，相对 pooled 校准在所选分组上平均最差组覆盖缺口全部下降，中位降幅 1.9 个百分点，五个设置的配对 site-bootstrap 区间不含零；但按预测风险分组在更广的缺失分组面板上缺口更小，且 eICU 逐院评估时三个预测器的增益都缩小、其中一个反号。
Motivation: 临床测量在不同医院记录率不同，marginal conformal coverage 不保证按缺失模式定义的组内覆盖；而 pooled 校准会通过组份额与覆盖误差的协方差重加权医院、并让符号相反的误差相互抵消，使 pooled 评估与院内评估可能给出相反的方法排序。
Method: 在独立样本上选择一个临床测量，按该测量是否被记录把患者分组，组内分别做 Mondrian conformal calibration，保证校准结果不被复用；在 eICU 跨医院与 MIMIC-IV 单院内 care unit 两种划分上，用三个预测器与 pooled 校准、按预测风险分组校准对比，并用 hospital-level decomposition 分解重加权与抵消两项。
Result: 相对 pooled 校准，所选分组上的平均最差组覆盖缺口在全部六个设置中下降，中位降幅 1.9 个百分点，配对 site-bootstrap 区间在五个设置中不含零。按预测风险分组在更广的缺失分组面板上得到更小缺口；eICU 逐院评估时三个预测器的增益全部缩小，其中一个反号。构造的总体分布显示 pooled 与院内评估可在无采样噪声时给出相反排序。
Conclusion: pooled 覆盖改善本身不足以证明院内覆盖更好，即使校准分组固定；差异可由组份额与覆盖误差的协方差重加权解释，符号相反误差的抵消解释了另外两个预测器的大部分衰减。

papers.title: NavGen: Visual Generative Models as a Scalable Data Engine for Embodied 3D Navigation
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose robot models increasingly rely on large and diverse datasets. For embodied 3D navigation, however, existing data sources face a fundamental trade-off: simulated data can be generated at scale but often suffer from the visual sim-to-real gap, whereas real-world flight data provide realistic observations but are costly to collect. This paper studies another direction: the use of high-fidelity visual generative models as scalable data engines for embodied 3D navigation. We introduce NavGen, a text-to-video data generation pipeline that produces diverse vision-language navigation (VLN) episodes across indoor and outdoor scenes. We also propose a style-diversification method that scales up long-tail data that are difficult and costly to collect. The resulting dataset contains approximately 400K navigation episodes. We evaluate our dataset against existing UAV navigation datasets across multiple metrics, and find that the model trained on our data generally improves with scale, outperforming those trained on existing datasets. To validate real-world transferability, we deploy the trained model in world-action-model paradigm to real-world flying experiments. The final model achieves a 75\% success rate across different navigation tasks and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NavGen 用 text-to-video 视觉生成模型替代仿真器，批量合成室内外具身 3D 导航的 vision-language navigation (VLN) episode，并用风格多样化方法补足难采集的长尾数据，得到约 400K 条导航 episode。在其上训练的模型随数据规模提升而变好，超过用现有 UAV 导航数据集训练的模型，按 world-action-model 范式部署到真实飞行实验后在不同导航任务与环境中达到 75% 成功率。
Motivation: 具身 3D 导航的通用机器人模型受制于数据来源的两难：仿真数据可规模化但存在视觉 sim-to-real gap，真实飞行数据真实但采集昂贵，长尾场景尤其难覆盖。
Method: 提出 NavGen：一条 text-to-video 数据生成管线，跨室内与室外场景合成多样 VLN episode；配套 style-diversification 方法规模化扩充难采集的长尾数据；训练后的模型以 world-action-model 范式部署到真实飞行。
Result: 生成的数据集约含 400K 条导航 episode；与现有 UAV 导航数据集在多个指标上对比，用该数据训练的模型总体随规模提升并超过用现有数据集训练的模型；真实飞行实验中最终模型在不同导航任务与环境下达到 75% 成功率。
Conclusion: 高保真视觉生成模型可以充当具身 3D 导航的可扩展数据引擎，绕开仿真视觉差距与真实采集成本，并把训练收益迁移到真实飞行。

papers.title: Query-Conditioned Prototype Adaptation for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning: Single-Query Inference, Controlled Comparisons, and Failure Modes
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain few-shot learning requires adapting a classifier to a new visual domain from very few labelled examples without target-time parameter updates. We isolate one question: under a fixed global representation, what does joint query-support adaptation contribute to prototype construction? The Within-Instance Prototypical Transformer (WIPT) implements single-query test-time prototype adaptation by jointly transforming one unlabelled query and the labelled support embeddings, then forming query-specific class means. Using a shared frozen ViT-S/16 encoder, miniImageNet source training, and CUB, EuroSAT and ISIC targets, we replicate the key comparisons across five independent training seeds. In 1-shot evaluation, WIPT improves frozen ProtoNet in every run on CUB (+0.21 percentage points) and EuroSAT (+2.07), but decreases ISIC (-0.22). In 5-shot evaluation, ProtoNet remains strongest overall, while WIPT consistently improves a capacity-matched support-only Transformer on ISIC (+0.99). Joint processing of up to five queries yields no reliable accuracy gain; in a head-only 5-shot benchmark, g = 5 reduces analytical attention-token pairs by 73% and peak allocated memory by 29% relative to g = 1, although latency is non-monotonic. Across all target/shot conditions, WIPT changes uncertain ProtoNet decisions far more than confident ones, and rescue/break decomposition accounts for the observed gains and losses. Source-shift and scorer controls further show that the benefit is not universal. Overall, WIPT provides a streaming-compatible form of test-time prototype adaptation that can improve difficult low-shot cross-domain decisions without target-time optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Within-Instance Prototypical Transformer (WIPT)，在固定冻结 ViT-S/16 表征下对单个无标签 query 与有标签 support 联合变换后构造 query-specific 类均值，实现无目标域参数更新的测试时原型自适应。1-shot 上相对 frozen ProtoNet 在 CUB +0.21、EuroSAT +2.07、ISIC -0.22 个百分点；5-shot 时 ProtoNet 整体最强，但 WIPT 在 ISIC 上稳定超过容量匹配的 support-only Transformer +0.99。
Motivation: 跨域少样本学习需要在极少标注下适配新视觉域且不做目标时参数更新，但联合 query-support 自适应对原型构造究竟贡献多少、在哪些域有效并不清楚。
Method: WIPT 用共享冻结 ViT-S/16 编码器，miniImageNet 源域训练，目标域为 CUB、EuroSAT、ISIC，五个独立训练种子复现关键比较；并做 source-shift 与 scorer 控制、rescue/break 分解，以及 g=1 与 g≤5 的 query 分组对比。
Result: 1-shot：WIPT 每次运行都提升 frozen ProtoNet，CUB +0.21、EuroSAT +2.07 个百分点，ISIC -0.22；5-shot：ProtoNet 整体最强，WIPT 在 ISIC 上一致提升 support-only Transformer +0.99。联合处理至多五个 query 无可靠精度增益，但 head-only 5-shot 基准中 g=5 相对 g=1 使解析 attention-token 对减少 73%、峰值分配内存减少 29%，延迟非单调。WIPT 主要改变 ProtoNet 的不确定决策而非高置信决策，收益与损失可由 rescue/break 分解解释。
Conclusion: WIPT 提供流式兼容的测试时原型自适应，能在无目标时优化的情况下改善困难的低样本跨域决策，但收益并非普遍，5-shot 下 ProtoNet 仍整体最强。

summary_sections.conclusion: WIPT 提供流式兼容的测试时原型自适应，能在无目标时优化的情况下改善困难的低样本跨域决策，但收益并非普遍，5-shot 下 ProtoNet 仍整体最强。

papers.title: Does Thinking Help Fairness? Reasoning Tokens Resolve Some Biases but Create More
papers.abstract_en: Thinking in reasoning language models (RLMs) has been subject to debate on whether it resolves or amplifies bias. Prior works have shown competing conclusions in both directions. Using a within-model thinking-vs.-non-thinking ablation across QwQ-32B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and Qwen3-32B on three high-stakes decision tasks (Adult, COMPAS, Credit), we show that thinking has an asymmetric dual effect on counterfactual fairness: it both resolves counterfactual flips produced by the non-thinking baseline and creates new flips at near-saturating model confidence. In all nine (model, dataset) combinations, the created flips outnumber the resolved flips by roughly 5 times. To explain the effect, we treat the thinking trace itself as a measurable site of fairness change and study it through two dynamic instruments: 1) We propose Counterfactual Depth Probability Gap (CDPG) to track bias evolution along thinking depth, and observe that bias propagates and amplifies with thinking. 2) We also formulate the Bias Transition Matrix (BTM) to show how predictions of counterfactual pairs change from non-thinking to thinking, and find that the asymmetric dual effect originates in the pair-state joint transition.
papers.comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 QwQ-32B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B、Qwen3-32B 上做 thinking 与 non-thinking 的同模型消融，发现推理思维对反事实公平性 (counterfactual fairness) 是不对称双效应：既修复非思考基线的反事实翻转，又在模型置信度接近饱和时制造新翻转。在全部 9 个（模型, 数据集）组合中，制造的翻转数约为修复翻转数的 5 倍，且偏差沿思考深度传播并被放大。
Motivation: 关于推理语言模型的 thinking 是缓解还是放大偏差，已有工作结论相互矛盾，缺少在同一模型上量化翻转来源的工具。
Method: 在三个高风险决策任务 Adult、COMPAS、Credit 上做同模型 thinking-vs-non-thinking 消融；提出 Counterfactual Depth Probability Gap (CDPG) 沿思考深度追踪偏差演化，并构建 Bias Transition Matrix (BTM) 刻画反事实对从非思考到思考的预测状态转移。
Result: 9 个（模型, 数据集）组合中，thinking 新造的反事实翻转数约为其修复翻转数的 5 倍；CDPG 显示偏差随思考深度传播并放大，BTM 表明不对称双效应源于反事实对的联合状态转移 (pair-state joint transition)。
Conclusion: thinking 对反事实公平性是净负面的不对称双效应：修复少、新造多，且新翻转发生在模型置信度接近饱和处，因此思考轨迹本身应作为公平性变化的可测量位点来分析。

papers.title: Insurance Reserve Intelligence Platform
papers.abstract_en: Insurance reserve estimation is a fundamental actuarial task supporting premium pricing, solvency assessment, financial reporting, capital planning, and risk management. Classical reserve methods based on Thiele's differential equation provide a rigorous and interpretable foundation for life insurance valuation, but repeated reserve calculations become computationally expensive in sensitivity analysis, optimization, and large-scale scenario evaluation. This paper presents an Insurance Reserve Intelligence Platform for term-life reserve modelling that combines a classical Thiele-equation solver with a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) enhanced by Knowledge-Informed Neural Network (KINN) losses. The framework includes synthetic policy generation, risk-adjusted premium calculation, classical reserve trajectory generation, reserve-ratio dataset construction, configurable neural training, validation diagnostics, sensitivity and elasticity analysis, prototype optimization workflows, and interest-rate scenario testing. A key refinement is the use of premium ratio and the explicit separation of pricing-time and scenario-time interest-rate semantics. The final model uses seven features: elapsed time, issue age, pricing interest rate, scenario interest rate, premium ratio, sum assured, and mortality intensity. It predicts a standardized reserve ratio instead of raw reserve values, improving numerical stability across policies with different sums assured. The model achieved an R2 of 0.9887, MAE of 785.48, and RMSE of 1212.76 on the test set. On 200 policies, PINN/KINN inference was approximately 119.53 times faster than the classical solver. Results show strong predictive accuracy, physics consistency, and boundary performance, while highlighting remaining limitations in monotonicity and out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把寿险准备金的 Thiele 微分方程求解器与 Physics-Informed Neural Network（PINN）加 Knowledge-Informed Neural Network（KINN）损失结合，预测标准化准备金比率而非原始准备金。测试集 R² 达 0.9887、MAE 785.48、RMSE 1212.76；在 200 张保单上推理比经典求解器快约 119.53 倍。
Motivation: Thiele 方程在敏感性分析、优化与大规模情景评估中反复求解计算代价高，需要在保持物理一致性的前提下加速。
Method: 平台包含合成保单生成、风险调整保费计算、经典准备金轨迹生成与准备金比率数据集构建；模型用七个特征（elapsed time、issue age、pricing interest rate、scenario interest rate、premium ratio、sum assured、mortality intensity），以 PINN/KINN 损失约束物理一致性，输出标准化准备金比率，并区分定价期与情景期利率语义。
Result: 测试集 R² = 0.9887，MAE = 785.48，RMSE = 1212.76；在 200 张保单上 PINN/KINN 推理约比经典求解器快 119.53 倍；另做敏感性与弹性分析、原型优化流程与利率情景测试。
Conclusion: 用 PINN/KINN 近似 Thiele 准备金可在保持物理一致性与边界表现的同时大幅提速，但作者指出单调性与分布外泛化仍是限制。

papers.title: HCOE: Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings from Biomedical Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical language models (LMs) encode textual semantics but do not explicitly preserve medical code hierarchies. We present Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings (HCOE) for hierarchy-aware clinical concept representation. HCOE maps frozen BioBERT embeddings into a Poincare ball, combining parent-side and child-side ontology-guided contrastive learning with coarse-to-fine ontology-path aggregation. It uses International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes organized by Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) and Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) medication hierarchies. Evaluations show that HCOE performs best on ICD/ATC clinical relation prediction and CCS-to-PheCode hierarchy transfer. On the MIMIC-IV dataset, HCOE also achieves the best performance on mortality prediction, readmission prediction, medication recommendation, and rare drug prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HCOE 把冻结的 BioBERT 临床文本嵌入映射到 Poincaré 球，用父侧与子侧的本体引导对比学习加粗到细的本体路径聚合，显式保留 ICD/CCS/ATC 医疗编码层级。在 ICD/ATC 临床关系预测与 CCS 到 PheCode 层级迁移上取得最佳表现，并在 MIMIC-IV 的死亡预测、再入院预测、用药推荐和罕见药物预测上均取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 生物医学语言模型编码了文本语义，却不显式保留医疗编码的层级结构，临床概念表示缺少本体关系约束。
Method: 将冻结的 BioBERT 嵌入映射到 Poincaré 球，结合父侧与子侧的本体引导对比学习 (ontology-guided contrastive learning) 和粗到细的本体路径聚合 (coarse-to-fine ontology-path aggregation)；层级来源为 ICD 码经 CCS 组织的分类以及 ATC 用药层级。
Result: 在 ICD/ATC 临床关系预测与 CCS-to-PheCode 层级迁移任务上表现最佳；在 MIMIC-IV 数据集上，死亡预测、再入院预测、用药推荐、罕见药物预测四项任务均取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 把层级本体约束显式注入双曲空间的临床概念嵌入，可同时改善临床关系预测、层级迁移与多项 MIMIC-IV 临床预测任务。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Timo: $\textbf{T}$aming Mult$\textbf{i}$modal Diffusion Transformer for Human $\textbf{Mo}$tion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Most existing human motion generation (HMG) methods use cross-attention modules to inject text semantics, but ignore the importance of bidirectional modeling between motion and text tokens, which limits text comprehension. A straightforward idea is introducing multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiT), which have shown effective joint text--visual modeling in vision generation, into HMG. However, we find that articulated motion is temporally coherent but weakly correlated across joints, in which directly applying an MMDiT with flow matching produces poorly coordinated and jerky motion. In this work, we propose Timo, a novel kinematics-aware MMDiT framework tailored for HMG. Timo combines fully shared multimodal attention for bidirectional text--motion modeling with flow matching, geometric and rotational-kinematics supervision that compares actual rotations and their changes over time, and a two-stage curriculum progressing from broad motion learning to detailed caption alignment. Further, we construct a benchmark of $40{,}025$ held-out clips from six public datasets spanning diverse actions, assessing six complementary dimensions under a common evaluator and scoring protocol. Our model substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Remarkably, Timo surpasses Kimodo on five of six dimensions, achieving a $40.8$% relative improvement in the average benchmark score. Project page: https://kyfafyd.wang/projects/timo. Demo page: https://timo.kyfafyd.wang.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Timo 把视觉生成里的多模态扩散 Transformer (MMDiT) 改造成运动感知版本用于人体动作生成 (HMG)：全共享的多模态注意力做文本-运动双向建模并配合 flow matching，再加几何与旋转运动学监督以及两阶段课程（先学大类动作再对齐细粒度 caption）。在由六个公开数据集构成的 40,025 条 held-out 片段基准上，Timo 在六个维度中的五个上超过 Kimodo，基准平均分相对提升 40.8%。
Motivation: 现有 HMG 方法用 cross-attention 注入文本语义，缺少文本与运动 token 的双向建模，文本理解受限；直接把 MMDiT 加 flow matching 搬过来会因关节间弱相关而生成不协调、抖动的动作。
Method: Timo 采用全共享多模态注意力实现文本-运动双向建模并与 flow matching 结合；监督项包含比较实际旋转及其随时间变化的几何与旋转运动学监督；训练按两阶段课程，从宽泛动作学习推进到细粒度 caption 对齐。另构建含 40,025 条 held-out 片段、覆盖六个公开数据集的基准，在统一评测器与打分协议下评六个互补维度。
Result: 在 40,025 条 held-out 片段、六个维度的统一评测中，Timo 在定量与定性评估上均大幅超过现有方法；相对 Kimodo 在六个维度中的五个上胜出，基准平均分相对提升 40.8%。
Conclusion: 把 MMDiT 的双向联合建模引入 HMG 时必须配运动学感知的监督与课程，才能在保持文本对齐的同时产出协调不抖动的动作。

papers.title: LLPR: Location-aware learning and physics-based reconstruction for raindrop removal from a single image
papers.abstract_en: Raindrops can cause occlusion and distortion in the background scenes due to their adherence to windows or camera lenses. Existing raindrop removal methods concentrate on designing sophisticated CNN or Transformer architectures to recover distorted and missing texture. In this paper, we try to integrate location information and physical model into off-the-shelf CNN or Transformer architectures to help improve their performance. Specifically, we notice that existing methods deploy a preprocessing sub-network to generate a binary or soft mask to indicate the raindrop location, which will increase the network parameters and computational complexity. In contrast, a location-aware learning branch is embedded to teach the encoder in the training phase with the capability of perceiving the position of the raindrops. Note that this location-aware learning branch can be removed during the inference process (achieving performance improvements at no cost). Furthermore, instead of directly reconstructing the raindrop-free image (i.e., background scene), we devise a physics-based reconstruction scheme to first learn the transparency matrix and the raindrop layer. The latent background layer is then reversely derived based on the physical model. By combining the above-mentioned components, we propose our location-aware learning and physics-based reconstruction (LLPR) framework for this challenging ill-posed problem. We also collect a real-world raindrop-degraded image dataset, which is challenging for single-image raindrop removal (SIRR) methods. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of our LLPR framework, achieving superior performance against state-of-the-art SIRR methods. The code will be made available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLPR 把位置感知分支和物理成像模型嵌入现成 CNN/Transformer 做单图雨滴去除 (SIRR)：训练期用 location-aware learning branch 教编码器感知雨滴位置，推理期可整体移除；重建时不直接输出无雨滴图像，而是先学透明度矩阵与雨滴层，再按物理模型反解背景层。在自采真实雨滴退化数据集上优于现有 SIRR 方法。
Motivation: 雨滴附着在窗户或镜头上造成遮挡与畸变，现有方法靠堆 CNN/Transformer 结构恢复纹理，且需前置子网络生成雨滴掩码，增加参数量与计算复杂度。
Method: LLPR 框架含两部分：一是嵌入式 location-aware learning branch，仅在训练阶段教编码器感知雨滴位置，推理时可移除；二是 physics-based reconstruction scheme，先学习透明度矩阵 (transparency matrix) 与雨滴层，再由物理模型反解潜在背景层。整体接入现成 CNN 或 Transformer 架构，并自采一个真实雨滴退化单图数据集。
Result: 在作者自采的真实雨滴退化数据集上，LLPR 相对 state-of-the-art SIRR 方法取得更优性能；位置感知分支在推理阶段移除后仍带来零开销的性能提升；摘要称框架有效且具通用性，可配合不同骨干架构。
Conclusion: 把位置先验与成像物理放进重建过程，而不是加掩码子网络或加宽主干，就能在单图雨滴去除上以更低推理代价换取更好恢复效果。

papers.title: Selective Amortization of Full-Budget Counterfactual Reasoning for Visual Token Communication
papers.abstract_en: Generative image communication transmits compact semantic tokens under a limited packet budget, where token selection directly affects the final reconstruction quality after the complete packet is decoded. However, accurately estimating the terminal value of every candidate token requires repeated receiver-side reconstruction, resulting in substantial encoder-side computation. To address this problem, we propose ACV-Gate, an adaptive candidate evaluation framework that learns to approximate full-budget counterfactual evaluation and selectively assigns exact evaluations to the most informative candidates. Specifically, a set-aware student is trained using terminal advantages and regrets to predict candidate rankings directly, while a selective refinement mechanism evaluates only a bounded candidate set containing both Local-MDL and direct actions; cost-based thresholds further enable explicit control of the average evaluation workload. Experiments on CIFAR-10 show that ACV-Gate consistently improves reconstruction quality while substantially reducing candidate evaluations; at 0.20 bpp, the primary adaptive configuration improves PSNR over LocalMDL by 0.636 dB with only 2.13 candidate evaluations per image, corresponding to 27.60% of the calls required by the Exact-Full expert. Matched-candidate comparisons, synchronized GPU measurements, and evaluations on STL-10 and 384 *384 scale transfer further demonstrate consistent quality computation trade-offs, with particularly pronounced gains at low bit rates. These results show that combining terminal-value learning with selective candidate evaluation provides an effective and controllable mechanism for allocating encoder computation in packet-constrained generative image communication.
papers.comment: Visual token communication, counterfactual evaluation, selective computation, knowledge distillation, resource allocation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACV-Gate 用一个 set-aware student 直接预测候选 token 的终端价值排序，只对含 Local-MDL 与直接动作的有界候选集做精确反事实评估，并用基于代价的阈值控制平均评估负载。在 CIFAR-10 上 0.20 bpp 时，主自适应配置相对 LocalMDL 把 PSNR 提高 0.636 dB，而每张图仅 2.13 次候选评估，相当于 Exact-Full expert 调用量的 27.60%。
Motivation: 生成式图像通信中，逐候选做完整预算反事实评估需要在接收端反复重建，编码端计算量过大，限制了包预算受限场景下的 token 选择。
Method: 提出 ACV-Gate：用终端优势与后悔 (terminal advantages and regrets) 训练 set-aware student 直接预测候选排名；选择性细化机制只对包含 Local-MDL 与直接动作的有界候选集做精确评估；基于代价的阈值显式控制平均评估工作量。
Result: CIFAR-10 上 0.20 bpp 时主自适应配置 PSNR 比 LocalMDL 高 0.636 dB，每图仅 2.13 次候选评估，为 Exact-Full expert 调用次数的 27.60%；匹配候选比较与同步 GPU 计时，以及 STL-10 和 384×384 尺度迁移实验均给出一致的质量-计算权衡，低码率下增益尤其明显。
Conclusion: 终端价值学习加选择性候选评估，可以在包受限的生成式图像通信中按可控方式分配编码端算力，且低码率收益最大。
