papers.title: Training-Free Bottleneck Width Planning for Convolutional Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Multiscale Spectral Rate-Distortion (MS-SRD) estimates the bottleneck channels required at user-supplied spatial cuts from training images and a normalized mean-squared error (NMSE) bound, without fitting a neural network. Its covariance-tail rule is exact for shared linear block-convolutional autoencoders under squared error. A nested-scale dominance result motivates reporting the activation-parameter Pareto frontier alongside the minimum-latent candidate. At NMSE <= 0.01 on thirteen grayscale datasets, its latent-size prediction has 0.84% mean absolute percentage error against nonlinear patch-autoencoder boundaries; ten predictions are exact and the remaining three differ by one channel. In a four-dataset deployable comparison, MS-SRD matches all retrospective external widths and all four selected models pass, without training a selector; a 46-fit validation grid and four Least-Volume fits each pass on two datasets. In a skip-closed U-shaped autoencoder at the same bound, five predictions are exact, nine are within one channel, and every failing prediction is one channel short. Experiments at looser bounds show progressively larger nonlinear savings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-SRD 在不训练任何网络的前提下，从训练图像与给定 NMSE 上界直接算出卷积自编码器瓶颈通道数，其 covariance-tail 规则对共享线性块卷积自编码器在平方误差下精确。在 NMSE ≤ 0.01 的十三个灰度数据集上，对非线性 patch-autoencoder 边界的潜变量尺寸预测平均绝对百分比误差为 0.84%，十条预测完全命中、其余三条只差一个通道。
Motivation: 卷积自编码器的瓶颈宽度通常靠试错或训练一个选择器来定，代价高且缺少可推导的依据；需要一种免训练、有理论支撑的宽度规划方法。
Method: Multiscale Spectral Rate-Distortion (MS-SRD)：在用户给定的空间切分与 NMSE 上界下，用 covariance-tail 规则估计所需瓶颈通道数，对共享线性块卷积自编码器在平方误差下给出精确结果；嵌套尺度支配结论 (nested-scale dominance) 建议同时报告激活参数 Pareto 前沿与最小潜变量候选。
Result: NMSE ≤ 0.01 时，十三个灰度数据集上潜变量尺寸预测对非线性 patch-autoencoder 边界的 MAPE 为 0.84%，十条精确、三条差一个通道；四数据集可部署对比中 MS-SRD 匹配全部回溯外部宽度，所选四个模型全部通过，且未训练选择器；46 次拟合的验证网格与四个 Least-Volume 拟合各在两个数据集上通过；同上界下 skip-closed U 形自编码器中五条预测精确、九条在一条通道内，所有失败预测都少一个通道；更松的上界下非线性节省逐步增大。
Conclusion: 免训练的谱率失真分析足以在给定 NMSE 上界下定出卷积自编码器瓶颈宽度，且失败模式系统性地表现为少估一个通道。

papers.title: Skill Profiling with Attributable Reasoning (SPAR): A Wearable Analysis System for Boxing
papers.abstract_en: A punch is a ballistic, full-body action driven by a kinetic chain running from the legs through the trunk to the arm, where a small sequencing error separates a scoring strike from a miss. Wearable sensors can capture this movement in the gym, but most deployable systems only classify which punch was thrown rather than assess how well it was thrown. We present Skill Profiling with Attributable Reasoning (SPAR), an eight-IMU garment and pressure-insole system that classifies each punch as expert or novice and treats an explanation of that prediction as feedback. Feedback is only useful if the person receiving it can act on it, so SPAR explains the prediction at three tiers, a per-joint attribution for the analyst, a counterfactual over kinetic-chain layers for the coach, and a plain-language narrative of the two for the athlete. Across 17 participants and 4,713 punches, SPAR reaches a leave-one-participant-out AUC of 0.842 (95% CI [0.769, 0.907] over participants). A frozen time-series foundation model encodes the joint-angle and plantar-force series, and a small transformer trained on the cohort classifies the encoding. We audit the two quantitative tiers and report six themes from a thematic analysis of interviews with six practicing boxing coaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPAR 用八 IMU 服装加压力鞋垫把拳击出拳判为专家级或新手级，并把预测本身拆成三层可归因解释：逐关节归因给分析师、动力链层的反事实给教练、自然语言叙述给运动员。在 17 名参与者、4,713 次出拳上，留一参与者交叉验证 AUC 为 0.842（按参与者 95% CI [0.769, 0.907]）。
Motivation: 现有可部署的可穿戴拳击系统大多只分类打出了哪种拳，而不评估这一拳打得质量如何；而动力链上一个小小的时序错误就决定命中得分还是落空，教练和运动员需要可执行的分层反馈。
Method: 八个 IMU 加压力鞋垫采集关节角度与足底受力序列，由一个冻结的时序基础模型编码，再接一个在该人群上训练的小型 Transformer 做专家/新手分类；解释分三层输出——逐关节归因、跨动力链层的反事实、以及把前两者转成自然语言的叙述，并对两个量化层做审计。
Result: 在 17 名参与者、4,713 次出拳上，留一参与者 (leave-one-participant-out) AUC 为 0.842，按参与者计算的 95% CI 为 [0.769, 0.907]；对 6 名执业拳击教练的访谈做主题分析，得到六个主题。
Conclusion: 把预测解释本身当作反馈、并按分析师/教练/运动员三种受众分层，可让可穿戴拳击评估从出拳类型分类走向可执行的质量反馈。

papers.title: Differentiable RNA Secondary Structure Extraction for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many deep learning approaches to RNA secondary structure prediction have recently been proposed. They typically output a weight matrix $W$ where $W_{ij}$ is an arbitrary weight for base $i$ pairing with base $j$. Converting this matrix to a predicted secondary structure or base-pairing probability matrix typically involves ad hoc and problematic downstream algorithms. Despite the importance of this conversion step, which we refer to as structure extraction, it has received relatively little attention in the literature. In this work, we analyze how the congruence between training and extraction methods affects prediction performance. To do this, we compare four extraction algorithms: a Nussinov-like dynamic programming method, maximum-weight graph matching and the greedy extraction algorithms used by SPOT-RNA and RiNALMo. These are evaluated on outputs from the pretrained RiNALMo model and three toy models trained in this paper: a differentiable Nussinov-like model, a binary cross-entropy (BCE) baseline, and a model that incorporates a novel symmetric doubly stochastic matrix (SDSM) normalization algorithm during training which allows it to output base-pairing probability matrices directly, without a separate extraction step. This SDSM normalization algorithm is differentiable and can be added inline to any deep learning model during training and evaluation. We find that the performance of each extraction method depends strongly on how the corresponding model was trained. Considering the toy models themselves, the SDSM model showed the strongest overall performance: it outperformed the BCE baseline under all four extraction algorithms and produced pre-extraction outputs closest to the ground truth. These results suggest that SDSM normalization is a tractable alternative to traditional structure extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RNA 二级结构预测中，把权重矩阵转成碱基配对结构的 extraction 步骤常是 ad hoc 的，本文发现训练目标与提取算法的 congruence 强烈决定最终性能。提出可微的对称双随机矩阵 (SDSM) 归一化，让模型直接输出配对概率矩阵、跳过独立提取步；在 RiNALMo 预训练输出与三个 toy 模型上比较四种提取算法，SDSM 在全部四种提取下都超过 BCE 基线，且提取前输出最接近真值。
Motivation: 深度 RNA 二级结构模型输出的权重矩阵 W_ij 需要下游算法转成结构或配对概率矩阵，这一步 (structure extraction) 多为 ad hoc 且有问题，却少有人研究；训练与提取方法不一致会拖累预测性能。
Method: 比较四种提取算法：Nussinov 式动态规划、maximum-weight graph matching、SPOT-RNA 与 RiNALMo 使用的 greedy 提取。评测对象为预训练 RiNALMo 模型输出，以及本文训练的三个 toy 模型：可微 Nussinov 式模型、BCE 基线、以及训练时加入新 SDSM 归一化算法的模型（可微、可内联加入任意深度学习模型，直接输出配对概率矩阵）。
Result: 每个提取方法的性能强烈依赖对应模型的训练方式；toy 模型中 SDSM 在全部四种提取算法下都优于 BCE 基线，且提取前输出最接近 ground truth。
Conclusion: SDSM 归一化是传统 structure extraction 的可行替代：训练与提取保持一致比换提取算法本身更能决定最终结构预测质量。

papers.title: Backbone-Adaptive Evidence Routing for Robust Pairwise LLM Judging
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise language-model judges can gather evidence through direct comparison, reasoning, or reference-based verification, but no single protocol is best across benchmarks and judge backbones. We introduce Backbone-Adaptive Evidence Routing (BAER), which adapts the evidence mechanism while preserving candidate symmetry: swapping the two responses may reverse the preference but cannot change its strength. BAER separates each expert's signed preference from candidate-invariant reliability and builds three symmetric heads: evidence stacking, reliability-based expert routing, and candidate-blind reference verification. Development data select one head for each benchmark--backbone condition, and that choice is frozen before testing. Across four benchmarks and two 8B judge backbones, BAER achieves the highest test accuracy among the compared methods in all eight conditions, with full prediction coverage and gains of 0.87--7.32 points over the strongest external baseline. The results show that adapting how evidence is gathered is more reliable than fixing one judging protocol everywhere.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Backbone-Adaptive Evidence Routing (BAER)：在保持候选对称性（交换两个回答可反转偏好但不改变强度）的前提下，把证据收集机制做成可按基准-骨干自适应选择的路由。在四个基准、两个 8B judge 骨干共八个条件下，BAER 测试准确率全部最高，相对最强外部基线提升 0.87–7.32 个百分点，且预测全覆盖。
Motivation: 成对 LLM 评判中，直接比较、推理、参考核验三种证据协议各有适用场景，没有单一协议在所有基准和 judge 骨干上都最优，固定协议会损失准确率。
Method: BAER 将每个专家的带符号偏好与候选不变的可靠性分离，构造三个对称头：evidence stacking、基于可靠性的专家路由、candidate-blind 参考核验；用开发集为每个基准-骨干条件选定一个头并在测试前冻结。
Result: 在四个基准与两个 8B judge 骨干构成的全部八个条件中，BAER 测试准确率均为所比较方法最高，预测覆盖完整，较最强外部基线提升 0.87–7.32 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者主张：自适应地改变证据收集方式比在所有场景固定单一评判协议更可靠，且候选对称性可在路由设计中保持。

papers.title: ORCA: Evaluating LLMs on Data Science Code Translation
papers.abstract_en: Data Science Code Translation (DSCT) is the process of converting code between data science libraries while preserving functional equivalence and enabling interoperability across data science ecosystems. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable progress in Data Science Code Generation (DSCG), their performance in DSCT remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce ORCA, a comprehensive benchmark with two complementary settings: ORCA-MAIN, which comprises 1,600 carefully curated grounding-level tasks across 3 representative domains: Data Querying, Data Manipulation, and Deep Learning; and ORCA-PROJECT, which contains 200 translation tasks over complete data science projects across 7 data science task types. Each task is accompanied by annotated reference translations and test cases for validating functional equivalence. We further incorporate a multi-stage quality verification process that thoroughly verifies task correctness and test case robustness. Experimental results demonstrate challenges in DSCT, with even frontier LLMs showing limited performance. Specifically, Claude-Opus-4.6 achieves a success rate of 56.92% on ORCA-MAIN and 33.67% on ORCA-PROJECT, indicating considerable room for improvement in DSCT. We also observe a clear directional preference in DSCT, where translation is consistently easier when the source code expresses the task through more explicit, fine-grained operations. Motivated by this, we propose an intent-augmented method, in which the model first infers source-code intent and then uses it as additional context for translation, achieving average absolute success-rate gains of 4.80% and 5.33% on ORCA-MAIN and ORCA-PROJECT, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ORCA 是评测 LLM 在数据科学库之间做代码翻译 (DSCT) 的基准，含 ORCA-MAIN 1,600 个 grounding-level 任务与 ORCA-PROJECT 200 个完整项目翻译任务，均带参考译文与测试用例。Claude-Opus-4.6 成功率仅 56.92% 与 33.67%；源码写得越显式细粒度越易翻译，据此提出的 intent-augmented 方法先推断源码意图再作上下文，平均绝对提升 4.80% 与 5.33%。
Motivation: LLM 在数据科学代码生成 (DSCG) 上进展明显，但跨数据科学库保持功能等价的代码翻译 (DSCT) 缺少系统评测，前沿模型表现不足。
Method: 提出 ORCA 基准，两个互补设置：ORCA-MAIN 覆盖 Data Querying、Data Manipulation、Deep Learning 三个领域的 1,600 个 grounding-level 任务；ORCA-PROJECT 覆盖 7 类数据科学任务的 200 个完整项目翻译任务，每题附参考译文与验证功能等价的测试用例，并有多阶段质量校验。另提出 intent-augmented 方法：模型先推断源码意图，再把意图作为额外上下文做翻译。
Result: Claude-Opus-4.6 在 ORCA-MAIN 成功率 56.92%，在 ORCA-PROJECT 33.67%。观察到明确方向性偏好：源码以更显式、细粒度操作表达任务时翻译更易。intent-augmented 方法在 ORCA-MAIN 与 ORCA-PROJECT 分别取得平均绝对成功率提升 4.80% 与 5.33%。
Conclusion: DSCT 对前沿 LLM 仍是难题，尤其在完整项目层面；先显式化源码意图能稳定抬升翻译成功率，且源码表达粒度直接决定翻译难度。

papers.title: Beyond the Last Truffula Tree: SustainAI - A Water-Aware, Closed-Loop Framework for Environmentally Accountable AI
papers.abstract_en: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes embedded in everyday life, its environmental footprint, particularly water consumption remains largely invisible. While energy and carbon impacts are widely recognized, the substantial freshwater demands of data center cooling and electricity generation receive little attention. To address this gap, we introduce SustainAI, a water-aware, closed-loop framework incorporating environmental accountability into AI deployment. SustainAI integrates real-time water metering, a hallucination-aware penalty model, and a water-aware routing algorithm that accounts for regional water stress. Evaluated via Small Language Models (SLMs) extracting health misinformation, results reveal an 11-fold variation in water footprint across geographically distributed data centers (0.0477 mL to 0.5360 mL per inference). Across 1,335 inference runs, the system consumed approximately 399 mL of water but produced only 240 correct outputs, demonstrating that substantial resources are spent on inaccurate responses. Crucially, SustainAI extends beyond technical optimization through a Care by Design lens, framing AI sustainability around relational ethics, regional equity, and ecological stewardship. By combining water monitoring, adaptive accountability, and Care by Design principles, SustainAI provides a practical foundation for integrating ethical care and environmental responsibility into AI infrastructure design and lifecycle management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SustainAI 是一个把用水核算纳入 AI 部署的闭环框架，由实时水表计量、幻觉感知惩罚模型和考虑区域水压力的 water-aware 路由组成。用小型语言模型 (SLM) 抽取健康错误信息的评测显示，地理分布式数据中心之间单次推理水足迹相差 11 倍（0.0477 mL 到 0.5360 mL）；1,335 次推理共耗水约 399 mL 却只产出 240 个正确输出，说明算力被浪费在不准确回答上。
Motivation: AI 的能耗与碳排已被广泛讨论，但数据中心冷却和发电的新鲜水消耗几乎不可见，缺少把用水与回答正确性一起核算的部署机制。
Method: 框架含三个组件：实时水表计量、幻觉感知惩罚模型、按区域水压力加权的 water-aware 路由；评测用 SLM 做健康错误信息抽取，并以 Care by Design 视角把区域公平与生态责任纳入设计。
Result: 地理分布式数据中心单次推理水足迹相差 11 倍，从 0.0477 mL 到 0.5360 mL；1,335 次推理总耗水约 399 mL，仅得到 240 个正确输出。
Conclusion: AI 基础设施的可持续性必须把用水监测、按正确性计费的自适应问责和区域水压力一起纳入生命周期管理，而不只优化能耗。

papers.title: Mechanism-Aware Ensemble Conditioning for Data-Limited Emulation of Extreme Events
papers.abstract_en: Extreme events in chaotic systems are difficult to learn from short trajectories because they are controlled by transient finite-time instability rather than by frequently observed bulk dynamics. We propose a mechanism-aware conditioning plug-in framework that turns a nudged coarse ensemble into a non-intrusive sensor of local instability geometry. In the small-noise regime, the ensemble covariance aggregates the same finite-time deformation kernels that govern local instability, providing a Jacobian-free proxy for the local amplification structure around a synchronized coarse trajectory. A small FiLM module injects statistics of this ensemble geometry into an otherwise unchanged backbone while leaving the coarse simulator unchanged. We demonstrate this interface in two distinct pipelines: a Transformer-style residual-attention corrector for a controlled low-dimensional chaotic system and a probabilistic recurrent STORN corrector for topographic two-layer quasi-geostrophic (QG) flow. In the low-dimensional benchmark, ensemble covariance directions co-activate with OTD modes and FiLM conditioning improves 99th-percentile exceedance-frequency errors over an identical no-context Transformer baseline. In QG, a fixed ensemble-conditioned FiLM-STORN model trained on only \(50\) time units substantially improves long-horizon rare-event statistics in the data-limited regime, including density-tail errors, exceedance frequencies, and spatial exceedance-area distributions relative to an unconditioned STORN trained on the same data; on averaged high-threshold exceedance diagnostics, it also outperforms the baseline STORN trained with $20$ times more high-resolution data. These results show that local instability geometry is not merely interpretable post hoc, but an actionable conditioning signal for data-efficient rare-event emulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出机制感知系综条件化插件：把带 nudging 的粗系综协方差当作局部不稳定几何的免 Jacobian 代理，用小 FiLM 模块把该几何统计注入原本不变的 backbone。在地形两层准地转 (QG) 流上，仅用 50 个时间单位训练的 FiLM-STORN 显著改善长时程稀有事件统计（密度尾部误差、超越频率、空间超越面积分布），在高阈值平均超越诊断上还优于用 20 倍高分辨率数据训练的未条件化 STORN。
Motivation: 混沌系统中的极端事件由瞬态有限时不稳定控制，而非高频出现的主体动力学，短轨迹难以学到；数据受限时稀有事件的长时程统计尤其难 emulation。
Method: 把带 nudging 的粗系综的协方差作为局部放大结构的免 Jacobian 代理（小噪声下它聚合了支配局部有限时变形的 kernel），用小型 FiLM 模块把系综几何统计注入 backbone，粗模拟器保持不变。在两条 pipeline 上演示：受控低维混沌系统的 Transformer 式 residual-attention corrector，以及地形两层 QG 流的概率循环 STORN corrector。
Result: 低维基准中系综协方差方向与 OTD 模式共同激活，FiLM 条件化相对同构无上下文 Transformer 基线改善 99 百分位超越频率误差。QG 中固定系综条件化 FiLM-STORN 仅用 50 时间单位训练，即在数据受限体制下显著改善长时程稀有事件统计（密度尾部误差、超越频率、空间超越面积分布）；在高阈值平均超越诊断上还超过用 20 倍高分辨率数据训练的未条件化 STORN。
Conclusion: 局部不稳定几何不只是事后可解释的量，而是可直接用于条件化的信号，能显著提升数据高效的稀有事件 emulation。

papers.title: Anatomy-Aware Dexterity-Driven Design Optimization of Surgical Continuum Robots
papers.abstract_en: Performing complex medical procedures with continuum robots requires careful selection of their geometric design parameters. The robot should have high dexterity in the specific anatomical environment of its procedure. This work presents a design optimization method that considers both dexterity and anatomy. We introduce the Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle (RVDSA) metric as our objective, which measures the ability of a robot's end effector to reach the points in a goal volume from different directions via collision-free paths from a start configuration. We present a computationally efficient motion planner to compute this objective function for a given robotic design, and we use an asymptotically optimal simulated annealing optimizer to compute an optimized design. We applied our new method to optimize the design of a bimanual dexterous sheaths robot for performing procedures on cancerous polyps in colon anatomies, achieving a 78% higher RVDSA on average than optimizing for 3D voxel coverage alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出同时考虑灵巧度与解剖环境的连续体手术机器人设计优化方法：以 Reachable Volumetric Dexterous Solid Angle (RVDSA) 为目标，用高效运动规划器计算该目标，再用渐近最优模拟退火求解设计参数。在结肠解剖中优化双臂灵巧鞘机器人对癌性息肉的操作设计，RVDSA 平均比仅优化 3D voxel 覆盖高 78%。
Motivation: 连续体手术机器人的几何设计参数需在特定解剖环境中具备高灵巧度，仅按几何覆盖选型无法反映末端执行器从不同方向经无碰撞路径到达目标体积的能力。
Method: 以 RVDSA 度量为目标函数，衡量末端执行器从起始构型经无碰撞路径从不同方向到达目标体积内各点的能力；配套一个计算高效的运动规划器来计算该目标，再用渐近最优的模拟退火 (simulated annealing) 优化器搜索设计参数。
Result: 在结肠解剖中对癌性息肉操作的双臂灵巧鞘 (bimanual dexterous sheaths) 机器人设计进行优化，所得设计的 RVDSA 平均比仅优化 3D voxel 覆盖高 78%。
Conclusion: 把解剖环境下的方向灵巧度（RVDSA）而非单纯几何覆盖作为设计目标，能得到在结肠手术场景中可达方向能力更强的连续体机器人设计。

papers.title: From S3Q Theory to Implementation: Towards an Architecture for Machine Qualia
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in machine consciousness research is translating theoretical models into computational-level implementations. In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing a five-layer implementation architecture for the S3Q (Simulated, Situated, Structurally Coherent) theory of consciousness. Rather than introducing novel formalisms, the architecture composes published computational primitives into a single pipeline. S3Q identifies three jointly necessary conditions for qualia: (1) grounded sensorimotor situatedness, (2) internal simulation via a world model, and (3) structural coherence between predictions and observations. No existing computational system implements all three simultaneously. We map each S3Q tenet to specific, compatible computational machinery and specify how these components interface within a single representation pipeline that operates on continuous, differentiable, per-object slot vectors, along with a developmental bootstrap sequence and falsifiable predictions for the composed system that no subset of the architecture produces in isolation. The model suggests that a basic sense of "self" develops by linking actions to their outcomes, and that behavior falls into three patterns (hesitation, curiosity, or avoidance) depending on how unexpected an outcome is and whether it is experienced as positive or negative. Each prediction is individually falsifiable, providing the field with a testable framework to advance our understanding of machine consciousness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 S3Q（Simulated, Situated, Structurally Coherent）意识理论落到计算实现的五层架构：以连续可微的逐物体 slot 向量为统一表示，把具身情境性、世界模型内部模拟、预测与观测的结构一致性三条必要条件装进同一条 pipeline，并给出发展性自举顺序。行为被预测为三种模式——犹豫、好奇、回避，取决于结果的意外程度及其正负效价；每条预测单独可证伪，且声称架构的任何子集都产生不了这些预测。

Method: 提出五层实现架构，不引入新形式化，而是把已发表的计算原语组合成单一表示 pipeline：以连续、可微、逐物体的 slot 向量为载体，把 S3Q 三条信条逐一映射到兼容的计算机制并规定接口，附带一个发展性 bootstrap 序列。
Result: 给出可组合、可证伪的架构与预测：基本的“自我”感由动作与其结果的联结发展而来；行为按结果意外程度和正负效价分为犹豫、好奇、回避三种模式；每条预测单独可证伪，且声称没有任何架构子集能单独产生这些预测。
Conclusion: 机器 qualia 可以通过组合既有计算原语得到可测试的实现路径，检验标准是三条必要条件同时在场且预测逐条可证伪。

papers.title: From Mono to Stereo: Accelerating Binocular Gaussian Splatting via Reprojection and Selective Patching
papers.abstract_en: Binocular rendering requires two nearby views of the same scene and therefore repeats substantial visibility and shading work. We present a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) pipeline that fully renders a dominant-eye RGB image and an alpha-weighted depth proxy, reprojects that image to the affiliated eye, and repairs uncovered pixels. Small interior gaps are interpolated, whereas larger disoccluded regions are identified as regions of interest (ROIs) and selectively re-rendered. The depth proxy reuses the alpha-blending weights computed during dominant-eye rasterization, avoiding a separate depth-rendering pass. An adaptive ROI generator localizes the required updates using reprojected image boundaries and optional connected center-hole detection. On DTU, Tanks and Temples, and MipNeRF-360, the method reduces the measured time of a sequential two-pass binocular reference by 15.5\% to 28.8\% and peak GPU memory by 6\% to 11\%. The corresponding affiliated-eye quality degradation is at most 1.3 dB PSNR, 0.02 SSIM, and 0.02 LPIPS, representing a measurable trade-off that requires application-specific perceptual validation. These results establish a practical efficiency-quality trade-off for controlled static-scene stereo rendering and motivate future evaluation under continuous motion and on physical VR hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出一条双目 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) 渲染管线：完整渲染主眼 RGB 与 alpha 加权深度代理，把主眼图像重投影到辅眼，只对未覆盖区域做选择性重渲染。在 DTU、Tanks and Temples、MipNeRF-360 上，相对顺序双趟参考实现测得时间下降 15.5%–28.8%、峰值显存下降 6%–11%，代价是辅眼质量最多退化 1.3 dB PSNR、0.02 SSIM、0.02 LPIPS。
Motivation: 双目渲染需要同一场景的两个邻近视角，可见性判定与着色工作大量重复，导致静态场景立体渲染的时间与显存开销偏高。
Method: 管线完整渲染主眼 RGB 与复用主眼光栅化 alpha-blending 权重的深度代理（省去独立深度渲染趟），将主眼图像重投影到 affiliated eye 并修补未覆盖像素：小的内部空洞直接插值，较大的 disoccluded 区域由自适应 ROI 生成器依据重投影图像边界与可选的连通中心孔检测定位为感兴趣区域，再选择性重渲染。
Result: 在 DTU、Tanks and Temples、MipNeRF 360 上，相对顺序双趟双目参考，测得时间减少 15.5% 到 28.8%，峰值 GPU 显存减少 6% 到 11%；affiliated-eye 质量退化最多为 1.3 dB PSNR、0.02 SSIM、0.02 LPIPS。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为受控静态场景立体渲染建立了可实用的效率-质量折衷，并主张在连续运动与实体 VR 硬件上做进一步评估，质量退化需要按应用做感知验证。

papers.title: Beyond Mean Attention: Diversity-Aware, Layer-Wise Scoring for KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: KV cache eviction methods such as SnapKV and PyramidKV rank tokens solely by mean attention over a small observation window. We study a unified score, $μ_i+λ_1σ_i+λ_2\mathrm{corr}(i,S)$, adding attention dispersion across window queries and redundancy relative to selected tokens. For $λ_2<0$, the score penalizes similarity to selected tokens as in maximal marginal relevance (MMR), without extra forward passes. To test whether this relevance-diversity balance should vary with depth, we compare fixed global coefficients with three-segment and quadratic profiles. Only these depth profiles are searched on a development split under a $\sinh$ reparameterization. On all 16 English LongBench datasets with Mistral-7B at a budget of 64 entries per layer, a single global diversification constant improves 13 of 16 datasets (macro +1.1); the gain holds at budget 32 and narrows at 128. Per-dataset search finds no detectable layer structure on most datasets; on passage retrieval it finds a large one: a mid-layer sign flip that rewards similarity and is worth +9.6 over the baseline at budget 64 and, without re-tuning, +13.2 over the global constant at budget 128. Ablations attribute the gain to the redundancy term; replaying every accepted search state on the held-out test set separates genuine structure from tuning noise.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 KV cache 驱逐中仅按观察窗平均注意力打分的问题，提出统一分数 μ_i+λ_1σ_i+λ_2corr(i,S)，把注意力离散度与相对已选 token 的冗余度纳入排序，λ_2<0 时等价于 MMR 式惩罚且不增加前向传播。在 LongBench 全部 16 个英文数据集、Mistral-7B、每层 64 条预算下，单一全局多样化常数改进 13/16 个数据集（macro +1.1）；逐数据集搜索发现 passage retrieval 存在中层符号翻转，预算 64 时较基线 +9.6。
Motivation: SnapKV、PyramidKV 等 KV cache 驱逐方法只用小观察窗上的平均注意力给 token 排序，既忽略注意力在窗内查询间的离散度，也不考虑已选 token 之间的冗余，且不清楚相关性与多样性的平衡是否应随层深变化。
Method: 构造统一打分 μ_i+λ_1σ_i+λ_2corr(i,S)：μ 为观察窗平均注意力，σ 刻画跨窗查询的注意力离散度，corr 度量相对已选 token 的冗余；λ_2<0 时按 MMR 方式惩罚相似性且无需额外前向。对比固定全局系数、三段式与二次型三种层深剖面，仅在开发集上用 sinh 重参数化搜索剖面，并在留出测试集上重放每个被接受的搜索状态以区分真实结构与调参噪声。
Result: 在 LongBench 全部 16 个英文数据集、Mistral-7B、每层 64 条预算下，单一全局多样化常数改进 13/16 个数据集，macro +1.1；该增益在预算 32 时保持，在 128 时收窄。逐数据集搜索在多数数据集上检测不到层结构，但在 passage retrieval 上找到显著结构：中层符号翻转改为奖励相似性，预算 64 时较基线 +9.6，且不重新调参在预算 128 时较全局常数 +13.2。消融把增益归因于冗余项。
Conclusion: 全局的注意力多样化常数能稳定小幅提升 KV cache 驱逐质量，但相关性-多样性的最优权衡通常不随层深变化，只有 passage retrieval 这类任务在中层出现符号翻转；搜索必须在留出集上重放以排除调参噪声。

papers.title: Learning What to Skip: Counterfactual Credit Assignment for Efficient Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM workflows use planning, execution, verification, and summarization to improve task performance, yet the value of each component depends on the state already produced. Executing every component can waste computation or overwrite a correct intermediate answer. We formulate component omission as counterfactual credit assignment: full-workflow logs reveal the executed trajectory's reward, while controlled skip interventions reveal the consequences of omitting a future step. We introduce Learning What to Skip (LW2S), which learns action-specific safety models from these interventions and combines held-out calibration with domain-native guards to select skips. When an early skip is rejected, the controller can continue execution and reconsider a later component. Across mathematical reasoning, multiple-choice QA, and code generation with two instruction-model families, LW2S reduces recorded token cost while matching or improving aggregate full-workflow accuracy in the evaluated settings. Scale-up and second-topology experiments further examine component redundancy, while shared-error cases reveal why agreement alone is insufficient for skip selection. These findings connect efficient workflow execution to learning the conditional utility of individual components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LW2S 把多智能体 LLM 工作流的组件跳过建模为反事实信用分配：用受控 skip 干预学习每个动作的安全模型，再结合留出校准与领域原生 guard 决定跳过哪个组件，被拒绝的早期跳过可继续执行并在后续组件重新考虑。在数学推理、多选 QA 与代码生成三类任务、两族指令模型上，它降低记录的 token 成本，同时持平或提升完整工作流的聚合准确率。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 工作流的规划、执行、验证、 summarization 各组件价值取决于当前状态，全量执行既浪费算力，也可能覆盖本已正确的中间答案，而组件的条件效用没有被显式学习。
Method: 把组件省略形式化为反事实信用分配：完整工作流日志给出已执行轨迹的 reward，受控 skip 干预给出省略未来步骤的后果；LW2S 由这些干预学习 action-specific 安全模型，用留出校准 (held-out calibration) 加领域原生 guard 选择跳过，早期跳过被拒时继续执行并重新考虑后续组件。
Result: 在数学推理、多选 QA、代码生成三类任务与两族指令模型的评估设置中，LW2S 降低记录的 token 成本，同时持平或改进完整工作流的聚合准确率；scale-up 与第二拓扑实验进一步检验组件冗余，shared-error 案例显示仅凭一致 (agreement) 不足以决定跳过。
Conclusion: 高效工作流执行可归结为学习各组件的条件效用，跳过决策需要安全模型加校准而非只看输出一致性。

papers.title: Amplify What You Gaze At: Target Saliency Boosting in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation has advanced in controlling what, where, and how objects appear, yet how visual attention is distributed among objects remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Target Saliency Boosting, a new task aimed at boosting the visual saliency of a specific object during text-to-image generation without requiring any visual priors. Our key insight is that visual saliency is inherently relative: boosting the saliency of a target object also depends on the global saliency distribution across all objects in the scene. Based on this insight, we propose GazeME, a lightweight framework that uses saliency-marked prompts, inserting learnable marker tokens around object descriptions to indicate which objects to visually emphasize or suppress. To learn these markers, we construct a saliency-semantics dataset that associates objects in image--prompt pairs with object-level saliency scores, and propose Saliency Prior Marker Activation (SPMA), a saliency-aware stochastic marker activation strategy that exploits relative saliency relationships for robust training. During inference, GazeME automatically inserts appropriate markers into the prompt, thereby directly enhancing the visual saliency of the target object. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GazeME effectively boosts target saliency while preserving both semantic alignment and image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Target Saliency Boosting 这一新任务：在文生图生成中提升指定目标物体的视觉显著性，且不需要任何视觉先验。核心洞察是视觉显著性本质上是相对的，提升目标物体的显著性取决于场景中所有物体的全局显著性分布；据此提出轻量框架 GazeME，在物体描述周围插入可学习的 marker token 来标记需强调或抑制的物体。
Motivation: 文生图已能控制物体出现的 what、where、how，但视觉注意力在多个物体之间如何分配基本未被探索，缺少在生成时定向提升某一物体显著性的手段。
Method: GazeME 用 saliency-marked prompts，在物体描述旁插入可学习 marker token 指示强调或抑制；构建 saliency-semantics 数据集，为 image–prompt 对中的物体标注物体级显著性分数；训练用 Saliency Prior Marker Activation (SPMA)，一种利用相对显著性关系的显著性感知随机 marker 激活策略；推理时自动向 prompt 插入相应 marker。
Result: 大量实验显示 GazeME 能有效提升目标物体显著性，同时保持语义对齐与图像质量。
Conclusion: 把显著性当作跨物体的相对量并用可学习 marker 在 prompt 中编码，可以在无需视觉先验的情况下定向增强目标物体的视觉显著性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出 Target Saliency Boosting 这一新任务：在文生图生成中提升指定目标物体的视觉显著性，且不需要任何视觉先验。核心洞察是视觉显著性本质上是相对的，提升目标物体的显著性取决于场景中所有物体的全局显著性分布；据此提出轻量框架 GazeME，在物体描述周围插入可学习的 marker token 来标记需强调或抑制的物体。

papers.title: TR-SSQP: A Trust-Region Method for Constrained Stochastic Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: We consider stochastic nonlinear optimization problems with deterministic equality constraints. While unconstrained stochastic optimization is well understood, the interplay between optimality and feasibility in the constrained setting poses significant challenges. Moreover, existing theoretical guarantees for constrained stochastic methods predominantly rely on bounded-variance assumptions, leaving the heavy-tailed noise regime largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose a novel trust-region method within the stochastic sequential quadratic programming framework, termed TR-SSQP. Our method employs a normal-tangential decomposition in the step computation to balance optimality and feasibility. In addition, we incorporate a normalization mechanism in the design of the trust-region radius, together with Polyak momentum for gradient estimation, ensuring stable updates without gradient clipping. When the trust-region radius and the momentum parameter decay at appropriate rates, we establish global almost-sure convergence of the method. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first asymptotic convergence result for constrained stochastic optimization under heavy-tailed noise. We demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed method through extensive numerical experiments, including comparisons among its variants and with existing constrained stochastic optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TR-SSQP 把信赖域引入随机序列二次规划 (stochastic SQP) 来解带确定性等式约束的随机非线性优化，在重尾噪声下用步长的法向-切向分解平衡最优性与可行性，并用归一化信赖域半径配合 Polyak 动量做梯度估计、无需梯度截断。当信赖域半径与动量参数按适当速率衰减时，方法全局几乎必然收敛，作者称这是重尾噪声下约束随机优化的首个渐近收敛结果。
Motivation: 无约束随机优化理论已较成熟，但约束情形下最优性与可行性的耦合仍困难；且现有约束随机方法的理论保证基本依赖有界方差假设，重尾噪声 regime 基本空白。
Method: 在随机 SQP 框架内提出 TR-SSQP：步长计算采用法向-切向分解 (normal-tangential decomposition)；信赖域半径设计中加入归一化机制；梯度估计用 Polyak 动量，从而在不截断梯度的条件下保持更新稳定。收敛性在信赖域半径与动量参数按适当速率衰减的条件下建立。
Result: 建立该方法的全局几乎几乎必然 (almost-sure) 收敛，作者称据其所知是重尾噪声下约束随机优化的首个渐近收敛结果；并通过大量数值实验展示性能，包括各变体之间以及与已有约束随机优化方法的比较（32 页、5 图、3 表）。
Conclusion: 信赖域半径与动量参数按适当速率衰减即可在重尾噪声下同时保证约束随机优化的最优性与可行性收敛，归一化半径加 Polyak 动量是免梯度截断的可行设计。

papers.title: Input-Layer Starvation: Why Per-Layer Pruning Breaks IoT Intrusion Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Intrusion detectors for small Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices are usually compressed by pruning and judged by overall accuracy. We show that this hides a severe class-level failure, find its cause, and give low-overhead prevention and repair. On CICIoT2023, a two-layer convolutional detector pruned with uniform layer-wise magnitude pruning at 80% sparsity loses 16 points of accuracy but half of its macro-F1, the mean per-class F1 (0.542 to 0.271 over five independently trained models); 17 of 34 classes are materially damaged. Remaining weight count does not explain it: a perceptron and a transformer pruned to the same or fewer weights lose at most 0.096. The first layer does. It has 192 weights; uniform pruning leaves 38, 46% of its 64 filters lose every input weight, and fine-tuning under that starvation leaves the running means of the first normalisation layer displaced by up to 0.8 standard deviations in a few surviving channels, on which the deployed model collapses. Protecting those 192 weights, or pruning globally at the same sparsity, prevents the collapse (loss 0.013); recomputing the normalisation statistics on unlabelled training data, with no weight changed, repairs it (loss 0.039) and returns the false-alert rate to 33% (dense 29%). Damage shows a strong increasing dose-response in first-layer sparsity, starving a perceptron's input layer reproduces the collapse, and the pattern holds on TON_IoT. The failure is misattribution and false alerts, not silent evasion: on validation-selected blind spots, uniformly pruned detectors misattribute 72% of the traffic, against 50% with the first layer protected and 47% for the dense model.
papers.comment: 38 pages including a 15-page supplement; 12 main tables, 4 figures. Code and results: https://github.com/anasbiswas1/iot-trust-compression
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IoT 入侵检测器按层均匀剪枝到 80% 稀疏度时，第一层 192 个权重被剪到 38，64 个滤波器中 46% 丢失全部输入权重，饥饿态微调使首层归一化运行均值偏移最多 0.8 个标准差，模型在少数存活通道上崩溃。保护这 192 个权重或改用全局剪枝可把损失压到 0.013，仅在无标签数据上重算归一化统计（不改权重）可修复到损失 0.039。
Motivation: 小 IoT 设备上的入侵检测器靠剪枝压缩，却只用总体准确率评判，掩盖了严重的类别级失效；作者要找出其成因并给出低开销的预防与修复手段。
Method: 在 CICIoT2023 上对两层卷积检测器做逐层均匀幅值剪枝（uniform layer-wise magnitude pruning），跨五个独立训练模型分析；对照同权重数的 perceptron 与 transformer，并在 TON_IoT 上检验模式是否成立，另用验证集选出的 blind spot 分析误归因。
Result: 80% 稀疏度下准确率掉 16 点，macro-F1（五模型平均 per-class F1）从 0.542 跌到 0.271，34 类中 17 类实质受损；perceptron 与 transformer 剪到相同或更少权重时损失至多 0.096。首层剪枝剂量-反应强烈，保护首层或全局剪枝损失 0.013，重算归一化统计损失 0.039 并把误报率拉回 33%（dense 29%）。误归因流量：均匀剪枝 72%，保护首层 50%，dense 47%；模式在 TON_IoT 上同样成立。
Conclusion: 逐层均匀剪枝的崩溃由首层输入饥饿与归一化统计偏移造成，而非剩余权重总量；失败表现为误归因与误报，不是静默规避。保护首层权重、改用全局剪枝或仅重算归一化统计即可预防或修复。

papers.title: Learning Polarization Image Restoration with General Restoration Priors
papers.abstract_en: Polarization imaging captures distinctive surface and geometric cues that benefit a wide range of vision tasks. However, real-world polarization acquisition is often affected by multiple coupled degradations, making image restoration essential for practical polarization vision. Existing methods are largely tailored to specific degradations and remain constrained by the limited scale and quality of polarization data. To address these limitations, we develop an all-in-one polarization restoration framework for diverse and composite degradations. We first study the impact of different polarization representations on restoration performance and identify the normalized Stokes representation as an effective choice for separating intensity and polarization information. Accordingly, we devise a dual-branch architecture that separates intensity and polarization modeling. To overcome the limitations of polarization-specific training, the intensity branch leverages pretrained general restoration priors and a mixture-of-experts extension for composite degradations, while its restoration knowledge is adaptively distilled into the symmetric polarization branch via a cross-domain feature transform. In addition, we establish a composite-degradation polarization benchmark to support all-in-one restoration research. Extensive experiments on public datasets and our proposed benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向偏振图像的 all-in-one 复原框架：以 normalized Stokes 表示分离强度与偏振信息，双分支架构中强度分支借用预训练通用复原先验与 mixture-of-experts 处理复合退化，再经跨域特征变换把复原知识自适应蒸馏到对称的偏振分支。在公开数据集与自建复合退化偏振 benchmark 上验证有效。
Motivation: 真实偏振成像常受多种耦合退化影响，现有方法多针对单一退化设计，且偏振数据规模与质量有限，难以支撑通用复原。
Method: 先比较不同偏振表示对复原的影响并选定 normalized Stokes 表示；据此设计分离强度与偏振建模的双分支架构，强度分支用预训练通用复原先验加 mixture-of-experts 扩展应对复合退化，通过 cross-domain feature transform 将知识自适应蒸馏到偏振分支；同时构建复合退化偏振 benchmark。
Result: 在公开数据集与自建复合退化偏振 benchmark 上的大量实验表明所提方法有效；normalized Stokes 被识别为分离强度与偏振信息的有效表示。
Conclusion: 把通用复原先验经 MoE 与跨域蒸馏迁移到偏振分支，是绕开偏振数据稀缺、实现多退化 all-in-one 偏振复原的可行路径。

papers.title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cost-Inefficient Behaviors in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Although effective, coding agents often incur substantial monetary costs. Their recurring cost-inefficient behaviors remain underexplored. We conduct the first study of behavioral cost inefficiencies in coding agents, analyzing 1,200 trajectories from Claude Code and Mini-SWE-Agent across four configurations on SWE-bench Verified. We identify three cost-inefficient behaviors: subsumed retrieval, similar script generation, and test re-execution. We then evaluate three mitigation strategies: structure-aware retrieval, agent-synthesized skills, and developer-designed skills, over 10k trajectories on held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro tasks. Our main findings are: (1) The three behaviors affect 79.00\%--98.00\% of coding tasks and account for up to 22.75\% of task cost. (2) Structure-aware retrieval can introduce retrieval overhead and alter agent delegation, causing inconsistent improvements in retrieval efficiency and cost increases of up to 28.14\%. (3) Agent-synthesized skills tend to produce low-level, trace-specific guidance, limiting their effectiveness and generality. (4) In contrast, developer-designed skills provide high-level, trace-agnostic guidance, reducing cost by up to 41.73\%, roughly twice the maximum gain from agent-synthesized skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对编码智能体 (coding agent) 的成本低效行为做首次系统研究：在 SWE-bench Verified 上分析 Claude Code 与 Mini-SWE-Agent 的 1,200 条轨迹，识别出 subsumed retrieval、similar script generation、test re-execution 三类行为，它们波及 79.00%–98.00% 的任务、最高占任务成本 22.75%。三种缓解策略中，structure-aware retrieval 最多反增成本 28.14%，agent-synthesized skills 效果受限，developer-designed skills 最高降本 41.73%，约为前者的两倍。
Motivation: 编码智能体有效但货币成本高，其反复出现的、可归因于具体行为的成本低效此前缺乏系统刻画，也没有针对性的缓解手段评估。
Method: 先在四种配置下分析 Claude Code 与 Mini-SWE-Agent 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 1,200 条轨迹以归纳三类低效行为，再在 held-out 的 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Pro 任务上、超过 10k 条轨迹中评估三种缓解策略：structure-aware retrieval、agent-synthesized skills、developer-designed skills。
Result: 三类行为影响 79.00%–98.00% 的编码任务，最高占任务成本 22.75%；structure-aware retrieval 引入检索开销并改变 agent delegation，检索效率改善不一致、成本最高上升 28.14%；agent-synthesized skills 倾向产出低层、绑定具体 trace 的指引，效果与通用性受限；developer-designed skills 给出高层、trace-agnostic 指引，成本最高下降 41.73%，约为 agent-synthesized skills 最大收益的两倍。
Conclusion: 成本低效是编码智能体中普遍且可量化的现象，而由开发者撰写的高层、与 trace 无关的 skills 是比检索改造或智能体自合成 skills 更有效的降本手段。

papers.title: EviDETR: Preserving Query-Relevant Temporal Evidence for Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection
papers.abstract_en: Joint video moment retrieval and highlight detection requires identifying query-relevant temporal segments while estimating clip-level saliency, yet DETR-style pipelines do not explicitly preserve query-relevant evidence throughout encoding, decoding, and cross-task prediction. We propose EviDETR, an evidence-preserving framework with three components. Semantic-aware Feature Reweighting (SFR) enhances query-relevant clip representations through saliency estimation and cross-modal interaction. A Temporal Top-2 Mixture-of-Experts (TTop2MoE) decoder performs query-adaptive refinement via sparse expert routing. MR-to-HD (MR2HD) fusion transfers span-level retrieval evidence to clip-level highlight prediction through confidence-weighted multi-scale aggregation. Using CLIP+SlowFast features, EviDETR achieves 69.29 R1@0.5, 54.77 R1@0.7, and 48.41 Avg. mAP for moment retrieval on QVHighlights, together with 41.83 HD-mAP and 68.33 HIT@1. Strong results on TACoS and Charades-STA further demonstrate cross-dataset transferability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EviDETR 在 DETR 式视频时刻检索 (moment retrieval) 与高光检测 (highlight detection) 联合框架中显式保留查询相关时序证据：SFR 重加权查询相关片段特征，TTop2MoE 解码器做查询自适应稀疏专家路由精炼，MR2HD 以置信度加权多尺度聚合把片段级检索证据迁移到片段级高光预测。在 QVHighlights 上取得 69.29 R1@0.5、54.77 R1@0.7、48.41 Avg. mAP（MR）与 41.83 HD-mAP、68.33 HIT@1（HD），并在 TACoS 与 Charades-STA 上展现跨数据集可迁移性。
Motivation: DETR 式流水线在编码、解码与跨任务预测各阶段都没有显式保留查询相关证据，导致时刻检索与高光检测的联合预测中证据流失。
Method: 三个组件：Semantic-aware Feature Reweighting (SFR) 用显著性估计与跨模态交互增强查询相关片段表示；Temporal Top-2 Mixture-of-Experts (TTop2MoE) 解码器通过稀疏专家路由做查询自适应精炼；MR-to-HD (MR2HD) 融合用置信度加权多尺度聚合把片段级检索证据传给片段级高光预测。特征采用 CLIP+SlowFast。
Result: QVHighlights 上 moment retrieval 达 69.29 R1@0.5、54.77 R1@0.7、48.41 Avg. mAP；highlight detection 达 41.83 HD-mAP 与 68.33 HIT@1。TACoS 与 Charades-STA 上同样取得强结果，显示跨数据集迁移能力。
Conclusion: 在编码、解码与跨任务预测全链路显式保留查询相关证据，可同时支撑时刻检索与高光检测，并跨数据集迁移。

papers.title: TrafficImag: A Benchmark for Counterfactual Roadside Traffic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing roadside traffic datasets support perception, forecasting, and visual question answering, but they do not evaluate counterfactual video generation, in which a selected actor is modified and the generated future should remain consistent with road topology and unrelated traffic. We introduce TrafficImag, the first benchmark for counterfactual roadside traffic video generation. TrafficImag combines a large-scale roadside dataset (9,022 annotated images, 7,043 deduplicated video clips, and 31,145 actor-centered history-future samples) with an executable protocol that supports behavior reasoning, intervention-aware image editing, and conditional video generation. Each intervention is represented as an actor-level program describing the target actor, intended behavior, legal route, interaction order, and temporal constraints, enabling a unified evaluation interface across heterogeneous foundation models. TrafficImag evaluates four complementary validity dimensions: initial-state correctness, route and behavior validity, interaction consistency, and non-target preservation, and considers an end-to-end counterfactual successful only when all four are satisfied. Across state-of-the-art foundation models, the strongest reasoner reaches 80.4% macro F1, the complete condition interface raises end-to-end success from 23.3% to 55.0% for the best generator. Oracle studies further show that conditional video execution is the primary remaining bottleneck. TrafficImag provides a reproducible benchmark for evaluating and diagnosing counterfactual traffic video generation beyond perceptual video quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TrafficImag 是首个反事实路侧交通视频生成基准：把对目标 actor 的干预写成含合法路线、交互顺序与时间约束的 actor 级程序，用初始状态正确性、路线与行为有效性、交互一致性、非目标保持四个维度联合判定成功。最强推理模型 macro F1 达 80.4%，完整条件接口把最佳生成器的端到端成功率从 23.3% 提到 55.0%，oracle 研究指向条件视频执行是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有路侧交通数据集只覆盖感知、预测与 VQA，无法评测反事实视频生成——即修改指定 actor 后，生成的未来仍须与道路拓扑及无关交通保持一致。
Method: 组合 9,022 张标注图像、7,043 个去重视频片段与 31,145 个 actor 中心的历史-未来样本，配套可执行协议，支持行为推理、干预感知图像编辑与条件视频生成；每个干预表示为描述目标 actor、意图行为、合法路线、交互顺序与时间约束的 actor 级程序，为异构基础模型提供统一评测接口。
Result: 四个有效性维度全部满足才算端到端反事实成功。最强推理模型 macro F1 80.4%；完整条件接口使最佳生成器端到端成功率从 23.3% 升至 55.0%；oracle 研究显示条件视频执行是主要剩余瓶颈。
Conclusion: 反事实交通视频生成可被程序化干预与四维联合判据统一评测，当前短板在条件视频执行而非推理或接口设计。

papers.title: When 10,000 Windows Are Not 10,000 Tests: Auditing Statistical Confidence in Sliding-Window Time-Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Sliding-window classifiers are often evaluated on thousands of overlapping test windows, even though neighboring predictions share observations and remain nested within recordings and subjects. Subject-disjoint evaluation prevents one form of leakage but does not make those test windows independent. We present a practical audit that maps three claims - performance on observed recordings, future recordings from observed subjects, and unseen subjects - to explicit aggregation rules and established dependence-robust inference. At 75% overlap, controlled simulations give 16.9% Type-I error for IID observed-record inference and 7.2% for session-centered Bartlett-HAC: a substantial improvement with residual miscalibration. Audits of frozen WISDM and HARTH predictions show that nearly fourfold growth in test rows yields only 1.75-1.94-fold variance-equivalent information growth. At that overlap, fixed-record paired Accuracy-difference intervals are 1.22-1.66 times the IID widths; this inflation is not universal at zero overlap. On HARTH, paired Accuracy-difference intervals include zero across three overlap settings, whereas Macro-F1 favors MiniROCKET. Independent recomputation, common-session checks, class-level results, and separately seeded calibration make the audit's scope and limitations inspectable. The resulting workflow distinguishes additional predictions from additional independent evidence.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 滑窗时序分类把上万重叠测试窗当独立样本会虚高统计置信度。作者给出审计流程，把三种泛化声明映射到聚合规则与依赖稳健推断；75% 重叠下 IID 观测记录推断的 Type-I 错误率为 16.9%，session-centered Bartlett-HAC 降到 7.2%。
Motivation: 重叠测试窗共享观测、且嵌套在记录与被试内，IID 独立性假设失效；subject-disjoint 划分只堵住一种泄漏，不使测试窗独立，导致置信区间与显著性检验失真。
Method: 提出审计流程，把三种声明（已见记录上的性能、已见被试的未来记录、未见被试）映射到显式聚合规则与依赖稳健推断（session-centered Bartlett-HAC）；用受控模拟校准 Type-I 错误，并对冻结的 WISDM 与 HARTH 预测做审计，附独立重算、common-session 检查、类别级结果与独立种子校准。
Result: 75% 重叠受控模拟中，IID observed-record 推断 Type-I 错误 16.9%，session-centered Bartlett-HAC 为 7.2%（仍有残余失准）。WISDM/HARTH 上测试行近四倍增长只带来 1.75–1.94 倍的方差等效信息增长；该重叠下 fixed-record 配对 Accuracy 差值区间宽度为 IID 的 1.22–1.66 倍，而零重叠时无此膨胀。HARTH 上配对 Accuracy 差值区间在三种重叠设置下均含零，Macro-F1 则支持 MiniROCKET。
Conclusion: 额外预测不等于额外独立证据：重叠窗下的置信度必须按依赖稳健推断重算，且该膨胀在零重叠时消失，说明问题源于重叠而非方法本身。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Werracle: Sub-Cent Intra-Block AI Reflex Oracles and Flash-Loan Circuit Breakers for EVM Smart Contracts
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary on-chain artificial intelligence (AI) encounters an intractable Von Neumann memory and latency wall. Storing static floating-point neural weight matrices inside Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) storage costs millions of gas, rendering direct on-chain inference impossible. While Zero-Knowledge Machine Learning (ZK-ML) offloads matrix tensor multiplications to off-chain provers, it introduces fatal constraints: 10 to 300 seconds of SNARK proving latency and 250,000 to 500,000 gas per proof verification. Because decentralized finance (DeFi) exploits - such as uncollateralized flash-loan attacks, predatory sandwich MEV, and toxic loss-versus-rebalancing (LVR) flow - occur atomically inside a single block, ZK-ML oracles cannot react in time. Here, we present Werracle, a production-grade, zero-storage on-chain AI decision oracle fitting inside a single 32-byte EVM storage slot (bytes32). Leveraging foundational procedural Mandelbrot escape dynamics (z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c) established by Dagli et al. (arXiv:2609.25498), Werracle derives continuous non-linear decision hyperplanes from a 24-byte coordinate triplet Theta = (c_x, c_y, zoom). Implemented in pure Solidity bytecode using fixed-point Q16.16 arithmetic (WerrMath.sol), Werracle evaluates a 16-point Pareto micro-grid in only 21,438 gas (under 0.0005 USD on Layer-2 rollups like Base and Arbitrum) with sub-millisecond execution latency. We demonstrate real-world DeFi efficacy via WerracleFeeHook.sol, a Uniswap v4 dynamic swap fee governor that measures orderbook turbulence on-the-fly and atomically adjusts liquidity provider fees between 0.05% and 0.50%. The protocol is formally verified against a 1,000-test cryptographically sealed deterministic verification suite (100.0% pass rate) with telemetry permanently disabled, operating live on a dedicated EVM devnet sandbox (Chain ID 4242).
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Replication package and open data at Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22942598. Accompanies companion theoretical research arXiv:2609.25498. Patent Pending TR 2026/016285. Code available at https://github.com/pCwOrM/werracle
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Werracle 把神经网络式决策压进单个 32 字节 EVM 存储槽，用 Mandelbrot 逃逸动力学 (z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c) 从 24 字节坐标三元组 Theta=(c_x,c_y,zoom) 导出非线性决策超平面，以 Q16.16 定点数纯 Solidity 实现，16 点 Pareto 微网格仅耗 21,438 gas、亚毫秒延迟，从而绕开 ZK-ML 的 10–300 秒证明延迟与每次验证 250,000–500,000 gas。配套的 Uniswap v4 动态手续费钩子 WerracleFeeHook.sol 在单块内原子地把 LP 手续费在 0.05%–0.50% 之间调节，1,000 项确定性验证测试 100.0% 通过。
Motivation: 链上 AI 受制于 EVM 存储与延迟墙：静态浮点权重存进 storage 要数百万 gas，ZK-ML 又带来 10–300 秒 SNARK 证明延迟和每次验证 250,000–500,000 gas，而闪电贷攻击、三明治 MEV、LVR 等 DeFi 攻击在单个块内原子发生，链下证明根本来不及反应。
Method: Werracle 用 24 字节坐标三元组 Theta=(c_x,c_y,zoom) 经 Mandelbrot 逃逸映射生成连续非线性决策超平面，零存储地塞进单个 bytes32 槽；WerrMath.sol 以 Q16.16 定点算术在纯 Solidity 字节码中求值 16 点 Pareto 微网格；WerracleFeeHook.sol 作为 Uniswap v4 钩子实时测量订单簿湍流并原子调费，配套 1,000 项密码学封存的确定性验证套件与 Chain ID 4242 的 EVM devnet 沙盒。
Result: 单次 16 点 Pareto 微网格求值 21,438 gas，在 Base、Arbitrum 等 L2 rollup 上低于 0.0005 USD，执行延迟亚毫秒；对照的 ZK-ML 为 10–300 秒证明延迟、每次证明验证 250,000–500,000 gas。LP 手续费在 0.05%–0.50% 区间动态调节；1,000 项确定性验证测试通过率 100.0%，运行于 Chain ID 4242 devnet。
Conclusion: 把决策几何而非权重搬上链，可以让 DeFi 风控在单块原子窗口内做出 AI 式反应，代价是放弃链上存储的浮点权重与链外证明路径。

papers.title: NEMSim: Learning Control-Conditioned Multi-Event Physical Dynamics via Executable Event-Mechanism Priors
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity simulation of control-conditioned multi-event physical systems is computationally expensive, especially across broad control spaces and long trajectories. In these systems, macroscopic evolution emerges from localized discrete events whose intensities and effects depend on process controls and evolving local states, while the available system knowledge is typically expressed as event-attribute descriptions. Purely data-driven surrogates must infer these event effects from limited trajectory coverage, which can hinder generalization to unseen control regimes. Physics-guided methods instead primarily build on equation-level constraints or differentiable solvers rather than discrete event-rule priors. We therefore propose NEMSim (Neural Event-Mechanism Simulator), which compiles predefined event-attribute descriptions into an executable transition structure linking control-dependent event intensities, prior-guided mechanism attribution, and state-dependent responses. To enable evaluation of control-conditioned multi-event dynamics with explicit system knowledge, we construct a 3D KMC-based benchmark pairing high-fidelity trajectories with explicit event rules, standardized splits, and evaluation protocols. Across three settings, NEMSim reduces Avg. RMSE by 58.9%-81.3% relative to the strongest baseline in each setting. It also remains best in the data-efficiency study with training-data fractions down to 10%. Mechanism analyses further show that these gains arise from executable rule integration rather than prior access or architecture alone.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NEMSim 把事件属性描述编译成可执行的转移结构，把控制相关的事件强度、先验引导的机制归因与状态依赖响应连起来，用于控制条件下的多事件物理动力学仿真。作者另建了一个基于 3D KMC 的基准，配高保真轨迹、显式事件规则、标准化划分与评测协议；在三种设置下 NEMSim 相对各设置最强基线将 Avg. RMSE 降低 58.9%–81.3%，且在训练数据比例低至 10% 时仍为最优。
Motivation: 控制条件下的多事件系统仿真在宽控制空间与长轨迹上代价高，而宏观演化来自局部离散事件；纯数据驱动代理只能从有限轨迹覆盖中推断事件效应，遇到未见控制域就难以泛化，物理引导方法又主要依赖方程级约束或可微求解器而非离散事件规则先验。
Method: NEMSim (Neural Event-Mechanism Simulator) 将预先定义的事件属性描述编译为可执行转移结构，耦合控制依赖的事件强度、先验引导的机制归因 (mechanism attribution) 与状态依赖响应；同时构建基于 3D KMC 的基准，配对高保真轨迹与显式事件规则、标准化划分和评测协议，并做机制分析以区分增益来源。
Result: 在三种设置下，NEMSim 相对各设置最强基线将 Avg. RMSE 降低 58.9%–81.3%；在训练数据比例低至 10% 的数据效率研究中仍保持最优；机制分析显示增益来自可执行规则整合，而非仅凭先验可得性或架构本身。
Conclusion: 把离散事件规则编译成可执行转移结构，比单纯依赖轨迹数据或方程级约束更能提升控制条件多事件动力学的泛化与数据效率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Words Speak Louder Than Order: A Behavioral Evaluation of Gemma 4
papers.abstract_en: When a language model receives two conflicting documents as input, how does it decide which one to prioritize? Does it rely on how the sources are framed or the presentation order of the documents? We evaluated this behavior on Google's pre-trained Gemma 4-e4b model across a targeted behavioral suite (n = 13 items, 784 forward passes in short, single-turn contexts) using a completely counterbalanced experimental design. This setup allowed us to mathematically isolate the specific effects of source framing and reading position, while ensuring the model's natural vocabulary biases were canceled out. Across ten test conditions, we discovered the following: 1. Source framing heavily overpowers reading position. When directly competing, the semantic framing of a source (such as presenting it as an official guideline or a fresh update) had a significantly stronger impact on the model's final answer than the presentation order of the document. 2. The model favors the first document it reads, but this bias is highly variable. While the model consistently demonstrated a primacy effect (preferring the first document presented), the actual strength of this bias fluctuated by at least a factor of 5 based solely on the surface wording. 3. Overall structural repetition, not short copy-cues, drives positional bias. The model's preference for the first document is not a mechanical reaction to short, repetitive trigger phrases, such as "is [Answer]". However, the primacy effect does increase significantly when the two competing documents are structurally identical, using word-for-word verbatim templates. Introducing variation in the overall wording between the two sources reduces this positional bias.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 1 figure, evaluation dataset and logs released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Gemma 4-e4b 做完全交叉平衡 (counterbalanced) 的冲突文档行为评测，数学上分离来源框架 (source framing) 与阅读位置的效应。框架效应显著压过顺序效应；模型稳定表现出首因效应 (primacy effect)，但其强度随表面措辞至少波动 5 倍；位置偏置由整体结构重复驱动，而非短促复制提示，两文档措辞出现差异即可削弱该偏置。
Motivation: 语言模型同时收到两份冲突文档时依据什么取舍，此前无法把来源框架与呈现顺序的贡献分开，也难判断首因效应是机械的短语触发还是结构性重复所致。
Method: 在 Google 预训练模型 Gemma 4-e4b 上运行定向行为套件 (n = 13 items，短单轮上下文共 784 次 forward passes)，采用完全交叉平衡实验设计以数学隔离框架与位置效应，并抵消模型自身词汇偏好；共设十个测试条件，对比官方指南式与新鲜更新式框架、逐字模板重复与措辞变化等操纵。
Result: 十个测试条件下：来源框架对最终答案的影响显著强于文档顺序；模型一致偏好先读到的文档，但该偏置强度仅凭表面措辞就至少波动 5 倍；首因效应在两文档结构完全相同（逐字模板）时显著增强，措辞出现变化则位置偏置下降，而 "is [Answer]" 这类短复制提示并不驱动位置偏置。
Conclusion: 冲突文档中的取舍主要由语义框架决定，顺序偏置是随措辞与结构重复度变化的可变效应，可通过打破两来源的结构同构来削弱。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CRC-Router: Risk-Constrained Routing for Medical Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are increasingly being explored in medical imaging to improve throughput and reduce clinician workload; however, safe deployment remains challenging because autonomous errors may propagate into downstream clinical decisions. A central requirement is therefore not only strong predictive performance, but also a reliable routing mechanism that determines when the system should proceed autonomously and when a case should be escalated for further review. To address this gap, we propose CRC-Router, a risk-constrained, uncertainty-aware routing module that is applicable to both conventional medical prediction models and agentic medical AI systems. CRC-Router combines multiple complementary uncertainty signals with the predictive score to construct a per-finding routing feature vector, maps this vector to an estimated wrong-accept risk using a lightweight per-finding risk model, and then applies Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to calibrate acceptance thresholds under a user-specified risk target. Instantiated on chest X-ray multi-finding triage using the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, CRC-Router achieves the strongest empirical risk--coverage trade-off among the evaluated baselines, both as a standalone routing layer and as a plug-in module integrated with the state-of-the-art MedRAX agent. These results demonstrate both the effectiveness of CRC-Router in selective medical automation and its modular, model-agnostic compatibility with existing predictive and agentic medical pipelines. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/XLIAaron/CRC-Router
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CRC-Router：把多个互补不确定性信号与预测分数拼成 per-finding 路由特征，用轻量风险模型映射为错误接受风险，再用 Conformal Risk Control (CRC) 在用户给定风险目标下校准接受阈值，决定病例自动处理还是升级复审。在 NIH ChestX-ray14 多发现分诊上，无论作为独立路由层还是接入 SOTA 的 MedRAX agent，都在所评估基线中取得最强的经验风险–覆盖权衡。
Motivation: 医疗影像 agentic AI 的自主错误会传导到下游临床决策，系统既要有预测性能，又需要一个可靠的路由机制来判定何时自主推进、何时升级人工复审，而现有部署缺少这种风险受控的门控。
Method: CRC-Router 融合多个互补不确定性信号与预测分数，构造 per-finding 路由特征向量；用轻量的 per-finding 风险模型把该向量映射为估计的错误接受风险；再用 Conformal Risk Control 在用户指定风险目标下校准接受阈值。模块既可作为常规医学预测模型的独立路由层，也可作为插件接入 agentic 医学 AI 流水线。
Result: 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 的多发现分诊任务上，CRC-Router 在所评估基线中取得最强的经验风险–覆盖权衡，且在两种设置下都成立：作为独立路由层，以及作为插件集成到 SOTA 的 MedRAX agent 中。
Conclusion: 风险受控的选择性路由可以作为模型无关的通用层，同时服务常规预测模型与 agentic 医学 AI，在给定风险目标下决定自动化与人工复审的边界。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Parameter Estimation for Unnormalized Discrete Models via Empirically Localized Deformed Bregman Divergence
papers.abstract_en: Estimation of parameter of probabilistic models is an important task in the field of machine learning.For models of discrete variables, calculation of the normalization constant of model is sometimes difficult and a lot of researches have been done to avoid the calculation of the normalization constant. In this paper, we tackle with the difficulty by combining a technique of empirical localization and a deformed Bregman divergence.The technique of empirical localization makes it possible to drastically reduce computational cost of the calculation of the normalization constant, and in addition, appropriate choice of the deformation for the Bregman divergence can invest the proposed estimator with various kinds of favorable statistical properties, such as efficiency or robustness against outlier noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对离散变量概率模型中归一化常数难以计算的问题，提出把经验局部化 (empirical localization) 与变形 Bregman 散度 (deformed Bregman divergence) 结合的参数估计量：经验局部化大幅降低归一化常数的计算开销，对 Bregman 散度选取不同变形则可赋予估计量效率或对离群噪声的稳健性等统计性质。
Motivation: 离散变量模型的配分函数常难以计算，直接做参数估计代价高；需要在避开归一化常数的同时还能调控估计量的统计性质。
Method: 将经验局部化技术与变形 Bregman 散度结合构造估计量：前者压缩归一化常数计算成本，后者通过选择变形形式注入效率或抗离群点噪声等性质。
Result: 摘要给出的是构造性结论：经验局部化可大幅降低归一化常数计算开销，变形的选择可使估计量获得效率、对离群噪声稳健等统计性质；无实验数值。
Conclusion: 避开配分函数与调控估计量统计性质可以在同一个基于变形 Bregman 散度的估计框架里同时实现。

papers.title: VLALight: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Models for Emergency-Aware Traffic Signal Control
papers.abstract_en: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for mitigating urban congestion. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) enable richer interpretation of intersection scenes, opening new opportunities for visual-context-aware TSC. However, the loose coupling and repeated information conversion between modules can lead to the loss of fine-grained visual details, while sequential inference introduces substantial latency. To address these limitations, we propose VLALight, a lightweight end-to-end vision-language-action framework that directly maps intersection observations and signal-phase information to discrete signal actions. To handle the multi-view nature of TSC, VLALight combines multiple directional camera views into a unified visual input and uses textual instructions to establish their correspondence with traffic movements and signal phases. This design enables direct action prediction with a compact 0.5 B-parameter model, without intermediate image-to-text descriptions or handcrafted traffic-state representations. Experiments show that VLALight delivers the best emergency-vehicle service of all compared methods, reducing pooled emergency waiting time by 21.1% over the cascaded VLMLight while running in real time on local hardware and generalizing to unseen intersection topologies and traffic-flow patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLALight 把多方向路口相机视图与信号相位文本指令一起端到端映射到离散信号动作，用 0.5 B 参数模型省掉中间图像转文字与手工交通状态表示。在对比方法中它给出最好的应急车辆服务，合并应急等待时间比级联式 VLMLight 降低 21.1%，且可在本地硬件实时运行、泛化到未见过的路口拓扑与车流模式。
Motivation: 视觉语言 TSC 中模块松耦合与反复信息转换会丢失细粒度视觉细节，串行推理又带来大延迟，制约视觉上下文感知的信号控制落地。
Method: 端到端 vision-language-action 框架：把多个方向相机视图合成统一视觉输入，用文本指令建立其与交通运动、信号相位的对应，直接预测离散信号动作；模型仅 0.5 B 参数，不含中间 image-to-text 描述与手工交通状态表示。
Result: 在与各对比方法的实验中应急车辆服务最佳，合并应急等待时间较级联式 VLMLight 降低 21.1%；在本地硬件上实时运行，并泛化到未见过的路口拓扑与车流模式。
Conclusion: 把视觉与相位信息直接压进单一轻量动作模型，可以在保住应急车辆优先服务的同时把 TSC 推理压到实时，且不依赖逐路口的中间表示。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Combining General and Domain-Specific Pretext Tasks for Brain MR Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in medical image analysis is the scarcity of large annotated datasets for specific populations and diseases. As deep learning models rely heavily on labeled data, effective transfer learning strategies are needed to reduce the dependence on manual annotations. Self-supervised learning has emerged as a promising approach for developing foundation models by enabling the learning of transferable feature representations from large-scale unlabeled medical imaging datasets. In this study, we investigate voxel-level brain age prediction as a domain-specific self-supervised pretext task and compare it with image inpainting, a widely used non-domain-specific alternative. We further propose a multitask self-supervised pretraining framework that jointly optimizes both objectives to learn complementary neuroimaging representations. The pretrained models are evaluated on three downstream magnetic resonance image segmentation tasks: multiple sclerosis lesion segmentation, ischemic stroke lesion segmentation, and cortical brain structure segmentation. Overall, the proposed multitask pretraining framework consistently outperformed the single-task pretrained models and training from scratch across most experimental settings, demonstrating the benefit of combining domain-specific and general self-supervised learning pretext tasks for the development of generalizable neuroimaging foundation models.\ Code Availability: The source code used in this study is publicly available at https://github.com/TasneemN/Combining-General-and-Domain-Specific-Pretext-Tasks-for-Brain-MR-Image-Segmentation/

papers.title: LAVOIR: Teaching a Single-Pass Decision Encoder When and What to Ask with Amortized Value of Information
papers.abstract_en: "System One" decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev and its open counterpart Laya answer typed questions about a text in a single forward pass with calibrated probabilities, but they cannot ask for missing information: when a first message does not say what separates two departments, they guess. We present LAVOIR (Laya with Value-Of-Information Routing), which places the candidate pieces of missing information (slots) in the input next to the answer options, so that one forward pass returns both the decision distribution and, for every slot, the expected gain in the probability of the correct decision if the user were asked about it. VOI targets need no human labels: gold decisions come from schema rules, an LLM only verbalizes messages and answers, a model from another family checks every text, and pairing each message with several profiles makes regression on realized gains estimate the expected gain. A Gini-impurity cap bounds the predicted value by what a calibrated model can still gain. In a controlled study, decisions on seen schemas are statistically indistinguishable from the Bayes ceiling. The final model's question policy matches a greedy oracle VOI policy on seen schemas (AUC 0.799 vs. 0.797), and with at most 0.5 questions per conversation it is 14.1 points more accurate than never asking. On real ABCD conversations, one real exchange raises accuracy by 8.3 points where LAVOIR asks and leaves it unchanged where it does not; on SGD the cap lowers the asking rate from 93% to 8.6%. On Laya's twelve benchmarks LAVOIR is above Laya's reported scores on seven, and it answers a question in 31 ms (median, GH200).
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/moganai/lavoir ; model: https://huggingface.co/moganai/lavoir
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAVOIR 把候选缺失信息槽位 (slots) 与选项一起放进单次前向输入，让 System One 决策模型同时输出决策分布和每个槽位的期望信息价值 (VOI)，从而决定该不该向用户提问。在 seen schema 上其提问策略与贪心 oracle VOI 策略 AUC 为 0.799 对 0.797，每对话最多问 0.5 个问题时比从不提问高 14.1 个百分点；Gini 不纯度上限把 SGD 上的提问率从 93% 压到 8.6%。
Motivation: TypeSafe 的 Jev 与其开源对应物 Laya 能单次前向回答带类型的问题并给出校准概率，但无法主动索取缺失信息：当首条消息没说清区分两个部门的依据时，模型只能猜。
Method: LAVOIR (Laya with Value-Of-Information Routing) 把候选缺失信息槽位放在输入中答案选项旁边，一次前向同时返回决策分布与每个槽位的期望正确率增益；VOI 目标无需人工标注——gold decision 由 schema 规则给出，LLM 负责把消息与回答语言化，另一模型家族的模型校验每条文本，同一条消息配多个 profile 使对已实现增益的回归可估计期望增益；再用 Gini 不纯度上限把预测价值限制在校准模型仍可获得的范围内。
Result: 在受控研究中，seen schema 上的决策与 Bayes ceiling 在统计上不可区分；最终模型的提问策略在 seen schema 上与贪心 oracle VOI 策略 AUC 为 0.799 对 0.797，每对话最多 0.5 个问题时比从不提问准确率高 14.1 个百分点。在真实 ABCD 对话上，LAVOIR 提问处一次真实往返使准确率提高 8.3 个百分点、不提问处保持不变；在 SGD 上 Gini 上限把提问率从 93% 降到 8.6%。在 Laya 的十二个基准中，LAVOIR 有七个高于 Laya 报告分数，单次回答中位延迟 31 ms (GH200)。
Conclusion: 把 VOI 路由压进单次前向，可在几乎不增加提问次数的前提下逼近 oracle 提问策略并超过从不提问；Gini 上限是控制过度提问的直接开关。

papers.title: The Price of Thought: Does Test-Time Reasoning Pay in LLM Trading?
papers.abstract_en: While inference-time reasoning in large language models (LLMs) promises better decision making, its higher computational cost may not yield better economic outcomes. Yet reasoning controls are rarely evaluated as economic interventions, where changes in model outputs must translate into better portfolios after trading costs. We conduct a controlled study of representative LLMs from the DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini families. We vary reasoning effort while holding information available at each formation date, prompts, output formats, and portfolio construction fixed. Our evaluation covers a full year of U.S. equities under three input conditions: numerical, identifiable news, and masked news. It includes more than 800,000 asset predictions and repeated model generations. Across all three model families, additional reasoning does not produce a reliable improvement in net portfolio returns. For DeepSeek, where we examine the full progression from no reasoning to maximum reasoning, performance is nonmonotonic. Repeated generations also produce unstable treatment effects and portfolio selections, even when overall scores remain similar. These findings show that additional reasoning can change financial decisions without reliably improving their economic value, motivating validation for each task before deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定信息、提示词、输出格式与组合构建的受控实验中，对 DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 三族 LLM 系统改变推理强度，覆盖美股一整年、超 80 万次资产预测。三个模型族中额外推理都没有带来净组合收益的可靠提升；DeepSeek 从无推理到最高推理的表现非单调，重复生成还会让处理效应与持仓选择不稳定。结论是每个任务部署前都要单独验证推理开销是否换回经济价值。
Motivation: 推理时计算成本上升，但很少有人把推理强度当作经济干预来评估——输出变化必须在扣除交易成本后转化为更好的组合，才真正算数。
Method: 受控研究：固定每个形成日可用信息、提示词、输出格式与组合构建，只改变推理强度；输入条件分数值、可识别新闻、遮蔽新闻三种，评估覆盖美股一整年，累计超 80 万次资产预测并做重复生成。
Result: 三个模型族中额外推理都未带来净组合收益的可靠改善；DeepSeek 从无推理到最高推理的性能非单调；重复生成产生不稳定的处理效应与组合选择，即使总体分数相近；共超 800,000 次资产预测、覆盖一整年美股。
Conclusion: 额外推理会改变金融决策却不稳定地提升其经济价值，因此每个任务在部署前都需要单独验证。

papers.title: SAGE: Source-Anchored Guidance via Frequency Equalization for Hierarchical RGB-T Alignment and Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Spatial misregistration and cross-modal discrepancies often cause ghosting, structural blurring, and content imbalance in RGB-T fusion. Existing methods typically decouple appearance adaptation, geometric alignment, and information fusion, limiting dependency propagation across stages. We propose Source-Anchored Guidance via Frequency Equalization for Hierarchical RGB-T Alignment and Fusion (SAGE), a unified framework integrating frequency equalization, hierarchical alignment, and subband fusion. SAGE employs invertible joint encoding and source-specific low-frequency modulation to derive structural and gain guidance while preserving source information. Hierarchical frequency collaborative alignment estimates global affine geometry from low-frequency approximations and transfers geometric and contextual cues to high-frequency correlation reasoning for reliability-aware residual refinement. Guided subband fusion jointly aggregates the aligned frequency coefficients under propagated source and alignment guidance, coordinates complementary low- and high-frequency information, and reconstructs the fused image through the inverse wavelet transform. Extensive experiments on RGB-T datasets with real-world and synthetic misalignments demonstrate consistently competitive performance in alignment and fusion, validating the effectiveness of source-anchored guidance for weakly registered RGB-T images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 把 RGB-T 融合中的频率均衡、分层对齐与子带融合统一进一个框架：用可逆联合编码与源特定低频调制生成结构/增益引导，低频近似估全局仿射几何并把线索传给高频相关推理做可靠性感知残差细化，最后在引导下聚合子带系数并经逆小波变换重建。在含真实与合成错位的 RGB-T 数据集上，对齐与融合表现持续具有竞争力。
Motivation: 空间配准误差与跨模态差异会造成重影、结构模糊与内容失衡；现有方法把外观适配、几何对齐、信息融合割裂开，阶段间依赖无法传播。
Method: SAGE 由三部分组成：可逆联合编码加源特定低频调制，导出结构与增益引导并保留源信息；分层频率协同对齐，从低频近似估计全局 affine 几何，把几何与上下文线索传入高频相关推理，做可靠性感知的残差细化；引导子带融合在源与对齐引导下聚合对齐后的频率系数，协调低高频互补信息，经逆小波变换重建融合图像。
Result: 在含真实与合成错位 (misalignments) 的 RGB-T 数据集上，对齐与融合均持续表现出有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 把源信息作为锚点、让引导跨对齐与融合阶段传播，对弱配准 RGB-T 图像的对齐与融合有效。

papers.title: MM-VeriAgent: Learning to Use Extensive Tools to Verify Multimodal Misinformation with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world multimodal misinformation often involves mixed forgery sources, requiring sample-specific detection strategies. Existing tool-augmented methods rely on predefined workflows or inference-time planning, limiting adaptability or increasing inference cost. To address this issue, we introduce \textbf{MM-VeriAgent}, which learns to verify mixed-source multimodal misinformation with tools. We first build \textbf{MM-VeriTools}, a specialized toolkit for misinformation detection agents. By benchmarking various candidate models and methods on the sub-tasks required by mixed-source detection, we select the strongest for textual, visual, and cross-modal forgery analysis and encapsulate them as callable tools with a unified interface. On top of this toolkit, we train the LVLM agent with reinforcement learning to teach it how to use these tools to better solve mixed-source detection. Since many of the tools are specialized models whose online execution at every rollout severely limits RL efficiency, we further introduce \textbf{Tool-Execution Cache}, which pre-executes candidate tool calls and reuses their cached outputs during training. This preserves multi-step rollouts while reducing online tool execution, largely improving the training efficiency.Experiments on MMFakeBench demonstrate substantial accuracy gains over the base model without explicit tool search at inference time. Ablation and efficiency analyses further validate the learned tool-use policy and show that Tool-Execution Cache reduces online tool executions during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MM-VeriAgent 把混合伪造源的多模态谣言验证做成 LVLM 智能体的工具调用问题：先建 MM-VeriTools 工具集，再用强化学习训练其调用策略，并以 Tool-Execution Cache 预执行候选工具调用、复用缓存输出以提升训练效率。在 MMFakeBench 上，相比推理时不显式搜索工具的基座模型有显著准确率提升。
Motivation: 真实多模态谣言常混合多种伪造来源，需要按样本定制检测策略；现有工具增强方法依赖预定义工作流或推理时规划，前者不灵活、后者推高推理成本。
Method: 先构建 MM-VeriTools：在混合源检测各子任务上对候选模型与方法做基准测试，选出文本、视觉、跨模态伪造分析的最强者，封装为统一接口的可调用工具。再用强化学习训练 LVLM 智能体学习调用这些工具的策略；针对在线执行专用模型拖慢 RL 的问题，引入 Tool-Execution Cache 预执行候选工具调用并在训练中复用缓存输出，保留多步 rollout 的同时减少在线执行。
Result: 在 MMFakeBench 上，相比推理时不进行显式工具搜索的基座模型，准确率有大幅提升；消融与效率分析验证了学到的工具使用策略，并显示 Tool-Execution Cache 减少了训练期间的在线工具执行次数。
Conclusion: 把工具选择交给训练期学得的策略、并用缓存摊薄工具执行成本，可以在推理时不搜索工具的前提下提升混合源多模态谣言验证的准确率与训练效率。

summary_sections.method: 先构建 MM-VeriTools：在混合源检测各子任务上对候选模型与方法做基准测试，选出文本、视觉、跨模态伪造分析的最强者，封装为统一接口的可调用工具。再用强化学习训练 LVLM 智能体学习调用这些工具的策略；针对在线执行专用模型拖慢 RL 的问题，引入 Tool-Execution Cache 预执行候选工具调用并在训练中复用缓存输出，保留多步 rollout 的同时减少在线执行。
summary_sections.result: 在 MMFakeBench 上，相比推理时不进行显式工具搜索的基座模型，准确率有大幅提升；消融与效率分析验证了学到的工具使用策略，并显示 Tool-Execution Cache 减少了训练期间的在线工具执行次数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把工具选择交给训练期学得的策略、并用缓存摊薄工具执行成本，可以在推理时不搜索工具的前提下提升混合源多模态谣言验证的准确率与训练效率。

papers.title: LUMO (Lightweight Unified Multilingual Orchestrator): A Privacy Preserving Offline Voice Assistant
papers.abstract_en: Reliable voice interaction is essential in environments with limited internet connectivity and strong privacy. However, most existing voice assistants depend on cloud-based services, which leads to latency issues, dependency on internet access, and privacy vulnerabilities. This research presents LUMO (Lightweight Unified Multilingual Orchestrator), a privacy preserving offline voice assistant designed for edge computing environments. This system integrates local Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), locally deployed quantized Large Language Model (LLM), and Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis into a fully offline pipeline running on a Raspberry Pi 5 with 8 GB RAM. To enable efficient operation on resource constrained hardware, the language model is compressed using 4-bit GGUF quantization, which reduces memory usage while preserving practical conversational capability. Existing edge based voice assistants Mycroft provides partial offline functionality without a generative LLM, with an approximate latency of ~5 s and power consumption of ~12 W, while Rhasspy supports full offline operation but lacks generative capabilities, with ~3 s latency and ~11 W power usage. In contrast, LUMO achieves a Word Error Rate (WER) of 6.8% for short English utterances in low noise conditions, an end-to-end response latency of 2.0-4.0 s, and a lower peak power consumption of approximately 9.0 W. The system also achieves effective offline recognition for Bangla speech, supporting multilingual accessibility in low resource settings. By operating entirely offline, LUMO provides strong data privacy, reduced need for cloud connectivity, and suitability for privacy sensitive edge execution such as rural healthcare, education, and disaster response scenarios.

Motivation: 现有语音助手依赖云端，带来延迟、联网依赖与隐私风险；边缘设备上要在资源受限条件下同时保住生成能力、延迟与功耗。
Method: 流水线为本地 ASR + 本地部署的量化 LLM + TTS，全部离线运行于 Raspberry Pi 5（8 GB RAM）；语言模型用 4-bit GGUF 量化压缩内存，同时保留可用的对话能力。

papers.title: Threat-Aware Energy-Efficient Deployment for Dynamic UAV Networks: A Multi-Agent RL Approach
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring operational safety in threat-prone environments remains a critical challenge for multi-UAV networks serving as aerial base stations. This paper proposes an efficient framework to maximize global energy efficiency (EE) while promoting safe operation through threat-aware clustering and reward-based safety enforcement. The proposed framework is executed in three steps. First, a threat-aware K-means (TAKM) algorithm determines the minimum required UAVs and computes safe initial placements. Second, an optimal matching stage assigns physical UAVs to these centroids to minimize energy expenditure. Third, a threat-aware multi-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient (MATD3) algorithm dynamically optimizes trajectories, power, and user associations. Simulation results show that the proposed framework achieves zero observed safety violations in the considered scenarios while achieving superior EE and faster convergence than other learning methods and non-clustering baselines. Compared to heuristic optimization, the proposed framework outperforms the greedy particle swarm optimization (GPSO) and achieves performance comparable to that of the optimized PSO (OPSO), while incurring significantly lower online deployment computational complexity. Furthermore, the proposed framework demonstrates effective generalization to unseen user distributions, large UAV fleets, and different threat geometries, while maintaining zero safety violations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向威胁环境下的动态 UAV 空中基站网络，提出三步框架：威胁感知 K-means (TAKM) 定最少 UAV 数与安全初始布点，最优匹配把物理 UAV 分配到质心以省能耗，再用威胁感知 MATD3 动态优化轨迹、功率与用户关联。仿真中所考察场景零安全违规，能效与收敛速度优于学习类与非聚类基线，接近 OPSO 但在线部署计算复杂度显著更低。
Motivation: 威胁环境下的多 UAV 网络既要最大化全局能效 (EE) 又要保证安全运行，而 UAV 数量、初始布点、轨迹与关联需联合决策，纯启发式方法在线计算开销大。
Method: 三步框架：TAKM 确定最少 UAV 数并给出安全初始质心；最优匹配阶段把物理 UAV 分配到质心以最小化能耗；威胁感知 MATD3（multi-agent twin delayed DDPG）在奖励中加入安全约束，动态优化轨迹、发射功率与用户关联。
Result: 仿真所考察场景中观测到零安全违规；相比学习类与非聚类基线，EE 更优且收敛更快；相对启发式优化，优于 greedy PSO (GPSO)、性能与 optimized PSO (OPSO) 相当，而在线部署计算复杂度显著更低；对未见用户分布、更大 UAV 机队与不同威胁几何均能泛化并保持零违规。
Conclusion: 威胁感知聚类加奖励安全约束的多智能体 RL 可以在不牺牲能效的前提下把安全违规压到零，并把在线部署开销降到启发式优化之下。

papers.title: On the Limits of Univariate Deep Learning for Significant Wave Height Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: This study conducts a systematic hyperparameter search across five deep learning architectures, DLinear, LSTM, PatchTST, ResAttLstm, and Mamba2, and nine context lengths (1-168 h) for single-station significant wave height (Hs) forecasting on NDBC buoy 41009, followed by re-evaluation of the best configurations on a 47-buoy, 37-year corpus. The five families converge to a common performance level on the multi-buoy evaluation (between-family SD = 0.0014 m^2, 0.8% of the grand mean), a spread dwarfed by the 4.83x cross-dataset MSE shift between buoy corpora. All multi-buoy trials beat persistence (mean skill +0.062), but no architecture consistently outperforms the others. On the single-buoy experiment, skill peaks at 12-24 h where five trials fall below persistence, per-family Q4/Q3 test MSE ratios range from 2.4 to 2.6, and deep models underperform persistence for the most extreme 1% of waves. These findings are consistent with the interpretation that persistence already captures the dominant linear-inertial signal in univariate Hs, and that architecture engineering under this univariate input setting has reached diminishing returns: cross-buoy variance, not model class, dominates forecast error. Future work should prioritise atmospheric covariates, zero-shot cross-buoy transfer, and decomposition of Hs into swell and wind-sea components. By establishing a rigorous reference baseline for what univariate Hs models can and cannot achieve, this study provides a benchmark against which future multivariate and physics-informed approaches can be calibrated, and offers practical guidance for lightweight buoy-level forecasting in mid-latitude storm-dominated and swell-mixed environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对单站有效波高 (Hs) 做系统超参搜索：五种单变量深度模型 (DLinear、LSTM、PatchTST、ResAttLstm、Mamba2) × 九种 context length (1–168 h)，在 NDBC 41009 站训练后，把最优配置拿到 47 站、37 年语料上复评。五族模型收敛到同一水平（族间 SD 0.0014 m²，仅占总均值 0.8%），远小于跨数据集 MSE 位移 4.83 倍；单变量输入下架构工程已到收益递减，瓶颈是跨浮标差异而非模型类别。
Motivation: 单变量 Hs 预报里换架构换超参到底还能带来多少增益，缺少跨站、跨年的严格基线；若架构间差异远小于数据集间差异，继续做架构工程就是浪费。
Method: 在 NDBC buoy 41009 上对五个架构族 (DLinear、LSTM、PatchTST、ResAttLstm、Mamba2) 与九种 context length (1–168 h) 做系统超参搜索，再把最优配置在 47 浮标、37 年语料上复评；对照 persistence 基线，并按 Q4/Q3 分位与最极端 1% 浪况分层统计测试 MSE。
Result: 多浮标评测上五族模型族间 SD 0.0014 m²（占总均值 0.8%），而浮标语料间 MSE 位移达 4.83 倍；全部多浮标试验均胜过 persistence（平均 skill +0.062），但无架构持续领先。单浮标实验中 skill 在 12–24 h 达峰，有五次试验低于 persistence，各族 Q4/Q3 测试 MSE 比为 2.4–2.6，且最极端 1% 浪况下深度模型不如 persistence。
Conclusion: persistence 已捕获单变量 Hs 中主导的线性-惯性信号，单变量设定下架构工程收益递减，预报误差由跨浮标方差而非模型类别主导；后续应转向大气协变量、零样本跨浮标迁移与 Hs 的涌浪/风浪分解。
Relevance: 38
