papers.title: PixSim: a calibrated open-source simulator of instant-payment fraud, recovery and interdiction under analyst capacity constraints
papers.abstract_en: Brazil's Pix settles about 5.9 billion instant, irreversible transfers a month. A fraudulent transfer can be recovered only while the funds remain in a traceable account, and in 2025 the Central Bank's recovery mechanism (MED) returned 9% of accepted contested value. Interdiction therefore has to happen before settlement, by routing each transaction to pass, human review or block, under a finite analyst team and a regulatory hold window. To our knowledge no public simulator jointly models irreversible settlement, a regulated recovery mechanism, downstream fund dispersal and capacity-constrained review. We present PixSim, an open-source simulator of the Pix rail with these elements, calibrated to Banco Central do Brasil open data, with every parameter sourced, calibrated to one published observable, or registered as an assumption. With the model frozen, full-scale runs reproduce the 2025 recovery rate within 0.006 and its decomposition within 0.02; the February-April 2026 window is reported as a misfit and the May 2026 tracing regime as a projection. On a benchmark with a payer-side scorer, four reference policies and ten scenarios, within the simulated mule model: recovery after settlement is constrained by dispersal speed; staffing by the arrival profile cuts a fixed rule's alert expiry from 52% to 2% at constant hours; halving the team removes a fixed threshold-and-block rule's advantage over a queue-aware rule, on loss and on loss plus false-block harm (+0.106 of victim value, positive on all twenty paired seeds), while a reversal at two thirds of the team was not confirmed on independent seeds; and a synthetic scorer of held-out AUC 0.82 cuts lost value by about a quarter. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22948895
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixSim 是一个开源的巴西 Pix 即时支付欺诈仿真器，联合建模不可逆清算、监管追回机制 (MED)、下游资金扩散与分析师容量约束下的 pass/review/block 拦截决策，参数全部标注来源并校准到巴西央行公开数据。模型冻结后全尺度运行把 2025 年追回率复现到 0.006 以内、其分解复现到 0.02 以内；按到达曲线排班可把固定规则的告警过期率从 52% 降到 2%，合成评分器 (held-out AUC 0.82) 削减约四分之一损失价值。
Motivation: Pix 每月结算约 59 亿笔不可逆转账，欺诈资金只有在仍留在可追踪账户时才能追回（2025 年 MED 仅追回已受理争议金额的 9%），因此拦截必须发生在清算之前；但现有公开仿真器没有把不可逆清算、受监管追回、资金扩散与容量受限的人工审核放在同一个模型里。
Method: PixSim 作为开源仿真器实现 Pix 支付轨道：每笔交易被路由到 pass、人工审核或 block，受有限分析师团队和监管持有窗口约束；每个参数要么有出处、要么校准到一个已发布观测量、要么登记为假设，校准目标为 Banco Central do Brasil 公开数据。评测用带 payer-side 评分器的 benchmark，含 4 条参考策略与 10 个场景，损失侧含 mule 模型，比较在 20 个配对随机种子上进行。
Result: 模型冻结后全尺度运行把 2025 年追回率复现到 0.006 以内、分解复现到 0.02 以内；2026 年 2–4 月窗口作为 misfit 报告，2026 年 5 月 tracing regime 作为 projection 报告。按到达曲线排班把固定规则的告警过期率从 52% 降到 2%（工时不变）；团队减半后固定 threshold-and-block 规则相对 queue-aware 规则在损失、以及损失加误拦伤害上的优势消失（+0.106 受害者价值，20 个配对种子上全为正），而三分之二团队处的反转在独立种子上未被确认；held-out AUC 0.82 的合成评分器削减约四分之一损失价值。
Conclusion: 清算后追回受资金扩散速度限制，拦截必须前移到清算之前；审核排班按到达曲线配置比加固定阈值更省人力，而固定规则的优势对团队规模敏感，团队减半即消失。

summary_sections.motivation: Pix 每月结算约 59 亿笔不可逆转账，欺诈资金只有在仍留在可追踪账户时才能追回（2025 年 MED 仅追回已受理争议金额的 9%），因此拦截必须发生在清算之前；但现有公开仿真器没有把不可逆清算、受监管追回、资金扩散与容量受限的人工审核放在同一个模型里。
summary_sections.method: PixSim 作为开源仿真器实现 Pix 支付轨道：每笔交易被路由到 pass、人工审核或 block，受有限分析师团队和监管持有窗口约束；每个参数要么有出处、要么校准到一个已发布观测量、要么登记为假设，校准目标为 Banco Central do Brasil 公开数据。评测用带 payer-side 评分器的 benchmark，含 4 条参考策略与 10 个场景，损失侧含 mule 模型，比较在 20 个配对随机种子上进行。
summary_sections.result: 模型冻结后全尺度运行把 2025 年追回率复现到 0.006 以内、分解复现到 0.02 以内；2026 年 2–4 月窗口作为 misfit 报告，2026 年 5 月 tracing regime 作为 projection 报告。按到达曲线排班把固定规则的告警过期率从 52% 降到 2%（工时不变）；团队减半后固定 threshold-and-block 规则相对 queue-aware 规则在损失、以及损失加误拦伤害上的优势消失（+0.106 受害者价值，20 个配对种子上全为正），而三分之二团队处的反转在独立种子上未被确认；held-out AUC 0.82 的合成评分器削减约四分之一损失价值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 清算后追回受资金扩散速度限制，拦截必须前移到清算之前；审核排班按到达曲线配置比加固定阈值更省人力，而固定规则的优势对团队规模敏感，团队减半即消失。

papers.title: Structure-Guided Masked Autoencoders for Ultra-High Resolution Scientific Image Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised pre-training with Vision Transformers, including Masked Autoencoders (MAE), is difficult to apply to gigapixel scientific images. Random masking is poorly matched to the structured, multi-scale morphology of scientific data, while uniform tokenization produces prohibitively long sequences that make $O(N^2)$ attention impractical. We propose SGMA, a structure-guided masked autoencoding framework for ultra-high-resolution scientific images. SGMA couples two components: a content-adaptive quadtree tokenizer that compresses gigapixel images into a fixed-length sequence, and a structure-conditioned masking process that biases reconstruction toward spatially informative regions. To stabilize this process across scales, we introduce Damped Accumulation (DA), which aggregates signal-dependent responses across the tree into a structure canvas used to guide masking. The resulting pre-training task preserves fine microstructure while remaining compatible with standard ViT encoders and MAE-style reconstruction. Across electron microscopy, whole-slide optical microscopy, and X-ray CT datasets, SGMA consistently outperforms MAE baselines. It achieves 95.68% Dice on the 8K x 8K x 28K SpringXCT dataset, improving over the same-architecture MAE baseline by +13.00 points, and 83.21% Dice on the 32K^2 WSI PAIP dataset, improving by +16.84 points, while providing up to a 24.8x inference speedup.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SGMA 用内容自适应 quadtree tokenizer 把吉像素科学图像压成定长序列，再用结构条件化掩码把重建偏向空间信息丰富区域，从而让 MAE 预训练可用于超高分辨率科学图像。在 SpringXCT 与 PAIP 上 Dice 分别达 95.68%（较同架构 MAE +13.00 点）和 83.21%（+16.84 点），推理加速最高 24.8 倍。
Motivation: 随机掩码与科学数据的多尺度形态结构不匹配，而均匀 token 化产生的序列过长使 O(N^2) attention 在吉像素图像上不可行，MAE 类自监督预训练因此难以落地。
Method: SGMA 耦合两部分：内容自适应 quadtree tokenizer 将吉像素图像压缩为定长序列；结构条件化掩码过程偏向空间信息丰富区域。为跨尺度稳定，引入 Damped Accumulation (DA) 在树上聚合信号相关响应，构成 structure canvas 引导掩码，预训练任务兼容标准 ViT 编码器与 MAE 式重建。
Result: 在电子显微镜、全切片光学显微与 X-ray CT 数据集上均优于 MAE 基线：8K×8K×28K SpringXCT 上 Dice 95.68%，较同架构 MAE 提升 13.00 点；32K² WSI PAIP 上 Dice 83.21%，提升 16.84 点；推理加速最高 24.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把 token 化与掩码都按科学图像的结构先验定制，可在保持标准 ViT/MAE 管线不变的前提下同时提升超高分辨率分割精度与推理速度。

papers.title: Design-Ignoring versus Design-Respecting World Models for Epidemiology
papers.abstract_en: World models for epidemiology learn from records shaped by study designs, including assignment, sampling, measurement, and related processes. A model may therefore reconstruct observed trajectories while learning an intervention contrast that depends on how records were collected. We formalize study design as constraints on a world model latent-world interface, action mechanism, observation likelihood, and target readout. This distinguishes design-respecting models, which encode these constraints, from design-ignoring models, which fit selected records without relating assignment and observation to the intended intervention question. Using a large scale cluster-randomized test-negative trial, we hold the latent structure and fitting settings fixed and compare a design-ignoring case-count model with a design-respecting test-negative observation model. Both models achieve comparable factual reconstruction. Yet across 500 paired resampling experiments at different relative sampling intensity, median contrast changes are substantial for the design-ignoring model, versus merely marginal for the design-respecting model. The same qualitative separation holds when sampling also varies across clusters. Thus, factual reconstruction alone does not establish design alignment; testing whether fitted contrasts preserve design-implied observation-process invariances provides a sharper evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 流行病学 world model 若忽略研究设计（抽样、分配、检测），即使完美重建观测病例轨迹，学到的干预对比仍随相对抽样强度漂移。在大规模整群随机检测阴性试验中固定潜结构与拟合设置，500 次配对重抽样显示 design-ignoring 模型的中位对比变化显著，design-respecting 的检测阴性观测模型仅为边缘变化；跨 cluster 抽样变化时结论一致。
Motivation: 流行病学记录由分配、抽样、测量过程塑造，模型可能重建轨迹却学到依赖数据收集方式的干预对比；仅看事实重建无法判断模型是否对齐设计隐含的观测过程不变性。
Method: 把研究形式化为 world model 的四类约束：latent-world 接口、action mechanism、observation likelihood、target readout，据此区分 design-respecting 与 design-ignoring 模型；在大规模整群随机检测阴性试验 (cluster-randomized test-negative trial) 上固定潜结构与拟合设置，对比 design-ignoring 的 case-count 模型与 design-respecting 的 test-negative 观测模型，并做 500 次配对重抽样，改变相对抽样强度及跨 cluster 抽样。
Result: 两模型事实重建能力相当；500 次配对重抽样中，design-ignoring 模型的中位干预对比变化 substantial，design-respecting 模型仅 marginal；抽样强度变化与跨 cluster 抽样变化下定性分离一致。
Conclusion: 事实重建本身不能证明设计对齐；应检验拟合对比是否保持设计隐含的观测过程不变性，作为更锐利的评估标准。

papers.title: TRACE: Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation of Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to interpret evidence as it arrives, yet current evaluations often report task scores without specifying when evidence becomes valid, how visual history is maintained, or how responses are triggered. As a result, similar scores may correspond to different workloads, failure modes, and operational behavior. We introduce TRACE (Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation), a condition-aware benchmark and evaluation framework that makes these factors explicit. TRACE combines temporally audited visual tasks with evidence timing and instruction-dependent trigger annotations, a unified causal Core--Adapter protocol that controls information availability while recording actual history processing and response events, and multidimensional reporting of answer quality, timeliness, response-selection behavior, workload, completion, and reliability. On 1,240 records from 517 videos, we evaluate eight publicly available models or systems in eight configurations. We find that nearly identical QA accuracy can mask substantial differences in completion, answer validity, and generation workload, while proactive performance separates into response quality, response delay, false alarms (responses emitted while no target window is currently valid and a later one remains), and missed target windows. These results show that streaming-video performance should be interpreted as execution-conditioned system behavior rather than a single score. Our benchmark and code can be accessed at \href{https://github.com/om-ai-lab/trace-bench}{https://github.com/om-ai-lab/trace-bench}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 把流式视频理解的评测从单一 QA 分数改成条件化审计：标注证据生效时刻、视觉历史维护方式与触发条件，并用统一的 Core-Adapter 协议控制信息可用性、记录实际历史处理与响应事件。在 1,240 条记录、517 个视频上评测 8 个公开模型/系统的 8 种配置后发现，几乎相同的 QA 准确率会掩盖完成度、答案有效性和生成负载的大幅差异，主动式性能还须拆成响应质量、响应延迟、误报与漏报目标窗口。
Motivation: 流式视频评测只报任务分数，不说明证据何时生效、视觉历史如何维护、响应如何触发，导致相近分数背后可能是完全不同的工作量、失败模式和运行行为。
Method: TRACE 由三部分组成：带时间审计的视觉任务并附证据时序与指令依赖的触发标注；统一的 Core-Adapter 协议控制信息可用性同时记录真实历史处理与响应事件；多维报告覆盖答案质量、时效性、响应选择行为、负载、完成度与可靠性。
Result: 在 1,240 条记录、517 个视频上评测 8 个公开模型或系统的 8 种配置：近乎相同的 QA 准确率掩盖了完成度、答案有效性与生成负载的显著差异；主动式性能分解为响应质量、响应延迟、误报（目标窗口尚未生效且后续窗口仍有效时发出响应）与漏报目标窗口。
Conclusion: 流式视频性能应被解读为受执行条件约束的系统行为，而不是单一分数。

papers.title: StarWM: Self-Supervised Trained Attention Routing for Robust World Models
papers.abstract_en: A robust world model must strike the balance between faithfully capturing environmental dynamics and abstracting away from irrelevant content. While reconstruction-based world models ensure faithful supervision, they misallocate representational capacity by pixel area rather than dynamics relevance for visual tasks, which can cause task-irrelevant content to dominate the learned representation. Alternatively, reconstruction-free methods avoid this bias but risk discarding possibly relevant information. We propose StarWM, which uses a cross-attention module trained on self-supervised dynamics to decide where reconstruction applies. A dual-stream decoder then restricts reconstruction to the attended regions, with stop-gradient barriers preventing interference between the two objectives. These components allows reconstruction to supervise the visual content of attended regions without contaminating the latent with non-predictive information. On DeepMind Control with dynamic video backgrounds, default (reward-free) StarWM achieves the strongest performance under random-frame distractors and substantially outperforms reconstruction-based baselines under sequential video. In addition, its reward-augmented variant matches or exceeds reconstruction-free methods on sequential video, achieving the highest overall return across all distractor regimes. Mechanistic probing confirms StarWM preserves state attributes with near-perfect fidelity through long-horizon imagination while systematically discarding distractors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StarWM 用自监督动力学训练的 cross-attention 决定重建应作用于哪些区域，双流解码器只在被注意区域做重建，并用 stop-gradient 隔离两个目标，避免像素面积而非动力学相关性主导表征。在 DeepMind Control 的动态视频背景干扰下，默认（无奖励）版本在随机帧干扰下取得最强表现、在连续视频干扰下大幅超过重建式基线，其奖励增强变体在连续视频上追平或超过无重建方法，并在全部干扰体制下取得最高总回报。
Motivation: 重建式世界模型按像素面积分配表征容量，任务无关内容会主导学到的表征；完全无重建的方法虽避开该偏差，却可能丢弃本应保留的信息。
Method: StarWM 由三部分组成：在自监督动力学上训练的 cross-attention 模块决定重建施加的位置；双流解码器把重建限制在被注意区域；stop-gradient 屏障阻止两个目标相互干扰，使重建只监督被注意区域的视觉内容而不把非预测性信息污染进 latent。
Result: 在 DeepMind Control 动态视频背景设置下，默认（reward-free）StarWM 在 random-frame distractor 下表现最强，在 sequential video distractor 下大幅优于重建式基线；reward-augmented 变体在 sequential video 上追平或超过无重建方法，并在所有 distractor 体制下取得最高 overall return。机制探针 (mechanistic probing) 显示其在长程想象中以近乎完美的保真度保留状态属性，同时系统性丢弃干扰物。
Conclusion: 把重建限定在自监督注意到的区域并用 stop-gradient 隔离目标，可以让世界模型既忠实保留动力学相关状态又主动丢弃干扰内容，在多种干扰体制下同时胜过重建式与无重建式基线。

papers.title: LLM Parkinsonism: Executive-Control Failure, Token-Inefficient Persistence, and an Uncertainty-Aware Global Executive Control Architecture for Autonomous Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can plan, use tools, write code, and execute long-horizon workflows, yet strong local competence does not guarantee project-level executive control. Agents may continue acting after the original objective is satisfied, producing low-value refinements, repeated verification, and repairs to self-created complexity. We use LLM Parkinsonism as a narrowly defined, non-clinical metaphor for this pattern of persistent action despite diminishing task-level value. We argue that the problem is not explained by autoregressive next-token prediction alone, but more directly by concentrating proposal generation, scope interpretation, progress assessment, and stopping authority within the same self-conditioned loop. We therefore introduce Global Executive Control (GEC) v0.2, an uncertainty-aware governance architecture that separates action generation from project-level control. In a 24,000-episode matched-candidate benchmark under a common 40,000-token ceiling, a first-candidate baseline achieved 67.42% hard-goal success, a candidate-set local control achieved 96.53%, and GEC achieved 96.57%. The candidate-set control shows that access to multiple candidate actions explains most of the success gain; relative to that control, GEC preserved success while reducing mean token use from 19,782 to 12,574 (36.4%) and restricted mean tokens to completion at the 40,000-token ceiling from 16,136 to 13,114 (18.7%), while eliminating measured pre-completion drift and sharply reducing gross complexity. Governance-overhead sensitivity remained favorable through an additional 500 synthetic governance tokens per cycle. These mechanistic simulations support explicit governance of scope, evidence, resource use, and stopping, while live-model validation remains necessary.

papers.title: Population loss in shallow ReLU networks: Bias & families of critical points
papers.abstract_en: The main result presented is a formula for the population loss in the student-teacher kernel model that is applicable to shallow ReLU networks with bias. This extends previous work of Choo and Saul (2009) and Brutzkus and Globerson (2017). The formula makes essential use of Owen's T-function. The necessary theory of the T-function is given and a high precision coding using MPFR for the T-function, based on an algorithm of Komelj (2023), is available on request. It is shown that various families of spurious minima described in past papers of Arjevani and the author extend to biased networks and that the loss is always strictly decreased when bias is added. The change in landscape geometry caused by adding bias appears to be relatively mild. Only the simplest examples are described in this paper where it is assumed that the number of inputs is equal to the number of neurons (this restriction is for reasons of length). A review of relevant previous results on unbiased networks is included. Aside from Gaussian statistics, the main mathematical tools and ideas come from analytic geometry (analytic and subanalytic sets, the Curve Selection Lemma).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出带偏置浅层 ReLU 网络在 student-teacher kernel 模型下的 population loss 显式公式，核心工具是 Owen's T-function；并证明 Arjevani 与作者此前描述的多族伪极小点在带偏置网络中依然存在，而加入偏置后 loss 总是严格下降，损失景观几何的改变相对温和。
Motivation: Choo 与 Saul (2009)、Brutzkus 与 Globerson (2017) 的 population loss 公式只覆盖无偏置的浅层 ReLU 网络，带偏置情形下伪极小点族与景观几何是否延续缺乏刻画。
Method: 在 student-teacher kernel 模型中借助 Owen's T-function 推导带偏置浅层 ReLU 网络的 population loss 公式；T-function 理论自行给出，并基于 Komelj (2023) 算法用 MPFR 实现高精度计算（代码可索取）；伪极小点族的延续性用解析几何工具（analytic/subanalytic sets、Curve Selection Lemma）证明，另附无偏置网络已有结果综述。
Result: 证明多族伪极小点（spurious minima）从无偏置情形延续到带偏置网络，且加入偏置后 loss 严格下降；损失景观几何变化相对温和。限制在输入维数等于神经元数的最简情形，全文 118 页、3 幅图。
Conclusion: 偏置并不消除浅层 ReLU 网络已知的伪极小点族，但会使 loss 严格降低，且景观几何改变相对温和；带偏置情形的 loss 可由 T-function 精确刻画。

papers.title: Image Reconstruction from Phase with Untrained Neural Priors
papers.abstract_en: Fourier phase encodes important spatial image structure, but recovering an image without measured spectral magnitude requires additional constraints and leaves absolute intensity ambiguous. We propose a projection-based two-stage framework that combines Fourier-phase and spatial-support constraints with an image-specific neural prior. The first stage alternates constraint enforcement with regularized neural-prior updates, while the second performs phase/support refinement alone with guaranteed convergence. We evaluate two neural-prior implementations on the same 77 microscopy images and compare them with a constraint-only baseline. After 500 final refinement passes, the best-performing variant achieves 31.41 dB pooled PSNR, 35.75 dB mean PSNR, and 0.9531 mean SSIM, improving pooled PSNR by 1.51~dB and reducing pooled MSE by 29.3% relative to the baseline. The results demonstrate the benefit of combining neural guidance with explicit constraint refinement at the evaluated iteration budget, while showing that lower phase residual alone does not guarantee greater reconstruction accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于投影的两阶段框架，把 Fourier 相位约束与空间支撑约束交替施加，并配合图像专属的未训练神经先验 (untrained neural prior) 做正则更新，第二阶段只做相位/支撑精修并保证收敛。在 77 张显微图像上，500 次精修后最优变体 pooled PSNR 31.41 dB、mean PSNR 35.75 dB、mean SSIM 0.9531，较仅约束基线 pooled PSNR 提高 1.51 dB、pooled MSE 降低 29.3%；同时相位残差更低并不必然意味着重建更准。
Motivation: 只用 Fourier 相位重建图像时缺少实测谱幅度，必须引入额外约束，且绝对强度本身存在歧义；纯约束方法在固定迭代预算下精度受限。
Method: 两阶段投影框架：第一阶段在 Fourier 相位约束与空间支撑约束的强制执行之间，交替插入带正则的神经先验更新；第二阶段单独做相位/支撑精修并保证收敛。比较两种神经先验实现，并与仅施加约束的基线对照，评估用 77 张显微图像。
Result: 在 77 张显微图像上，500 次最终精修后最优变体 pooled PSNR 31.41 dB、mean PSNR 35.75 dB、mean SSIM 0.9531；相对仅约束基线 pooled PSNR 提升 1.51 dB，pooled MSE 降低 29.3%。同一评估还显示，更低的相位残差并不保证更高的重建精度。
Conclusion: 在所评估的 500 次迭代预算下，神经先验引导与显式约束精修结合能提升相位恢复精度，而相位残差不能单独作为重建质量的判据。

papers.title: DiffusionShadow: Diffusion-based Shadow Caching for Neural Volume Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) have gained momentum in scientific visualization due to their compactness and scalability to large datasets, making them well suited for integration with direct volume rendering (DVR). However, real-time volume rendering of INR with advanced illumination effects, such as shadows, remains computationally expensive, as evaluating shadow terms via ray marching is costly. Alternatively, precomputing and storing shadows for many lighting directions is prohibitive in both memory and storage. To address this, we introduce a diffusion-based shadow caching framework that compresses a vast set of pre-calculated shadow INRs into a single diffusion model. Rather than focusing on generalizing to unseen directions, our method effectively memorizes and reconstructs a dense set of pre-trained lighting conditions on the fly. We first encode a collection of shadow coefficient volumes as shadow INRs, and then train a diffusion model conditioned on lighting direction to predict the corresponding shadow INR weights at inference time. This design integrates directly with standard INR renderers without additional runtime sampling. Experiments show that our approach achieves faster rendering than traditional methods while bypassing the massive storage bloat of independent INRs, producing shadows that closely match most of the reference results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffusionShadow 把大量预计算的阴影 INR 压进一个以光照方向为条件的 diffusion 模型，推理时直接预测对应 shadow INR 权重并接入标准 INR 渲染器，无需运行时采样。渲染速度快于逐方向 ray marching 求阴影项的传统方法，同时避开独立 INR 的存储膨胀，阴影与多数参考结果接近。
Motivation: INR 体渲染要加阴影等高级光照，逐 ray marching 求阴影项太贵，而为大量光照方向预存阴影又在内存与存储上不可行。
Method: 先把一组 shadow coefficient volumes 编码为 shadow INR，再训练一个以 lighting direction 为条件的 diffusion 模型，在推理时预测该方向的 shadow INR 权重；设计为直接对接标准 INR 渲染器，不需要额外运行时采样，定位为记忆并重建密集预训练光照条件而非泛化到未见方向。
Result: 实验显示渲染速度快于传统方法，避免独立 INR 的大量存储开销，生成的阴影与多数参考结果紧密吻合。
Conclusion: 用条件 diffusion 做阴影缓存可以在保持接近参考阴影质量的同时加速 INR 体渲染并压缩存储，其路线是记忆密集预计算光照条件而非外推新方向。

papers.title: Causal Retention in Interactive Agents: Interface Factorization and Selective Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Task performance need not determine which intervention mechanism an agent retains. We study causal retention: whether a frozen learned state answers a mechanism-probe map fixed independently of training, including action, context, direct target, value, and delay. For finite structural causal model classes, the optimal probe error is a Bayes decision risk. It vanishes exactly when every learning-interface fiber lies within one probe-answer fiber; any state obtained by post-processing that interface inherits the same lower bound. A posterior-coverage theorem characterizes budgeted retesting, while an exact edit decomposition shows that the shifted set is the unique support of an error-free target update. Causal Core implements these conditions through evidence-gated writing, readout filtering, temporal credit, hidden-context setup, and local diagnostic updates. Experiments cover finite causal systems, continuous simulators, an official TD-MPC2 world model, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. A frozen Qwen last-layer probe reaches 0.958 balanced accuracy on source mechanisms but 0.583 on changed delays; the gated mechanism state reaches 1.000 and accepts only 0.056 of synchronized-readout candidates. In TD-MPC2, five target states per actuator recover effect-sign accuracy from 0.057 to 0.948 without degrading stable responses. Causal retention is therefore distinct from task sufficiency and source-domain decodability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出因果保留 (causal retention) 这一判据：冻结的学习状态能否回答与训练无关的机制探针映射（动作、上下文、直接目标、价值、延迟），并证明最优探针误差是 Bayes 决策风险，仅当每个学习接口纤维落在同一探针答案纤维内才为零。Causal Core 用证据门控写入、读出过滤、时间信用、隐藏上下文设置与局部诊断更新实现这些条件；在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上冻结末层探针在源机制上 balanced accuracy 0.958、在延迟改变后掉到 0.583，而门控机制状态达到 1.000 且只接受 0.056 的同步读出候选。
Motivation: 任务表现好并不意味着 agent 保留了正确的干预机制：状态可能在源域可解码、任务足够，却在机制改变（如延迟变化）后失效，现有评估无法区分这两者。
Method: 对有限结构因果模型类定义机制探针映射，证明最优探针误差为 Bayes 决策风险及其为零的纤维条件，并给出后验覆盖定理（预算化重测试）与精确编辑分解（移位集是无误差目标更新的唯一支撑）。据此实现 Causal Core：证据门控写入、读出过滤、时间信用、隐藏上下文设置、局部诊断更新；实验覆盖有限因果系统、连续模拟器、官方 TD-MPC2 world model 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上冻结末层探针在源机制 balanced accuracy 0.958、在改变延迟上 0.583；门控机制状态达 1.000，且只接受 0.056 的同步读出候选。TD-MPC2 中每个执行器五个目标状态使 effect-sign accuracy 从 0.057 恢复到 0.948，且不损害稳定响应。
Conclusion: 因果保留与任务充分性、源域可解码性是三件不同的事；要让状态在机制变化后仍正确，必须让学习接口的纤维结构满足探针答案纤维条件，而非只追求任务指标。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: 对有限结构因果模型类定义机制探针映射，证明最优探针误差为 Bayes 决策风险及其为零的纤维条件，并给出后验覆盖定理（预算化重测试）与精确编辑分解（移位集是无误差目标更新的唯一支撑）。据此实现 Causal Core：证据门控写入、读出过滤、时间信用、隐藏上下文设置、局部诊断更新；实验覆盖有限因果系统、连续模拟器、官方 TD-MPC2 world model 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。
summary_sections.result: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上冻结末层探针在源机制 balanced accuracy 0.958、在改变延迟上 0.583；门控机制状态达 1.000，且只接受 0.056 的同步读出候选。TD-MPC2 中每个执行器五个目标状态使 effect-sign accuracy 从 0.057 恢复到 0.948，且不损害稳定响应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 因果保留与任务充分性、源域可解码性是三件不同的事；要让状态在机制变化后仍正确，必须让学习接口的纤维结构满足探针答案纤维条件，而非只追求任务指标。

papers.title: Conditional Predictive Sufficient Statistics for Visual Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: A useful visual representation is a statistic of the observed past that retains the latent factors shared with the future and discards patch-private noise. We formalize this requirement as a conditional predictive sufficient statistic (CPSS). Under a shared-factor model of image patches, the mutual information between the past and the next patch equals the information the past carries about the shared factor, up to a remainder that the next patch itself fails to reveal. Predicting the next patch embedding with a cosine loss is maximum likelihood for a von Mises-Fisher model of that embedding's direction, and is therefore a tractable surrogate for the predictive information. The same population loss is also minimized by a constant embedding, so stop-gradient does not by itself select the sufficient statistic; it only blocks the symmetric gradient that implements the constant solution in one step. The regression target is a shallow embedding, which forces the network output back into that shallow range and leaves the sufficient statistic in intermediate blocks. Small causal Transformers on MNIST and CIFAR-10 are used as diagnostics, not as a leaderboard. On MNIST the future shift and the stop-gradient move probe accuracy by tens of points, and the CPSS readout peaks before the output. On CIFAR-10, with the same short budget and no augmentation, every objective lands near a linear classifier on pixels. What still matches the derivation is the geometry: the CPSS output is a worse readout than its best intermediate block, next-pixel regression does not pay that penalty, and removing the stop-gradient collapses the effective rank of the embedding even when the pretext loss looks perfect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉表征学习的目标形式化为条件预测充分统计量 (CPSS)：好的表征应保留过去与未来共享的潜因子、丢掉 patch 私有噪声。余弦损失预测下一 patch 嵌入等价于对嵌入方向的 von Mises-Fisher 最大似然，是预测信息的可解代理；但常数嵌入同样最小化该损失，stop-gradient 只是阻断实现常数解的对称梯度，并不选择充分统计量。诊断实验中 MNIST 上 future shift 与 stop-gradient 使 probe 精度移动数十个点，且 CPSS 读出在输出层之前就达峰。
Motivation: 视觉表征应保留与未来共享的信息、丢弃 patch 私有噪声，但现有自监督目标缺少对这一充分性要求的形式化，且无法解释 stop-gradient 与浅层回归目标各自真正起什么作用。
Method: 在图像 patch 的 shared-factor 模型下定义 CPSS，证明过去与下一 patch 的互信息等于过去对共享因子的信息（差一个下一 patch 自身无法揭示的余量）；把余弦损失的下一 patch 嵌入回归解释为 von Mises-Fisher 方向模型的最大似然，并分析常数嵌入解、stop-gradient 与浅层回归目标的作用；用 MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上的小型因果 Transformer 作诊断。
Result: MNIST 上 future shift 与 stop-gradient 使 probe 精度移动数十个点，CPSS 读出在输出层之前达峰；CIFAR-10 上在相同短预算、无数据增强时所有目标都接近像素上的线性分类器。几何层面与推导一致：CPSS 输出是比其最佳中间块更差的读出，next-pixel 回归没有这一损失，去掉 stop-gradient 会使嵌入有效秩坍缩，即使 pretext loss 看起来完美。
Conclusion: 余弦预测损失本身不足以选出充分统计量，stop-gradient 与浅层目标决定充分统计量落在中间层还是输出层；诊断应看表征几何与有效秩，而不是 pretext loss 或单一读出精度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MARCEDES: Score-based causal discovery under non-Gaussianity with continuous optimization
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning the underlying causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) structure corresponding to a structural equation model (SEM) with non-Gaussian errors. Motivated by an intentionally misspecified non-Gaussian SEM with all Laplace errors, we first introduce the mean absolute residual risk, defined over the space of all real matrices, and show that, asymptotically, the risk of the true weighted causal DAG matrix is strictly smaller than that of any other matrix. Nevertheless, to enhance generality and account for high-dimensional and finite-sample settings, we further incorporate row-specific sparsity penalties along with a soft DAG constraint to derive a continuous score function over the space of real matrices. Accordingly, we propose a score-based DAG learning method, named MARCEDES, formulated as an unconstrained score minimization problem, which can be efficiently solved using gradient-based optimization techniques, thereby circumventing the challenges associated with constrained optimization. Furthermore, we develop a computational algorithm to handle the non-smoothness of the score objective and to enable optimal tuning of row-specific sparsity penalties under a generalized Bayes framework. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency and improved performance of the proposed method over existing approaches through an extensive simulation study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARCEDES 在非高斯误差的结构方程模型 (SEM) 上做因果 DAG 学习：以 Laplace 误差下定义在全体实矩阵空间的平均绝对残差风险为理论基础，证明真实加权因果 DAG 矩阵的风险渐近严格小于任何其他矩阵，再加入逐行稀疏惩罚与软 DAG 约束得到连续可微的 score，作为无约束最小化问题用梯度法求解。仿真研究显示其效率与性能优于现有方法。
Motivation: 非高斯误差下学习因果 DAG 通常要处理离散或带约束的组合优化，高维有限样本时更难用梯度方法直接求解。
Method: 先在全 Laplace 误差的故意误设 SEM 下定义 mean absolute residual risk 并证明真实 DAG 矩阵渐近风险最小；再叠加 row-specific sparsity penalty 与 soft DAG 约束，导出实矩阵空间上的连续 score 函数，作为无约束 score 最小化用梯度优化求解；针对目标非光滑另设计计算算法，并在 generalized Bayes 框架下做逐行惩罚的最优调参。
Result: 理论结果：真实加权因果 DAG 矩阵的 mean absolute residual risk 渐近严格小于任意其他矩阵。实验为一项 extensive simulation study，显示 MARCEDES 相比现有因果发现方法具有效率与改进的性能。
Conclusion: 把非高斯 SEM 的因果发现改写成实矩阵空间上的连续无约束 score 最小化，可绕开约束优化的困难并用梯度法高效求解，同时在高维有限样本下靠逐行稀疏惩罚与 generalized Bayes 调参保持竞争力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Framework for Identifying, Categorizing, and Explaining Bias in AI-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become integrated into software development workflows, concerns regarding unintentional biases in AI-generated code. Although evidence suggests these biases exist, limited research has systematically identified, categorized, and explained them. This study investigates bias in AI-generated code and evaluates whether LLMs can reliably identify and explain it through a taxonomy-driven framework. We extended an existing dataset of biased AI-generated Python code and manually annotated snippets with bias categories and human-authored justifications to establish a ground-truth dataset. Using this dataset, we evaluated proprietary and open-source LLMs as automated bias detection and justification systems through ICL. Finally, we analyzed similarity between LLM-generated explanations and human-authored justifications using structured justification and code identification metrics. Our findings demonstrate that LLMs can effectively support code bias identification and explanation. Gemini achieved 80.14% classification accuracy, with 84.0% precision and 95.7% recall, while the best open-source alternative, Qwen3-coder, achieved 82.45% accuracy, 68.64% precision, and 80.22% recall. Additionally, the models achieved justification similarity scores of 80.4% and 80.14%, respectively, relative to human-authored reasoning, and code identification similarity scores of 86.0% and 87.82%. These results suggest that LLMs can detect biased logic in generated Python code and produce explanations that substantially align with expert interpretations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由分类体系驱动的 AI 生成代码偏差识别与解释框架：扩展现有含偏差的 Python 代码数据集并人工标注偏差类别与人类理由作为 ground truth，再用 in-context learning (ICL) 让专有与开源 LLM 做自动检测和理由生成。Gemini 分类准确率 80.14%（precision 84.0%、recall 95.7%），最佳开源模型 Qwen3-coder 准确率 82.45%（precision 68.64%、recall 80.22%），说明 LLM 能检出生成代码中的偏差逻辑并与专家解释高度对齐。
Motivation: LLM 已进入软件开发流程，生成代码中存在非有意偏差，但缺少系统化的识别、分类与解释研究，也没有可用的 ground-truth 标注集。
Method: 扩展现有含偏差的 AI 生成 Python 代码数据集，人工标注偏差类别与人类撰写的理由构成 ground truth；用 ICL 评测专有与开源 LLM 作为自动偏差检测与理由生成系统，并用结构化理由相似度与代码识别相似度指标衡量 LLM 解释与人类理由的一致性。
Result: Gemini 分类准确率 80.14%、precision 84.0%、recall 95.7%；Qwen3-coder 准确率 82.45%、precision 68.64%、recall 80.22%。两者理由相似度分别为 80.4% 与 80.14%，代码识别相似度分别为 86.0% 与 87.82%（相对人类撰写的理由）。
Conclusion: LLM 能有效支持代码偏差的识别与解释，其生成的解释与专家解读高度一致，可作为自动偏差检测与理由生成系统使用。

papers.title: Support-Compiled Feature Folding: More Evidence at Lower Memory Across Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Wide tables offer tabular foundation models more evidence, but accessing it can exhaust their memory: full-width pairwise mixing grows quadratically with the number of columns, while feature selection makes inputs affordable by discarding evidence. We ask whether using more features requires interacting over all of them at once. We introduce Support-Compiled Feature Folding (SCFF), a training-free inference framework that encodes wide tables through bounded calls to a frozen backbone. SCFF organizes support-ranked features into a strong Core and a candidate Tail, folds them into narrow feature groups, and support-checks the Tail's added evidence before a single contextual prediction. This converts quadratic feature-interaction work into linear-in-width work with a bounded local working set, without ensembling predictions or training new parameters. On the exhaustive 18-dataset wide-table slice of fixed AMLB-29, TabZilla, and TabArena snapshots, SCFF improves dataset-macro accuracy and NLL on all six evaluated backbones. All four matched-width comparisons retain favorable 95% dataset-bootstrap intervals on locked folds, with relative error reductions up to 26.1%. Median paired GPU-memory savings are 2.09-2.36x, and the ratio of separately observed maximum peaks reaches 34.3x. Under a measured peak-memory ceiling, SCFF uses the saved budget to preserve more support-selected evidence, improving accuracy by 4.06 and 3.72 points over the widest feasible single leaf on predeclared wide-Core strata of TabICLv2 and TabPFN-3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCFF 是面向宽表表格基础模型的免训练推理框架：按 support 排序把特征分成 Core 与候选 Tail，折叠成窄特征组并对 Tail 的增量证据做 support 检查，再做一次上下文预测，把二次方的特征交互开销降为线性宽度开销且工作集有界。在 AMLB-29、TabZilla、TabArena 固定快照的 18 数据集宽表切片上，六个 backbone 的宏平均准确率与 NLL 全部提升，相对误差降幅最高 26.1%，配对 GPU 显存中位数节省 2.09–2.36x。
Motivation: 宽表给表格基础模型更多证据，但全宽两两混合的开销随列数二次增长，特征选择虽让输入可负担却直接丢弃证据；需要在不牺牲证据的前提下把显存与交互开销压下来。
Method: 免训练推理框架 SCFF：把 support 排序特征组织为强 Core 与候选 Tail，折叠成窄特征组，对 Tail 新增证据做 support 检查后再做单次上下文预测；不集成预测也不训练新参数，通过有界次数调用冻结 backbone 编码宽表。
Result: 在固定 AMLB-29、TabZilla、TabArena 快照的穷举 18 数据集宽表切片上，SCFF 在全部六个评估 backbone 上同时提升数据集宏平均准确率与 NLL；四组匹配宽度比较在锁定折上 95% 数据集 bootstrap 区间均保持有利，相对误差降幅最高 26.1%；配对 GPU 显存中位数节省 2.09–2.36x，分别观测到的最大峰值之比达 34.3x；在实测峰值显存上限下，SCFF 用省下的预算保留更多 support 选中证据，在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-3 预先声明的宽 Core 分层上比最宽可行单叶准确率高 4.06 与 3.72 个百分点。
Conclusion: 同时交互全部特征并非必要：折叠加 support 检查能在有界显存下保留更多证据，从而在冻结表格基础模型上同时提高准确率、降低 NLL 并大幅压低显存峰值。

summary_sections.result: 在固定 AMLB-29、TabZilla、TabArena 快照的穷举 18 数据集宽表切片上，SCFF 在全部六个评估 backbone 上同时提升数据集宏平均准确率与 NLL；四组匹配宽度比较在锁定折上 95% 数据集 bootstrap 区间均保持有利，相对误差降幅最高 26.1%；配对 GPU 显存中位数节省 2.09–2.36x，分别观测到的最大峰值之比达 34.3x；在实测峰值显存上限下，SCFF 用省下的预算保留更多 support 选中证据，在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-3 预先声明的宽 Core 分层上比最宽可行单叶准确率高 4.06 与 3.72 个百分点。

papers.title: Transferable Evidence Reconstruction for Longitudinal Glucose Representations
papers.abstract_en: Long physiological recordings contain many routine measurements, while predictive information often lies in rare events, sustained burden, and recurring patterns. These properties can be computed as label-free evidence, but directly using them as features leaves limited labeled data to separate reproducible associations from sample-specific ones. Learning to reconstruct evidence can exploit unlabeled recordings, yet joint reconstruction does not explicitly require the decoding rule to transfer across individuals. We introduce transferable evidence reconstruction (TER): a Ridge regressor fits evidence from representations in one group and predicts it in an identity-disjoint group without refitting. The transfer error trains the encoder through the differentiable fit. For continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), clock-aware encoding preserves the multi-day content and timing needed for evidence recovery. Matched interventions connect the gains to reduced fitting-group sensitivity, with structured targets improving on raw recovery. Across ten leading CGM and time-series baselines, TER sets a new best metric on 12/14 phenotype tasks and exceeds the strongest prior overall PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 by 4.95/4.43/0.66 percentage points; the PR-AUC and ROC-AUC gains are $2.6\times$ and $2.2\times$ the respective gaps between the two strongest baselines. Meal-response and future-CGM studies further demonstrate predictive utility. TER thus uses meaningful signal properties to supervise not only what a representation preserves, but how reliably it can be read across individuals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可迁移证据重构 (Transferable Evidence Reconstruction, TER)：用 Ridge 回归从一组个体的表征拟合无标签证据并在身份不相交的组上不重训地预测，迁移误差经可微拟合反传训练编码器。在连续血糖监测 (CGM) 上，TER 在 14 项表型任务中的 12 项刷新十个基线的最佳指标，整体 PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 分别高出最强先前方法 4.95/4.43/0.66 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程生理记录的预测信息集中在罕见事件与持续负担等可无标签计算的证据上，但直接当特征会耗尽标注；联合重构又不约束解码规则跨个体迁移。
Method: TER 用 Ridge 回归在一组个体的表征上拟合证据，并在 identity-disjoint 组上不重训预测，迁移误差经可微拟合训练编码器；CGM 用 clock-aware 编码保留多日内容与时序，配合结构化目标而非原始恢复。
Result: 在十个领先 CGM 与时间序列基线上，TER 在 14 项表型任务中 12 项取得新最佳指标，整体 PR-AUC/ROC-AUC/Macro-F1 超出最强先前方法 4.95/4.43/0.66 个百分点，其中 PR-AUC 与 ROC-AUC 的提升是两个最强基线之间差距的 2.6 倍与 2.2 倍；餐后反应与未来 CGM 研究显示预测效用。
Conclusion: 用可跨个体读出的证据属性监督表征，比只监督表征保留了什么更能得到可迁移的生理表征。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: NS-ATTENTION: Newton-Schulz Transformations of Attention Outputs in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Newton-Schulz (NS) iteration has recently been used in the Muon optimizer to transform update matrices during the training of large language models. Motivated by its spectral effect, we investigate applying NS directly to Transformer attention representations. We introduce Newton-Schulz Attention (NS-Attn.), a parameter-free transformation applied to the output of each attention head. Each head output is arranged as a feature-by-token matrix and normalized by its Frobenius norm. We then apply a finite NS polynomial step and restore the original norm. The objective is to reduce spectral concentration and increase effective rank before standard head merging and output projection. Across ViT and Swin on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, NS-Attn. improves final-epoch accuracy in all 12 matched-seed comparisons, with mean gains of 0.25--0.83 percentage points. ViT ablations show higher mean accuracy with one iteration than with two. Spectral analysis further shows reduced leading-eigenvalue concentration and increased effective rank. These gains incur additional inference latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Muon 优化器里的 Newton-Schulz 迭代直接搬到 Transformer 注意力输出上：对每个注意力头的输出按 feature-by-token 排列、Frobenius 归一化后做有限 NS 多项式一步再还原范数，以降低谱集中、抬高有效秩。在 ViT 与 Swin 上 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 的 12 组同种子对比中全部提升，平均增益 0.25–0.83 个百分点，且一次迭代优于两次。
Motivation: 注意力头输出存在主特征值过度集中的问题，导致有效秩偏低；NS 迭代此前只在 Muon 中用于变换更新矩阵，其谱效应尚未直接作用于注意力表征本身。
Method: 提出参数无关的 NS-Attn.：将每个注意力头输出排成 feature-by-token 矩阵，用 Frobenius 范数归一化，施加一次有限 Newton-Schulz 多项式步，再恢复原范数，插在标准 head merging 与输出投影之前；在 ViT 和 Swin 上做 CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 同种子配对比较，并做迭代次数消融与谱分析。
Result: 在 ViT 与 Swin、CIFAR-10 与 CIFAR-100 上，NS-Attn. 在全部 12 组同种子配对比较中都提升最终 epoch 准确率，平均增益 0.25–0.83 个百分点；ViT 消融显示一次迭代的平均准确率高于两次；谱分析显示主特征值集中度下降、有效秩上升；代价是额外推理延迟。
Conclusion: 对注意力头输出做一次参数无关的 Newton-Schulz 变换即可通过降低谱集中、提高有效秩带来一致的准确率提升，但会增加推理延迟，且迭代次数不宜超过一次。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Do Tabular Foundation Models Compute In Context? In-Situ Representation Refinement through Attention-Gated Updates
papers.abstract_en: A tabular foundation model must discover which distinctions matter for each new table without updating its parameters. We develop in-situ representation refinement: support labels guide changes to the episode's representations, improving the information available to later queries. A regularized leave-one-out objective yields a support correction and its query extension. The leading term separates attention-based reading from state-dependent scaling, motivating RefineICL: an attention-gated, FFN-free contextual stack with selected low-rank feature interaction and typed memory. A direct intervention tests the role of evolving support states: removing one intermediate support update while preserving the block's query output increases final query cross-entropy in all 72 tested episodes. RefineICL-L24 reaches 0.93836 OVR-AUC and 0.87173 accuracy on AMLB29. A benchmark-informed continuation reaches 1644.8 Elo on the 38-dataset TabArena snapshot, 31.4 Elo above TabPFN-3 under the same evaluation. It also improves all four reported metrics over TabPFN-v3 on both TabZilla views. In a matched 100K-update depth grid, an expanded FFN gives no consistent validation benefit and uses 60.2% more peak inference memory at L8. These results connect learning within a forward pass to representation refinement and show how this view guides a competitive, memory-efficient model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model) 无需更新参数即可为新表自适应：提出 in-situ representation refinement，用 support 标签经正则化 leave-one-out 目标产生 support correction 与 query 扩展，并据此设计 attention-gated、无 FFN 的 RefineICL 栈。在 AMLB29 上 RefineICL-L24 达 0.93836 OVR-AUC、0.87173 accuracy；38 数据集 TabArena 上 1644.8 Elo，比同评估下的 TabPFN-3 高 31.4 Elo。
Motivation: 表格基础模型必须在不更新参数的前提下判断每张新表里哪些区分是重要的；作者把前向过程中的学习重新表述为表示精化问题。
Method: in-situ representation refinement：support 标签引导 episode 内表示变化，正则化 leave-one-out 目标给出 support correction 及其 query 扩展；主导项区分 attention-based reading 与 state-dependent scaling，由此导出 RefineICL——attention-gated、FFN-free 的 contextual stack，带选定的 low-rank feature interaction 与 typed memory。另做一次直接干预：在保持 block query 输出不变时移除一个中间 support 更新。
Result: 干预实验中移除单个中间 support 更新使全部 72 个测试 episode 的最终 query cross-entropy 上升。RefineICL-L24 在 AMLB29 上 0.93836 OVR-AUC、0.87173 accuracy；benchmark-informed continuation 在 38 数据集 TabArena snapshot 上 1644.8 Elo，比同评估的 TabPFN-3 高 31.4 Elo；在 TabZilla 两个视图上均优于 TabPFN-v3 的全部四项报告指标。匹配 100K-update 深度网格中，扩展 FFN 无一致验证收益，且 L8 峰值推理内存多用 60.2%。
Conclusion: 前向过程内的学习可理解为表示精化，attention-gated 而非 FFN 扩展的路径能在更省内存的条件下保持竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NV-Reason-CT: 3D Visual Language Model for CT Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present NV-Reason-CT, a generative vision--language model for chest and abdominal CT combining native 3D visual encoding with radiologist-guided reasoning. The model couples a native 3D vision transformer with a language model, passing all visual tokens and their explicit 3D coordinates into language decoding without further spatial token merging. This retains volumetric spatial information within the vision encoder and through the language model's positional encoding during joint processing with text. We train on a curated corpus of approximately 550,000 multimodal instruction examples from 70,111 unique CT image inputs, combining standardized reports, abnormality-focused and anatomy-specific questions, multi-turn interactions, and radiologist-authored reasoning from recorded and transcribed expert CT interpretations. Expert annotations provide direct supervision and guide additional report-grounded synthetic reasoning. End-to-end supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), with verifiable rewards over chest and abdominal abnormality sets. The model supports abnormality classification, report generation, and interactive reasoning with reviewable observations, differential diagnoses, and uncertainty. Evaluation spans public CT benchmarks and a held-out NIH cohort. On CT-RATE, NV-Reason-CT achieves a macro-F1 of 0.614 and macro-AUROC of 0.871 without a task-specific classification head; generated reports achieve a report-derived macro-F1 of 0.592. In a preliminary study with expert radiologists, AI-assisted review received favorable confidence ratings and was associated with a 50% reduction in average reported interpretation and reporting time. We release the model and training code to support reproducible research on explainable AI for volumetric medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NV-Reason-CT 是面向胸腹部 CT 的生成式视觉-语言模型，用原生 3D vision transformer 直接把全部视觉 token 及其 3D 坐标送入语言解码，不做空间 token 合并，再经 SFT 与 GRPO（对胸腹异常集合设可验证奖励）训练。在 CT-RATE 上无任务专用分类头即达 macro-F1 0.614、macro-AUROC 0.871，生成报告的 report-derived macro-F1 为 0.592；专家放射科医生初步研究中 AI 辅助阅片平均解读与报告时间下降 50%。
Motivation: CT 体积数据在进入语言模型前常被压平或合并空间 token，体积信息丢失，且医学 VLM 的推理过程对放射科医生不可审查。
Method: 原生 3D vision transformer 与语言模型耦合，全部视觉 token 连同显式 3D 坐标经位置编码进入语言解码；训练语料约 550,000 条多模态指令、来自 70,111 个唯一 CT 输入，含标准化报告、异常与解剖定向问题、多轮交互及放射科医生撰写的推理；流程为端到端 SFT 后接 GRPO，奖励为胸腹异常集合上的可验证奖励。
Result: CT-RATE 上 macro-F1 0.614、macro-AUROC 0.871（无任务专用分类头），生成报告 report-derived macro-F1 0.592；评测覆盖公开 CT 基准与留出 NIH 队列；专家放射科医生初步研究中 AI 辅助阅片获正面信心评分，平均解读与报告时间下降 50%。
Conclusion: 保留体积空间信息并配合可审查的推理链，可在不加分类头的情况下支撑异常分类、报告生成与交互式推理，并明显缩短放射科医生的阅片与报告时间；模型与训练代码开源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Hierarchical GNNs for power flow: letting physics shape the hierarchy
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical latent communication improves the generalization of a power-flow model, shared across three grids, to new operating scenarios. The module exchanges information through two reduced graphs inside the corrective network of GENCO, replacing two of its local correction steps. We compare Kron-derived transports, a same-anchor Quotient construction and the flat GENCO Base architecture, all trained under one protocol of our own with about a hundred times fewer optimizer updates per grid than GENCO's reference training: 200 epochs on three grid topologies, fewer than 1,900 training scenarios per grid and three initialization seeds per model. Evaluation uses 200 newly generated, preselected scenarios per grid. On the training topologies, Kron reaches a macro family-balanced voltage error of $0.851\pm0.110$, 51.3% below a per-bus mean fitted on training solutions (1.747). Kron is below this reference on 98.5% of the 600 fresh scenarios, and both hierarchical models outperform it on every training topology in all three seeds. The flat baseline reaches $5.660\pm0.899$ and does not outperform the reference on any training topology, so Kron's 85.0% reduction relative to it compares architectures within our training regime. Kron is also 31.0% below Quotient ($1.235\pm0.225$). These results demonstrate generalization across operating scenarios within the studied topologies, with one set of learned parameters shared across grids. On two topologies unseen in training, the current models do not yet outperform the fitted reference in calibrated transfer; extrapolation to new topologies is the next development objective.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Hyperbolic Residual-Quantized Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Residual Vector Quantization turns continuous representations into discrete, multi-level token sequences. Yet most methods operate in Euclidean space, despite the coarse-to-fine structure of the resulting codes and the latent hierarchies present in many data domains. Hyperbolic geometry offers a natural alternative for hierarchical representations, but naive hyperbolic extensions introduce geometric inconsistencies: non-associative hyperbolic addition prevents consistent residual aggregation, while standard straight-through gradient estimation ignores the geometry of the latent space. We propose a geometry-aware hyperbolic residual quantization that addresses these issues in both the forward and backward passes. In the forward pass, Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation restores the telescoping behavior of residual quantization on the Poincare ball. In the backward pass, a discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator routes the reconstruction gradient through the quantizer as a single geometric block, avoiding unstable recursive gradient transport across residual stages. Evaluations on hierarchical prediction, recommendation, image tokenization, and neural audio coding tasks show that our method improves the stability and structural organization of hyperbolic residual codes over naive hyperbolic baselines. At the same time, we observe a clear structure-compression trade-off: Euclidean residual quantization remains preferable for pure compression, while geometry-aware hyperbolic quantization is most useful for hierarchically organized discrete latent spaces.
papers.comment: 14-page main paper (30 pages total with references and appendix), 3 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at the Beyond Euclidean Workshop, ECCV 2026 (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把残差量化 (Residual Vector Quantization) 搬到 Poincaré 球上时，前向的双曲加法不满足结合律会破坏残差的 telescoping 结构，反向的标准 straight-through 估计又忽略隐空间几何。本文提出几何感知的双曲残差量化：前向用 Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation 恢复 telescoping，反向用折扣式 Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator 把重建梯度作为单一几何块穿过量化器。在层次预测、推荐、图像 token 化与神经音频编码上，双曲残差码的稳定性与结构组织优于朴素双曲基线，但存在明确的结构-压缩权衡：纯压缩仍以欧氏残差量化为佳。
Motivation: 残差量化把连续表示压成多层离散 token，但现有方法都在欧氏空间，浪费了码字的 coarse-to-fine 层次与数据本身的隐层结构；直接做双曲扩展会因非结合的双曲加法与几何不匹配的梯度估计而失效。
Method: 前向通道用 Hyperbolic Residual Aggregation 在 Poincaré 球上恢复残差量化的 telescoping 行为；反向通道用 discounted Hyperbolic Straight-Through Estimator，把重建梯度经量化器作为单个几何块回传，避免跨残差阶段的递归梯度传输不稳定。
Result: 在层次预测、推荐、图像 token 化和神经音频编码四类任务上，该方法相对朴素双曲基线提升了双曲残差码的稳定性与结构组织；同时观察到清晰的结构-压缩权衡：纯压缩场景欧氏残差量化仍更优，几何感知双曲量化更适合层次组织的离散隐空间。
Conclusion: 双曲几何只有在前向聚合与反向梯度都按几何一致的方式处理时才对层次化离散码有用；是否采用取决于任务更看重结构组织还是纯压缩率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Scalable Minimum-Volume Simplex Estimation with Non-asymptotic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We study the estimation of a $K$-dimensional simplex from $N$ i.i.d.\ points sampled uniformly from its interior; the observations are convex combinations of $K+1$ unknown prototypes. Existing polynomial-time estimators need cubic per-sample work or $O(NK)$ storage and are impractical at $N\sim 10^6$--$10^8$. We propose DeepMVSA, which re-expresses the minimum-volume principle in neural implicit form: a lightweight coordinate network generates the mixing weights and a triangular LU-type parameterization the dual simplex matrix, reducing the trainable-state memory to $O(K^2)$, independent of $N$, and the cost per data pass to $O(NK^2)$. We prove a non-asymptotic sample-complexity bound of the polynomial-time benchmark order for a localized surrogate estimator; an oracle inequality for every global minimizer of the neural objective, with volume-inflation control and an explicit shrinkage bias; a conditional end-to-end error budget separating statistical, approximation, optimization, and enclosure-residual terms on an explicit envelope event; and two-point lower bounds: at any noise level $σ>0$ fixed independently of $N$, the $N^{-1/2}$ scaling is unimprovable in its $N$-exponent. Experiments with up to $N=10^8$ synthetic observations are consistent with the predicted accuracy and scaling, and feasibility on real scenes of $\sim 10^7$ pixels is demonstrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepMVSA 把最小体积单纯形估计 (minimum-volume simplex estimation) 改写成神经隐式形式：轻量坐标网络生成混合权重、LU 型三角参数化对偶单纯形矩阵，把可训练状态内存降到 O(K^2)（与 N 无关）、单样本代价降到 O(NK^2)。给出非渐近样本复杂度界、oracle 不等式与端到端误差预算，并证明在 σ>0 固定时 N^{-1/2} 的 N 指数不可改进；实验做到 N=10^8 合成观测与约 10^7 像素真实场景。
Motivation: 现有多项式时间单纯形估计器每样本代价为立方级或需 O(NK) 存储，在 N~10^6–10^8 规模不可用；需要在保持统计保证的同时把内存与单遍代价压到与 N 解耦。
Method: 以神经隐式形式重写最小体积原理：轻量坐标网络输出混合权重，三角 LU 型参数化生成对偶单纯形矩阵，可训练状态内存 O(K^2)、每数据遍历 O(NK^2)。理论侧给出局部替代估计器的非渐近样本复杂度界（达到多项式时间基准量级）、神经目标全局极小值的 oracle 不等式（含体积膨胀控制与显式收缩偏差），以及在显式包络事件上分离统计、逼近、优化、enclosure-residual 四项的条件端到端误差预算。
Result: 在任意固定噪声水平 σ>0（独立于 N）下，N^{-1/2} 标度的 N 指数不可改进（two-point lower bound）。最多 N=10^8 合成观测的实验与预测精度和标度一致，并在约 10^7 像素的真实场景上演示可行性。
Conclusion: 神经参数化加三角对偶单纯形约束可以在 O(K^2) 内存下把最小体积单纯形估计推到 10^8 观测规模，同时保留非渐近统计保证与不可改进的 N^{-1/2} 收敛速率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Hill Sampling for Test-Time Scaling: A Simple and Better Alternative to Repeated Sampling, Evolution, and Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can improve solutions to verifiable scientific and algorithmic problems by spending additional computation at test time. Recent systems achieve strong results with increasingly elaborate evolutionary search harnesses or by updating model parameters during test-time training. We ask how much of this machinery is necessary. We introduce Hill Sampling, a form of hill-climbing optimization that repeatedly samples candidate programs from a frozen LLM, retains the best program found so far, and conditions all subsequent samples on that program. We evaluate the method on circle packing, sums and differences of sets, and Erdos' minimum-overlap problem using three open-weight models. Hill Sampling sets a new state of the art on circle packing among published methods, improves over the AlphaEvolve reference on Erdos' minimum-overlap problem, and achieves strong results on sums and differences of finite sets. The circle-packing and Erdos results require only hours of wall-clock time on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. We compare Hill Sampling against what is, to our knowledge, the largest application by parameter count of evolution strategies (ES) to LLM weights at test time. Surprisingly, when evaluating a method by the best program it generates, we find that learning model weights via ES is worse than invoking ES with a learning rate set to zero, i.e., using random weight-space perturbations to search for better models. Moreover, repeated sampling outperforms both ES methods, and Hill Sampling is the strongest of all. These results suggest a simple test-time compute allocation strategy: repeatedly sample edits to the best verified solution found so far before introducing additional complexity, such as adding archives, diversity mechanisms, evolutionary scaffolds, or test-time parameter learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hill Sampling 是一种对冻结 LLM 反复采样候选程序、保留当前最优并以其为条件继续采样的爬山式 test-time scaling 方法。在 circle packing、集合和差问题、Erdos minimum-overlap 问题上，它以 8 张 H100 数小时的开销取得 circle packing 已发表方法的新 SOTA，并优于 AlphaEvolve 参照；对比最大规模的 ES 测试时权重更新时，ES 学权重反而不如学习率为零的随机权重扰动，重复采样又胜过两者 ES，Hill Sampling 最强。
Motivation: 测试时提升可验证问题的解质量通常依赖复杂的进化搜索脚手架或测试时训练更新参数，作者追问这些机制究竟有多少是必需的。
Method: Hill Sampling：从冻结 LLM 反复采样候选程序，保留迄今最优程序，并把后续所有采样都以该程序为条件；在 circle packing、sums and differences of sets、Erdos' minimum-overlap 问题上用三个 open-weight 模型评测，并与进化策略 (ES) 测试时权重学习（按参数量计为最大规模应用）对比。
Result: circle packing 上达到已发表方法的新 SOTA；Erdos minimum-overlap 上优于 AlphaEvolve 参照；sums and differences of finite sets 上结果强。circle packing 与 Erdos 结果只需 8 张 NVIDIA H100 数小时墙钟时间。按生成的最优程序评判时，用 ES 学权重差于学习率设为零的 ES（即随机权重空间扰动），重复采样胜过两种 ES 方法，Hill Sampling 最强。
Conclusion: 测试时算力应先反复采样编辑当前最优已验证解，再考虑引入 archive、多样性机制、进化脚手架或测试时参数学习这类额外复杂度。

papers.title: Detecting Agitation Before Behavioral Escalation in Autistic Youth Through Multimodal Wearable Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Challenging behaviors including aggression, self-injury, and property destruction are observed in 68% of autistic youth and pose risks to youth and caregivers. These episodes are preceded by agitation, a rising state of distress expressed through movement, vocalization, and autonomic arousal. Its signs are subtle and individualized, and its autonomic components are invisible without instrumentation. We collected upper-body movement from inertial measurement units, physiology from a wrist-worn device, and vocalizations from lapel microphones across 30 clinician-led sessions with 15 autistic youth, paired with expert behavioral annotations. We adapt four pretrained foundation models, one per modality, project each to a shared 128-dimensional space, and fuse them into a single group model. The model detected agitation with an area under the ROC curve of 0.724 at the clinician-annotated onset (within-participant permutation p=0.0005), declining to 0.608 at 30,s before onset. Thirteen of fifteen participants were above chance. A from-scratch configuration reached only 0.58, while frozen and fine-tuned features performed comparably (0.71 and 0.72). Audio contributed most of the signal, and a watch-only configuration stayed near chance. Individualized agitation is therefore detectable, including in unannotated windows preceding the annotated onset, using foundation-model transfer with one shared model rather than one per child.

papers.title: Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $γ$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Bellman 最优性的线性规划刻画提升到 (Q,V) 联合空间，得到每个约束只涉及数据集内状态-动作对的 Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP)，再松弛成 hinge 惩罚实现为 ALBUM：单 critic、无 target network 与 EMA、无对 bootstrap 目标的平方回归。在 OGBench 上 ALBUM 以 Gaussian policy 匹配 FQL 的平均性能、可比于近期 action-chunking 方法，同时参数量最少、峰值 GPU 显存最低。
Motivation: Offline RL 的 critic 通常靠对 bootstrap 目标做回归并用 EMA target network 稳定，多步目标还必须做 off-policy 修正；这条管线引入额外机制且开销不小。
Method: LBLP 把 Bellman 最优性的线性规划刻画提升到联合 (Q,V) 空间，使全部不等式约束只用数据集内的状态-动作对；沿数据轨迹 K 段的约束不改变唯一极小点。再把约束松弛为 hinge 惩罚（表格情形下惩罚系数超过有限阈值即恢复同一解），用神经网络实现为 ALBUM，对 K 步 rollout 目标做 stop gradient。
Result: 理论：唯一极小点即 in-sample 最优对，对任意 rollout 策略与 horizon 不变；确定性动力学下该解位于数据集最优回报与最优值之间；hinge 松弛在表格情形超过有限惩罚系数即给出同一解；在系数条件（与 γ、K 无关）下该解是 detached 更新的驻点。实验在 OGBGench 上：ALBUM 平均性能匹配 FQL、可比于近期 action-chunking 方法，且在所有对比方法中参数量最少、峰值 GPU 显存最低。
Conclusion: 把 Bellman 约束写成不等式并松弛，可以去掉 target network、EMA 与 off-policy 修正，同时让数据轨迹上的折扣回报直接充当下界；代价是性能只是与 FQL 持平而非超越。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Explainable Predictive Condition-based Maintenance of Naval-Propulsion Systems using Fuzzy Logic
papers.abstract_en: The shipping industry has a significant impact on the global economy, emphasizing the need for operational availability and safety through the use of effective maintenance techniques. During the last decades, predictive maintenance (PdM) has emerged as a promising solution compared to the existing conventional maintenance systems. This is because it offers several advantageous functions, such as damage predictions for vessel components, reduced downtime, improved and extended life of machinery, as well as higher safety during voyages. However, existing methodologies developed for performing PdM do not provide explanations of their results to users, so that they can understand the failures that may occur. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel framework based on a fuzzy decision tree and a deep residual neural network, aiming to perform explainable PdM on naval vessels. The proposed framework is able to generate fuzzy local rules based on the dataset used, and can provide explanations of its outcomes, using cause-and-effect relationships, in a way that are understandable to users, thereby gaining their trust. Experiments using a publicly available dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, as it achieves an accuracy of 99.24%.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 30th Pan-Hellenic Conference on Informatics (PCI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对舰船推进系统预测性维护 (PdM) 结果不可解释的问题，提出模糊决策树与深度残差网络结合的框架，从数据生成模糊局部规则并以因果关系给出可理解的解释。在公开数据集上实验，该框架准确率达到 99.24%。
Motivation: 现有预测性维护方法只给出预测结果而不提供解释，用户无法理解部件可能发生的失效原因，难以建立信任。
Method: 框架结合模糊决策树 (fuzzy decision tree) 与深度残差神经网络 (deep residual neural network)，从数据集生成模糊局部规则，并用因果关系 (cause-and-effect) 形式输出可解释的结论。
Result: 在公开可用数据集上的实验中，该框架准确率达到 99.24%。
Conclusion: 模糊规则与残差网络结合可以在保持高准确率的同时为舰船 PdM 提供用户可理解的解释。

papers.title: Retrieval Geometry Shapes Cache-Based Clip Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Cache-based test-time adaptation improves CLIP predictions by storing and retrieving examples from the target stream while keeping the model frozen. However, existing methods largely treat the feature space used for image-image retrieval as fixed, leaving open how much adaptation depends on the retrieval space itself. We study this question by fixing the memory and changing only the retrieval encoder, finding that the same memory can yield very different gains: across sixteen retrieval spaces, ImageNet-A cache gain ranges from at most +0.44 points for CLIP and MAE to +19.7 +/- 0.4 for DINOv2-L, while label-free retrieval-space selection retains 98% of oracle gain on ImageNet-V2. These results show that memory quality depends not only on which examples are stored, but also on how they are retrieved. Motivated by this finding, we propose MARC (Memory Augmented Retrieval for CLIP), a training-free system that uses frozen CLIP for prediction and DINOv2-B for retrieval with a single fusion weight. A single-view cache repairs 1074 +/- 21 baseline errors, compared with 878 +/- 4 for a 64-view ensemble, at roughly one seventh of the cost. Across four ImageNet distribution shifts, MARC reaches a 67.91% OOD average and, at matched DINOv2-B scale and eight views, achieves 64.17 +/- 0.31% versus 62.75 +/- 0.15% for a graph-based cache system while running 2.6 times faster. Overall, our results establish retrieval space as a first-order design choice for robust cache-based adaptation in remote sensing, scientific imaging, and changing visual environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CLIP 的缓存式测试时自适应中，固定存储内容、只换检索编码器，同一份缓存的收益可从 +0.44 点（CLIP、MAE 检索空间，ImageNet-A）跳到 +19.7±0.4（DINOv2-L）。据此提出免训练的 MARC：冻结 CLIP 出预测、DINOv2-B 负责检索、只用一个融合权重，单视角缓存修复 1074±21 个基线错误，约为 64 视角集成（878±4）的七分之一成本。
Motivation: 缓存式测试时自适应把图像-图像检索所用的特征空间当作固定前提，无法回答自适应收益在多大程度上取决于检索空间本身。
Method: 先固定 memory、只替换检索编码器，在十六种检索空间上做受控对比；再提出 MARC（Memory Augmented Retrieval for CLIP），免训练、冻结 CLIP 做预测、DINOv2-B 做检索、单一融合权重，并用无标签方式选择检索空间。
Result: 十六种检索空间下 ImageNet-A 缓存增益从 CLIP 与 MAE 的至多 +0.44 点到 DINOv2-L 的 +19.7±0.4；无标签检索空间选择在 ImageNet-V2 上保留 98% 的 oracle 增益。MARC 单视角缓存修复 1074±21 个基线错误，64 视角集成为 878±4，成本约七分之一；四个 ImageNet 分布偏移上 OOD 平均 67.91%；在匹配 DINOv2-B 规模、八视角下为 64.17±0.31%，对比基于图的缓存系统 62.75±0.15%，速度快 2.6 倍。
Conclusion: 检索空间是缓存式自适应的一阶设计选择，而非固定背景；用免训练的预测/检索分工（CLIP 预测 + DINOv2-B 检索）即可在遥感、科学成像与变化视觉环境中取得稳健收益。

papers.title: MM-ContextFold: Context Folding for Multimodal Agentic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Agentic Retrieval (MAR) requires agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks by iteratively invoking external tools. Typical frameworks such as ReAct maintain raw multimodal inputs and the accumulating interaction history in a single, ever-growing context, leading to the context explosion problem. While existing methods alleviate this issue by compressing redundant text, effective strategies for managing token-intensive visual content remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of approximately 10,000 trajectories. The results show that as visual cues are progressively extracted through external tools and textualized into the context, raw images become increasingly redundant. Continued image retention is associated with higher output entropy and can even degrade task accuracy. Motivated by these findings, we propose MM-ContextFold, a training-free framework that loads raw images only when needed. It maintains a persistent, text-only main context for high-level planning and spawns ephemeral branch contexts for image-dependent subtasks. Within each branch, the agent loads the relevant images, completes the subtask, and folds the result back into the main context as a concise textual summary; the images and branch trace are then discarded. Experiments on seven MAR benchmarks across five backbone models show that MM-ContextFold improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing the working context length by 27.5\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MM-ContextFold 针对多模态智能体检索 (MAR) 中视觉 token 膨胀导致的上下文爆炸，改为按需加载原始图像：主上下文只保留文本规划，图像相关子任务在临时分支上下文中完成并折叠回文本摘要。约 10,000 条轨迹的实证研究显示，随着视觉线索被工具抽取并文本化，保留原图与更高输出熵相关并可能拉低任务准确率；在七个 MAR 基准、五种骨干模型上，该免训练框架较 ReAct 平均准确率提升 6.3 个百分点，同时工作上下文长度缩短 27.5%。
Motivation: ReAct 类框架把原始多模态输入与不断累积的交互历史塞进单一持续增长的上下文，形成 context explosion；现有方法主要压缩冗余文本，对 token 开销大的视觉内容如何管理基本空白。
Method: 先对约 10,000 条轨迹做系统实证研究，量化原图保留与输出熵、任务准确率的关系；据此提出免训练 (training-free) 的 MM-ContextFold：维护纯文本持久主上下文负责高层规划，为依赖图像的子任务派生临时分支上下文，分支内加载相关图像、完成子任务后把结果折回主上下文的简明文本摘要，随后丢弃图像与分支轨迹。
Result: 实证研究覆盖约 10,000 条轨迹，发现原图保留与更高输出熵相关并可能降低任务准确率；在七个 MAR 基准、五种骨干模型上，MM-ContextFold 相对 ReAct 平均准确率提升 6.3 个百分点，工作上下文长度减少 27.5%。
Conclusion: 视觉内容在被工具文本化后即成冗余，按需加载并把分支结果折叠为文本，可在不训练的前提下同时提高 MAR 准确率并压缩上下文长度。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 先对约 10,000 条轨迹做系统实证研究，量化原图保留与输出熵、任务准确率的关系；据此提出免训练 (training-free) 的 MM-ContextFold：维护纯文本持久主上下文负责高层规划，为依赖图像的子任务派生临时分支上下文，分支内加载相关图像、完成子任务后把结果折回主上下文的简明文本摘要，随后丢弃图像与分支轨迹。
summary_sections.result: 实证研究覆盖约 10,000 条轨迹，发现原图保留与更高输出熵相关并可能降低任务准确率；在七个 MAR 基准、五种骨干模型上，MM-ContextFold 相对 ReAct 平均准确率提升 6.3 个百分点，工作上下文长度减少 27.5%。

papers.title: Matrix AdaGrad: Row-wise and Column-wise Adaptive Subgradient Methods
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive optimization methods such as AdaGrad and Adam are widely used in modern deep neural network training, but their adaptive scaling is primarily designed for vector-valued parameters and does not explicitly exploit matrix structure. Recent matrix-aware optimizers demonstrate the benefits of structured optimization, yet a general theoretical framework for deriving matrix-aware adaptivity comparable to that of AdaGrad remains lacking. In this work, we develop an Online Mirror Descent framework with adaptive proximal functions for matrix-valued parameters, providing a principled methodology for deriving matrix-aware adaptive optimization through online regret minimization. By introducing row-wise and column-wise matrix proximal functions, our framework explicitly reveals the trade-off governing adaptive scaling: increasing the scaling factors reduces the gradient-dependent dual norm term while increasing the cost of evolving the proximal geometry. In the row-wise setting, this trade-off becomes separable under diagonal parameterization, allowing the adaptive scaling for each row to be derived independently by minimizing its corresponding row-wise regret bound. The column-wise counterpart follows directly by applying the row-wise construction to the transposed matrix. This framework yields Row-wise Matrix AdaGrad and Column-wise Matrix AdaGrad as concrete instantiations, with regret guarantees that are strictly tighter than those of entry-wise AdaGrad under row-sparse or column-sparse gradient structures. Experiments on matrix factorization and stacked deep MLP training further demonstrate the benefits of matrix-aware adaptive scaling, yielding improved optimization performance in both settings and enhanced optimization stability and trainability at larger learning rates and greater network depths in the latter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向矩阵参数的 Online Mirror Descent 自适应近端函数框架，导出 Row-wise 与 Column-wise Matrix AdaGrad 两个实例；在行稀疏或列稀疏梯度结构下其 regret 上界严格优于 entry-wise AdaGrad，并在矩阵分解与深层 MLP 训练中改善优化性能与大学习率、深网络下的稳定性。
Motivation: AdaGrad/Adam 的自适应缩放面向向量参数，未显式利用矩阵结构；已有 matrix-aware 优化器缺少可与 AdaGrad 相媲美的一般理论框架。
Method: 构建带自适应近端函数的 Online Mirror Descent 框架，通过在线 regret 最小化推导矩阵自适应缩放；引入行式与列式矩阵近端函数，揭示缩放因子增大带来的对偶范数项与几何演化代价的权衡；对角参数化下逐行独立最小化行 regret 上界，列式通过对转置矩阵复用同一构造。
Result: 在行稀疏或列稀疏梯度结构下，Row-wise/Column-wise Matrix AdaGrad 的 regret 上界严格紧于 entry-wise AdaGrad；在矩阵分解与堆叠深层 MLP 训练两个设置上均改善优化性能，并在后者中于更大学习率与更深网络下提升优化稳定性与可训练性。
Conclusion: 矩阵感知的自适应缩放可由统一的在线 regret 框架导出，且在稀疏梯度结构下给出严格更紧的理论保证与实证优化收益。

papers.title: Elastic Threshold Attention: Learned Contextual Sparsity for Long-Context Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Massive KV caches can cause severe memory-bandwidth bottlenecks during long-context decoding. Sparse attention methods mitigate this problem, but often drop necessary context, leading to quality degradation. We introduce \textbf{Elastic Threshold Attention (ETA)}, an end-to-end trainable architecture that rivals dense model quality under hardware-aligned block-sparse decoding. ETA predicts dynamic, contextual thresholds directly from query representations, adjusting context retention depending on the task at hand. To learn this policy from scratch while enabling near lossless KV cache pruning at inference time, we filter attention logits through a shifted SiLU gate during training. We show theoretically and empirically that this creates a smooth, near-uniform attention floor that neutralizes sub-threshold value contributions while simultaneously causing localized attention sinks on initial tokens to disappear. To materialize these advantages, we implement a fused inference-time kernel in Triton that screens KV blocks in $O(1)$ time using cached geometric-probabilistic bounds. Across language modeling, reasoning, and RULER benchmarks, our 1.45B ETA model matches or exceeds dense quality, outperforming alternative fast decoding methods (Quest, H$_2$O, NSA) while achieving higher sparsity levels. Our kernel also achieves up to $2.15\times$ end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-2 at context lengths of up to $512$K tokens. Finally, we introduce an offline calibration algorithm for domain-specific deployments that freezes per-head constant thresholds, cutting attention compute by an additional 27\% at no quality cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Elastic Threshold Attention (ETA)，一种端到端可训练的稀疏注意力架构：从 query 表示动态预测上下文相关阈值，训练时用 shifted SiLU 门过滤 attention logits，推理时用 Triton 融合 kernel 以 O(1) 时间筛 KV block。1.45B 模型在语言建模、推理与 RULER 上匹配或超过 dense 质量，最高 2.15× 端到端加速（相对 FlashAttention-2，上下文至 512K tokens）。
Motivation: 长上下文解码中巨大 KV cache 造成严重内存带宽瓶颈；现有稀疏注意力方法常丢掉必要上下文，导致质量下降。
Method: ETA 从 query 表示直接预测动态、随任务变化的上下文保留阈值；训练时用 shifted SiLU 门过滤 attention logits，从零学习该策略并支持推理时近乎无损的 KV cache 剪枝；用缓存的几何-概率界在 Triton 融合 kernel 中 O(1) 筛选 KV block；另给出离线校准算法，为特定领域冻结每头常数阈值。
Result: 1.45B ETA 模型在语言建模、推理和 RULER 基准上匹配或超过 dense 质量，优于 Quest、H2O、NSA 等快速解码方法且稀疏度更高；kernel 在最长 512K tokens 上下文下相对 FlashAttention-2 取得最高 2.15× 端到端加速；离线校准的每头常数阈值再削减 27% attention 计算且无质量损失。
Conclusion: 理论与实验表明 shifted SiLU 门产生平滑、近均匀的 attention floor，抵消低于阈值的 value 贡献并消除初始 token 上的局部 attention sink，因此带硬件对齐 block-sparse 解码的 ETA 可以在更高稀疏度下保住 dense 质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Quadratic Loss: The Stability Phase Diagram of Adam
papers.abstract_en: Loss spikes are recurrent instabilities in neural-network training and can arise from multiple mechanisms. For Adam in particular, macroscopic loss spikes have been linked to optimizer dynamics, yet how its two momentum timescales govern them remains unclear. We investigate this dependence by mapping training dynamics across the $(β_1,β_2)$ plane. Across a range of model--task settings, an approximately linear boundary, $1-β_2=C(1-β_1)$, separates spiky from non-spiky dynamics, whereas a one-dimensional quadratic loss produces approximately cubic slope. A one-dimensional superquadratic loss $L(x)\propto|x|^n$ recovers the near-linear scaling and links the boundary coefficient to the effective loss exponent $n$. We further show that confident cross-entropy losses develop a core--wall landscape comprising a narrow quadratic core followed by a steep wall, which produces effective superquadratic behavior at the scale of an optimizer update. Together, these results connect Adam loss spikes to both the mismatch between momentum timescales and finite-scale superquadratic loss geometry beyond the Hessian.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 (β1, β2) 平面上绘制 Adam 训练动力学，发现一条近似线性的失稳边界 1-β2 = C(1-β1) 分隔 loss spike 与平稳动力学，且边界系数 C 与损失的有效指数 n 相连。一维二次损失给出近似三次方斜率，而一维超二次损失 L(x)∝|x|^n 恢复近似线性标度；自信 cross-entropy 的 core-wall 几何在优化器更新尺度上表现为超二次，从而把 loss spike 归因于动量时间尺度失配与 Hessian 之外的有限尺度损失几何。
Motivation: Adam 的宏观 loss spike 已被联系到优化器动力学，但两个动量时间尺度 (β1, β2) 如何共同决定这种不稳定仍不清楚，且现有分析多局限于二次损失假设。
Method: 在 (β1, β2) 平面上系统扫描训练动力学，跨多种模型-任务设置定位 spike/非 spike 分界；用一维二次损失与一维超二次损失 L(x)∝|x|^n 做对照标定，并分析 confident cross-entropy 的 core–wall 损失几何（窄二次核心 + 陡峭 wall）。
Result: 跨多种模型-任务设置，分界近似为线性 1-β2 = C(1-β1)；一维二次损失给出近似三次方斜率，一维超二次损失恢复近似线性标度并把边界系数 C 与有效损失指数 n 关联；confident cross-entropy 呈现窄二次核心加陡峭 wall 的 core–wall 结构，在优化器更新尺度上产生有效超二次行为。
Conclusion: Adam 的 loss spike 由动量时间尺度失配与超出 Hessian 的有限尺度超二次损失几何共同决定，仅用二次损失无法解释该不稳定边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Information Geometric Self-Organization at the Edge of Stability in High-Capacity Kernel Associative Memories
papers.abstract_en: High-capacity associative memories based on Kernel Logistic Regression (KLR) exhibit exceptional storage capabilities and robustness. Previous empirical studies identified a hyperparameter regime, the "Ridge of Optimization," where attractor stability is maximized. However, the geometric nature of this regime and the optimization dynamics required to reach it have remained unclear. In this paper, we investigate the static geometry of the parameter space and the learning trajectory of Gradient Descent (GD) in KLR-trained Hopfield networks. Using the eigenvalue spectrum of the Hessian, we reveal that the Ridge corresponds to a phase boundary located adjacent to a rank-1 spectral collapse, acting as a geometric singularity where the principal curvature is massively amplified. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the learning dynamics exhibit a transient self-stabilizing behavior driven by the Edge of Stability (EoS) phenomenon. Rather than seeking flat regions, the network parameters are driven toward a state where the local curvature dynamically equilibrates near the stability limit dictated by the learning rate, allowing the optimization to survive the initial instability. We provide analytical derivations for both the rank-1 asymptotic collapse and the dynamic feedback loop governing this equilibration. These findings suggest that optimal, high-capacity memory representations are not formed in flat minima, but are dynamically sculpted at the highly curved boundaries of geometric singularities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KLR 训练的 Hopfield 网络中，吸引子稳定性最强的超参区域 Ridge of Optimization 被判定为紧邻 rank-1 谱坍缩的相边界，主曲率在此被极大放大；梯度下降靠 Edge of Stability 的动态反馈把局部曲率稳定在由学习率决定的稳定性极限附近，从而熬过初始不稳定。最优高容量记忆表征形成于几何奇异性的高曲率边界，而非平坦极小值。
Motivation: KLR 核联想记忆虽有高存储容量与鲁棒性，但此前只经验性地找到 Ridge of Optimization 这一稳定性最优的超参区域，其几何本质与到达该区域所需的优化动力学一直不清楚。
Method: 分析 KLR 训练的 Hopfield 网络参数空间的静态几何与 Gradient Descent 学习轨迹：用 Hessian 特征值谱定位 Ridge，推导 rank-1 渐近坍缩的解析形式，并给出驱动曲率趋于学习率所定稳定性极限的动态反馈回路的解析推导。
Result: Ridge 对应紧邻 rank-1 谱坍缩的相边界，是主曲率被极大放大的几何奇点；学习动力学呈现 Edge of Stability 驱动的瞬态自稳定行为，局部曲率动态平衡在由学习率决定的稳定性极限附近，使优化熬过初始不稳定。
Conclusion: 最优高容量记忆表征不是在平坦极小值中形成，而是在几何奇异性的高曲率边界上被动力学雕琢出来；rank-1 坍缩与曲率平衡回路均有解析推导支撑。

papers.title: A Weighted Kernel Method for Approximation that Adapts to Learned Multivariable Structure
papers.abstract_en: Approximating the input-output behavior of a multivariable black-box function from limited data is challenging when blind to the importance of its inputs and their interactions. We introduce total sensitivity kernels (TSKs), a method based on families of weighted ANOVA kernels that learn and adapt to this multivariable structure. TSKs parameterize the weights on each multivariable component of the target function by factors for each input. We propose learning these factors directly from function evaluations by selecting the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) in which the target function has minimum norm. Under suitable conditions, we show that this norm-minimization problem admits a unique solution, and we establish consistency of a finite-data formulation based on minimum-norm interpolation. The learned TSK factors characterize the participation of individual inputs across interactions and main effects, providing a kernel-dependent notion of input sensitivity related to total Sobol indices. Numerical experiments demonstrate that adapting the kernel to learned multivariable structure can substantially improve approximation accuracy over a standard product kernel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 total sensitivity kernels (TSKs)，用逐输入因子参数化加权 ANOVA 核的各多变量分量权重，直接从函数求值中学习这些因子，使核自适应目标函数的输入重要性与交互结构。在合适条件下最小范数问题有唯一解，有限数据的最小范数插值格式具有一致性；数值实验显示相对标准 product kernel 显著提高逼近精度。
Motivation: 从有限数据逼近多变量黑箱函数的输入-输出行为时，若对输入重要性及其交互结构一无所知，标准核难以匹配真实结构。
Method: 以加权 ANOVA 核族为基础，用逐输入因子参数化目标函数每个多变量分量的权重；通过选取使目标函数范数最小的 RKHS 直接从函数求值中学习这些因子，并给出基于最小范数插值的有限数据格式。
Result: 在合适条件下证明最小范数问题存在唯一解，并建立有限数据最小范数插值格式的一致性；学习到的 TSK 因子刻画各输入在交互与主效应中的参与度，给出与 total Sobol indices 相关的核依赖输入敏感度；数值实验表明自适应核相对标准 product kernel 可显著改善逼近精度。
Conclusion: 把核权重当作从数据学出的结构参数，可以在有限求值下同时得到更准的逼近和可解释的输入敏感度度量。
Relevance: 18
