papers.title: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for Precise and Comprehensive Brain Tumor Diagnosis from Preoperative Multimodal Data
papers.abstract_en: We developed BrainVLM to classify all 12 World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 brain tumor types. BrainVLM integrates an uncertainty quantification strategy to indicate prediction reliability and a module for generating radiology reports to elucidate the clinical rationale. BrainVLM was trained on multi-modal data (MRI scans, demographics, and radiology reports) from 40,043 individuals. It was validated on 5,211 patients with pathologically confirmed brain tumors, including 3,877 held-out patients from the primary hospital and 1,334 patients from 11 independent hospitals. We further conducted two proof-of-concept studies to validate its clinical utility in AI-clinician workflows: 1) a blinded multireader study where 12 neuroradiologists across varying experience levels interpreted 248 retrospective cases with or without AI assistance, and 2) a real-world prospective study in which 1,009 patients were independently and blindly assessed by BrainVLM and radiologists before surgery. Additionally, we demonstrated BrainVLM's utility in preoperative molecular subgroup prediction for adult-type diffuse gliomas, using a multi-center cohort of 632 patients. In primary evaluation, BrainVLM achieved an area under the curve (macro-AUC) of 0.85 (95% CI: 0.84-0.86), and an F1 score of 0.82 (95% CI: 0.81-0.83), surpassing neuroradiologists (F1 = 0.80 (95% CI: 0.79-0.81)). In external validation across 11 centers, BrainVLM achieved an AUC = 0.80 (95% CI: 0.79-0.82) and F1 = 0.75 (95% CI: 0.73-0.78), compared with F1 = 0.71 (95% CI: 0.69-0.73) for neuroradiologists. In prospective real-world evaluation, BrainVLM maintained performance comparable to neuroradiologists. The BrainVLM project page is available at https://hku-healthai.github.io/brainvlm_project.github.io/.
papers.comment: 94 pages, 22 Figures, supplement files, Project page link: https://hku-healthai.github.io/brainvlm_project.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrainVLM 把术前多模态数据（MRI、人口学信息、放射报告）统一到一个视觉-语言基础模型，覆盖 WHO 2021 全部 12 类脑肿瘤，附带不确定性量化与报告生成模块。主评测 macro-AUC 0.85、F1 0.82，超过神经放射科医生的 F1 0.80；11 家外部医院 AUC 0.80、F1 0.75，仍高于放射科医生的 0.71。
Motivation: 术前脑肿瘤分型需整合影像、人口学与报告等多源信息，且需覆盖 WHO 2021 全部 12 类并跨院泛化，单一模态模型与院内验证难以支撑。
Method: BrainVLM 在 40,043 人的多模态数据（MRI、人口学、放射报告）上训练，输出 12 类 WHO 2021 分类，内置不确定性量化以指示预测可靠性，并带放射报告生成模块解释临床依据；另做两项概念验证：12 名神经放射科医生对 248 例回顾性病例的盲法多读者研究，以及 1,009 例术前前瞻盲法对照。
Result: 主评测 macro-AUC 0.85（95% CI 0.84–0.86）、F1 0.82（0.81–0.83），对比神经放射科医生 F1 0.80（0.79–0.81）；外部 11 中心验证 AUC 0.80（0.79–0.82）、F1 0.75（0.73–0.78），放射科医生 F1 0.71（0.69–0.73）；前瞻 1,009 例中表现与放射科医生相当；在 632 例多中心队列上用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤术前分子亚型预测。
Conclusion: 多模态视觉-语言基础模型可在术前脑肿瘤全类别分型上达到并略超神经放射科医生水平，且在跨 11 家医院的外部验证中保持优势，可作为 AI 辅助读片流程中的决策支持。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Recovering Governing Dynamics from Distributed Observations via Exact Spline Merging
papers.abstract_en: Scientific observations are frequently distributed across locations, time periods, and institutions. Combining such observations into a continuous, differentiable field enables recovering governing physical parameters from its derivatives. This paper makes two contributions in this setting. First, the established additive structure of fixed-basis ridge-regression statistics is applied to tensor-product spline fields: each data holder computes a local Gram matrix and moment vector, and the merged solution is mathematically identical to centralized fitting, with no raw data shared and no iterative synchronization. This property is specific to the fixed-feature squared-error setting; the present derivation does not establish an analogous guarantee for general jointly trained multilayer networks. Second, a complete pipeline connects distributed observations to physical parameter inference through field reconstruction, derivative extraction, and linear regression. The pipeline is validated on four PDEs: diffusion, wave, heat-with-source, and the nonlinear viscous Burgers equation, recovering governing parameters to sub-percent accuracy in the linear cases and 5\% for Burgers. In all cases, distributed merging introduces zero degradation relative to centralized fitting. Synthetic experiments validate parameter recovery; application to 41 years of NOAA sea-surface temperature data validates field reconstruction and aggregation equivalence on real spatiotemporal observations. Source code to reproduce all experiments is available at https://github.com/NAVEENMN/splinemerge.
papers.comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把固定基 ridge 回归的可加统计量搬到张量积样条场上：各数据持有方只算本地 Gram 矩阵与矩向量，合并解与集中式拟合数学等价，无需共享原始数据也无需迭代同步。再经场重建、求导与线性回归恢复 PDE 参数，四个 PDE 上线性情形达亚百分比精度、Burgers 为 5%，且合并相对集中式零退化。
Motivation: 观测分散在不同地点、时段与机构，合成连续可微场后才能从导数反演物理参数；但分布式合并通常需要共享原始数据或迭代通信，且等价性缺少保证。
Method: 将固定基 ridge 回归统计量的可加结构应用于张量积样条场：每个数据持有方计算本地 Gram 矩阵与矩向量后合并，得到与集中式拟合数学等价的解；再接场重建、导数提取与线性回归构成参数推断管线。该等价性限定在固定特征 + 平方误差设定，不保证推广到一般多层网络联合训练。
Result: 在 diffusion、wave、heat-with-source、非线性 viscous Burgers 四个 PDE 上验证：线性情形参数恢复达亚百分比精度，Burgers 为 5%；所有情形中分布式合并相对集中式拟合零退化。另用 41 年 NOAA 海表温度数据验证场重建与聚合等价性。
Conclusion: 在固定特征平方误差设定下，样条场的分布式合并可做到与集中式完全等价且无通信迭代，从而支持从分布式观测恢复 PDE 控制参数；该保证不覆盖一般神经网络联合训练。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Gödel's and Scott's Variants of the Ontological Argument in Lean 4 and TPTP THF
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a complete, structure-preserving port to Lean 4 of the Isabelle/HOL dataset accompanying Benzmüller and Scott's study of Gödel's ontological argument and Scott's variant: 30 modules, one per theory, retaining section structure, declaration order and names up to documented renamings; a comparison tool certifies the 548 statements identical as parsed. Every named result the original proves is proved again, from the inconsistency of Gödel's 1970 axioms to modal collapse, monotheism and the ultrafilter property of positive properties. Five statements the original reports proved but does not replay are proved here. The 45 statements it refutes with Nitpick (35) or leaves open (10) are anonymous sorrys nothing depends on. Lean 4 has neither a sledgehammer nor a model finder, so automated proofs become explicit proof terms and the 65 Nitpick invocations are documentation. #print axioms then lists, as Isabelle/HOL's thm_deps would, the postulates each proof consumes, hence an upper bound on the modal logic it needs: the proofs of Scott's necessary-existence theorem and of modal collapse consume only symmetry of the accessibility relation, so KB suffices; those of the essence and monotheism lemmas, of the possible existence of a God-like being (with one recorded exception) and of the 1970 inconsistency consume none. The port also renders the dataset in TPTP THF, the format in which Gödel's argument was first mechanised, and in SMT-LIB: a metaprogram prints the 294 theorems as problems. Six provers (E, Vampire, Zipperposition, cvc5, Leo-II, Leo-III) prove 227 of them within ten seconds on one core, 231 within sixty, and none of the 45 left unproved; Leo-II, repaired here and released as 2.2, is level with E at ten seconds. The development needs no library beyond Lean 4's core; sources, tools, cross-checks and both renderings are ancillary files.
papers.comment: 55 pages. Version 2 adds the dataset rendered in TPTP THF and SMT-LIB, its evaluation with six provers at ten and sixty seconds and on the whole machine, the two Isabelle cross-check sessions, and a maintenance release of Leo-II, 2.2. Ancillary files: the Lean 4 package, the tools, both renderings with every prover result, and a run over the TH0 part of the TPTP library
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Gödel 本体论证明与 Scott 变体的 Isabelle/HOL 数据集完整移植到 Lean 4，并额外渲染为 TPTP THF 与 SMT-LIB：30 个模块、548 条语句经工具认证解析后一致，294 条定理中六 provers 在单核十秒内证出 227 条、六十秒 231 条，45 条未证的一条也没被证出。#print axioms 显示 Scott 必然存在定理与 modal collapse 只消耗可达关系对称性（KB 即够），essence、monotheism 与 1970 公理不一致性等证明不消耗任何额外公理。
Motivation: Gödel 论证的机械化散落在 Isabelle/HOL 与 TPTP 两套体系中，缺少跨证明助理的结构保持移植与公理依赖审计，难以核对每个证明实际用到的模态逻辑强度。
Method: 逐模块移植 30 个 Isabelle/HOL 理论到 Lean 4，保留节结构、声明顺序与名称（含记录在案的重命名），用比较工具认证 548 条语句解析后相同；用 metaprogram 把 294 条定理打印为 TPTP THF 与 SMT-LIB 问题，交 E、Vampire、Zipperposition、cvc5、Leo-II、Leo-III 六个 prover 求解，并以 #print axioms 列出每条证明消耗的公理，另做两个 Isabelle 交叉核对 session，修复并发布 Leo-II 2.2。
Result: 548 条语句经比较工具认证一致；原作证明的每个具名结果都重新证出，另补证 5 条原作报告已证但未重放的语句；原作用 Nitpick 反驳的 45 条中 35 条、留空的 10 条以匿名 sorry 处理，65 次 Nitpick 调用在 Lean 中仅作文档。294 条定理在单核上十秒内被证出 227 条、六十秒 231 条，45 条未证的一条也没被证出；Leo-II（本文修复并发布 2.2）十秒时与 E 持平。Scott 必然存在定理与 modal collapse 的证明只消耗可达关系对称性（KB 足够），essence 与 monotheism 引理、神样存在性（有一处记录的例外）以及 1970 不一致性的证明不消耗任何公理。
Conclusion: Gödel 与 Scott 论证可在 Lean 4 核心库之外完整重建，且公理依赖可被机器审计：最强结论只需 KB 级模态逻辑，部分证明零额外公理；TPTP THF 渲染使该数据集可被通用自动化证明器批量检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProtoLIP: From Sentence-Level to Object-Level Evidence Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Query-conditioned vision-language models enable fine-grained interpretation by revealing which visual content supports a given textual query and how this evidence changes across queries. However, semantically, sentence-level evidence does not necessarily decompose into object-specific contributions, while spatially, object-level evidence can remain entangled with co-occurring objects and surrounding scene context. Across multiple VLM architectures and independent benchmarks, we observe persistent object-level evidence entanglement. Moreover, exposed evidence maps do not necessarily correspond to the evidence that directly constitutes the model's prediction. To disentangle visual evidence at both semantic and spatial levels, we introduce ProtoLIP, a lightweight prototype-mediated evidence layer that organizes reusable visual prototypes into text-derived semantic families and uses coarse-to-fine evidence routing, where semantic families constrain prototype eligibility and the complete query determines fine-grained prototype contributions. Our studies show that ProtoLIP improves evidence localization and separation across query granularities, achieving average relative gains of 29% in Pointing and 43% in Energy across four object- and phrase-level OOD benchmarks. Its localization gains also transfer to independently pretrained VLMs, with larger improvements observed in several transfer settings. On the primary backbone, ProtoLIP also improves image-text matching discrimination while remaining competitive with a spatially supervised grounding model in object-level localization. Crucially, ProtoLIP constructs its image-text matching score directly from localized prototype evidence, enabling exact decomposition across prototypes, semantic families, and spatial evidence without spatial annotations or backbone retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoLIP 在查询条件化 VLM 上加一层轻量原型中介的证据层，把可复用视觉原型组织成语义族并做粗到细证据路由，从而在语义与空间两个层面解开物体级证据纠缠。在四个物体与短语级 OOD benchmark 上，Pointing 平均相对提升 29%、Energy 提升 43%，且增益可迁移到独立预训练的 VLM。
Motivation: 句子级证据并不天然分解为物体级贡献，而物体级证据又与共现物体和场景上下文纠缠；暴露的证据图还未必对应真正构成预测的证据。
Method: 提出轻量的 prototype-mediated evidence layer：把可复用视觉原型按文本派生的语义族组织，语义族限定原型候选，完整查询决定细粒度原型贡献，实现 coarse-to-fine evidence routing；image-text matching 分数直接由定位后的原型证据构造，可在原型、语义族与空间证据上精确分解，无需空间标注也无需重训 backbone。
Result: 在四个物体与短语级 OOD benchmark 上，Pointing 平均相对增益 29%，Energy 平均相对增益 43%；定位增益可迁移到独立预训练的 VLM，若干迁移设置下提升更大；在主 backbone 上 image-text matching 判别力也提升，并在物体级定位上与一个空间监督的 grounding 模型保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把证据按语义族与原型两级解耦，可以在不使用空间标注、不重训 backbone 的前提下同时改善证据定位、分离与匹配判别，且跨 VLM 架构可迁移。

papers.title: Interpreting hierarchical organisation of speaker embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Speaker recognition neural networks recognise speaker identities from input utterances by learning latent representations (i.e. speaker embeddings). However, these networks' internal mechanisms remain largely opaque, motivating research in explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) to understand them. Existing studies have analysed how speaker embeddings are organised, but rarely frame these analyses within XAI. This work proposes to explain and interpret the organisation of speaker embeddings from an XAI perspective. To this end, we apply a hierarchical clustering algorithm, Single-Linkage Clustering (SLINK), to analyse whether our prepared speaker embeddings naturally form clusters with hierarchical relationships. The resulting hierarchical organisation (i.e. hierarchical clusters) is evaluated using the Cluster-Class Matching (CCM) method. Moreover, we propose a new method, termed Hierarchical Cluster-Class Matching (HCCM), to identify which hierarchical clusters best match individual semantic classes like male and conjunctive semantic classes like UK & male, thereby interpreting the clusters using their matched classes. We quantify the matching degree with a new metric called the L-score, which makes imperfect matches diagnosable. HCCM's results reveal that the hierarchical clusters analysed by SLINK are well interpreted using classes related to speaker identity, gender, and nationality, showing the semantics inside the hierarchical organisation of the examined speaker embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把说话人嵌入的层次组织放进 XAI 框架解释：用 SLINK 层次聚类分析嵌入是否天然形成层次簇，再以新方法 HCCM 与新指标 L-score 判定哪些层次簇匹配单个语义类（如 male）或合取类（如 UK & male）。结果显示 SLINK 得到的层次簇可由说话人身份、性别、国籍相关类得到良好解释，揭示嵌入内部语义。
Motivation: 说话人识别网络的内部机制长期不透明，XAI 研究需要解释嵌入的组织方式；已有嵌入组织分析很少置于 XAI 框架下，且缺少可诊断不完美匹配的量化手段。
Method: 对准备好的说话人嵌入施加 Single-Linkage Clustering (SLINK) 层次聚类，检验其是否天然形成层次关系簇；用既有 Cluster-Class Matching (CCM) 评估层次组织，并提出 Hierarchical Cluster-Class Matching (HCCM) 识别与单语义类及合取语义类匹配的层次簇，以新指标 L-score 量化匹配度。
Result: HCCM 结果显示 SLINK 分析的层次簇可由说话人身份、性别、国籍相关类良好解释；L-score 使不完美匹配可被诊断。
Conclusion: 说话人嵌入的层次组织携带可解释的语义结构，可用层次聚类加语义类匹配的方式从 XAI 角度读出。

papers.title: T-LoopFormer: Token-Level Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning with Dynamic Routing
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers have recently demonstrated strong performance in both reasoning and language tasks by reusing a shared set of parameters across multiple iterations, achieving parameter efficiency without sacrificing representational power. Besides, looped Transformers perform inference directly in the latent space (latent reasoning) to reduce the number of tokens consumed during inference, thereby achieving improved sample efficiency. However, these models typically apply a fixed recursion depth uniformly to every token, leading to suboptimal compute allocation and leaving significant efficiency gains on the table. In this work, we propose dynamic token-choice routing for looped transformers, enabling each token to adaptively determine its own number of loop iterations based on its hidden state, which can improve the token generation accuracy. Moreover, we further introduce recursion-wise KV cache, which maintains an independent key-value cache for each recursion loop, this design ensures that tokens at different depths only attend to their corresponding cached states, effectively enabling faster autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments show that T-LoopFormer achieves robust performance on language modeling and zero-shot reasoning tasks and our model can reach the lowest decoding latency, which validate the effectiveness of token-choice router and recursion-wise KV cache. Code is available at https://github.com/YuMingQian1234/T-LoopFormer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-LoopFormer 让 looped transformer 中每个 token 依据自身 hidden state 自适应决定循环迭代次数（token-choice routing），并为每个 recursion loop 维护独立 KV cache，使不同深度的 token 只注意对应缓存状态。在语言建模与 zero-shot reasoning 上取得稳健表现并达到最低解码延迟。
Motivation: looped transformer 对所有 token 施加统一的固定递归深度，算力分配次优，浪费了可得的效率收益。
Method: 提出动态 token-choice 路由，按 hidden state 为每个 token 决定循环次数；并引入 recursion-wise KV cache，每个递归层独立缓存 key-value，配合 latent space 推理减少推理 token 消耗。
Result: 在语言建模与 zero-shot reasoning 任务上表现稳健，解码延迟达到所有对比设置中最低，验证了 token-choice router 与 recursion-wise KV cache 的有效性。
Conclusion: 按 token 分配递归深度并按深度隔离 KV cache，可在 looped transformer 中同时保住性能并压低自回归解码延迟。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: State of Thought Enables Endogenous Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute has emerged as a major approach to improving the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing test-time reasoning paradigms rely heavily on externally imposed control, either through fixed reasoning programs or through costly expansion in constrained search spaces, limiting both generalization and efficiency. We propose State of Thought (SoT), a new reasoning paradigm that enables endogenous reasoning in LLMs, with the model's internal reasoning state governing how reasoning unfolds. Concretely, SoT extracts a compact dynamics-geometric state from the model's internal information transfer and uses a 582-parameter controller on frozen backbones to selectively activate historical reasoning support useful under the current reasoning state, framing reasoning as a state-conditioned process over evidence rather than an externally prescribed token chain. Across quantitative (1.34x), general (1.62x), symbolic-and-code (1.76x), and long-context (2.51x) reasoning on 3 LLMs and 16 datasets, SoT consistently improves mean-baseline accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 62.6% and end-to-end latency by 44.6%. Across 2 VLM scales and 3 reasoning tasks, it improves mean accuracy by 3.8 points over reasoning baselines, with 74.9% fewer completion tokens and 73.5% lower latency than search-based methods. Under constrained access, SoT retains 38.2%/36.5% mean accuracy gains in training-free/embedding-only settings, while trajectory-only judging reaches 84.1% agreement across 3 API models. Together, endogenous state-driven reasoning provides a generalizable and efficient alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 State of Thought (SoT)：从模型内部信息流中抽取紧凑的动力学几何状态，用 582 参数控制器在冻结骨干上按当前状态选择性激活历史推理支撑，把推理变成对证据的状态条件化过程。在 3 个 LLM、16 个数据集上相对 mean-baseline 提升 1.34x–2.51x，同时生成 token 减少 62.6%、端到端延迟降 44.6%。
Motivation: 现有 test-time reasoning 依赖外部强加的控制——固定推理程序或受限搜索空间中的高成本扩展，泛化性与效率都受限。
Method: SoT 从模型内部信息转移中提取紧凑的 dynamics-geometric state，在冻结骨干上训练一个 582 参数控制器，按当前状态选择性激活有用的历史推理支撑，将推理表述为状态条件化的证据过程而非外部规定的 token 链；另设 training-free 与 embedding-only 受限访问变体，以及 trajectory-only judging。
Result: 在 3 个 LLM、16 个数据集上，quantitative/general/symbolic-and-code/long-context 四类推理分别提升 1.34x/1.62x/1.76x/2.51x，mean-baseline accuracy 一致提高，生成 token 减少 62.6%、端到端延迟降 44.6%；在 2 个 VLM 规模、3 个推理任务上比推理基线平均精度高 3.8 点，较搜索类方法 completion token 少 74.9%、延迟低 73.5%；受限访问下 training-free/embedding-only 仍保留 38.2%/36.5% 的平均精度增益，trajectory-only judging 在 3 个 API 模型上达到 84.1% 一致性。
Conclusion: 内生的、状态驱动的推理可作为外部控制式 test-time compute 的通用且高效的替代，在冻结骨干与受限访问条件下仍能同时提高精度并压缩 token 与延迟。

papers.title: Large Distant Gradients Need Not Be Reliable: reliability-weighted credit assignment for long-horizon autoregressive forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In autoregressive forecasting, long prediction rollouts provide distant supervision, but backpropagation through time (BPTT) carries gradients from those losses through many autoregressive steps. Repeated Jacobian products can make distant gradients dominate the update while amplifying predictable signal and unpredictable innovation together; a large distant gradient therefore need not carry reliable learning signal. Motivated by this, we introduce Internal Dual-Wiener routing (Internal-DW), a backward-only intervention that preserves the full forward rollout and all step losses while reliability-weighting internal gradient routes. At each residual block, we derive bounded Wiener gains for the identity and nonlinear routes that balance preserving predictable learning signal against suppressing unpredictable variation, and estimate them from route-level gradient statistics and an explicit noise model. In a controlled system with known gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), we show that distant gradients can grow even as their SNR falls, and that Internal-DW reduces error in recovering predictable gradient signals and improves forecasting. On four history-dominated, weak-drive testbeds, Internal-DW reduces forecast error by 5.2%-13.8% relative to full BPTT, outperforms gradient clipping and Jacobian regularization on three testbeds, with similar performance on shear flow, and outperforms validation-selected truncated BPTT (TBPTT) on three. It also extends or preserves the fitted optimal training-horizon range across these four testbeds. Across benchmarks, the current Internal-DW estimator has a clear applicability boundary: its benefit diminishes or reverses when usable history is limited or when the selected sampler fails to represent dominant drive-dependent variation. The results show that retaining long-horizon supervision does not require trusting every backward contribution equally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长时程自回归预报中，BPTT 把远端损失的梯度经多步 Jacobian 乘积传回，梯度变大时其信噪比 (SNR) 反而下降，大梯度并不可靠。提出仅作用于反向的 Internal-DW 路由：在每个残差块为恒等路与非线性路推导有界 Wiener 增益，按路线级梯度统计与显式噪声模型做可靠性加权，前向 rollout 与各步损失完全保留。在四个 history-dominated 弱驱动 testbed 上相对完整 BPTT 降低预报误差 5.2%–13.8%。
Motivation: 长时程自回归预报里远端监督要靠 BPTT 穿过大量自回归步，重复 Jacobian 乘积会让远端梯度主导更新，同时放大可预测信号与不可预测扰动，远端大梯度未必携带可靠的学习信号。
Method: Internal-DW 是 backward-only 干预：保留完整前向 rollout 与全部步损失，只对内部梯度路线做可靠性加权。在每个残差块推导恒等路与非线性路的有界 Wiener 增益，在保留可预测信号与抑制不可预测变化之间折中，并由路线级梯度统计加显式噪声模型估计。
Result: 在已知梯度 SNR 的受控系统中，远端梯度可在 SNR 下降时仍增大，Internal-DW 降低恢复可预测梯度信号的误差并改善预报。在四个 history-dominated 弱驱动 testbed 上，Internal-DW 相对完整 BPTT 降低预报误差 5.2%–13.8%；在三个 testbed 上优于梯度裁剪与 Jacobian 正则化，在 shear flow 上相当；在三个上优于按验证集选择的 TBPTT，并在四个 testbed 上扩展或保持拟合出的最优训练时程范围。
Conclusion: 保留长时程监督不等于要同等信任每一条反向贡献，按梯度可靠性加权即可在不牺牲前向 rollout 的前提下改善预报。当前估计器有明确适用边界：可用历史有限、或所选采样器无法代表主导的 drive-dependent 变化时，收益会减弱甚至反转。
Relevance: 47

papers.title: Exploring Second-Order Pattern Recognition in Speaker Recognition
papers.abstract_en: In traditional pattern recognition tasks, neural networks are trained to recognise human-defined patterns (e.g. audio categories) in model inputs (e.g. audio). Meanwhile, some Explainable AI (XAI) methods explain latent patterns characterising the network's recognition of inputs as human-defined patterns; this work calls these latent patterns second-order patterns and proposes to discover them. Accordingly, we apply a hierarchical clustering algorithm to analyse whether our speaker recognition network's representations learned from known utterances naturally form hierarchical clusters. Each resulting cluster is a second-order pattern that characterises a context in our network's recognition of the known utterances as speaker identities. All discovered second-order patterns are then interpreted using the Hierarchical Cluster-Class Matching (HCCM) method. Moreover, we propose a new task, second-order pattern recognition, to identify which of the discovered second-order patterns characterising the recognition of known utterances also apply to unseen utterances, thereby characterising the recognition of unseen utterances. Accordingly, we design the Hierarchical Cluster Navigation and Assignment (HCNA) method. HCNA recognises a second-order pattern as applying to an unseen utterance when the utterance's network representation lies within the extrapolation space of the cluster regarded as that second-order pattern. Experimental results demonstrate that the extrapolation space introduced in HCNA substantially improves task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在说话人识别网络上提出二阶模式识别任务：用层次聚类把已知语句的网络表示聚成层次簇，每簇即一个二阶模式，再用 HCCM 解读、用 HCNA 判断该模式是否适用于未见语句。实验表明 HCNA 引入的 extrapolation space 显著提升该任务表现。
Motivation: 现有 XAI 只解释网络如何把输入认作人类定义的类别，缺少发现并复用这些潜在（二阶）模式、判断其能否迁移到未见输入的任务与方法。
Method: 对说话人识别网络在已知语句上的表示做层次聚类，得到层次簇作为二阶模式；用 Hierarchical Cluster-Class Matching (HCCM) 解读各簇；新任务由 Hierarchical Cluster Navigation and Assignment (HCNA) 完成，当语句表示落在该簇的 extrapolation space 内即判定模式适用。
Result: 实验结果显示 HCNA 中引入的 extrapolation space 显著改善二阶模式识别任务的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 潜在模式可以被自动发现、解读并判定其对未见输入的适用性，而基于 extrapolation space 的归属判据是该任务有效的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EGGROLL, Unrolled: Understanding and Improving Low-Rank Evolution Strategies at Scale
papers.abstract_en: EGGROLL (Sarkar et al., 2026) makes evolution strategies (ES) practical for LLMs by replacing dense Gaussian weight perturbations with low-rank Gaussian products, often of rank one. This choice is computationally attractive but geometrically severe: Each rank-one perturbation lies in a zero-volume subset of the ambient matrix space, despite having identity covariance. We characterize the EGGROLL update mean field at finite rank and nonzero perturbation radius as a resolvent applied to the gradient of the perturbation-smoothed objective. This transformation can make the mean field nonconservative and reverse the local stability of an optimum. EGGROLL nevertheless recovers the gradient exactly on quadratic objectives at every rank and radius. In finite populations, the additional sampling variance of rank-one perturbations relative to dense Gaussian ES decays inversely with matrix width under a local affine model, and is only $0.098\%$ at width $4096$. Finally, we introduce LOO-ROLL, a leave-one-out estimator that replaces EGGROLL's two antithetic evaluations per direction by one. At equal evaluation cost, LOO-ROLL halves estimator MSE in transformer blocks. Across fourteen post-training settings up to 14B parameters, matched-time comparisons with EGGROLL yield eleven improvements in individual paired tests and no significant loss. At 1.7B, 8B, and 14B parameters, matched-time gains are $2.9$, $14.1$, and $7.9$ percentage points on GSM8K and $12.2$, $8.4$, and $8.1$ points on MATH-500.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EGGROLL 用低秩高斯乘积扰动替代稠密权重扰动，本文在有限秩与非零扰动半径下把其更新均值场刻画为对扰动平滑目标梯度施加的 resolvent，指出该变换可使均值场非保守并翻转最优点的局部稳定性，但在二次目标上任意秩与半径都精确恢复梯度。进一步提出 LOO-ROLL，用单次留一估计替代每个方向的两次对偶评估，在同等评估预算下把 transformer block 的估计器 MSE 减半。
Motivation: 低秩高斯扰动让 ES 能扩展到 LLM，但秩一扰动落在零体积子集上，其几何与统计后果此前缺少刻画；同时 EGGROLL 每个方向两次对偶评估的开销在大规模后训练中偏高。
Method: 在有限秩与非零扰动半径下推导 EGGROLL 更新均值场的 resolvent 表达式，分析其非保守性与局部稳定性；在局部仿射模型下比较秩一与稠密高斯扰动的采样方差；提出 LOO-ROLL 留一估计器，把每个方向的两次对偶评估换成一次，并在 14 个后训练设置上做 matched-time 对比。
Result: 秩一扰动相对稠密高斯 ES 的额外采样方差随矩阵宽度反比衰减，宽度 4096 时仅为 0.098%；LOO-ROLL 在同等评估成本下把 transformer block 的估计器 MSE 减半；在最多 14B 参数的 14 个后训练设置中，matched-time 对比 EGGROLL 有 11 项配对检验改进且无显著损失；1.7B、8B、14B 上 GSM8K 提升 2.9、14.1、7.9 个百分点，MATH-500 提升 12.2、8.4、8.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 低秩扰动的几何缺陷在实践中代价很小（方差随宽度快速衰减），而评估预算的重新分配（留一估计）才是可兑现的收益来源：LOO-ROLL 在同等时间预算下稳定优于 EGGROLL。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: High-probability guarantees for linear accessibility in feature superposition
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks can leverage feature superposition to encode more concepts than dimensions, but cross-feature interference constrains the linear accessibility of simultaneously active features. By framing linear accessibility as a compressed sensing problem, we derive high-probability bounds for fixed supports under subgaussian noise, proving the sufficient dimension scales linearly ($d=O_{\varepsilon}(k \log m)$) rather than prior worst-case quadratic limits. We characterize the asymmetry between active and inactive interference and the trade-off between interference and observation-noise budgets. We then validate these bounds across system parameters through Gaussian-tail approximations. We also introduce IHT-SAE, which uses learned iterative refinement to improve feature recovery beyond the limits of linear availability. These results quantify the geometric constraints of the linear representation hypothesis, providing a framework for evaluating sparse autoencoders, compositional generalization, and neural interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把特征叠加下的线性可读性形式化为压缩感知问题，证明固定支撑、次高斯噪声下充分维度只需 d=O_ε(k log m)，把先前最坏情况的二次界降到线性；并给出活跃/非活跃干扰的不对称性与干扰-观测噪声预算的权衡，用 Gaussian-tail 近似在系统参数上验证这些界。
Motivation: 神经网络用 feature superposition 编码超过维度数的概念，但跨特征干扰限制了同时活跃特征的线性可读性，此前的充分维度界是最坏情况的二次量级，掩盖了固定支撑下的真实几何约束。
Method: 将线性可读性表述为压缩感知问题，在次高斯噪声与固定支撑下推导高概率界；刻画活跃与非活跃干扰的不对称性及干扰与观测噪声预算的权衡；用 Gaussian-tail 近似在系统参数范围内验证界；提出 IHT-SAE，用学习式迭代精化改进特征恢复。
Result: 充分维度为 d=O_ε(k log m)，线性而非先前的最坏情况二次界；界通过 Gaussian-tail 近似在系统参数上验证；IHT-SAE 被提出用于超越线性可用性的特征恢复上限。
Conclusion: 线性表示假说的可读性受可显式刻画的几何约束支配，固定支撑下维度需求随 k log m 增长；该框架可用于评估 sparse autoencoder、组合泛化与神经可解释性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Steering Interference Reflects the Model's Defaults, Not the Behavior Directions
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering promises modular control of language model behavior: a behavior such as politeness corresponds to a direction in a model's activations, and adding that direction while it generates should switch the behavior on and leave everything else alone. It does not. We ask what decides which other behaviors move, and by how much, and find that it is the model rather than the behavior being steered. A steer relaxes the model toward a small set of behaviors it already favors, chiefly refusal, sycophancy, and poeticism, and that set is much the same whatever is steered. Three results across 24 behaviors and ten instruction-tuned models support this, every effect read off the generated text by a language-model judge rather than off a probe. That readout matters: all 24 behaviors are linearly decodable, but only 20 change what the model writes. First, a direction carrying no behavioral content, matched to a real steer only in the size of the vector it adds, moves the same behaviors in the same order as real steers do, while producing none of the behaviors that need a specific direction. Second, most interference runs one way, so it cannot be an overlap between two directions: steering profanity makes the model toxic, while steering toxicity leaves profanity untouched. Third, with a behavior held out entirely, geometry measured on the others explains almost none of the interference it takes part in. The account holds on all ten models, the pull toward defaults strongest below 10B parameters and weakening in each family's largest. Reading a steer as a perturbation whose endpoint the model fixes implies that disentangling behavior directions cannot by itself make steering modular.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 激活方向引导 (activation steering) 的副作用不由被引导行为的方向决定，而由模型自身的默认偏好决定：任何 steer 都把模型拉向 refusal、sycophancy、poeticism 这一小撮默认行为，且顺序与被引导内容无关。作者据此断言，仅靠解耦行为方向无法让 steering 变得模块化。
Motivation: activation steering 承诺模块化控制——加上某行为方向就只打开该行为、其余不变——但实际会牵动其他行为。需要回答：牵动哪些行为、幅度多大，由什么决定。
Method: 在 24 个行为、10 个 instruction-tuned 模型上做三组检验：(1) 与真实 steer 仅向量大小相同、无行为内容的随机方向；(2) 检验干扰的方向性（引导 profanity vs 引导 toxicity）；(3) 完全留出一个行为，看其余行为上测得的几何能否解释其干扰。所有效应由 language-model judge 从生成文本读出，而非探针。
Result: 24 个行为全部可被线性解码，但只有 20 个会改变模型实际写出的内容。无行为内容的方向以相同顺序移动相同的行为集，却不产生任何需要特定方向的行为。干扰基本单向：引导 profanity 使模型 toxic，引导 toxicity 则不动 profanity。留出行为的干扰几乎无法被其余行为的几何解释。结论在全部 10 个模型上成立，向默认行为的牵引在 10B 参数以下最强，在各家族最大模型上减弱。
Conclusion: 把 steer 读作端点由模型决定的扰动，意味着解耦行为方向本身不能使 steering 模块化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Geometry of Refusal: Why Post-Hoc Safety Is Fragile and Pretraining-Time Safety Persists
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc safety training (RLHF, DPO) is the dominant way to align large language models, yet jailbreaks (Zou et al., 2023), fine-tuning attacks (Qi et al., 2024), and activation-space edits (Arditi et al., 2024) keep recovering the behaviors it was meant to remove. We give this fragility one geometric explanation and follow it into pretraining. We measure the safety update $Δ= W_{safe} - W_{base}$ against the curvature of the model's capabilities (the empirical Fisher of a capability loss). Across five model families, post-hoc safety lands in a suppression regime: $Δ$ is nearly orthogonal to the capability directions, and its small in-subspace part concentrates on a few high-curvature ones. The update is thin but sharp, a refusal gate laid over intact capabilities rather than erasure of them. A kernel-immobility lemma explains why such an update can only mask a capability, not remove it, so a little benign fine-tuning restores it: 100 benign examples cut the AdvBench refusal of Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct by 35 to 38 pp. Following the account into pretraining, a pretraining-checkpoint sweep of OLMo-2-1B (Team OLMo et al., 2024) shows the features that refusal attaches to emerging in a sharp transition between 1B and 63B pretraining tokens. We then use the account constructively: models trained from scratch with safety co-training spread continuously across pretraining reach 87 to 98% AdvBench refusal that the same attack erodes by only 2 to 14 pp at every scale from 410M to 6.9B, against 35 to 38 pp for post-hoc installs, at a small cost on short-answer capability probes; a windowed schedule of equal total safety weight installs no refusal. Persistence of the safety signal across pretraining, not its timing, is what buys attack robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用几何视角解释对齐后安全训练为何脆弱：安全更新 Δ=W_safe−W_base 几乎正交于能力方向，只在少数高曲率方向上形成薄而尖的拒绝门，因此只能掩盖能力而不能消除它。100 条良性微调样本即可让 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的 AdvBench 拒绝率下降 35 到 38 个百分点；而从预训练起做安全共训的模型在 410M 到 6.9B 各规模上达到 87% 到 98% 的 AdvBench 拒绝率，同一攻击只侵蚀 2 到 14 个百分点。
Motivation: RLHF/DPO 等事后安全训练是主流对齐手段，但越狱、微调攻击与激活空间编辑反复恢复被移除的行为；作者要为这种脆弱性给出几何解释并追到预训练阶段。
Method: 以能力损失的经验 Fisher 曲率度量安全更新 Δ 的落点，在五个模型族上分解 Δ 与能力方向的夹角及子空间内分量；提出 kernel-immobility lemma 说明该类更新只能掩盖能力；再做 OLMo-2-1B 预训练检查点扫描定位拒绝特征涌现，并对比事后安装与从零起的安全共训（含等总安全权重的窗口化调度）。
Result: 事后安全更新 Δ 近似正交于能力方向，小子空间分量集中在少数高曲率方向；100 条良性样本使 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的 AdvBench 拒绝率下降 35 到 38 pp。OLMo-2-1B 上拒绝所附着的特征在 1B 到 63B 预训练 token 之间急剧涌现。安全共训模型在 410M 到 6.9B 各规模达 87% 到 98% AdvBench 拒绝率，同一攻击仅侵蚀 2 到 14 pp（事后安装为 35 到 38 pp），代价是短答能力探针小幅下降；等总安全权重的窗口化调度完全装不上拒绝。
Conclusion: 事后安全只是叠在完好能力之上的拒绝门，良性微调即可揭开；带来攻击稳健性的是安全信号在预训练全程的持续存在，而非其施加时机。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thinking with Cameras: Active Visual Reasoning via Dynamic Viewpoint Control for Surveillance Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in general-purpose video understanding. However, their application to real-world surveillance remains challenging due to the lack of large-scale domain-specific datasets and the limitation of passive observation from fixed viewpoints. In surveillance scenarios, critical visual evidence can be easily missed when targets are distant, small, occluded, or move beyond the current camera view. In this work, we introduce CamVLM, a new framework for Thinking with Cameras, which enables LVLMs to actively acquire visual evidence in real-world surveillance by continuously controlling camera viewpoints. We first construct CCTV-Anomaly, a large-scale surveillance video understanding dataset containing 14,133 videos across 10 anomaly categories, with detailed captions and event annotations. We further formulate viewpoint control as an active visual perception problem and build CamTrack-53K, an object-centric viewpoint trajectory dataset for learning camera actions. Moreover, we propose a reinforcement learning based viewpoint policy optimization framework, which models camera control as a sequential decision-making process and learns long-horizon observation strategies beyond supervised trajectory imitation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CamVLM achieves state-of-the-art performance under both passive observation and dynamic viewpoint settings, validating the effectiveness of active camera-based reasoning for surveillance video understanding. Our datasets, model, and code will be available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/CamVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CamVLM 让视觉-语言模型在监控视频中主动控制相机视角来获取证据：构建 CCTV-Anomaly（14,133 段视频、10 类异常）与 CamTrack-53K 视角轨迹数据集，用强化学习视角策略优化替代监督轨迹模仿。实验在被动观测与动态视角两种设定下均达到 state-of-the-art，验证主动相机推理对监控视频理解有效。
Motivation: LVLM 在通用视频理解上进展显著，但缺少大规模领域数据集，且只能从固定视角被动观测；当目标远、小、被遮挡或移出视野时关键证据容易丢失。
Method: 提出 CamVLM 框架：先构建 CCTV-Anomaly 监控视频理解数据集（14,133 段视频、10 类异常，含详细描述与事件标注），再把视角控制形式化为 active visual perception 问题并构建对象中心的视角轨迹数据集 CamTrack-53K；相机控制建模为序贯决策过程，用基于强化学习的 viewpoint policy optimization 学习长时程观测策略，而非监督式轨迹模仿。
Result: 在被动观测与动态视角两种设定下实验均报告 state-of-the-art 表现；数据集规模为 CCTV-Anomaly 14,133 段视频、10 类异常，以及 CamTrack-53K 视角轨迹数据。
Conclusion: 主动控制相机视角的推理方式对监控视频理解有效，超越仅靠监督轨迹模仿的策略学习；数据集、模型与代码将在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: PLSR: Progressive and Localized Super-Resolution of 3D Objects via Localized Latent Voxel Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution 3D asset generation is vital in various 3D applications. Existing state-of-the-art diffusion-based models remain constrained by fixed resolutions, limiting their ability to produce details. In this paper, we tackle the challenge of generating more detailed, higher-resolution 3D objects by introducing a 3D super-resolution (SR) framework built on existing 3D generative foundation models. To this end, we design PLSR, a progressive and localized super-resolution solution to achieve this goal effectively and memory efficiently. Technically, given a coarse geometry from a pretrained 3D generator, we decompose the global SR task into localized sub-tasks via an associative input decomposition scheme, adapt a flow-based 3D generator into a localized super-resolution model through low-cost finetuning, and unify them in an iterative patch-wise denoising pipeline for seamless high-resolution output. Experiments on challenging objects show that our approach is able to generate 3D details with new strong fine-detail fidelity while significantly reducing the computational cost, offering a new and practical solution for high-resolution 3D asset generation.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 15 figures, including supplementary material. ECCV 2026. Additional evaluation data are provided as ancillary files

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLSR 把受限于固定分辨率的 3D 扩散生成模型改造成渐进式局部超分辨率框架：将全局 SR 拆成局部子任务，用低成本微调把基于流的 3D 生成器改成本地超分模型，再以迭代 patch 级去噪输出无缝高分辨率几何。在有挑战性的物体上生成出新的强细节保真度，同时显著降低计算开销。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的 3D 生成模型受固定分辨率限制，难以产出更细的几何细节，直接生成高分辨率 3D 资产代价过高。
Method: 以预训练 3D 生成器产出的粗糙几何为输入，用关联式输入分解 (associative input decomposition) 把全局 SR 拆成局部子任务；通过低成本微调将基于流的 3D 生成器适配为局部超分模型；最后统一进迭代的 patch-wise 去噪管线，实现无缝高分辨率输出。
Result: 在有挑战性的物体上生成出具有新强细节保真度 (fine-detail fidelity) 的 3D 细节，并显著降低计算成本；论文为 ECCV 2026，34 页、15 图，附带 ancillary 评估数据。
Conclusion: 在既有 3D 生成基础模型之上做渐进式局部超分，是兼顾高分辨率 3D 资产细节与显存/计算效率的实用路径。

papers.title: WEECFP-SuRGE: A Position-Aware Substructure Encoding Method for Molecular Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Computational molecular property prediction requires representations that capture local chemistry, long-range interactions, and molecular topology. Conventional fingerprints provide efficient local substructure features, whereas learned graph and sequence models can represent broader context but often rely on pretraining or three-dimensional conformers. We introduce Wide Encoded Extended Connectivity Fingerprints (WEECFP) with Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding (SuRGE), a tokenized hierarchical Morgan representation in which graph-distance-dependent rotations are applied at the input and within transformer self-attention. Across MoleculeNet and the Therapeutic Data Commons ADMET benchmarks, WEECFP-SuRGE is competitive with recent pretrained and geometry-aware methods without external pretraining or conformer generation. We also show that the rotated token representation remains structurally informative. A guided confirmed-handshake overlap procedure reconstructs the correct constitutional isomer for 92.6% of a 4,200-molecule self-library evaluation. Together, the predictive and reconstruction results indicate that WEECFP-SuRGE preserves local substructure identity while making relative topology available to the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WEECFP-SuRGE：把 Morgan 指纹做成 token 化的层级表示，并在输入与 transformer 自注意力中施加图距离相关的旋转 (SuRGE)，使模型无需外部预训练或三维构象即可同时拿到局部子结构与相对拓扑。在 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutic Data Commons ADMET 上与近期预训练及几何感知方法相当；其旋转 token 表示可用 guided confirmed-handshake overlap 流程在 4,200 分子自库中以 92.6% 重建正确构造异构体。
Motivation: 分子性质预测需要同时刻画局部化学、长程相互作用与拓扑，但传统指纹只有局部子结构特征，图与序列模型又常依赖预训练或三维构象。
Method: 提出 Wide Encoded Extended Connectivity Fingerprints (WEECFP) 结合 Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding (SuRGE)：token 化的层级 Morgan 表示，在输入层与 transformer 自注意力内部都施加图距离相关的旋转；评测覆盖 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutic Data Commons ADMET 基准，另用 guided confirmed-handshake overlap 流程做构造异构体重建。
Result: 在 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutic Data Commons ADMET 上，WEECFP-SuRGE 在不使用外部预训练与构象生成的条件下，与近期预训练及几何感知方法表现相当；旋转 token 表示保持结构信息量；在 4,200 分子的自库评测中，guided confirmed-handshake overlap 流程以 92.6% 的比例重建出正确的构造异构体。
Conclusion: 作者认为预测与重建两组结果共同表明：WEECFP-SuRGE 在保留局部子结构身份的同时，把相对拓扑信息开放给了模型，因此不必依赖预训练或构象生成。

papers.title: SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms for VLAs, such as retrieval banks, learned compressors and recurrent states, must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. They were motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which no longer holds for modern VLM backbones. We propose SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module that uses the backbone's native video context directly as memory. It keeps the sampled history intact in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process, routes the evidence it finds to a standard flow-matching action head through the hidden states of a generated sub-task, and prefills the history shared by consecutive decisions during action execution, keeping latency close to that of a single-frame VLA. SimpleMemVLA achieves state-of-the-art results on four memory benchmarks without loss on general-purpose control, and with the same backbone and training setup it outperforms retrieval, compression and recurrent-state methods by a wide margin. History interventions show that the policy reads specific evidence from its past and follows edited histories without parameter updates, a visual form of in-context learning. On a physical dual-arm robot, it completes two tasks whose decisive evidence disappears before the robot acts. Code available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/SimpleMemVLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimpleMemVLA 去掉 VLA 的专用记忆模块，直接把带时间戳的历史视频原样喂给 VLM backbone 作为记忆，经生成的子任务隐状态把证据送入 flow-matching 动作头，并在连续决策间预填充共享历史以把延迟压到接近单帧 VLA。在四个记忆基准上达到 SOTA 且通用控制不掉点，同 backbone 同训练设置下大幅超过检索、压缩与循环状态记忆；历史干预实验表明策略会读取过去的具体证据并跟随被编辑的历史，无需更新参数。
Motivation: 长程操作是部分可观测的，决定下一步动作的信息可能出现在几分钟前的观测里；现有 VLA 记忆机制（检索库、学习式压缩器、循环状态）必须在不知道未来决策需要什么之前就决定保留什么，而分钟级历史过大、必须压缩的前提对现代 VLM backbone 已不成立。
Method: 不设专用记忆模块：把采样历史保持为 backbone 预训练所用的带时间戳视频格式原样输入，利用原生视频上下文作记忆；通过生成子任务 (sub-task) 的 hidden states 把找到的证据路由到标准 flow-matching 动作头；动作执行期间对连续决策共享的历史做 prefill，使延迟接近单帧 VLA。
Result: 在四个记忆基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，且通用控制 (general-purpose control) 无损失；在相同 backbone 与训练设置下大幅优于检索、压缩与循环状态记忆方法。历史干预显示策略读取过去的具体证据并跟随被编辑的历史而无需参数更新；在实体双臂机器人上完成两个决定性证据在机器人行动前就已消失的任务。
Conclusion: 分钟级历史可以直接交给现代 VLM backbone 处理，无需在决策前压缩记忆；原生视频上下文足以支撑长程操作的证据回溯，甚至支持视觉形式的 in-context learning。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Track from Privileged Target Appearances
papers.abstract_en: Target templates define what a visual tracker searches for, yet the templates available at inference trade off localization certainty with appearance freshness: the initial ground-truth template is exact but becomes stale, whereas recent templates better reflect the current appearance but are cropped from uncertain predictions. We quantify this bottleneck with a non-deployable oracle that supplies an exact current-frame target crop, improving AUC on LaSOT by 15.2 percentage points. This gap reveals a training-only opportunity: frame-level ground truths provide exact current- and future-frame target crops, although such crops are unavailable at deployment. We introduce Privileged Appearance Transfer for Tracking (PATT), a teacher-student training framework that transfers these privileged appearances to a deployable tracker through multi-level representation prediction. The privileged teacher observes exact target crops from past, current, and future frames, whereas the student receives only past-frame templates and learns to predict the teacher's search representations. To avoid transferring unreliable teacher signals, PATT weights this transfer by the teacher's relative localization advantage over the student and its absolute localization accuracy. After training, the teacher, latent predictor, reliability weights, and privileged crops are removed, leaving standard student-only inference. Across seven benchmarks at two model scales, PATT achieves consistent gains under both long- and short-term tracking protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉目标跟踪中模板要么精确但过期、要么新鲜但定位有噪声，用一个不可部署的 oracle 供给当前帧精确目标裁剪，在 LaSOT 上把 AUC 提升 15.2 个百分点。由此提出 PATT：训练期教师看到过去/当前/未来帧的精确裁剪，学生只用过去帧模板去预测教师的搜索层表示，并按教师相对与绝对定位优势加权迁移；训练后教师与特权信息全部移除，只留学生推理。在七个基准、两种模型尺度上，长短时跟踪协议均取得一致增益。
Motivation: 模板选择存在定位确定性与外观新鲜度的固有矛盾：初始真值模板精确但会过期，近期模板新鲜但裁自有噪声的预测，限制了跟踪器的搜索目标定义。

papers.title: Learning with Volterra Neural Networks: A System Theoretic Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order interaction components are important for signal, image, and video modeling, but explicit high-order operators often suffer from rapidly increasing parameter and computational costs. This paper presents kVNN, a learnable kernelized Volterra Neural operator for compact higher-order filtering. The motivation is to use kernelization to improve the efficiency of Volterra-type neural operators while providing a structured interpretation of their higher-order components. The proposed formulation combines the order-wise structure of Volterra filtering with learnable polynomial-kernel atoms, allowing different interaction orders to be represented by separate learnable centers and coefficients. This order-decoupled representation avoids explicit high-order tensor parameterization and can be implemented as a CNN-compatible layer. Experiments on representative vision tasks show that kVNN achieves a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 kVNN：把 Volterra 滤波的逐阶结构与可学习多项式核原子结合，各阶交互用独立的可学习中心与系数表示，从而避免显式高阶张量参数化，并可实现为 CNN 兼容层。在代表性视觉任务上取得较好的精度-效率权衡。
Motivation: 高阶交互分量对信号、图像、视频建模很重要，但显式高阶算子的参数量与计算量随阶数快速上升，需要紧凑的高阶滤波表示。
Method: kVNN（kernelized Volterra Neural operator）用核化改造 Volterra 型神经算子：逐阶结构配可学习多项式核原子，不同交互阶由各自的可学习中心与系数承载，做成 CNN 兼容层，绕开显式高阶张量参数化。
Result: 在代表性视觉任务上，kVNN 取得较好的 accuracy-efficiency 权衡；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 核化加逐阶解耦的表示可以在不显式参数化高阶张量的前提下表达高阶交互，兼顾效率与高阶分量的结构化解释。

papers.title: Provably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract_en: We address safe sim-to-real transfer, in which an agent leverages an imperfect simulator and limited real-world interaction while ensuring safety throughout data collection in the real system. This problem arises in applications such as robotics and healthcare: simulators provide cheap data, but sim-to-real mismatch makes direct transfer unreliable, and collecting real-world data to correct this mismatch must itself be safe. Moreover, deployment objectives may vary across tasks, making it costly to collect new data for each reward function. We therefore formulate safe sim-to-real transfer as a reward-free safe reinforcement learning (RL) problem, in which data are collected once and reused to plan for arbitrary reward functions. We develop a computationally efficient algorithm that identifies where the simulator and real dynamics differ, uses certified simulator transitions where they are reliable, and estimates mismatched transitions from safely collected data. With high probability, every policy deployed during learning is feasible, and the collected data support the computation of a feasible and near-optimal policy for any reward function. When the simulator is uninformative, our algorithm recovers online reward-free safe RL while improving the best-known sample complexity by a factor of \(\widetildeΘ(H/ξ^2)\), where \(ξ\) is the safety margin of a baseline policy. When the simulator is accurate on most transitions, this improvement grows to \(\widetildeΘ(H^2|\mc S||\mc A|/(ξ^2|\mc B|))\), where \(|\mc B|\) denotes the size of the sim-to-real mismatch region.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把安全 sim-to-real 迁移形式化为 reward-free 安全强化学习：数据只采一次，之后可为任意奖励函数规划，且学习期间部署的每个策略都以高概率满足安全约束。算法识别模拟器与真实动力学的差异处，可靠处用经认证的模拟器转移，失配处用安全采集的数据估计；样本复杂度相对已知最好结果改进 ~Θ(H/ξ²)，模拟器在多数转移上准确时改进扩大到 ~Θ(H²|S||A|/(ξ²|B|))。
Motivation: 模拟器与真实系统存在 sim-to-real 失配，直接迁移不可靠；而为修正失配采集真实数据本身必须安全，且部署目标随任务变化，逐奖励函数重新采数代价高。
Method: 将问题建模为 reward-free 安全 RL：先定位模拟器与真实动力学的失配区域，对可信转移使用经认证的模拟器转移，对失配转移用安全采集的真实数据估计；给出计算高效算法，保证部署策略可行并支持任意奖励函数的可行近最优规划。
Result: 以高概率学习期间部署的每个策略均可行，所采数据可为任意奖励函数计算可行且近最优的策略；模拟器无信息时恢复在线 reward-free 安全 RL，样本复杂度较已知最好结果改进 ~Θ(H/ξ²)（ξ 为基线策略的安全裕度），模拟器在多数转移上准确时改进为 ~Θ(H²|S||A|/(ξ²|B|))，|B| 为失配区域大小。
Conclusion: 安全 sim-to-real 迁移可按一次采集、多奖励复用的 reward-free 框架求解，样本复杂度的改进幅度取决于模拟器可信转移的比例与失配区域大小。

papers.title: SUN: Agentic Robot Policy Learning with Persistent Task Programs
papers.abstract_en: Model-based control can directly execute specified objectives, while learning can amortize such behaviors into reactive policies, making their combination a natural solution to multi-stage manipulation. We introduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables that compile grounded relations into aligned optimal control objectives, satisfaction predicates, and learning rewards. Our harness, Kuafu, equips a foundation model as a task-level agent to orchestrate scene preparation, verification, residual RL, and data production. The agent uses program feedback to repair candidate programs and training diagnostics to calibrate relative reward weights, retaining accepted task semantics across tool calls. Across nine multi-stage manipulation tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% average success rate, significantly outperforming all learned baselines. Its learned controllers generate demonstrations at 10.57x the human-teleoperation rate, yielding data that improve visualpolicy success by 23.6 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The policies transfer zero-shot to physical Franka and Kinova robots, demonstrating sim-to-real generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SUN 把多阶段操作任务编译成带类型、可执行的持久任务程序（SUN Programs），再由 Kuafu 让基础模型作为任务级 agent 编排场景准备、验证、residual RL 与数据生产，并用程序反馈修复候选程序、用训练诊断校准奖励权重。在九个多阶段操作任务上平均成功率 82.03%，显著超过全部学习型基线，且策略零样本迁移到 Franka 与 Kinova 实体机器人。
Motivation: 多阶段机器人操作需要把显式目标规格与可摊销的反应式策略结合起来，但语义在多次工具调用与训练循环中容易丢失，学习型基线成功率也偏低。
Method: SUN Programs 将 grounded relations 编译为对齐的最优控制目标、满足谓词 (satisfaction predicates) 与学习奖励；Kuafu harness 让基础模型 agent 编排场景准备、验证、residual RL 和数据生产，依据程序反馈修复候选程序、依据训练诊断校准相对奖励权重，并在工具调用间保留已接受的任务语义。
Result: 九个多阶段操作任务上 Kuafu 平均成功率 82.03%，显著优于所有学习型基线；其学习控制器生成演示的速度为人类遥操作的 10.57 倍，由此产生的数据使视觉-策略成功率比最强基线提高 23.6 个百分点；策略零样本迁移到实体 Franka 与 Kinova 机器人。
Conclusion: 把任务语义固化为可执行、可修复的持久程序并交给基础模型 agent 编排，能在多阶段操作上同时拿到高成功率、高速数据生产和 sim-to-real 泛化。

papers.title: One Capability or Many? Structural and Predictive Tests of Benchmark Validity Disagree About Economic Benchmarks for Frontier AI
papers.abstract_en: Frontier-model leaderboards now rank systems on economic benchmarks, and those rankings inform what organisations buy and what regulators scrutinise. Whether such benchmarks measure a capability distinct from general test-taking is a question of construct validity that a structural test and a predictive test can answer in opposite ways. We show that they do on a hash-pinned snapshot of a frontier leaderboard with 421 model configurations across twelve benchmarks, four of them economic, of which 103 configurations carry all three sparsely scored economic benchmarks and 96 carry all twelve; four hypotheses and their thresholds were fixed before analysis, and every deviation from the plan is reported. The first factor of a three-factor extraction carries 74.5% of common variance and tracks release date (R^2 = 0.505), and date adjustment lowers its share by 14.9 points. Under the dimensionality rule fixed in advance the economic benchmarks form no factor of their own. A leave-one-benchmark-out test with factors re-estimated inside every fold nevertheless finds that a multi-factor representation predicts held-out economic scores better than a single general index (pooled Delta-MSE 0.037, 95% bootstrap interval [0.019, 0.055]) under the linear learners that fit best, an advantage that reverses for tree learners. Under the linear learners the same representation also predicts the eight other benchmarks better, so the battery carries predictive structure that one index misses and the economic benchmarks share it without forming a distinct factor. Construct validity should therefore be assessed by predictive tests alongside structural ones. We give a two-test protocol for benchmark builders and release the pinned data, the analysis plan and the code.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 11 figures. v2 reframes the paper around the disagreement between structural and predictive tests. Analysis plan: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/VD34J (retrospective deposit). Code and data: https://github.com/louisyzhu/frontier-ai-economic-validity. Library: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22705351
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对前沿模型榜单做结构效度与预测效度两类检验，二者结论相反：经济类基准在预注册的维度规则下不构成独立因子，但多因子表征在留一基准交叉验证中对留出经济分数的预测优于单一综合指数（pooled Δ-MSE 0.037，95% bootstrap 区间 [0.019, 0.055]）。作者据此主张基准效度须同时用结构检验与预测检验评估，并给出面向基准构建者的两检验协议。
Motivation: 前沿模型榜单的经济类排名影响企业采购与监管审查，但这些基准衡量的是独立于一般应试能力的构念，还是同一通用能力的投影，结构检验与预测检验可能给出相反答案，需要一个可复现的判定框架。
Method: 在哈希固定 (hash-pinned) 的前沿榜单快照上分析 421 个模型配置、12 个基准（其中 4 个经济类），103 个配置覆盖全部三个稀疏打分经济基准、96 个覆盖全部 12 个；四个假设与阈值在分析前预注册，偏离计划全部报告。流程含三因子抽取、按发布日期的回归调整、预注册维度规则判定因子结构，以及因子在每折内部重新估计的留一基准 (leave-one-benchmark-out) 预测检验，分别用线性学习器与树学习器拟合。
Result: 三因子抽取的第一因子解释共同方差的 74.5%，与发布日期相关 R² = 0.505，日期调整使其份额下降 14.9 个百分点；按预注册维度规则，经济类基准不构成独立因子。留一基准检验中多因子表征对留出经济分数的预测优于单一综合指数（pooled Δ-MSE 0.037，95% bootstrap 区间 [0.019, 0.055]），该优势在拟合最好的线性学习器下成立、在树学习器下反转；线性学习器下同一表征对其余八个基准也预测更好。
Conclusion: 结构检验与预测检验会就经济基准是否构成独立构念给出相反结论，因此基准效度应由两类检验共同判定；作者发布两检验协议以及固定数据、分析计划与代码。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 对前沿模型榜单做结构效度与预测效度两类检验，二者结论相反：经济类基准在预注册的维度规则下不构成独立因子，但多因子表征在留一基准交叉验证中对留出经济分数的预测优于单一综合指数（pooled Δ-MSE 0.037，95% bootstrap 区间 [0.019, 0.055]）。作者据此主张基准效度须同时用结构检验与预测检验评估，并给出面向基准构建者的两检验协议。
summary_sections.motivation: 前沿模型榜单的经济类排名影响企业采购与监管审查，但这些基准衡量的是独立于一般应试能力的构念，还是同一通用能力的投影，结构检验与预测检验可能给出相反答案，需要一个可复现的判定框架。
summary_sections.method: 在哈希固定 (hash-pinned) 的前沿榜单快照上分析 421 个模型配置、12 个基准（其中 4 个经济类），103 个配置覆盖全部三个稀疏打分经济基准、96 个覆盖全部 12 个；四个假设与阈值在分析前预注册，偏离计划全部报告。流程含三因子抽取、按发布日期的回归调整、预注册维度规则判定因子结构，以及因子在每折内部重新估计的留一基准 (leave-one-benchmark-out) 预测检验，分别用线性学习器与树学习器拟合。
summary_sections.result: 三因子抽取的第一因子解释共同方差的 74.5%，与发布日期相关 R² = 0.505，日期调整使其份额下降 14.9 个百分点；按预注册维度规则，经济类基准不构成独立因子。留一基准检验中多因子表征对留出经济分数的预测优于单一综合指数（pooled Δ-MSE 0.037，95% bootstrap 区间 [0.019, 0.055]），该优势在拟合最好的线性学习器下成立、在树学习器下反转；线性学习器下同一表征对其余八个基准也预测更好。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结构检验与预测检验会就经济基准是否构成独立构念给出相反结论，因此基准效度应由两类检验共同判定；作者发布两检验协议以及固定数据、分析计划与代码。

papers.title: AdapToPASS: Ambiguity-aware Adaptive Spherical Transformer for Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Spherical Transformers have emerged as a promising framework for panoramic semantic segmentation (PASS) by operating directly on spherical geometry and alleviating projection-induced distortions. However, existing architectures often assume canonical spherical structure and stable viewpoints, which are frequently violated in real-world imagery due to unconstrained camera motion, introducing contextual and geometric ambiguity. Consequently, they lack adaptive mechanisms to handle such ambiguity, limiting robustness to unseen spherical transformations. In contrast, biological perception is inherently ambiguity-aware, adapting to fluctuations in cue reliability caused by geometric and contextual variations to maintain stable interpretation under complex transformations. Motivated by this, we first systematically analyze existing PASS architectures under various unseen spherical transformations. We then introduce AdapToPASS, a novel bio-inspired Spherical Transformer that adaptively models contextual and geometric ambiguities for robust PASS. At its core, Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) blocks dynamically modulate attention according to local contextual ambiguity, mimicking adaptive, context-driven biological perception. To address geometric ambiguity, AdapToPASS employs Bifocal Spherical Representation to balance field of view and spatial resolution, together with boundary supervision inspired by the boundary-sensitive nature of biological vision. Across indoor and outdoor semantic segmentation, AdapToPASS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. Under unseen spherical transformations, it surpasses the next-best method by +13.38% relative mIoU on Stanford2D3D and +18.77% on WildPASS. We further introduce AdapToPASS-Swift, a lightweight variant with fewer than 2M parameters, which surpasses compact baselines while retaining robustness to spherical transformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdapToPASS 是面向全景语义分割 (PASS) 的仿生 Spherical Transformer，用 Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) 按局部上下文歧义动态调制注意力，配合 Bifocal Spherical Representation 与边界监督处理几何歧义。在未见过的球面变换下，其相对 mIoU 在 Stanford2D3D 上超出次优方法 13.38%，在 WildPASS 上超出 18.77%。
Motivation: 现有 Spherical Transformer 假设规范球面结构与稳定视角，而真实拍摄中相机运动不受约束，带来上下文与几何歧义，导致对未见球面变换的鲁棒性不足。
Method: 先系统分析现有 PASS 架构在多种未见球面变换下的表现；再提出 AdapToPASS：AdaSpA 块按局部上下文歧义动态调制注意力，Bifocal Spherical Representation 平衡视场与空间分辨率，并加入受生物视觉边界敏感性启发的边界监督；另给出参数量少于 2M 的 AdapToPASS-Swift 轻量变体。
Result: 在未见球面变换下，AdapToPASS 相对 mIoU 超出次优方法：Stanford2D3D +13.38%，WildPASS +18.77%；在室内与室外语义分割上一致优于先前 SOTA；AdapToPASS-Swift 以少于 2M 参数超越紧凑基线并保持对球面变换的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把上下文与几何歧义显式建模进球面注意力，可在相机运动导致的未见球面变换下稳定提升全景语义分割的鲁棒性，且轻量变体也能保留该鲁棒性。

papers.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: An avatar that holds a conversation should decide what to say and to move while saying it, yet these abilities live in separate model families: spoken dialogue models produce speech without motion, and co-speech motion models produce motion only from audio handed to them. The standard remedy is a cascade that first generates the spoken response and then runs a motion model over the finished audio, which requires a second full inference pass and precludes any joint optimisation between the two. We present Motion-Omni, an end-to-end framework in which a spoken dialogue model natively outputs explicit facial expression together with hand, upper-body and lower-body motion, generated directly from the hidden states that produce the speech. Joint training is not optional here: with the speech pathway frozen, motion remains misaligned with the audio, and co-adapting the LLM, Speech Generator and Motion Generator under both objectives is what recovers alignment while retaining spoken-dialogue ability. Supervision comes from a scalable, model-agnostic pipeline that pseudo-labels consistent-voice speech responses with a replaceable motion teacher, yielding 422,856 quality-ranked pairs (1,402 hours). We further release SwDA-500 and, to our knowledge, the first public evaluation protocol for stochastic open-ended full-body spoken dialogue, matching audio across motion systems while unifying rendering, automatic metrics, human evaluation, and latency measurement. Instantiated with a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbone, Motion-Omni-Q7 matches the same-audio teacher cascade to within 2% on reference-free motion metrics while responding 5.4 x faster (RTF=0.78, faster than real time), surpasses all non-teacher cascades on beat correlation and diversity, and reaches a 2.62% word error rate, the lowest among the omni-modal systems compared.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Updated figures, presentation, and author notes. Project page: https://step-out.github.io/Motion-Omni-Page/ Code: https://github.com/step-out/Motion-Omni Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ChengqianMa/Motion-Omni
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Motion-Omni 把语音对话与全身动作生成合并为一个端到端框架：对话模型从产生语音的 hidden states 直接输出面部表情、手部、上肢与下肢动作，省掉级联所需的第二次完整推理。联合训练是必需的——冻结语音通路时动作与音频仍错位，只有让 LLM、Speech Generator、Motion Generator 在两个目标下共同适应才能恢复对齐。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 骨干上，Motion-Omni-Q7 在无参考动作指标上追平同音频教师级联的 2% 以内，速度快 5.4 倍（RTF=0.78），词错率 2.62%。
Motivation: 语音对话模型只出语音不出动作，co-speech 动作模型只能被动接收音频；标准级联要跑第二次完整推理，且两段之间无法联合优化，动作与语音容易错位。
Method: 端到端框架中对话模型从生成语音的 hidden states 直接解码显式面部表情与手部、上肢、下肢动作；LLM、Speech Generator、Motion Generator 在语音与动作两个目标下共同训练。监督来自可扩展、模型无关的伪标注流水线：用可替换的 motion teacher 为统一音色的语音回复打动作标签，得到 422,856 对质量排序数据（1,402 小时）；另发布 SwDA-500 及首个面向随机开放式全身语音对话的公开评测协议，统一渲染、自动指标、人评与延迟测量。
Result: 以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为骨干的 Motion-Omni-Q7 在无参考动作指标上与同音频教师级联差距在 2% 以内，响应快 5.4 倍（RTF=0.78，快于实时）；在 beat correlation 与多样性上超过所有非教师级联；词错率 2.62%，为所比较的 omni-modal 系统中最低。训练数据为 422,856 对、1,402 小时伪标注样本。
Conclusion: 语音与全身动作应当由同一个模型从共享 hidden states 联合生成，且必须联合训练而非冻结语音通路，才能在保留对话能力的同时恢复音画对齐并大幅降低延迟。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.
papers.comment: 27z pages, 6 figures. Code, data, pre-registration and all cached model outputs: https://github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation . Also archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给 LLM agent 呈现专业外观的市场面板会使其在可证伪不可预测的问题上给出方向性判断：12 个前沿模型的承诺率随证据升级从 6.5% 升到 54.0%；即使面板数字全部捏造，承诺率仍从 24.5% 升到 36.8%，与真实市场数据的 37.6% 无统计差异。失败点定位在 act/don't-act 决策门而非能力或校准，用 540 个合成样本微调 3B 模型可把原题承诺率压到 0.0% 并迁移到三个未见领域，但该门在不留推理空间的刚性输出格式下失效。
Motivation: LLM agent 在不可知问题上是否行动，与其能力、陈述概率和可知识别能力脱钩：面板的权威外观本身就能解锁自信决策，而现有校准评估无法定位这一失败。
Method: 对 12 个前沿模型做证据梯度实验（裸问题 vs 逐级升级的市场面板，含全捏造面板对照），并用同面板下的可答问题、陈述概率与 climatological baseline 对比、可知识别任务分别排除能力、信念、判断缺失；随后用 540 个以骰子、硬币、罐子、计时器为主的合成样本对 3B 模型做监督微调 (SFT) 训练决策门。
Result: 承诺率随证据升级 6.5% → 54.0%；全捏造面板 24.5% → 36.8%，与真实数据的 37.6% 统计上不可区分；陈述概率在推动行动 48 个百分点的梯度上几乎不动且差于 climatological baseline；模型把问题判为不可约 (irreducible) 的比例为 90%，而其中仅 0.4% 仍承诺；SFT 后原题承诺率降至 0.0% 并迁移到三个未见领域。
Conclusion: 解锁自信行动的是包装的权威性而非信息，失败集中在 act/don't-act 门且集中于少数模型；该门可训练但上下文脆弱——输出格式不留推理空间时模型会自信地答错本可答对的问题，部署需同时考虑这两点。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SimCast-S2S: A Computationally Efficient Diffusion Model for Subseasonal Precipitation Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) precipitation forecasting has substantial financial and societal impact, yet remains challenging because of weak predictive signals, high associated uncertainty, and the computational cost of operational systems, which constrains simulation fidelity. We introduce SimCast-S2S, a generative latent-diffusion framework for probabilistic S2S precipitation forecasting that addresses three major bottlenecks in data-driven prediction. First, because S2S prediction requires uncertainty quantification rather than only deterministic point forecasts, SimCast-S2S is the first data-driven system that uses a diffusion-based generative pipeline for S2S prediction, enabling effective sampling from the underlying conditional distribution. Second, since generating large probabilistic ensembles is computationally costly in physical space, SimCast-S2S instead operates in a compact latent space learned by variational autoencoders (VAEs), enabling efficient large-ensemble generation. Third, diffusion models typically require large training datasets; SimCast-S2S overcomes this via transfer learning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), pretraining on large ensembles of climate simulations before fine-tuning on limited reanalysis data. On reanalysis data, SimCast-S2S outperforms deep learning baselines, including convolutional neural networks and U-Net architectures. Notably, despite using only a subset of atmospheric input variables and no post-processing, bias correction, or calibration, SimCast-S2S remains competitive with, and in many aspects outperforms, state-of-the-art operational systems such as the ECMWF-S2S baseline. These results indicate that latent generative modeling combined with simulation-to-reanalysis transfer learning offers an efficient and scalable path toward data-driven probabilistic S2S precipitation forecasting.
papers.comment: Manuscript submitted to npj Climate and Atmospheric Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimCast-S2S 是首个用于次季节到季节 (S2S) 降水预报的扩散式生成系统：在 VAE 学到的紧凑 latent space 中采样以低成本生成大集合，并用 LoRA 迁移学习先在大集合气候模拟上预训练、再在有限再分析数据上微调。在再分析数据上它胜过 CNN 与 U-Net 深度学习基线，且在不使用后处理、偏差订正或校准、只用部分大气输入变量的情况下，与 ECMWF-S2S 业务基线相当并在多方面更优。
Motivation: S2S 降水预报信号弱、不确定性高，业务系统计算成本限制了模拟保真度；数据驱动方法又面临概率不确定性量化、物理空间大集合生成开销、以及扩散模型需大数据集三重瓶颈。
Method: 生成式 latent-diffusion 框架：用 VAE 学紧凑 latent space，在其中做扩散采样以生成概率集合；通过 LoRA 低秩适配做迁移学习，先在大集合气候模拟上预训练，再在有限再分析数据上微调。
Result: 在再分析数据上优于 CNN 与 U-Net 等深度学习基线；只用部分大气输入变量、且不做后处理、偏差订正或校准，仍与 ECMWF-S2S 业务基线相当并在多方面更优。
Conclusion: latent 生成建模加模拟到再分析的迁移学习，是数据驱动概率 S2S 降水预报的一条高效可扩展路径。

papers.title: PhysElite: How Far Are LLMs from Solving Olympiad-Level Physics Problems?
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how (multimodal) large language models perform on physics problems requires benchmarks that reflect the difficulty and breadth of expert-level physical reasoning. Existing physics benchmarks remain limited in the following two important ways: (1) short of high-difficulty datasets, and (2) lack of comprehensive coverage of visual forms, knowledge points, and step-by-step solution processes. As a result, model performance on current datasets may not be fully representative of their ability to solve complex physics problems. To address these issues, we present PhysElite, a large-scale bilingual multimodal benchmark for Olympiad-level physics reasoning. PhysElite contains 11,586 Olympiad-tier problems. For each problem, we provide corresponding visual diagrams, step-by-step bilingual Chinese-English solution derivations, and the final answer. We benchmark 18 open-source and closed-source MLLMs, and find that even the strongest model reaches only 33.7% answer accuracy. We additionally conduct step-level process evaluation to diagnose where models fail in the reasoning chain. Our datasets are released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/physelite/PhysElite.
papers.comment: Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysElite 是一个 11,586 题的双语多模态奥林匹克物理基准，每题配图示、中英双语分步推导与最终答案。对 18 个开源与闭源 MLLM 的评测显示，最强模型答案准确率仅 33.7%，并辅以 step-level 过程评测定位推理链失败环节。
Motivation: 现有物理基准缺少高难度数据集，且在视觉形式、知识点与分步解题过程上覆盖不全，导致模型在这些数据上的成绩不能代表其解决复杂物理问题的真实能力。
Method: 构建大规模双语多模态奥林匹克级物理基准 PhysElite，收录 11,586 道题，每题提供视觉图示、中英双语分步推导与最终答案；评测 18 个开源与闭源 MLLM，并加入 step-level 过程评测以诊断推理链中的失败位置。
Result: 在 18 个开源与闭源 MLLM 上评测，最强模型答案准确率仅 33.7%；另以 step-level 过程评测诊断模型在推理链中的失败环节。数据集发布于 Hugging Face 的 physelite/PhysElite。
Conclusion: 即便最强的多模态大模型在奥林匹克级物理推理上仍远未解决，答案准确率天花板为 33.7%，且需要分步过程评测来定位失败环节。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Provable Quantum-Classical Separation for Continuous Gibbs Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We prove the first quantum-classical separation for a sampling problem over a continuous domain. For a class of Gibbs states $p\propto e^{-βE}$ on the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ with smooth ($s$-Gevrey) potential and barrier amplitude $α=e^{βΔ}$, where $Δ= \max E-\min E$, every classical algorithm querying the value, gradient, or any higher-order derivatives of the log-density requires $Ω(α)$ queries to sample at constant accuracy in total variation distance, while a quantum algorithm based on quantum singular value thresholding and temperature annealing samples with $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrtα\right)$ queries to an oracle for the gradient. The advantage is quadratic in the barrier amplitude, which becomes exponential in the dimension, $e^{Ω(d)}$, at low temperature. The classical bound is information-theoretic, holding for every classical algorithm with query access to the Gibbs potential and its derivatives at any order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明了连续域上首个采样问题的量子-经典分离：在环面 T^d 上势垒幅度 α=e^{βΔ} 的 Gibbs 态，任何查询对数密度各阶导数的经典算法在常数 TV 距离精度下都需要 Ω(α) 次查询，而基于量子奇异值阈值 (quantum singular value thresholding) 与温度退火的量子算法只需 Õ(√α) 次梯度 oracle 查询。优势在 α 上是二次的，低温下随维度放大为 e^{Ω(d)}。
Motivation: 此前量子采样优势多在离散域，连续域 Gibbs 采样缺少对任意经典算法都成立的信息论下界，无法说明经典方法在势垒高、维度大时的根本瓶颈。
Method: 对 s-Gevrey 光滑势、势垒幅度 α=e^{βΔ} 的 Gibbs 分布 p∝e^{-βE} 建立模型：经典侧给出对势及其任意阶导数具有查询访问的通用信息论下界；量子侧给出基于量子奇异值阈值与温度退火的采样算法。
Result: 经典算法在常数总变差距离精度下需 Ω(α) 次查询；量子算法用 Õ(√α) 次梯度 oracle 查询完成采样，优势为 α 的二次量级，低温下随维度呈指数 e^{Ω(d)}。经典下界对任意查询访问 Gibbs 势及其各阶导数的算法均成立。
Conclusion: 连续域 Gibbs 采样存在可证明的量子二次（进而在低温高维下指数）查询优势，且经典侧瓶颈是信息论的而非算法设计问题。

papers.title: PolyChirp: Multi-Species Birdsong Classification Using TinyML on Low-Power Acoustic Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in the field of TinyML has demonstrated that low-power hardware based on microcontrollers can achieve bird species monitoring in real time based on acoustic sensor data for an entire breeding period on a single battery charge. However, the state of the art on low-power microcontrollers was so far limited to binary classification of a single species. In contrast, real fauna monitoring deployments often target multiple species simultaneously. To address this challenge we develop PolyChirp, an approach combining biological domain expertise, automated dataset curation, neural architecture optimization and novel hardware to achieve multiclass bird species detection in the wild. PolyChirp is based on newly designed tiny multiclass models that leverage recent microcontrollers and hardware acceleration with a neural processing unit (NPU). We evaluate the predictive performance of these models, and we measure their computational performance -- flash footprint, latency, energy consumption -- on common microcontroller hardware. Our results demonstrate that PolyChirp matches or exceeds the TinyChirp architectures retrained under our protocol on single-species detection, and further achieves robust classification of up to 10 species simultaneously (macro F2 up to 0.97), while still fitting the flash, latency and energy budget of a low-power microcontroller sensor. A data-driven front-end redesign additionally makes on-device mel feature extraction 7x to 11x cheaper.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE International Symposium on the Internet of Sounds (IS2) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyChirp 把低功耗微控制器上的鸟鸣监测从单物种二分类推到多物种分类：结合生物学先验、自动数据集整理、神经架构优化与带 NPU 的新硬件，训练极小多类模型。在单物种检测上匹配或超过按同一协议重训的 TinyChirp 架构，同时最多同时稳健识别 10 个物种（macro F2 最高 0.97），并仍装进低功耗传感器的 flash、延迟与能耗预算；数据驱动的前端重设计让设备上 mel 特征提取便宜 7 到 11 倍。
Motivation: 低功耗微控制器上的声学物种监测此前只做到单物种二分类，而真实野外部署通常要同时监测多个物种，多类检测在 MCU 的 flash、延迟、能耗预算内尚未打通。
Method: PolyChirp 组合生物学领域专长、自动化数据集整理、神经架构优化与带神经处理单元 (NPU) 的新硬件，设计极小多类模型；在常见微控制器硬件上测预测性能与计算性能（flash 占用、延迟、能耗），并以 TinyChirp 架构按本文协议重训作为对照；另做数据驱动的前端重设计以降低设备上 mel 特征提取开销。
Result: 多类模型最多同时稳健识别 10 个物种，macro F2 最高 0.97；单物种检测上匹配或超过按本文协议重训的 TinyChirp 架构；设备上 mel 特征提取成本降低 7 到 11 倍；模型仍满足低功耗微控制器传感器的 flash、延迟与能耗预算。
Conclusion: 在 MCU 上做多物种鸟类声学监测是可行的：把架构优化、硬件加速与前端重设计一起做，可以在单电池、低功耗预算内把能力从二分类扩到 10 类并保持高 macro F2。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer
papers.abstract_en: The components of a transformer communicate by writing to and reading from a shared residual stream, and the mechanistic interpretability literature has mapped these connections by hand, one circuit at a time. We present the communication map, which charts every potential communication channel from the geometry of the model's weights alone, generalizing the composition score of Elhage et al. (2021) into a single coupling coefficient covering all 18 connection classes, from head-to-head to neuron-to-neuron and everything in between. We provide an account of the properties of the coupling coefficient, including its geometric interpretation and its exact chance level. The census finds that 70-89% of head pairs are oriented far from chance, some coupled strongly and others actively avoiding each other. We demonstrate the communication map in two novel applications. In Application 1, we recover the known induction circuits blind from the strongest head-to-head couplings and group the heads into communities, and ablating one such community destroys the model's in-context copying. In Application 2, we pool the coupling coefficients of every head to identify a distinct two-dimensional residual stream subspace, whose deletion abolishes the induction capability in six models up to Pythia-6.9B. We show that this subspace is different from those identified by either activation PCA or outlier dimensions. We release the map, the statistical machinery, and the intervention suite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 communication map：仅从 Transformer 权重几何出发，把 Elhage et al. (2021) 的 composition score 推广为覆盖全部 18 类连接（head-to-head 到 neuron-to-neuron）的单一 coupling coefficient，并给出其几何解释与精确随机水平。普查显示 70-89% 的 head pair 显著偏离随机、有的强耦合有的相互回避；据此可盲恢复 induction circuit、把 head 分成社区，且删除一个社区会摧毁 in-context copying，池化 coupling 找到的二维残差流子空间在六个模型（最大 Pythia-6.9B）中删除即消除 induction 能力，且不同于 activation PCA 或 outlier dimensions 所识别的子空间。
Motivation: 可解释性文献目前靠手工逐个 circuit 地绘制组件间连接，缺少从权重几何一次性刻画所有潜在通信通道的系统工具。
Method: communication map 从模型权重几何计算 coupling coefficient，推广 Elhage et al. (2021) 的 composition score，统一覆盖 18 类连接；配套给出该系数的性质、几何解释与精确 chance level，并发布统计工具与干预套件。
Result: 普查中 70-89% 的 head pair 在方向上远离随机水平，部分强耦合、部分相互回避。应用一：从最强 head-to-head coupling 盲恢复已知 induction circuit 并对 head 做社区划分，消融其中一个社区即破坏模型的 in-context copying。应用二：池化所有 head 的 coupling coefficient 定位出一个二维残差流子空间，删除它在六个模型（最大 Pythia-6.9B）中均消除 induction 能力，且该子空间不同于 activation PCA 与 outlier dimensions 所识别者。
Conclusion: Transformer 组件间的通信结构可由权重几何单独系统刻画，且其中特定耦合与二维子空间对 induction 和 in-context copying 是因果必需的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Governance Records as Supervision: Verifier-Selected Self-Training for Structured Workflow Repair
papers.abstract_en: Machine-verifiable workflows produce governance records linking a task contract, model attempt, verifier decision, accepted output, and target origin. We test whether verifier-admitted outputs can supervise a bounded model by consolidating occasional or expensive capability into reliable one-shot execution. On fresh, structure-disjoint PlanBench replanning cases, Qwen3-14B thinking produced 24 plans admitted by independently authored VAL. They trained the same checkpoint for non-thinking execution, without oracle targets or a stronger teacher. VAL acceptance rose from 1/80 to 57/80. A prospective replication held targets, model revision, recipe, and evaluation corpus fixed across eight LoRA seeds and three inference realizations per seed. Every seed produced a clear lift: adapters reached 45/80 to 70/80 against 1/80 for every matched base report; the exact seed-level sign-flip test gave p=0.0078125. Target-selection performance was less stable. An initial matched seed gave 102/160 accepted plans after VAL selection versus 69/160 after blinded model self-selection. Across eight prospective seeds, the contrast was seed-dependent, included one clear reverse seed, and did not replicate (p=0.3672). VAL also had a positive descriptive aggregate over schema-only selection but failed its preregistered seed-level reliability gate (p=0.0703). The verifier remains the admission authority; no reliable downstream capability advantage of semantic selection is established. A complementary Phi arm supports stronger-teacher distillation. Earlier synthetic studies bound teachability, cumulative learning, transfer, and stopping. The evidence supports robust consolidation of one fixed, machine-checkable capability, not arbitrary planning, enterprise validity, or unrestricted self-improvement.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 PlanBench 重规划任务上，用独立编写的验证器 VAL 接受的 24 条 Qwen3-14B 思考轨迹作为监督，对同一 checkpoint 做非思考 LoRA 微调，VAL 接受率从 1/80 升到 57/80；八个种子复现中每个种子都稳定提升（45/80–70/80，符号翻转检验 p=0.0078125）。但语义选择相对盲自选的种子级优势不复现（p=0.3672），结论限定为单一可机检能力的稳健固化。
Motivation: 机器可验证工作流产生的治理记录（任务契约、模型尝试、验证器判定、接受输出）能否充当监督信号，把偶发或昂贵的高能力固化成可靠的一次性执行，而不依赖 oracle 目标或更强教师。
Method: 在结构不相交的 PlanBench 重规划新案例上，取 Qwen3-14B thinking 产生的 24 条被 VAL 接受的计划作目标，对同一 checkpoint 做非思考 LoRA 微调；前瞻复现固定目标、模型修订、配方与评测语料，跨 8 个 LoRA 种子、每种子 3 次推理实现，用种子级符号翻转检验，并设预注册的种子级可靠性门槛。
Result: VAL 接受率 1/80 → 57/80；八个种子全部提升，45/80 至 70/80，对应匹配基线均为 1/80，符号翻转检验 p=0.0078125。目标选择上，初始匹配种子 VAL 选择 102/160 对盲自选 69/160，但八个前瞻种子中对比呈种子依赖、含一个明显反向种子，不复现 p=0.3672；相对 schema-only 选择的描述性汇总为正但未过预注册门槛 p=0.0703。
Conclusion: 证据支持一个固定、机器可检验能力的稳健固化，不支持任意规划、企业级有效性或不受限的自我改进；验证器仍是唯一准入权威，语义选择的下游能力优势未被可靠确立。
Relevance: 2
