papers.title: LiD-GLM: Lipschitz-constrained Deep Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: The combination of traditional statistical models and neural network (NN) components into semi-structured hybrid models is an intriguing approach to construct models that, ideally, combine traditional interpretability with the unprecedented flexibility of NNs. In order to preserve interpretability, it is usually necessary to restrict the NN components to prevent them from dominating the model. However, existing methods that enforce structural constraints on their NN components severely limit their models' flexibility; in contrast, methods that only enforce weak, indirect constraints lose meaningful interpretability. The method we propose therefore leverages invertible residual neural networks (i-ResNets) to equip generalized linear models with both nonlinear parameter estimation and a flexible correction of their distributional assumptions while always retaining stochastic monotonicity of the modeled distribution in the (formerly linear) predictor. The i-ResNets correspond to a controlled deviation from identity and by constraining their Lipschitz constant one can rigorously limit and quantify how far the hybrid model deviates from its traditional counterpart. This enables a user-specifiable compromise between flexibility and interpretability without limiting the structure of nonlinear and interaction effects that can be learned. Furthermore, we develop specific inherent interpretation techniques for our model and enforce model identifiability through an adapted post-hoc orthogonalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiD-GLM 用 Lipschitz 常数受控的可逆残差网络 (i-ResNet) 扩展广义线性模型，使非线性参数估计与分布假设修正同时可行，并严格保持建模分布对预测子的随机单调性。由于 i-ResNet 是对恒等映射的受控偏离，Lipschitz 约束可量化混合模型偏离传统 GLM 的程度，从而给出灵活性与可解释性之间用户可指定的折中，且不限制可学习的非线性与交互效应结构。
Motivation: 半结构化混合模型中，对 NN 组件施加结构约束的方法严重限制模型灵活性，而只施加弱的间接约束的方法又会丢失有意义的可解释性，二者难以兼得。
Method: 以 i-ResNet 作为 GLM 的受控恒等偏离，约束其 Lipschitz 常数以严格限制并量化混合模型对传统 GLM 的偏离；同时提供专门的内在解释技术，并通过改进的 post-hoc 正交化 (adapted post-hoc orthogonalization) 保证模型可辨识性。
Result: 摘要给出的是构造性性质：混合模型始终保留分布对（原线性）预测子的随机单调性，偏离程度可被 Lipschitz 约束严格限制与量化，并支持用户指定的灵活性—可解释性折中；无实验数值。
Conclusion: 通过把 Lipschitz 约束写进 i-ResNet，可以在不限制非线性与交互效应结构的前提下，为半结构化混合模型提供可量化的可解释性保证。

papers.title: A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic approximation of fixed points of a non-expansive operator $T$ when the oracle samples originate from a continuing Markovian trajectory. A direct block-minibatch implementation of Halpern iteration attains an expected last-iterate residual of order $O(\log N/N)$, but accrues a substantive complexity of $\tilde O(ε^{-5})$ Markovian samples. We therefore introduce a variance-reduced Markovian PAGE-Halpern method whose refresh and same-state difference blocks are analyzed through the Poisson equation. In Hilbert spaces, the cocoercivity of $I-T$ results in an $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. Our main result extends this construction to a general finite-dimensional Banach space. A displacement-level Halpern bound replaces the Hilbert-space potential and yields $\tilde O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. We also establish a high-probability guarantee with the same leading accuracy dependence by measuring the estimator in an auxiliary smooth norm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Markov 轨迹采样下做非扩张算子不动点的随机逼近，直接分块 Halpern 迭代末次迭代残差达 O(log N/N)，但样本复杂度为 õ(ε^{-5})。改用方差缩减的 Markovian PAGE-Halpern（刷新块与同状态差分块用 Poisson 方程分析），Hilbert 空间因 I−T 的余强制性得到 O(ε^{-3})，有限维 Banach 空间用位移级 Halpern 界替代 Hilbert 势函数得到 õ(ε^{-3})，并给出同阶精度的高概率保证。
Motivation: Markov 相关采样下非扩张算子不动点的 Halpern 迭代，直接分块实现虽有 O(log N/N) 残差却要 õ(ε^{-5}) 个样本，且 Hilbert 空间的势函数论证无法直接搬到一般 Banach 空间。
Method: 提出方差缩减的 Markovian PAGE-Halpern：刷新块与同状态差分块通过 Poisson 方程分析；Hilbert 情形利用 I−T 的余强制性 (cocoercivity)，有限维 Banach 情形改用位移级 Halpern 界 (displacement-level bound) 替代 Hilbert 势函数；另在辅助光滑范数下度量估计器以证高概率保证。
Result: 直接分块 minibatch Halpern 的期望末次迭代残差为 O(log N/N)，样本复杂度 õ(ε^{-5})；Markovian PAGE-Halpern 在 Hilbert 空间达 O(ε^{-3})，在一般有限维 Banach 空间达 õ(ε^{-3})；高概率保证具有相同的首阶精度依赖。
Conclusion: 方差缩减加 Poisson 方程分析能把 Markov 采样下 Halpern 迭代的样本复杂度从 õ(ε^{-5}) 降到 õ(ε^{-3})，且该构造可从 Hilbert 推广到有限维 Banach 空间。

papers.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Agents that learn from experience improve at optimization modeling by storing solved trajectories and reusing them as skills. A wrong trajectory that enters the library can be retrieved again and again, and on a stream of new problems there is no ground-truth answer to decide with. Existing learners admit trajectories by matching known optima or labels, and label-free substitutes such as execution success or agreement at one instance can admit wrong models. We introduce ADMITOR, a label-free admission gate. It generates models from three model families, runs each on the stated problem and on instances with resampled parameters, keeps the largest group of models whose optimal values agree on every instance across families, and applies a threshold fitted on solver-verified problems to accept, abstain, or escalate, with a finite-sample bound on the false-discovery rate among accepted values. Inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, ADMITOR raises candidate-level admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote over the host's own samples and 0.726 for execution success, and its library, the smallest of the four, reaches the highest macro accuracy over five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote. An ablation on the same records shows that the gain comes from the accepted value being external to the learner and unanimous across families; on this stream, resampling never changed an accepted value and only reduced coverage. The false-discovery bound holds on the calibration set but not on the benchmark stream: an audit of every false certificate traces most of them to benchmark texts that omit or round the numbers needed to reproduce the labeled answer, and a label-free check of the extracted numbers against the text flags most of these cases.
papers.comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ADMITOR：用三个模型族各自生成优化模型，在原题与重采样参数实例上运行，保留所有实例最优值一致的最大模型群，再用 solver 已验证问题上拟合的阈值做接受/弃权/上报，并给出接受值假发现率的有限样本界。接入 SOTA 技能学习器后，候选级准入精度 0.927（多数投票 0.871、执行成功 0.726），其库为四者最小却在五个公开基准上取得最高宏精度 58.4（多数投票 54.8）。
Motivation: 经验学习器靠复用已解轨迹提升优化建模能力，但错误轨迹入库后会被反复检索，而新问题流上没有 ground-truth 可判定；现有准入依赖已知最优值或标签，执行成功、单实例一致这类无标签替代品会放行错误模型。
Method: ADMITOR 从三个模型族生成模型，在原题与参数重采样的实例上分别求解，保留每个实例上跨族最优值全部一致的最大模型群；阈值在 solver 已验证的问题上拟合，输出接受、弃权或上报，并对接受值的假发现率给出有限样本界；整体嵌入一个 SOTA 技能学习器内运行。
Result: 候选级准入精度 0.927，对比多数投票 0.871、执行成功 0.726；其技能库是四个中最小的，却在五个公开基准上取得最高宏精度 58.4，对比多数投票 54.8。同批记录上的消融显示增益来自接受值独立于学习器且跨族一致；该流上重采样从未改变被接受的值、只降低覆盖率。假发现界在校准集上成立但在基准流上不成立，审计显示多数假证书源于基准文本省略或四舍五入了复现标注答案所需的数字，用抽取数字与文本比对的无标签检查可标出其中大部分。
Conclusion: 跨族一致且独立于学习器的接受值是无标签准入有效的来源，但假发现界只在校准分布上可靠，基准流上的失败主要来自题目文本本身缺少数值，可用抽取数字与原文核对来补救。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Controlled Study of Self-Supervised Image and Video Pretraining under Limited Resources
papers.abstract_en: Visual foundation models are a cornerstone of image and video understanding but typically require large amounts of data and computation. The current scale required for pretraining visual foundation models may be unsustainable or unnecessary, and significant benefits arise when effective models can be obtained with fewer resources. To better understand how self-supervised learning (SSL) objectives behave under resource constraints, we conduct a controlled study of image and video SSL objectives under matched data, architecture, and compute budgets. We compare contrastive, reconstruction, feature-prediction, and diffusion objectives and evaluate both standalone and jointly trained image-video SSL formulations across a diverse set of image and video understanding tasks. Our results show that DINOv2-style pretraining consistently provides the strongest overall performance under limited resources. Furthermore, combining DINOv2 with video SSL objectives such as VideoMAE substantially improves image classification and segmentation performance, but degrades video tracking and camera-pose estimation performance, revealing an important tradeoff between semantic and geometric representation learning. These findings suggest that combining image and video SSL objectives can be beneficial in resource-limited settings, while highlighting the need for improved methods that better balance semantic, temporal, and geometric supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据、架构与算力预算全部对齐的受控设置下比较图像/视频自监督预训练目标，DINOv2 式预训练在资源受限时总体最强；再叠加 VideoMAE 等视频 SSL 目标可提升图像分类与分割，却会拉低视频跟踪与相机位姿估计，暴露语义表征与几何表征之间的取舍。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型预训练所需的数据与算力规模可能不可持续或并不必要，而不同 SSL 目标在资源受限条件下的表现缺少在匹配预算下的公平比较。
Method: 在匹配的数据、架构与算力预算下做受控研究，对比 contrastive、reconstruction、feature-prediction、diffusion 四类 SSL 目标，并同时评测单独训练与图像-视频联合训练的配方，覆盖一组多样的图像与视频理解任务。

papers.title: The Uncontrolled Variable: Vision-Language Refusal Is Conditioned on the Image-Attachment Interface, and Not Robust to Irrelevant Image Properties
papers.abstract_en: We show that aligned vision-language models also condition refusal on a property of a request's form: whether an image is attached, holding everything the request asks fixed. Attaching a blank canvas, an image that cannot be read, cannot relate to the request, and is byte-identical across every prompt in its condition, shifts benign refusal by tens of points. The shift is not blanket caution but a threshold shift: genuinely neutral instructions are almost unaffected (<=2 percentage points on three of four hosted models) while borderline-benign prompts move +23 to +51 points, so the cost falls on sensitivity-adjacent traffic, meaning benign questions about privacy, self-harm, violence and illegal activity. There is a benign reading of such a threshold, namely that attachment correlates with risk in real traffic, and we take it seriously; a black-box study cannot measure that correlation and we do not claim to. What it can test is whether the response to attachment is robust to variation carrying no information about the request, and on four independent measurements it is not. It varies with canvas colour and pixel count. Its sign inverts across checkpoints. It survives an explicit instruction to disregard the image. And on one model it fires on a bare assertion that an attachment exists, with nothing attached and the modality word contributing none of it. Finally we price it. On a matched harmful set the same canvas does lower attack success, so the cue buys something. But the charge is decoupled from the purchase: the checkpoint with the least harmful headroom we measure, completing only 2% of plain harmful requests, still pays the benign cost in full, and across our models the harmful-side denominator falls as alignment improves while the benign cost does not track it down. Image presence is not a conservative default that a deployer chose and priced. It is an uncontrolled variable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对齐后的视觉语言模型把「是否附带图片」当作拒绝依据：请求内容完全不变，仅附加一张与请求无关、字节恒定的空白画布，良性拒绝率就移动数十个百分点。这种移动是阈值平移而非普遍谨慎——中性指令几乎不动（四个托管模型中三个 ≤2 个百分点），而边界良性提示（隐私、自残、暴力、违法相关）上升 +23 到 +51 个百分点；该响应随画布颜色与像素数变化、跨 checkpoint 符号反转、无视「忽略图片」的显式指令，甚至在某模型上仅凭「声称有附件」的裸断言就触发。作者的结论是：图片存在性是一个未受控变量 (uncontrolled variable)，部署方并未为其定价。
Motivation: 对齐研究通常只看请求内容本身，但部署中请求的呈现形式（是否带附件）可能成为模型拒绝的隐性条件；若模型对与请求毫无信息量的图片属性也改变拒绝行为，部署方就无法预测或控制这部分拒绝成本。
Method: 黑盒研究：在保持请求内容不变的条件下操纵附件接口——附加空白画布、不可读图片、与请求无关且字节恒定的图片，以及仅在文本中声称存在附件；在四个独立测量维度上检验该响应对无信息变体的稳健性，包括画布颜色、像素数、跨 checkpoint、以及「忽略图片」的显式指令；同时在匹配的有害请求集上测量攻击成功率以给该行为定价。
Result: 空白画布使良性拒绝移动数十个百分点；中性指令在四个托管模型中的三个上变化 ≤2 个百分点，边界良性提示上升 +23 到 +51 个百分点。响应随画布颜色与像素数变化，符号跨 checkpoint 反转，且在「忽略图片」指令下依然存在；某模型上仅「存在附件」的裸断言即触发，模态词本身贡献为零。有害侧同一画布确实降低攻击成功率，但代价与收益解耦：有害完成度最低的 checkpoint（仅完成 2% 的纯有害请求）仍全额支付良性拒绝成本，且随对齐提升有害侧分母下降而良性代价并不随之下降。
Conclusion: 图片存在性不是部署方权衡后选定并定价的保守默认，而是一个未受控变量：模型对附件的拒绝响应对与请求无关的图片属性不稳健，其良性代价不随对齐改进而收敛。作者明确不主张真实流量中附件与风险的相关性，黑盒研究无法测量该相关。

papers.title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) condition robot actions on predicted futures, but iterative video rollout increases deployment latency. We ask whether action generation requires the evolving rollout trajectory or only its future representation. Across four WAMs on 40 simulated robotic manipulation tasks, paired closed-loop interventions show that blocking access to the future cache or reassigning its values changes execution and reduces success. Yet in the evaluated co-denoising settings, reusing one fixed final-clean key/value (K/V) cache throughout action denoising nearly preserves unmodified execution, with $1.7$--$1.9$ cm end-effector average displacement error. Obtaining this cache still requires iterative video generation. We therefore propose RIFT (Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens), which uses learned anticipation tokens to construct a complete future K/V cache in one backbone pass. On LIBERO, RIFT achieves $98.8\%$ overall success, outperforming all evaluated rollout-based methods while yielding a $3.1$--$9.2\times$ inference speedup. Without further training, it achieves $81.1\%$ overall success on the out-of-distribution LIBERO-Plus benchmark, a $+9.7$ percentage-point improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline. On RoboTwin, it achieves $92.9\%$ and $92.6\%$ success on clean and randomized scenes, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods. On real-world manipulation tasks, RIFT achieves $45.3\%$ average success, a $+6.0$ percentage-point improvement over Fast-WAM-Joint. These results support rollout-free future conditioning without iterative video generation at deployment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIFT 用学习到的 anticipation tokens 在一次 backbone 前向中直接构造完整的未来 K/V cache，从而在动作去噪全程复用，免去世界动作模型 (WAM) 部署时的迭代视频 rollout。在 LIBERO 上总体成功率 98.8%，推理加速 3.1–9.2×，且免训练迁移到 LIBERO-Plus 达 81.1%。
Motivation: WAM 靠迭代视频 rollout 提供未来条件，但部署延迟高；配对干预表明动作生成其实只需要固定的最终干净 K/V cache，而非整条演化轨迹，而该 cache 本身仍要靠迭代视频生成才能拿到。
Method: 先在四个 WAM、40 个模拟操作任务上做配对闭环干预：阻断未来 cache 或改写其值会改变执行并降低成功率，而在 co-denoising 设置中全程复用单个最终干净 K/V cache 几乎保持原执行（末端执行器平均位移误差 1.7–1.9 cm）。据此提出 RIFT (Rollout-free Imagination via Future Tokens)，用学习的 anticipation tokens 一次前向生成完整未来 K/V cache。
Result: LIBERO 总体成功率 98.8%，超过全部被评估的 rollout-based 方法，推理加速 3.1–9.2×；免进一步训练在 OOD 的 LIBERO-Plus 上 81.1%，比最强基线高 9.7 个百分点；RoboTwin 干净与随机化场景分别为 92.9% 与 92.6%，为被评估方法中最高；真实操作任务平均成功率 45.3%，比 Fast-WAM-Joint 高 6.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 部署时的未来条件化可以不依赖迭代视频生成：动作生成真正需要的是未来表示而非 rollout 轨迹本身，用 anticipation tokens 一次构造 cache 即可同时保住成功率并大幅降延迟。

papers.title: Beyond Forecasting: Recasting Volatility Control as a Routing Problem
papers.abstract_en: Volatility control converts risk estimates into portfolio exposure, yet existing approaches often rely on a fixed volatility estimator or a pre-defined control rule that may not adapt to changing market conditions. We propose VolRouter, a modular framework that formulates volatility control as state-conditioned routing over estimator-controller pairs. VolRouter first summarizes market conditions into a control-relevant state profile and then performs routing through three stages: state inference, switch review, and pair selection. The Router can be implemented using rule-based, learnable, or LLM-based decision modules, while portfolio actions remain generated by predefined control policies. We evaluate VolRouter across S&P 500, Multi-Asset, Bitcoin, and USDT volatility-control settings. VolRouter achieves the highest Sharpe ratio in three of four settings. On S&P 500, it improves Sharpe from 0.952 for RV + Naive Scaling to 1.222 while reducing maximum drawdown from 15.10% to 12.58% and daily CVaR from 1.76% to 1.32%. On Multi-Asset, it improves Sharpe from 1.498 to 1.540 and reduces CVaR from 1.56% to 1.18%. Bitcoin shows similar improvements in risk-adjusted performance, while USDT provides a boundary case where simpler state-aware selectors remain competitive. Ablation and sensitivity analyses show that the improvement comes from relative policy evaluation and selective persistent switching rather than simply expanding the policy library. These results suggest that volatility control can be viewed as a policy-selection problem when risk management requirements vary across market states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VolRouter 把波动率控制重写为按状态在“估计器-控制器”对之间做路由的问题：先归纳市场状态画像，再经状态推断、切换审查、成对选择三步选策略，组合动作仍由预定义控制策略生成。在 S&P 500、Multi-Asset、Bitcoin、USDT 四个设定中三个取得最高 Sharpe；S&P 500 上 Sharpe 从 0.952（RV + Naive Scaling）升到 1.222，最大回撤从 15.10% 降到 12.58%，日 CVaR 从 1.76% 降到 1.32%。
Motivation: 现有波动率控制依赖固定估计器或预定义控制规则，难以随市场状态变化而调整，风险管理要求在不同市场状态下本就不同。
Method: VolRouter 为模块化框架：先把市场条件压缩成 control-relevant 状态画像，再经状态推断、切换审查、成对选择三阶段路由到估计器-控制器对；Router 可用规则式、可学习或 LLM 决策模块实现，组合动作仍由预定义控制策略生成，并做消融与敏感性分析。
Result: 四个设定中三个取得最高 Sharpe。S&P 500：Sharpe 0.952 → 1.222（RV + Naive Scaling 基线），最大回撤 15.10% → 12.58%，日 CVaR 1.76% → 1.32%。Multi-Asset：Sharpe 1.498 → 1.540，CVaR 1.56% → 1.18%。Bitcoin 有类似风险调整后改善；USDT 为边界情形，更简单的状态感知选择器仍有竞争力。消融显示改进来自相对策略评估与选择性持续切换，而非单纯扩大策略库。
Conclusion: 当风险管理要求随市场状态变化时，波动率控制可视为策略选择问题；收益来自相对策略评估与选择性持续切换，USDT 这类简单场景下简单选择器已够用。

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
papers.abstract_en: A main promise of looped language models is depth-adaptive inference. By looping a block of shared layers a variable number of times, the model can use less compute for "easy" tokens and more for "hard" ones. However, tokens with different numbers of loops cannot share a uniform forward pass and therefore cannot be handled by standard batching systems such as vLLM. The practical value of depth-adaptive inference thus hinges on whether batching can be made efficient. We introduce the first efficient method for depth-adaptive looped LMs via continuous depth batching (CDB), which forms new batches between loop steps. Our method dynamically schedules looped and non-looped parts of the architecture, manages looped KV-caching, and predicts which tokens will exit the loop in advance so it can prepare batches asynchronously. Experiments on Ouro 1.4B and Huginn 3.5B show that fully looped architectures are best suited to depth-adaptive inference, as large non-looped layers outside the recurrent core (e.g., token embedding, LM head, and unshared transformer blocks) slow down and complicate scheduling. Overall, CDB realizes up to 99% of the estimated maximum speedup available, leaving further gains primarily dependent on model architecture and exit behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 循环语言模型 (looped LM) 的深度自适应推理因不同 token 循环次数不同而无法共享前向，标准 batching 系统如 vLLM 无法处理。提出 continuous depth batching (CDB)，在循环步之间动态重组批次、管理循环 KV-cache 并提前预测 token 退出循环以异步准备批次；在 Ouro 1.4B 与 Huginn 3.5B 上实现最高达估计最大加速的 99%。
Motivation: 深度自适应推理让简单 token 少算、难 token 多算，但循环次数不同的 token 无法进入同一前向，vLLM 等标准 batching 系统无法调度，其实际价值取决于 batching 能否做高效。
Method: CDB 在循环步之间形成新批次，动态调度架构中循环与非循环部分，管理循环部分的 KV-cache，并提前预测哪些 token 将退出循环，从而异步准备批次。
Result: 在 Ouro 1.4B 与 Huginn 3.5B 上，CDB 实现了估计最大加速的最高 99%；完全循环的架构最适合深度自适应推理，而循环核心之外的大非循环层（token embedding、LM head、未共享 transformer 块）会拖慢并复杂化调度。
Conclusion: 剩余加速空间主要取决于模型架构与退出行为，而非调度本身；完全循环的架构比带大非循环层的架构更适合深度自适应推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform for High Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
papers.abstract_en: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. This architecture also enables an interactive agent to provide natural language interfaces and hands-free, real-time guidance during intricate medical maneuvers. We validate the proposed system through a prototype deployment comprising a Meta Quest 3 interface linked to a local GPU-accelerated AI backend, demonstrating a feasible architecture for HDR brachytherapy simulation. Experimental results indicate that the system maintains suitable end-to-end latency and high context precision, answer completeness, and relevance in the RAG-enhanced pedagogical support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向高剂量率 (HDR) 阴道穹窿 (VC) 近距离放疗培训，提出元宇宙 + LLM 智能体的沉浸式仿真平台：VR 与移动计算搭建无放射源风险的训练环境，RAG 知识感知助手把智能体回答锚定在权威临床指南上，提供自然语言与免手持的实时操作引导。原型在 Meta Quest 3 加本地 GPU 加速 AI 后端上部署，端到端延迟合适，RAG 教学支持的上下文精度、答案完整度与相关性均高。
Motivation: HDR 近距离放疗操作受实体解剖与活放射源的安全和设备约束，学员难以反复练习复杂术式；通用 LLM 智能体若不接地临床指南则无法在手术操作中给出可信引导。
Method: 系统整合 VR 与移动计算构建高保真风险-free 仿真环境；核心是 RAG 知识感知助手，将智能体交互接地到权威临床指南，并提供自然语言接口与免手持实时引导；原型为 Meta Quest 3 界面连接本地 GPU 加速 AI 后端。
Result: 原型部署验证了 HDR 近距离放疗仿真架构的可行性；实验结果显示系统保持合适的端到端延迟，且 RAG 增强教学支持具有高上下文精度 (context precision)、答案完整度 (answer completeness) 与相关性。
Conclusion: 元宇宙 + LLM 智能体 + RAG 的组合可在无放射源风险的条件下支撑 HDR 近距离放疗的沉浸式技能培训，其可行性由 Quest 3 加本地 GPU 后端的原型架构验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupling Intention from Trajectory: A Representational Deduction Framework for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding to generative motion planning. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion thought-of-chain (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only significantly improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, enabling it to serve as an efficient few-shot real-robot fine-tuning strategy and demonstrating superior scalability for migration to mainstream WAM architectures.
papers.comment: At the request of our institution, we are withdrawing this preprint pending completion of the institutional clearance process for public release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PILOT 用 Representational Deduction 让动作分支显式生成潜在状态转移 token 并保留为推理空间的 motion CoT，从而把高层运动语义与低层轨迹解耦。摘要称其在复杂机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率与泛化能力，并可作为少样本真机微调策略迁移到主流 WAM 架构。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 视觉分支只预测静态视觉观测，无法反映运动交互下的状态转移信息，导致高层物理条件演化与低层动作轨迹在 Action Model 中表征纠缠，形成结构瓶颈并削弱世界演化预测对动作生成的支撑。
Method: 提出 PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories)，核心是 Representational Deduction：鼓励动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移 token，这些 token 作为 CoT 留在推理空间中引导细粒度运动轨迹，并以 motion thought-of-chain 引导作为模型原生能力；引入的状态转移监督信号缓解动作生成的稀疏监督。
Result: 实验显示 RD 在复杂机器人操作任务上显著提高 WAM 的成功率与泛化能力，并通过解耦高层运动语义与低层轨迹细节增强模型的物理可解释性；丰富的状态转移监督使方法可作为高效的少样本真机微调策略，并在迁移到主流 WAM 架构时展现可扩展性。
Conclusion: 把潜在状态转移显式建模为可保留的 CoT 推理 token，能同时缓解动作生成的稀疏监督并解除表征纠缠，使 WAM 在真机操作上更易微调与迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Not Every Divergence Should Be Suppressed: Counterfactual Recoverability in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-visited trajectories, yet divergence-based rules cannot determine whether an erroneous prefix remains correctable. We formulate this decision as counterfactual recoverability and replay each error state through budget-matched teacher-continuation and rollback branches. Based on their relative success, states are categorized as recoverable, irreversible-but-avoidable, or ambiguous, and these labels guide whether training retains, rolls back, or conventionally supervises the corresponding trajectory. On AIME branch diagnostics, the mean continuation-minus-rollback effect is 0.185 for recoverable states and -1.000 for irreversible-but-avoidable states, demonstrating opposite intervention preferences. A branch-derived recoverability proxy achieves an AUC of 1.000, substantially outperforming divergence alone at 0.392. Across frozen evaluations, recoverability-aware control achieves the strongest recorded performance, reaching 0.578 success on held-out AIME2025 compared with 0.517 for the best baseline. It also improves AIME2024-2025 average@32 from 0.2656 to 0.3125 and GPQA-Diamond average@32 from 0.2702 to 0.3070. Component ablations further show that retaining teacher-correctable prefixes provides the largest individual contribution. These findings establish recoverability as an outcome-grounded decision variable for selective supervision in OPD.
papers.comment: This preprint is withdrawn due to issues in experimental validation. Further investigation is ongoing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy distillation 中，用反事实可恢复性 (counterfactual recoverability) 替代纯散度规则决定是否压制学生轨迹偏差：把每个错误状态分别用预算对齐的 teacher-continuation 与 rollback 分支重放，按相对成功率标为可恢复、不可逆但可避免、或模糊，再决定保留、回滚还是常规监督。AIME 分支诊断中可恢复状态的 continuation-minus-rollback 平均效应为 0.185、不可逆但可避免状态为 -1.000，方向相反；分支导出的可恢复性代理 AUC 达 1.000，散度单独只有 0.392。
Motivation: on-policy distillation 里基于散度的监督规则无法判断一个错误前缀是否仍可纠正，导致该压制的偏差与该保留的可纠正轨迹被同等对待。
Method: 对每个错误状态做预算对齐的反事实重放：teacher-continuation 分支与 rollback 分支各跑一次，按两者相对成功把状态分为可恢复、不可逆但可避免、模糊三类，再分别对应保留、回滚、常规监督三种训练动作；同时构造分支导出的可恢复性代理，并做组件消融。
Result: AIME 分支诊断中可恢复状态的 continuation-minus-rollback 平均效应 0.185，不可逆但可避免状态为 -1.000；可恢复性代理 AUC 1.000，散度单独 0.392。冻结评测下 recoverability-aware control 在 held-out AIME2025 上成功率 0.578，最佳基线 0.517；AIME2024-2025 average@32 从 0.2656 提到 0.3125，GPQA-Diamond average@32 从 0.2702 提到 0.3070。消融显示保留 teacher 可纠正前缀贡献最大单项增益。
Conclusion: 作者主张把可恢复性作为 OPD 中选择性监督的、以结果为准的决策变量，而不是一律压制偏差；该 preprint 因实验验证问题被撤回，作者称仍在进一步调查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Despite the dominance of massive language models, leading paradigms like Transformers and Mamba fundamentally falter at continuous deterministic state tracking, suffering from catastrophic out-of-distribution (OOD) collapse when generalizing to extended sequences. To shatter this bottleneck, we present the \textbf{Complex State Propagator (CSP)}, a radically minimalist recurrent paradigm that operates strictly on the complex phase manifold without intermediate output projections, amplitude modulations, or per-step non-linearities. Crucially, we unveil an unprecedented architectural marvel: \textbf{the phase signal survives extreme depth with absolute zero informational attenuation}. By implementing an exact four-quadrant \textbf{Coordinate-to-Phase (C-to-2)} transformation governed by the \(\text{atan2}(y, x)\) activation, CSP forces the continuous optimization landscape to seamlessly align with discrete cyclic groups. Remarkably, with a mere \textbf{3-layer hidden topology} trained on short inputs (length 16),CSP demonstrates absolute mathematical purity, achieving a nearly $100\%$ validation accuracy and F1-score when generalized to a $4\times$ prolonged OOD length of 64 on the canonical Mod-3 tracking task. Our work establishes complex-valued, pure-phase propagation not merely as a compact alternative, but as a dominant frontier that beats heavy networks at a fraction of their size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出复值状态空间模型 Complex State Propagator (CSP)，在复相位流形上做纯相位递推，用 atan2(y,x) 的四象限 Coordinate-to-Phase 变换把连续优化对齐到离散循环群。仅 3 层、在长度 16 短序列上训练，在 Mod-3 确定性状态跟踪任务上外推到 4 倍长的 OOD 长度 64 时验证准确率与 F1 接近 100%。
Motivation: Transformer 与 Mamba 等主流序列模型在连续确定性状态跟踪上会随序列延长出现灾难性 OOD 崩溃，长序列泛化失效。
Method: CSP 是极简递归范式：不使用中间输出投影、幅度调制与逐步非线性，仅在复相位流形上传播状态；用 atan2(y,x) 激活实现精确四象限 Coordinate-to-Phase (C-to-2) 变换，使连续优化地形与离散循环群对齐，相位信号在极深网络中零信息衰减。
Result: 在标准 Mod-3 状态跟踪任务上，3 层隐藏结构、训练序列长度 16，泛化到 4 倍 OOD 长度 64 时验证准确率与 F1-score 均接近 100%。
Conclusion: 复值纯相位传播不只是紧凑替代方案，而是能以远小于重型网络的规模在长序列 OOD 状态跟踪上取胜的主导路线。

summary_sections.result: 在标准 Mod-3 状态跟踪任务上，3 层隐藏结构、训练序列长度 16，泛化到 4 倍 OOD 长度 64 时验证准确率与 F1-score 均接近 100%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 复值纯相位传播不只是紧凑替代方案，而是能以远小于重型网络的规模在长序列 OOD 状态跟踪上取胜的主导路线。

papers.title: DAIF: A Data-Driven Intermediate Fusion Framework for Multimodal Supervised Learning via Approximate Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal supervised learning seeks to leverage multiple heterogeneous data sources to improve predictive performance. A central challenge is determining the fusion granularity across modalities: over-integration may amplify noise while under-integration fails to exploit cross-modal dependence. Existing approaches rely on pre-specified fusion architectures, from early to late fusion, that may not adapt to the underlying dependence structure among modalities. We propose DAIF, a data adaptive intermediate fusion framework that combines random matrix theory and non-parametric dependence measures to learn fusion structure directly from data. We operate under a Bayesian multimodal factor model where the prior on the latent factors determines the cross-modal dependence. Our method clusters modalities based on estimated intermodal dependence, then performs clusterwise empirical Bayes estimation of the priors. These estimated priors are used to construct denoisers within an approximate message passing (AMP) framework, yielding denoised low-dimensional features that borrow strength across related modalities while preserving modality-specific signal. The resulting embeddings are used for downstream supervised prediction. We evaluate the framework through simulations under varying dependence structures and signal regimes, comparing against several benchmark methods, and demonstrate its practical utility on two multimodal datasets, namely a trimodal TEA-seq dataset (Swanson et al., 2021) and TCGA-BRCA dataset (Goldman et al., 2020). In the first example, we predict the expression level of a T-cell differentiation marker protein and in the second case we analyze patient survival prediction based on multimodal information. Our method competes with or outperforms the state-of-the-art techniques in both prediction problems, demonstrating its versatility across diverse supervised learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAIF 用随机矩阵理论与非参数相依性度量从数据里学融合结构：先按估计的模态间相依性聚类模态，再做 clusterwise empirical Bayes 先验估计，构造 approximate message passing (AMP) 框架内的 denoiser，得到跨相关模态借力、又保留模态特异信号的低维嵌入用于下游监督预测。在 TEA-seq 三模态与 TCGA-BRCA 两个数据集上，对 T 细胞分化标志蛋白表达与患者生存预测，性能与最先进技术相当或更优。
Motivation: 多模态监督学习里融合粒度难定：过度融合放大噪声，融合不足又用不上跨模态相依；现有 early/late fusion 架构需预先指定，无法自适应底层相依结构。
Method: 在 Bayesian multimodal factor model 下（潜因子先验决定跨模态相依），先按估计的 intermodal dependence 对模态聚类，再对先验做 clusterwise empirical Bayes 估计；用这些先验在 AMP 框架内构造 denoiser，输出去噪低维特征作为下游监督预测的嵌入。
Result: 在不同相依结构与信号体制的模拟中与若干 benchmark 方法比较；在 trimodal TEA-seq 数据集 (Swanson et al., 2021) 预测 T 细胞分化标志蛋白表达水平，在 TCGA-BRCA 数据集 (Goldman et al., 2020) 做患者生存预测，两个预测任务上与最先进技术相当或更优。
Conclusion: 融合结构应由数据自适应地学出来而非预先指定：以相依性聚类加 empirical Bayes 先验驱动的 AMP denoising 能跨相关模态借力并保留模态特异信号，在两类异质监督任务上通用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: InMyStyle is a privacy-first, single-user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine-tunes LoRA adapters on Qwen2.5 models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length-aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. We report a single-user case study: 219 evaluation pairs derived from 73 paragraphs of one author's scientific writing, with all adapters trained using the same rank-8, three-epoch recipe. The automatic composite score (0-1 scale) plateaus across model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding ($Q=0.689$-$0.695$, with overlapping confidence intervals). In this setting, small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, and model size mainly determines efficiency trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. The gains favor content-preserving naturalization more than recovery of personal style, with authorship probabilities staying near the classifier's decision boundary (0.51--0.53) and stylometric improvement being near zero. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-generated inputs, with scores decreasing with model size in this sample. The study does not establish generalization across users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InMyStyle 是隐私优先的单用户系统：用本地多个 helper LLM 构造配对样本，在 Qwen2.5（0.5B–7B）上以 rank-8、3 epoch 微调 LoRA，无需推理指令即可把 AI 改写文本拉回个人写作风格。单作者案例中综合分 Q=0.689–0.695 在各模型规模上持平，作者身份概率仅 0.51–0.53、文体计量改善近零，说明小模型已够用，规模主要换效率而非质量。
Motivation: 通用改写会抹平个人文风，而把大模型整体个性化既重又难保隐私；需要在单用户、本地小模型条件下判断多大参数量就够把文本改回本人风格。
Method: 以用户文档为源，用多个本地 helper LLM 生成配对训练样本，在 Qwen2.5 0.5B–7B 上统一用 rank-8、3 epoch 配方微调 LoRA；配长度感知生成预算与自动分块以适配不同长度输入，推理时无需指令提示。
Result: 单作者案例：73 段科学写作导出 219 个评估对，贪心与采样解码下自动综合分（0–1）Q=0.689–0.695 且置信区间重叠；作者身份概率 0.51–0.53 贴近分类器决策边界，文体计量改善近零。次要评测中五个 LLM 评委给出 400 条评分，InMyStyle 输出的感知 AI 痕迹均分比 helper 输入低 20% 以上，且该样本内分数随模型规模下降。
Conclusion: 在该单用户设定下小模型足以完成测得的改写任务，模型规模主要决定效率权衡而非稳定质量排序；收益偏向保留内容的自然化而非恢复个人风格，且研究未确立跨用户泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to acquire new knowledge from multimodal data while retaining previously learned knowledge. Existing MMCL methods primarily mitigate forgetting by aligning cross-modal representations or preserving feature-level semantic similarity. However, different tasks may rely on different modalities, and learning new tasks can alter how modalities contribute to predictions on previously learned tasks. It remains underexplored how modality contributions evolve across incremental stages and how such changes relate to forgetting in MMCL. We term such changes Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and introduce an MCD score based on controlled modality-subset interventions. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show how contribution drift can lead to forgetting, while existing MMCL and conventional CL methods do not effectively mitigate MCD. To address this issue, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR) to preserve the modality contribution profiles of previously learned tasks in both replay-based and replay-free settings. In the replay-based setting, CMCDR estimates modality contributions from stored old samples and regularizes their drift relative to a frozen previous model. In the replay-free setting, CMCDR uses current-task samples as probes to match old-class contribution profiles between the current and frozen models without storing old exemplars. Across six benchmarks covering multimodal class-incremental learning and continual multimodal question answering, CMCDR substantially reduces modality contribution drift, improves average accuracy by 0.88-7.66 percentage points, and reduces average forgetting by 0.85-11.55 percentage points over the corresponding baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态持续学习中，新任务学习会改变各模态对旧任务预测的贡献度，作者称之为 Modality Contribution Drift (MCD)，并提出 CMCDR 在 replay-based 与 replay-free 两种设定下正则化该漂移。在覆盖多模态类增量学习与持续多模态问答的六个基准上，平均准确率较对应基线提升 0.88–7.66 个百分点，平均遗忘下降 0.85–11.55 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 MMCL 方法靠对齐跨模态表示或保持特征语义相似来缓解遗忘，但不同任务依赖的模态不同，新任务学习会改变模态对旧任务预测的贡献；这种贡献漂移如何演化、与遗忘有何关系尚缺刻画。
Method: 基于受控模态子集干预 (controlled modality-subset interventions) 定义 MCD 分数，理论与实证分析贡献漂移导致遗忘的机制；提出 CMCDR：replay-based 设定下从存储的旧样本估计模态贡献，相对冻结的上一模型正则化其漂移；replay-free 设定下用当前任务样本作探针，使当前模型与冻结模型的旧类贡献画像对齐，不存旧样本。
Result: 在六个基准（覆盖多模态类增量学习与持续多模态问答）上，CMCDR 显著降低 modality contribution drift，平均准确率较对应基线提高 0.88–7.66 个百分点，平均遗忘降低 0.85–11.55 个百分点；理论与实证分析表明贡献漂移会导致遗忘，而现有 MMCL 与常规 CL 方法无法有效抑制 MCD。
Conclusion: 遗忘的一个未被处理的来源是模态贡献画像在增量阶段的漂移，直接正则化该漂移（相对冻结旧模型）在有回放与无回放两种设定下都能同时减小漂移、提升准确率并降低遗忘。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the robustness of noisy solutions in non-convex neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Optimization in non-convex neural network models is strongly influenced by the geometry of the solution space: sparse, isolated, point-like clusters are typically algorithmically inaccessible, whereas wide and flat regions can be found efficiently despite being relatively rare. At zero temperature this picture has been formalized in binary perceptrons through the overlap gap property (OGP), which limits algorithmic access to configurations with zero training error above a critical constraint density $α_{\rm OGP}$. Here we extend this description to finite temperature, where a positive training error is allowed and statistically penalized. We first show that the frozen one-step replica-symmetry-breaking solution, dominating the zero temperature equilibrium measure, survives at any finite temperature. We furthermore derive a general criterion, based on the smoothness of the single-pattern Gibbs weight near the decision boundary, that determines when a finite-temperature relaxation of the loss removes freezing. We then extend the OGP construction to finite temperature and show that dense, algorithmically accessible regions of finite-energy configurations persist beyond $α_{\rm OGP}$, up to a threshold $α_{\rm OGP}(ε)$ that grows with the allowed training error $ε$. Finally, in the teacher-student setting, we show that these wide, finite-energy regions still retain good generalization. Using a finite energy message-passing algorithm, we demonstrate numerically that thermal noise enables effective generalization in the regime of constraint densities where both recovering the teacher and finding a zero temperature solution are computationally hard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把二值感知机的 overlap gap property (OGP) 从零温推广到有限温：允许带统计惩罚的正训练误差后，稠密、算法可达的有限能量区域在 α_OGP 之外仍存在，其阈值 α_OGP(ε) 随允许训练误差 ε 增大而抬升。有限温松弛在单模式 Gibbs 权重于决策边界附近足够光滑时会消除 freezing；teacher-student 设定下这些宽的有限能量区仍保持良好泛化，有限能量 message-passing 算法在热噪声下于恢复 teacher 与找零温解都难的约束密度区间实现有效泛化。
Motivation: 零温下 OGP 说明零训练误差的可达构型在临界约束密度 α_OGP 之上被算法性排除，但真实训练总带噪声与有限温，需要知道允许正训练误差后可达区域是否重新出现。
Method: 把 OGP 构造推广到有限温，先证明零温主导平衡测度的 frozen one-step replica-symmetry-breaking 解在任意有限温下存活，再基于单模式 Gibbs 权重在决策边界附近的光滑性给出有限温损失松弛何时消除 freezing 的判据；最后在 teacher-student 设定用有限能量 message-passing 算法做数值检验。
Result: 稠密可达的有限能量构型区域在 α_OGP 之外仍持续到阈值 α_OGP(ε)，该阈值随允许训练误差 ε 增大而增长；teacher-student 下这些宽的有限能量区仍保持良好泛化；数值上热噪声使算法在恢复 teacher 与找零温解均为计算困难的约束密度区间实现有效泛化。
Conclusion: 有限温（允许被统计惩罚的训练误差）能绕开零温 OGP 造成的算法不可达性，且不牺牲泛化；frozen 1RSB 解本身在任意有限温下并不消失。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Think Short, Defer Smart, Act, and Repeat: Calibrated Reasoning and Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for Edge LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents following the ReAct paradigm are promising enablers of complex multi-step tasks, including multi-hop question answering, code generation, and control of physical AI systems. Yet, when deployed at the edge, they must tightly manage their reasoning budget while remaining reliable and deferring to a cloud-side model only when local uncertainty is too high to act safely. We propose Think Short, Defer Smart (TSDS), a framework that synergistically integrates a lightweight convergence probe, which halts on-device reasoning once the intended action has stabilized, with a perplexity-based deferral rule that escalates uncertain actions to a cloud-side model. Both mechanisms are jointly calibrated on end-to-end episode trajectories via a multi-objective Learn-Then-Test (LTT) procedure, providing simultaneous finite-sample guarantees on expected episode reward and cloud-call rate. We evaluate TSDS on four ReAct benchmarks spanning arithmetic reasoning (GSM8K), multi-hop question answering (HotpotQA), code generation (MBPP), and multi-step embodied planning (household robot), and compare against thought-calibration-only and calibrated-deferral-only standalone baselines. TSDS reduces per-episode thinking compute by 43%-65% over deferral-only baselines across HotpotQA, MBPP, and the household robot task, while maintaining certified reward and cloud-call rate guarantees.

Motivation: 边缘部署的 ReAct agent 必须在有限计算预算内保持可靠性，只在本地不确定度过高时才向云端求助；推理预算与安全弃权缺少可认证的联合控制手段。
Method: TSDS 融合轻量收敛探针（动作稳定即停止设备端推理）与基于 perplexity 的弃权规则（不确定动作升级到云端模型），二者通过多目标 Learn-Then-Test (LTT) 在端到端 episode 轨迹上联合校准，得到期望 episode 奖励与云端调用率的同时有限样本保证。

papers.title: Depth, Not Breadth: Best-of-N Jailbreaking Beyond Surface Noise
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-N jailbreaking spends a query budget on surface variation, scrambling and recasing a request until one draw lands. We ask what a budget buys when its variance is moved into a structural channel instead, holding the search identical across both arms so the encoding is the only difference. Against SAGE, the strongest published self-check defense, best-of-N over a code-completion encoding reaches 67, 22 and 15% of behaviors on three open-weight targets, where that encoding fired once reaches at most 4.7% and the published character search at full budget at most 3.0%: 9 to 75 times the sum of the parts, with bootstrap intervals clearing both ingredients on every target. We report the operative figure beside the headline rather than the headline alone: at the actionable severity threshold those cells read 24, 8 and 1 behaviors (95% CI [13, 28], [3, 13], [0, 3]). A 2x2 holding encoding and variation apart shows the two defense families fail to different factors: a transform defense is broken by the depth of the encoding (7 -> 67 behaviors at fixed variation) and a gate by the breadth of the variation (13 -> 57 at fixed encoding). Repeated sampling also inflates apparent robustness, because an attacker who may try N times experiences the maximum over draws while safety results are reported as means: on one target SAGE blocks 99.8% of individual draws yet loses 12 behaviors to a repeat attacker where a classifier gate blocking 95.6% loses 10. Removing the target's sampling costs SAGE 59, 76, 82 and 29 points of coverage more than it costs an undefended control, against 25, -5, 8 and 2 for a defense whose verdict comes from a fixed shadow model. The design that loses is the one fusing screening and answering into a single generation, so every attacker draw redraws the safety decision as well. The prescription is architectural, not free: do not fuse screening with generation.
papers.comment: 27 pages (7 pages main text, references, 18 pages supplementary material), 2 figures, 22 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Best-of-N 越狱中把查询预算从表面扰动（改写、乱序、大小写）移到结构化编码通道，攻击成功率大幅上升：对最强自检防御 SAGE，代码补全编码在三个开源权重目标上分别攻破 67%、22%、15% 的行为，而同一编码单次触发至多 4.7%、满预算字符搜索至多 3.0%，达到各成分之和的 9–75 倍。作者的处方是架构层面的：不要把安全筛查与回答生成融合在同一次生成里。
Motivation: Best-of-N 越狱把查询预算花在表面变化上，而防御评测常以单次抽样的均值报告鲁棒性；攻击者可重复尝试时实际体验的是多次抽样的最大值，导致表面鲁棒性被高估。
Method: 在保持搜索过程完全相同的两臂对照中，只改变编码方式：把请求改用代码补全编码（structural channel），与表面字符搜索对比；用 2×2 设计把编码深度与变化广度分离，分别对变换类防御与门控类防御做归因，并用 bootstrap 区间检验两个成分的贡献。
Result: 对 SAGE，代码补全编码的 best-of-N 在三个开源权重目标上达到 67%、22%、15% 的行为，而该编码单次触发至多 4.7%、满预算字符搜索至多 3.0%，为各成分之和的 9–75 倍，bootstrap 区间在每个目标上都同时超过两个成分；在可行动严重度阈值下对应 24、8、1 个行为（95% CI [13,28]、[3,13]、[0,3]）。2×2 中固定变化时变换类防御被编码深度击穿（7→67 个行为），固定编码时门控被变化广度击穿（13→57）。一个目标上 SAGE 挡住 99.8% 的单次抽样，但对重复攻击者损失 12 个行为，而挡住 95.6% 的分类器门控损失 10 个。去掉目标采样使 SAGE 比无防御对照多损失 59、76、82、29 个百分点的覆盖率，而判决来自固定 shadow model 的防御仅多损失 25、−5、8、2。
Conclusion: 越狱预算应投向编码深度而非表面广度；反复抽样会虚高防御鲁棒性，因为安全结果按均值报告而攻击者取多次抽样的最大值。作者的处方是架构性的：不要把筛查与生成融合，否则每次攻击抽样都会重抽安全判决。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Blind, Not Weak: A Best-of-Suite Safety-Utility Frontier for Recover-and-Reguard Defenses Against Encoded VLM Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Safety classifiers ("guards") are the dominant black-box defense for vision-language models, yet a guard judges an input's surface form, not its meaning: a harmful request re-encoded as set theory, formal logic, a classical language, code, or text rendered inside an image slips past a guard that would block it in plain language - the decode gap. The standard fix is a preprocessor that recovers image content and decodes the encoding before the guard. We build one and evaluate it against an ensemble of eleven encoding attacks - six published implementations, one standard encoding baseline, one adapted and three author-constructed renders - counting a behavior as broken if any attack succeeds. Restoring a view the guard never had is what buys coverage - block rates on image renders go from exactly zero to 67-90% - and what it costs in benign traffic is set by the guard, not by the mechanism: one guard pays 9 benign blocking points for the same 70-point gain another pays 69 for. It still does not make the system safer: against an attacker free to choose among eleven encodings, closing one channel relocates the success rather than removing it, and no ensemble contrast for that step survives multiple-comparison correction. What does lower ensemble attack success is a reguard step that re-screens the recovered pre-decode surface, and it is the one every guard pays for: it raises benign over-refusal on all ten guard-target pairs, where restoring a single channel raises it on some and not others. Across the full guard x target x condition factorial, no configuration reaches an ensemble attack-success rate at or below 40% while holding benign over-refusal under 70%. That empty region is a property of the configurations we sample, not a bound on what recovery-based defenses can reach, and we breach its safety half ourselves.
papers.comment: 52 pages (7 pages main text, references, 42 pages supplementary material), 4 figures, 41 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLM 编码式越狱 (encoded jailbreaks)，指出仅靠安全分类器 (guard) 会因只看表面形式而漏掉集合论、形式逻辑、古典语言、代码、图像内文字等重编码请求 (decode gap)。恢复图像内容再解码能把图像渲染类攻击的拦截率从恰好 0 提到 67–90%，但对可自由选择十一种编码的攻击者只是转移成功而非消除；真正降低整体攻击成功率的是对解码前恢复表面做二次筛查的 reguard 步骤，代价是全部十个 guard-target 对的良性过度拒绝都上升。在完整 guard×target×condition 因子扫描中，没有配置能同时把整体攻击成功率压到 40% 及以下且良性过度拒绝低于 70%。
Motivation: 安全分类器只判断输入的表面形式而非语义，有害请求被重编码为集合论、形式逻辑、古典语言、代码或图像内文字即可绕过在明文下会拦截它的 guard，形成 decode gap；标准的预处理恢复+解码方案的实际收益与代价尚不清楚。
Method: 构建一个先恢复图像内容、再解码编码的预处理器 (recover)，并加入对恢复后、解码前表面重新筛查的 reguard 步骤；针对十一种编码攻击的集成评估（六个已发表实现、一个标准编码基线、一个改编与三个作者构造的渲染），任一攻击成功即计为被攻破；在 guard×target×condition 的完整因子设计上比较，并对集成对比做多重比较校正。
Result: 图像渲染类攻击的拦截率从恰好 0 提升到 67–90%；同等约 70 个百分点的拦截增益下，良性拦截代价因 guard 而异，一个 guard 付 9 个百分点、另一个付 69 个百分点；针对该步骤的集成对比没有一个能在多重比较校正后存活；reguard 使全部十个 guard-target 对的良性过度拒绝都上升；完整因子扫描中没有任何配置达到整体攻击成功率 ≤40% 且良性过度拒绝 <70%。
Conclusion: 恢复+解码买到的是覆盖面而非安全性——关掉一个通道会把攻击成功转移走；能压低整体攻击成功率的只有 reguard，且它是每个 guard 都要付的代价。那个空区域是所采样配置的性质，不是恢复类防御的上界，作者自己就越过了它的安全一半。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Do Cheap Probes Predict Expensive Training? Probing 3D-CT Encoders for Text Generation
papers.abstract_en: Building a 3D CT vision language model begins with a choice of which image encoder to build on. Today that choice is made by fine-tuning every candidate through the full language model and comparing downstream scores, an enormously expensive search. A cheap probe on the encoder's representation promises a way out, but whether it forecasts the expensive outcome has never been tested. We test this with CheapCT on report generation and on MeasureVQA, a new VQA dataset we build. MeasureVQA scores the outcome one capability at a time, its answers measured from segmentation masks and Hounsfield units. Report generation scores the whole report at once and reflects mostly disease. CheapCT forecasts expensive training across every capability. The forecast survives changing the probe readout and the language-model backbone. The rank agreement between CheapCT and fine-tuning stays high throughout, from rho = 0.90 to 0.97. Used to choose an encoder, CheapCT picks one nearly as good as the best while fine-tuning a single candidate, at orders of magnitude less compute. We release the code and MeasureVQA at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CheapCT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CheapCT 用对 3D-CT 图像编码器表征的廉价探针来预测「把候选编码器接上语言模型做全量微调」后的下游成绩，从而替代昂贵的编码器搜索。在报告生成与新构建的 MeasureVQA 上，探针预测与全量微调的秩一致性 rho 达 0.90–0.97，且换探针读出方式与换语言模型 backbone 后结论不变；用它选编码器只需微调单个候选，计算量低若干数量级，效果接近最优。
Motivation: 3D CT vision-language 模型起步要选图像编码器，现行做法是把每个候选都接上语言模型全量微调再比下游分数，搜索成本极高；而廉价探针能否真正预测昂贵训练的结果此前从未被检验。
Method: CheapCT 在编码器表征上做廉价探针，预测全量微调后的下游表现；评测覆盖两条路径——报告生成（整份报告一次性打分，主要反映疾病）与作者新构建的 MeasureVQA（按单一能力打分，答案由 segmentation masks 与 Hounsfield units 度量）。另做两项稳健性检验：更换探针读出方式 (probe readout)、更换语言模型 backbone。
Result: CheapCT 与全量微调的秩一致性 rho 在 0.90 到 0.97 之间，且在所有能力上都能预测昂贵训练的结果；换 probe readout 与换语言模型 backbone 后该预测仍成立。用 CheapCT 选编码器，只微调单个候选即可拿到接近最优的结果，计算量比逐个微调低若干数量级。
Conclusion: 对 3D-CT 编码器表征的廉价探针足以预测全量微调的下游排序，编码器选择可以由「全量微调所有候选」改为「探针筛选 + 微调单个候选」，且该结论对探针读出与 backbone 都稳健。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: CheapCT 用对 3D-CT 图像编码器表征的廉价探针来预测「把候选编码器接上语言模型做全量微调」后的下游成绩，从而替代昂贵的编码器搜索。在报告生成与新构建的 MeasureVQA 上，探针预测与全量微调的秩一致性 rho 达 0.90–0.97，且换探针读出方式与换语言模型 backbone 后结论不变；用它选编码器只需微调单个候选，计算量低若干数量级，效果接近最优。
summary_sections.motivation: 3D CT vision-language 模型起步要选图像编码器，现行做法是把每个候选都接上语言模型全量微调再比下游分数，搜索成本极高；而廉价探针能否真正预测昂贵训练的结果此前从未被检验。
summary_sections.method: CheapCT 在编码器表征上做廉价探针，预测全量微调后的下游表现；评测覆盖两条路径——报告生成（整份报告一次性打分，主要反映疾病）与作者新构建的 MeasureVQA（按单一能力打分，答案由 segmentation masks 与 Hounsfield units 度量）。另做两项稳健性检验：更换探针读出方式 (probe readout)、更换语言模型 backbone。

summary_sections.conclusion: 对 3D-CT 编码器表征的廉价探针足以预测全量微调的下游排序，编码器选择可以由「全量微调所有候选」改为「探针筛选 + 微调单个候选」，且该结论对探针读出与 backbone 都稳健。

papers.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation. These results demonstrate that content-aware objectives are key to perceptually faithful compression of generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向扩散模型的重要性感知剪枝 (importance-aware pruning)：把由条件信号或模型注意力导出的空间重要性图并入剪枝目标，使参数排序对齐感知显著区域而非均匀重建误差。在 MS-COCO 上，该训练无关框架在高压缩比下持续保持主体保真与结构正确，而常规剪枝出现可见退化。
Motivation: 扩散模型剪枝通常按均匀重建误差排序参数，忽视图像中语义显著区域，导致高压缩比下主体与结构可见退化。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 剪枝框架：从条件信号或模型注意力生成空间重要性图 (spatial importance maps)，将其并入剪枝目标以得到按感知相关性排序的参数重要性，替代均匀重建误差排序。
Result: 在 MS-COCO 数据集上，该方法在高压缩比下持续保持主体保真与结构正确性，而常规剪枝产生可见退化；摘要未给出具体压缩比或评分数值。
Conclusion: 内容感知的剪枝目标是生成模型感知保真压缩的关键，参数取舍应按感知显著性而非均匀误差分配。

papers.title: Econometrics with Pre-Trained Embeddings for Unstructured Data
papers.abstract_en: Unstructured data, such as images and text, are increasingly used in empirical economics. Since training machine-learning models on unstructured data is costly, economists often use off-the-shelf pre-trained deep learning models developed by computer scientists to extract embeddings, which are then used as covariates in target economic analyses. Despite the popularity of this practice, its theoretical foundations remain limited. There are two main difficulties. First, pre-trained models are typically trained on different datasets and for different tasks, making it unclear when they can be used reliably for the target task. Second, the embedding function is subject to an identification problem, complicating the analysis of its estimation error and the effect of that error on the target task. We provide sufficient conditions to overcome these difficulties. A key condition, which we call transferability, governs the convergence rate we derive. To assess transferability, we develop a computationally feasible bootstrap test that does not require re-estimating the embeddings and nuisance functions. Our theory applies to a wide range of double machine learning applications, including partially linear regression with unstructured controls, price elasticity estimation in demand models accounting for product quality measured by images and text, missing-data imputation using unstructured data, and average treatment effect estimation with unstructured confounders. As an empirical application, we estimate the labor supply elasticity on Amazon Mechanical Turk, an online labor market platform, using job-description embeddings as controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为「用预训练模型 embedding 当协变量」这一经验经济学惯例补齐理论：给出可迁移性 (transferability) 充分条件，据此推导目标估计量的收敛速率，并提出无需重估 embedding 与 nuisance 函数的 bootstrap 检验来判定可迁移性。
Motivation: 预训练模型训练数据与任务各异，且 embedding 函数本身存在识别问题，导致估计误差及其对目标分析的影响难以刻画，该流行做法缺乏理论基础。
Method: 提出 transferability 充分条件以克服数据/任务不匹配与识别问题，推导收敛速率；配套开发计算可行的 bootstrap 检验，无需重新估计 embedding 和 nuisance 函数；理论覆盖 double machine learning 下的部分线性回归、含图像文本质量的需求价格弹性、缺失数据插补与 ATE 估计。
Result: 在 Amazon Mechanical Turk 在线劳动力市场上，用职位描述 (job-description) 的 embedding 作为控制变量估计劳动供给弹性；理论给出由 transferability 决定的收敛速率与相应 bootstrap 检验。
Conclusion: 预训练 embedding 可否用于目标任务由 transferability 条件判定，满足该条件即可纳入 DML 框架并获得可推断的收敛速率。

papers.title: CT-Merging: Consensus Directions and Task-Specific Scaling for LoRA Adapter Merging
papers.abstract_en: LoRA merging methods increasingly operate on the low-rank structure of task updates, yet how the common subspace is estimated and how coefficients are assigned after recomposition are rarely compared directly. We propose CT-Merging, which estimates common directions from averaged task subspace projectors and assigns a separate residual scale to each task. Projector averaging selects directions supported across task subspaces without weighting them by singular magnitude, while task-specific scaling removes component-wise magnitude variation and preserves scale differences across tasks. On the released KnOTS CLIP adapters, CT-Merging achieves the best average and worst-task normalized accuracy on both backbones, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 2.56 and 6.65 points, respectively. On the DC-Merge adapter benchmark, it achieves the best average normalized accuracy in eight of nine backbone and task-count settings. Ablations show that projector averaging outperforms summed-update SVD and that task-specific scaling improves worst-task accuracy over global isotropic scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CT-Merging 用任务子空间投影算子的平均来估计公共方向（不按奇异值幅度加权），重组后为每个任务单独分配残差缩放。在 KnOTS 的 CLIP adapter 上，它在两个 backbone 上同时取得最佳平均与最差任务归一化精度，比最强基线最多高 2.56 与 6.65 个点；在 DC-Merge 上九个 backbone×任务数设置中拿下八个的最佳平均精度。
Motivation: LoRA 合并已转向利用任务更新的低秩结构，但公共子空间如何估计、重组后系数如何分配这两点很少被直接对比。
Method: CT-Merging：对各任务子空间投影算子取平均以选出跨任务被支持的方向（不按奇异幅度加权），重组后为每个任务分配独立的残差 scale，以消除分量级幅度差异并保留任务间尺度差异；消融对比 summed-update SVD 与全局各向同性缩放。
Result: 在发布的 KnOTS CLIP adapters 上，两个 backbone 的平均与最差任务归一化精度均为最佳，较最强基线分别最多提升 2.56 与 6.65 个点；在 DC-Merge adapter 基准的九个 backbone 与任务数设置中，八个取得最佳平均归一化精度。消融显示投影算子平均优于 summed-update SVD，任务特定缩放比全局各向同性缩放提升最差任务精度。
Conclusion: 公共方向应按跨任务支持度而非奇异值幅度来选，且缩放应按任务分别设定，这样能在不牺牲平均精度的前提下抬高最差任务表现。

papers.title: Do Neural Networks Preserve Case Structure? Case-Based Decomposition, Interpretation, and Decision Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks increasingly inform consequential decisions, making their reliability increasingly important. Yet their internal mechanisms provide little evidence of whether decisions remain grounded in the training cases and which cases ultimately support or oppose their outcomes. Without this connection between decisions and training cases, users cannot determine whether a model has learned reliable decision patterns from data. This motivates a fundamental question: do neural networks preserve case structure? We establish a connection between neural networks and Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT), showing that trained neural networks can preserve a recoverable case structure through their learned representations. Such a structure allows fitted decision margins to be decomposed into individual case contributions. We identify the conditions under which this recovered case structure admits a CBDT interpretation. We further establish decision consistency between this interpretation and the decision selected by the original neural network. Experiments on a controlled CBDT setting and three decision tasks based on real-world data validate our approach. These results connect neural network decisions with the cases that shape them. This connection allows model choices to be traced back to supporting and opposing cases, providing a basis for assessing the reliability of neural network decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经网络与 Case-Based Decision Theory (CBDT) 建立对应，证明训练后的网络在学习表示中保留可恢复的 case 结构，从而把拟合的决策边界分解为逐条训练样本的支持或反对贡献，并给出该 CBDT 解释与原网络所选决策一致的条件。在一个受控 CBDT 设定和三个基于真实数据的决策任务上验证了该方法。
Motivation: 神经网络已用于高后果决策，但其内部机制无法说明决策是否仍锚定在训练样本上、哪些样本真正支持或反对该结果，用户因此无法判断模型是否从数据中学到可靠的决策模式。
Method: 建立神经网络与 CBDT 的理论联系，从训练后网络的表示中恢复 case 结构，将拟合的决策边界分解为逐 case 贡献；刻画该结构可作 CBDT 解释的成立条件，并证明此解释与原网络决策之间的一致性 (decision consistency)。
Result: 在一个受控 CBDT 设定和三个基于真实数据的决策任务上的实验验证了该方法；摘要给出的是方法与一致性结论，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 训练后的神经网络可以保留可恢复的 case 结构，模型决策因而能追溯到具体的支持与反对样本，为评估神经网络决策可靠性提供依据。

papers.title: Influence Diagnostics in High-dimensional M-estimation: Precise Asymptotics
papers.abstract_en: The impact of a given training point on a statistical model can be measured through its leave-one-out influence on the model parameters, which quantifies how its removal from the training set affects the learned weights. For convex M-estimation under Gaussian design, in the high-dimensional limit $n\asymp d$, we show that the empirical distribution of influences across training points concentrates around a deterministic measure which we sharply characterize. This characterization suggests that influential samples tend to lie on average close to the decision boundary, making contact with a standard data selection heuristic in active learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高维凸 M-估计（n≈d、高斯设计）中，训练点的 leave-one-out 影响力经验分布收敛到一个可精确刻画的确定性测度；该刻画显示高影响样本平均而言更靠近决策边界，从而与主动学习中按边界距离选数据的标准启发式相接。
Motivation: 高维统计中单个训练点对模型参数的影响力难以解析刻画，缺少可精确计算的极限描述，也就无法解释现有数据选择启发式为何有效。
Method: 针对高斯设计下 n≈d 高维极限的凸 M-估计，推导 leave-one-out 影响力经验分布的确定性极限测度并给出精确刻画（precise asymptotics）。
Result: 证明影响力经验分布在训练点上集中于一个被精确刻画的确定性测度；由此得出高影响样本平均而言靠近决策边界这一结论。
Conclusion: 高维 M-估计的影响力分布有可解析的极限形式，且其结构为按边界距离选样本的主动学习启发式提供了理论接触点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over the evaluated baselines beyond simulation. See the project website at https://github.com/ut-dragon-lab/CoFL

TL;DR: CoFL-S 把视觉-语言导航 (VLN) 的低层动作表示换成语言条件化的局部可见扇区流场 (flow field)，直接 rollout 出连续轨迹，并把整段指令的 VLN-CE episode 改写成帧级局部监督（对齐子指令 + 匹配的 action、trajectory、稠密流场目标）。在自建的连续时间 Habitat 基准（统一速度指令控制器、跨 planner 频率）上，匹配编码器与训练设置时 CoFL-S 在各 planner 频率下均优于基线，零样本真实世界闭环部署同样显示优势。
Motivation: VLN 近年重心在高层指令推理、记忆、全局建图与指令分解，低层动作表示长期被忽视；VLN-CE 的固定离散前进一步/转一步接口又把动作层与指令分解耦合，难以做分解无关的闭环比较。
Method: 提出低层 vision-language-action 框架 CoFL-S：在机器人局部可见扇区上预测语言条件化流场，再 rollout 该流场生成连续轨迹；训练时把「整段指令 + 动作序列」的 VLN-CE episode 转换为帧级局部监督，含对齐子指令与匹配的 action、trajectory、dense flow-field 目标。评测用自建连续时间 Habitat 基准，所有方法经共享 velocity-command controller 执行，可跨 planner 频率比较。
Result: 在匹配编码器与训练设置下，CoFL-S 在连续时间 Habitat 基准的各 planner 频率上均稳定优于基线；零样本真实世界闭环部署相对所评测基线仍显示优势。
Conclusion: 低层动作表示本身（语言条件流场 + 连续 rollout）能在不依赖指令分解的前提下提升 VLN 闭环表现，且该优势可从仿真迁移到真实机器人。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Generative molecular design is shaped by simple proxy benchmarks for drug-like properties and models pretrained on large pharmaceutical datasets. This combination yields strong benchmark metrics but limits transferability to domains structurally distinct from drug discovery. To overcome this limitation and drive discovery toward real, scientifically grounded targets, we introduce the Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark, which bridges machine learning (ML) and quantum materials science. NMO acts simultaneously as a rigorous testbed for the ML community and a discovery engine for nanotechnology research. The suite replaces proxy oracles with quantum simulations and introduces strict protocols that prioritize scientific utility over leaderboard-oriented overfitting. The physics-based NMO tasks impose hard structural constraints and rugged fitness landscapes, posing fundamentally new requirements on generative models. Notably, advanced molecular optimization methods underperform much simpler approaches on the NMO tasks. We develop a new baseline method identifying the critical components to solve the NMO tasks, including a novel representation for modeling structural constraints and a domain-agnostic pretraining strategy to eliminate pharmaceutical dataset bias. Our results surpass state-of-the-art physical properties and reveal previously unknown structural motifs, offering new insights for the nanotechnology community and demonstrating that ML can drive genuine scientific discovery.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NMO Benchmark 把分子生成的评测从药物类代理指标换成量子模拟 oracle，并施加硬结构约束与崎岖适应度地形。在 NMO 任务上，先进的分子优化方法反而不如简单得多的方法；作者给出的新基线（含结构约束新表示与去药企数据偏置的领域无关预训练）超过 SOTA 物理性质并发现此前未知的结构基序。
Motivation: 生成式分子设计被药物性质代理基准和大规模药企预训练数据主导，指标好看但难以迁移到与药物发现结构差异大的领域，也无法驱动真实科学靶点的发现。
Method: 提出 Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark，用量子模拟取代代理 oracle，任务带硬结构约束与崎岖适应度地形；配套新基线方法，包含建模结构约束的新表示和消除药企数据偏置的领域无关预训练 (domain-agnostic pretraining) 策略，并从中识别解题关键组件。
Result: 在 NMO 任务上，先进分子优化方法表现不如简单方法；新基线在物理性质上超过 state-of-the-art，并揭示此前未知的结构基序。
Conclusion: 代理基准上的强指标不等于跨域迁移能力，面向纳米技术的硬约束任务需要新的表示与预训练策略，ML 确实能驱动真实科学发现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TeDiServe: High SLO Attainment Serving for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive language models. By generating multiple tokens in parallel during each denoising step, they offer higher inference throughput while maintaining competitive quality. However, realizing these throughput gains while meeting latency SLOs in a serving system requires addressing challenges introduced by DLMs' unique characteristics. These include navigating the speed-quality tradeoff created by confidence-based denoising, choosing appropriate parallelization levels across model instances under fluctuating load, and coordinating approximate KV caching mechanisms that introduce non-uniform per-step costs. To address these challenges, we present TeDiServe, a cluster-level serving system for DLMs. TeDiServe enables deadline-aware scheduling and adaptive load control through confidence-threshold adjustment, and dynamically reconfigures the cluster by solving a quality-aware optimization problem, while explicitly modeling the step-level heterogeneity introduced by approximate KV caching. Across multiple benchmarks and real-world traces, TeDiServe improves SLO attainment by up to 56.6 percentage points and reduces end-to-end request latency by up to 46\% while incurring less than 1\% accuracy drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TeDiServe 是面向扩散语言模型 (DLM) 的集群级服务系统：通过置信度阈值调整做 deadline 感知调度与自适应负载控制，再求解质量感知优化问题动态重构集群，并显式建模近似 KV caching 带来的逐步开销异质性。在多个 benchmark 与真实负载 trace 上，SLO attainment 最多提升 56.6 个百分点，端到端请求延迟最多下降 46%，精度损失不到 1%。
Motivation: DLM 每个去噪步并行生成多个 token，吞吐高但要同时满足延迟 SLO 很难：基于置信度的去噪带来速度-质量权衡，负载波动下各实例的并行度难以选择，近似 KV caching 又让每步开销不均匀。
Method: 集群级服务系统 TeDiServe：按置信度阈值调整实现 deadline 感知调度与自适应负载控制；求解一个质量感知优化问题动态重构集群（各实例并行度），并在模型中显式刻画近似 KV caching 引入的 step 级异质开销。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 与真实 trace 上，SLO attainment 最多提升 56.6 个百分点，端到端请求延迟最多降低 46%，同时精度下降不到 1%。
Conclusion: 把置信度阈值、集群重构与 KV cache 开销一起纳入调度优化，可以让 DLM 服务在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅提高 SLO 达成率并压低延迟。

papers.title: Statistically Valid Post-Training Hyperparameter Selection: From Tuning to Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Post-training hyperparameter selection is a critical step in the deployment of modern artificial intelligence systems, given the need to tune degrees of freedom of pre-trained models such as inference-time parameters, implementation-level settings, and thresholds driving decision rules. Despite its practical importance, hyperparameter selection is typically performed using best-effort empirical methods such as grid search or Bayesian optimization, which provide no formal statistical guarantees on reliability or safety. This monograph, intended for an audience of signal processing and machine learning researchers, presents a unified statistical framework for reliable post-training hyperparameter selection, centered on the learn-then-test (LTT) paradigm. LTT formulates the hyperparameter selection problem as multiple hypothesis testing over a candidate set of hyperparameters. The framework enables the choice of hyperparameters that provably satisfy application-specific reliability requirements---such as bounds on average risk, quantile risk, or information-theoretic constraints---with explicit, finite-sample control of error probabilities. The supporting statistical machinery, namely p-values, e-values, and concentration inequalities, is developed from first principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于训练后超参数选择的统计学习专著，把超参数选择形式化为候选集上的多重假设检验，用 learn-then-test (LTT) 范式配合 p 值、e 值与集中不等式，使所选超参数以显式有限样本误差概率控制满足平均风险、分位数风险或信息论约束。与网格搜索、贝叶斯优化等尽力而为方法不同，它给出可证明的可靠性保证。
Motivation: 预训练模型部署时需调节推理时参数、实现级设置与决策阈值，但网格搜索、贝叶斯优化等经验方法对可靠性或安全性不提供任何形式化统计保证。
Method: 以 learn-then-test (LTT) 为核心，把候选超参数集上的选择写成多重假设检验问题；从第一性原理推导支撑统计工具，包括 p 值、e 值与集中不等式，用以对平均风险、分位数风险、信息论约束等应用特定可靠性要求施加有限样本误差概率控制。
Result: 所选超参数可被证明满足应用特定可靠性要求（平均风险上界、分位数风险、信息论约束），且误差概率有显式有限样本控制；面向信号处理与机器学习研究者，从第一性原理给出 p 值、e 值与集中不等式的推导。
Conclusion: 训练后超参数选择应从经验调参转为带有限样本统计保证的多重假设检验问题，LTT 提供统一框架。

papers.title: ConSolv: Solvent-Conditional Machine Learning Implicit Solvent Potential
papers.abstract_en: Implicit solvent machine learning potentials (MLPs) offer a powerful route to bridging the gap between accuracy and efficiency in molecular simulations. However, existing models have largely focused on aqueous environments, overlooking the diverse and important roles of non-aqueous solvents in areas such as organic synthesis and battery technology. Here, we present ConSolv, a solvent-conditional MLP architecture that explicitly incorporates solvent effects on solute interactions through an attention-based solvent-embedding block. By combining experimental solvation free energy data with ab initio data, we train a single implicit solvent MLP that is transferable across 66 common organic solvents. ConSolv outperforms classical explicit solvent methods and selected ab initio implicit solvent approaches across multiple solvation free energy benchmarks, and demonstrates generalization to unseen solvents. Beyond solvation free energies, the model shows close agreement with experimental nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) data for $γ$-fluorohydrin molecules in chloroform. ConSolv's architecture is readily extensible to broader chemical spaces and alternative training strategies, while its attention-based design supports explainable artificial intelligence (AI) analysis that can help elucidate complex, solvent-dependent molecular interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConSolv 用基于 attention 的 solvent-embedding block 把溶剂效应显式注入隐式溶剂机器学习势 (implicit solvent MLP)，单个模型即可跨 66 种常见有机溶剂迁移。它在多个溶化自由能基准上超过经典显式溶剂方法与部分 ab initio 隐式溶剂方法，并对未见溶剂泛化；在氯仿中 γ-fluorohydrin 的 NMR 数据上与实验接近。
Motivation: 现有隐式溶剂 MLP 几乎只覆盖水相，而非水溶剂在有机合成与电池技术中作用关键，缺少跨多种溶剂可迁移的统一模型。
Method: 以 attention-based solvent-embedding block 显式编码溶剂对溶质相互作用的影响；将实验溶化自由能数据与 ab initio 数据结合训练单个隐式溶剂 MLP，覆盖 66 种常见有机溶剂，并借助 attention 设计做可解释 AI 分析。
Result: 在多个溶化自由能基准上优于经典显式溶剂方法与选定的 ab initio 隐式溶剂方法，并能泛化到未见溶剂；在氯仿中对 γ-fluorohydrin 分子的 NMR 数据与实验高度一致；训练覆盖 66 种有机溶剂。
Conclusion: 溶剂条件化的 attention 嵌入可让单一隐式溶剂 MLP 跨溶剂迁移并保持精度，架构可扩展到更广化学空间与替代训练策略。

papers.title: Do Location Encoders Capture Spatial Effects? A GeoShapley Benchmark Across Scales
papers.abstract_en: Location encoders transform geographic coordinates into high dimensional embeddings for downstream machine learning, but it is unclear how well these representations capture interpretable spatial effects. We benchmark whether GeoShapley, a game-theoretic explainer that treats all location features as a single joint player, can recover spatially varying coefficients from models built on location-encoder embeddings. Eleven encoders from the TorchSpatial framework are evaluated against a synthetic process with known coefficients, across three scales (grid, county, global), with and without raw coordinates alongside the embedding, and under untrained and contrastively trained conditions. Measuring recovery as the correlation between estimated and true coefficients, we report how it varies with scale and encoder architecture and compare the embeddings against a raw-coordinate baseline. Recovery of the primary coefficient is consistently high across encoders, whereas recovery of a secondary coefficient is more scale-dependent, differing most at the global scale; the raw-coordinate baseline remains competitive throughout.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 1 table; accepted for SIGSPATIAL 2026; revised to match the accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoShapley 把所有位置特征当作一个联合玩家，可以从 location encoder 嵌入中恢复空间变化系数：在 TorchSpatial 的 11 个编码器、grid/county/global 三种尺度、有无原始坐标、未训练与对比学习训练的组合下，主系数恢复相关性始终较高，次系数恢复更依赖尺度且在全球尺度差异最大，而原始坐标基线全程保持竞争力。
Motivation: location encoder 把坐标映射成高维嵌入，但这些表示能否捕捉可解释的空间效应并不清楚，缺少跨尺度、跨架构的可解释性基准。
Method: 用 GeoShapley（把全部位置特征视为单一联合玩家的博弈论解释器）在已知真实系数的合成过程上估计空间变化系数，以估计系数与真实系数的相关性衡量恢复度；评测 TorchSpatial 框架的 11 个编码器，覆盖 grid、county、global 三种尺度，含/不含原始坐标与嵌入拼接，以及未训练与对比学习训练两种条件，并与原始坐标基线对比。

papers.title: NAC: Neural Action Codec for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on discrete action tokenizers to bridge continuous robot control and autoregressive sequence modeling, yet existing tokenizers often trade off between compression, latency, and downstream performance. We revisit this design through the lens of neural audio codecs - convolutional encoder-decoder architectures with residual vector quantization that serve as the standard front end for audio foundation models. Motivated by their success, we introduce the Neural Action Codec (NAC), which treats short robot action trajectories as multi-channel 1D signals and compresses them using a multi-scale RVQGAN architecture. With adaptations to the action representation, compression rate, and reconstruction objective, audio-codec-style models can autoencode actions with high fidelity without substantial architectural changes. NAC provides a compact, ordered token space via offset codebooks, enabling standard autoregressive policies to operate over short, structured sequences. Meanwhile, a Vocos-style decoder with an ISTFT head and adversarial discriminators recovers action trajectories. Across LIBERO-10, RoboMimic, and a suite of real-world manipulation tasks, NAC achieves high reconstruction fidelity and higher average success rates than binning, FAST, and prior VQ-based tokenizers at comparable or better compression rates. These results demonstrate that repurposed neural audio codecs offer a strong, practical backbone for learned action tokenization in modern VLAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NAC 把机器人短动作轨迹当作多通道 1D 信号，用借自神经音频 codec 的多尺度 RVQGAN（含 offset codebook 与 Vocos 式 ISTFT 解码器）压缩成离散动作 token。在 LIBERO-10、RoboMimic 与真实操作任务上，它在相当或更高压缩率下取得高于 binning、FAST 和既有 VQ tokenizer 的平均成功率。
Motivation: VLA 依赖离散动作 tokenizer 桥接连续控制与自回归建模，现有方案在压缩率、延迟与下游性能之间互相牺牲，动作 token 化本身缺少强基线架构。
Method: 把短动作轨迹视作多通道 1D 信号，用多尺度 RVQGAN 编码器-解码器压缩；对动作表示、压缩率与重建目标做适配，用 offset codebook 提供紧凑有序的 token 空间供标准自回归策略使用，解码端采用 Vocos 式 ISTFT 头加对抗判别器恢复轨迹。
Result: 在 LIBERO-10、RoboMimic 及一组真实操作任务上，NAC 实现高重建保真度，并在相当或更高压缩率下取得高于 binning、FAST 与既有基于 VQ 的 tokenizer 的平均成功率。
Conclusion: 改造后的神经音频 codec 可直接充当现代 VLA 学习式动作 token 化的实用骨干，无需大幅改动架构即可兼顾压缩与下游成功率。

papers.title: ThousandWorlds: A benchmark for climate emulation of potentially habitable exoplanets
papers.abstract_en: The search for life beyond Earth will depend on detecting faint signatures in the atmospheres of potentially habitable exoplanets. Interpreting those signatures requires understanding the host planet's climate: the same molecule may signal life on one planet and abiotic chemistry on another. Global climate models (GCMs) provide this understanding, but individual runs can require up to millions of core-hours and substantial domain expert time. Machine-learning emulators could remove this bottleneck, but progress has been limited by the absence of a curated, multi-model exoclimate dataset. We introduce ThousandWorlds, an ML-ready benchmark for exoclimate emulation and for the broader regime of low-data, multi-simulator, parameter-to-field regression. The dataset contains approximately 1,700 simulations from five GCMs, mapping eight planet parameters to 3D atmospheric fields including temperature, humidity, winds, clouds, and radiation. Three nested subsets define progressively harder challenges: single-simulator regression, multi-simulator regression with complete observations, and multi-simulator regression with structured missingness. We propose two evaluation protocols: one for ranking methods, and one that measures performance relative to the disagreement between GCMs themselves. We evaluate ten baselines spanning simple methods, trees, deep learning, and Gaussian processes. GP-based methods perform best, suggesting that ThousandWorlds exposes a regime where off-the-shelf deep learning does not yet succeed. Data: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8695. Code: https://github.com/edstevenson/ThousandWorlds.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. 9 pages main text, 30 pages references/appendix, plus checklist. Data at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8695. Code at https://github.com/edstevenson/ThousandWorlds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThousandWorlds 是一个系外行星气候模拟 (exoclimate emulation) 基准：约 1,700 次五个 GCM 的模拟，把八个行星参数映射到含温度、湿度、风、云、辐射的 3D 大气场，并按难度分三个嵌套子集。评测十个基线后 GP 类方法表现最好，说明该低数据、多模拟器 regime 下现成深度学习尚不奏效。
Motivation: GCM 单次运行可达数百万 core-hours 并占用大量领域专家时间，而 ML 气候模拟器进展受限于缺少策展好的多模式系外气候数据集。
Method: 构建 ML-ready 数据集：约 1,700 次模拟、五个 GCM、八个行星参数到 3D 大气场的回归；设三个嵌套子集（单模拟器回归、多模拟器完整观测、多模拟器结构化缺失），提出排序协议与相对 GCM 间分歧的协议，评测十个覆盖简单方法、树模型、深度学习与 Gaussian process 的基线。
Result: 数据集约含 1,700 次模拟、五个 GCM、八个输入参数与 3D 温度/湿度/风/云/辐射场；十个基线中 GP-based 方法表现最佳，提示该基准暴露出现成深度学习尚未成功的 regime。
Conclusion: 系外气候模拟在低数据、多模拟器、参数到场回归这一 regime 下，Gaussian process 优于现成深度学习，基准以此作为方法排序的参照。

papers.title: Amortized quadrature for posterior expectations in inverse problems
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty in the solution of an inverse problem and in the tasks performed on it is quantified by posterior expectations, each an average of an integrand over $M$ posterior samples. While designed quadratures improve on the $O(M^{-1/2})$ error of Monte-Carlo estimation, they solve an optimization problem, often against the posterior density, for every new observation, which can be computationally costly. To address this limitation, we introduce the quadrature field, a set-equivariant network that maps an observation and its $M$ posterior samples to an $M$-node signed-weight quadrature in one forward pass. Trained once on a family of posteriors to minimize the worst-case integration error over a class of functions, it serves any observation, any $M$ and any integrand in that class with no further optimization. We show that, with high probability and up to a computable slack, the resulting quadrature is never worse than the Monte-Carlo estimate built from the same samples. We validate the quadrature field on closed-form and on learned posteriors, one constrained by a partial differential equation, where it improves on the Monte-Carlo estimate in median at every node count, often by orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 quadrature field：一个 set-equivariant 网络，把一次观测及其 M 个后验样本一次前向映射为带符号权重的 M 节点求积规则，训练一次即可对任意观测、任意 M、函数类内任意被积函数直接给出后验期望估计，无需逐次优化。在高概率意义下其误差不超过同样本数的 Monte-Carlo 估计；在闭式与学习得到的后验（含一个受 PDE 约束的后验）上，各节点数的中位误差均优于 MC，常达数量级改进。
Motivation: 反问题的后验期望要对 M 个后验样本做平均，Monte-Carlo 误差只有 O(M^{-1/2})；已有改进型求积法对每个新观测都要解一次优化（常针对后验密度），逐次计算代价高。
Method: 引入 quadrature field：set-equivariant 网络，输入一次观测与其 M 个后验样本，单次前向输出 M 节点带符号权重求积；在一族后验上一次性训练，目标是最小化某函数类上的最坏情形积分误差。
Result: 理论上以高概率、至多一个可计算的松弛，所得求积误差不差于用同样本构造的 Monte-Carlo 估计；在闭式后验与学习后验（其中一个受偏微分方程约束）上，每个节点数的中位误差都优于 MC，常改进若干数量级。
Conclusion: 把逐观测求积优化换成一次训练的前向映射，可在保持 MC 之下误差保证的同时，把后验期望的逐次计算成本降为单次前向。
