papers.title: EmoZone-Talker: Regional Semantic Control of Audio-Driven 3DGS Talking Heads via Facial Action Units
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown strong potential for high-fidelity talking head synthesis. However, enabling fine-grained, interpretable, and editable facial expression control remains fundamentally challenging due to intrinsic conflicts between speech-driven facial dynamics and explicit expression signals. Existing methods rely on implicit multimodal fusion, leading to spatial entanglement and temporal instability. We present EmoZone-Talker, a novel framework that reformulates audio-driven facial animation as a structured spatial-temporal coordination problem under cross-modal conflicts. Our approach introduces an explicit spatial disentanglement and temporal dynamics modeling of facial motion. Specifically, we propose Synergy Zones with Prioritized Attention Bias (SZ-PAB) to explicitly decouple modality contributions via region-wise constraints guided by anatomical priors, and a Channel-Independent Temporal AU Encoder (CIT-AE) to model temporally coherent AU dynamics. By integrating these representations into 3D Gaussian deformation, EmoZone-Talker enables precise and interpretable control over facial expressions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method improves expression controllability and realism, with notable gains in upper-face accuracy and temporal coherence, while preserving high rendering quality and accurate lip synchronization. Code will be publicly released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmoZone-Talker 把音频驱动的说话头合成重构为跨模态冲突下的时空协调问题，用解剖先验引导的区域约束（SZ-PAB）显式解耦语音与表情信号的模态贡献，再用通道独立时间 AU 编码器（CIT-AE）建模时序连贯的面部动作单元动态，最后并入 3D Gaussian 变形。实验显示表情可控性与真实感提升，上半脸精度和时序连贯性改善，同时保持高渲染质量与准确唇同步。
Motivation: 语音驱动的面部动态与显式表情信号存在内在冲突，现有方法依赖隐式多模态融合，导致空间纠缠与时序不稳定，难以做细粒度、可解释、可编辑的表情控制。
Method: 提出 Synergy Zones with Prioritized Attention Bias (SZ-PAB)，按解剖先验做区域级约束以显式解耦各模态贡献；配合 Channel-Independent Temporal AU Encoder (CIT-AU) 建模时序连贯的 AU 动态；两路表征整合进 3D Gaussian 变形以驱动说话头。
Result: 大量实验显示该方法提升表情可控性与真实感，上半脸精度 (upper-face accuracy) 与时序连贯性有明显增益，同时保持高渲染质量和准确唇同步；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把音频驱动表情控制显式拆成区域解耦加时间 AU 建模，可在不牺牲渲染质量与唇同步的前提下改善可控性与稳定性；代码将公开发布。

papers.title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
papers.abstract_en: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of 18 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/tok), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, qwen2.5:0.5b and tinyllama:1.1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.2747 J/tok and 0.3234 J/tok) and the highest throughput (>325 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 8.6x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:0.8b(on) exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 本地部署 LLM 因隐私与本地推理需求增长，但消费级硬件上的能耗成本刻画不足，多数基准只测精度不测功耗。
Method: 在单张消费级 GPU（RTX 4060 Ti 16GB）上用 Ollama 推理引擎运行 18 个 0.5B–7B 开源 LLM，用 nvidia-smi 以 2Hz 采样 GPU 功率，固定 prompt 集，统计平均/峰值功率、每 prompt 总能耗 (J/prompt)、每输出 token 能耗 (J/tok) 与吞吐 (tok/s)。

papers.title: SciR: A Controllable Benchmark for Scientific Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Three paradigmatic forms of inference recur across scientific reasoning: deduction, induction, and causal abduction. Reliably evaluating LLMs on these in scientific settings is currently out of reach: scientific benchmarks built on human annotations are costly and lack mechanistic ground truth, while synthetic logical-reasoning benchmarks do not resemble real scientific documents. We introduce SciR, a benchmark that combines multi-paradigm reasoning with controllable scientific rendering, anchored on three paradigmatic scientific problems. Tasks are generated from formal objects (deduction tree, inductive rule hypothesis, causal graph) to guarantee verifiable answers, then rendered into multi-document scientific discourse via per-track domain-tuned genres. The construction lets us independently vary two difficulty axes: how hard it is to extract the key information needed for inference, and how hard the principled inference itself is. We test six models. Both axes hurt every model, and their effects compound. The rendering even hurts neurosymbolic pipelines, which hand inference to a verified solver. The two axes yield a per-model extraction-vs-inference profile: for instance, reasoning models like deepseek-r1 mostly surpass non-reasoning instruct models on the inference axis. To our knowledge, SciR is the first multi-paradigm scientific-reasoning benchmark with parametric control on both extraction and inference difficulty.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets track). v2: camera-ready version with corrected induction scoring and new analyses."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciR 从形式对象（deduction tree、inductive rule hypothesis、causal graph）生成可验证答案的科学推理任务，再渲染成多文档科学论述，从而独立调节“信息抽取难度”与“推理本身难度”两条轴。测试六个模型后发现两条轴都使所有模型表现变差且效应叠加，渲染甚至拖累把推理交给已验证求解器的 neurosymbolic 流水线；deepseek-r1 这类推理模型主要在推理轴上超过非推理 instruct 模型。
Motivation: 基于人工标注的科学基准成本高且缺少 mechanistic ground truth，而合成逻辑推理基准又不像真实科学文档，导致 LLM 的科学推理能力难以可靠评测。
Method: SciR 以三种范式性科学问题为锚，从形式对象生成任务以保证答案可验证，再按 per-track domain-tuned genres 渲染为多文档科学论述；构造方式允许独立改变抽取难度与推理难度两条轴，并给出每个模型的 extraction-vs-inference profile。
Result: 测试六个模型：两条难度轴都使每个模型表现下降且效应叠加；渲染同样损害 neurosymbolic 流水线；deepseek-r1 等推理模型大体只在推理轴上超过非推理 instruct 模型。
Conclusion: SciR 被作者称为首个在抽取与推理难度上都具备参数化控制的多范式科学推理基准，评测 LLM 时必须把“读不出关键信息”和“推不出来”分开度量。

papers.title: Genetic Algorithms with Optimization Guided Operators
papers.abstract_en: Recent work in ML applies genetic algorithms at inference time to iteratively improve solutions to optimization problems. The basic mutation and recombination operators involved are qualitatively different from those studied classically. Mutations are no longer random; an ML algorithm mutates a solution with the goal of improving an objective. Similarly, recombination is not based on random collages of parent solutions. Instead, it is an ML optimization-based operator whose goal is to synthesize improved solutions from its inputs. Thus, these mutation and recombination operators are more likely to improve the objective, but their computational cost is much higher. We introduce a general model of genetic algorithms and formulate optimization in this model as a query complexity problem, using the language of reinforcement learning. We demonstrate three fundamental phenomena. First, we show that diversity of the solution pool can be necessary: for parity learning, viewed in our framework, we show that with pool size $w$ and vectors of length $n$, the optimal query complexity is $Θ(w+2^{n-w})$. We further show that this phenomenon persists under general memory constraints: $Θ(n^2)$ bits of memory are necessary for efficient success. Second, we show that generation, mutation, and recombination can all be simultaneously necessary to reach a nearly optimal solution. Finally, we give a phase transition for Gaussian distributions, showing that a positive {\em drift} of the operators yields exponential speedup.
papers.comment: Added references to the literature, other small changes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把推理时用 ML 算子做变异/重组的遗传算法形式化为查询复杂度问题（用 RL 语言），证明解池多样性对 parity 学习是必要的：池大小 w、向量长度 n 时最优查询复杂度为 Θ(w+2^{n-w})，且高效成功需要 Θ(n²) bit 内存。生成、变异、重组三者可同时必要；对高斯分布给出相变结论——算子带正 drift 时带来指数级加速。
Motivation: ML 驱动的变异与重组算子比经典随机算子更可能改进目标但计算代价高，其查询复杂度与所需多样性缺少统一的理论刻画。
Method: 提出遗传算法的一般模型，用强化学习语言把其中的优化表述为查询复杂度问题；在 parity 学习上分析解池大小与内存约束下的下界，并对高斯分布分析算子 drift 的相变。
Result: parity 学习在池大小 w、向量长度 n 下最优查询复杂度为 Θ(w+2^{n-w})；高效成功需要 Θ(n²) bit 内存；生成、变异、重组可同时为达到近似最优解所必需；高斯分布下算子正 drift 导致指数级加速。
Conclusion: 解池多样性与内存是这类推理时遗传算法的硬性资源，而算子是否带正 drift 决定加速是指数级还是没有。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning for humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation within one policy. A natural design choice is between a single (unified) critic that estimates the combined value of all objectives and separate (dual) critics with disjoint reward signals. We compare the two on the Unitree G1 humanoid in NVIDIA Isaac Lab. In the standing mode of a standardized evaluation, the dual-critic run reaches targets 3.5x faster (6.5 vs. 22.6 simulation steps), achieves 2x the throughput (14.3 vs. 7.0 validated reaches per 1,000 steps) and a higher validated reach rate (65.2% vs. 53.8%) than the unified-critic run. That evaluation pins the fingers open for every policy, whereas the unified run had trained driving its own. When the unified run drives its own fingers, with nothing else changed, the standing-mode gap falls from 3.5x to 1.3x in speed and from 2x to 1.1x in throughput. This is a single re-evaluation of a single checkpoint, and we do not generalize from it. Adding five anti-gaming reward mechanisms to the dual critic did not raise validated reach rate (60.9% vs. 65.2%). The two runs differ not only in the critic but also in the PPO update rule (one summed advantage under one likelihood ratio, versus a per-stream advantage and a ratio per actor), and further in curriculum, arm action dimensionality, finger control and reward weights; each is a single run. The measurement therefore cannot separate the critic from the update rule. We argue that critic architecture deserves explicit treatment as a design variable in multi-objective humanoid RL, and specify the single-variable ablation needed to establish its causal contribution. Code, checkpoints and a project page: https://mturan33.github.io/critic-architecture-matters/
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Reinforcement Learning in the Era of Imitation Learning (RL4IL), Vienna. 7 pages, 2 figures. v3 fixes the workshop name and the unified run's description; with its own fingers driven, the standing-mode gap falls from 3.5x/2x to 1.3x/1.1x (speed/throughput; one re-evaluation). No retraining. https://mturan33.github.io/critic-architecture-matters/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人（NVIDIA Isaac Lab）上对比多目标 RL 的双 critic 与统一 critic：站立模式标准化评测中双 critic 达标快 3.5 倍（6.5 vs 22.6 仿真步）、吞吐 2 倍（每千步 14.3 vs 7.0 次有效抓取）、有效抓取率 65.2% vs 53.8%。但该评测把所有策略的手指钉死张开，而统一 critic 训练时驱动自己的手指；让它驱动自己的手指后（其余不变），速度差距从 3.5 倍缩到 1.3 倍、吞吐从 2 倍缩到 1.1 倍。作者据此主张把 critic 架构当作多目标人形 RL 的显式设计变量，并指出当前两次 run 同时差了 PPO 更新规则、课程、动作维度、手指控制与奖励权重，无法把差异归因于 critic 本身。
Motivation: 多目标人形 RL 需要在一个策略里同时协调运动与操作，critic 是选单一统一值函数还是按奖励流拆成双 critic 缺乏受控证据；现有对比被混杂变量污染，无法分离 critic 架构的因果贡献。
Method: 在 Unitree G1 与 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 上各跑一次 unified critic 与 dual critic 的 PPO 训练：dual 版按不相交奖励流给每个 actor 一个 advantage 与 likelihood ratio，unified 版用单一汇总 advantage 与单一 ratio。另在 dual critic 上加五种 anti-gaming 奖励机制做一次对照，并对统一 run 的 checkpoint 做一次不重训的重新评测（改由其自己驱动手指）。
Result: 站立模式：dual 达标 6.5 vs unified 22.6 仿真步（3.5 倍），吞吐 14.3 vs 7.0 次有效抓取/千步（2 倍），有效抓取率 65.2% vs 53.8%。统一 run 自驱手指后差距缩到 1.3 倍（速度）与 1.1 倍（吞吐），为单 checkpoint 单次重评。五种 anti-gaming 机制未提升抓取率（60.9% vs 65.2%）。
Conclusion: critic 架构应作为多目标人形 RL 的显式设计变量，但当前两次 run 的差异无法与 PPO 更新规则等混杂因素分离，需要单变量 ablation 才能确立其因果贡献；作者明确表示不从单次重评结果做推广。

papers.title: Bergson: An Open Source Library for Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Data attribution is a promising field in interpretability that aims to explain model behavior through the influence of its training data, with applications including debugging undesirable model behavior and training dataset curation. However, significant engineering effort is required to perform it at scale, and many cutting edge techniques lack open-source tooling and support. Bergson is an open source library that aims to enable faster progress in the field by providing a host of techniques that scale to very large language models and pre-training datasets. The library natively supports on-disk gradient stores and multi-node distributed training, and provides quality of life tools for researchers. Finally, we introduce the first open-source implementations of three leading data attribution methods: MAGIC, SOURCE, and TrackStar. The library is available at https://github.com/EleutherAI/bergson .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Bergson 是一个开源的数据归因 (data attribution) 库，把可扩展到超大语言模型与预训练数据集的归因技术打包成统一工具，原生支持磁盘上的梯度存储 (on-disk gradient stores) 与多节点分布式训练。它首次开源实现了三个主流数据归因方法 MAGIC、SOURCE 和 TrackStar，代码在 github.com/EleutherAI/bergson。
Motivation: 数据归因需要大量工程投入才能在大规模上执行，许多前沿技术缺少开源工具与支持，阻碍了该可解释性方向的进展。
Method: 提供一套可扩展到超大 LLM 与预训练数据集的归因技术集合，原生支持 on-disk gradient stores 与多节点分布式训练，并附带研究用的辅助工具；其中包含 MAGIC、SOURCE、TrackStar 三个领先数据归因方法的首个开源实现。
Result: 发布开源库 Bergson 及其代码仓库，内含 MAGIC、SOURCE、TrackStar 三个领先数据归因方法的首个开源实现，支持 on-disk gradient stores 与多节点分布式训练。
Conclusion: 把规模化数据归因的工程细节沉淀成开源库，可降低调试异常模型行为与训练数据集筛选的门槛，加快该领域进展。

papers.title: Attention-Discounted Adaptive Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models can reduce inference steps by revealing multiple tokens per denoising iteration, but this parallelism is fragile: positions that are individually confident may be unsafe to commit together when their predictions are coupled. Existing training-free samplers such as Top-\(k\), Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler mainly control how many tokens to reveal, while often ranking candidates by token-wise scores that ignore interactions within the selected set. We propose ADAS, a training-free reranking rule that leaves the base sampler's stopping rule unchanged and greedily discounts each token-wise confidence score according to its attention to already selected positions, weighted by their prediction uncertainty. Across LLaDA-8B-Base and Dream-7B-Base on the reasoning benchmarks GSM8K and MATH500 and the code benchmarks HumanEval and MBPP, plugging ADAS into all three samplers improves low-NFE performance at matched denoiser evaluations by \(9.11\) and \(10.46\) percentage points on average, respectively, with \(3.1\%\) per-forward runtime overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/yusufsahin99/ADAS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADAS 是面向掩码扩散语言模型 (masked diffusion LLM) 的免训练重排序规则：保持基采样器的停止准则不变，按已选位置的注意力与其预测不确定性，贪心折扣每个 token 的置信分，从而避免逐位置自信但联合提交不安全的并行解码。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 与 Dream-7B-Base 上接入 Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler 三种采样器，低 NFE 下 GSM8K 与 MATH500 平均提升 9.11 与 10.46 个百分点，单次前向额外开销 3.1%。
Motivation: 掩码扩散 LLM 每轮揭示多 token 可减少推理步数，但逐位置分数忽略所选集合内部的耦合，单个自信的位置一起提交并不安全；现有免训练采样器 Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler 主要控制揭示数量，排序仍用 token-wise 分数。
Method: ADAS 作为免训练重排序规则叠加在既有采样器上：不动其停止准则，对每个 token-wise 置信分按其对已选位置的 attention 做贪心折扣，并以这些位置的预测不确定性加权；代码已开源。
Result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Base 与 Dream-7B-Base 上，于推理基准 GSM8K、MATH500 与代码基准 HumanEval、MBPP，把 ADAS 接入 Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler 三种采样器后，在相同去噪器评估次数的低 NFE 设定下，前两个基准平均提升 9.11 个百分点、后两个平均提升 10.46 个百分点，每次前向运行时开销 3.1%。
Conclusion: 并行揭示 token 的安全性取决于集合内的注意力耦合与不确定性，而不只是各自分数的排序；用注意力折扣重排序即可在几乎不增加运行时的前提下改善低 NFE 质量，且可即插即用地叠加到不同采样器上。

papers.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers from a pool of unstructured, automatically collected documents, and a Solver that improves by training on them. The solver is trained with standard correctness rewards against the generator-provided answers, while the generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score that measures whether each proposed question would actually improve the solver on the target distribution. Because this continuous, noisy influence score is poorly served by standard GRPO, we propose DuGRPO, a dual-normalized variant of GRPO, for generator training. Together, these turn the document pool into an adaptive curriculum that favors questions useful to the current solver, not just hard ones. On Qwen3-8B-Base, INFUSER outperforms strong self-evolution baselines with over 20% relative improvement on Olympiad and SuperGPQA benchmarks, and an 8B INFUSER co-evolving generator outperforms a frozen 32B thinking generator on math and coding. Ablations confirm each design choice is necessary, and two extensions, applying INFUSER to an instruction-finetuned anchor and augmenting it with rule-verifiable RLVR data, further demonstrate the flexibility and generalizability of the framework. Code is available at https://github.com/FFishy-git/INFUSER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INFUSER 用文档池同时训练生成器与求解器：生成器按 optimizer-aware influence score 出题（而非难度启发式），求解器按正确性奖励训练，并提出双归一化变体 DuGRPO 来训练这个连续含噪的 influence 信号。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，Olympiad 与 SuperGPQA 相对提升超过 20%，8B 共同进化生成器在数学与代码上胜过冻结的 32B thinking 生成器。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法要么依赖大量人工整理或教师生成的训练数据，要么在无监督生成时用难度启发式奖励生成器，而难度未必让求解器变强。
Method: 迭代共训练框架含两个共进化角色：Generator 从自动收集的非结构化文档池起草题目与参考 golden answer，Solver 在其上以针对参考答案的正确性奖励训练；Generator 用衡量题目能否真正改进目标分布上求解器的 optimizer-aware influence score 作奖励，因该信号连续且含噪、标准 GRPO 不适配，提出双归一化的 DuGRPO 训练生成器，从而把文档池变成偏向当前求解器有用题目的自适应课程。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，INFUSER 在 Olympiad 与 SuperGPQA 上相对强自进化基线提升超过 20%；8B 的 INFUSER 共同进化生成器在数学与代码上胜过冻结的 32B thinking 生成器。消融确认每项设计选择都必要，另有两个扩展（用于 instruction-finetuned anchor、以及加入 rule-verifiable RLVR 数据）检验框架的灵活性与泛化性。
Conclusion: 用 optimizer-aware influence 而非难度来奖励生成器，能把文档池变成自适应课程，让小模型的自进化超过更大冻结教师；代码已开源。

papers.title: QueryGraph: Reliable Multi-Tool Query Execution Planning via LLM-Based Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world queries over personal data span multiple applications and require structured planning, as individual tools expose only partial information. While LLMs show strong reasoning and tool use, reliably executing multi-step, cross-tool queries remains challenging. We introduce a system that converts natural language queries into structured graphs and executes them via a deterministic planner. Our approach uses depth-first search to resolve dependencies and combine results across tools, improving reliability and enabling queries beyond traditional keyword-based search. We demonstrate high accuracy even with smaller or locally hosted LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QueryGraph 把自然语言查询转成结构化图，再用确定性规划器按深度优先搜索 (DFS) 解析跨工具依赖并合并结果，从而可靠执行多步、跨应用查询。作者演示即使使用较小或本地部署的 LLM 也能达到高准确率。
Motivation: 个人数据上的查询往往跨多个应用、每个工具只暴露部分信息，LLM 虽有推理与工具使用能力，但多步跨工具查询的可靠执行仍是难点，传统关键词搜索也覆盖不了这类查询。
Method: 系统将自然语言查询转换为结构化图，由确定性规划器执行：用深度优先搜索解析工具间依赖并跨工具合并结果，从而替代纯 LLM 的逐步决策。
Result: 在演示中，即使使用较小或本地托管的 LLM，系统仍达到高准确率；摘要未给出具体数值、数据集或基线对比。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的角色限定为图生成、把执行交给确定性规划器，可以在小模型上实现可靠的多步跨工具查询，并支持超出关键词搜索能力的查询。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Bounds for Sparse Covariance Estimation in the Vertical-Split Distributed Model
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimax estimation error for distributed covariance matrix estimation in the vertical-split (feature-split) setting, where two agents each observe different coordinates of~$m$ i.i.d.\ sub-Gaussian samples and communicate a limited number of bits to a central server. While \cite{rahmani2025fundamental} established nearly tight bounds for dense (unstructured) cross-covariance matrices, we investigate whether imposing elementwise $s$-sparsity on the cross-covariance $C_{21}$ can reduce the required communication and sample complexity. We show that sparsity can reduce the communication required for cross-covariance estimation in the vertical split at a fixed target distortion. Specifically, for sufficiently large $d_1d_2/s'$ and $0<\varepsilon<σ^2\sqrt{s'}/32$, any scheme achieving expected Frobenius distortion at most $\varepsilon$ must satisfy $B_k = Ω(σ^4 d_k\, s' \log(d_1 d_2/s')/\varepsilon^2)$ and $m = Ω(σ^4\, s' \log(d_1 d_2/s')/\varepsilon^2)$ for cross-covariance estimation, where $s' = s \wedge d_{\min}$. For the $1$-sparse case, our achievable scheme reduces the $d_1d_2$ factor in the dense communication rate to $\log(d_1d_2)$, up to polylogarithmic factors, for the cross-covariance communication component in the matching regime. Our lower bounds are established via Fano's method with an explicit sparse packing using a Varshamov--Gilbert-type argument for signed partial permutation matrices combined with the Conditional Strong Data Processing Inequality of \cite{rahmani2025fundamental}. We show that the communication lower bound is tight up to polylogarithmic factors under the conditions of Remark 4.9, using an achievable scheme based on covering-net quantization and entry-wise hard thresholding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 vertical-split（特征切分）分布式协方差估计中，对交叉协方差 C21 施加逐元素 s-稀疏可在固定失真下降低通信与样本复杂度：当 d1d2/s' 足够大且 0<ε<σ²√s'/32 时，期望 Frobenius 失真 ≤ε 的方案必须满足 Bk = Ω(σ⁴ d_k s' log(d1d2/s')/ε²) 与 m = Ω(σ⁴ s' log(d1d2/s')/ε²)。1-稀疏情形下可达方案把稠密通信率中的 d1d2 因子降到 log(d1d2)（差 polylog 因子）。
Motivation: Rahmani et al. 2025 已给出稠密（无结构）交叉协方差在分布式设定下的近紧界，但稀疏结构能否降低 vertical-split 下的通信与样本需求尚无结论。
Method: 下界用 Fano 方法，构造基于 Varshamov--Gilbert 论证的 signed partial permutation matrix 稀疏打包，结合 Conditional Strong Data Processing Inequality；上界用 covering-net 量化加 entry-wise hard thresholding 的可达方案，其中 s' = s ∧ d_min。
Result: 在 d1d2/s' 足够大且 0<ε<σ²√s'/32 时，通信下界 Bk = Ω(σ⁴ d_k s' log(d1d2/s')/ε²)、样本下界 m = Ω(σ⁴ s' log(d1d2/s')/ε²)；1-稀疏情形下交叉协方差通信分量的 d1d2 因子降为 log(d1d2)（差 polylog 因子）；在 Remark 4.9 条件下通信下界 polylog 紧。
Conclusion: 稀疏性确实能降低 vertical-split 交叉协方差估计的通信需求，且该下界在给定条件下 polylog 紧。

papers.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Right-Censored Survival Data
papers.abstract_en: Proper scoring rules provide a rigorous theoretical basis for the training and evaluation of probabilistic forecasts. In survival analysis, such forecasts describe the distribution of the time until an event occurs. However, this event time is often only partially observed because follow-up may end before the event occurs, resulting in right censoring. We propose a framework for proper scoring of right-censored survival outcomes based on a simple idea: first, map the predictive distribution through the censoring mechanism, then apply the underlying proper score on the induced observed-data law. This yields localized scores for fixed censoring times and marginalized scores when the censoring time is random or only partially observed. The resulting construction recovers familiar right-censored likelihood and IPCW-type criteria within a coherent framework, while also yielding right-censored versions of the CRPS, pinball loss, Brier score, and energy score. We show that the marginalized construction is proper under conditional independent censoring and, for strictly proper base scores, identifies the latent joint CDF on the identifiable region. The same principle also leads to censored engression, a sample-based learning objective for multivariate right-censored survival modeling. In experiments, our scores correctly rank the oracle forecast across several censoring regimes, whereas forecast-dependent plug-in weighted scores can exhibit ranking reversals. Censored engression likewise substantially improves over naive training on censored outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出右删失生存数据的 proper scoring 框架：先把预测分布经删失机制映射到观测数据分布，再在其上套用底层 proper score，得到 CRPS、pinball loss、Brier score、energy score 的右删失版本。在多种删失机制下，该分数能正确排序 oracle 预测，而依赖预测的 plug-in 加权分数会出现排序反转；配套的 censored engression 样本式目标也显著优于在删失结果上直接训练。
Motivation: 概率预报的 proper score 依赖完整观测的事件时间，但生存数据常在事件发生前随访结束形成右删失，直接套用会破坏评分的 propriety 与排序可靠性。
Method: 两步构造：将预测分布通过删失机制映射为观测数据律，再施加底层 proper score；删失时间固定时得 localized scores，随机或部分观测时得 marginalized scores。该原则同时导出右删失版 CRPS、pinball loss、Brier score、energy score，以及样本式目标 censored engression 用于多元右删失建模。
Result: 在若干删失机制下，所提分数能正确排序 oracle 预测，而 forecast-dependent plug-in 加权分数会出现排序反转；censored engression 相比在删失结果上朴素训练有显著提升。理论上 marginalized 构造在条件独立删失下是 proper 的，对严格 proper 的底层分数可在可识别区域上识别潜在联合 CDF。
Conclusion: 经删失机制变换后再套底层 proper score 是统一构造右删失评分的正确路径，可回收右删失似然与 IPCW 类准则，并避免 plug-in 加权带来的排序反转。

summary_sections.tldr: 提出右删失生存数据的 proper scoring 框架：先把预测分布经删失机制映射到观测数据分布，再在其上套用底层 proper score，得到 CRPS、pinball loss、Brier score、energy score 的右删失版本。在多种删失机制下，该分数能正确排序 oracle 预测，而依赖预测的 plug-in 加权分数会出现排序反转；配套的 censored engression 样本式目标也显著优于在删失结果上直接训练。

summary_sections.method: 两步构造：将预测分布通过删失机制映射为观测数据律，再施加底层 proper score；删失时间固定时得 localized scores，随机或部分观测时得 marginalized scores。该原则同时导出右删失版 CRPS、pinball loss、Brier score、energy score，以及样本式目标 censored engression 用于多元右删失建模。
summary_sections.result: 在若干删失机制下，所提分数能正确排序 oracle 预测，而 forecast-dependent plug-in 加权分数会出现排序反转；censored engression 相比在删失结果上朴素训练有显著提升。理论上 marginalized 构造在条件独立删失下是 proper 的，对严格 proper 的底层分数可在可识别区域上识别潜在联合 CDF。
summary_sections.conclusion: 经删失机制变换后再套底层 proper score 是统一构造右删失评分的正确路径，可回收右删失似然与 IPCW 类准则，并避免 plug-in 加权带来的排序反转。

papers.title: Statistical Priors for Implicit Preferences: Decoupling Skill Selection as a Local Harness in Personal Agents
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities advance, locally deployed personal agents relying on API-based remote models and external skills have emerged as a novel paradigm. With the rapid expansion of available skills, enabling personal agents to learn and adapt to implicit user preferences becomes a critical challenge. However, local deployment constraints preclude complex centralized selection algorithms, creating an urgent need for a lightweight local preference harness. This paper explores the implementation of such a harness through a novel architecture that strictly decouples statistical preference learning from semantic intent parsing. Specifically, we leverage localized statistical results to influence and modulate the selection decisions of the remote LLM. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our decoupled approach achieves the lowest cumulative regret and highest test accuracy, significantly outperforming traditional memory-augmented agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对本地部署的个人 agent 难以学习用户隐式偏好，提出把统计偏好学习与语义意图解析严格解耦的轻量本地 harness，用局部统计结果去调制远程 LLM 的技能选择决策。评测中该解耦方案取得最低累计 regret 与最高测试准确率，显著优于传统记忆增强 agent。
Motivation: 本地部署的个人 agent 依赖 API 远程模型与不断增多的外部技能，但本地算力约束排除了复杂的集中式选择算法，缺少轻量的本地偏好 harness。
Method: 设计严格解耦的架构：统计偏好学习独立于语义意图解析，用本地化的统计结果影响并调制远程 LLM 的技能选择决策，作为本地 harness。
Result: 在评测中取得最低累计 regret 和最高测试准确率，显著优于传统记忆增强 agent（memory-augmented agents）；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把偏好统计与意图解析解耦、由统计量调制远程 LLM 选择，可在本地部署约束下比记忆增强 agent 更好地适配隐式用户偏好。

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hide-and-Seek 把 VLA 执行失败检测建模为粗监督 (coarsely supervised) 学习问题，用轨迹间与轨迹内对比目标从仅有轨迹级标签的数据中定位失败动作，产生时间结构化的失败信号，无需逐步标注。在 LIBERO、VLABench 与真实机器人平台上对 OpenVLA、π0、π0.5 三种策略达到 SOTA 多任务失败检测性能，并在 conformal prediction 下给出实用的精度—时效权衡，对见过与未见任务均能泛化。
Motivation: VLA 模型在真实部署中易发生执行失败，而现有检测方法要么依赖昂贵的动作重采样或外部模型，要么把轨迹级标签均匀传播到每个时间步，掩盖了局部化的失败信号。
Method: 提出 Hide-and-Seek 框架：将失败检测表述为粗监督学习，结合 inter-trajectory 与 intra-trajectory 两种对比目标，仅用轨迹级监督诱导时间结构化的失败信号并定位失败指示性动作；推理阶段配合 conformal prediction 控制精度与时效的权衡。
Result: 在 LIBERO、VLABench 及真实机器人平台上，针对 OpenVLA、π0、π0.5 三种代表性 VLA 策略，取得 state-of-the-art 的多任务失败检测性能，并在 conformal prediction 下实现实用的 accuracy–timeliness 权衡；对 seen 与 unseen 任务均泛化良好。
Conclusion: 仅靠轨迹级标签加对比目标即可定位失败时刻，无需逐步标注或动作重采样，足以支撑 VLA 的运行时失败监控并迁移到未见任务。

papers.title: Efficient Safety Benchmarking via Item Response Theory
papers.abstract_en: Safety benchmarks for language models are typically evaluated using static paradigms that treat all items as equally informative for all models, an assumption that is particularly problematic for adversarial, highly heterogeneous safety items. Applied in full to modern benchmark suites, current evaluation procedures would require on the order of $10^5$ responses, most of which provide little ranking signal. We analyze six widely used safety benchmarks and make three contributions toward more efficient safety evaluation. First, we show that Item Response Theory (IRT) recovers interpretable structure on safety benchmarks, with ability estimates resolving differences among models that cluster at the ceiling of raw safety metrics. Second, we show that adaptive item selection, which dynamically chooses informative items for each model based on its responses, approximates full-benchmark rankings (Spearman's $ρ>$ 0.90), reducing evaluation cost by at least 80% on every benchmark where this threshold is attainable, and by up to 99.9%, achieved on AIR-Bench 2024. Third, we introduce a practical procedure for extracting a fixed, informative subset of items reusable across models, a static alternative to adaptive selection with savings of 80--99.8% across benchmarks. Together, these results establish that psychometric methods enable benchmark-aware reductions in evaluation costs across the safety evaluation pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用项目反应理论 (Item Response Theory, IRT) 替代等信息量假设的静态安全评测，在六个常用语言模型安全基准上按模型作答动态挑选有信息量的题目，以 Spearman ρ>0.90 近似全量排名，每个可达该阈值的基准评测成本至少降 80%，AIR-Bench 2024 上最高降 99.9%。
Motivation: 安全基准把所有题目当作对所有模型同等有信息量，而对抗性、高度异质的题目使这一假设失效；按现有流程全量评测现代基准需要约 10^5 次响应，其中多数不提供排名信号。
Method: 在六个广泛使用的安全基准上拟合 IRT，得到可解释的能力估计；再按模型历史作答动态选择信息量高的题目做自适应选题 (adaptive item selection)，并给出抽取固定题目子集、可跨模型复用的静态替代流程。
Result: 自适应选题近似全量基准排名的 Spearman ρ>0.90，在每个可达该阈值的基准上成本至少降 80%，AIR-Bench 2024 上最高降 99.9%；固定子集流程在各基准上节省 80–99.8%；IRT 能力估计可区分在原始安全指标上聚在天花板的模型。
Conclusion: 心理测量学方法可以让安全评测按基准特性削减成本，同时在原始指标饱和处仍保留模型间区分度，且自适应与固定子集两条路径都可用。

papers.title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy. CODESKILL extracts multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, evolves skills with new experience, and maintains a compact skill bank for future task solving. We train CODESKILL with reinforcement learning, using a hybrid reward that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent. Experiments on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2 show that CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 11.03 over the no-skill baseline and by 5.10 over the strongest prompt-based or memory baseline, while maintaining a compact skill bank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CODESKILL 把编码 agent 的轨迹蒸馏成可复用程序性技能，并把技能抽取与技能库维护本身形式化为一个用强化学习训练的管理策略，而非固定提示加启发式更新规则。混合奖励结合基于 rubric 的稠密技能质量反馈与来自冻结下游 agent 的稀疏可验证执行反馈。在 EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2 上，平均通过率较无技能基线提升 11.03，较最强的 prompt 或 memory 基线提升 5.10，同时保持技能库紧凑。
Motivation: 现有技能构建与维护方法依赖固定提示和启发式更新规则，无法回答知识应如何被选择、抽象和维护才能最好地服务下游 agent。
Method: 以 LLM 为底座，从编码 agent 轨迹中抽取多粒度程序性技能，用新经验演化技能并维护紧凑技能库；用强化学习训练该管理策略，奖励为基于 rubric 的稠密技能质量反馈与冻结下游 agent 给出的稀疏可验证执行反馈的混合。
Result: 在 EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2 上，平均 pass rate 较 no-skill 基线提高 11.03，较最强的 prompt-based 或 memory 基线提高 5.10，且技能库保持紧凑。
Conclusion: 技能的选择、抽象与维护可以作为一个可学习的管理策略来训练，用可验证执行反馈驱动的强化学习比固定提示加启发式规则更能提升下游 agent 的任务通过率。

papers.title: Large Language Model Selection with Limited Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Choosing a Large Language Model (LLM) for a given task requires comparing many strong candidates, yet standard evaluation relies on costly annotations over fixed evaluation sets. To address this challenge, we develop SELECT-LLM, the first framework for active model selection of LLMs. SELECT-LLM aims to find a small set of queries whose annotations are most informative for identifying the best LLM for a given task. To this end, we introduce a query selection rule based on expected information gain, computed from pairwise similarities between candidate model outputs. Because this rule only uses generated model responses, SELECT-LLM can be applied across candidate models without assumptions about their architecture or access to model weights. This makes it suitable for both open-weight and black-box LLMs. We evaluate SELECT-LLM across 23 datasets, 156 evaluated models, diverse task families, and multiple text evaluation metrics. Across all experiments, SELECT-LLM improves over the strongest baseline in every setting, with annotation cost reductions up to 81.8% for best model selection and up to 84.78% for near-best model selection.
papers.comment: This submission was uploaded as a separate arXiv entry in error. It is a revised version of arXiv:2510.09418, which will be updated instead
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SELECT-LLM 是首个面向 LLM 的主动模型选择框架：用候选模型输出之间的两两相似度计算期望信息增益，挑出标注信息量最大的少量查询，从而用最少的人工标注找出给定任务上最好的 LLM。在 23 个数据集、156 个候选模型和多种文本评测指标上，它在每一种设置中都优于最强基线，最佳模型选择的标注成本最多降低 81.8%，近最佳模型选择最多降低 84.78%。
Motivation: LLM 选型要在大量强候选间比较，标准做法依赖对固定评测集的昂贵人工标注；标注成本高且与架构无关的主动选择方法此前缺失。
Method: SELECT-LLM：基于期望信息增益的查询选择规则，信息增益由候选模型输出的两两相似度算出；只用生成的响应，不假设架构、不访问权重，因此同时适用于开源权重与黑盒 LLM。
Result: 在 23 个数据集、156 个被评估模型、多类任务与多种文本评测指标上，SELECT-LLM 在全部实验中每种设置都超过最强基线；最佳模型选择的标注成本最多降低 81.8%，近最佳模型选择最多降低 84.78%。
Conclusion: 只靠模型输出相似度驱动的期望信息增益，就能在不接触权重的前提下大幅压缩 LLM 选型所需标注量，且对开源与黑盒模型通用。

summary_sections.result: 在 23 个数据集、156 个被评估模型、多类任务与多种文本评测指标上，SELECT-LLM 在全部实验中每种设置都超过最强基线；最佳模型选择的标注成本最多降低 81.8%，近最佳模型选择最多降低 84.78%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 只靠模型输出相似度驱动的期望信息增益，就能在不接触权重的前提下大幅压缩 LLM 选型所需标注量，且对开源与黑盒模型通用。

papers.title: Smooth Piecewise Cutting for Neural Operator to Handle Discontinuities and Sharp Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have achieved strong performance in learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs), but their inherently continuous representations struggle to capture discontinuities and sharp transitions. Existing approaches typically approximate such features within continuous function spaces, often requiring increased model capacity and high-resolution data. In this work, we propose Cut-DeepONet, a two-stage training framework that explicitly models discontinuities while reducing learning complexity. Our approach reformulates the problem via a lifting strategy, partitioning the domain into smooth subregions while representing discontinuities as boundaries in a higher-dimensional space. This separation aligns the operator learning task with the inductive bias of neural networks and avoids directly approximating discontinuities. An additional network predicts input-dependent discontinuity locations for unseen inputs, which are then used to guide the neural operator in generating smooth components within each region. Experiments on benchmark PDEs show that Cut-DeepONet outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when trained on low-resolution datasets. The method excels on problems with discontinuities and sharp transitions, while using fewer trainable parameters. Our results highlight the benefits of changing the representation of operator learning rather than increasing model complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cut-DeepONet 用两阶段训练显式建模 PDE 解的间断：先以提升策略 (lifting) 把区域切成光滑子域、把间断表示为高维空间中的边界，再用一个辅助网络预测未见输入的间断位置来引导神经算子分段生成光滑分量。在基准 PDE 上超过 SOTA，且在低分辨率训练数据下仍成立，可训练参数更少。
Motivation: 神经算子的连续表示难以捕捉间断与陡峭过渡，现有方法在连续函数空间内硬逼近，往往需要更大模型容量和高分辨率数据。
Method: 两阶段训练框架：提升策略将定义域划分为光滑子域、把间断重写为高维空间中的边界，使任务对齐神经网络的归纳偏置；第二个网络预测输入相关的间断位置，用于指导神经算子在各子域内生成光滑分量。
Result: 在基准 PDE 实验上优于 state-of-the-art 方法，即使训练数据为低分辨率；在含间断与陡峭过渡的问题上表现突出，且使用更少的可训练参数。
Conclusion: 改变算子学习的表示方式比增加模型复杂度更有效，间断应被显式建模为边界而非在连续空间中硬拟合。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: MSAlign: Aligning Molecule and Mass Spectra representations for Metabolite Identification
papers.abstract_en: Accurately identifying metabolites i.e. small molecules from mass spectrometry data remains a core challenge in metabolomics, with broad applications in drug discovery, environmental analysis, and clinical research. We address the Molecule Retrieval task, which consists in recovering the chemical structure of a metabolite from its MS/MS spectrum given a set of candidate molecules. We make three contributions. First, we propose a unified framework encompassing recent approaches based on representation alignment and contrastive learning. Second, we introduce MSAlign, a lightweight model that achieves state-of-the art performances by aligning two frozen foundation models (DreaMS for mass spectra and MolDeBERTa for molecules) and demonstrate that a score fusion strategy further improves the performance for a very small computational cost. Third, we investigate a long-standing evaluation problem: data splitting strategies in molecule retrieval implicitly trade off data leakage against domain shift. We formalize this tension by introducing a quantitative measure of distribution shift, and use it to evaluate splitting strategies in existing benchmarks. All datasets, splits, candidate sets, and a unified implementation of MSAlign and baselines are publicly released to support reproducible research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSAlign 用轻量对齐头把两个冻结的 foundation model（质谱 DreaMS 与分子 MolDeBERTa）的表示对齐，实现从 MS/MS 谱检索候选分子结构，并称达到 state-of-the-art，叠加 score fusion 还能进一步提升且计算开销极小。同时把分子检索中数据划分的泄漏与域偏移权衡形式化为一个可量化的分布偏移度量，用于评估既有 benchmark 的划分策略。
Motivation: 代谢物鉴定依赖从 MS/MS 谱恢复化学结构，而既有分子检索 benchmark 的数据划分在数据泄漏与域偏移之间隐式取舍，缺乏量化标准，导致性能比较不可靠。
Method: 提出统一框架归纳表示对齐与对比学习两类方法；MSAlign 冻结 DreaMS（质谱）与 MolDeBERTa（分子）两个 foundation model，仅训练轻量对齐模块，并加入 score fusion 策略；另引入分布偏移的量化度量来评估既有划分策略，公开全部数据集、划分、候选集与统一实现。
Result: MSAlign 达到 state-of-the-art 表现，score fusion 在极小计算开销下进一步提升性能；提出的分布偏移量化度量被用于评估现有 benchmark 的数据划分策略。
Conclusion: 冻结 foundation model 加轻量对齐即可在分子检索上取得 SOTA，score fusion 是低成本增益项；分子检索的评测必须显式权衡数据泄漏与域偏移，划分策略应按量化分布偏移来选择。

papers.title: C2P-VAR: Continual and Compositional Personalization in Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have recently emerged as an efficient paradigm for text-to-image generation, yet their personalization capabilities remain largely limited to static, single-concept settings. In practice, users may continuously introduce new concepts and wish to compose multiple personalized concepts within a single image. Such scenarios pose two fundamental challenges: catastrophic forgetting during sequential personalization and feature interference during multi-concept composition. In this work, we study continual and compositional personalization in VAR models and propose C2P-VAR, a unified framework addressing both challenges. For continual personalization, we introduce C2PVAR-S, which identifies concept-relevant parameters from gradient magnitudes and dynamically updates their selection during training. To preserve previously learned concepts, C2PVAR-S applies regularization only to parameters shared by the current and historical concepts, thereby reducing unnecessary interference without introducing additional model components. For multi-concept personalization, we further propose C2PVAR-M, which employs parallel global and concept-specific branches with spatially localized feature fusion and logit aggregation to achieve controllable concept placement and reduce feature entanglement. Extensive experiments on continual and multi-concept personalization demonstrate that C2P-VAR consistently outperforms existing baselines in subject fidelity, while maintaining competitive text alignment and introducing negligible storage and inference overhead. Our results establish a unified framework for scalable and controllable personalization of visual autoregressive models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C2P-VAR 把视觉自回归 (VAR) 模型的个性化从单概念静态设定扩展到连续新增概念与单图多概念组合：C2PVAR-S 按梯度幅值筛选概念相关参数并动态更新选择，只对新旧概念共享参数施加正则以抑制灾难性遗忘；C2PVAR-M 用并行全局分支与概念专属分支做空间局部特征融合和 logit 聚合，控制概念摆放并减少特征纠缠。实验显示其在主体保真度 (subject fidelity) 上持续优于现有基线，同时保持有竞争力的文本对齐，存储与推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: VAR 模型的个性化目前局限于静态单概念设定，而实际使用中用户会连续引入新概念并希望在一张图里组合多个个性化概念；顺序个性化会灾难性遗忘，多概念组合会特征干扰。
Method: C2PVAR-S 依据梯度幅值识别概念相关参数并在训练中动态更新该选择，且只对当前概念与历史概念共享的参数施加正则，从而减少不必要干扰而不引入额外模型组件。C2PVAR-M 采用并行的全局分支与概念专属分支，配合空间局部特征融合 (spatially localized feature fusion) 与 logit 聚合，实现可控的概念摆放。
Result: 在连续个性化与多概念个性化实验中，C2P-VAR 在主体保真度上持续优于现有基线，同时保持有竞争力的文本对齐，存储与推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者认为 C2P-VAR 为视觉自回归模型的可扩展、可控个性化提供了一个统一框架，同时处理顺序学习的遗忘与多概念组合的干扰两类问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: HiLiftAeroML: A High-Fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics Dataset for High-Lift Aircraft Aerodynamics
papers.abstract_en: HiLiftAeroML is, to our knowledge, the first open high-fidelity computational fluid dynamics dataset dedicated to high-lift aircraft aerodynamics. It contains 1,800 simulations spanning 180 variants of the NASA Common Research Model high-lift configuration and ten angles of attack from $4^\circ$ to $22^\circ$. Each case was generated with a GPU-accelerated explicit wall-modeled large-eddy simulation approach on solution-adapted grids of 300--500 million cells, covering attached, separated, and post-stall flow conditions. Comparisons with wind-tunnel measurements for reference landing configurations show good agreement in integrated loads and sectional pressures, with grid adaptation substantially improving drag and pitching-moment predictions. The CC-BY-4.0 release includes geometries, time-averaged surface and volume fields, integrated loads, validation material, and deterministic benchmark splits. Initial GeoTransolver and Transolver baselines, evaluated on the complete native surface and volume support of every held-out case rather than on a sampled subset, reconstruct the fields well for several interpolation and held-out-geometry tests, while high-angle separated flow, limited-data training, and out-of-distribution flow-regime shifts remain substantially harder. The dataset and baselines provide a common resource for developing and assessing data-driven models for realistic high-lift aerodynamics.
papers.comment: 70 pages. v2: expanded with GeoTransolver and Transolver baselines, native-support evaluation, updated CFD and data-quality documentation, computational-cost analysis, and public score-reproduction artifacts and checkpoints (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33993865)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiLiftAeroML 是首个面向高升力飞机气动的开源高保真 CFD 数据集，含 NASA Common Research Model 高升力构型 180 个变体、10 个攻角（4°–22°）共 1,800 个 GPU 加速壁模态 LES 算例，网格 3–5 亿单元。GeoTransolver 与 Transolver 基线在完整原生面/体支撑上重建流场良好，但高攻角分离流、少数据训练与分布外流态偏移仍明显更难。
Motivation: 数据驱动气动模型缺少覆盖附着、分离与失速后全流态的高保真公开基准，现有工作多在采样子集或窄构型上评测，难以公平比较。
Method: 用 GPU 加速显式壁模态大涡模拟 (wall-modeled LES) 在解自适应网格 (solution-adapted grids, 300–500M 单元) 上生成 1,800 个算例；发布几何、时间平均表面/体积场、积分载荷、风洞验证材料与确定性 benchmark splits；v2 增加 GeoTransolver 与 Transolver 基线及分数复现工件。
Result: 与风洞测量对比，参考着陆构型的积分载荷与截面压力吻合良好，网格自适应显著改善阻力与俯仰力矩预测；GeoTransolver/Transolver 在每个留出算例的完整原生表面与体积支撑上（而非采样子集）对多种插值与留出几何测试重建良好，但高攻角分离流、有限数据训练与 OOD 流态偏移仍显著更难。
Conclusion: 高升力气动的数据驱动评测应基于完整原生支撑与确定性划分，且当前 Transformer 类基线尚不足以处理高攻角分离与分布外流态。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Rebalancing Reference Frame Dominance to Improve Motion in Image-to-Video Models
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-video models often generate videos that remain overly static, compared to text-to-video models. While prior approaches mitigate this issue by weakening or modifying the image-conditioning signal, they often require additional training or sacrifice fidelity to the reference image. In this work, we identify reference-frame dominance as a key mechanism behind motion suppression. We observe that non-reference frames in I2V models allocate excessive self-attention to reference-frame key tokens, causing reference information to be over-propagated across time and suppressing inter-frame dynamics. Based on this finding, we propose DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider), a training-free and model-agnostic method that rebalances the attention pathway from generated frames to the reference frame during initial denoising steps. DyMoS leaves both the input image and model weights unchanged and introduces a single scalar parameter for continuous control over motion strength. Experiments across multiple state-of-the-art I2V backbones demonstrate that DyMoS consistently improves motion dynamics while maintaining visual quality and fidelity to the reference image.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sh0xed98b8.github.io/DyMoS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: I2V 生成视频偏静的根因是参考帧主导 (reference-frame dominance)：非参考帧把过多 self-attention 分给参考帧的 key token，使参考信息跨时间过度传播、压制帧间动态。DyMoS 在初始去噪步重新平衡生成帧到参考帧的注意力通路，训练无关、模型无关，只引入一个标量连续调节运动强度，且不改动输入图像与模型权重。
Motivation: I2V 模型生成的视频普遍比 T2V 更静态；已有方法靠削弱或改写图像条件信号来缓解，但往往需要额外训练，或牺牲对参考图像的保真度。
Method: DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider)：定位到非参考帧对参考帧 key token 的过度 self-attention，在初始去噪步骤重新平衡生成帧到参考帧的注意力通路；训练无关、模型无关，输入图像与模型权重保持不变，用单个标量连续控制运动强度。
Result: 在多个 SOTA I2V backbone 上的实验中，DyMoS 一致提升运动动态，同时保持视觉质量与对参考图像的保真度；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 参考帧主导是 I2V 运动抑制的关键机制，仅在推理期重标定注意力通路即可在不牺牲保真度的前提下增强运动。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: I2V 模型生成的视频普遍比 T2V 更静态；已有方法靠削弱或改写图像条件信号来缓解，但往往需要额外训练，或牺牲对参考图像的保真度。
summary_sections.method: DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider)：定位到非参考帧对参考帧 key token 的过度 self-attention，在初始去噪步骤重新平衡生成帧到参考帧的注意力通路；训练无关、模型无关，输入图像与模型权重保持不变，用单个标量连续控制运动强度。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 SOTA I2V backbone 上的实验中，DyMoS 一致提升运动动态，同时保持视觉质量与对参考图像的保真度；摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 参考帧主导是 I2V 运动抑制的关键机制，仅在推理期重标定注意力通路即可在不牺牲保真度的前提下增强运动。

papers.title: Federated Martingale Posterior Samping
papers.abstract_en: Federated Bayesian neural networks require fixing a prior on the model parameters, which is notoriously difficult, and misspecification of this prior can severely degrade accuracy and calibration. Motivated by the rapid progress of predictive models, the martingale posterior, also known as predictive Bayes, replaces the prior--likelihood pair with a predictive distribution and recovers parameter uncertainty by repeatedly drawing predictive samples and refitting the model. This letter proposes {federated martingale posterior} (FMP) sampling, a one-shot embarrassingly parallel protocol in which each client uploads a small set of trainable data embeddings and the server runs the predictive sampler centrally. Analysis of the sampling error demonstrates the impact of the dataset compression rate, while experiments show that FMP closely matches the centralized counterpart and achieves the lowest mean expected calibration error (ECE) among the evaluated one-shot federated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出联邦鞅后验 (federated martingale posterior, FMP) 采样：把 prior–likelihood 换成预测分布，各客户端只上传少量可训练数据嵌入，由服务器集中跑预测采样器，一次通信即可完成联邦贝叶斯神经网络的不确定性推断。采样误差分析给出数据压缩率的影响；实验中 FMP 与集中式结果接近，并在所评估的一次性联邦方法中取得最低的平均期望校准误差 (ECE)。
Motivation: 联邦贝叶斯神经网络必须人为指定参数先验，先验误设会同时损害精度与校准；鞅后验虽绕开先验，但直接搬到联邦场景需要各客户端反复重拟合、通信代价高。
Method: 用鞅后验 (predictive Bayes) 取代 prior–likelihood 对，通过反复抽取预测样本并重拟合模型恢复参数不确定性；FMP 协议中每个客户端上传一组可训练的数据嵌入，服务器在中心侧运行预测采样器，构成一次性、天然并行的流程，并对采样误差随数据压缩率的变化给出分析。
Result: 实验显示 FMP 与集中式对应方法高度吻合，并在所评估的一次性 (one-shot) 联邦方法中取得最低的平均期望校准误差 (ECE)；采样误差分析刻画了数据集压缩率对采样误差的影响。
Conclusion: 把数据压缩后的嵌入上传给中心预测采样器，可以在一次性联邦设定下逼近集中式鞅后验的不确定性质量，同时缓解先验误设问题。

papers.title: Tabular Imbalanced Learning: A Survey, Benchmark, and Practical Guide
papers.abstract_en: Imbalanced learning remains a fundamental challenge in tabular data applications. Despite decades of research and numerous proposed methods, there is still limited systematic understanding of how different imbalance-handling strategies perform across diverse data regimes and computational constraints, making practical method selection difficult. In this work, we provide a systematic survey of tabular imbalanced learning and introduce Tabular Imbalanced Learning Benchmark (TILBench), a large-scale empirical benchmark for evaluating existing methods. We first organize imbalanced learning approaches into a unified taxonomy and then benchmark more than 40 representative methods across 57 tabular datasets under a standardized evaluation protocol, examining overall predictive performance, sensitivity to dataset characteristics, and computational scalability. Our results show that no single method consistently dominates across all settings. Instead, the effectiveness of different strategies depends strongly on dataset regimes and computational constraints, highlighting the need for regime-aware method selection. Based on these findings, we provide practical recommendations for selecting imbalanced learning methods under different data conditions and identify open challenges and promising directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出表格不平衡学习基准 TILBench，在统一评测协议下横评 40 余种方法、57 个表格数据集，覆盖预测性能、对数据集特性的敏感度与计算可扩展性。结论是没有任何方法在所有设定下稳定占优，策略效果强烈依赖数据分布与算力条件，因此方法选择必须按 regime 决策。
Motivation: 表格不平衡学习方法众多但缺少跨数据分布与算力约束的系统对照，实践者难以判断在自己的数据条件下该选哪一类策略。
Method: 先给出不平衡学习方法的统一分类体系 (taxonomy)，再以标准化评测协议在 57 个表格数据集上基准测试 40 余种代表性方法，考察总体预测性能、对数据集特性的敏感性与计算可扩展性。
Result: 覆盖 40 余种方法、57 个表格数据集；核心发现为无单一方法在所有设定下持续占优，各策略效果强烈依赖数据集 regime 与计算约束。
Conclusion: 不平衡学习方法应按数据条件与算力做 regime-aware 选择，并据此给出不同数据条件下的选型建议与后续开放问题。

papers.title: Mixed neural posterior estimation for simulators with discrete and continuous parameters
papers.abstract_en: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) enables rapid parameter inference for complex simulators with intractable likelihoods. NPE trains an inference network to estimate a probability density over parameters given data, typically assumed to be \emph{continuous}. However, many scientific models involve parameter spaces that are \emph{mixed}, that is, they contain both discrete and continuous dimensions. We address this limitation by extending NPE to mixed parameter spaces through an inference network that jointly handles discrete and continuous parameters. The inference network factorizes the joint posterior into discrete and continuous components, combining an autoregressive classifier for the discrete parameters with a generative model for the continuous parameters, trained jointly under a single simulation-based objective. In addition, we propose a diagnostic tool to assess the calibration of the mixed posterior approximation. Across tractable toy examples and real-world scientific simulators, our joint inference approach yields accurate and calibrated posteriors. The inference framework is available in the \texttt{sbi} Python package.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) 扩展到离散+连续混合参数空间：推断网络把联合后验分解为离散与连续两部分，用自回归分类器处理离散参数、生成模型处理连续参数，在同一个 simulation-based 目标下联合训练，并配套一个混合后验校准诊断工具。在可解 toy examples 与真实科学模拟器上，该联合推断给出准确且校准的后验，实现已进入 sbi Python 包。
Motivation: 标准 NPE 假设参数连续，而许多科学模型的参数空间同时含离散与连续维度，现有 NPE 无法直接给出这类混合参数的后验。
Method: 推断网络将联合后验因子化为离散与连续分量：离散参数用自回归分类器 (autoregressive classifier)，连续参数用生成模型，两者在单一 simulation-based 目标下联合训练；另提出评估混合后验校准度的诊断工具，代码发布于 sbi 包。
Result: 在可解 toy examples 与真实科学模拟器上，联合推断方法得到准确且校准的 (accurate and calibrated) 混合后验；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把离散与连续参数放进同一个训练目标联合推断，可以在混合参数模拟器上得到校准的后验，且该框架已作为可用工具发布在 sbi 中。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Supervised Deep Multimodal Matrix Factorization for Interpretable Brain Network Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal brain network analysis faces a persistent trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability. Deep neural networks achieve high accuracy but behave as black boxes that reveal little about the brain modules driving their decisions, whereas matrix factorization methods provide parts-based interpretability yet remain largely shallow, unsupervised, and restricted to a single view, integrating modalities through predefined or heuristic fusion rules. To bridge this gap with a formulation that couples hierarchical modeling capacity with structured, interpretable representations and data-driven fusion, we present Supervised Deep Multimodal Matrix Factorization (SD3MF), an interpretable framework for integrative brain network analysis that generalizes Symmetric Nonnegative Matrix Tri-Factorization (SNMTF) from unsupervised single-graph clustering to supervised prediction over populations of multimodal graphs. SD3MF learns deep hierarchical factorizations for each modality together with a shared latent representation that aligns subjects across modalities. An encoder-decoder formulation jointly optimizes graph reconstruction and supervised prediction, while adaptive weights enable data-driven multimodal fusion. By representing each subject through community-level interaction matrices, the model yields interpretable and discriminative features. Experiments on multimodal connectome datasets show that SD3MF consistently outperforms strong deep learning baselines such as {Convolutional Neural Networks and Graph Neural Networks}, while enabling biologically interpretable insights. Code for reproducibility is available at https://github.com/amjadseyedi/SD3MF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出监督式深度多模态矩阵分解 SD3MF，把对称非负矩阵三因子分解 (SNMTF) 从无监督单图聚类推广到多模态图的群体监督预测：每个模态做深层分层分解，共享潜表示对齐被试，编码器-解码器联合优化图重构与预测，自适应权重实现数据驱动融合。在多模态 connectome 数据集上稳定优于 CNN、GNN 等深度学习基线，同时给出社区级交互矩阵的生物学可解释特征。
Motivation: 多模态脑网络分析长期在预测精度与可解释性之间取舍：深度网络精度高但黑箱，矩阵分解可解释却浅层、无监督、限于单一视图，融合依赖预设或启发式规则。
Method: SD3MF 将 SNMTF 推广为监督预测框架：对每个模态学习深层分层因子分解，并学得跨模态对齐被试的共享潜表示；编码器-解码器形式联合优化图重构与监督预测，自适应权重做数据驱动多模态融合；每个被试以社区级交互矩阵表示，产出可解释且有判别力的特征。
Result: 在多模态 connectome 数据集上的实验中，SD3MF 稳定优于 CNN、GNN 等强深度学习基线，并同时给出生物学可解释的分析结果；代码发布于 github.com/amjadseyedi/SD3MF。
Conclusion: 分层矩阵分解与数据驱动融合结合，可以在群体多模态脑网络预测上同时拿到深度网络的精度和 parts-based 可解释性，不必在两者之间二选一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grid-Orch: An LLM-Powered Orchestrator for Distribution Grid Simulation and Analytics
papers.abstract_en: The power distribution engineering workforce faces a projected shortage of up to 1.5 million engineers by 2030, creating urgent demand for more accessible analysis tools. This paper introduces Grid-Orch, a framework that bridges Large Language Models (LLMs) and power system simulation through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling engineers to perform complex distribution analyses via natural language. Using OpenDSS as the reference implementation, Grid-Orch provides 36 domain-specific tools across eleven categories, covering power flow, voltage analysis, quasi-static time series (QSTS) simulation, and automated optimization. A provider-agnostic LLM layer supports both cloud-hosted (Gemini, Claude) and locally deployed (Ollama, llama-cpp) models, enabling air-gapped operation for security-sensitive utility environments. Three optimization skills, capacitor placement, voltage violation analysis, and overvoltage mitigation, extend the platform beyond single-tool queries to multi-step engineering workflows. Grid-Orch is delivered as an interactive web platform with chat-based interaction, a QSTS dashboard, and feeder topology visualization, and renders simulation results inline. Workflow demonstrations show that distribution analyses formerly requiring hours of scripting, such as distributed energy resource (DER) interconnection screening, complete in under two minutes through natural language, producing numerically identical results to direct OpenDSS scripting.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Open Access Journal of Power and Energy, vol. 13, pp. 727-738, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Grid-Orch 用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 把 LLM 接到 OpenDSS 配电网仿真上，提供 36 个领域工具与三个多步优化 skill，让工程师用自然语言完成原本要写脚本的配电分析。演示中分布式能源 (DER) 并网筛查从数小时缩短到 2 分钟以内，结果与直接 OpenDSS 脚本数值完全一致。
Motivation: 预计到 2030 年电力配电工程人才缺口高达 150 万人，复杂配电分析依赖脚本编写，门槛高、效率低，需要更易用的分析工具。
Method: 以 OpenDSS 为参考实现，通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 暴露 36 个分属十一类的领域工具，覆盖潮流、电压分析、准稳态时序 (QSTS) 仿真与自动优化；LLM 层 provider-agnostic，支持云端 Gemini/Claude 与本地 Ollama、llama-cpp 部署以实现 air-gapped 运行；内置电容器选址、电压越限分析、过电压缓解三个优化 skill，交付为带聊天界面、QSTS 仪表盘与馈线拓扑可视化的 Web 平台。
Result: 工作流演示中，原本需要数小时脚本编写的 DER 并网筛查经自然语言在 2 分钟内完成，且与直接 OpenDSS 脚本产生数值完全一致的结果；平台提供 36 个工具、十一类覆盖与三个优化 skill。
Conclusion: LLM 加 MCP 的编排层可把多步配电工程工作流压到分钟级并保持与手写 OpenDSS 脚本的数值一致性，且本地模型部署使其可用于安全敏感的电力公司环境。

papers.title: CaC: Advancing Video Reward Models via Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Concentrating
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Concentrate and Concentrate (CaC), a coarse-to-fine anomaly reward model based on Vision-Language Models. During inference, it first conducts a global temporal scan to anchor anomalous time windows, then performs fine-grained spatial grounding within the localized interval, and finally derives robust judgments via structured spatiotemporal Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To equip the model with these capabilities, we construct the first large-scale generated video anomaly dataset with per-frame bounding-box annotations, temporal anomaly windows, and fine-grained attribution labels. Building on this dataset, we design a three-stage progressive training paradigm. The model initially learns spatial and temporal anchoring through single- and multi-frame supervised fine-tuning, and then is optimized by a reinforcement learning strategy based on two-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Beyond conventional accuracy rewards, we introduce Temporal and Spatial IoU rewards to supervise the intermediate localization process, effectively guiding the model toward more grounded and interpretable spatiotemporal reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CaC can stably concentrate on subtle anomalies, achieving a 25.7% accuracy improvement on fine-grained anomaly benchmarks and, when used as a reward signal, CaC reduces generated-video anomalies by 11.7% while improving overall video quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CaC 是基于 VLM 的由粗到细视频异常奖励模型：先全局时序扫描定位异常时间窗，再在区间内做细粒度空间定位，最后用结构化时空 Chain-of-Thought 给出判断。在细粒度异常基准上准确率提升 25.7%，作为奖励信号时把生成视频的异常降低 11.7% 并提升整体视频质量。
Motivation: 视频生成模型会产生时间与空间上的异常，现有奖励模型难以同时给出准确判断和可解释的时空定位，无法为生成过程提供有依据的监督信号。
Method: 构建首个大规模生成视频异常数据集，含逐帧 bounding box、异常时间窗与细粒度归因标签；三阶段渐进训练：单帧与多帧监督微调学习时空锚定，再用两轮 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 强化学习优化，并在常规准确率奖励之外引入 Temporal IoU 与 Spatial IoU 奖励监督中间定位过程。
Result: 在细粒度异常基准上准确率提升 25.7%；作为奖励信号使用时，生成视频异常减少 11.7%，同时整体视频质量提升。
Conclusion: 把异常判断拆成时间窗锚定、空间定位与时空 CoT 推理，并用时空 IoU 奖励监督中间定位，可使奖励模型更接地、更可解释，从而稳定抓住细微异常并反哺视频生成质量。

papers.title: Nice Fold or Hero Call: Learning Budget-Efficient Thinking under Policy-Dependent Solvability
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve problem solving through extended reasoning, but often misallocate test-time compute. Existing efficiency methods reduce cost by compressing reasoning traces or conditioning budget on perceived difficulty, yet read the resulting pass rate as a difficulty score, leaving the zero-return regime unmodeled. As a result, they overspend on queries beyond the model's capability while compressing hard-but-solvable ones that need deeper reasoning. In this work, we formulate adaptive reasoning as a computational investment under uncertainty, where budget follows the expected return of reasoning rather than perceived difficulty. To instantiate this principle, we propose Budget-Efficient Thinking (BET), a two-stage framework that combines behavioral cold-start with GRPO under an investment-cost-aware reward. By aligning solve-or-fold decisions with rollout-derived solvability, BET learns three behaviors: (1) short solve, answering easy queries concisely; (2) nice fold, abstaining early when continued reasoning has near-zero expected return; and (3) hero call, preserving sufficient compute for hard-but-solvable queries. Across seven benchmarks and three base models, BET reduces reasoning tokens by 54% while improving up to 3.2% accuracy, and transfers zero-shot to scientific QA and logical reasoning with comparable efficiency gains. Code is available at https://github.com/houqiii/BET
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BET 把自适应推理建模为不确定性下的计算投资，让预算跟随推理的期望回报而非感知难度，通过行为冷启动加带投资成本感知奖励的 GRPO 学会短答、早弃与为难但可解题保留算力三种行为。在七个基准与三个基座模型上推理 token 减少 54%，准确率最多提升 3.2%，并零样本迁移到科学 QA 与逻辑推理。
Motivation: 现有推理效率方法按感知难度调预算，却把通过率直接当难度分数，未建模零回报区间：对超出模型能力的题超支，对需要更深推理的难而可解题反而压缩。
Method: 提出两阶段 Budget-Efficient Thinking (BET)：行为冷启动 (behavioral cold-start) 加 GRPO 训练，奖励中计入投资成本 (investment-cost-aware reward)；用 rollout 推导的可解性 (rollout-derived solvability) 对齐 solve-or-fold 决策，学出 short solve、nice fold、hero call 三种行为。
Result: 在七个基准、三个基座模型上推理 token 减少 54%，准确率最多提升 3.2%；零样本迁移到科学 QA 与逻辑推理，效率增益相当。
Conclusion: 按期望回报而非感知难度分配测试时计算，可以同时省 token 并保住甚至提高准确率，且该策略能跨任务零样本迁移。

papers.title: AcuityBench: Evaluating Clinical Acuity Identification and Uncertainty Alignment
authors: Noémie Elhadad (1 and 2) ((1) Department of Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: We introduce AcuityBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether language models identify the appropriate urgency of care from user medical presentations. Existing health benchmarks emphasize medical question answering, broad health interactions, or narrow workflow-specific triage tasks, but they do not offer a unified evaluation of acuity identification across these settings. AcuityBench addresses this gap by harmonizing five public datasets spanning user conversations, online forum posts, clinical vignettes, and patient portal messages under a shared four-level acuity framework ranging from home monitoring to immediate emergency care. The benchmark contains 914 cases, including 697 consensus cases for standard accuracy evaluation and 217 physician-confirmed ambiguous cases for uncertainty-aware evaluation. It supports two complementary task formats: explicit four-way classification in a QA setting, and free-form conversational responses evaluated with a rubric-based judge anchored to the same framework. Across 12 frontier proprietary and open-weight models, we find substantial variation in clear-case acuity accuracy and error direction. Comparing task formats reveals a systematic tradeoff: conversational responses reduce over-triage but increase under-triage relative to QA, especially in higher-acuity cases. In ambiguous cases, no model closely matches the distribution of physician judgments, and model predictions are more concentrated than expert clinical uncertainty. We also compare expert and model adjudication on a subset of maximally ambiguous cases, using those cases to examine the role of clinical uncertainty in label disagreement. Together, these results position acuity identification as a distinct safety-critical capability and show that AcuityBench enables systematic comparison and stress-testing of how well models guide users to the right level of care in real-world health use.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 5 figures. Preprint under review for the Track on Evaluations and Datasets at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AcuityBench 把五个公开健康数据集统一到四级紧急度框架（居家监测到立即急救），共 914 例（697 例共识 + 217 例医师确认的模糊例），在 12 个前沿专有与开源模型上比较 QA 四分类与自由对话两种任务格式。对话格式系统性降低 over-triage 但抬高 under-triage，尤其在高紧急度病例；模糊例上没有任何模型贴近医师判断分布，模型预测比专家临床不确定性更集中。
Motivation: 现有健康基准偏重医学问答、宽泛健康交互或单一窄化分诊任务，缺少跨场景统一的紧急度识别评测，无法系统比较模型把用户引导到正确救治级别的能力。
Method: 统一五个公开数据集（用户对话、在线论坛帖、临床病历 vignette、患者门户消息）为四级紧急度框架；两种任务格式——QA 场景下的显式四分类，以及基于同一框架 rubric 的自由对话回答评测；含 697 例共识例做标准准确度评测、217 例医师确认模糊例做不确定性对齐评测，并在部分极端模糊例上对比专家与模型裁决。
Result: 在 12 个前沿专有与开源模型上，清晰例的紧急度准确度与错误方向差异显著；对话格式相对 QA 系统性减少 over-triage、增加 under-triage，高紧急度病例尤甚；模糊例上无模型接近医师判断分布，模型预测比专家临床不确定性更集中。
Conclusion: 紧急度识别应作为独立的安全关键能力来评测，且任务格式的选择直接决定 over-triage 与 under-triage 的权衡方向；模型在临床不确定性上仍系统性偏离专家分布。

papers.title: From Articulated Kinematics to Routed Visual Control for Action-Conditioned Surgical Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned surgical video generation is a critical yet highly challenging problem for robotic surgery. The core difficulty is that low-dimensional control vectors must precisely govern complex image-space evolution. In this work, we propose a kinematic-to-visual lifting paradigm that converts articulated kinematics into a unified set of five image-aligned control modalities. Building on this representation, we introduce a hierarchically routed visual control framework that selectively activates the most relevant control modalities and motion scales. Instead of uniformly applying all control signals, our model performs hierarchical routing to dynamically allocate conditioning capacity. We further design kinematic-prior-guided routing loss functions to ensure physically meaningful, temporally stable, and efficient expert utilization. To improve efficiency, we propose a budgeted training and inference scheme that leverages routing-induced sparsity. By selectively discarding low-significance control pathways during training and execution, our approach enables adaptive computation that is complementary to standard distillation. We additionally construct a new benchmark with curated articulated annotations, obtained through human-in-the-loop semantic labeling and differentiable pose tracking, providing realistic supervision for action-conditioned surgical video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves action faithfulness, visual fidelity, and cross-domain generalization over diverse baselines. Moreover, our efficient variant achieves substantial reductions in latency while maintaining strong control accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 kinematic-to-visual lifting 范式，把机器人手术的低维关节运动学提升为五种图像对齐的控制模态，再用层级路由 (hierarchical routing) 只激活最相关的模态与运动尺度，并配合 kinematic-prior 引导的路由损失与基于路由稀疏的预算化训练/推理。在自建的带人工语义标注与可微位姿跟踪基准上，动作忠实度、视觉保真度与跨域泛化一致优于多种基线，高效变体在保持控制精度的同时大幅降低延迟。
Motivation: 机器人手术中低维控制向量必须精确支配高维图像空间演化，这一映射本身很难；均匀施加全部控制信号还会浪费条件化容量并推高延迟。
Method: 先做 kinematic-to-visual lifting，把关节运动学统一成五种图像对齐控制模态；再用 hierarchically routed visual control 框架按需激活模态与运动尺度，配 kinematic-prior-guided routing loss 保证物理合理与时序稳定；并用 budgeted training/inference 丢弃低显著性控制通路，利用路由稀疏做自适应计算，与标准蒸馏互补。另建新基准，标注经 human-in-the-loop 语义标注与 differentiable pose tracking 得到。
Result: 实验显示该方法在多样基线上一致提升 action faithfulness、visual fidelity 与 cross-domain generalization；其高效变体在保持强控制精度的同时显著降低延迟。基准由人工在环语义标注与可微位姿跟踪构建，提供动作条件化手术视频生成的真实监督。
Conclusion: 把运动学提升为分层路由的多模态视觉控制并按路由稀疏分配计算预算，可在不牺牲控制精度的前提下同时改善生成质量与推理效率。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transformers Can Implement Preconditioned Richardson Iteration for In-Context Gaussian Kernel Regression
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study in-context kernel ridge regression (KRR) with Gaussian kernels and show, both theoretically and empirically, that a standard softmax-attention transformer can approximate the KRR predictor during its forward pass. Under bounded-data assumptions, we construct a single-head transformer whose forward pass approximately implements \textit{preconditioned Richardson iteration} on the associated kernel system. The construction uses $O(\log(1/ε))$ blocks and MLP width $O(\sqrt{N/ε})$ to achieve $ε$-accurate prediction for prompts of length $N$. Our construction reveals a functional decomposition within the transformer architecture: softmax attention produces a row-normalized Gaussian-kernel operator needed for \emph{cross-token} interactions, while MLP layers act locally to approximate the \emph{intra-token} scalar arithmetic required by the update. Empirically, we train GPT-2-style transformers on Gaussian-process regression tasks and observe that they progressively align with the exact Gaussian KRR estimator across depth in terms of both \emph{prediction error} and \emph{induced weights}, with ablations further supporting this trend. Comparisons with classical KRR solvers also show that deeper layers align with later solver iterates. Together, we empirically demonstrate that the pretrained transformers exhibit progressive refinement toward exact Gaussian KRR across depth, and theoretically establish inexact preconditioned Richardson iteration as a concrete mechanism for approximating this predictor within an explicitly constructed softmax-attention transformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明标准 softmax-attention transformer 的前向传播可逼近高斯核岭回归 (KRR) 预测器：单头构造在有界数据假设下实现预条件 Richardson 迭代，用 O(log(1/ε)) 个 block 与 O(√(N/ε)) 的 MLP 宽度达到 ε 精度。GPT-2 式模型在高斯过程回归任务上随深度在预测误差与诱导权重两方面逐步对齐精确 KRR，且更深的层对应经典求解器更靠后的迭代步。
Motivation: in-context learning 中 transformer 逼近核回归的机制此前缺少显式构造：不清楚 softmax attention 与 MLP 各自承担核系统的哪部分计算，也缺少与经典迭代求解器的对应关系。
Method: 构造单头 transformer，使 softmax attention 产生行归一化的高斯核算子负责 cross-token 交互，MLP 层局部逼近更新所需的 intra-token 标量运算，整体实现预条件 Richardson 迭代；复杂度为 O(log(1/ε)) blocks、MLP 宽度 O(√(N/ε))。实证部分在高斯过程回归任务上训练 GPT-2 式 transformer，并与经典 KRR 求解器迭代步对照，含 ablation。
Result: 理论：ε 精度预测所需 block 数 O(log(1/ε))、MLP 宽度 O(√(N/ε))，prompt 长度 N。实证：训练出的 transformer 随深度在 prediction error 与 induced weights 上逐步对齐精确高斯 KRR 估计器，更深层对应经典 KRR 求解器更晚的迭代步，ablation 支持该趋势。
Conclusion: inexact preconditioned Richardson iteration 是 softmax-attention transformer 近似 KRR 预测器的一个具体机制，且深度方向对应求解器迭代的推进。

papers.title: Agentick: A Unified Benchmark for General Sequential Decision-Making Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agent research spans a wide spectrum: from RL agents that learn from scratch to foundation model agents that leverage pre-trained knowledge, yet no unified benchmark enables fair comparison across these approaches. We present Agentick, a benchmark for sequential decision-making agents designed to evaluate RL, LLM, VLM, hybrid, and human agents on common ground and to power research on the fundamental challenges of sequential decision-making. Agentick provides 37 procedurally generated tasks across six capability categories, four difficulty levels, and five observation modalities, all exposed through a single Gymnasium-compatible interface. The benchmark ships with a Coding API, oracle reference policies for all tasks, pre-built SFT datasets, a composable agent harness, and a live leaderboard. An evaluation spanning 27 configurations and over 90,000 episodes reveals that no single approach dominates: GPT-5 mini leads overall at 0.309 oracle-normalized score while PPO dominates planning and multi-agent tasks; the reasoning harness multiplies LLM performance by 3-10x; and ASCII observations consistently outperform natural language. These findings highlight the substantial room for improvement that remains across all agent paradigms. Agentick's capability-decomposed, multi-modal design provides the empirical infrastructure needed to drive progress toward general autonomous agents, both as an evaluation framework and as a training ground for RL post-training of foundation models in truly sequential environments.
papers.comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentick 把 RL、LLM、VLM、混合与人类智能体放到同一基准上比较，含 37 个程序生成任务、六类能力、四档难度、五种观测模态，统一 Gymnasium 接口。27 种配置、逾 90,000 局评估显示无单一范式通吃：GPT-5 mini 以 0.309 的 oracle 归一化分领先，PPO 在规划与多智能体任务占优，reasoning harness 使 LLM 成绩放大 3–10 倍，ASCII 观测稳定优于自然语言。
Motivation: 从零训练的 RL 智能体与依赖预训练知识的基础模型智能体之间缺少统一基准，无法在同一起跑线上公平比较，也难以支撑序贯决策基本挑战的研究。
Method: 提供 37 个程序生成任务，覆盖六类能力、四档难度、五种观测模态，统一经 Gymnasium 兼容接口暴露；配套 Coding API、全部任务的 oracle 参考策略、预置 SFT 数据集、可组合 agent harness 与在线 leaderboard，用于评估 RL、LLM、VLM、混合及人类智能体。
Result: 评估跨 27 个配置、逾 90,000 局：GPT-5 mini 以 0.309 oracle 归一化分总体领先；PPO 在规划与多智能体任务上占优；reasoning harness 将 LLM 成绩放大 3–10 倍；ASCII 观测一致优于自然语言观测。
Conclusion: 没有任何单一智能体范式在 Agentick 上全面占优，各范式仍有很大提升空间；该基准既可作评估框架，也可作基础模型在真实序贯环境中做 RL post-training 的训练场。

papers.title: StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents, but optimizing them for long-horizon decision making remains difficult because current methods are largely purely reactive, which weakens both exploration and credit assignment over extended trajectories. In this work, we present Strategic Trajectory Abstraction (StraTA), a simple framework that introduces an explicit trajectory-level strategy into agentic reinforcement learning (RL). StraTA samples a compact strategy from the initial task state, conditions subsequent actions on that strategy, and trains strategy generation and action execution jointly with a hierarchical GRPO-style rollout design, further enhanced by diverse strategy rollout and critical self-judgment. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SciWorld show that StraTA consistently improves both sample efficiency and final performance over strong baselines. StraTA reaches success rates of 93.1% on ALFWorld and 84.2% on WebShop. On SciWorld, StraTA attains a 63.5% overall score, outperforming frontier closed-source models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StraTA 在 agentic RL 中引入显式轨迹级策略：从初始任务状态采样一个紧凑 strategy，后续动作以该 strategy 为条件，用分层 GRPO 式 rollout 联合训练策略生成与动作执行，并加入多样化策略 rollout 与 critical self-judgment。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SciWorld 上同时提升样本效率与最终性能，成功率分别达 93.1% 与 84.2%，SciWorld 总分 63.5%。
Motivation: 长时程决策的 LLM agent 优化困难，现有方法基本是纯反应式，导致探索不足、长轨迹上的 credit assignment 弱化。
Method: StraTA 在初始任务状态采样紧凑的轨迹级策略，后续动作以该策略为条件；用分层 GRPO 式 rollout 联合训练策略生成与动作执行，辅以多样化策略 rollout 和 critical self-judgment。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 上成功率 93.1%，WebShop 上 84.2%，SciWorld 上总分 63.5% 并超过前沿闭源模型；摘要称在三个基准上相对强基线一致提升样本效率与最终性能。
Conclusion: 把显式轨迹级策略注入 agentic RL 能同时改善探索与 credit assignment，从而在长时程交互任务上提高样本效率和最终成功率。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Simplicial Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: The Weisfeiler--Lehman (WL) test and its simplicial extension (SWL) characterize the combinatorial expressivity of message passing networks, but they are blind to geometry, i.e., meshes with identical connectivity but different embeddings are indistinguishable. We introduce the Geometric Simplicial Weisfeiler--Lehman (GSWL) test, which incorporates vertex coordinates into color refinement for geometric simplicial complexes. In addition, we show that (i) the expressivity of geometry-aware simplicial message passing schemes is bounded above by GSWL, and (ii) that there exist parameters such that the discriminating power of GSWL is matched by these schemes on any fixed finite family of geometric simplicial complexes. Combined with the Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT), a complete invariant for geometric simplicial complexes, this yields a geometric expressivity characterization together with an approximation framework. Experiments on synthetic and mesh datasets serve to validate our theory, showing a clear hierarchy from combinatorial to geometry-aware models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把顶点坐标并入颜色精化的 Geometric Simplicial Weisfeiler-Lehman (GSWL) 检验，证明几何单纯消息传递的表达力被 GSWL 上界、且在任意固定有限几何单纯复形族上可被匹配，并与 Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT) 结合给出几何表达力刻画与逼近框架。合成与 mesh 数据集实验显示从纯组合到几何感知模型存在清晰的表达力层级。
Motivation: WL/SWL 只刻画组合表达力，对连通性相同但嵌入不同的 mesh 无法区分，几何信息在单纯消息传递中未被理论刻画。
Method: 在几何单纯复形上把顶点坐标并入颜色精化，定义 GSWL 检验；证明几何感知单纯消息传递方案的表达力以 GSWL 为上界，并存在参数使其判别力在任意固定有限几何单纯复形族上与 GSWL 匹配；再结合作为几何单纯复形完全不变量的 Euler Characteristic Transform (ECT) 构建逼近框架。
Result: 在合成数据集与 mesh 数据集上的实验验证理论，显示从组合模型到几何感知模型的清晰表达力层级；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: GSWL 给出几何感知单纯消息传递的表达力上界并可被匹配，与 ECT 结合即构成几何单纯复形的表达力刻画与逼近框架。

papers.title: HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning
papers.abstract_en: World models support model-based planning through learned latent dynamics, but imagined rollouts can become unstable as the planning horizon grows or the dynamics distribution shifts. We propose HaM-World, a structured world model that combines history-conditioned selective memory with a Soft-Hamiltonian latent dynamics prior. The latent state is decomposed into a canonical (q,p) subspace and a context subspace c. Mamba selective state-space memory summarizes past observations and actions and conditions the same latent transition used for prediction, reward and value estimation, imagined rollouts, and cross-entropy method planning. The (q,p) subspace follows an energy-derived Hamiltonian vector field augmented with learnable residual and control dynamics, while c represents semantic, dissipative, and other non-conservative factors. On six DeepMind Control Suite tasks, HaM-World ranks first on four tasks and second on two, achieving the highest average AUC on the four-task core suite (117.9, 9.5% above TD-MPC2). Within the short-to-medium horizons used by the planner, it reduces imagined-rollout error to 45% of a strong baseline and wins 11 of 12 rollout-MSE cells for horizons k in {3,5,7}. At longer open-loop horizons, its error grows faster and is overtaken between k=7 and k=20; we therefore do not claim uniform long-horizon stability. Under 12 out-of-distribution perturbations involving dynamics shifts, action delay, and observation masking, it achieves the highest absolute return in every condition, with average gains of 10.2% on Finger Spin and 13.6% on Reacher Easy. Ablations show that memory accounts for the larger share of the observed gains, while Soft-Hamiltonian geometry provides smaller but consistent complementary improvements.
papers.comment: 28 pages including references and technical appendix. Accepted as a poster at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HaM-World 把历史条件化的 Mamba selective state-space memory 与 Soft-Hamiltonian 潜在动力学先验结合：潜状态拆成正则 (q,p) 子空间与上下文子空间 c，(q,p) 走能量导出的 Hamiltonian 向量场加可学习残差与控制项，c 承载语义、耗散等非保守因素，同一潜在转移用于预测、奖励价值估计、想象 rollout 与 CEM 规划。在 DeepMind Control Suite 六个任务上四项第一、两项第二，四任务核心套件平均 AUC 117.9，比 TD-MPC2 高 9.5%；短中程想象 rollout 误差降到强基线的 45%，k∈{3,5,7} 的 12 个 rollout-MSE 格子赢 11 个，12 种分布外扰动下每个条件都拿到最高绝对回报（Finger Spin 平均增益 10.2%，Reacher Easy 13.6%）。作者明确不主张长时域稳定：开环误差在 k=7 到 k=20 之间被反超。
Motivation: 世界模型做基于模型的规划时，想象 rollout 随规划时域增长或动力学分布偏移会失稳，长时域想象误差累积使规划不可靠。
Method: 潜状态分解为 (q,p) 与上下文 c 两个子空间；Mamba selective state-space memory 汇总历史观测与动作，并条件化同一套潜在转移，用于预测、奖励与价值估计、想象 rollout 及 cross-entropy method (CEM) 规划；(q,p) 遵循能量导出的 Hamiltonian 向量场，叠加可学习残差与控制动力学，c 表示语义、耗散等非保守因素。
Result: 在六个 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上排名第一（四项）与第二（两项），四任务核心套件平均 AUC 117.9，比 TD-MPC2 高 9.5%；短中程 rollout 误差降至强基线的 45%，k∈{3,5,7} 的 12 个 rollout-MSE 格子赢 11 个；开环误差在 k=7 到 k=20 之间被反超，作者不主张长时域稳定；12 种 OOD 扰动（动力学偏移、动作延迟、观测遮蔽）下每个条件都取得最高绝对回报，Finger Spin 平均增益 10.2%、Reacher Easy 13.6%；消融显示 memory 贡献更大，Soft-Hamiltonian 几何提供较小但一致的互补改进。
Conclusion: 选择性记忆是主要增益来源，Soft-Hamiltonian 几何提供稳定的辅助收益；该组合在短中程与分布外扰动下有效，但不保证长开环时域的稳定性。
Relevance: 1
