summary_sections.result: 在六个 DeepMind Control Suite 任务上排名第一（四项）与第二（两项），四任务核心套件平均 AUC 117.9，比 TD-MPC2 高 9.5%；短中程 rollout 误差降至强基线的 45%，k∈{3,5,7} 的 12 个 rollout-MSE 格子赢 11 个；开环误差在 k=7 到 k=20 之间被反超，作者不主张长时域稳定；12 种 OOD 扰动（动力学偏移、动作延迟、观测遮蔽）下每个条件都取得最高绝对回报，Finger Spin 平均增益 10.2%、Reacher Easy 13.6%；消融显示 memory 贡献更大，Soft-Hamiltonian 几何提供较小但一致的互补改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 选择性记忆是主要增益来源，Soft-Hamiltonian 几何提供稳定的辅助收益；该组合在短中程与分布外扰动下有效，但不保证长开环时域的稳定性。

papers.title: QuadraSHAP: $ε$-Exact Shapley Values for Product Games in Logarithmic Parallel Time
papers.abstract_en: We introduce QuadraSHAP, a method for $ε$-exact Shapley computation in product games, cooperative games whose coalition values factorize across players. Given a tolerance $ε\ge0$, the method determines a computational budget before evaluation, guaranteeing an absolute attribution error of at most $ε$ for every feature in exact arithmetic. By extending to weighted sums of product games, the framework supports baseline and empirical interventional attribution across a broad class of models, including log-link regression models, Cox proportional-hazards models, odds-scale classifiers, product-kernel machines, and tree-based models. For a $d$-player product game, we replace the exponentially large coalition sum by a one-dimensional integral of a polynomial of degree at most $d-1$. Gauss--Legendre quadrature with $m_q=\lceil d/2\rceil$ nodes therefore recovers exact Shapley values when $ε=0$. For positive tolerances, a computable error bound derived from the game factors decays geometrically with the node count and can certify substantially smaller budgets. To support efficient evaluation at scale, we share computations across features and evaluate products in log-space with sign tracking, mitigating intermediate overflow and underflow. Given the quadrature rule, computing all $d$ attributions requires $O(d\,m_q)$ work per product game, and admits $O(\log d)$ parallel time with sufficient processors. On a survival analysis problem with $396{,}065$ features, the exact quadrature configuration computes all feature attributions in approximately five minutes of GPU evaluation per explanation, at a scale where exhaustive coalition enumeration is infeasible. Explicit error control enables a further reduction: setting $ε=10^{-6}$ selects a smaller, theoretically certified quadrature budget and reduces the mean evaluation time to $0.36$ seconds per explanation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuadraSHAP 把 product game（联盟值可按玩家分解的合作博弈）的指数级联盟求和换成最高 d-1 次多项式的一维积分，用 Gauss–Legendre 求积在求值前就锁定预算，保证每个特征的绝对归因误差不超过 ε。d 个归因的计算量为 O(d·m_q)、并行深度 O(log d)；在 396,065 特征的生存分析问题上，精确求积每次解释约 5 分钟 GPU，取 ε=10⁻⁶ 后平均降到 0.36 秒。
Motivation: Shapley 归因的联盟枚举随玩家数指数增长，在数十万特征的模型上不可行；同时现有方法缺少可计算的误差证书，无法在求值前知道要花多少预算才能达到给定精度。
Method: 对 d 玩家 product game，把联盟求和替换为次数至多 d-1 的多项式的一维积分，用 m_q=⌈d/2⌉ 个 Gauss–Legendre 节点在 ε=0 时精确恢复 Shapley 值；ε>0 时由 game factors 导出随节点数几何衰减的可计算误差界以缩小预算。再把框架扩展到 product games 的加权和以支持 baseline 与 empirical interventional 归因，覆盖 log-link 回归、Cox 比例风险、odds-scale 分类器、product-kernel machine 与树模型；跨特征共享计算，并在 log-space 加符号跟踪求乘积以缓解溢出与下溢。
Result: 复杂度：每个 product game 全部 d 个归因需 O(d·m_q) 工作量，在足够处理器下并行时间为 O(log d)。在含 396,065 个特征的生存分析问题上，精确求积配置每次解释约 5 分钟 GPU 求值（穷举联盟枚举在此规模不可行）；设 ε=10⁻⁶ 会选出更小且有理论证书的求积预算，把平均求值时间降到每次解释 0.36 秒。
Conclusion: 在 product game 上，一维求积加几何衰减的误差界可以把 Shapley 归因从指数枚举变成带 ε 证书的对数并行时间计算，使数十万特征的精确归因在分钟级、加容差后亚秒级完成。

papers.title: Gradient-Momentum Coupling: A Parameter-Space Proxy for Learning Progress
papers.abstract_en: Measuring learning progress is at the core of curiosity-driven exploration, which rewards an agent for going where its model is still learning. However, the abstract notion of learning progress is not directly measurable, and existing methods often derive it from the prediction error in the output space. This paper proposes Gradient-Momentum Coupling (GMC), which measures how strongly a sample drives change in the parameter space, given by the normalized absolute product of its gradient with the momentum of previous gradients. Directions of change that persist across samples accumulate in momentum, while noise cancels out. In controlled experiments GMC allocates near uniform priority across tasks with varying levels of noise, where prediction error chases the noisiest, and orders learnable tasks by improvement speed rather than difficulty. On four MiniGrid MultiRoom tasks, substituting GMC for prediction error inside the Intrinsic Curiosity Module (ICM) recovers exploration ICM loses to unpredictable observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Gradient-Momentum Coupling (GMC)：用样本梯度与历史梯度动量的归一化绝对乘积度量该样本对参数空间的改变强度，跨样本持续的方向在动量中累积、噪声相互抵消。在受控实验中 GMC 对不同噪声水平的任务近乎均匀分配优先级（预测误差则追逐噪声最大的任务），并按改进速度而非难度排序可学习任务；在四个 MiniGrid MultiRoom 任务上替换 ICM 中的预测误差后，找回了 ICM 因不可预测观测而丢失的探索。
Motivation: 好奇心驱动探索依赖“学习进度”这一抽象量，但它不可直接测量，现有方法用输出空间的预测误差近似，导致噪声大的样本被误判为最值得探索。
Method: GMC 定义为样本梯度与其历史梯度动量之积的归一化绝对值，作为参数空间变化的代理；先在受控实验中与预测误差对照，再把 GMC 嵌入 Intrinsic Curiosity Module (ICM) 替换其预测误差项，在 MiniGrid MultiRoom 上检验。
Result: 受控实验中 GMC 在不同噪声水平任务间近乎均匀分配优先级，而预测误差偏向噪声最大的任务；GMC 按改进速度而非难度对可学习任务排序。在四个 MiniGrid MultiRoom 任务上，用 GMC 替换 ICM 的预测误差后恢复了 ICM 因不可预测观测而失去的探索。
Conclusion: 参数空间的梯度-动量耦合比输出空间预测误差更适合作为学习进度信号，能避免把噪声误当学习进度并改善好奇心驱动探索。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Detecting Time Series Anomalies Like an Expert: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Specialized Analyzers
papers.abstract_en: Time-series anomaly detection often returns scores or intervals, while analysts need to understand the abnormal behavior and the evidence supporting it. We introduce SAGE (Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection), a multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded diagnosis of univariate time series. Four specialized Analyzers examine point, structural, seasonal, and pattern anomalies using numerical tools and diagnostic visualizations. A Detector integrates their evidence into intervals, candidate types, and evidence-strength confidence scores; a Supervisor translates these records into analyst-facing reports. Synthetic in-context references are constructed from normal-reference training segments, reducing dependence on real anomalous demonstrations. Across Yahoo S5, KPI, and WSD, SAGE achieves an average Point-F1 of 66.26, the highest among the evaluated methods. Controlled synthetic evaluation examines localization and type diagnosis, while component ablations support the detection contribution of specialized evidence generation. In a method-blind human study, evaluators rate SAGE's diagnostic outputs as more useful than those of the compared methods.
papers.comment: Preprint. 8 pages main text, 28 pages total, with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用多智能体 LLM 框架把单变量时间序列异常检测做成可举证的诊断：四个专门 Analyzer 分别查点异常、结构异常、季节异常与模式异常，Detector 汇总成区间、候选类型与证据强度置信分，Supervisor 再写成面向分析师的报告。在 Yahoo S5、KPI、WSD 上平均 Point-F1 达 66.26，为所评估方法中最高，方法盲的人评也认为其诊断输出更有用。
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测通常只输出分数或区间，分析师真正需要的是异常行为的解释与支撑证据，纯打分式输出无法满足这一诊断需求。
Method: 四个专门 Analyzer 用数值工具与诊断可视化分别检查点、结构、季节、模式四类异常；Detector 把各路证据整合为异常区间、候选类型与证据强度置信分，Supervisor 将记录转写为分析师报告。合成 in-context 参考由正常参考训练片段构造，减少对真实异常示例的依赖；评测含受控合成的定位与类型诊断、组件消融，以及方法盲的人类研究。
Result: 在 Yahoo S5、KPI、WSD 三个数据集上平均 Point-F1 为 66.26，在所评估方法中最高；受控合成评测检验定位与类型诊断，组件消融支持专门化证据生成对检测的贡献；方法盲人评中评估者认为 SAGE 的诊断输出比对照方法更有用。
Conclusion: 把异常检测拆成专门化证据生成再汇总，可以在保持检测精度的同时产出分析师可读的举证式诊断，且不依赖真实异常演示。

papers.title: Low-Cost Black-Box Detection of LLM Hallucinations via Dynamical System Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently generate plausible but non-factual content, a phenomenon known as hallucination. While existing detection methods typically rely on computationally expensive sampling-based consistency checks or external knowledge retrieval, we propose a new method that treats the LLM as a black-box dynamical system. By projecting LLM responses into a high-dimensional manifold via an embedding model, we characterize the resulting vector sequences as observable realizations of the model's latent state-space dynamics. Leveraging Koopman operator theory, we fit the transition operators for both factual and hallucinated regimes and define a differential residual score based on their respective prediction errors. This approach enables low-cost hallucination detection in a single-sample pass, avoiding the need for secondary sampling or external grounding. Extensive testing across three data benchmarks demonstrates that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with reduced resource overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 当作黑箱动力系统：用 embedding 模型把回答投影到高维流形，借 Koopman 算子分别拟合事实性与幻觉两种状态的转移算子，用两者预测误差之差（differential residual score）在单次采样内判定幻觉。在三个数据 benchmark 上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，且无需二次采样或外部知识检索，资源开销更低。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测依赖高开销的采样一致性检查或外部知识检索，成本高且需要额外 grounding。
Method: 以 embedding 模型将 LLM 响应投影到高维流形，把向量序列视为模型隐状态空间动力学的可观测实现；基于 Koopman 算子理论分别拟合 factual 与 hallucinated 两种 regime 的转移算子，按两者预测误差定义 differential residual score，单次前向即可打分。
Result: 在三个数据 benchmark 上取得 state-of-art 性能并降低资源开销；相较基于采样一致性或外部检索的方法，单样本单次通过即可完成检测，无需二次采样或外部 grounding。
Conclusion: LLM 幻觉可作为黑箱动力系统的 regime 切换来检测：Koopman 转移算子的预测误差差分足以在低成本下区分事实与幻觉内容。

papers.title: How Long Does Infinite Width Last? Signal Propagation in Long-Range Linear Recurrences
papers.abstract_en: We study signal propagation in linear recurrent models at finite width. While existing signal propagation theory relies predominantly on the infinite-width limit, it remains unclear for how long that approximation remains accurate when recurrent depth $t$ grows jointly with width $n$. This question is especially relevant for modern recurrent sequence models, whose natural operating regime involves long input sequences, i.e., large $t$. We derive exact finite-width formulas for the hidden state signal energies in linear recurrences under complex Gaussian initialization. Using these formulas, we identify the joint depth--width scaling regimes that govern signal propagation: (i) a \emph{subcritical regime} $t=o(\sqrt n)$, in which the infinite-width approximation remains valid; (ii) a \emph{critical regime} $t\sim c\sqrt n$, in which non-negligible deviations from infinite-width predictions appear and a nontrivial joint scaling limit emerges; and (iii) a \emph{supercritical regime} $t\gg \sqrt n$, in which finite-width effects dominate. Thus, our results pinpoint the precise recurrent depth scale at which infinite-width theory breaks down in long-range linear recurrences. In turn, this shows when standard initialization schemes, such as Glorot, become unstable. More broadly, our results show that what constitutes "large width" depends crucially on the architecture: recurrent weight sharing makes finite-width effects visible at substantially shorter depths than in feedforward networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在复高斯初始化下推导线性递归模型有限宽度隐藏状态信号能量的精确公式，得到三个深度-宽度联合标度区制：t=o(√n) 时无限宽近似成立，t~c√n 出现不可忽略偏离并浮现非平凡联合标度极限，t≫√n 时有限宽度效应主导。由此精确定位无限宽理论在长程线性递归中失效的深度尺度，并说明 Glorot 等标准初始化何时变得不稳定。
Motivation: 现有信号传播理论几乎都建立在无限宽极限上，但现代递归序列模型的自然工作区是长输入序列，即递归深度 t 很大；t 与宽度 n 联合增长时无限宽近似能撑多久一直不清楚。
Method: 在复高斯初始化下推导线性递归隐藏状态信号能量的精确有限宽度公式，据此划分深度-宽度联合标度区制（次临界 t=o(√n)、临界 t~c√n、超临界 t≫√n），并据此判定 Glorot 类初始化的稳定性边界。
Result: 三个区制的定量判据：次临界 t=o(√n) 无限宽近似有效；临界 t~c√n 出现不可忽略偏离并产生非平凡联合标度极限；超临界 t≫√n 有限宽度效应主导。递归权重共享使有限宽度效应在比前馈网络短得多的深度上就可见。
Conclusion: “大宽度”是架构相关的概念：对线性递归，可用深度尺度由 √n 决定，超过该尺度无限宽理论与标准初始化方案失效。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Reward-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning for Immersive Video Role-Playing
papers.abstract_en: Text-based role-playing models can imitate character styles, but often fail to capture scene atmosphere and evolving tension, which are crucial for immersive applications such as VR games and interactive narratives. We study video-grounded role-playing dialogue and introduce EBM-RL (Eye--Brain--Mouth Reinforcement Learning), a decoupled GRPO-based framework that separates observation (<perception>), reasoning (<think>), and utterance generation (<answer>). This design mimics the human See-Think-Speak process, enabling the model to ground dialogue in visual perception before reasoning and response generation. To optimize this See-Think-Speak process, EBM-RL integrates complementary rewards for scene--text alignment, perceptual--cognitive utility, answer faithfulness, and format consistency. Extensive experiments show that EBM-RL substantially outperforms text-only role-playing baselines and larger-scale vision-language models on our immersive role-playing benchmark, improving both visual-atmosphere consistency and character authenticity. Moreover, EBM-RL demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer to out-of-domain VideoQA benchmarks without additional fine-tuning. We also release an open-source dataset for video-grounded role-playing dialogue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EBM-RL（Eye–Brain–Mouth RL）：基于 GRPO 的奖励分解框架，把视频角色扮演对话拆成观察（<perception>）、推理（<thought>）、发言（<answer>）三段，分别配场景-文本对齐、感知-认知效用、答案忠实度与格式一致性四类奖励，让台词先锚定视觉感知再生成。在自建沉浸式角色扮演基准上显著优于纯文本角色扮演基线与更大规模的视觉-语言模型，并零样本迁移到域外 VideoQA。
Motivation: 纯文本角色扮演模型能模仿人物语言风格，却抓不住场景氛围与逐步升级的张力，而这两点正是 VR 游戏与交互叙事这类沉浸式应用的关键。
Method: EBM-RL 采用解耦的 GRPO 框架，把生成过程切成观察、推理、发言三段（See-Think-Speak），并整合四类互补奖励：场景-文本对齐、感知-认知效用、答案忠实度、格式一致性，以此优化整条链路。
Result: 在作者自建的沉浸式角色扮演基准上，EBM-RL 大幅超越纯文本角色扮演基线与更大规模的视觉-语言模型，同时提升视觉氛围一致性与角色真实感；在域外 VideoQA 基准上无需额外微调即展现强零样本迁移能力。
Conclusion: 把奖励按观察-推理-发言分段并让台词先接地视觉感知，是视频接地角色扮演对话的有效训练路径，且学到的能力可零样本迁移到通用 VideoQA。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Interpretable Damage Detection based on Aerodynamic Pressure Measurements
papers.abstract_en: The increasing flexibility of modern large wind turbine blades necessitates cost-efficient and reliable structural monitoring solutions. For this purpose, we propose to use aerodynamic pressure measurements obtained via Aerosense, a novel, non-intrusive and economical sensing system. In former work [Franz et al., 2025], we investigated the potential of aerodynamic pressure measurements for structural damage detection on elastic and aerodynamically loaded structures. An experimental campaign was conducted on a NACA 633418 airfoil mounted on a vertically vibrating cantilever beam within an open wind tunnel. Structural damage was introduced progressively through controlled saw cuts near the beam support. Aerodynamic pressure distributions were recorded under varying inflow conditions and structural states. Based on this data set, we developed a convolutional neural network to detect structural damage and classify its severity using only aerodynamic pressure signals. The results demonstrate that pressure measurements can effectively enable real-time detection and quantification of damage in elastic, beam-like structures subjected to mildly turbulent flow and varying operational conditions. Recognizing the limitations of pure black-box classification, in this study, we further incorporate physics-based insights and explainable machine learning methods to interpret how structural damage influences both the dynamic response and the aerodynamic pressure field. This leads to an enhanced damage detection pipeline, aiming to improve transparency, robustness, and physical consistency in data-driven monitoring of elastic, aerodynamically loaded structures.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用非侵入式气动压力传感系统 Aerosense 的表面压力信号做风机叶片类弹性结构的损伤检测与严重度分类，并在纯黑箱 CNN 之上加入物理机理与可解释机器学习，解释损伤如何改变结构动力响应和气动压力场。风洞中 NACA 633418 翼型加竖直振动悬臂梁、以受控锯切逐步引入损伤的数据集上，压力信号可在轻度湍流与变工况下实现实时损伤检测与量化。
Motivation: 现代大型风机叶片柔性增大，需要低成本可靠的结构监测；纯黑箱分类缺乏透明性与物理一致性，难以说明损伤究竟如何改变气动压力分布。
Method: 在开式风洞中对安装于竖直振动悬臂梁的 NACA 633418 翼型，通过靠近梁根的受控锯切逐步引入结构损伤，在不同来流条件与结构状态下记录气动压力分布；先用仅吃压力信号的 CNN 检测损伤并分类严重度，再引入基于物理的分析与可解释机器学习方法解读损伤对动力响应和压力场的影响，构成增强的损伤检测流程。
Result: 在轻度湍流 (mildly turbulent flow) 与变化工况下，仅用气动压力信号即可实时检测并量化弹性梁式结构的损伤及其严重度；本研究进一步给出损伤影响结构动力响应与气动压力场的可解释性分析。
Conclusion: 气动压力测量足以支撑弹性、气动载荷结构的实时损伤检测，而叠加物理机理与可解释方法的增强流程能提升数据驱动监测的透明性、鲁棒性与物理一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning over Horn clauses in depth-bounded Transformers. By discouraging the reliance on statistical shortcuts via counterfactual data augmentation, and promoting the learning of shared reasoning primitives across direct and CoT modes, we find that in sufficiently deep models with a bidirectional prefix mask, implicit reasoning approaches explicit CoT performance across graph topologies and problem widths, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation. These findings represent a step toward achieving better compositional reasoning in Transformers. The code and models to reproduce this work are available at: https://github.com/envomp/Implicit-Deductive-Reasoning-in-Transformers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在深度受限的 Transformer 上研究 Horn 子句隐式演绎推理的扩展规律：用反事实数据增广抑制统计捷径，并让直接模式与 CoT 模式共享推理原语。在足够深且使用双向 prefix mask 的模型中，隐式推理在多种图拓扑与问题宽度上逼近显式 CoT 的表现，但深度外推仍必须用 CoT。
Motivation: Transformer 的组合式演绎推理常依赖统计捷径，隐式（无中间步骤）推理能否达到显式思维链的水平、以及能否外推到更深问题，此前缺少受控的扩展性结论。
Method: 以 Horn 子句演绎为任务，训练 depth-bounded Transformer；用反事实数据增广 (counterfactual data augmentation) 打断捷径依赖，并在直接模式与 CoT 模式之间共享推理原语进行联合训练，考察不同图拓扑、问题宽度与模型深度。
Result: 在足够深且带双向 prefix mask 的模型上，隐式推理在各图拓扑与问题宽度上接近显式 CoT 的性能；CoT 在深度外推 (depth extrapolation) 上仍是必需的。
Conclusion: 共享推理原语加反事实增广能让隐式推理逼近 CoT，但超出训练深度的泛化仍依赖显式中间步骤。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReasonAudio: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reasoning Beyond Matching in Text-Audio Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Existing audio retrieval benchmarks primarily assess semantic matching, lacking comprehensive evaluation of the logical reasoning capabilities required by complex queries. We introduce ReasonAudio, a benchmark for reasoning-intensive Text-Audio Retrieval that evaluates four abilities: negation, temporal order, sound co-occurrence, and sound duration. It comprises five synthetic subtasks with 1,000 queries over 10,000 composite audio clips and a natural subtask with 100 queries over 1,000 real-world clips. Evaluation of 11 state-of-the-art retrieval systems reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, OmniEmbed-7B, achieves an overall score of 20.7. In a controlled experiment designed to reduce the influence of sound-event matching, OmniEmbed-7B attains 53.8% average accuracy, compared with 70.6% for its generative backbone, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-Thinker, and 95.6% for humans. Our results highlight the challenges of reasoning-intensive audio retrieval and reveal a performance gap between OmniEmbed-7B and its generative backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReasonAudio 是面向推理密集型文本-音频检索的基准，用否定、时序、声音共现、声音时长四类能力拆开「语义匹配」与「逻辑推理」。五个合成子任务共 1,000 条查询配 10,000 段复合音频，加一个 100 条查询配 1,000 段真实音频的自然子任务；11 个先进检索系统中最好的 OmniEmbed-7B 总分仅 20.7。
Motivation: 现有音频检索基准主要测语义匹配，无法评估复杂查询所需的逻辑推理能力，检索与生成骨干之间的推理差距也无从暴露。
Method: 基准设计四类推理能力（negation、temporal order、sound co-occurrence、sound duration），含五个合成子任务与一个自然子任务；评测 11 个先进检索系统，并做受控实验以削弱声音事件匹配的影响，同时对照其生成骨干 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-Thinker 与人类表现。
Result: 11 个系统中最佳 OmniEmbed-7B 总分 20.7；受控实验中 OmniEmbed-7B 平均准确率 53.8%，其生成骨干 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B-Thinker 为 70.6%，人类为 95.6%。数据规模为 1,000 条合成查询 / 10,000 段复合音频，自然子任务 100 条查询 / 1,000 段真实音频。
Conclusion: 推理密集型文本-音频检索对当前系统仍是难题，且 OmniEmbed-7B 与其生成骨干之间存在明显性能差距。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Topology-Driven Anti-Entanglement Control for Soft Robots
papers.abstract_en: In the field of precision manufacturing in complex constrained environments, the role of soft robots is increasingly prominent, and the realization of anti-winding control based on multi-intelligent body reinforcement learning has become a research hotspot. One of the core problems at present is to coordinate multiple robots to complete the unwinding operation in a highly constrained environment. The existing distributed training framework faces some observability challenges in high-density barrier and unstable environments, resulting in poor learning results. This paper proposes a topology-driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TD-MARL) framework to coordinate multi-robot systems to avoid entanglement. Specifically, the critical network adopts centralized learning, so that each intelligent body can perceive the strategies of other intelligent bodies by sharing the topological state, thus alleviating the training instability caused by complex interactions; eliminating the demand for communication resources between robots through distributed execution, Upgrade system reliability; the integrated topological security layer uses topological invariants to accurately assess and mitigate the risk of entanglement to avoid the strategy from falling into local difficulties. Finally, the full simulation experiments carried out in the real simulation environment show that the method is better than the current advanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method in terms of convergence and anti-winding effect.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向复杂受限环境多软机器人防缠绕的拓扑驱动多智能体强化学习框架 TD-MARL：集中式训练共享拓扑状态让各智能体感知他者策略，分布式执行取消机间通信，并用拓扑不变量构成的安全层评估与缓解缠绕风险。在真实仿真环境的全量实验中，其收敛性与防缠绕效果优于现有先进深度强化学习 (DRL) 方法。
Motivation: 高密度障碍与不稳定环境下，现有分布式训练框架可观测性不足、复杂交互导致训练不稳，多机器人难以协同完成解缠操作。
Method: TD-MARL 框架：集中式训练阶段通过共享拓扑状态使各智能体感知其他智能体策略以缓解训练不稳定；分布式执行阶段取消机器人间通信需求；集成拓扑安全层用拓扑不变量评估并缓解缠绕风险，避免策略陷入局部困境。
Result: 在真实仿真环境中的全量仿真实验显示，该方法在收敛性和防缠绕效果两方面均优于当前先进的深度强化学习 (DRL) 方法。
Conclusion: 以拓扑状态共享加拓扑不变量安全层的集中训练、分布式执行设计，可提升受限环境中多软机器人防缠绕协同的训练稳定性与可靠性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: QASM-Eval: A Dataset to Train and Evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM-3 Beyond Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computing remains in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, with performance constrained by noise. Addressing this limitation requires hardware-facing capabilities beyond gate sequences: mid-circuit measurement and classical feedback for quantum error correction (QEC), precise timing for dynamical decoupling (DD), and pulse-level waveform access for calibration. OpenQASM 3 exposes these capabilities through a hardware-level programming interface. Despite rapid progress in large language models (LLMs) for code generation, datasets targeting these advanced features remain lacking. We introduce QASM-Eval, the first comprehensive dataset to train and evaluate LLMs on OpenQASM 3, targeting completion of hardware-facing constructs within a supplied program context. QASM-Eval comprises an expert-curated test set of 1,200 tasks and a training set of over 4,000 tasks, covering classical logic, timing scheduling, pulse control, and complex tasks inspired by quantum-control workflows. An extended verifier automatically checks syntax, quantum measurement distributions, and program timelines. Our evaluation identifies substantial headroom for OpenQASM 3 code generation and significant gains from targeted fine-tuning. Fine-tuned Llama-3-8B outperforms zero-shot GPT-5.6-Terra, while fine-tuned Llama-3-70B achieves 61.17% overall pass@1 and approaches few-shot-augmented GPT-5.6-Terra. QASM-Eval provides a benchmark and training resource for specification-guided code generation over the hardware-facing constructs of OpenQASM 3, supporting the development of LLM assistants for quantum programming. Data and code: https://github.com/fuzhenxiao/QASM-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QASM-Eval 是首个面向 OpenQASM 3 硬件级构造（中途中断测量、经典反馈、时序调度、脉冲控制）的 LLM 训练与评测数据集，含 1,200 条专家测试任务与 4,000 余条训练任务，并配一个校验语法、量子测量分布与程序时序的扩展 verifier。微调后 Llama-3-70B 取得 61.17% 整体 pass@1，接近 few-shot 增强的 GPT-5.6-Terra，微调 Llama-3-8B 则超过 zero-shot GPT-5.6-Terra，说明该任务仍有明显 headroom 且定向微调收益显著。
Motivation: LLM 代码生成数据集集中在门序列层面，缺少覆盖 OpenQASM 3 中途中断测量、经典反馈、动态解耦时序与脉冲级波形等硬件级构造的数据集，难以训练和评测面向 NISQ 硬件的量子编程助手。
Method: 构建专家策划的测试集 1,200 条任务与 4,000 余条训练任务，任务在给定程序上下文内补全硬件级构造，覆盖经典逻辑、时序调度、脉冲控制及受量子控制工作流启发的复杂任务；扩展 verifier 自动校验语法、量子测量分布与程序时序；评测采用 pass@1，对比 zero-shot 与 few-shot 的 GPT-5.6-Terra 及微调 Llama-3-8B/70B。
Result: 微调 Llama-3-70B 整体 pass@1 达 61.17%，接近 few-shot-augmented GPT-5.6-Terra；微调 Llama-3-8B 超过 zero-shot GPT-5.6-Terra。评测同时显示 OpenQASM 3 代码生成存在 substantial headroom，定向微调带来显著提升。
Conclusion: OpenQASM 3 硬件级构造的代码生成对现有 LLM 仍是难题，但用 QASM-Eval 做定向微调可让开源模型逼近大模型 few-shot 水平，数据与代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unlocking the Forecasting Economy: A Suite of Datasets for the Full Lifecycle of Prediction Market: [Experiments \& Analysis]
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets are markets for trading claims on universal future events (e.g., presidential elections). Fueled by a meteoric surge with over \$50 billion trading volume, they have emerged as a promising forecasting mechanism, where their prices provide continuously updated signals of collective beliefs. In decentralized platforms (e.g., Polymarket), the prediction market lifecycle include six stages: market creation, token registration, trading, oracle interaction, dispute, and final settlement. However, comprehensively tracking this complete pipeline remains a major challenge, as the underlying data are severely fragmented across heterogeneous on-chain smart contracts and off-chain sources. To fill this critical gap, we present the first continuously synchronized dataset suite for the full-lifecycle of decentralized prediction markets. To achieve large-scale cross-source integration, incomplete linkage, and continuous synchronization, we build a unified relational data system that integrates three canonical layers: i) market metadata, ii) fill-level trading records, iii) oracle-resolution events, through identifier resolution, on-chain recovery, and incremental updates. The resulting dataset spans from October 2020 to update-to-date and comprise more than 3.29 million market records, over 1.90 billion order execution records, and nearly 21 million oracle events. We describe the data model, collection pipeline, and consistency mechanisms that make the datasets reproducible and extensible. We further demonstrate its utility for multiple communities through NBA outcome calibration for sport traders, CPI expectation reconstruction for economists, and oracle-risk analysis for blockchain researchers. A public website with dataset access, interactive visualizations, and lightweight LLM-assisted exploration tools are publicly available at https://www.polymonitor.club.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对去中心化预测市场（Polymarket）全生命周期数据被割裂在链上合约与链下来源的问题，构建首个持续同步的全生命周期数据集套件：以统一关系数据系统整合市场元数据、成交流水、oracle 裁决事件三层，靠标识符解析、链上回补与增量更新维持同步。数据覆盖 2020 年 10 月至今，含 329 万条市场记录、19 亿条订单执行记录、2100 万条 oracle 事件，并演示了 NBA 结果校准、CPI 预期重构与 oracle 风险分析三类用途。
Motivation: 预测市场交易量已超 500 亿美元，但其六阶段生命周期（创建、代币注册、交易、oracle 交互、争议、结算）的底层数据严重碎片化于异构链上智能合约与链下来源，难以完整追踪。
Method: 构建统一关系数据系统，整合三层规范数据：市场元数据、成交流水记录、oracle 裁决事件；通过标识符解析、链上回补 (on-chain recovery) 与增量更新实现大规模跨源集成、不完整链接补全与持续同步，并给出数据模型、采集流水线与一致性机制以保证可复现可扩展。
Result: 数据集自 2020 年 10 月起持续更新，含超过 329 万条市场记录、超过 19 亿条订单执行记录、近 2100 万条 oracle 事件；平台累计交易量超 500 亿美元。在 NBA 结果校准、CPI 预期重构、oracle 风险分析三类场景演示其用途，并公开数据访问、交互可视化与 LLM 辅助探索工具。
Conclusion: 预测市场全生命周期数据可以被统一为可复现、可扩展的持续同步数据集，从而支撑体育交易者、经济学者与区块链研究者的下游分析。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Information Aggregation with AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Can Large Language Models (AI agents) aggregate dispersed private information through trading and reason about the knowledge of others by observing price movements? We conduct a controlled experiment where AI agents trade in a prediction market after receiving private signals, across four information structures of increasing complexity. We find that although the median market is effective at aggregating information in the easy information structures, performance deteriorates in the harder structures, suggesting that AI agents struggle in environments where more than two levels of interactive reasoning are required, a ceiling close to the one documented in human subjects. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, market accuracy does not improve from allowing cheap talk communication, changing the duration of the market, or strategic prompting; initial price has little average effect but matters in the very hard structure. We also find that ``smarter'' AI agents perform better at aggregation and are more profitable. Surprisingly, giving them feedback about past performance does not improve aggregation. A further wave of markets, run three months later with capability-frontier models, aggregates information more often in the three easier structures but not in the hardest one, where higher capability replaces markets that are confidently wrong with markets that hedge near 0.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预测市场中让 LLM 代理用私有信号交易并从价格变动推断他人知识，发现中位市场在简单信息结构下能有效聚合信息，但当交互推理层级超过两层时表现恶化，接近人类被试的认知上限。允许 cheap talk、延长市场时长、策略性提示都不提升准确率；更强模型聚合更好也更赚钱，但反馈无效，能力前沿模型只在三个较易结构中改善，最难结构仍失败。
Motivation: 分散私有信息能否被 AI 代理通过市场聚合、以及它们能处理多少层交互推理，此前缺少受控实验；这关系到 LLM 代理在策略性信息环境中的推理边界。
Method: 受控实验：AI 代理在收到私有信号后于预测市场中交易，设置四种复杂度递增的信息结构；对照理论预测，分别操纵 cheap talk 沟通、市场时长、策略性提示、初始价格、过往表现反馈，并更换为能力前沿模型重跑一轮（三个月后）。
Result: 简单信息结构下中位市场有效聚合信息，超过两层交互推理的更难结构表现恶化，上限接近人类被试；cheap talk、市场时长改变、策略性提示均不提升准确率；初始价格平均影响很小但在极难结构中重要；更“聪明”的代理聚合更好且更盈利，反馈过往表现不改善聚合；三个月后能力前沿模型在三个较易结构中更常聚合信息，最难结构仍不成功，只是把自信错误的市场换成在 0.5 附近对冲的市场。
Conclusion: AI 代理的信息聚合能力受交互推理深度限制（约两层），提高模型能力可扩展但未突破最难结构；沟通、时长、提示、反馈这些干预按理论预测均无效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Where to Focus: Query-Modulated Multimodal Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long video understanding remains a formidable challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to the prohibitive cost of processing dense frame sequences. Prevailing keyframe-selection methods rely on either a single visual-centric metric (e.g., CLIP similarity) or a static fusion of heuristic scores. This "one-size-fits-all" paradigm frequently fails: visual-only metrics are ineffective for plot-driven narrative queries, while indiscriminately adding textual scores introduces severe "modal noise" for purely visual tasks. To break this bottleneck, we propose Q-Gate, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that treats keyframe selection as a dynamic modality routing problem. We decouple retrieval into three lightweight expert streams: Visual Grounding for local details, Global Matching for scene semantics, and Contextual Alignment for subtitle-driven narratives. Crucially, Q-Gate introduces a Query-Modulated Gating Mechanism that uses the in-context reasoning of an LLM to assess query intent and dynamically allocate weights across the experts, activating necessary modalities while "muting" irrelevant ones to maximize the signal-to-noise ratio. Extensive experiments on LongVideoBench and Video-MME across multiple MLLM backbones show that Q-Gate outperforms representative keyframe-selection baselines in most settings, with particularly strong gains on long and medium videos, providing a robust and interpretable solution for scalable video reasoning.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. To appear in Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-Gate 把长视频关键帧选择做成动态模态路由：用 LLM 的上下文推理判断查询意图，给 Visual Grounding、Global Matching、Contextual Alignment 三条轻量专家流分配权重，激活需要的模态并静音无关模态。在 LongVideoBench 与 Video-MME 上跨多个 MLLM backbone 的多数设置中超过代表性关键帧选择基线，长视频与中等视频增益尤其明显。
Motivation: MLLM 处理稠密帧序列代价过高，现有关键帧选择要么只用单一视觉指标（如 CLIP 相似度），要么静态融合启发式分数：纯视觉指标对剧情驱动的查询无效，而无差别加入文本分数会给纯视觉任务带来模态噪声。
Method: Q-Gate 是免训练、即插即用的框架，把检索解耦为三条轻量专家流——Visual Grounding（局部细节）、Global Matching（场景语义）、Contextual Alignment（字幕驱动叙事）；Query-Modulated Gating Mechanism 借助 LLM 的 in-context reasoning 评估查询意图，动态分配各专家权重以最大化信噪比。
Result: 在 LongVideoBench 和 Video-MME 上、跨多个 MLLM backbone 的实验中，Q-Gate 在多数设置里优于代表性关键帧选择基线，在长视频和中等视频上增益尤其明显。
Conclusion: 按查询意图动态路由模态而非固定融合分数，是可扩展视频推理中更稳健且可解释的关键帧选择方案。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Scepsy: Serving Agentic Workflows Using Aggregate LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows carry out complex tasks by orchestrating multiple large language models (LLMs) and tools. Serving them at a target throughput with low latency is hard because they are written in arbitrary agentic frameworks and their execution times are unpredictable: execution branches, fans out, or recurs in data-dependent ways. Since their LLMs often outnumber the available GPUs, they also oversubscribe GPUs. We describe Scepsy, a serving system that schedules arbitrary multi-LLM agentic workflows onto a GPU cluster. Scepsy exploits the insight that, while the end-to-end latency of an agentic workflow is unpredictable, each LLM's fraction of execution time is comparatively stable across requests. Scepsy profiles each LLM under different parallelism degrees and combines the profiles with these fractions into an Aggregate LLM Pipeline, a lightweight throughput and latency predictor for allocations. To minimize latency at a target throughput, Scepsy uses the Aggregate LLM Pipeline to search over fractional GPU shares, tensor parallelism degrees, and replica counts. A hierarchical heuristic then places the chosen allocation onto the cluster, minimizing fragmentation and respecting network topology. On realistic agentic workflows, Scepsy achieves up to 2.5x higher throughput before saturation and 1.0-3.3x lower latency than systems that optimize LLMs independently or rely on user-specified allocations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scepsy 把任意 agentic workflow 调度到 GPU 集群上：利用每个 LLM 占执行时间的比例跨请求稳定这一性质，把各 LLM 在不同并行度下的 profiling 与该比例合成 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 这一轻量吞吐/延迟预测器，再据此搜索分数级 GPU 份额、张量并行度与副本数，最后用分层启发式放置以减少碎片并遵守网络拓扑。在真实感 agentic workflow 上，饱和前吞吐最高提升 2.5 倍，延迟比独立优化各 LLM 或依赖用户指定分配的系统低 1.0–3.3 倍。
Motivation: agentic workflow 由任意框架写成，执行时间因分支、扇出、递归而不可预测，且 LLM 数量常超过 GPU 数导致超订，现有按单个 LLM 独立优化或靠用户手工指定分配的做法无法在目标吞吐下控住延迟。
Method: Scepsy 先对每个 LLM 在不同并行度 (parallelism degrees) 下做 profiling，结合各 LLM 执行时间占比构造 Aggregate LLM Pipeline 预测器；用它在分数级 GPU 份额、tensor parallelism 度与副本数构成的空间上搜索目标吞吐下的最小延迟分配，再由分层启发式把分配放到集群上，最小化碎片并遵守网络拓扑。
Result: 在真实感 agentic workflow 上，Scepsy 相比独立优化各 LLM 或依赖用户指定分配的系统，饱和前吞吐最高提升 2.5 倍，延迟降低 1.0–3.3 倍。
Conclusion: 端到端延迟虽不可预测，但单个 LLM 的执行时间占比跨请求稳定，据此做聚合式预测与联合分配搜索，就能在 GPU 超订的 agentic serving 中同时提高吞吐并压低延迟。

papers.title: Identifying Causal Effects Using a Single Proxy Variable
papers.abstract_en: Unobserved confounding is a key challenge when estimating causal effects from a treatment on an outcome. In this work, we assume that we observe a single, potentially multi-dimensional proxy variable of the unobserved confounder and that we know the mechanism that generates the proxy from the confounder. Under an assumption called Single Proxy Identifiability of Causal Effects or simply SPICE, we prove that this error mechanism is complete and causal effects are identifiable. We extend the proxy-based causal identifiability results by Kuroki and Pearl (2014); Pearl (2010) to multi-dimensional continuous settings, more flexible functional relationships and a broader class of distributions. Further, we develop a neural network based estimation framework, SPICE-Net, to estimate causal effects, which is applicable to both discrete and continuous treatments.
papers.comment: Equal contribution between Pfister and Weichwald
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅观测到单个（可为多维）混淆变量代理、且已知代理生成机制的条件下，提出 Single Proxy Identifiability of Causal Effects (SPICE) 假设并证明该误差机制是完备的 (complete)，因果效应可识别；据此给出神经网络估计框架 SPICE-Net，适用于离散与连续处理。
Motivation: 未观测混淆使处理对结果的因果效应难以识别，已有代理变量识别结果多限于离散、低维与特定函数形式设定。
Method: 在已知混淆变量到代理的生成机制下提出 SPICE 假设，证明该误差机制完备并推导因果效应可识别；将 Kuroki and Pearl (2014)、Pearl (2010) 的代理识别结果推广到多维连续情形、更灵活的函数关系与更广的分布类；再构造基于神经网络的 SPICE-Net 估计框架。
Result: 证明在 SPICE 下误差机制完备且因果效应可识别，并把代理识别结论推广到多维连续设定、更灵活函数关系与更广分布类；SPICE-Net 可同时用于离散与连续处理的效应估计。
Conclusion: 只要代理生成机制已知且满足 SPICE，单个代理就足以识别因果效应，并可用神经网络落地估计。

papers.title: The Shrinking Lifespan of LLMs in Science
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws describe how language model capabilities grow with compute and data, but say nothing about how long a model matters once released. We introduce time-to-peak and lifespan as measures of model obsolescence and use them to characterize the scientific adoption trajectories of 62 LLMs across more than 108k citing papers (2019-2025), separating active adoption from background citation to recover per-model trajectories that citation counts cannot resolve. We find that a model's longevity is shaped more by when it was released than by its characteristics: release year predicts time-to-peak and lifespan more strongly than architecture, openness, or scale. LLM adoption follows an inverted-U curve (rising after release, peaking, and then declining), but this pattern is rapidly compressing. Each successive release year is associated with a 27% shorter time-to-peak and a 23% shorter lifespan ($p < 0.001$), robust to minimum-age thresholds and controls for model size. These adoption-side dynamics are invisible to scaling laws and suggest that specialization on any single model may be a depreciating investment, with costs falling on reproducibility and migration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 time-to-peak 与 lifespan 两个指标衡量 LLM 发布后的淘汰速度，并区分主动采用与背景引用来还原 62 个 LLM 在 2019–2025 年 10.8 万余篇引用论文中的采用轨迹。模型寿命更多由发布年份而非架构、开放性或规模决定：每晚一年发布，time-to-peak 缩短 27%、lifespan 缩短 23%（p < 0.001），且倒 U 形采用曲线正在快速压缩，因此针对单一模型的专门化投入是贬值型投资。
Motivation: Scaling laws 只描述训练算力与数据如何带来能力，无法说明模型发布后还能被学界使用多久；传统引文计数又无法分辨主动采用与背景引用，因而看不出单模型采用轨迹的快速压缩。
Method: 提出 time-to-peak 与 lifespan 两个模型淘汰度量，从 108k+ 篇引用论文（2019–2025）中分离主动采用与背景引用，重建 62 个 LLM 的逐模型采用轨迹，并用最小年龄阈值与模型规模控制做稳健性检验。
Result: 发布年份对 time-to-peak 和 lifespan 的预测力强于架构、开放性与规模；每晚一个发布年度对应 time-to-peak 缩短 27%、lifespan 缩短 23%（p < 0.001），该结果对最小年龄阈值与模型规模控制稳健；LLM 采用呈倒 U 形（发布后上升、达峰、随后下降）。
Conclusion: LLM 的采用窗口在逐年压缩，这类采用侧动态是 scaling laws 看不到的，意味着把研究绑定在单一模型上是贬值型投资，成本落在可复现性与模型迁移上。

papers.title: Neural Parameter Estimation of RC Thermal Building Models for Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract_en: Gray-box RC models are widely used to enable energy-efficient model predictive control (MPC) in buildings. However, estimating RC parameters remains difficult, as conventional optimization-based algorithms are prone to local minima, rely heavily on good initial guesses, and incur high computational cost. To address these issues, we propose the Estimator from Scratch, a novel neural parameter estimation approach that embeds the physical equations into a neural network's training process to estimate RC parameters. To further improve estimation accuracy and eliminate dependence on an initial guess, we extend this approach by pretraining the neural network on data from multiple source buildings, the Pretrained Estimator. We benchmark both methods against a genetic-algorithm-based RC estimator and a fully black-box neural network. All methods are evaluated across eight simulated and three real-world buildings for two RC configurations, for both prediction accuracy and closed-loop MPC performance, the latter only for the simulated buildings. The Pretrained Estimator achieves the best prediction performance among all RC-based methods, particularly with little training data, and yields the lowest and least variable MPC costs across buildings and benchmarks. These results position the Pretrained Estimator as a robust, computationally efficient, and initial-guess-free alternative for RC parameter estimation, with potential to extend to other control-oriented dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Estimator from Scratch：把 RC 热网络方程嵌入神经网络训练过程直接估计建筑 RC 参数，并通过在多栋源建筑数据上预训练得到 Pretrained Estimator，消除对初值的依赖。在 8 栋仿真建筑与 3 栋真实建筑、两种 RC 配置上，预训练估计器在所有基于 RC 的方法中预测精度最高（训练数据很少时尤其明显），且 MPC 成本最低、跨建筑波动最小。
Motivation: 灰箱 RC 模型是建筑 MPC 节能的基础，但基于优化的参数估计易陷局部极点、严重依赖初值且计算代价高，限制了 MPC 的实际部署。
Method: Estimator from Scratch 将 RC 物理方程嵌入神经网络训练损失中估计参数；Pretrained Estimator 进一步在多栋源建筑数据上预训练网络。对比基线为基于遗传算法 (genetic algorithm) 的 RC 估计器与全黑箱神经网络，在 8 栋仿真 + 3 栋真实建筑、两种 RC 配置上评测预测精度与闭环 MPC 成本（闭环仅限仿真建筑）。
Result: Pretrained Estimator 在全部基于 RC 的方法中预测性能最佳，尤其在训练数据很少时；在各建筑与各 benchmark 上取得最低且方差最小的 MPC 成本。评测覆盖 8 栋仿真建筑、3 栋真实建筑、2 种 RC 配置，对比遗传算法估计器与全黑箱网络。
Conclusion: 预训练的物理嵌入神经参数估计器是稳健、计算高效且免初值的 RC 参数估计替代方案，并可推广到其他面向控制的动力系统。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Combee: Scaling Prompt Learning for Self-Improving Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in prompt learning allow large language model agents to acquire task-relevant knowledge from inference-time context without parameter changes. For example, existing methods (like ACE or GEPA) can learn system prompts to improve accuracy based on previous agent runs. However, these methods primarily focus on single-agent or low-parallelism settings. This fundamentally limits their ability to efficiently learn from a large set of collected agentic traces. It would be efficient and beneficial to run prompt learning in parallel to accommodate the growing trend of learning from many agentic traces or parallel agent executions. Yet without a principled strategy for scaling, current methods suffer from quality degradation with high parallelism. To improve both the efficiency and quality of prompt learning, we propose Combee, a novel framework to scale parallel prompt learning for self-improving agents. Combee speeds up learning and enables running many agents in parallel while learning from their aggregate traces without quality degradation. To achieve this, Combee leverages parallel scans and employs an augmented shuffle mechanism; Combee also introduces a dynamic batch size controller to balance quality and delay. Evaluations on AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, Formula, and FiNER demonstrate that Combee achieves up to 17x speedup over previous methods with comparable or better accuracy and equivalent cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Combee 把 prompt learning 从单智能体扩展到高并行：用 parallel scan 加增强版 shuffle 机制聚合大量 agent traces，并以动态 batch size 控制器在质量与延迟之间取舍，使自改进 LLM agent 在并行度提高时不再出现质量退化。在 AppWorld、Terminal-Bench、Formula、FiNER 上最高取得 17 倍加速，同时精度相当或更好、成本相当。
Motivation: 现有 prompt learning 方法（如 ACE、GEPA）主要面向单智能体或低并行场景，无法有效利用大规模 agentic traces；缺少可扩展的并行策略时，并行度一高就会出现质量退化。
Method: Combee 框架并行运行多个 agent、聚合其 traces 做 prompt learning：以 parallel scan 加 augmented shuffle 机制组织跨并行轨迹的学习，并引入 dynamic batch size controller 平衡质量与延迟。
Result: 在 AppWorld、Terminal-Bench、Formula、FiNER 四个基准上，相对先前方法最高 17 倍加速，精度相当或更好，成本相当。
Conclusion: 并行 prompt learning 可以在不牺牲质量与成本的前提下大幅提速，让自改进 agent 从大量并行执行的聚合 traces 中学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GVCC: Zero-Shot Video Compression via Codebook-Driven Stochastic Rectified Flow
papers.abstract_en: At ultra-low bitrates, high-fidelity reconstruction requires sampling plausible videos from the posterior rather than regressing to oversmoothed conditional means. We propose Generative Video Codebook Codec (GVCC), a zero-shot framework in which a pretrained video generative model serves directly as the decoder, and the transmitted bitstream specifies its generation trajectory. Modern rectified-flow video models are typically sampled with deterministic ODE solvers, which leave no per-step stochastic channel for transmitting compressed information. GVCC addresses this by converting the deterministic flow sampler into an equivalent marginal-preserving stochastic process, so that information can be transmitted by encoding the per-step stochastic innovations. Unlike images, videos introduce longer temporal dependencies and more diverse conditioning modes. We instantiate GVCC in three practical modes: Text-to-Video (T2V) without a reference frame, autoregressive Image-to-Video (I2V) with tail latent correction, and First-Last-Frame-to-Video (FLF2V) with boundary-sharing Group of Pictures (GOP) chaining. On the seven-sequence UVG dataset, local atom-count sweeps characterize the rate--quality behavior of all three variants. We report full-dataset perceptual and fidelity metrics together with temporal diagnostics, without inferring matched-rate or global RD improvements from these limited local sweeps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GVCC 把预训练 rectified-flow 视频生成模型直接当解码器，把确定性 ODE 采样器改写成边缘分布保持的随机过程，用逐步随机创新量承载码流信息，实现零样本视频压缩。在 UVG 七个序列上以局部 atom-count 扫描刻画 T2V、I2V、FLF2V 三种模式的率-质量行为，并报告全数据集感知与保真度指标及时序诊断。
Motivation: 超低码率下高保真重建需要从后验采样合理视频，而不是回归到过度平滑的条件均值；但现代 rectified-flow 视频模型用确定性 ODE 求解器采样，每步没有随机通道可传压缩信息。
Method: 将确定性 flow 采样器改写为等价的边缘保持随机过程 (marginal-preserving stochastic process)，对每步随机创新编码以传信息；预训练视频生成模型作解码器，码流指定其生成轨迹。实例化三种模式：无参考帧的 T2V、带尾部隐变量校正 (tail latent correction) 的自回归 I2V、边界共享 GOP 串联的 FLF2V。

papers.title: On associative neural networks for sparse patterns with huge capacities
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Hopfield models with higher-order or exponential interaction terms are known to have substantially larger storage capacities than the classical quadratic model. On the other hand, associative memories for sparse patterns, such as the Willshaw and Amari models, already exhibit enhanced storage capacities in the sparse regime. In this paper we combine these two mechanisms. We introduce higher-order versions of sparse associative memory models and study their storage capacities in the sense of fixed-pattern stability. For the Amari and Willshaw models with fixed interaction order $n$, we obtain storage scales of order $\frac{N^n}{(\log N)^n}$. When the interaction order grows logarithmically with the number of neurons, the resulting storage scale becomes super-polynomial. We also study higher-order interactions in the block-structured Gripon--Berrou architecture, where the natural storage scale is of order $c^n$. Our results show that the capacity increase caused by higher-order interactions persists in the sparse setting, while the precise storage scale depends on the underlying architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把高阶相互作用引入稀疏联想记忆（Amari、Willshaw、Gripon–Berrou），在 fixed-pattern stability 意义下证明存储容量随相互作用阶数 n 增长：固定 n 时存储规模为 N^n/(log N)^n，n 随神经元数对数增长时变为超多项式，块结构 Gripon–Berrou 架构下自然存储规模为 c^n。结论是高阶带来的容量增益在稀疏机制下依然保持，但具体标度取决于底层架构。
Motivation: 高阶/指数相互作用的广义 Hopfield 模型与稀疏机制的 Willshaw、Amari 模型各自已知能提升存储容量，但两种机制结合后的容量标度尚不清楚。
Method: 构造高阶版本的稀疏联想记忆模型（Amari、Willshaw，固定相互作用阶数 n），以 fixed-pattern stability 为容量判据推导存储规模；并分析块结构 Gripon–Berrou 架构中的高阶相互作用。
Result: 固定阶数 n 的 Amari 与 Willshaw 模型存储规模为 N^n/(log N)^n；当 n 随神经元数对数增长时存储规模变为超多项式；块结构 Gripon–Berrou 架构的自然存储规模为 c^n。
Conclusion: 高阶相互作用带来的容量提升在稀疏设定下依然存在，但精确的存储标度取决于所用架构。

papers.title: On the Expressive Power of Transformers for Contextual Relations
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have revolutionized machine learning by making attention a central mechanism for modeling interactions within a context. Despite the central role of attention, the theoretical capabilities of Transformers for representing contextual relations remain unclear. In this work, we address this question by developing a mathematical framework based on probability and optimal transport. We view a text as a distribution of its representations and attention as a probabilistic relation between them. This perspective reveals a connection between attention normalization and optimal transport: standard softmax normalization produces conditional relations, while Sinkhorn normalization produces joint relations with prescribed marginals. Thus, both mechanisms provide structured probabilistic relations from attention scores. Under mild conditions, we establish universal approximation results for both settings. We show that Transformer architectures with Sinkhorn normalization can approximate arbitrary contextual relations represented as joint probabilities, while standard softmax Transformers can approximate arbitrary contextual relations represented as conditional probabilities. These results provide a mathematical characterization of the expressive power of Transformers for contextual relations and show how the choice of normalization determines the probabilistic structure of the relations represented by attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把文本视为其表示的分布、把 attention 视为表示之间的概率关系，用概率论与最优传输 (optimal transport) 建立框架：softmax 归一化给出条件关系，Sinkhorn 归一化给出带指定边缘 (prescribed marginals) 的联合关系。在温和条件下两者都具备万能逼近能力，即带 Sinkhorn 的 Transformer 可逼近任意表示为联合概率的上下文关系，标准 softmax Transformer 可逼近任意表示为条件概率的上下文关系。
Motivation: attention 是 Transformer 建模上下文交互的核心机制，但其表示上下文关系的理论能力一直不清楚，缺少刻画表达力的数学框架。
Method: 以概率与最优传输为数学基础，把文本建模为表示的分布、attention 建模为表示间的概率关系；对比 softmax 归一化（条件关系）与 Sinkhorn 归一化（指定边缘的联合关系）两种结构，并在温和条件下证明两者的万能逼近结果。
Result: 建立两类万能逼近定理：Sinkhorn 归一化的 Transformer 可逼近任意以联合概率表示的上下文关系，标准 softmax Transformer 可逼近任意以条件概率表示的上下文关系；归一化选择决定 attention 所表示关系的概率结构。
Conclusion: attention 的表达力由归一化方式决定：softmax 与 Sinkhorn 分别对应条件与联合两类概率关系，且两者在各自结构下都达到万能逼近。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Adaptive Subspace Modeling With Functional Tucker Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Tensors provide a structured representation for multidimensional data, yet discretization discards the underlying continuous structure when the data originate from continuous processes. We address this limitation by introducing a functional Tucker decomposition (FTD) that embeds a mode-wise continuity constraint directly into the factorization. The FTD models the continuous mode as a function in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), avoiding a prespecified basis while preserving the multilinear subspace structure of the Tucker model. We derive a reconstruction error bound for the continuous mode that quantifies the approximation quality when a subspace estimated on one domain is reused on another. This bound provides theoretical justification for subspace transfer, whose practical value we demonstrate on cross-domain classification tasks in hyperspectral imaging and multivariate time-series analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出函数型 Tucker 分解 (functional Tucker decomposition, FTD)，把连续 mode 直接建模为 RKHS 中的函数并施加 mode 级连续性约束，从而在离散化后保留数据的连续结构。推导了连续 mode 的重构误差界，量化在一个域上估计的子空间迁移到另一域时的近似质量，并在高光谱成像与多变量时间序列的跨域分类任务上演示子空间迁移的实际价值。
Motivation: 张量分解通常先离散化，丢掉了数据本源的连续结构；当需要把在一个域上估好的子空间复用到另一个域时，缺少可量化的近似质量保证。
Method: FTD 在 Tucker 的多线性子空间结构中，把连续 mode 表示为再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS) 中的函数，不预设基函数，同时嵌入 mode 级连续性约束；并为连续 mode 推导重构误差界，用于界定跨域复用子空间的近似质量。
Result: 给出连续 mode 的重构误差界，量化子空间从一个域迁移到另一域时的近似质量；该界为子空间迁移提供理论依据，并在高光谱成像与多变量时间序列分析的跨域分类任务上演示其实际价值。
Conclusion: 把连续性约束放进 Tucker 分解并给出跨域重构误差界，子空间迁移在跨域分类上是有理论支撑且实用的做法。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Spectral-Sphere-Constrained Hyper-Connections
papers.abstract_en: Hyper-Connections (HC) extend residual connections into multiple streams, employing residual matrices for cross-stream mixing to enrich model expressivity. However, unconstrained mixing disrupts the identity mapping property intrinsic to the residual connection, causing unstable training. To address this, Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and its variants restrict these matrices to be doubly stochastic via Sinkhorn-Knopp (SK) algorithm or permutation-based parameterizations. We reveal three limitations of this doubly stochastic constraint: (1) identity degeneration, where learned matrices collapse around the identity initialization and diminish cross-stream interactions, (2) a expressivity bottleneck, where the doubly stochastic constraint restricts the freedom of the subdominant spectrum of the residual matrices, preventing the model from selectively preserving or attenuating cross-stream variations, and (3) parameterization inefficiencies, manifesting as unstable SK iterations or the factorial-scaling overhead of permutation-based parameterizations. To overcome these flaws, we propose Spectral-Sphere-Constrained Hyper-Connections ($\mathrm{s}^{2}$HC). By confining residual matrices to a spectral norm sphere, $\mathrm{s}^{2}$HC restores free control over the subdominant spectrum, enabling the model to selectively preserve or attenuate cross-stream variations. This shift eliminates unstable SK iterations and factorial parameterization, enabling expressive, non-degenerate residual matrices while preserving training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: s²HC 把 Hyper-Connections 的残差混合矩阵约束在谱范数球 (spectral norm sphere) 上，取代 mHC 的双随机约束，从而恢复对次主导谱 (subdominant spectrum) 的自由控制，让模型可选择性保留或衰减跨流变化，同时保住训练稳定性。该约束直接消除不稳定的 Sinkhorn-Knopp 迭代与置换参数化的阶乘开销，避免矩阵塌缩到恒等初始化。
Motivation: 无约束的跨流混合破坏残差连接固有的恒等映射性质导致训练不稳，而 mHC 用双随机约束（Sinkhorn-Knopp 或置换参数化）虽稳却带来三个问题：恒等退化、次主导谱受限的表达瓶颈、以及 SK 迭代不稳或阶乘级参数化开销。
Method: 提出 Spectral-Sphere-Constrained Hyper-Connections (s²HC)：将 HC 的残差矩阵限制在谱范数球上，而非双随机集合；由此放开次主导谱的自由度，并去掉 Sinkhorn-Knopp 迭代与基于置换的参数化。
Result: s²HC 恢复对残差矩阵次主导谱的自由控制，使模型能选择性保留或衰减跨流变化，得到非退化的表达性残差矩阵；同时消除不稳定的 SK 迭代与阶乘级参数化开销，并保留训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 双随机约束是 HC 稳定性的不必要代价：谱范数球约束足以维持训练稳定，同时解除恒等退化、表达瓶颈与参数化低效这三项缺陷。

summary_sections.conclusion: 双随机约束是 HC 稳定性的不必要代价：谱范数球约束足以维持训练稳定，同时解除恒等退化、表达瓶颈与参数化低效这三项缺陷。

papers.title: Minimax and Adaptive Covariance Matrix Estimation under Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Estimating covariance matrices is fundamental to a wide range of statistical applications. This paper studies minimax and adaptive estimation of high-dimensional covariance matrices under $ρ$-zero-concentrated differential privacy ($ρ$-zCDP) over three nested classes: the pointwise-decay class $\mathcal{H}_α$, the row-tail class $\mathcal{G}_α$, and the separated-block class $\mathcal{F}_α$. We consider both squared operator norm loss and normalized squared Frobenius norm loss. For $\mathcal{H}_α$ and $\mathcal{G}_α$, we develop center--outer dyadic estimators tailored to the refined geometry of the two classes, while for $\mathcal{F}_α$, we develop a blockwise tridiagonal estimator. The resulting minimax-optimal rates reveal a nontrivial interplay among the smoothness $α$, the loss, the geometry of the covariance class, and the privacy constraint. In contrast to the non-private setting, privacy distinguishes covariance classes that share the same leading non-private rate and induces a polynomial dependence on the ambient dimension. We further develop procedures that adapt to the unknown decay parameter over all three covariance classes under both losses, at the cost of at most polylogarithmic factors. To establish minimax lower bounds, we develop a novel differentially private van Trees inequality that connects Fisher information with the $ρ$-zCDP constraint and may be useful for other private estimation problems. We also construct carefully designed prior distributions to obtain matching minimax lower bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ρ-zCDP 差分隐私下研究高维协方差矩阵的 minimax 与自适应估计，覆盖三类嵌套结构类 H_α、G_α、F_α 与两种损失（平方算子范数、归一化平方 Frobenius 范数）。隐私使原本非隐私速率相同的类被区分开，并引入对环境维度的多项式依赖；自适应估计代价至多为多对数因子。
Motivation: 高维协方差估计是众多统计应用的基础，但在差分隐私约束下，不同结构类的 minimax 速率如何被隐私区分、维度依赖如何恶化，此前缺少刻画。
Method: 对 H_α 与 G_α 提出 center–outer dyadic 估计器，对 F_α 提出 blockwise tridiagonal 估计器；下界部分提出连接 Fisher 信息与 ρ-zCDP 约束的差分隐私版 van Trees 不等式，并设计专门先验分布以得到匹配下界；另给出在三类与两种损失下对未知衰减参数 α 自适应的程序。
Result: 得到匹配的 minimax 最优速率，揭示平滑度 α、损失、协方差类几何与隐私约束之间的相互作用；与非隐私情形相比，隐私能区分具有相同非隐私主项速率的类，并带来对环境维度的多项式依赖；自适应估计在两类损失、三类结构下代价至多为多对数因子。
Conclusion: 差分隐私从根本上改变高维协方差估计的速率结构：类之间的可区分性与维度多项式依赖是隐私本身引入的，而自适应到未知衰减参数几乎不额外付出代价。

papers.title: Murmurations, Mestre--Nagao sums, and Convolutional Neural Networks for elliptic curves
papers.abstract_en: We apply one-dimensional convolutional neural networks to the Frobenius traces of elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ and evaluate and interpret their predictive capacity. In keeping with similar experiments by Kazalicki--Vlah, Bujanović--Kazalicki--Novak, and Pozdnyakov, we observe high accuracy predictions for the analytic rank across a range of conductors. We interpret the prediction using saliency curves and explore the interesting interplay between saliency, murmurations and Mestre--Nagao sums.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把一维 CNN 用在有理数域椭圆曲线的 Frobenius traces 上预测解析秩 (analytic rank)，在一段 conductor 范围内取得高准确率，并用 saliency 曲线解释模型，发现 saliency、murmurations 与 Mestre--Nagao sums 之间存在相互对应。
Motivation: 椭圆曲线解析秩的预测已有类似实验，但模型学到的信号与 murmurations、Mestre--Nagao sums 这些已知算术现象之间的关系尚不清楚。
Method: 对椭圆曲线的 Frobenius traces 序列施加一维卷积神经网络 (1D CNN) 预测解析秩，并用 saliency 曲线做特征归因，对照 murmurations 与 Mestre--Nagao sums 解释预测依据。
Result: 在一段 conductor 范围内观察到高准确率的解析秩预测，与 Kazalicki--Vlah、Bujanović--Kazalicki--Novak、Pozdnyakov 的同类实验一致；saliency 曲线与 murmurations、Mestre--Nagao sums 呈现有趣的对应关系。
Conclusion: 1D CNN 对椭圆曲线解析秩的预测既准确又可解释，其学到的判别信号与 murmurations 和 Mestre--Nagao sums 所刻画的算术结构相吻合。

papers.title: NBAvatar: Neural Billboards Avatars with Realistic Hand-Face Interaction
papers.abstract_en: We present NBAvatar - a method for realistic rendering of head avatars handling non-rigid deformations caused by hand-face interaction. To this end, we introduce a novel hybrid implicit-explicit representation for animated avatars by combining the training of explicit oriented planar primitives with implicit neural rendering. Such a combination of representations in the end-to-end pipeline enables NBAvatar to handle temporally and pose-consistent geometry, along with fine-grained appearance details provided by the neural rendering technique. To enable joint optimization of different representations we propose a geometry-aware training scheme that allows our hybrid representation to surpass existing approaches in terms of novel-view and novel-pose rendering quality. Specifically, NBAvatar achieves up to 53% LPIPS reduction compared to Gaussian-based avatar methods, while also improving PSNR and SSIM, and achieves higher structural similarity compared to the state-of-the-art hand-face interaction method InteractAvatar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NBAvatar 用显式有向平面基元与隐式神经渲染的混合表示渲染手-脸交互下的头部 avatar，配合几何感知训练方案实现联合优化。在 novel-view 与 novel-pose 渲染上，相比基于 Gaussian 的 avatar 方法 LPIPS 最多降低 53%，PSNR 与 SSIM 同步提升，结构相似度高于手-脸交互方法 InteractAvatar。
Motivation: 手-脸交互会造成非刚性形变，纯显式或纯隐式 avatar 表示难以同时保证时序与姿态一致的几何和细粒度外观，现有方法在该交互场景下渲染质量不足。
Method: 提出混合显式-隐式表示：训练显式有向平面基元 (oriented planar primitives) 负责几何，配合隐式神经渲染补细节外观，端到端管线中联合优化；并设计几何感知训练方案 (geometry-aware training scheme) 使两种表示协同。
Result: 相比基于 Gaussian 的 avatar 方法，LPIPS 最多降低 53%，同时 PSNR 与 SSIM 均有提升；在 novel-view 与 novel-pose 渲染质量上超过现有方法，结构相似度高于 SOTA 手-脸交互方法 InteractAvatar。
Conclusion: 显式平面基元与隐式神经渲染的混合表示加几何感知训练，能在手-脸非刚性交互下同时拿到一致几何与细节外观，渲染质量优于 Gaussian 类 avatar 与 InteractAvatar。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Jagarin: A Three-Layer Architecture for Hibernating Personal Duty Agents on Mobile
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents face a deployment paradox on mobile: persistent background execution drains the battery and conflicts with platform background limits, yet purely reactive agents miss time-sensitive obligations until the user remembers to ask. We present Jagarin, a three-layer architecture that resolves this through structured hibernation and demand-driven wake. DAWN (Duty-Aware Wake Network) is an on-device scoring engine that runs on the platform's periodic wake and combines four signals (duty-typed optimal action windows, predicted user engagement, the cost of delay, and cross-duty batching) with per-duty adaptive thresholds to decide whether a sleeping agent should stay silent, nudge the user, or offer escalation. ARIA (Agent Relay Identity Architecture) is a commercial email identity proxy that turns institutional email into structured duty records and routes messages by category, removing manual data entry. ACE (Agent-Centric Exchange) is a protocol for machine-readable communication from institutions to personal agents, intended to make email parsing unnecessary in the long run. DAWN and ACE are specified and evaluated in companion papers; this paper describes how the three layers fit together and a working Flutter prototype on Android that combines them with an ephemeral cloud agent invoked only when the user asks. Behavioural signals, thresholds and scoring never leave the device, and every record ARIA extracts is sealed to the device's public key before it is stored, so the relay holds only ciphertext it cannot read. Cloud model exposure is limited to parsing commercial email and to user-initiated escalation, which receives only the structured duty record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jagarin 用三层架构让移动端个人代理在休眠与按需唤醒之间切换：DAWN 在平台周期唤醒时按四类信号与逐 duty 自适应阈值决定静默、轻推或升级，ARIA 把机构邮件转成结构化 duty 记录并按类别路由，ACE 定义机构到代理的机器可读协议。行为信号与阈值不出设备，ARIA 记录以设备公钥封装，云端只接触解析邮件与用户主动升级时的结构化记录。
Motivation: 移动端个人代理常驻后台会耗电并触碰平台后台限制，而纯反应式代理在用户想起来提问之前会错过时效性义务，形成部署悖论。
Method: 三层结构：DAWN 为设备端打分引擎，融合 duty 类型的最优行动窗口、预测的用户参与度、延迟代价与跨 duty 批处理四路信号，配合逐 duty 自适应阈值输出静默/轻推/升级；ARIA 作为商业邮件身份代理，把机构邮箱转为结构化 duty 记录并按类别路由；ACE 是面向机构到个人代理的机器可读通信协议。附带 Android 上的 Flutter 原型，叠加仅在用户发起时调用的临时云端代理。
Result: DAWN 与 ACE 在配套论文中给出规范与评估，本文给出三层整合方式与可运行的 Flutter 原型；隐私设计为行为信号、阈值与打分全程留在设备端，ARIA 提取的每条记录在存储前用设备公钥封装，中继只持有不可读密文，云端模型暴露范围限于商业邮件解析与用户发起的升级（升级只传结构化 duty 记录）。
Conclusion: 把时效判断放在设备端的分层休眠-唤醒架构，可以在不放开后台常驻、不外泄行为信号的前提下保住时效性义务；长期方向是用 ACE 让机构直接产出机器可读 duty，从而免去邮件解析。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Distribution-Conditioned Transport
papers.abstract_en: Learning a transport model that maps a source distribution to a target distribution is a canonical problem in machine learning, but scientific applications increasingly require models that can generalize to source and target distributions unseen during training. We introduce distribution-conditioned transport (DCT), a framework that conditions transport maps on learned embeddings of source and target distributions, enabling generalization to unseen distribution pairs. DCT also allows semi-supervised learning for distributional forecasting problems: because it learns from arbitrary distribution pairs, it can leverage distributions observed at only one condition to improve transport prediction. DCT is agnostic to the underlying transport mechanism, supporting models ranging from flow matching to distributional divergence-based models (e.g. Wasserstein, MMD). We demonstrate the practical performance benefits of DCT on synthetic benchmarks and four applications in biology: batch effect transfer in single-cell genomics, perturbation prediction from mass cytometry data, learning clonal transcriptional dynamics in hematopoiesis, and modeling T-cell receptor sequence evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 distribution-conditioned transport (DCT)，把源分布与目标分布的 learned embedding 作为条件喂给 transport map，从而对训练时未见过的分布对做泛化，并可用只在单一条件下观测到的分布做半监督训练。该框架对底层 transport 机制无关，可接 flow matching 或 Wasserstein、MMD 等散度模型，在合成基准与四个生物学任务上展示性能收益。
Motivation: 标准 transport 模型只在训练见过的源-目标分布上有效，而科学应用需要对未见过的分布对泛化；分布预测问题中还有大量分布只在单一条件下被观测。
Method: DCT 用源分布与目标分布的 learned embeddings 条件化 transport map，支持从任意分布对学习的半监督设置；机制无关，可搭配 flow matching 或基于分布散度（Wasserstein、MMD）的模型。
Result: 在合成基准与四个生物学应用上展示 DCT 的实际性能收益：单细胞基因组学的 batch effect transfer、质谱数据的 perturbation prediction、造血作用中的 clonal transcriptional dynamics 学习、以及 T-cell receptor 序列演化建模。
Conclusion: 把分布身份编码为条件即可让 transport 模型跨未见分布对泛化，并把只在单一条件下观测到的分布纳入训练，且不绑定具体 transport 机制。

papers.title: Scale-invariant Gaussian derivative residual networks
papers.abstract_en: Generalisation across image scales remains a fundamental challenge for deep networks, which often fail to handle images at scales not seen during training (the out-of-distribution problem). In this paper, we present provably scale-invariant Gaussian derivative residual networks (GaussDerResNets), constructed out of scale-covariant Gaussian derivative residual blocks coupled in cascade, aimed at addressing this problem. By adding residual skip connections to the previous notion of Gaussian derivative layers, deeper networks with substantially increased accuracy can be constructed, while preserving very good scale generalisation properties. Explicit proofs are provided for the underlying scale-covariant and scale-invariant properties in arbitrary dimensions. To analyse the ability of GaussDerResNets to generalise to new scales, we apply them on a new rescaled version of the STL-10 dataset, where training is done at a single fixed scale and evaluation is performed on copies of the test set, each rescaled to a distinct spatial scale, with scale factors extending over a range of 4. We also conduct similar systematic experiments on the rescaled versions of Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets, and the existing STIR datasets. Experimentally, we demonstrate that the GaussDerResNets have strong scale generalisation and scale selection properties on all the four considered datasets with scaling variations. In our ablation studies, we investigate different architectural variants of GaussDerResNets, demonstrating that basing the architecture on depthwise-separable convolutions reduces the number of parameters and computations, with reasonably maintained accuracy and scale generalisation. We conclude by outlining how the proposed GaussDerResNets can be extended to joint local spatial and scale selection, to address the topic of multi-object detection in a provably scale-invariant manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可证明尺度不变的 Gaussian derivative 残差网络 (GaussDerResNets)，用尺度协变的 Gaussian derivative 残差块级联，使深层网络在只用单一尺度训练后仍能泛化到未见过的图像尺度。在重缩放 STL-10（尺度因子跨度 4）、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 与 STIR 上均表现出强尺度泛化与尺度选择能力；基于 depthwise-separable 卷积的变体在参数量与计算量下降的同时保持精度与尺度泛化。
Motivation: 深度网络对训练时未见过的图像尺度泛化差（out-of-distribution），需要在加深网络提升精度的同时保留尺度泛化能力。
Method: 把 Gaussian derivative 层加上残差跳连构成尺度协变残差块并级联，得到 GaussDerResNets；对任意维度的尺度协变与尺度不变性质给出显式证明。评测用单一固定尺度训练、再对测试集按不同空间尺度重缩放评估，覆盖重缩放 STL-10、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 与 STIR 数据集，并做架构变体消融（含 depthwise-separable 卷积）。
Result: 在四个含尺度变化的数据集上均展示强尺度泛化与尺度选择性质，其中 STL-10 测试副本的尺度因子跨度为 4；消融显示以 depthwise-separable 卷积为基础的架构减少参数量与计算量，精度与尺度泛化仅适度下降。
Conclusion: 尺度协变 Gaussian derivative 残差块可以在加深网络、提高精度的同时保持尺度不变性，作者并给出向联合局部空间与尺度选择扩展以实现可证明尺度不变多目标检测的路径。

papers.title: A Multi-Stage Framework for Kuzushiji Character Recognition in Japanese Historical Documents
papers.abstract_en: Kuzushiji was a widely used cursive writing system in pre-modern Japan. Due to simplification and glyph variation, most modern Japanese readers cannot read Kuzushiji characters. Consequently, recent studies have developed optical character recognition (OCR) systems for Kuzushiji. Despite recent progress, Kuzushiji character recognition (KCR) in Japanese historical documents remains challenging because of seal-character overlap and complex layouts, which interfere with character recognition and hinder accurate reconstruction of the reading order. To address these challenges, we propose a multi-stage KCR framework comprising character detection, cropping, classification, ordering, and large language model (LLM)-based post-OCR correction. Specifically, we employ a synthetic data augmentation strategy to improve character detection robustness against seal interference and introduce an adaptive column clustering algorithm to reconstruct the reading order. Finally, we leverage the contextual capabilities of the LLM to correct OCR errors. In addition, we correct annotation omissions, reconstruct the benchmark dataset, and introduce a synthetic test set with simulated seal interference and an out-of-domain (OOD) test set for evaluation. Compared with the conventional character-level OCR baseline, our framework achieves relative CER reductions of 43.48%, 46.02%, and 39.11% on the real, synthetic, and OOD test sets, respectively.
papers.comment: Project page is available at https://ruiyangju.github.io/KuzushijiOCR/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向日本历史文献变体假名 (Kuzushiji) 的多阶段 OCR 框架：检测、裁剪、分类、阅读顺序重建，再用 LLM 做 post-OCR 纠错。针对印章遮挡与复杂版面，用合成数据增强提升检测鲁棒性并引入自适应列聚类算法恢复阅读顺序；相对传统字符级 OCR 基线，CER 在真实、合成、OOD 三个测试集上分别下降 43.48%、46.02%、39.11%。
Motivation: 变体假名因简化与字形变化已无人能读，而印章遮挡和复杂版面同时干扰字符识别与阅读顺序还原，使现有 Kuzushiji OCR 难以准确重建文本。
Method: 多阶段框架依次为字符检测、裁剪、分类、顺序重建与 LLM post-OCR 纠错；检测端用合成数据增强对抗印章干扰，顺序端用自适应列聚类算法，纠错端利用 LLM 上下文能力。同时修正标注遗漏、重建基准数据集，并新增带模拟印章干扰的合成测试集与 OOD 测试集。
Result: 相对传统字符级 OCR 基线，CER 相对下降 43.48%（真实测试集）、46.02%（合成测试集）、39.11%（OOD 测试集）。
Conclusion: 检测增强、列聚类排序与 LLM 纠错的分阶段组合能把变体假名识别的 CER 相对压低约四成，且在合成印章干扰与域外数据上同样成立。

papers.title: GT-HarmBench: Benchmarking AI Safety Risks Through the Lens of Game Theory
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI systems are increasingly capable and deployed in high-stakes multi-agent environments. However, existing AI safety benchmarks largely evaluate single agents, leaving multi-agent risks such as coordination failure and conflict poorly understood. We introduce GT-HarmBench, a benchmark of 1,535 high-stakes scenarios spanning game-theoretic structures such as the Prisoner's Dilemma, Stag Hunt and Chicken. Scenarios are drawn from realistic AI risk contexts in the MIT AI Risk Repository. Across 15 frontier models, agents fail to choose socially beneficial actions in 38% of high-stakes cases, such as military escalation, election manipulation, and medical malpractice. We measure sensitivity to game-theoretic prompt framing and ordering, and analyze reasoning patterns driving failures. We further show that game-theoretic interventions improve socially beneficial outcomes by up to 18%. Our results highlight substantial reliability gaps and provide a broad standardized testbed for studying alignment in multi-agent environments. The benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/causalNLP/gt-harmbench.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Main Conference. Camera-ready will be out soon. This is still the preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GT-HarmBench 用博弈论结构（囚徒困境、猎鹿、斗鸡）构建 1,535 个高风险多智能体场景，场景取自 MIT AI Risk Repository。在 15 个前沿模型上，智能体在 38% 的高风险案例（军事升级、选举操纵、医疗过失）中未选择社会最优行动；博弈论干预最多把社会有益结果提升 18%。
Motivation: 现有 AI 安全基准大多只评单智能体，多智能体风险如协调失败与冲突缺乏系统评估，而前沿模型正被部署进高风险多智能体环境。
Method: 构建 GT-HarmBench：1,535 个覆盖囚徒困境、猎鹿、斗鸡等博弈结构的高风险场景，取材于 MIT AI Risk Repository；对 15 个前沿模型的智能体做评测，测量对博弈论提示框架与顺序的敏感性，并分析导致失败的推理模式，另测试博弈论干预。
Result: 15 个前沿模型在 38% 的高风险案例中未选择社会有益行动（涉及军事升级、选举操纵、医疗过失）；博弈论干预使社会有益结果最多提升 18%；同时测得模型对提示框架与顺序的敏感性。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在多智能体高风险情境中存在显著可靠性缺口，博弈论干预可部分弥补，GT-HarmBench 提供了研究多智能体对齐的标准化测试平台。

papers.title: Latent Generative Solvers for Generalizable Long-Term Physics Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable physics simulation demands two capabilities that today's neural PDE solvers do not deliver together: generalization across heterogeneous PDE families, and stability under long autoregressive rollouts. Deterministic operators accumulate error geometrically, while existing probabilistic solvers are confined to a single PDE family or short horizons. We close this gap with the \textbf{Latent Generative Solver} (LGS), three coupled components: (i) a Physics VAE (PhyVAE) compressing twelve PDE families into a shared latent manifold; (ii) a Pyramidal Flow-Forcing Transformer (PFlowFT) that generates the next latent by flow matching, conditioned on a per-trajectory context updated on the model's own predictions; and (iii) input noising during training, for which we derive a sufficient-condition contraction bound explaining the observed long-horizon stability. Pretrained on a 2.5\,M-trajectory, 16-system corpus at $128^2$, LGS matches the strongest deterministic baseline at one step, wins on 15/16 systems at both 5- and 10-step rollout, cuts 20-step L2RE from $56.1\%$ to $\mathbf{30.2\%}$, and uses $\mathbf{13}$--$\mathbf{77\times}$ less recurrent dynamics-step compute. It also adapts efficiently to a $256^2$ Kolmogorov flow held out from the pretraining corpus, dropping 1-step L2RE from $0.398$ to $0.129$ in five finetune epochs against U-AFNO's $0.653{\to}0.343$. These empirical claims are limited to the evaluated 2D regular-grid systems and discrete horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Generative Solver (LGS)，把 12 类 PDE 压进共享潜空间后用 flow matching 生成下一步潜变量，并以训练期输入噪声换取长时程稳定。在 16 系统、128² 预训练语料上，20 步 L2RE 从 56.1% 降到 30.2%，5 步与 10 步 rollout 在 15/16 系统上胜过最强确定性基线，循环动力学步计算量少 13–77×。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器难以同时做到跨异质 PDE 家族泛化与长自回归 rollout 稳定：确定性算子误差几何累积，概率求解器又局限于单一 PDE 家族或短时程。
Method: LGS 由三部分组成：Physics VAE (PhyVAE) 将 12 个 PDE 家族压缩到共享潜流形；Pyramidal Flow-Forcing Transformer (PFlowFT) 用 flow matching 生成下一潜变量，并以基于模型自身预测逐步更新的逐轨迹 context 为条件；训练期加入 input noising，并推导一个解释长时程稳定性的充分条件收缩界 (contraction bound)。预训练语料为 2.5M 条轨迹、16 个系统、128² 分辨率。
Result: 单步与最强确定性基线持平；5 步与 10 步 rollout 在 16 个系统中的 15 个上更优；20 步 L2RE 从 56.1% 降至 30.2%；循环动力学步计算量少 13–77×。在预训练语料之外的 256² Kolmogorov flow 上，5 个 finetune epoch 内 1 步 L2RE 从 0.398 降到 0.129，同设置下 U-AFNO 为 0.653→0.343。
Conclusion: 共享潜空间加 flow matching 生成与输入噪声训练，可让单一模型跨 PDE 家族泛化并保持长 rollout 稳定；作者明确将经验结论限定在所评估的 2D 规则网格系统与离散时程。

papers.title: FlyAOC: Evaluating Agentic Ontology Curation of Drosophila Scientific Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: Scientific knowledge bases accelerate discovery by curating findings from primary literature into structured, queryable formats for both human researchers and emerging AI systems. Maintaining these resources requires expert curators to search papers, reconcile evidence across documents, and produce ontology-grounded annotations. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate isolated subtasks, such as named entity recognition or relation extraction, and therefore do not capture this end-to-end workflow. We present FlyAOC to evaluate AI agents on end-to-end agentic ontology curation from scientific literature. Given a gene symbol, a concise FlyBase gene description, access to a 16,898-paper corpus, and ontology resources, agents must search for evidence and recover as many curator-relevant structured annotations as possible. Outputs span standardized function terms, expression patterns, and historical synonyms linking decades of nomenclature. The benchmark includes 7,397 expert-curated annotations across 100 genes drawn from FlyBase, the Drosophila knowledge base. Across four baseline agent harnesses---memorization, fixed pipeline, single-agent, and multi-agent---FlyAOC is sensitive to harness design, model family, and tool-use reliability. These results reveal system-level failure modes that model-only evaluations do not capture. FlyAOC provides a reproducible testbed for retrieval-augmented scientific curation.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlyAOC 把果蝇知识库的本体策展做成端到端 agent 基准：给定基因符号、FlyBase 简介、16,898 篇论文语料与本体资源，agent 需检索证据并产出功能术语、表达模式与历史同义词等结构化标注。在 7,397 条专家标注、100 个基因上，四类基线 harness（记忆式、固定流水线、单 agent、多 agent）的结果对 harness 设计、模型家族与工具调用可靠性都敏感，暴露了只测模型本身看不到的系统级失效模式。
Motivation: 现有基准只测 NER、关系抽取等孤立子任务，无法覆盖专家策展人跨文档检索、对齐证据并产出本体标注的完整工作流。
Method: 输入为基因符号、FlyBase 基因简介、16,898 篇论文语料与本体资源；agent 自主检索证据并输出标准化功能术语、表达模式、跨数十年命名的历史同义词。评测覆盖四类 harness：memorization、fixed pipeline、single-agent、multi-agent。
Result: 基准含来自 FlyBase 的 7,397 条专家策展标注、覆盖 100 个基因；四类基线 harness 的表现对 harness 设计、模型家族和工具调用可靠性敏感，揭示模型单独评测捕捉不到的系统级失效模式。
Conclusion: 检索增强的科学策展需要可复现的端到端测试台来暴露系统级失效，仅评模型本身不足以刻画真实策展工作流。

papers.title: Affective Flow Language Model for Emotional Support Conversation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced emotional support conversation, but existing alignment methods rely mainly on sparse preferences at the response level or outcomes at the dialogue level, providing limited supervision for sequential strategy decisions in multi-turn interactions. This raises a key question: how can detailed process signals be derived from overall dialogue outcomes to guide the gradual adaptation of support strategies? We propose the Affective Flow Language Model (AFlow), which models multi-turn emotional support as an affective utility flow evolving along dialogue trajectories. AFlow searches diverse support trajectories and estimates the utility of intermediate dialogue states and candidate strategies. It further introduces Affective Flow Preference Optimization (AFPO), which uses a flow-balance objective defined over dialogue subpaths to propagate downstream preference signals to intermediate states and learn strategy transitions consistent with support outcomes over the full dialogue. AFlow introduces flow-balance learning into multi-turn affective interaction, providing a process-based approach to dynamic affect modeling and continuous strategy optimization. Experiments on ExTES and ESConv show consistent improvements in strategy alignment, response diversity, and generation quality across different model environments and evaluation settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/chz2025/AffectiveFlow.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/chz2025/AffectiveFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AFlow 把多轮情感支持对话建模为沿对话轨迹演化的情感效用流，用 AFPO 的流平衡目标把整段对话结局的偏好信号回传到中间状态，从而指导策略逐步切换。在 ExTES 与 ESConv 上，策略对齐、回复多样性与生成质量在不同模型环境和评测设置下均一致提升。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法只用响应级稀疏偏好或对话级结局做监督，无法为多轮交互中的序列化策略决策提供细粒度过程信号。
Method: 提出 Affective Flow Language Model (AFlow)：搜索多样化支持轨迹并估计中间对话状态与候选策略的效用；再引入 Affective Flow Preference Optimization (AFPO)，在对话子路径上定义流平衡目标，把下游偏好信号传播到中间状态，学习与全程结局一致的策略转移。
Result: 在 ExTES 与 ESConv 两个数据集上，策略对齐、回复多样性与生成质量在不同模型环境和评测设置下均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 把情感支持当作可平衡的效用流来做过程级偏好优化，能为多轮策略转移提供比响应级、对话级监督更细的引导。

papers.title: Pseudo-Invertible Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The Moore-Penrose Pseudo-inverse (PInv) serves as the fundamental solution for linear systems. In this paper, we propose a natural generalization of PInv to the nonlinear regime in general and to neural networks in particular. We introduce Surjective Pseudo-invertible Neural Networks (SPNN), a class of architectures explicitly designed to admit a tractable non-linear PInv. The proposed non-linear PInv and its implementation in SPNN satisfy fundamental geometric properties. One such property is null-space projection or "Back-Projection", $x' = x + A^\dagger(y-Ax)$, which moves a sample $x$ to its closest consistent state $x'$ satisfying $Ax=y$. We formalize Non-Linear Back-Projection (NLBP), a method that guarantees the same consistency constraint for non-linear mappings $f(x)=y$ via our defined PInv. We leverage SPNNs to expand the scope of zero-shot inverse problems. Diffusion-based null-space projection has revolutionized zero-shot solving for linear inverse problems by exploiting closed-form back-projection. We extend this method to non-linear degradations. Here, "degradation" is broadly generalized to include any non-linear loss of information, spanning from optical distortions to semantic abstractions like classification. This approach enables zero-shot inversion of complex degradations and allows precise semantic control over generative outputs without retraining the diffusion prior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Surjective Pseudo-invertible Neural Networks (SPNN)，把 Moore-Penrose 伪逆从线性系统推广到非线性映射，并形式化 Non-Linear Back-Projection (NLBP)：对 f(x)=y 保证 x' = x + A†(y-Ax) 式的一致性约束。借助该性质把基于扩散模型的零样本线性逆问题求解扩展到非线性退化（光学畸变到分类等语义抽象），无需重训扩散先验即可做零样本反演与生成输出的语义控制。
Motivation: Moore-Penrose 伪逆只对线性系统成立，而实际退化（光学畸变、语义抽象）是非线性的，扩散模型的零样本反演因此只能依赖线性闭式 back-projection。
Method: 设计 SPNN 架构，使非线性伪逆可解且满足几何性质（含 null-space 投影/Back-Projection）；在此基础上形式化 NLBP，对非线性 f(x)=y 施加与线性情形相同的一致性约束，并将其接入扩散先验做零样本反演。
Result: 给出非线性伪逆的定义与 SPNN 实现，满足包括 Back-Projection 在内的基本几何性质；NLBP 对非线性映射保证一致性约束，使零样本反演覆盖从光学畸变到分类的非线性退化，并支持不重训扩散先验的语义控制。
Conclusion: 非线性伪逆加一致性投影可以把扩散模型的零样本逆问题求解从线性退化推广到一般非线性信息损失，同时保留对生成结果的精确语义控制。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Where It Matters: Geometric Anchoring for Robust Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and related methods align large language models from pairwise preferences by regularizing updates against a fixed reference policy. As the policy drifts, a static reference, however, can become increasingly miscalibrated, leading to distributional mismatch and amplifying spurious preference signals under noisy supervision. Conversely, reference-free variants avoid mismatch but often suffer from unconstrained reward drift. We propose Geometric Anchor Preference Optimization (GAPO), which replaces the fixed reference with a dynamic, geometry-aware anchor: an adversarial local perturbation of the current policy within a small radius that serves as a pessimistic baseline. This anchor enables an adaptive reweighting mechanism, modulating the importance of each preference pair based on its local sensitivity. We further introduce the Anchor Gap, the reward discrepancy between the policy and its anchor, and show under smoothness conditions that it approximates worst-case local margin degradation. Optimizing a logistic objective weighted by this gap downweights geometrically brittle instances while emphasizing robust preference signals. Across diverse noise settings, GAPO consistently improves robustness while matching or improving performance on standard LLM alignment and reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GAPO 用当前策略小半径内的对抗性局部扰动作为动态几何锚点，替代 DPO 的固定参考策略，把锚点与策略的奖励差（Anchor Gap）当作逐偏好对的权重。平滑性条件下该 gap 近似最坏情况局部间隔退化，加权 logistic 目标因此压低几何脆弱样本、保留稳健偏好信号，在多种噪声设定下提升鲁棒性并在标准对齐与推理基准上持平或更好。
Motivation: DPO 类方法用固定参考策略正则化更新，策略漂移后参考逐渐失准，造成分布错配并在含噪监督下放大虚假偏好信号；无参考变体虽避免错配却易出现不受约束的 reward drift。
Method: 提出 Geometric Anchor Preference Optimization (GAPO)：以当前策略在小半径内的对抗性局部扰动作为悲观基线的动态锚点，定义 Anchor Gap（策略与锚点的奖励差）并据此自适应重加权每个偏好对，优化按 gap 加权的 logistic 目标。
Result: 在多种噪声设定下 GAPO 一致提升鲁棒性，并在标准 LLM 对齐与推理基准上持平或改进；理论结果为平滑性条件下 Anchor Gap 近似最坏情况局部间隔退化。
Conclusion: 把参考策略换成几何感知的悲观锚点并按局部敏感度给偏好对加权，可以在含噪偏好下同时抑制 reward drift 与虚假信号，而不牺牲标准对齐与推理表现。
