papers.title: Beyond Bag-of-Words: Diagnosing Compositional Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision-language models struggle with basic compositional reasoning, failing to bind attributes to objects or relations to their referents. Existing benchmarks either rely on noisy real images that conflate confounding visual variables with the reasoning failure, or use simplistic synthetic scenes lacking the realism modern VLMs are tuned for. We introduce \textbf{Auto-Comp}, a fully automated, concept-driven pipeline that bridges this gap by generating photorealistic compositional benchmarks at scale. Its core innovation is a \textit{parallel A/B construction}: for each concept, the pipeline emits a \textit{Minimal} sample (template caption, isolated objects on a white background) and a \textit{Contextual} sample (LLM-rewritten caption, objects embedded in a realistic scene), isolating core binding ability from visio-linguistic complexity. We instantiate \textit{four} task families spanning the two canonical axes of compositional binding: \textit{Color} and \textit{Shape-Color} (attribute binding), and \textit{Position} and \textit{Relative Size} (relational binding). We evaluate over 25 VLMs spanning CLIP, SigLIP, hard-negative-trained, and frontier generative models. The findings are consistent across architectures and scales: every model exhibits a large Swap-vs-Confusion gap, with low-entropy distractors (e.g., repeated objects or colors) exposing failures \textit{beyond} the known bag-of-words limitations. We further uncover a task-dependent trade-off: visio-linguistic context aids relational reasoning but hinders attribute binding through visual clutter. We publicly release the pipeline and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Auto-Comp 用全自动、概念驱动的流程批量生成照片级组合推理基准，每个概念并行产出 Minimal（白底孤立物体、模板 caption）与 Contextual（LLM 改写 caption、真实场景）配对样本，把绑定能力与视觉-语言复杂度解耦。在 25 个 VLM（CLIP、SigLIP、hard-negative 训练模型与前沿生成模型）上，所有模型都出现显著的 Swap-vs-Confusion 差距，低熵 distractor（重复物体或颜色）暴露超出 bag-of-words 已知局限的失败；上下文有助于关系推理却因视觉杂乱损害属性绑定。
Motivation: 现有组合推理基准要么用嘈杂真实图像把混杂视觉变量与推理失败混在一起，要么用过于简单的合成场景，缺少现代 VLM 所适应的真实感，难以干净地诊断属性-物体与关系-指称的绑定失败。
Method: 提出 Auto-Comp：概念驱动的全自动管线，对每个概念并行生成 Minimal 与 Contextual 配对样本（parallel A/B construction），实例化 Color、Shape-Color（属性绑定）与 Position、Relative Size（关系绑定）四个任务族，并公开管线与基准。
Result: 在 25 个 VLM（涵盖 CLIP、SigLIP、hard-negative-trained 与前沿生成模型）上评测，跨架构与规模一致：每个模型都呈现很大的 Swap-vs-Confusion gap，低熵 distractor（重复物体或颜色）暴露超出已知 bag-of-words 局限的失败；并发现任务依赖的权衡——视觉-语言上下文帮助关系推理、却因视觉杂乱阻碍属性绑定。
Conclusion: 组合绑定失败并非 bag-of-words 一句话可概括，且上下文的真实感对属性绑定与关系推理作用方向相反，因此诊断基准必须用 Minimal/Contextual 配对把核心绑定能力与视觉-语言复杂度分开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HuPER: A Human-Inspired Framework for Phonetic Perception
papers.abstract_en: We propose HuPER, a human-inspired framework that models phonetic perception as adaptive inference over acoustic-phonetics evidence and linguistic knowledge. With only 100 hours of training data, HuPER achieves state-of-the-art phonetic error rates on five English benchmarks and strong zero-shot transfer to 95 unseen languages. HuPER is also the first framework to enable adaptive, multi-path phonetic perception under diverse acoustic conditions. All training data, models, and code are open-sourced. Code and demo avaliable at https://github.com/Berkeley-Speech-Group/HuPER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HuPER 把语音感知建模为在声学-音素证据与语言学知识之间的自适应推理，仅用 100 小时训练数据即在五个英语基准上取得 state-of-the-art 音素错误率，并对 95 种未见语言实现强零样本迁移，是首个支持多样声学条件下自适应多路径音素感知的框架。
Motivation: 语音感知模型在低资源训练与多样声学条件下难以兼顾精度与跨语言泛化，且缺少模拟人类自适应、多路径推理的机制。
Method: HuPER 以人类启发的框架将音素感知表述为声学-音素证据与语言学知识上的自适应推理，支持多样声学条件下的自适应多路径感知；训练数据、模型与代码全部开源。
Result: 仅用 100 小时训练数据，在五个英语基准上取得 state-of-the-art 音素错误率，并在 95 种未见语言上展现强零样本迁移能力。
Conclusion: 以自适应推理融合声学证据与语言学知识，可在小规模训练数据下同时实现英语 SOTA 音素错误率与大规模跨语言零样本迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stepwise Intrinsic Rewards for Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a widely used paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and Vision-language models (VLMs). Sparse binary outcome rewards, however, score only final correctness and cannot identify which intermediate steps contributed to it; in multimodal tasks, they may also reward answers driven by linguistic priors rather than visual evidence. Process reward models (PRMs) densify supervision but usually require process annotations, auxiliary models, or inference-time search. In this paper, we introduce Stepwise Marginal Information Gain (MIG), an intrinsic process reward computed from the policy itself. MIG measures how each structured reasoning prefix changes the length-normalized, teacher-forced log-likelihood of the reference answer. A monotonic historical watermark rewards only new likelihood maxima, avoiding duplicate credit after sub-record detours. We combine this signal with outcome and format rewards and a gated self-distillation objective that retains only structurally valid and correct trajectories. For VLMs, a real-versus-blank likelihood gate down-weights rewards when answers remain predictable without the image. Across eight task-specific benchmarks, the full method exceeds outcome-only GRPO in every single-run comparison. In broad-data transfer, it improves average accuracy by up to 4.8 points over binary-reward training and gains 12.6 points on MathVerse. At 7B, it exceeds an external PRM-BoN@16 baseline by 12.9 points on vision-language transfer without inference-time reranking. These results support policy-derived stepwise credit as an annotation-free alternative to explicit process reward modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stepwise Marginal Information Gain (MIG)：用策略自身计算的过程奖励，衡量每个结构化推理前缀对参考答案长度归一化、teacher-forced 对数似然的改变量，配合单调历史水位线只奖励新的似然峰值，并叠加门控自蒸馏与 VLM 的 real-versus-blank 似然门。八个任务基准上完整方法在每一次单 run 对比中都超过 outcome-only GRPO，7B 视觉语言迁移上比外部 PRM-BoN@16 基线高 12.9 分且无需推理时重排序。
Motivation: 稀疏二元结果奖励只判最终对错，无法定位哪一步起了作用，多模态任务里还会奖励靠语言先验而非图像证据得出的答案；现有过程奖励模型 (PRM) 又依赖过程标注、辅助模型或推理时搜索。
Method: MIG 由策略自身给出：对每个结构化推理前缀计算参考答案的长度归一化 teacher-forced 对数似然变化，用单调历史水位线 (monotonic historical watermark) 只奖励新的似然极大值，避免绕路后重复计分；再与 outcome、format 奖励以及只保留结构有效且正确轨迹的门控自蒸馏目标组合，VLM 上加 real-versus-blank 似然门，答案在无图时仍可预测则降权。
Result: 在八个任务特定基准上，完整方法在每一次单 run 对比中都超过 outcome-only GRPO；广数据迁移中平均准确率比二元奖励训练最多提高 4.8 分，MathVerse 提高 12.6 分；7B 视觉语言迁移上比外部 PRM-BoN@16 基线高 12.9 分，且不做推理时重排序。
Conclusion: 策略自产的逐步信用 (policy-derived stepwise credit) 可以作为免标注的过程奖励建模替代方案，同时用似然门抑制语言先验驱动的答案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeshGraphNet-Transformer: Scalable Mesh-based Learned Simulation for Solid Mechanics
papers.abstract_en: We present MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T), a novel architecture that combines the global modeling capabilities of Transformers with the geometric inductive bias of MeshGraphNets, while preserving a mesh-based graph representation. MGN-T overcomes a key limitation of standard MGN, the inefficient long-range information propagation caused by iterative message passing on large, high-resolution meshes. A physics-attention Transformer serves as a global processor, updating all nodal states simultaneously while explicitly retaining node and edge attributes. By directly capturing long-range physical interactions, MGN-T eliminates the need for deep message-passing stacks or hierarchical, coarsened meshes, enabling efficient learning on high-resolution meshes with varying geometries, topologies, and boundary conditions at an industrial scale. We demonstrate that MGN-T successfully handles industrial-scale meshes for impact dynamics, a setting in which standard MGN fails due message-passing under-reaching. The method accurately models self-contact, plasticity, and multivariate outputs, including internal, phenomenological plastic variables. Moreover, MGN-T outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on classical benchmarks, achieving higher accuracy while maintaining practical efficiency, using only a fraction of the parameters required by competing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGN-T 把 physics-attention Transformer 作为全局处理器，一次性更新所有节点状态并保留节点与边属性，从而绕开 MeshGraphNets 在大网格上靠迭代消息传递传播长程信息的低效。它在工业级冲击动力学网格上处理了标准 MGN 因消息传递 under-reaching 而失败的场景，并在经典基准上以更少参数取得更高精度。
Motivation: 标准 MGN 在大尺寸、高分辨率网格上靠深层消息传递堆叠或层级粗化才能触达远距离节点，代价高且在工业尺度冲击动力学上直接失效。
Method: 保留网格图表示，用 physics-attention Transformer 作全局处理器并行更新全部节点状态，同时显式携带节点与边属性；由此免去深层消息传递堆叠与粗化网格，支持不同几何、拓扑与边界条件。
Result: 在工业级冲击动力学网格上处理了标准 MGN 因消息传递 under-reaching 而失败的设定；准确建模自接触、塑性以及包含内部唯象塑性变量的多变量输出；在经典基准上超过 state-of-the-art 方法，精度更高且参数量只占竞争基线的一小部分。
Conclusion: 全局注意力加网格几何归纳偏置可以在工业尺度高分辨率网格上学到长程物理交互，无需深层消息传递或网格粗化，同时把参数量压到基线的一小部分。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dynamic Welfare-Maximizing Pooled Testing
papers.abstract_en: Pooled testing uses one test to certify several agents as healthy when the pooled result is negative. We study a budget-constrained welfare problem in which agents have heterogeneous utilities and independent prior probabilities of being healthy. Welfare is earned when an agent is certified healthy, and a dynamic policy may choose each pool after observing earlier test outcomes. We ask how much such adaptation can improve over a static allocation that fixes all pools in advance. Our main result proves that the optimal dynamic policy has value at most twice that of the optimal static overlapping allocation, for every population, test budget, and pool-size cap. The proof samples a path through the dynamic policy using an independent health profile, randomly thins the selected pools, and compares the resulting static allocation with the dynamic policy one agent at a time. A Boolean-cube argument proves the comparison on uniform subcubes, and a complementary-profile coupling lifts the result to arbitrary heterogeneous product priors. We also identify regimes in which adaptivity has no value, show that strict adaptive gains require re-pooling agents after positive tests, and give a three-agent instance in which adaptation is strictly beneficial. Exact-Joint Greedy obtains a $1/(e+1)$ fraction of optimal static overlapping welfare. The static non-overlapping Greedy algorithm of Finster et al. has the same guarantee, hence our factor-two theorem newly implies that each is a $2(e+1)$-approximation to the optimal dynamic policy. Finally, a reproducible exact small-instance study compares the dynamic and static benchmarks and greedy policies. The appendix records separate exploratory results for Gibbs-marginal and reinforcement-learning approaches at larger scales.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 4 tables. Substantially revised and expanded; adds a uniform factor-two bound on the adaptivity gap, new structural and approximation results, and updated exact experiments. Edwin Lock added as a coauthor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在预算受限的合并检测 (pooled testing) 福利问题中，证明最优动态策略的福利至多是最优静态重叠分配的两倍，该因子二界对任意人群、检测预算与池大小上限都成立。Exact-Joint Greedy 达到最优静态重叠福利的 1/(e+1)，因此对最优动态策略是 2(e+1)-近似；严格自适应增益要求在阳性检测后重新分池。
Motivation: 合并检测中动态策略可依据先前检测结果调整后续池，但自适应相对预先固定全部池的静态分配究竟能带来多大改进缺少一般性刻画。
Method: 用独立健康画像采样动态策略的一条路径，随机稀释所选池，再逐个 agent 将所得静态分配与动态策略比较；用 Boolean-cube 论证处理一致子立方，用 complementary-profile coupling 推广到任意异质乘积先验。另给出 Exact-Joint Greedy 与 Finster 等人的静态非重叠 Greedy，并附可复现的小规模精确实例研究。
Result: 主定理：最优动态策略价值至多为最优静态重叠分配的 2 倍，对任意人群、检测预算与池大小上限成立。Exact-Joint Greedy 取得最优静态重叠福利的 1/(e+1)，Finster 等人的静态非重叠 Greedy 有相同保证，故二者对最优动态策略均为 2(e+1)-近似。给出自适应无价值的若干体制、严格增益需阳性后重新分池的结论，以及一个自适应严格更优的三 agent 实例；附录记录 Gibbs-marginal 与强化学习在更大规模上的探索性结果。
Conclusion: 自适应相对静态分配的收益有统一的因子二上界，且只有在阳性后重新分池时才可能严格获益；贪心算法经该定理自动获得对动态最优的 2(e+1) 近似。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAPTOR: Ridge-Adaptive Logistic Probes
papers.abstract_en: Probing studies what information is encoded in a frozen LLM's layer representations by training a lightweight predictor on top of them. Beyond analysis, probes are often used operationally in probe-then-steer pipelines: a learned concept vector is extracted from a probe and injected via additive activation steering by adding it to a layer representation during the forward pass. The effectiveness of this pipeline hinges on estimating concept vectors that are accurate, directionally stable under ablation, and inexpensive to obtain. Motivated by these desiderata, we propose RAPTOR (Ridge-Adaptive Logistic Probe), a simple L2-regularized logistic probe whose validation-tuned ridge strength yields concept vectors from normalized weights. Across extensive experiments on instruction-tuned LLMs and human-written concept datasets, RAPTOR matches or exceeds strong baselines in accuracy while achieving competitive directional stability and substantially lower training cost; these quantitative results are supported by qualitative downstream steering demonstrations. Finally, using the Convex Gaussian Min-max Theorem (CGMT), we provide a mechanistic characterization of ridge logistic regression in an idealized Gaussian teacher-student model in the high-dimensional few-shot regime, explaining how penalty strength mediates probe accuracy and concept-vector stability and yielding structural predictions that qualitatively align with trends observed on real LLM embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAPTOR 用验证集调强度的 L2 正则 logistic probe 从冻结 LLM 层表示中提取概念向量，在指令微调 LLM 与人工概念数据集上达到与强基线持平或更高的准确率，同时训练成本显著更低、方向稳定性有竞争力，并用 CGMT 在高维少样本高斯 teacher-student 模型中给出正则强度如何同时调控准确率与概念向量稳定性的机制刻画。
Motivation: probe-then-steer 流程依赖概念向量准确、在消融下方向稳定且获取成本低，而现有 probe 难以同时满足这三点。
Method: 提出 RAPTOR：L2 正则 logistic probe，用验证集调节 ridge 强度，从归一化权重得到概念向量；再用 Convex Gaussian Min-max Theorem (CGMT) 在理想化高斯 teacher-student 模型的高维少样本 regime 下分析 ridge logistic regression。
Result: 在指令微调 LLM 与人工撰写概念数据集的大量实验中，RAPTOR 准确率匹配或超过强基线，方向稳定性有竞争力，训练成本显著更低，并有定性的下游 steering 演示；CGMT 推导的结构预测与真实 LLM embedding 上观察到的趋势定性一致。
Conclusion: 验证集调强度的 ridge logistic probe 能同时兼顾概念向量的准确率、方向稳定性与低成本，且其行为可由高维少样本理论解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Modeling of Discrete Data Using Geometric Latent Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: We propose a geometric latent-subspace framework for generative modeling of discrete data. Specifically, we introduce latent subspaces in the exponential parameter space of product manifolds of categorical distributions as a novel approach to learning low-dimensional representations of high-dimensional discrete data. The resulting low-dimensional latent space captures statistical dependencies and removes redundant degrees of freedom among the categorical variables. We equip the parameter domain with a Riemannian geometry such that the latent subspace and induced data manifold are related isometrically, enabling consistent flow matching. Exploiting this structure, we propose a geometry-aware dimensionality reduction objective, called geometric PCA (GPCA), which we formulate as a regularized cross-entropy minimization that encourages small Riemannian distances between the data and their reconstructions. In particular, under the induced geometry, geodesics correspond to straight lines in the latent parameter space, allowing flow matching to be performed directly in reduced coordinates. Empirical results show that low-dimensional latent representations suffice to accurately model high-dimensional discrete data and enable substantially more computationally efficient flow matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分类分布乘积流形的指数参数空间中引入几何潜子空间，配以使潜子空间与数据流形等距的 Riemannian 几何，使测地线在潜参数空间中成为直线，从而可在降维坐标上直接做 flow matching。几何降维目标 GPCA 被写成鼓励数据与重建之间 Riemannian 距离小的正则化交叉熵最小化；实证显示低维潜表示足以准确建模高维离散数据，并显著提升 flow matching 的计算效率。
Motivation: 高维离散数据（分类变量）的生成建模中，变量间存在统计依赖与冗余自由度，直接在高维参数空间做 flow matching 计算代价高，需要一种保留几何一致性的低维表示。
Method: 在分类分布乘积流形的指数参数空间中定义潜子空间，并给参数域装备 Riemannian 几何，使潜子空间与诱导的数据流形等距对应，从而支持一致的 flow matching；提出几何感知降维目标 geometric PCA (GPCA)，形式化为正则化交叉熵最小化，鼓励数据与其重建之间的 Riemannian 距离小；在该几何下测地线对应潜参数空间中的直线，因此 flow matching 可直接在降维坐标中进行。
Result: 实证结果显示低维潜表示足以准确建模高维离散数据，并使 flow matching 的计算效率显著提升（substantially more computationally efficient）。
Conclusion: 把离散数据的指数参数空间配上合适 Riemannian 几何后，低维潜子空间既能保留统计依赖，又能让 flow matching 在降维坐标中保持几何一致并大幅省算力。

papers.title: When to Think Fast and Slow? AMOR: Adaptive Entropy Gate for Hybrid Models
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent-attention hybrids aim to combine the efficiency of recurrence with the contextual recall of attention, but existing approaches typically apply attention uniformly across all positions, even when the recurrent state alone is sufficient for accurate prediction. We introduce AMOR (Adaptive Metacognitive Output Router), a post-hoc hybrid architecture that selectively invokes attention based on predictive uncertainty. A recurrent backbone is augmented with entropy-gated attention blocks that activate only when the model's output entropy exceeds a dynamic threshold derived from a running batch median and scaled standard deviation. The resulting binary gate requires no learned routing parameters. Pretrained from scratch on FineWeb-Edu and with attention invoked on only ~40% of positions, one of the AMOR variants (Mamba2 or Gated DeltaNet backbones) achieves the highest eight-task common-sense reasoning average at each scale among pure recurrent, pure attention, and fixed-schedule hybrid models. AMOR also improves retrieval performance over pure recurrent models while remaining competitive against fixed-schedule hybrids. Additionally, AMOR retains the long-context robustness of its recurrent backbones, where the Transformer and other hybrid architectures degrade under distribution shift. These results suggest that when attention is applied matters as much as how much: selectively allocating attention based on predictive uncertainty improves accuracy, robustness, and efficiency, offering a simple alternative to uniform or fixed routing strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AMOR 用输出熵超过动态阈值（运行批中位数加缩放标准差）作为二值门控，只在不确定的位置调用注意力，注意力仅在约 40% 位置触发。在 FineWeb-Edu 从零预训练后，其 Mamba2 或 Gated DeltaNet 变体在各规模上取得八项常识推理平均最高分，并在分布偏移下保持长上下文稳健性。
Motivation: 循环-注意力混合模型通常在所有位置均匀使用注意力，即使循环状态已足以准确预测，造成效率浪费且路由策略固定。
Method: AMOR（Adaptive Metacognitive Output Router）是后训练混合架构：以循环骨干（Mamba2 或 Gated DeltaNet）加熵门控注意力块，门控阈值由运行批中位数与缩放标准差动态导出，二值门无需可学习路由参数；在 FineWeb-Edu 上从零预训练。
Result: 注意力仅在约 40% 位置触发；在各规模上，AMOR 的八项常识推理平均分高于纯循环、纯注意力与固定调度混合模型；检索性能优于纯循环模型并与固定调度混合模型相当；在分布偏移下保持循环骨干的长上下文稳健性，而 Transformer 与其他混合架构出现退化。
Conclusion: 何时使用注意力与使用多少同样重要：基于预测不确定性选择性分配注意力，可在不引入可学习路由参数的前提下同时改善准确率、稳健性与效率，是均匀或固定路由的简单替代。

papers.title: Initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model
papers.abstract_en: Artificially intelligent systems have become remarkably sophisticated. They hold conversations, write essays, and seem to understand context in ways that surprise even their creators. This raises a crucial question: Are we creating systems that are conscious? The Digital Consciousness Model (DCM) is a first attempt to assess the evidence for consciousness in AI systems in a systematic, probabilistic way. It provides a shared framework for comparing different AIs and biological organisms, and for tracking how the evidence changes over time as AI develops. Instead of adopting a single theory of consciousness, it incorporates a range of leading theories and perspectives - acknowledging that experts disagree fundamentally about what consciousness is and what conditions are necessary for it. This report describes the structure and initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model. Overall, we find that the evidence is against 2024 LLMs being conscious, but the evidence against 2024 LLMs being conscious is not decisive. The evidence against LLM consciousness is much weaker than the evidence against consciousness in simpler AI systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Digital Consciousness Model (DCM) 用概率化、多理论并存的框架系统评估 AI 系统是否具有意识，可跨模型与生物体比较并随时间追踪证据变化。初始结果是：证据反对 2024 年 LLM 具有意识，但并不决定性；且反对 LLM 意识的证据远弱于反对更简单 AI 系统意识的证据。
Motivation: AI 已能对话、写作并表现出看似理解语境的能力，是否因此有意识成为紧迫问题；而意识理论专家在定义与必要条件上根本分歧，缺少统一、可随时间更新的证据评估框架。
Method: 提出 DCM：一个系统化、概率化的评估框架，不绑定单一意识理论，而是纳入多种主流意识理论与视角，为不同 AI 系统和生物体提供共享比较基准，并支持随 AI 发展追踪证据演化；报告描述其结构与初始结果。
Result: 初始结果：证据反对 2024 LLM 具有意识，但该反对证据并非决定性；反对 LLM 意识的证据强度远弱于反对更简单 AI 系统意识的证据。
Conclusion: 对 2024 LLM 意识的否定证据应视为非决定性的、且随系统复杂度减弱，因此需要用可累积、可更新的概率框架而非单一理论来判定 AI 意识。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeepFedNAS: Efficient Hardware-Aware Architecture Adaptation for Heterogeneous IoT Federations via Pareto-Guided Supernet Training
papers.abstract_en: Deploying federated learning across heterogeneous IoT device fleets requires tailored neural network architectures for each device class, yet existing Federated Neural Architecture Search (FedNAS) methods suffer from unguided supernet training and prohibitively costly post-training search pipelines that validate thousands of subnets to construct learned accuracy predictors. We introduce DeepFedNAS, a two-phase framework built on a multi-objective fitness function that synthesizes information-theoretic network metrics with architectural heuristics. In the first phase, Federated Pareto Optimal Supernet Training replaces random subnet sampling with a pre-computed cache of elite, high-fitness architectures, yielding a superior supernet. In the second phase, a Predictor-Free Search uses the structural fitness function as an accuracy proxy without constructing a learned subnet-accuracy predictor. In our CIFAR-10 benchmark, preparing the baseline predictor requires evaluating 10,000 subnets over the 5,000-image validation split, totaling 50 million image-level forward evaluations. DeepFedNAS eliminates these evaluations and selects a hardware-optimized architecture in $\sim$20 seconds on a CPU. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and CINIC-10 demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy and robust performance under extreme non-IID conditions ($α=0.1$). On CIFAR-100, DeepFedNAS provides an average 2.12-percentage-point gain across the four computation-budget intervals. Under the lowest evaluated computation budget, its mean result exceeds SuperFedNAS's best mean accuracy while using $2.95\times$ fewer parameters. These results make DeepFedNAS practical for scalable, communication-constrained IoT federations. Source code: https://github.com/bostankhan6/DeepFedNAS
papers.comment: This paper significantly extends the preliminary work presented at ESANN 2026. Source Code: https://github.com/bostankhan6/DeepFedNAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepFedNAS 用两阶段联邦神经架构搜索 (FedNAS) 替代昂贵的子网后搜索：先用精英架构缓存做 Pareto 引导的 supernet 训练，再用结构适应度函数直接当精度代理，免去训练子网-精度预测器。在 CIFAR-100 上四个计算预算区间平均提升 2.12 个百分点，最低预算下均值超过 SuperFedNAS 最佳均值且参数量少 2.95 倍，CPU 上约 20 秒选出硬件优化架构。
Motivation: 现有 FedNAS 的 supernet 训练用随机子网采样缺乏引导，且后训练搜索要验证上千个子网来拟合精度预测器，成本高到难以在通信受限的异构 IoT 联邦中落地。
Method: 两阶段框架，核心是把信息论网络度量与架构启发式合成的多目标适应度函数：第一阶段 Federated Pareto Optimal Supernet Training 用预计算的高适应度精英架构缓存替代随机子网采样；第二阶段 Predictor-Free Search 直接以结构适应度作为精度代理，不构建学习式子网-精度预测器。
Result: CIFAR-10 基线预测器需评估 10,000 个子网、覆盖 5,000 张验证图像，合计 5,000 万次图像级前向；DeepFedNAS 省去这些评估并在 CPU 上约 20 秒选出硬件优化架构。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CINIC-10 上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并在极端 non-IID（α=0.1）下表现稳健；CIFAR-100 四个计算预算区间平均提升 2.12 个百分点，最低预算下均值超过 SuperFedNAS 最佳均值且参数量少 2.95 倍。
Conclusion: 把适应度函数同时用作采样引导和精度代理，可以让 FedNAS 摒弃昂贵的预测器搜索流程，变得适用于可扩展、通信受限的 IoT 联邦。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Autoregressive Video Modeling Encodes Effective Representations
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in pretraining general foundation models have significantly improved performance across diverse downstream tasks. While autoregressive (AR) generative models like GPT have revolutionized NLP, most visual generative pretraining methods still rely on BERT-style masked modeling, which often disregards the temporal information essential for video analysis. The few existing autoregressive visual pretraining methods suffer from issues such as inaccurate semantic localization and poor generation quality, leading to poor semantics. In this work, we propose NExT-Vid, a novel autoregressive visual generative pretraining framework that utilizes masked next-frame prediction to jointly model images and videos. NExT-Vid introduces a context-isolated autoregressive predictor to decouple semantic representation from target decoding, and a conditioned flow-matching decoder to enhance generation quality and diversity. Through context-isolated flow-matching pretraining, our approach achieves strong representations. Extensive experiments on large-scale pretrained models demonstrate that our proposed method consistently outperforms previous generative pretraining methods for visual representation learning via attentive probing in downstream classification.
papers.comment: We plan to substantially revise the content of the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NExT-Vid 用掩码下一帧预测 (masked next-frame prediction) 联合建模图像与视频，通过 context-isolated 自回归预测器把语义表征与目标解码解耦，再用 conditioned flow-matching 解码器提升生成质量与多样性。在大规模预训练模型上的 attentive probing 下游分类实验中，其表征学习一致优于此前的生成式视觉预训练方法。
Motivation: 视觉生成式预训练多沿用 BERT 式掩码建模，忽略视频分析必需的时序信息；现有少数自回归视觉预训练又存在语义定位不准、生成质量差的问题，导致表征语义弱。
Method: NExT-Vid 框架以掩码下一帧预测联合预训练图像与视频，核心组件为 context-isolated autoregressive predictor（将语义表征与目标解码解耦）与 conditioned flow-matching decoder（提升生成质量与多样性），训练方式为 context-isolated flow-matching pretraining。
Result: 在大规模预训练模型上，通过 attentive probing 做下游分类，NExT-Vid 一致优于此前的生成式视觉预训练方法（视觉表征学习方向）。
Conclusion: 把下一帧预测与解耦的语义-解码结构结合，能产出强视觉表征，说明自回归视频建模可作为视觉生成式预训练的有效范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric-Photometric Event-based 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras offer a high temporal resolution over traditional frame-based cameras, which makes them suitable for motion and structure estimation. However, it has been unclear how event-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) approaches could leverage fine-grained temporal information of sparse events. This work proposes GPERT, a framework to address the trade-off between accuracy and temporal resolution in event-based 3DGS. Our key idea is to decouple the rendering into two branches: event-by-event geometry (depth) rendering and snapshot-based radiance (intensity) rendering, by using ray-tracing and the image of warped events. The extensive evaluation shows that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the real-world datasets and competitive performance on the synthetic dataset. Also, the proposed method works without prior information (e.g., pretrained image reconstruction models) or COLMAP-based initialization, is more flexible in the event selection number, and achieves sharp reconstruction on scene edges with fast training time. We hope that this work deepens our understanding of the sparse nature of events for 3D reconstruction. https://github.com/e3ai/gpert

papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 事件相机时间分辨率高，但事件驱动 3DGS 如何利用稀疏事件的细粒度时间信息一直不清楚，精度与时间分辨率之间存在权衡。
Method: GPERT 将渲染解耦为两条分支：逐事件的几何（深度）渲染走 ray-tracing，快照式辐射（强度）渲染基于 warped events 图像；不依赖预训练图像重建模型或 COLMAP 初始化，事件选取数量更灵活。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，在合成数据集上取得有竞争力的性能；场景边缘重建锐利、训练时间短，且对事件选取数量更灵活。
Conclusion: 把几何与辐射渲染解耦是释放事件稀疏性用于 3D 重建的有效路径，可在不依赖先验初始化的前提下兼顾时间分辨率与重建质量。

papers.title: FLAME: Flow Enhanced Legendre Memory Models for General Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce FLAME, a family of extremely lightweight and capable Time Series Foundation Models, which support versatile forecasting tasks via generative probabilistic modeling, while ensuring both efficiency and robustness. FLAME utilizes the Legendre Memory for strong generalization capabilities. By adapting variants of Legendre Memory, i.e., translated Legendre (LegT) and scaled Legendre (LegS), in the Encoding and Decoding phases, FLAME can effectively capture the inherent inductive bias within data and make efficient long-range inferences. To enhance the accuracy of probabilistic forecasting while remaining efficient, FLAME adopts a normalizing-flow-based forecasting head, which can model complex distributions over the forecasting horizon in a generative manner. Comprehensive experiments on three well-recognized benchmarks, including TSFM-Bench, ProbTS, and TFB, demonstrate that FLAME is a strong out-of-the-box tool for decision intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLAME 是一族极轻量的时间序列基础模型，用 Legendre Memory 的两个变体（translated Legendre LegT 与 scaled Legendre LegS）分别改造编码与解码阶段以捕捉数据归纳偏置并做长程推理，再接 normalizing-flow 预测头对预测窗口输出生成式概率分布。在 TSFM-Bench、ProbTS、TFB 三个基准上作为开箱即用的概率预测工具被检验。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型要在覆盖多类预测任务的同时保持轻量、概率输出与长程推理能力，现有模型难以兼顾效率与分布建模精度。
Method: 以 Legendre Memory 为核心记忆单元，编码阶段用 LegT、解码阶段用 LegS 变体注入归纳偏置；预测头采用 normalizing flow，以生成方式对整个预测窗口建模复杂分布，实现概率预测。
Result: 在三个公认基准 TSFM-Bench、ProbTS、TFB 上做了综合实验，摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: FLAME 被定位为一个极轻量、开箱即用、兼顾效率与鲁棒性的概率预测工具，可用于 decision intelligence。

papers.title: Prompt-Based Continual Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: We tackle continual adaptation of vision-language models to new attributes, objects, and their compositions in Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL), while preventing forgetting of prior knowledge. Unlike classical continual learning where classes are disjoint, CCZSL is more complex as attributes and objects may reoccur across sessions while compositions remain unique. Built on a frozen VLM backbone, we propose the first Prompt-based Continual Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (PromptCCZSL) framework that retains prior knowledge through recency-weighted multi-teacher distillation. It employs session-aware compositional prompts to fuse multimodal features for new compositions, while attribute and object prompts are learned through session-agnostic fusion to maintain global semantic consistency, which is further stabilized by a Cosine Anchor Loss (CAL) to preserve prior knowledge. To enhance adaptation in the current session, an Orthogonal Projection Loss (OPL) ensures that new attribute and object embeddings remain distinct from previous ones, preventing overlap, while an Intra-Session Diversity Loss (IDL) promotes variation among current-session embeddings for richer, more discriminative representations. We also introduce a comprehensive protocol that jointly measures catastrophic forgetting and compositional generalization. Extensive experiments on UT-Zappos and C-GQA benchmarks demonstrate that PromptCCZSL achieves substantial improvements over prior VLM-based and non-VLM baselines, setting a new benchmark for CCZSL in closed-world settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PromptCCZSL 用冻结 VLM 骨干加提示学习做持续组合零样本学习 (CCZSL)：新组合用 session-aware 组合提示融合多模态特征，属性与对象提示用 session-agnostic 融合保持全局语义一致，并以 Cosine Anchor Loss、Orthogonal Projection Loss、Intra-Session Diversity Loss 分别锚定旧知识、隔离新旧嵌入、拉开当前会话内嵌入。在 UT-Zappos 与 C-GQA 上相对既有 VLM 与非 VLM 基线取得显著提升，为闭集设定下的 CCZSL 立了新基准。
Motivation: 持续学习中类别互斥的设定不适用于 CCZSL：属性与对象会在不同会话重复出现而组合唯一，既要学会新组合又不能遗忘旧知识，现有持续学习方案无法直接处理。
Method: 冻结 VLM 骨干之上提出 PromptCCZSL：以 recency-weighted multi-teacher distillation 保留先前知识；session-aware 组合提示融合多模态特征以适配新组合，属性/对象提示经 session-agnostic 融合保持全局语义一致并由 Cosine Anchor Loss (CAL) 稳定；Orthogonal Projection Loss (OPL) 使新属性与对象嵌入与历史嵌入保持正交不重叠，Intra-Session Diversity Loss (IDL) 拉开当前会话内嵌入差异。另提出一套联合度量灾难性遗忘与组合泛化的评测协议。
Result: 在 UT-Zappos 与 C-GQA 两个基准上，相对既有 VLM-based 与非 VLM 基线取得 substantial improvements，并在闭集 (closed-world) 设定下为 CCZSL 设立新基准；同时给出联合衡量灾难性遗忘与组合泛化的协议。
Conclusion: 在冻结 VLM 上用提示与三条损失（CAL/OPL/IDL）配合 recency-weighted 多教师蒸馏，可以在属性对象复现、组合唯一的持续场景下同时保住旧知识并适配新组合。

papers.title: Consist-Retinex: One-Step Noise-Emphasized Consistency Training Accelerates High-Quality Retinex Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Retinex-based low-light image enhancement benefits from separating reflectance and illumination, yet recent generative approaches often rely on iterative sampling and are difficult to deploy under strict latency budgets. Consistency models offer a natural route to one-step restoration, but direct adaptation to Retinex-factorized enhancement is unstable: one-step inference is evaluated at the high-noise endpoint, whereas standard training schedules provide little supervision there, and temporal self-consistency alone does not determine the correct conditional target. We propose Consist-Retinex, which first uses a Retinex Transformer Decomposition Network (TDN) to obtain paired reflectance and illumination maps, then trains two conditional consistency models with a Retinex-aware dual objective and adaptive noise-emphasized fixed-point sampling. The dual objective combines trajectory consistency with paired ground-truth component alignment, while the sampling rule concentrates supervision near the inference endpoint without discarding full-range noise coverage. We further provide an endpoint error bound, an anchoring-propagation result, and a high-noise sample-allocation analysis that explain why endpoint supervision and temporal consistency are complementary for one-step Retinex enhancement. Experiments on paired and unpaired low-light benchmarks show that Consist-Retinex obtains the best VE-LOL-L scores among the compared methods under one-step inference and remains competitive on LOL, with substantially reduced sampling and consistency-stage training cost in the reported setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Consist-Retinex 把 Retinex 分解与一致性模型结合实现单步低-light增强：先用 Retinex Transformer Decomposition Network (TDN) 得到反射率与照度图，再用 Retinex-aware 双目标与自适应噪声加权定点采样把监督集中到推理端点。在配对与非配对低光基准上，单步推理取得 VE-LOL-L 最佳分数，LOL 上保持竞争力，并显著降低采样与一致性阶段训练开销。
Motivation: 基于生成式的 Retinex 低光增强依赖迭代采样，延迟预算下难以部署；直接把一致性模型搬到 Retinex 分解增强上不稳定——单步推理在高噪声端点评估，而标准训练在该处监督稀少，仅靠时间自洽无法确定正确条件目标。
Method: 先用 Retinex Transformer Decomposition Network (TDN) 得到成对的反射率与照度图，再训练两个条件一致性模型：Retinex-aware 双目标（轨迹一致性 + 成对真值分量对齐）配合自适应噪声加权定点采样 (noise-emphasized fixed-point sampling)，把监督集中到推理端点同时保留全噪声程覆盖；并给出端点误差界、锚定-传播结果与高噪声样本分配分析。
Result: 在配对与非配对低光基准上，单步推理下 Consist-Retinex 取得所比较方法中最佳 VE-LOL-L 分数，在 LOL 上保持竞争力；在报告的设置中采样与一致性阶段训练开销大幅降低。
Conclusion: 端点监督与时间一致性对单步 Retinex 增强是互补的，二者结合可在单步推理下取得高质量增强并压低采样与训练成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Testing the Utility of Using Large Language Models to Create Personalized Networks From Therapy Session Transcripts: A Proof of Concept Study
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in psychotherapy have focused on treatment personalization, such as by selecting treatment modules based on individual networks. However, estimating personalized networks typically requires intensive longitudinal data, which is not always feasible to collect. A solution to increase scalability of network-driven treatment personalization is leveraging large language models (LLMs). In this study, we developed an end-to-end pipeline for automatically generating client networks to support case conceptualization and treatment planning. We annotated 8,028 utterances from 77 therapy transcripts (N = 6). In the first stage of the pipeline, we identified clinically relevant processes (binary classification) and their corresponding dimensions (multi-label classification). Then, we introduced a two-step method that grouped the processes into clinically meaningful clusters and generated labels for the clusters. Finally, we generated connections between clusters. Evaluation results generally supported model utility, however, interrater agreement on model performance metrics was inconsistent, ranging from poor to substantial. Qualitative examination of the networks indicated consistency with original study data. Given coherence and interpretability of the generated networks, developing networks from therapy transcripts using LLMs appears to be feasible. Nonetheless, more research is needed to examine whether these networks improve treatment outcomes, including relative to other methods of treatment personalization, such as statistically estimated networks. Potential use cases and limitations of our pipeline are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 从治疗会谈转录中端到端生成个体化心理网络（client networks），无需密集纵向数据：先做临床过程二分类与维度多标签分类，再两步聚类并生成标签，最后生成簇间连接。在 77 段转录、8,028 条话语（N = 6）上评估总体支持模型可用，但评分者间一致性从 poor 到 substantial 不等。
Motivation: 基于个体网络的治疗个性化通常需要密集纵向数据，实际中难以采集，限制了网络驱动个性化方案的可扩展性。
Method: 端到端流水线分三阶段：二分类识别临床相关过程、多标签分类识别对应维度；两步法把过程分组为临床意义簇并生成簇标签；最后生成簇间连接。数据为 77 段治疗转录中的 8,028 条话语标注（N = 6）。
Result: 评估结果总体支持模型可用性；模型表现指标的评分者间一致性不一致，范围从 poor 到 substantial；定性检查显示生成网络与原始研究数据一致。
Conclusion: 用 LLM 从治疗转录生成网络是可行的，网络具备连贯性与可解释性；是否能改善治疗结局、以及相对统计估计网络等其他个性化方法的效果，仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Frequency-Decomposed Avatar Representation for Varying Camera Distances
papers.abstract_en: We present a CloseUpAvatar - a novel approach for articulated human avatar representation supporting a wider range of camera motions, while preserving rendering quality for close-up views. CloseUpAvatar represents an avatar as a set of textured planes with frequency-decomposed learnable textures for low and high-frequency detail. The method automatically switches to high-frequency textures when the camera comes close to the avatar's surface and gradually reduces their impact as the camera moves farther away. Such parametrization of the avatar enables CloseUpAvatar to adjust rendering quality based on camera distance ensuring realistic rendering across a wider range of camera orientations than previous approaches. We provide experiments on the ActorsHQ dataset with high-resolution input images and the THuman4.0 dataset with diverse articulated poses. CloseUpAvatar demonstrates both qualitative and quantitative improvements over existing methods in rendering from novel wide range camera positions, while maintaining high FPS by limiting the number of required primitives.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Anchor to Expand: Semantic Anchoring for Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models extends pretrained models to represent novel user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. However, learning a new concept while building on the prior knowledge of the pretrained model remains a key challenge. When personalization focuses on learning the target concept, the model tends to overfit the reference examples and degrade its general capability. In contrast, emphasizing prior preservation can hinder capturing distinctive personalized attributes. In this paper, we address this challenge by viewing a personalized concept as an underrepresented concept whose semantic counterpart is well represented in the pretrained model. Rather than treating the learning of a new concept and prior preservation as separate objectives, we reformulate them as a single anchored learning problem. We therefore introduce \textit{Semantic Anchoring Personalization} (SAP), which keeps concept learning grounded in the pretrained semantic structure while capturing subject-specific attributes. The proposed objective offers a simple yet effective formulation that can be applied across different model backbones without architectural modifications or auxiliary networks. Extensive experiments across various settings demonstrate that SAP achieves a better balance between subject fidelity and text-image alignment than baseline methods. Further ablation studies validate the contribution of semantic anchoring to personalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAP 把个性化概念视为预训练模型中语义对应物已充分表示的欠表示概念，将概念学习与先验保持重构为单一的锚定学习目标，使主体保真度与文本-图像对齐的权衡优于基线方法。
Motivation: 个性化扩散模型只用少量参考图学习新概念时，偏向概念学习会过拟合参考样本并损害通用能力，偏向先验保持又难以捕捉主体的独特属性，两个目标被当作彼此独立。
Method: 提出 Semantic Anchoring Personalization (SAP)：把新概念学习与先验保持统一为单一锚定学习问题，让概念学习始终锚定在预训练语义结构上，同时捕捉主体特有属性；目标函数可跨不同模型 backbone 使用，无需架构改动或辅助网络。
Result: 在多种设置下的实验表明，SAP 在主体保真度 (subject fidelity) 与文本-图像对齐 (text-image alignment) 之间取得优于基线方法的平衡；消融研究验证了语义锚定 (semantic anchoring) 对个性化的贡献。
Conclusion: 把概念学习与先验保持合并为单一锚定目标，可以在不改架构、不加辅助网络的前提下同时保住主体保真度与文本对齐。

papers.title: Does Understanding Inform Generation in Unified Multimodal Models? From Analysis to Path Forward
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed significant progress in Unified Multimodal Models, yet a fundamental question remains: Does understanding truly inform generation in Unified Multimodal Models? To investigate this, we introduce UniSandbox, a decoupled evaluation framework paired with controlled, synthetic datasets to avoid data leakage and enable detailed analysis. Our findings reveal a significant understanding-generation gap, which is mainly reflected in two key dimensions: reasoning generation and knowledge transfer. Specifically, for reasoning generation tasks, we observe that explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) in the understanding module effectively bridges the gap, and further demonstrate that a self-training approach can successfully internalize this ability, enabling implicit reasoning during generation. Additionally, for knowledge transfer tasks, we find that CoT assists the generative process by helping retrieve newly learned knowledge, and also discover that query-based architectures inherently exhibit latent CoT-like properties that affect this transfer. UniSandbox provides preliminary insights for designing future unified architectures and training strategies that truly bridge the understanding-generation gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniSandbox 用解耦评估框架与受控合成数据检验统一多模态模型中理解是否真的帮助生成，发现理解-生成差距主要出现在推理生成与知识迁移两个维度：理解模块中的显式 CoT 能弥合推理生成差距，自训练可把该能力内化为生成时的隐式推理；CoT 在知识迁移中靠帮助检索新学知识起作用，而 query-based 架构本身带有潜在的类 CoT 性质。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型同时做理解与生成，但理解能力是否真正反哺生成缺少可控检验；真实数据易泄漏，难以把差距归因到推理生成或知识迁移。
Method: 提出 UniSandbox：解耦评估框架，把理解模块与生成模块分开测；配受控合成数据集以避免数据泄漏并支持细粒度分析；在推理生成任务上比较显式 CoT 与自训练内化的隐式推理，在知识迁移任务上比较 CoT 辅助检索与 query-based 架构的潜在类 CoT 行为。
Result: 发现显著的理解-生成差距，集中于推理生成与知识迁移两个维度：显式 CoT 可有效弥合推理生成差距，自训练能内化该能力使生成时进行隐式推理；CoT 通过帮助检索新学知识辅助生成，query-based 架构天然表现出影响迁移的潜在类 CoT 性质。
Conclusion: 理解并不自动转化为生成：要弥合差距，推理生成需靠显式 CoT 起步再经自训练内化，知识迁移则依赖 CoT 检索与架构本身的类 CoT 机制；UniSandbox 为此类架构与训练策略设计提供初步依据。

papers.title: SLMFix: Leveraging Small Language Models for Domain Specific Language Error Fixing with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in code generation across many programming languages but even state-of-the-art LLMs generate programs that contain syntactic errors and fail to complete the given tasks, especially for low-resource programming languages (LRPLs). In addition, the high cost of training makes finetuning LLMs unaffordable for those with constrained computational resources, further weakening the effectiveness of LLMs for code generation. In this work, we propose SLMFix, a novel code generation pipeline that leverages a small language model (SLM) finetuned using reinforcement learning (RL) techniques to fix syntactic errors in LLM-generated programs for domain-specific languages (DSLs) based on interpreter feedback. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our approach across multiple DSLs, improving the validator pass rates by 40% on LRPLs and eliminating more than 50% of syntactic errors for high-resource DSLs. Notably, SLMFix brings substantial performance improvement to the base model and outperforms supervised finetuning approach even for 7B models on LRPLs including Ansible and Lean, showing the potential of our approach in improving the quality of LLM-generated programs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLMFix 用强化学习微调小语言模型 (SLM)，依据解释器反馈修复 LLM 为领域特定语言 (DSL) 生成的程序中的语法错误。在低资源语言 (LRPL) 上 validator 通过率提升 40%，高资源 DSL 消除超过 50% 的语法错误，且在 Ansible、Lean 等 LRPL 上 7B 模型也优于监督微调。
Motivation: LLM 生成的程序常含语法错误、无法完成任务，低资源语言尤其严重；全量微调 LLM 成本高，算力受限者难以负担。
Method: 提出 SLMFix 流水线：用强化学习微调小语言模型，奖励信号来自解释器对 LLM 生成程序的反馈，专门修复 DSL 程序的语法错误。
Result: LRPL 上 validator 通过率提升 40%；高资源 DSL 上消除超过 50% 的语法错误；在含 Ansible、Lean 的 LRPL 上，即使 7B 模型也优于监督微调 (supervised finetuning) 方案。
Conclusion: 用 RL 驱动的 SLM 修复 LLM 生成代码在多种 DSL 上有效且可泛化，能以低成本把基础模型的输出质量显著拉高。

papers.title: Structural Enforcement of Statistical Rigor in AI-Driven Discovery: A Functional Architecture
papers.abstract_en: AI-Scientist systems risk manufacturing spurious discoveries through uncontrolled multiple testing. We present a functional architecture that enforces statistical rigor at two levels: a Haskell embedded domain-specific language (the Research monad) that makes it impossible to test a hypothesis without updating the error budget, and a declarative scaffold that fixes the data flow and the statistical test, together with an OS-level sandbox that makes validation data physically absent from the environment in which LLM-generated code runs. We treat FDR control as a formal requirement and trace it to the implementation. We ground the design in a machine-checked Lean~4 formalization of LORD online false-discovery-rate (FDR) control: we derive its error budget and prove marginal FDR control, and full FDR control when thresholds do not adapt to earlier rejections. We then verify in SPARK/Ada that the LORD thresholds, computed in IEEE~754 arithmetic, never exceed the available wealth, given a margin condition that our configurations meet by a factor of at least eight; without a margin the property fails. To our knowledge this is the first machine-checked proof of an online FDR control theorem. In simulation, the architecture holds the false discovery rate near 1\% against a 5\% target, where a naive approach reaches 41\%. In end-to-end case studies, a valid test avoids the false discoveries a flawed one produces, yet still finds real effects when the data allow. An adversarial evaluation confirms that, inside the sandbox, generated code cannot read the held-out data even when given its exact path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI-Scientist 系统因失控多重检验制造假发现的问题，提出双层功能架构：Haskell 内嵌 DSL（Research monad）强制每次假设检验都更新误差预算，声明式 scaffold 固定数据流与统计检验，OS 级沙箱让验证数据在 LLM 生成代码的环境中物理不可达。以 Lean 4 机器校验的 LORD 在线 FDR 控制定理为形式化依据，仿真中该架构把错误发现率压到约 1%（目标 5%），朴素做法达 41%。
Motivation: AI-Scientist 系统在无人控管的多重检验下会批量制造虚假科学发现，且 LLM 生成的代码可能直接读到留出的验证数据，使统计检验形同虚设。
Method: 三层机制：Haskell Research monad 使不更新误差预算的假设检验无法表达；声明式 scaffold 固定数据流与所用统计检验；OS 级沙箱使验证数据在运行环境中物理缺席。正确性链条为 Lean 4 机器校验的 LORD 在线 FDR 控制形式化（推导误差预算，证明边缘 FDR 控制及阈值不依赖早期拒绝时的完全 FDR 控制），再用 SPARK/Ada 验证 IEEE 754 算术下 LORD 阈值不超过可用 wealth（需 margin 条件，配置至少以 8 倍满足；无 margin 则性质不成立）。
Result: 仿真中架构把错误发现率保持在约 1%（目标 5%），朴素方法达 41%；端到端案例研究中有效检验避免了有缺陷检验产生的假发现，同时在数据允许时仍检出真实效应；对抗性评估确认沙箱内生成代码即使拿到留出数据的确切路径也无法读取。作者称这是首个在线 FDR 控制定理的机器校验证明。
Conclusion: 把 FDR 控制当作形式化要求并追溯到实现（Lean 4 证明 + SPARK/Ada 数值验证 + 数据物理隔离），可以让 AI 驱动的科学发现在多重检验下保持统计严谨，且不牺牲检出真实效应的能力；margin 条件是数值实现成立的前提。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Models Got Talent: Identifying High Performing Wearable Human Activity Recognition Models Without Training
papers.abstract_en: Discovering high performing model architectures for wearables-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) applications is challenging. The astonishing diversity and variability due to differing sensor locations, recording apparatus, activities, etc., can cause established architectures to perform worse on datasets/tasks they were not designed for. A promising complement to Neural Architecture Search (NAS) involves the development of Zero Cost Proxies (ZCPs), which correlate well with trained performance, but can be computed through a single forward/backward pass on a randomly sampled batch of data. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of eight ZCPs on six benchmark HAR datasets, and demonstrate that the top-predicted architectures obtain performance within 7% of that attained by full-scale training of 2,000 randomly sampled architectures. Furthermore, training the top-10 predicted architectures results in performance within 2% of full-scale training, leading to substantial computational savings. Our experiments introduce ZCPs to sensor-based HAR and demonstrate their suitability as an addition to NAS pipelines in practical scenarios.

papers.title: Flow Reconstruction from Sparse Measurements in Urban Drainage Networks: An Application and Evaluation of Data-Driven Sparse Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Urbanization and increasingly frequent intense storms are placing stress on urban drainage networks. While dense monitoring of urban drainage networks is desirable, practical constraints in time, budget, and technology hinder its full implementation. How to monitor and predict flow conditions across the entire network under constrained resources is a major challenge. To address this, we utilized and evaluated an established data-driven sparse sensing (DSS) workflow for sensor placement optimization and sewer flow reconstruction in a 77-node urban drainage network. A validated SWMM parameterization was used to construct a spatial basis using singular value decomposition (SVD), select rank-specific layouts using pivoted QR, and define the reconstruction decoder. Applied to 225 held-out simulations combining 25 plausible calibrated parameter sets with 9 rainfall events, a 3-node monitoring layout (4% of the network) achieved a median system-level Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.791 and a 10th percentile of 0.719; all simulations exceeded NSE = 0.700. The pivoted QR-selected sensor sets were benchmarked against reference sensor configurations obtained from Greedy D-optimal and genetic algorithm, matching their performance without requiring iterative layout searches. We further evaluated the framework's robustness by introducing multiplicative Gaussian noise and simulating individual sensor failures, finding that performance was insensitive to noise but varied based on the location of lost monitored nodes. The reconstruction's sensitivity to monitored node loss was consistently associated with energy-weighted modal exposure with a leave-one-node-out Spearman correlation coefficient of 0.781, which was strongly correlated with the lost node's upstream drainage area, mean adjacent circular-conduit diameter, and nodal active flow fraction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 77 节点城市排水管网中，用 SVD 空间基加 pivoted QR 选点的 data-driven sparse sensing (DSS) 流程，仅布 3 个节点（占网络 4%）即可重建全网流量：225 组留出 SWMM 仿真上系统级 Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) 中位数 0.791、10 分位 0.719，全部仿真超过 0.700。QR 选点与 Greedy D-optimal、遗传算法的参考布点性能相当，且无需迭代搜索；性能对乘性高斯噪声不敏感，但对丢失节点位置敏感，敏感度由能量加权模态暴露度预测（leave-one-node-out Spearman 0.781）。
Motivation: 城市化与强降雨使排水管网承压，但时间、预算与技术约束使全网密集监测不可行，如何在受限资源下监测并预测全网流量状态是核心难题。
Method: 采用已有的 data-driven sparse sensing (DSS) 流程：以经验证的 SWMM 参数化构建流量场，用奇异值分解 (SVD) 生成空间基，用 pivoted QR 选择秩特定传感器布局并定义重建解码器；在 25 组可信校准参数与 9 场降雨事件组合出的 225 组留出仿真上检验，并与 Greedy D-optimal 和遗传算法得到的参考布局对比，另引入乘性高斯噪声与单传感器失效做鲁棒性测试。
Result: 3 节点布局（网络的 4%）在 225 组留出仿真上系统级 NSE 中位数 0.791、10 分位 0.719，全部仿真 NSE > 0.700；pivoted QR 选点在不需迭代布局搜索的情况下匹配 Greedy D-optimal 与遗传算法参考布局的性能。性能对乘性高斯噪声不敏感，但随丢失节点位置变化；对丢失节点的敏感度与能量加权模态暴露度的 leave-one-node-out Spearman 相关系数为 0.781，该暴露度又与丢失节点的上游汇水面积、相邻圆管平均直径和节点活跃流量分数强相关。
Conclusion: 稀疏传感布局配合 SVD/QR 重建能在仅 4% 节点监测下可靠复原全网流量，且选点无需昂贵搜索；传感器失效的代价主要由位置决定，可用能量加权模态暴露度提前识别高风险节点。

papers.title: The Plot Twist: Jailbreaking Unified Multimodal Models with a Three-Act NarrativeAttack
papers.abstract_en: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation Models (UMMs) increasingly combine visual understanding and image generation within a single interactive workflow, making generated visual content available as later reasoning context. However, existing jailbreak evaluations mostly study text rewriting or isolated visual prompts, leaving the safety risk of narrative cross-turn visual grounding underexplored. We propose NarrativeAttack, a semantic-preserving visual narrative jailbreak framework. NarrativeAttack employs a three-act narrative structure in which the UMM's own generator produces images for the setup (pre-event) and resolution (post-event) stages, making the full attack workflow self-contained while concealing the malicious event as a hidden climax. The attack concludes with an image-based "guessing game" that embeds the original malicious query among benign candidates, compelling the model to select and answer the most relevant one based on the established narrative context. A dynamic difficulty mechanism further enhances attack stability. Experiments show NarrativeAttack consistently surpasses prior approaches, achieving up to 88.25% ASR on Gemini-2.5-Flash. These results uncover an underdeveloped vulnerability and highlight the urgent need for safety alignment in UMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NarrativeAttack 用三幕叙事把恶意请求藏在统一多模态模型自己生成的图像序列里：第一幕与第三幕由模型生成事件前后的图，恶意事件作为隐藏高潮，最后用图像猜谜把恶意查询混入良性候选逼模型作答，再加动态难度机制稳定攻击。在 Gemini-2.5-Flash 上 ASR 最高达 88.25%，一致超过既有越狱方法。
Motivation: 现有越狱评测多针对文本改写或孤立视觉提示，跨轮次由生成图像承载叙事上下文的安全风险基本没被检验，而 UMM 的生成结果会成为后续推理的输入。
Method: 提出语义保持的视觉叙事越狱框架 NarrativeAttack：三幕结构中 setup（事件前）与 resolution（事件后）图像由被攻击 UMM 自身生成，恶意事件隐藏为高潮；收尾用基于图像的猜谜把原始恶意查询嵌入良性候选，配合动态难度机制提升攻击稳定性。
Result: 实验显示 NarrativeAttack 一致超过先前方法，在 Gemini-2.5-Flash 上 ASR 最高 88.25%。
Conclusion: 跨轮次叙事化的视觉落地是一条尚未充分防护的越狱通道，UMMs 需要针对这类自生成图像上下文的安全对齐。

papers.title: What Do They Fix? LLM-Aided Categorization of Security Patches for Critical Memory Bugs
papers.abstract_en: Open-source software projects are foundational to modern software ecosystems, with the Linux kernel standing out as a critical exemplar due to its ubiquity and complexity. Although security patches are continuously integrated into the Linux mainline kernel, downstream maintainers often delay their adoption, creating windows of vulnerability. A key reason for this lag is the difficulty in identifying security-critical patches, particularly those addressing exploitable vulnerabilities such as out-of-bounds (OOB) accesses and use-after-free (UAF) bugs. This challenge is exacerbated by intentionally silent bug fixes, incomplete or missing CVE assignments, delays in CVE issuance, and recent changes to the CVE assignment criteria for the Linux kernel. While fine-grained patch classification approaches exist, they exhibit limitations in both coverage and accuracy. In this work, we identify previously unexplored opportunities to significantly improve fine-grained patch classification. Specifically, by leveraging cues from commit titles/messages and diffs alongside appropriate code context, we develop DUALLM, a dual-method pipeline that integrates two approaches based on a Large Language Model (LLM) and a fine-tuned small language model. DUALLM achieves 87.4% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.875, significantly outperforming prior solutions. Notably, DUALLM successfully identified 111 of 5,140 recent Linux kernel patches as addressing OOB or UAF vulnerabilities, with 90 true positives confirmed by manual verification (many do not have clear indications in patch descriptions). Moreover, we constructed proof-of-concepts for two identified bugs (one UAF and one OOB), including one developed to conduct a previously unknown control-flow hijack as further evidence of the correctness of the classification.
papers.journal_ref: Network and Distributed System Security (NDSS) Symposium 2026, pp. 1-18
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DUALLM 用 LLM 与微调小模型双路流水线，结合 commit 标题/消息、diff 与代码上下文，对 Linux 内核安全补丁做细粒度分类（OOB/UAF）。准确率 87.4%、F1 0.875，显著超过既有方案；在 5,140 个近期补丁中筛出 111 个候选，人工确认 90 个真阳性，并为两个漏洞做出 PoC，其中一个实现此前未知的控制流劫持。
Motivation: 下游维护者迟迟不合入安全补丁，留下漏洞窗口；识别安全关键补丁困难，因为存在刻意静默的修复、CVE 缺失或延迟、以及 Linux 内核 CVE 判定标准近期变更，而既有细粒度补丁分类方法在覆盖面与准确率上都受限。
Method: DUALLM 是双方法流水线：一路基于 LLM，一路基于微调的小语言模型，输入为 commit 标题/消息、diff 及配套代码上下文，两者结合做 OOB 与 UAF 类安全补丁的细粒度分类。

Conclusion: 结合 commit 文本、diff 与代码上下文的 LLM+小模型双路分类能显著提升安全补丁识别的覆盖面与准确率，且分类结果可由 PoC 复现验证为正确。

papers.title: AUWave: A Data-Driven Model for Reconstructing Significant Wave Heights Using Sparse Observations
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing high-resolution regional significant wave height (SWH) fields from sparse buoy observations is a critical challenge for ocean monitoring. We introduce AUWave, a hybrid deep learning framework that fuses a station-wise encoder with a multi-scale U-Net enhanced by self-attention to recover regional SWH fields. Trained and validated using NDBC buoy observations and ERA5 reanalysis over the Hawaii region, AUWave achieves high accuracy. It consistently outperforms a representative baseline, especially in configurations with more than a single buoy, demonstrating the benefit of its multi-scale architecture. Spatial error analysis shows performance is highest near observation sites, as expected. Further, buoy ablation studies identify critical anchor stations whose removal disproportionately degrades performance, offering actionable guidance for observational network design. AUWave provides a scalable pathway for gap-filling, creating high-resolution priors for data assimilation, and contingency reconstruction. Cross-basin evaluations in the Atlantic and Pacific confirm the model robustness and portability, highlighting its potential for operational use across diverse ocean regimes.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 22 figures. Author-accepted manuscript of arXiv:2509.19384. Updated title, authors, and cross-basin results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AUWave 用站点编码器加自注意力增强的多尺度 U-Net，从稀疏浮标观测重建高分辨率有效波高 (SWH) 场，在 Hawaii 用 NDBC 浮标与 ERA5 训练验证，单浮标以上配置稳定优于代表性基线。浮标消融识别出移除后性能大幅下降的关键锚点站，跨大西洋与太平洋评估确认可迁移；该模型被定位为数据同化 (data assimilation) 的高分辨率先验与缺测填补工具。
Motivation: 稀疏浮标观测难以支撑高分辨率区域 SWH 场重建，而这类场既是海洋监测的关键，也是数据同化所需的高分辨率先验与缺测期应急重建的输入。
Method: 混合深度学习框架：站点编码器 (station-wise encoder) 逐站编码浮标观测，与自注意力增强的多尺度 U-Net 融合，输出区域 SWH 场；用 NDBC 浮标观测与 ERA5 再分析在 Hawaii 区域训练验证，并做浮标消融与跨盆地评估。
Result: 在 Hawaii（NDBC + ERA5）上精度高，且在多于单个浮标的配置下持续优于一个代表性基线；空间误差分析显示观测站点附近误差最低；浮标消融识别出移除后性能不成比例下降的关键锚点站；在大西洋与太平洋的跨盆地评估确认模型鲁棒性与可迁移性。
Conclusion: 多尺度架构加站点编码能从稀疏浮标有效重建区域 SWH 场，且可作为数据同化的高分辨率先验与业务化缺测填补路径；关键锚点站的识别可直接指导观测网布设。

summary_sections.motivation: 稀疏浮标观测难以支撑高分辨率区域 SWH 场重建，而这类场既是海洋监测的关键，也是数据同化所需的高分辨率先验与缺测期应急重建的输入。

papers.title: Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with Heavy-Tailed Noise
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers the smooth bilevel optimization in which the lower-level problem is strongly convex and the upper-level problem is possibly nonconvex. We focus on the stochastic setting where the algorithm can access the unbiased stochastic gradient evaluation with heavy-tailed noise, which is prevalent in many machine learning applications, such as training large language models and reinforcement learning. We propose a nested-loop normalized stochastic bilevel approximation (N$^2$SBA) for finding an $ε$-stationary point with the stochastic first-order oracle (SFO) complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(κ^{\frac{7p-3}{p-1}} σ^{\frac{p}{p-1}} ε^{-\frac{4 p - 2}{p-1}}\big)$, where $κ$ is the condition number, $p\in(1,2]$ is the order of central moment for the noise, and $σ$ is the noise level. Furthermore, we specialize our idea to solve the nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax optimization problem, achieving an $ε$-stationary point with the SFO complexity of~$\tilde{\mathcal O}\big(κ^{\frac{2p-1}{p-1}} σ^{\frac{p}{p-1}} ε^{-\frac{3p-2}{p-1}}\big)$. All the above upper bounds match the best-known results under the special case of the bounded variance setting, i.e., $p=2$. We also conduct the numerical experiments to show the empirical superiority of the proposed methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出嵌套循环的归一化随机双层近似算法 N²SBA，用于下层强凸、上层可能非凸的光滑双层优化，在仅有无偏但重尾噪声随机梯度的 oracle 下求 ε-驻点，SFO 复杂度为 Õ(κ^((7p−3)/(p−1)) σ^(p/(p−1)) ε^(−(4p−2)/(p−1)))，p∈(1,2] 为噪声中心矩阶数。该框架特化到非凸-强凹 minimax 优化得到 Õ(κ^((2p−1)/(p−1)) σ^(p/(p−1)) ε^(−(3p−2)/(p−1)))，两者在 p=2 的有界方差特例下均匹配已知最好结果。
Motivation: 随机双层优化与 minimax 优化的标准理论依赖有界方差噪声，而训练大语言模型、强化学习等场景的随机梯度噪声是重尾的，p=2 假设下的复杂度界不再适用。
Method: N²SBA 采用嵌套循环结构做随机双层近似，配合归一化处理重尾噪声（中心矩阶数 p∈(1,2]），以随机一阶 oracle (SFO) 求上层 ε-驻点；下层问题假设强凸，上层允许非凸。同一思想特化到非凸-强凹 minimax 优化。
Result: 双层问题的 SFO 复杂度为 Õ(κ^((7p−3)/(p−1)) σ^(p/(p−1)) ε^(−(4p−2)/(p−1)))；minimax 情形为 Õ(κ^((2p−1)/(p−1)) σ^(p/(p−1)) ε^(−(3p−2)/(p−1)))。两个上界在 p=2 的有界方差特例下均匹配已知最好结果；数值实验显示所提方法具有经验优势。
Conclusion: 重尾噪声下的双层与 minimax 优化可以达到与有界方差情形相当的最优复杂度，归一化随机近似是把 p=2 理论推广到 p∈(1,2] 的有效途径。

papers.title: Neural Bridge Processes
papers.abstract_en: Learning stochastic functions from partially observed context-target pairs requires models that are expressive, uncertainty-aware, and strongly conditioned on inputs. Neural Diffusion Processes (NDPs) improve expressivity with denoising diffusion, but their forward process is input-independent; inputs only enter the reverse denoiser, so the noisy training states themselves do not encode the conditioning inputs. We propose Neural Bridge Processes (NBPs), which replace the unconditional forward kernel with an input-anchored bridge trajectory. When input and output dimensions differ, NBP learns an output-space anchor $a_ψ(x)=P_ψ(x)$, allowing coordinates or other inputs to guide the generative path without changing the denoising backbone. We show theoretically that process-level anchoring induces pathwise input distinguishability, injects information about x into noisy states, and creates a direct gradient pathway unavailable to NDPs. Experiments on synthetic regression, EEG, CylinderFlow, and image regression show consistent improvements. Additional ablations show that the gains come from the full bridge construction with learned alignment, and that the same input-anchored path principle transfers to Flow Matching Neural Processes. These results suggest that bridge-anchored generative paths provide a general mechanism for strengthening conditional stochastic function modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neural Bridge Processes (NBP) 把 NDP 中与输入无关的前向扩散核换成由输入锚定的 bridge 轨迹：当输入与输出维度不同时，学习输出空间锚点 a_ψ(x)=P_ψ(x)，让条件输入直接进入含噪训练状态。理论上该过程级锚定带来 pathwise 输入可区分性、向含噪状态注入 x 信息，并形成 NDP 没有的直接梯度通路；在合成回归、EEG、CylinderFlow 与图像回归上均有一致改进。
Motivation: NDP 的前向过程与输入无关，输入只进入反向去噪器，含噪训练状态本身不携带条件信息，限制了条件随机函数建模的表达力与梯度路径。
Method: 用输入锚定的 bridge 前向核替换无条件前向核；输入输出维度不同时学习输出空间锚点 a_ψ(x)=P_ψ(x)，去噪 backbone 保持不变。给出过程级锚定的理论性质，并做消融验证增益来自含学习对齐的完整 bridge 构造，同时把该输入锚定路径原理迁移到 Flow Matching Neural Processes。
Result: 在合成回归、EEG、CylinderFlow 和图像回归四类任务上均取得一致改进；消融显示增益来自含学习对齐的完整 bridge 构造；同一输入锚定路径原理可迁移到 Flow Matching Neural Processes。
Conclusion: bridge 锚定的生成路径是强化条件随机函数建模的通用机制，且不依赖特定去噪骨干。

papers.title: DeepC4: Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering for Large-scale Multitask Spatial Disaggregation of Urban Morphology
papers.abstract_en: To understand our global progress for sustainable development and disaster risk reduction in many developing economies, two recent major initiatives - the Uniform African Exposure Dataset of the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) Foundation and the Modelling Exposure through Earth Observation Routines (METEOR) Project - implemented classical spatial disaggregation techniques to generate large-scale mapping of urban morphology using the information from various satellite imagery and its derivatives, geospatial datasets of the built environment, and subnational census statistics. However, the local discrepancy with well-validated census statistics and the propagated model uncertainties remain a challenge in such coarse-to-fine-grained mapping problems, specifically constrained by weak and conditional label supervision. Therefore, we present Deep Conditional Census-Constrained Clustering (DeepC4), a novel deep learning-based spatial disaggregation approach that incorporates local census statistics as cluster-level constraints while considering multiple conditional label relationships in a joint multitask learning of the patterns of satellite imagery. As a demonstration using Rwandan urban morphology, DeepC4 achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.63, 0.78, and 0.45 and macro-mIoU of 0.57, 0.71, and 0.42 for roof, wall, and height prediction respectively, estimates national dwelling and occupant counts within 1.13% and 1.11% error compared to census records, outperforming GEM (2.03% and 3.29%), and occupies 32%-49% more 500-meter grid pixels than METEOR across provinces. As the world approaches the conclusion of many global frameworks in 2030, our work offers a new deep learning-based mapping technique that explicitly encodes well-validated census and experts' belief systems to achieve an explainable and interpretable auditing of existing coarse-grained derived information at large scales.
papers.comment: Preprint (in review) | Keywords: urban morphology, building exposure, physical vulnerability, spatial disaggregation, deep clustering | Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13119552 | Code: https://github.com/riskaudit/DeepC4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DeepC4，把次国家级人口普查统计作为聚类级约束、并以多任务方式联合学习卫星影像中的多种条件标签关系，用于城市形态的粗到细空间分解 (spatial disaggregation)。在卢旺达演示中，屋顶/墙体/高度的 macro-F1 分别为 0.63、0.78、0.45，全国住户与人口计数误差 1.13% 与 1.11%，优于 GEM 的 2.03% 与 3.29%。
Motivation: GEM 的 Uniform African Exposure Dataset 与 METEOR 项目用经典空间分解生成大尺度城市形态图，但与经过验证的普查统计存在局部偏差，且在弱、条件性标签监督下模型不确定性会向下游传播。
Method: DeepC4 是基于深度学习的空间分解方法：把本地人口普查统计编码为聚类级约束，在联合多任务学习中同时建模多种条件标签关系，学习卫星影像及其衍生数据、建成环境地理空间数据的模式；目标是把粗网格信息审计到细粒度。
Result: 在卢旺达城市形态演示中，屋顶、墙体、高度预测的 macro-F1 分别为 0.63、0.78、0.45，macro-mIoU 分别为 0.57、0.71、0.42；全国住户数与人口数相对普查记录误差为 1.13% 与 1.11%，优于 GEM 的 2.03% 与 3.29%；在各省份比 METEOR 多覆盖 32%–49% 的 500 米网格像元。
Conclusion: 把经过验证的普查统计与专家信念显式编码进深度聚类，可以在大尺度上对既有粗粒度派生信息做可解释、可审计的重构，误差低于经典暴露制图流程。

papers.title: Unsupervised Methods for Video Quality Improvement: A Survey of Restoration and Enhancement Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Video restoration and enhancement are critical not only for improving visual quality, but also as essential pre-processing steps to boost the performance of a wide range of downstream computer vision tasks. This survey presents a comprehensive review of video restoration and enhancement techniques with a particular focus on unsupervised approaches. We begin by outlining the most common video degradations and their underlying causes, followed by a review of early conventional and deep learning methods-based, highlighting their strengths and limitations. We then present an in-depth overview of unsupervised methods, categorise by their fundamental approaches, including domain translation, self-supervision signal design and blind spot or noise-based methods. We also provide a categorization of loss functions employed in unsupervised video restoration and enhancement, and discuss the role of paired synthetic datasets in enabling objective evaluation. Finally, we identify key challenges and outline promising directions for future research in this field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于无监督视频复原与增强的综述，按域迁移 (domain translation)、自监督信号设计、盲点/噪声方法三类梳理无监督方法，并单独归类所用损失函数，讨论配对合成数据集在客观评测中的作用。结论是无监督视频复原可作为提升下游计算机视觉任务性能的前置环节，其可评测性依赖配对合成数据集。
Motivation: 视频复原与增强是下游计算机视觉任务的前置环节，但真实退化缺少干净参考，监督训练难以构造配对数据，需要系统梳理无监督路线及其评测方式。
Method: 综述先归纳常见视频退化及其成因，回顾传统与深度学习方法的优劣，再按域迁移、自监督信号设计、盲点/噪声方法三类组织无监督方法，并对损失函数单独分类，同时讨论配对合成数据集如何支撑客观评测。
Result: 综述给出视频退化类型、无监督方法三大类、损失函数分类体系，以及配对合成数据集用于客观评测的讨论，并指出该领域的关键挑战与未来方向；摘要中无定量指标。
Conclusion: 无监督视频复原与增强已形成域迁移、自监督信号、盲点/噪声三条清晰路线，其客观评测仍依赖配对合成数据集，作者据此列出关键挑战与后续研究方向。

papers.title: LapDDPM: Spectral Perturbation Diffusion for Robust Single-Cell Manifold Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-fidelity and biologically plausible synthetic single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is a critical challenge in computational biology, driven by the need to model high-dimensional, sparse, and non-linear cellular manifolds. Existing generative models often fail to capture the complex topology of cellular differentiation or lack robustness against technical noise and structural variability. We introduce LapDDPM, a novel conditional Graph Diffusion Probabilistic Model designed for robust manifold learning and high-fidelity generation. LapDDPM integrates graph-based inductive biases with score-based generative modeling, enhanced by a novel spectral adversarial perturbation mechanism. By systematically perturbing graph edge weights along principal spectral modes during training, our method acts as a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) framework, enforcing invariance to structural noise. We further extend LapDDPM to spatial transcriptomics and multi-modal data, treating generation as a robust inverse problem on cellular graphs. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets, including PBMC3K, Dentate Gyrus, HLCA, Visium, and 10x Multiome, demonstrate that LapDDPM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in distribution matching, manifold preservation, and downstream utility, generating biologically coherent cell states.
papers.comment: LapDDPM is a novel conditional graph diffusion model for scRNA-seq generation. Leveraging spectral adversarial perturbations, it ensures robustness and yields high-fidelity, biologically plausible, and cell-type-specific samples for complex data. TL;DR: LapDDPM 是面向 scRNA-seq 的条件图扩散生成模型，训练时沿图的主谱模态系统性扰动边权重，把生成当作分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 问题来强制对结构噪声不变。在 PBMC3K、Dentate Gyrus、HLCA、Visium 与 10x Multiome 上，其分布匹配、流形保持与下游效用均显著优于 SOTA 基线，并可扩展到空间转录组与多模态数据。
Motivation: 现有生成模型难以捕捉细胞分化的复杂拓扑，且对技术噪声与结构变异缺乏鲁棒性，高维稀疏非线性的细胞流形因此难以生成高保真、生物学可信的合成数据。
Method: 条件图扩散概率模型 (graph diffusion probabilistic model)，结合图归纳偏置与 score-based 生成建模；核心是谱对抗扰动机制，训练中沿主谱模态 (principal spectral modes) 系统扰动图边权重，构成 DRO 框架；并把生成扩展为细胞图上的鲁棒逆问题，覆盖空间转录组与多模态数据。
Result: 在 PBMC3K、Dentate Gyrus、HLCA、Visium、10x Multiome 等多样数据集上的实验中，LapDDPM 在分布匹配、流形保持和下游效用三个维度显著优于 SOTA 基线，生成生物学上连贯的细胞状态。
Conclusion: 把谱对抗扰动作为 DRO 约束加入图扩散，可在生成高保真 scRNA-seq 样本的同时获得对结构噪声的不变性，并推广到空间与多模态场景。

papers.title: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models represented by the Deepseek-R1-Distill series have been widely adopted by the open-source community due to their strong performance in mathematics, science, programming, and other domains. However, our study reveals that their benchmark evaluation results are subject to significant fluctuations caused by various factors. Subtle differences in evaluation conditions can lead to substantial variations in results. Similar phenomena are observed in other open-source inference models fine-tuned based on the Deepseek-R1-Distill series, as well as in the QwQ-32B model, making their claimed performance improvements difficult to reproduce reliably. Therefore, we advocate for the establishment of a more rigorous paradigm for model performance evaluation and present our empirical assessments of the Deepseek-R1-Distill series models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列及其衍生开源推理模型的基准评测结果会因评测条件的细微差异而大幅波动，QwQ-32B 也出现同样现象，导致宣称的性能提升难以可靠复现。作者据此主张建立更严格的模型性能评测范式，并给出对 Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列的实证评测。
Motivation: 开源社区广泛采用 Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列等推理模型，但其基准分数受评测条件影响波动显著，宣称的改进无法稳定复现，评测规范本身需要收紧。
Method: 对 Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列模型做实证评测，系统改变评测条件以观察结果波动，并把同一现象扩展检验到基于该系列微调的开源推理模型与 QwQ-32B。
Result: 评测条件的细微差别会导致结果的大幅变化，Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列的基准分数存在显著波动，基于其微调的开源模型与 QwQ-32B 也观察到同样现象，使宣称的性能提升难以可靠复现。
Conclusion: 推理模型的性能宣称必须建立在更严格、可复现的评测范式之上，否则报告的提升不可信。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OSPO: Object-Centric Self-Improving Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled unified multimodal understanding and generation. However, they still struggle with fine-grained text-image alignment, often failing to faithfully depict objects with correct attributes such as color, shape, and spatial relations. To mitigate this issue, previous studies have explored preference optimization methods such as DPO and GRPO, but these approaches incur substantial computational cost, both in constructing preference data and in performing optimization. This has motivated self-improving preference optimization approaches, in which the MLLM autonomously generates its own training data, self-estimates preference feedback, and self-optimizes using the resulting self-constructed preference pairs. However, existing self-improving methods still overlook fine-grained, object-level semantics, allowing object hallucination to persist. To tackle this problem, we propose Object-centric Self-improving Preference Optimization (OSPO), a self-improving framework designed to enhance object-level text-image alignment. OSPO explicitly constructs object-centric preference data without relying on any external data and external models. We also introduce a new approach that leverages attention-based object masks together with an object-weighted SimPO loss to enhance object-specific fidelity. Extensive experiments on three compositional image generation benchmarks demonstrate that OSPO significantly improves fine-grained alignment and reduces object hallucination, outperforming prior self-improving methods and even specialized diffusion-based text-to-image models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OSPO 针对多模态大模型 (MLLM) 文生图中物体属性与空间关系的细粒度对齐失败，提出完全自构造的物体中心偏好优化：不依赖外部数据与外部模型，用注意力生成的物体掩码 (attention-based object masks) 构造物体级偏好对，并以物体加权 SimPO 损失训练。在三个组合式文生图基准上显著改善细粒度对齐、减少物体幻觉，超过既往自改进方法乃至专门的扩散式文生图模型。
Motivation: MLLM 统一理解与生成后仍难以忠实描绘颜色、形状、空间关系等物体属性；已有 DPO/GRPO 类偏好优化构造偏好数据与优化开销大，而既有自改进方法忽略物体级语义，物体幻觉 (object hallucination) 持续存在。
Method: OSPO 是自改进 (self-improving) 框架：MLLM 自生成训练数据、自估计偏好反馈、用自构造偏好对自优化；显式构造完全不依赖外部数据与外部模型的物体中心偏好数据；引入基于注意力的物体掩码，配合物体加权 SimPO 损失 (object-weighted SimPO loss) 强化物体级保真。
Result: 在三个组合式图像生成基准 (compositional image generation benchmarks) 上，OSPO 显著改善细粒度文本-图像对齐并减少物体幻觉，优于既往自改进方法，也优于专门的扩散式文生图模型。
Conclusion: 把物体级语义显式放进自改进偏好优化的数据构造与损失加权，可以在不引入外部数据和外部模型的前提下解决 MLLM 文生图的物体幻觉问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChemMLLM: Chemical Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have seen rapid progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in the field of chemistry. However, chemical MLLMs that can handle cross-modal understanding and generation remain underexplored. To fill this gap, we propose ChemMLLM, a unified chemical multimodal large language model for molecule understanding and generation. In this work, we design five types of multimodal tasks across text, molecular SMILES strings and images, and curate the datasets. We benchmark ChemMLLM against a range of general leading MLLMs, Chemical LLMs and specialized models on these tasks. Experimental results show that ChemMLLM achieves superior performance among general-purpose MLLMs and close performance to specialized models across all evaluated tasks. Our work extends the capabilities of chemical multimodal large language models to the realm of image generation, demonstrating the feasibility of unifying multiple cross-modal chemical tasks within a single foundation model and enabling more intuitive, visual human-AI interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChemMLLM 是一个统一的化学多模态大语言模型，同时处理分子理解与生成，覆盖文本、SMILES 与图像之间的五类跨模态任务。在与通用 MLLM、化学 LLM 和专用模型的对比中，它在通用模型中最优、并接近专用模型水平，且把化学 MLLM 的能力扩展到图像生成。
Motivation: 现有化学多模态大语言模型主要做理解，跨模态的理解与生成（尤其是图像生成）尚未被统一到单一模型中。
Method: 设计覆盖文本、分子 SMILES 与图像的五类多模态任务并构建相应数据集，训练统一的化学 MLLM ChemMLLM，同时承担分子理解与生成；在这些任务上与通用领先 MLLM、化学 LLM 及专用模型对比评测。
Result: 在全部被评测任务上，ChemMLLM 在通用模型中性能最优，并接近专用模型的水平；同时展示了化学图像生成能力。
Conclusion: 单一基础模型可以统一多种跨模态化学任务，使化学 MLLM 拓展到图像生成，支持更直观的可视化人机交互。

papers.title: RefRef: A Dataset and Benchmark for Reconstructing Refractive and Reflective Objects
papers.abstract_en: Modern 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis approaches have demonstrated strong performance on scenes with opaque, non-refractive objects. However, most assume straight light paths and therefore cannot properly handle refractive and reflective materials. The lack of datasets specialized for these effects has impeded efforts to fairly and thoroughly evaluate performance and thereby make progress in this domain. Most existing datasets focus on opaque scenes, while those targeting refractive objects are often limited to thin glass with negligible ray bending, untinted single-material objects, or backgrounds treated as infinitely-distant, leaving key failure modes under strong refraction untested. To address this gap, we introduce the RefRef dataset. It contains 150 synthetic and 60 real scenes spanning varying levels of geometric complexity and diverse background types that expose the limitations of existing methods. For the purpose of benchmarking, we also provide an oracle method that, given the object geometry and refractive indices, calculates accurate light paths for neural rendering, and a simple two-stage baseline that relaxes these assumptions. We evaluate these against state-of-the-art methods and show that the task is far from solved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefRef 提出面向折射与反射物体的新视角合成基准：150 个合成场景加 60 个真实场景，覆盖不同几何复杂度与背景类型，并附带一个给定物体几何与折射率即可精确计算光路的 oracle 方法，以及一个放松这些假设的两阶段基线。与现有 SOTA 对比显示该任务远未解决。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重建与新视角合成方法默认光线直线传播，无法处理强折射/反射材质；而现有数据集要么是不透明场景，要么只含可忽略弯折的薄玻璃、无色单一材质或无限远背景，关键失效模式从未被检验。
Method: 构建 RefRef 数据集（150 合成 + 60 真实场景，多级几何复杂度与多样背景）；提供 oracle 方法，在已知物体几何与折射率时为神经渲染计算准确光路；另给出放松这些假设的两阶段基线，并与 SOTA 方法对比评测。
Result: 数据集含 150 个合成场景与 60 个真实场景；在该基准上与 state-of-the-art 方法对比评测，结果显示强折射/反射重建任务远未解决（far from solved）。
Conclusion: 强折射与反射下的新视角合成仍是未解决问题，需要专门数据集与显式光路建模才能公平评估；RefRef 提供了这样的评测基准与 oracle 参照。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What is the Added Value of UDA in the VFM Era?
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) can improve a perception model's generalization to an unlabeled target domain starting from a labeled source domain. UDA using Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) with synthetic source data can achieve generalization performance comparable to fully-supervised learning with real target data. However, because VFMs have strong generalization from their pre-training, more straightforward, source-only fine-tuning can also perform well on the target. As data scenarios used in academic research are not necessarily representative for real-world applications, it is currently unclear (a) how UDA behaves with more representative and diverse data and (b) if source-only fine-tuning of VFMs can perform equally well in these scenarios. Our research aims to close these gaps and, similar to previous studies, we focus on semantic segmentation as a representative perception task. We assess UDA for synth-to-real and real-to-real use cases with different source and target data combinations. We also investigate the effect of using a small amount of labeled target data in UDA. We clarify that while these scenarios are more realistic, they are not necessarily more challenging. Our results show that, when using stronger synthetic source data, UDA's improvement over source-only fine-tuning of VFMs reduces from +8 mIoU to +2 mIoU, and when using more diverse real source data, UDA has no added value. However, UDA generalization is always higher in all synthetic data scenarios than source-only fine-tuning and, when including only 1/16 of Cityscapes labels, synthetic UDA obtains the same state-of-the-art segmentation quality of 85 mIoU as a fully-supervised model using all labels. Considering the mixed results, we discuss how UDA can best support robust autonomous driving at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 VFM 时代重新评估无监督域适应 (UDA) 对语义分割的实际增量：当合成源数据更强时，UDA 相对源域微调的提升从 +8 mIoU 缩到 +2 mIoU，源数据换成更多样的真实数据时 UDA 完全没有增量。但合成源上的 UDA 泛化始终更高，且只用 1/16 的 Cityscapes 标签即可达到与全监督 85 mIoU 相同的 SOTA 分割质量。
Motivation: VFM 预训练带来的强泛化让源域微调在目标域上也能表现不错，而学术常用数据场景未必代表真实部署，因此 UDA 相对简单源域微调的额外价值在多样、真实数据下并不清楚。
Method: 以语义分割为感知任务代表，在 synth-to-real 与 real-to-real 两类用例上组合不同源/目标数据评估 UDA，并考察加入少量有标签目标数据的影响，对比对象是 VFM 的源域微调与全监督上界。
Result: 更强合成源数据下 UDA 相对源域微调的提升由 +8 mIoU 降至 +2 mIoU；更多样的真实源数据下 UDA 无增量；所有合成数据场景中 UDA 泛化始终高于源域微调；仅用 1/16 Cityscapes 标签的合成 UDA 达到 85 mIoU，与使用全部标签的全监督模型持平。
Conclusion: UDA 的价值取决于源数据：源越强、越真实，其相对 VFM 源域微调的增量越小直至消失，但在合成源场景下仍稳定占优，且能以极少目标标签换取全监督级分割质量；作者据此讨论 UDA 如何支撑大规模鲁棒自动驾驶。
Relevance: 3
