papers.title: Learning Operators by Regularized Stochastic Gradient Descent with Operator-valued Kernels
papers.abstract_en: We consider a class of statistical inverse problems involving the estimation of a regression operator from a Polish space to a separable Hilbert space, where the target lies in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space induced by an operator-valued kernel. To address the associated ill-posedness, we analyze regularized stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithms in both online and finite-horizon settings. The former uses polynomially decaying step sizes and regularization parameters, while the latter adopts fixed values. Under suitable structural and distributional assumptions, we establish prediction and estimation error bounds with no explicit dependence on the dimension of the output space. The resulting convergence rates are near-optimal in expectation, and we also derive high-probability estimates that imply almost sure convergence. Our analysis introduces a general technique for obtaining high-probability guarantees in infinite-dimensional settings. We illustrate the scope of our framework through applications to structured prediction and a class of parametric elliptic PDEs. For the latter, we construct kernels for arcsine and uniform sampling, verify the assumptions of our high-probability results, and obtain bounds uniform over finite parameter truncations under suitable conditions on coefficient decay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对从 Polish 空间到可分 Hilbert 空间的回归算子估计这一统计反问题，提出在算子值核 (operator-valued kernel) 诱导的向量值 RKHP 中做正则化 SGD：在线设定用多项式衰减的步长与正则参数，有限时域设定用固定值。在结构与分布假设下得到不显式依赖输出空间维数的预测与估计误差界，期望意义下近最优，并给出蕴含几乎必然收敛的高概率估计。
Motivation: 从 Polish 空间到可分 Hilbert 空间的回归算子估计是病态的统计反问题，且输出空间维数往往进入误差界；需要在无限维设定下给出不依赖输出维数的收敛保证。
Method: 在算子值核诱导的向量值 RKHP 中分析正则化 SGD，分在线（多项式衰减步长与正则参数）与有限时域（固定值）两种设定；推导预测与估计误差界、期望近最优收敛率及高概率估计，并给出无限维设定下获取高概率保证的一般技术。
Result: 误差界不显式依赖输出空间维数，收敛率在期望意义下近最优，高概率估计蕴含几乎必然收敛；应用到结构化预测与一类参数椭圆 PDE，为 arcsine 与 uniform 采样构造核、验证高概率结果的假设，并在系数衰减条件下得到对有限参数截断一致的界。
Conclusion: 正则化 SGD 配合算子值核可在不付出输出维数代价的前提下处理该类统计反问题，其高概率分析技术可推广到无限维设定，并对参数椭圆 PDE 给出一致于参数截断的界。

papers.title: MedHal: a Synthetic Dataset for Medical Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination, the generation of non factual content by AI systems, poses serious risks in medical contexts, where errors can directly affect patient outcomes. We present MedHal, a large-scale dataset specifically designed to assess capabilities and train models on the task of hallucination detection in medical texts. Current hallucination detection methods face significant limitations when applied to specialized domains like medicine, where they can have disastrous consequences. MedHal addresses this issue by incorporating diverse medical text sources and tasks covering both intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations, and by providing a substantial volume of data samples suitable for training medical hallucination detection models. We demonstrate MedHal's utility by training and evaluating a baseline medical hallucination detection model, showing improvements over general-purpose hallucination detection approaches. This resource enables more efficient evaluation and training of medical text generation systems while reducing reliance on costly expert review, potentially accelerating the development of medical AI research.
papers.comment: The 5th Asia-Pacific Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics and the 15th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing, November 6-10, 2026, Hengqin, China
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedHal 是面向医学文本幻觉检测的大规模合成数据集，覆盖 intrinsic 与 extrinsic 两类幻觉并整合多种医学文本来源与任务，可直接用于训练检测模型。作者用它训练并评测了一个基线医学幻觉检测模型，结果显示相对通用幻觉检测方法有提升，同时减少对昂贵专家评审的依赖。
Motivation: 通用幻觉检测方法迁移到医学等专业领域时效果受限，而医学场景的错误会直接影响患者结局，且专家评审成本高。
Method: 构建大规模合成数据集 MedHal，纳入多样医学文本来源与任务，标注覆盖 intrinsic 和 extrinsic hallucination；随后在该数据集上训练并评测一个基线医学幻觉检测模型，与通用幻觉检测方法对比。
Result: 训练并评测的基线医学幻觉检测模型相对通用幻觉检测方法 (general-purpose hallucination detection approaches) 有提升；数据集提供足量样本用于训练检测模型，并降低对专家评审的依赖。
Conclusion: 医学幻觉检测需要领域专用的训练与评测数据，MedHal 可支撑更高效的医学文本生成系统评测与训练，加速医学 AI 研究。

papers.title: SkillFlow: Scalable and Efficient Agent Skill Retrieval System
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can extend their capabilities at inference time by loading reusable skills into context, yet equipping an agent with too many skills, particularly irrelevant ones, degrades performance. As community-driven skill repositories grow, agents need a way to selectively retrieve only the most relevant skills from a large library. We present SkillFlow, the first open, multi-stage retrieval system for agent skill discovery that frames skill acquisition as an information retrieval problem over a corpus of ~35K community-contributed SKILL.md definitions indexed from GitHub. The pipeline progressively narrows a large candidate set through four stages (dense retrieval, two rounds of cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based selection), balancing recall and precision at each stage. We evaluate SkillFlow on two coding benchmarks: SkillsBench, a benchmark of 87 tasks and 229 matched skills; and Terminal-Bench, a benchmark that provides only 89 tasks, and no matched skills. On SkillsBench, SkillFlow-retrieved skills raise Pass@1 from 9.2% to 16.4% (+78.3%, $p_{adj} = 3.64 \times 10^{-2}$), reaching 84.1% of the oracle ceiling, while on Terminal-Bench, agents readily use the retrieved skills (70.1% use rate) yet show no performance gain, revealing that retrieval alone is insufficient when the corpus lacks high-quality, executable skills for the target domain. SkillFlow demonstrates that framing skill acquisition as an information retrieval task is an effective strategy, and that the practical impact of skill-augmented agents hinges on corpus coverage and skill quality, particularly the density of runnable code and bundled artifacts. (GitHub: https://github.com/IBPA/skill-flow)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillFlow 把 AI agent 的技能获取重构为信息检索问题，用四阶段流水线（dense retrieval + 两轮 cross-encoder 重排 + LLM 选择）从约 35K 条 GitHub SKILL.md 中逐级收窄候选。在 SkillsBench 上检索到的技能把 Pass@1 从 9.2% 提到 16.4%（+78.3%，p_adj=3.64×10⁻²），达到 oracle 上限的 84.1%；但在 Terminal-Bench 上技能使用率达 70.1% 却无性能提升，说明语料缺少可执行技能时检索本身不够。
Motivation: 社区技能库不断膨胀，给 agent 塞入过多尤其是不相关的技能会反而拉低性能，需要从大库中只检索最相关的技能。
Method: 四阶段流水线逐级收窄候选：dense retrieval 初筛，两轮 cross-encoder reranking，最后 LLM-based selection，在每级平衡 recall 与 precision；索引 GitHub 上约 35K 条社区贡献的 SKILL.md 定义。
Result: SkillsBench（87 任务、229 条匹配技能）上 Pass@1 由 9.2% 升至 16.4%（+78.3%，p_adj=3.64×10⁻²），达 oracle 上限的 84.1%；Terminal-Bench（89 任务、无匹配技能）上技能使用率 70.1% 但性能无提升。
Conclusion: 把技能获取当作信息检索任务是有效策略，但技能增强 agent 的实际收益取决于语料覆盖度与技能质量，尤其是可运行代码和附带工件的密度。

papers.title: VFM-UDA++: Improving Network Architectures and Data Strategies for Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) enables strong generalization from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain, often with limited data. In parallel, Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) pretrained at scale without labels have also shown impressive downstream performance and generalization. This motivates us to explore how UDA can best leverage VFMs. Prior work (VFM-UDA) demonstrated that replacing a standard ImageNet-pretrained encoder with a VFM improves generalization. However, it also showed that commonly used feature distance losses harm performance when applied to VFMs. Additionally, VFM-UDA does not incorporate multi-scale inductive biases, which are known to improve semantic segmentation. Building on these insights, we propose VFM-UDA++, which (1) investigates the role of multi-scale features, (2) adapts feature distance loss to be compatible with ViT-based VFMs and (3) evaluates how UDA benefits from increased synthetic source and real target data. By addressing these questions, we can improve performance on the standard GTA5 $\rightarrow$ Cityscapes benchmark by +1.4 mIoU. While prior non-VFM UDA methods did not scale with more data, VFM-UDA++ shows consistent improvement and achieves a further +2.4 mIoU gain when scaling the data, demonstrating that VFM-based UDA continues to benefit from increased data availability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VFM-UDA++ 在无监督域适应语义分割中改造视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的用法：引入多尺度特征、把特征距离损失改成与 ViT 兼容的形式，并扩大合成源域与真实目标域数据量。在 GTA5 → Cityscapes 基准上这些改动合计 +1.4 mIoU，再扩数据还能额外 +2.4 mIoU，而此前非 VFM 的 UDA 方法扩数据并不涨。
Motivation: VFM-UDA 已证明用 VFM 替换 ImageNet 编码器能提升泛化，但常用特征距离损失套到 VFM 上反而有害，且缺少语义分割所需的多尺度归纳偏置；同时既有非 VFM UDA 方法随数据量增加并不改善。
Method: 在 VFM-UDA 基础上提出 VFM-UDA++：(1) 研究多尺度特征的作用，(2) 改造特征距离损失使其兼容基于 ViT 的 VFM，(3) 检验 UDA 如何受益于更多的合成源域数据与真实目标域数据；评测采用标准 GTA5 → Cityscapes 域适应基准。
Result: 在 GTA5 → Cityscapes 上性能提升 +1.4 mIoU；扩大数据规模后进一步获得 +2.4 mIoU 增益，且与先前非 VFM UDA 方法不同，性能随数据量持续改善。
Conclusion: 基于 VFM 的 UDA 能同时吃下架构改动（多尺度、ViT 兼容的特征距离损失）与数据规模红利，随数据增多仍继续受益。

papers.title: LadderMIL: Multiple Instance Learning with Coarse-to-Fine Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) for whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology often neglects instance-level learning as supervision is typically provided only at the bag level, hindering the integrated consideration of instance and bag-level information during the analysis. In this work, we present LadderMIL, a framework designed to improve MIL through two perspectives: (1) employing instance-level supervision and (2) learning inter-instance contextual information at bag level. Firstly, we propose a novel Coarse-to-Fine Self-Distillation (CFSD) paradigm that probes and distils a network trained with bag-level information to adaptively obtain instance-level labels which could effectively provide the instance-level supervision for the same network in a self-improving way. Secondly, to capture inter-instance contextual information in WSI, we propose a Contextual Encoding Generator (CEG), which encodes the contextual appearance of instances within a bag. We also theoretically and empirically prove the instance-level learnability of CFSD. Our LadderMIL is evaluated on multiple clinically relevant benchmarking tasks including breast cancer receptor status classification, multi-class subtype classification, tumour classification, and prognosis prediction. Average improvements of 8.1%, 11% and 2.4% in AUC, F1-score, and C-index, respectively, are demonstrated across the five benchmarks, compared to the best baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LadderMIL 用 Coarse-to-Fine Self-Distillation (CFSD) 从仅有的 bag 级标签自适应蒸馏出 instance 级标签来回灌监督，再用 Contextual Encoding Generator (CEG) 编码 bag 内实例的上下文外观。在五个临床基准上相对最优基线平均提升 AUC 8.1%、F1 11%、C-index 2.4%。
Motivation: 计算病理 WSI 的 MIL 只有 bag 级监督，instance 级信息被忽略，实例与 bag 的信息无法联合考虑。
Method: CFSD 先用 bag 级信息训练网络，再探测并蒸馏该网络自适应得到 instance 级标签，以自提升方式为同一网络提供 instance 级监督；CEG 编码 bag 内实例的上下文外观以捕捉 inter-instance 上下文；作者对 CFSD 的 instance 级可学习性给出理论与实证证明。
Result: 在五个临床相关基准（乳腺癌受体状态分类、多类亚型分类、肿瘤分类、预后预测）上，相对最优基线平均提升 AUC 8.1%、F1-score 11%、C-index 2.4%。
Conclusion: 把 instance 级监督与 bag 级上下文一起纳入 MIL，可在 WSI 分析的分类与预后任务上稳定超过现有基线。

papers.title: LEAD: An EEG Foundation Model for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive, highly accessible, and cost-effective approach for detecting Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, existing methods, whether based on handcrafted feature engineering or standard deep learning, face three major challenges: 1) the lack of large-scale EEG-based AD datasets for robust representation learning and evaluation; 2) limited cross-subject generalizability; and 3) difficulty in adapting to highly heterogeneous data. To address these challenges, we curate the world's largest EEG-AD corpus to date, comprising 2,238 subjects. Leveraging this unique resource, we propose LEAD, the first foundation model for EEG-based AD detection. Specifically, we design a gated temporal-spatial Transformer that can adapt to EEG recordings with diverse lengths, channel configurations, and sampling rates. In addition, we introduce a subject-regularized training strategy to enhance end-to-end subject-level detection. We further employ medical contrastive learning to pre-train on 13 datasets, including 4 AD datasets and 9 non-AD neurological disorder datasets, and fine-tune/test the model on the other 5 AD datasets. LEAD achieves the best average ranking across all 20 evaluations on 5 downstream datasets, substantially outperforming existing approaches, including state-of-the-art (SOTA) EEG foundation models. These results strongly demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method and significant progress for EEG-based AD detection. Source code: https://github.com/DL4mHealth/LEAD

TL;DR: LEAD 是首个用于阿尔茨海默病检测的 EEG 基础模型，以 2,238 名受试者的最大 EEG-AD 语料预训练，用门控时空 Transformer 适配不同长度、通道与采样率的记录，并以受试者正则化训练做端到端受试者级判别。在 5 个下游 AD 数据集共 20 项评测上取得最佳平均排名，明显超过现有 EEG 基础模型等 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: EEG 检测 AD 缺少大规模数据集，跨受试者泛化差，且难以适配高度异构的记录；手工特征与常规深度学习方法都受这三点制约。
Method: 构建 2,238 受试者的 EEG-AD 语料；设计门控时空 Transformer (gated temporal-spatial Transformer) 兼容可变长度、通道配置与采样率；引入受试者正则化训练策略做端到端受试者级检测；用医学对比学习在 13 个数据集（4 个 AD、9 个非 AD 神经障碍）上预训练，再在其余 5 个 AD 数据集上微调与测试。
Result: 在 5 个下游数据集的全部 20 项评测上取得最佳平均排名，明显优于包括 SOTA EEG 基础模型在内的现有方法；语料规模 2,238 名受试者，预训练覆盖 13 个数据集，测试覆盖 5 个 AD 数据集。

papers.title: Sonicmesh: Enhancing 3D Human Mesh Reconstruction in Vision-Impaired Environments With Acoustic Signals
papers.abstract_en: 3D human mesh reconstruction (HMR) from RGB images often degrades under poor illumination, occlusion, and non-line-of-sight conditions. Acoustic sensing provides complementary spatial cues but suffers from low spatial resolution. We propose SonicMesh, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first acoustic--visual framework for robust 3D human mesh reconstruction. SonicMesh first converts ultrasonic echoes into range--azimuth acoustic images through an Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR)-based imaging process. It then introduces a cross-dimensional anatomical registration module that maps modality-specific 2D joint features into a common canonical 3D human space. The registered anatomical representations are further integrated with acoustic and visual features through a two-stage fusion network for final mesh reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that SonicMesh achieves accurate and robust 3D human reconstruction across normal, poor-light, occluded, and non-line-of-sight environments, consistently outperforming existing RGB-, radio-frequency (RF)-, and mmWave-based approaches under challenging sensing conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SonicMesh 把超声回波经 ISAR 成像转成 range-azimuth 声学图像，用跨维度解剖配准把两种模态的 2D 关节特征映射到统一的规范 3D 人体空间，再经两阶段融合网络输出 mesh。在正常、弱光、遮挡与非视距 (NLOS) 四类环境下均稳定优于现有 RGB、RF 与 mmWave 方法。
Motivation: RGB 图像的 3D 人体 mesh 重建 (HMR) 在弱光、遮挡和非视距条件下明显退化，而声学传感能提供互补空间线索但空间分辨率低，需要把两者有效结合。
Method: 三段式流程：先用基于逆合成孔径雷达 (ISAR) 的成像过程把超声回波转为 range-azimuth 声学图像；再用跨维度解剖配准模块把各模态特有的 2D 关节特征映射到统一的规范 3D 人体空间；最后将配准后的解剖表征与声学、视觉特征经两阶段融合网络完成 mesh 重建。
Result: 在正常、弱光、遮挡与非视距四类环境中均实现准确稳健的 3D 人体重建，并在挑战性传感条件下持续优于现有基于 RGB、射频 (RF) 与 mmWave 的方法。
Conclusion: 声学与视觉的解剖级配准融合可跨光照、遮挡与视距条件保持 3D HMR 稳健性，是该框架在挑战性传感条件下的核心优势。

papers.title: Preference-based opponent shaping in differentiable games
papers.abstract_en: Strategy learning in game environments with multi-agent is a challenging problem. Since each agent's reward is determined by the joint strategy, a greedy learning strategy that aims to maximize its own reward may fall into a local optimum. Recent studies have proposed the opponent modeling and shaping methods for game environments. These methods enhance the efficiency of strategy learning by modeling the strategies and updating processes of other agents. However, these methods often rely on simple predictions of opponent strategy changes. Due to the lack of modeling behavioral preferences such as cooperation and competition, they are usually applicable only to predefined scenarios and lack generalization capabilities. In this paper, we propose a novel Preference-based Opponent Shaping (PBOS) method to enhance the strategy learning process by shaping agents' preferences towards cooperation. We introduce the preference parameter, which is incorporated into the agent's loss function, thus allowing the agent to directly consider the opponent's loss function when updating the strategy. We update the preference parameters concurrently with strategy learning to ensure that agents can adapt to any cooperative or competitive game environment. Through a series of experiments, we verify the performance of PBOS algorithm in a variety of differentiable games. The experimental results show that the PBOS algorithm can guide the agent to learn the appropriate preference parameters, so as to achieve better reward distribution in multiple game environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Preference-based Opponent Shaping (PBOS)：把偏好参数写进智能体损失函数，更新策略时同时考虑对手损失，并与策略学习并发更新偏好参数，使智能体在合作或竞争型可微博弈中都能学到合适的偏好，获得更优的奖励分配。
Motivation: 多智能体博弈中各智能体奖励由联合策略决定，贪心自利更新易陷入局部最优；现有对手建模与 shaping 方法只做简单预测、缺少合作/竞争行为偏好建模，只能用于预设场景、泛化差。
Method: PBOS 引入 preference parameter 并入智能体损失函数，使更新策略时直接纳入对手损失函数；偏好参数与策略学习并发更新，以适配任意合作或竞争的可微博弈 (differentiable games)。
Result: 在一系列不同可微博弈上的实验验证了 PBOS 性能，结果显示该算法能引导智能体学到合适的偏好参数，从而在多个博弈环境中取得更好的奖励分配。
Conclusion: 把合作/竞争偏好作为可学习参数与策略联合更新，是让对手 shaping 跨博弈场景泛化并改善奖励分配的有效途径。

papers.title: Adapting Visualization Techniques for Time-Series Anomaly Detection: From Convolutional Neural Networks to Convolutional-Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on complex tasks but are often regarded as "black boxes," which limits their adoption in domains where transparency is essential. This lack of interpretability raises ethical and legal concerns, particularly in sensitive applications such as security, where automated decisions can have serious consequences. The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) reinforces the need to justify decisions made by these systems. In this work, we investigate visualization techniques to improve the interpretability of anomaly detection models based on convolutional recurrent neural networks (CNN+RNN) with a TimeDistributed layer. Our architecture combines Visual Geometry Group 19 (VGG19) for feature extraction with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) for sequential analysis of real-time video data. While this design is well suited for temporal inputs, the TimeDistributed layer complicates gradient propagation and weakens the link between spatial and temporal information, reducing the effectiveness of standard visualization methods. To address this challenge, we adapt techniques such as saliency maps and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) to models that incorporate a temporal dimension. Although dedicated visualization methods for such architectures remain limited, our study highlights both the difficulties and the potential of applying tools originally designed for static images to recurrent convolutional networks handling video sequences. This approach extends classical interpretation strategies to temporal models and provides an intermediate solution until more specialized methods are developed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把面向静态图像的可视化解释方法改造到含 TimeDistributed 层的 CNN+RNN 视频异常检测模型上：VGG19 提特征、GRU 做时序分析，适配 saliency map 与 Grad-CAM 使其能作用于带时间维的网络。核心发现是 TimeDistributed 层阻碍梯度传播、削弱时空信息关联，从而降低标准可视化方法的有效性，改造后可作为专用方法出现前的过渡方案。
Motivation: CNN+RNN 视频异常检测是黑盒，GDPR 要求对自动化决策给出理由，而原本为静态图像设计的解释工具难以直接用于带时间维的循环卷积网络。
Method: 架构为 VGG19 特征提取 + GRU 时序分析 + TimeDistributed 层处理实时视频；针对该结构适配 saliency map 与 Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM)，把基于图像的可视化技术扩展到循环卷积网络。
Result: 定性发现：TimeDistributed 层使梯度传播复杂化、削弱空间与时间信息的联系，从而降低标准可视化方法的有效性；适配后的 saliency map 与 Grad-CAM 可用于该类时序模型，展示静态图像工具应用于处理视频序列的循环卷积网络的难点与潜力。
Conclusion: 把经典图像解释策略扩展到时序模型是可行的过渡方案，可支撑视频异常检测的可解释性，直到更专用的方法出现。

papers.title: Exploring the Benefits of Vision Foundation Models for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Achieving robust generalization across diverse data domains remains a significant challenge in computer vision. This challenge is important in safety-critical applications, where deep-neural-network-based systems must perform reliably under various environmental conditions not seen during training. Our study investigates whether the generalization capabilities of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) and Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) methods for the semantic segmentation task are complementary. Results show that combining VFMs with UDA has two main benefits: (a) it allows for better UDA performance while maintaining the out-of-distribution performance of VFMs, and (b) it makes certain time-consuming UDA components redundant, thus enabling significant inference speedups. Specifically, with equivalent model sizes, the resulting VFM-UDA method achieves an 8.4$\times$ speed increase over the prior non-VFM state of the art, while also improving performance by +1.2 mIoU in the UDA setting and by +6.1 mIoU in terms of out-of-distribution generalization. Moreover, when we use a VFM with 3.6$\times$ more parameters, the VFM-UDA approach maintains a 3.3$\times$ speed up, while improving the UDA performance by +3.1 mIoU and the out-of-distribution performance by +10.3 mIoU. These results underscore the significant benefits of combining VFMs with UDA, setting new standards and baselines for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in semantic segmentation.
papers.comment: CVPR 2024 Workshop Proceedings for the Second Workshop on Foundation Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在语义分割的无监督域适应 (UDA) 中，视觉基础模型 (VFM) 与 UDA 方法互补：VFM-UDA 在同等模型规模下比此前非 VFM 的 SOTA 快 8.4×，UDA mIoU +1.2、域外泛化 mIoU +6.1；改用参数多 3.6× 的 VFM 后仍快 3.3×，两项 mIoU 分别 +3.1 与 +10.3。
Motivation: 深度分割网络在训练时未见的环境条件下可靠性不足，而既有 UDA 流水线中部分耗时组件拖慢推理；需要同时保住 VFM 的域外泛化与 UDA 的跨域性能。
Method: 将 Vision Foundation Model 与 UDA 方法组合用于语义分割，使若干耗时的 UDA 组件变得冗余；在等模型规模与 3.6× 参数规模两种配置下与非 VFM 的 UDA SOTA 对比。
Result: 等模型规模下 VFM-UDA 相对先前非 VFM SOTA 加速 8.4×，UDA 设定 mIoU +1.2，域外泛化 mIoU +6.1；用参数多 3.6× 的 VFM 时保持 3.3× 加速，UDA mIoU +3.1，域外 mIoU +10.3。
Conclusion: VFM 与 UDA 结合可同时提升跨域与域外性能并大幅提速，为语义分割的无监督域适应确立了新基线。

papers.title: Efficient Constrained Graph Search for Post-hoc Error Correction in Binary Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a model-agnostic framework for constrained post-hoc error correction in binary classifiers. Given a frozen base classifier, the method searches for an interpretable conjunction of feature--threshold rules that corrects residual false-positive or false-negative errors while explicitly constraining newly introduced errors. The approach combines graph-based search over candidate rule paths, depth-dependent dynamic constraints, and a reduced-histogram procedure for efficient threshold evaluation. Unlike retraining or modifying the base classifier, the learned correction path operates on its predictions and can therefore be applied to arbitrary binary classifiers with suitable input features. Experiments on a large binary-classification problem demonstrate that the method can identify compact correction rules efficiently; for example, one configuration removes 90\% of false positives while sacrificing 5\% of true positives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型无关的后处理纠错框架：对冻结的二分类器，用图搜索在候选规则路径上找可解释的特征-阈值合取式，纠正残余假阳/假阴并显式约束新引入的错误。在大规模二分类任务上，某配置去掉 90% 假阳性，仅牺牲 5% 真阳性。
Motivation: 重训或改动基分类器代价高且不可解释，而残余假阳/假阴错误需要在不触碰原模型的前提下被定向纠正并控制副作用。
Method: 组合三部分：对候选规则路径的图搜索 (graph-based search)、深度相关的动态约束 (depth-dependent dynamic constraints)、以及用于高效阈值评估的降维直方图 (reduced-histogram) 过程；学习到的纠错路径作用于基分类器的预测输出，可套用于任意带合适输入特征的二分类器。
Result: 在大规模二分类问题上，方法能高效识别紧凑纠错规则；其中一个配置移除 90% 的假阳性，同时只牺牲 5% 的真阳性。
Conclusion: 对冻结分类器做受约束的图搜索式后处理，可以在不重训的前提下用紧凑规则显著削减假阳性并把真阳性损失控制在个位数百分比。

papers.title: Differentially-Private Decision Trees and Provable Robustness to Data Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Decision trees are interpretable models that are well-suited to non-linear learning problems. Much work has been done on extending decision tree learning algorithms with differential privacy, a system that guarantees the privacy of samples within the training data. However, current state-of-the-art algorithms for this purpose sacrifice much utility for a small privacy benefit. These solutions create random decision nodes that reduce decision tree accuracy or spend an excessive share of the privacy budget on labeling leaves. Moreover, many works do not support continuous features or leak information about them. We propose a new method called PrivaTree based on private histograms that chooses good splits while consuming a small privacy budget. The resulting trees provide a significantly better privacy-utility trade-off and accept mixed numerical and categorical data without leaking information about numerical features. Finally, while it is notoriously hard to give robustness guarantees against data poisoning attacks, we demonstrate bounds for the expected accuracy and success rates of backdoor attacks against differentially-private learners. By leveraging the better privacy-utility trade-off of PrivaTree we are able to train decision trees with significantly better robustness against backdoor attacks compared to regular decision trees and with meaningful theoretical guarantees.
papers.comment: A previous version of this paper contained an incorrect proof (the privacy level of the node operations was overstated). Fixed in this version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于私有直方图 (private histograms) 的差分隐私决策树 PrivaTree，在少量隐私预算下选好切分点，同时支持数值与类别混合特征且不泄露数值特征信息。相比现有 DP 决策树算法，其隐私-效用权衡显著更好，并给出后门攻击成功率与期望精度的理论界，训练出的树对后门攻击的鲁棒性显著优于普通决策树。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私决策树算法为换取很小的隐私收益牺牲大量效用：随机决策节点降低精度、或在叶节点标注上花掉过多隐私预算；许多方法还不支持连续特征或会泄露其信息，而数据投毒下的鲁棒性保证本身很难给出。
Method: PrivaTree 用私有直方图在小隐私预算下选择切分点，接受数值与类别混合数据且不泄露数值特征；同时针对差分隐私学习者推导后门攻击成功率与期望精度的界，并利用更好的隐私-效用权衡训练决策树。
Result: 论文报告 PrivaTree 的隐私-效用权衡显著优于现有算法，且在后门攻击下相比普通决策树具有显著更好的鲁棒性并带上有意义的理论保证；摘要给出的是攻击成功率与期望精度的界这一理论结果，无具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张把切分选择建立在私有直方图上，可以在不泄露数值特征的前提下同时拿到更好的隐私-效用权衡和对后门投毒的可证明鲁棒性。注意该版本修正了前一版中关于节点操作隐私水平被高估的错误证明。

papers.title: In-Context Binding Capacity in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How many assignments can a language model recall before it loses track of which value belongs to which entity? We measure this limit using continuous recall curves for 12 models at or below 3B parameters and a threshold sweep over 30 open models up to 12B. On the continuous curves, the load at which recall falls halfway to chance follows $K_{50}=cN^α$, with $α=0.820$ and $R^2=0.73$. The broader sweep shows an eightfold range associated with pretraining recipe, although the continuous curves show no detectable recipe effect after controlling for scale, with few modern models in the fit. We derive why interference can lower measured capacity by reducing single-binding recall even when the load-dependent recall profile is unchanged. Direct task training also exceeds the extrapolated zero-shot law, but different measurement criteria prevent interpreting that comparison as a capacity gain. Its formation times follow a power-law form in two independent codebases, conditional on runs that succeed. Together, these results characterize capacity at the model's query interface. Bounds on joint recall and a decomposition of policy errors connect this measurement to working memory and instruction following, without treating recall as a measure of alignment. The controlled task also provides a baseline for testing whether binding limits constrain world-state tracking; the present experiments do not measure state updates or downstream transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控的键值绑定任务上测语言模型的上下文绑定容量：连续 recall 曲线上半降至随机的负载 K50 满足幂律 K50=cN^α，α=0.820、R²=0.73（12 个 ≤3B 模型），30 个 ≤12B 开放模型的阈值扫描显示容量与预训练配方相关的跨度达八倍，但在控制规模后连续曲线上检不出配方效应。
Motivation: 语言模型在提示中同时记住多少组“值—实体”绑定才不失配，此前缺少可跨模型比较的连续测量口径；不同测量准则还会把干扰效应误读成容量变化。
Method: 对 12 个 ≤3B 参数模型绘制连续 recall 曲线并取半降点 K50，对 30 个 ≤12B 开放模型做阈值扫描；拟合 K50=cN^α 幂律，推导干扰如何在负载曲线形状不变时压低单绑定 recall，并把直接任务训练结果与零样本外推律对照（注明准则不同不可直接比）。
Result: α=0.820、R²=0.73；阈值扫描中容量跨度八倍且与预训练配方相关，但控制规模后连续曲线上配方效应不可检出（拟合中现代模型很少）；直接任务训练超出零样本外推律；绑定形成时间在两个独立代码库中呈幂律，且仅对成功的运行成立。
Conclusion: 容量刻画的是模型查询接口处的表现，可与工作记忆和指令遵循挂钩但不等同于对齐度；该受控任务只作为检验绑定限制是否约束世界状态追踪的基线，现有实验不测状态更新与下游迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stable initialization without the CLT
papers.abstract_en: Successful training of deep neural networks is highly dependent on the distribution of the initial weights. If the weights are too large, network training blows up; if they are too small, the model fails to learn features. Stable initialization is the optimal moderation between these two extremes. The conventional theory of random networks uses the Central Limit Theorem to control inter-neuron dependencies, which introduces distributional approximation error and coupling between layers. For networks with sine activations, we derive the uniform-phase initialization, which obviates distributional approximation and fully decouples the layers. Ours is the first work to use the sine function's periodic symmetry. Models trained with the uniform-phase initialization outperform the state of the art in neural representation tasks like image and audio fitting. We find that our untuned models are competitive with the best-tuned baselines from previous work and support $μ$P width scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对正弦激活网络的初始化，提出 uniform-phase initialization：绕开中心极限定理带来的分布近似误差与层间耦合，直接利用正弦函数的周期对称性，使各层完全解耦。训练出的模型在图像与音频拟合等神经表示任务上超过现有最先进方法，未调参版本即可与先前工作的最佳调参基线竞争，并支持 μP 宽度缩放。
Motivation: 随机网络初始化的常规理论依赖中心极限定理控制神经元间依赖，引入分布近似误差和层间耦合；权重过大训练发散、过小学不到特征，正弦激活网络缺少更干净的初始化方案。
Method: 对 sine 激活网络推导 uniform-phase initialization，利用正弦函数的周期对称性替代 CLT 分布近似，从而解耦各层；方法附带复现代码（ancillary material），并兼容 μP 宽度缩放。
Result: 在图像与音频拟合等神经表示任务上，uniform-phase 初始化训练的模型优于 state of the art；未调参（untuned）模型与先前工作的最佳调参基线相当，并支持 μP 宽度缩放。
Conclusion: 初始化不必依赖 CLT 式分布近似：利用激活函数的周期对称即可同时消除近似误差与层间耦合，并在神经表示任务上取得更强且免调参的结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adapting Personalized Speech Enhancement for Low-Latency Audio-Visual Target-Speaker Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Online audio-visual target-speaker extraction aims to remove competing voices while preserving speech quality and bounding lookahead. Existing extractors are built and evaluated for separation on synthetic mixtures, leaving listening quality and meeting behavior largely untested. We introduce Audio-Visual Personalized Voice Quality Enhancement (AV-PVQE), which approaches these requirements from the other direction. We start from a personalized speech enhancement model that reconstructs a requested voice at high quality but confuses the target in 46% of two-speaker mixtures despite clean enrollment. Adding mouth features at its speaker-conditioning input and jointly fine-tuning the visual and reconstruction networks reduces this rate to 1.6%, with no future frames and 20 ms of algorithmic delay. Compared with an online autoregressive audio-visual extractor, AV-PVQE yields separation gains on two synthetic benchmarks and larger gains on recorded meetings, and keeps its advantage on excerpts with more speakers than the fine-tuning mixtures. In personalized P.835 listening tests on two meeting corpora, it improves overall quality over this extractor by 0.57 and 0.63 MOS, with similar mean rating relative to the starting model. Preservation and rejection tests show that it keeps the target intact when no competing voice is present and suppresses competing speech when the target is absent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AV-PVQE 把个性化语音增强模型改造成低时延视听目标说话人提取：在其说话人条件输入处接入唇部特征并联合微调视觉与重建网络，在无未来帧、20 ms 算法时延下把两说话人混合中认错目标的比例从 46% 降到 1.6%。在两个合成基准与实录会议上均取得分离增益，P.835 听测相对在线自回归视听提取器提升 0.57 与 0.63 MOS。
Motivation: 在线视听目标说话人提取的现有方法都在合成混合上以分离指标构建和评测，真实会议中的听感质量与会议行为基本未被检验；而个性化增强模型虽能高质量重建指定声音，却在干净注册条件下仍会认错目标。
Method: 以个性化语音增强模型为起点，在其 speaker-conditioning 输入处加入嘴部（视觉）特征，联合微调视觉网络与重建网络；推理不使用未来帧，算法时延 20 ms，并做 preservation 与 rejection 测试（目标缺席/竞争声缺席两种情形）。
Result: 两说话人混合中目标混淆率 46% → 1.6%（无未来帧、20 ms 算法时延）；相对在线自回归视听提取器，在两个合成基准上有分离增益、在实录会议增益更大，且在说话人数多于微调混合的片段上保持优势；P.835 听测在两个会议语料上整体质量分别提升 0.57 与 0.63 MOS，与起始模型的平均评分相当；无竞争声时保持目标完整，目标缺席时抑制竞争语音。
Conclusion: 从个性化增强这一侧切入、用视觉条件修正目标混淆，可以在严格零前瞻与 20 ms 时延下同时拿到分离与听感质量，且在说话人数超出训练分布时仍保持优势。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FRESHLATENT: Channel-Aware Latent Adaptation for Resource-Constrained Embodied VLM Perception
papers.abstract_en: Mission-critical UAVs increasingly rely on split vision-language model (VLM) perception under tight onboard-resource and wireless-communication constraints. However, corruption of transmitted intermediate features creates a deployment mismatch for clean-trained split interfaces, while stronger channel-aware codecs can impose substantial onboard cost. We present FreshLatent, a lightweight channel-aware latent adapter that trains a power-normalized encoder-decoder through wireless corruption while keeping the surrounding VLM frozen. We formulate deployment around a mission-conditioned perception requirement and embedded interface cost, linking channel quality and communication budget to the operating conditions under which perception remains usable. At 0 dB and the tightest communication budget, FreshLatent improves gIoU and cIoU over clean split compression by 20.79 and 20.87 points, respectively. At the most adverse evaluated SNR (0 dB), across all three communication budgets, FreshLatent recovers 63.5-69.1% of the gIoU improvement achieved by a much heavier, range-trained feature-JSCC codec. On an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier in 10-W mode, FreshLatent uses 37-40x fewer encoder parameters, 7.7-9.9x lower edge-interface latency, and 8.8-10.0x lower edge-interface energy than the heavier codec. Together, these results show that lightweight channel-aware adaptation can recover a substantial fraction of the robustness of a much larger communication interface while broadening quality-valid operation under constrained wireless conditions.

TL;DR: FreshLatent 是面向 UAV 分裂式 VLM 感知的轻量信道感知 latent adapter：在保持外围 VLM 冻结的前提下，让功率归一化的编解码器直接在无线信道损坏下训练。在 0 dB 且最紧通信预算下，gIoU 与 cIoU 相对 clean split compression 分别提升 20.79 与 20.87 点；在最不利 SNR 0 dB、三种通信预算下恢复了更重 range-trained feature-JSCC codec 所获 gIoU 改善的 63.5–69.1%。
Motivation: 分裂式 VLM 的中间特征经无线传输会被信道损坏，clean 训练的接口出现部署失配；而更强的信道感知 codec 在机载侧代价过高，UAV 上的资源与通信预算都受限。
Method: 提出信道感知 latent adapter：训练一个功率归一化的 encoder-decoder 穿过无线信道损坏，外围 VLM 保持冻结；部署围绕 mission-conditioned 感知需求与 embedded interface cost 建模，把信道质量与通信预算关联到感知可用的工作条件。
Result: 在 0 dB 与最紧通信预算下，gIoU、cIoU 相对 clean split compression 分别提高 20.79 与 20.87 点；在最不利评估 SNR 0 dB、全部三种通信预算上，恢复了更重 range-trained feature-JSCC codec 所达 gIoU 改善的 63.5–69.1%。在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 10-W 模式下，encoder 参数少 37–40 倍，edge-interface 延迟低 7.7–9.9 倍，能耗低 8.8–10.0 倍。
Conclusion: 轻量的信道感知适配能在受限无线条件下恢复更大通信接口的相当一部分鲁棒性，并拓宽 quality-valid 工作区间，无需替换冻结的 VLM。

papers.title: OpenHail: An Event-Driven Gymnasium Environment for Electric Ride-Hailing Fleet Control
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning policies have attracted increasing interest for ride-hailing fleet control in recent years. Reinforcement learning, in particular, requires a structured simulation environment that specifies observations, actions, rewards, and decision epochs for training and evaluation. For electric fleets, this environment must also capture the interaction among stochastic demand, vehicle operations, and capacitated charging infrastructure. We present OpenHail, an open-source Gymnasium environment for joint control of electric ride-hailing fleets. Its fixed-size observation--action interface exposes request assignment, repositioning, and charging to a single policy. The event-driven simulator represents requests with pickup deadlines, vehicle job queues, battery dynamics, and finite-capacity charging facilities with first-in--first-out queues. A configurable decision-epoch mechanism separates internal simulator events from policy interactions, supporting event-driven, periodic, hybrid, and policy-requested control within the same operational model. The software provides seeded instances, feasible-action utilities, evaluation tools, operational metrics, and baseline policies. The source code is available at https://github.com/tommaso-schettini/openhail.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Source code available at https://github.com/tommaso-schettini/openhail
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenHail 是一个开源 Gymnasium 环境，用事件驱动仿真把电动网约车车队的请求分配、车辆重调度与充电决策统一到单一策略接口下。固定尺寸的观测-动作空间暴露三类动作，仿真含取件截止时间、车辆任务队列、电池动力学与 FIFO 排队的有限容量充电站，并支持事件驱动、周期、混合与策略主动请求四种决策时隙模式。
Motivation: 强化学习做车队控制需要明确观测、动作、奖励与决策时隙的仿真环境，而电动车队还必须同时刻画随机需求、车辆运营与容量受限的充电设施，现有环境缺少这种联合建模。
Method: 事件驱动的 Gymnasium 环境：固定尺寸观测-动作接口把请求分配、重定位 (repositioning) 与充电交给单一策略；仿真含带取件截止时间的请求、车辆任务队列、电池动力学、FIFO 排队的有限容量充电站；可配置的 decision-epoch 机制在同一运营模型内支持事件驱动、周期、混合与策略请求式控制；附带种子化实例、可行动作工具、评估工具、运营指标与基线策略。
Result: 提出并开源 OpenHail 环境本身，提供四类决策时隙模式、可行动作工具、运营指标与基线策略；arXiv comment 记录 10 页、3 图、5 表，源码发布于 github.com/tommaso-schettini/openhail。
Conclusion: 电动网约车车队的 RL 训练与评估可以在一个统一的事件驱动运营模型内完成，把分配、重定位与充电交由同一策略决策，并通过 decision-epoch 机制在事件驱动与周期控制之间切换。

papers.title: Audio LLMs Know When They Can't Hear You
papers.abstract_en: Audio large language models allow users to interact with the model through speech. When an input recording is too degraded, the model may misinterpret the user's query and respond based on an incorrect transcription. In this paper, we study model-conditional transcription reliability: whether an Audio LLM can recognize when its own transcription is unreliable. We first prompt the Audio LLM to assess whether its own transcription would be reliable, and find that the model is a poor judge of its own transcription reliability: in most cases, it predicts that its transcription will be reliable. We find that existing approaches, including speech quality predictors, audio LLM generation uncertainty, and transcript-conditioned WER estimation, provide limited signals for detecting transcription failures. In contrast, we discover that transcription reliability is strongly represented in the model's audio-encoder representations. Based on this observation, we devise a lightweight reliability predictor that operates on representations extracted by the frozen audio encoder and predicts the reliability class before generation. The reliability predictor can trigger a clarification request from the user when their voice query is predicted to be unreliable, while allowing reliable queries to proceed without modifying the underlying Audio LLM. Our predictor achieves 81.10% in-domain and 78.09% cross-domain macro-F1 scores, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.33 and 11.93 points, respectively. Finally, we show that reliability labels can transfer across Audio LLM families, and that transfer performance is closely related to the alignment of their model-specific reliability boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Audio LLM 无法自行判断自己的转写是否可靠：直接让模型自评时，多数情况下它都预测转写可靠。作者发现转写可靠性强烈体现在冻结 audio encoder 的表征中，据此在生成前用轻量可靠性预测器给出可靠性类别，触发澄清请求或放行。在域内 macro-F1 81.10%、跨域 78.09%，分别比最强基线高 10.33 和 11.93 个百分点。
Motivation: 输入录音严重退化时，Audio LLM 会基于错误转写作答，而模型自评、speech quality predictor、生成不确定性与 transcript-conditioned WER 估计都给不出有效信号，无法在生成前拦截失败转写。
Method: 在冻结 audio encoder 上取表征，训练一个轻量可靠性预测器，在生成之前输出可靠性类别；预测不可靠时向用户发起澄清请求，可靠则不改动底层 Audio LLM 直接作答。另检验可靠性标签跨 Audio LLM 家族的迁移。
Result: 可靠性预测器域内 macro-F1 81.10%，跨域 78.09%，分别超出最强基线 10.33 与 11.93 个百分点；自评实验中模型多数时候预测自身转写可靠；可靠性标签可跨 Audio LLM 家族迁移，迁移效果与各模型可靠性边界的对齐程度密切相关。
Conclusion: 转写可靠性不是模型能自省的属性，但可从冻结 audio encoder 表征中预测出来，从而在生成前决定是否澄清；跨家族迁移是否成立取决于可靠性边界是否对齐。

papers.title: Subjects, Not Authors: The Authorship Hazard in Agentic Dataspaces
papers.abstract_en: Dataspace connectors decide whether a transfer may occur, not what the transferred value contains, tolerable for contracted applications, not for LLM agents that compose tool calls and spawn sub-agents. Research on agents that generate governance artifacts evaluates output quality; who may authorize an artifact for use falls between that literature and the governance literature, and neither owns it. A published policy is what a dataspace's decision point enforces, so publication is a governance event, and an agent that is both policy subject and policy author writes the norms that bind it. We name this the authorship hazard and state one principle: an agent is a subject of the governance plane, never an author of it. Its authorization channel to publication is closed by construction; its influence channel, drafting what humans approve, is treated as an enforcement problem. On a frozen corpus of agent drafts, publishing without approval reverses 80 authorization decisions, most through drafts that change only a field's sensitivity classification and no policy text; a classifier that reads the policy diff misses every such draft, necessarily. Treating classification as authorship routes them all to review; the registry-held classification this requires is designed and modelled here, not yet implemented in the prototype. At the execution boundary, protected fields reach the model in 105 of 105 cases under prompt-stated duties and in 0 of 105 when the ODRL duty is compiled into an invocation-time tool-call constraint, but where the value is not confined to a named field the compiled condition exposes it in 7 of 7. A centrally provisioned approval pool does not scale to the participant volume that motivates the problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 dataspace 治理中的 authorship hazard：当 LLM agent 既是策略约束对象又是策略作者时，它会写出约束自己的规范。作者给出原则——agent 只能是治理平面的 subject，永不作 author，其发布授权通道按构造关闭；在冻结的 agent 草稿语料上，未经批准发布会反转 80 项授权决策，而只读 policy diff 的分类器必然全部漏掉这类仅改字段敏感级、不动策略正文的草稿。
Motivation: dataspace connector 只判断传输是否发生，不判断传输值内容；现有 agent 生成治理工件的研究评输出质量，治理文献管谁有权授权，authorship 这一环落在两者之间无人认领。
Method: 把发布定义为治理事件，规定 agent 的授权通道按构造关闭、其影响通道（起草供人批准）按执行问题处理；在冻结的 agent 草稿语料上做反事实授权分析，并设计 registry-held classification 的模型（尚未在原型中实现）；在执行边界对比 prompt-stated duties 与把 ODRL duty 编译成调用时 tool-call 约束两种机制。
Result: 未经批准发布反转 80 项授权决策，多数草稿只改字段敏感级、不改策略文本，读 policy diff 的分类器全部漏检；把分类当 authorship 则全部转入 review。执行边界上，prompt-stated duties 下受保护字段 105/105 到达模型，ODRL duty 编译为调用时约束后为 0/105；值不局限于具名字段时，编译条件仍 7/7 暴露。集中式审批池无法扩展到问题所针对的参与者规模。
Conclusion: agent 不得成为治理平面的作者，其对规范的影响必须当作执行/审查问题处理；把字段分类权收归 registry 并纳入 review 才能堵住仅改敏感级的草稿，且编译式调用约束只在值被限定于具名字段时有效。

papers.title: MedTokenBudget: Lesion-Preserving Token Routing for Dermoscopic Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Dermoscopy classifiers built on Vision Transformers process all image patches uniformly, although diagnostic evidence is concentrated in the lesion region. Existing token pruning methods reduce tokens using generic saliency or similarity signals, but rarely ask whether the retained subset still contains the lesion. This paper introduces MedTokenBudget, a supervised post-backbone token routing framework that learns to construct compact lesion-enriched representations when auxiliary lesion masks are available. Its Lesion-Aware Token Scoring (LATS) module fuses attention entropy, feature norm, and local feature contrast through a learned scorer, then routes the top-$K$ patches under a target budget. LATS is trained with budget curriculum learning, diversity regularization, attention distillation, and lesion-mask supervision. The trained router is evaluated with a lesion retention rate that directly measures how much ground-truth lesion evidence survives the token budget. On ISIC 2019, mask-supervised LATS consistently outperforms Random and ToMe at headline budgets while retaining substantially more lesion patches. Code is provided for reproducibility, and complete tabulated results are included in the supplementary material.

papers.title: MVAgent: Multi-Agent Video Generation via Consistent Condition Construction and Shot-Level Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-shot agentic video generation requires consistent character appearance, stable spatial layout across camera angles, and continuous character state between shots. When every shot is a separate request to a frozen generator, repeated text does not determine appearance, layout or state. We therefore recast the problem as condition construction and present MVAgent, a multi-agent pipeline whose agents collaborate through typed conditioning inputs. Because an environment image shows one viewpoint, a Spatial Grounding agent samples views from generated camera-traversal clips and anchors each shot to the view matching its framing. As generated shots drift from the plan, an Observer records how each shot ends in a continuity memory, from which a Transition agent builds character action and spatial references for the next shot. An Orchestrator composes these inputs into each request. Since a request reveals its effect only after rendering, we train it by agentic reinforcement learning with Trunk-GDPO, which compares rendered candidates at every shot rather than once per video and continues the best as the trunk. With generator and judges frozen, MVAgent attains the highest cross-shot consistency and narrative-planning quality among the compared methods on ViMax-Bench and is preferred over the strongest agentic baseline in human evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVAgent 把多镜头视频生成重写为条件构造问题：空间锚定 agent 从相机遍历片段中采样视角并把每个镜头绑定到匹配取景的视图，过渡 agent 从连续性记忆构建角色动作与空间引用，Orchestrator 合成请求，再用逐镜头比较候选的 Trunk-GDPO 做 agentic 强化学习。在生成器与评判冻结的条件下，它在 ViMax-Bench 上取得所比方法中最高的跨镜头一致性与叙事规划质量，并在人评中优于最强的 agentic 基线。
Motivation: 把每个镜头当作对冻结生成器的独立请求时，重复文本无法决定角色外观、空间布局与状态连续性，多镜头视频生成因此难以保持跨镜头一致。
Method: 多 agent 流水线以类型化条件输入协作：Spatial Grounding agent 从生成的 camera-traversal clips 采样视角并锚定镜头，Observer 记录每个镜头结束状态到 continuity memory，Transition agent 据此构建下一镜头的角色动作与空间引用，Orchestrator 合成请求；训练用 agentic 强化学习 Trunk-GDPO，在每个镜头而非整段视频上比较渲染候选并延续最优者为 trunk。
Result: 在生成器与评判均冻结的设置下，MVAgent 在 ViMax-Bench 上于所比方法中取得最高的跨镜头一致性与叙事规划质量，并在人评中优于最强的 agentic 基线。
Conclusion: 多镜头一致性应通过显式条件构造与逐镜头的强化学习优化来获得，而不是靠对冻结生成器重复文本提示。

papers.title: Probabilistic Robustness-driven Universal Adversarial Perturbations with Explainability against Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Intrusion Detection System
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) enables adaptive intrusion detection in dynamic network environments but also exposes intrusion detection systems (IDS) to adversarial threats such as universal adversarial perturbations (UAPs), which apply a single input-agnostic perturbation to degrade detection performance across traffic. Probabilistic Robustness (PR), as a post-hoc evaluation metric, provides a principled, population-level measure of adversarial impact that conceptually aligns with the universality objective of UAPs, i.e., PR quantifies the prevalence of misclassification in the input space, making it a natural signal for guiding UAP generation. Hence, we propose PR-based UAP, which represents the first integration of an explicit PR-driven objective into generating UAPs against DRL-based IDS. Building on this formulation, we introduce PX-UAP, which leverages explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) to guide perturbation shaping under realistic domain constraints, and provides a rigorous theoretical analysis of its design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PX-UAP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art UAP methods in attack effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于深度强化学习的入侵检测系统 (DRL-based IDS)，提出以 Probabilistic Robustness (PR) 为显式目标生成通用对抗扰动 (UAP) 的 PR-based UAP，并在其上引入用可解释 AI (XAI) 引导扰动塑形、受现实域约束的 PX-UAP。实验中 PX-UAP 在攻击有效性上持续优于现有 SOTA UAP 方法。
Motivation: DRL 让 IDS 能在动态网络环境中自适应检测，但也使其暴露在输入无关的 UAP 之下；现有 UAP 生成缺少与 UAP 普适性目标在概念上对齐的群体级度量来指导。
Method: 把事后评估指标 PR 作为 UAP 生成的显式优化目标（PR-based UAP），量化输入空间中误分类的普遍程度；再提出 PX-UAP，用 XAI 引导扰动塑形并施加现实域约束，同时给出该设计的理论分析。
Result: 大量实验显示 PX-UAP 在攻击有效性上持续优于 state-of-the-art UAP 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以 PR 这一群体级鲁棒性度量驱动 UAP 生成，与 UAP 的普适性目标天然对齐，再叠加 XAI 引导的扰动塑形，可在 DRL-based IDS 上取得更强的攻击效果。

papers.title: The Hard Part Comes After Search: Benchmarking Web Agents on Synthesizing, Organizing, and Displaying Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks do not fully evaluate agents acting as assistants. A useful assistant retrieves information across complex, multi-step workflows, synthesizes it into artifacts (documents, presentations, spreadsheets), and navigates program interfaces to produce a coherent final product. Such workflows demand reasoning and synthesis, decomposition of complex tasks, as well as visual and spatial understanding. To study agents on workflows like these, we introduce KNOWS, a benchmark of open-ended, complex, browser-based tasks that jointly evaluate these capabilities, with each task culminating in a produced artifact. To write tasks, we develop a task design rubric and a protocol for ensuring that tasks meet the requirements. Each task is paired with an evaluator, a program that combines deterministic checks with LLM judgments to balance the richness, reliability, and automation tradeoff inherent to agent evaluation. We evaluate and analyze frontier computer-use agents and browser-based harnesses. They achieve moderate scores on partial-success metrics, but the best performer fully succeeds in fewer than 3% of our complex, long-horizon tasks. Failures on visual steps render the resulting artifacts unusable, even when agents complete more than 50% of other evaluation steps. Our results expose limitations of current agents acting as end-to-end assistants, and call for progress on tool use, visual understanding, and long-horizon reasoning.
papers.comment: 9 pages main text. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://alexgill321.github.io/KNOWS-benchmark/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KNOWS 是一个开放式、长时程的浏览器任务基准，每项任务最终要求产出文档、演示或表格等 artifact，用确定性检查与 LLM 判分结合的评测器联合考核检索、综合与界面操作能力。前沿 computer-use agent 在部分成功指标上得分中等，但最佳者在复杂长时程任务上完全成功不足 3%；视觉步骤失败会让产物不可用，即使其他评估步骤完成超过 50%。
Motivation: 现有 computer-use agent 基准没有充分评估 agent 作为助手的完整工作流：跨多步检索信息、综合成 artifact、并在程序界面中导航产出连贯成品，这类任务同时要求推理、任务分解与视觉空间理解。
Method: 提出 KNOWS 基准，配套任务设计 rubric 与保证任务满足要求的协议；每个任务配一个 evaluator 程序，把确定性检查与 LLM 判分结合，以平衡 agent 评测的丰富性、可靠性与自动化；在此之上评测并分析前沿 computer-use agent 与浏览器 harness。
Result: 前沿 agent 在部分成功指标上取得中等分数，但最佳者在复杂长时程任务上完全成功不足 3%；当 agent 完成超过 50% 的其他评估步骤时，视觉步骤的失败仍使产出的 artifact 不可用。
Conclusion: 当前 agent 作为端到端助手仍有明显短板，瓶颈集中在 tool use、视觉理解与长时程推理三处。

papers.title: Action Forcing: Training World Models on Unsupervised Video by Recovering Underlying Egomotion Bases
papers.abstract_en: Synchronised action annotations are needed to train controllable world models and these datasets remain elusive. Existing approaches make use of instrumented platforms with calibrated sensors, costly manual annotation, or latent-action models which lack grounding. We instead turn ordinary unlabelled video into action-supervised training data by recovering (without training) a data-derived egomotion basis. We track pixel displacements across frames and exploit the recurring coherent structure induced by egomotion to obtain grounded control signals directly. Using a method as simple as principal components analysis perform this, we find that the leading components provide signed, scalable, and composable throttle--yaw controls, although the method can recover only motion axes represented in the data. To prevent a high-capacity video DiT from exploiting pixel-level supervision, an online latent critic distils a frozen decoder--tracker--PCA (Principal Components Analysis) teacher without backpropagating through the decoder or tracker. Finally we critique the use of video generation metrics to evaluate WMs and introduce an example of an alternative, reference-free evaluation method. We measure \textit{controllability}, \textit{plausibility}, \textit{conjuring} (creating objects out of thin air) and \textit{geometric integrity}, revealing failures that conventional video metrics miss. We show that most baselines follow familiar action directions but struggle to reverse or remain stationary. Our model handles both while retaining compositional control and generation quality. Despite backwards actions being less than $1\%$ of our training data, we find that the model learns to reverse, scale its response linearly, and compose throttle with steering, all simply by learning through a grounded action space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用无标注视频训练可控世界模型：先不训练地跟踪像素位移并做 PCA，得到有符号、可缩放、可组合的 throttle–yaw 自我运动 (egomotion) 控制基，再用在线 latent critic 蒸馏冻结的 decoder–tracker–PCA 教师，避免视频 DiT 直接钻像素监督的空子。新提出的无参考评测显示多数基线只会沿熟悉动作方向走、难以倒退或静止，而该模型两者都能做，且在倒退动作不足训练数据 1% 的情况下仍学会倒退、线性缩放响应并组合 throttle 与 steering。
Motivation: 可控世界模型需要带同步动作标注的视频，而这类数据集稀缺：现有做法依赖带标定传感器的仪器化平台、昂贵人工标注，或缺乏 grounding 的 latent-action 模型。
Method: 跨帧跟踪像素位移，利用自我运动诱导的重复相干结构，用 PCA 直接提取有监督意义的控制信号（无需训练）；为防止高容量视频 DiT 利用像素级监督取巧，用在线 latent critic 蒸馏冻结的 decoder–tracker–PCA 教师，不反传穿过 decoder 与 tracker。评测上批评用视频生成指标评估世界模型的做法，改用无参考评测，度量 controllability、plausibility、conjuring（凭空造物）与 geometric integrity。
Result: PCA 主成分给出有符号、可缩放、可组合的 throttle–yaw 控制，但只能恢复数据中出现过的运动轴。无参考评测下多数基线能跟随熟悉动作方向却难以倒退或保持静止，本模型两者均可并保持组合控制与生成质量；倒退动作占训练数据不足 1%，模型仍学会倒退、响应线性缩放并与 steering 组合。
Conclusion: 只要动作空间是 grounded 的，普通无标注视频加一个免训练的 PCA 自我运动基就足以训出能倒退、缩放、组合动作的可控世界模型；作者主张用无参考的可控性/合理性/凭空造物/几何完整性评测替代传统视频生成指标。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: QSV: Quat-Sphere-Vision for Coupled Quaternion Attention on Spherical Lattices
papers.abstract_en: In standard attention, three separately learned projections decide how strongly a token attends to each neighbor ($W_Q$, $W_K$) and how the attended features are transformed before aggregation ($W_V$). We study Quat-Sphere-Vision (QSV), a sparse spherical vision model that replaces this projection triple with a single learned unit quaternion per token: the relative quaternion $r_{ij} = q_i^{*} \otimes q_j$ supplies both the attention logit $\operatorname{Re}(r_{ij})$ and a sandwich-product feature transport $x \mapsto r_{ij} \otimes x \otimes r_{ij}^{*}$, with messages passed over sparse kNN graphs on concentric Fibonacci spheres. Ablations that change only the targeted component show the two roles to be asymmetric. Removing the transport reduces test accuracy by about four percentage points on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (single runs per CIFAR-100 variant), while replacing the learned attention weights with uniform averaging leaves it essentially unchanged. Parameter-matched controls then remove the geometry itself: standard attention on the same graph exceeds QSV (mean $87.3\%$ vs. $85.9\%$), and the same model on a flat 2D lattice reaches $91.1\%$, within $2.1$ points of a ResNet-20 trained under the same pipeline (single run). In the coupled kernel, nearly all of the learned pairwise computation resides in the transport channel.

TL;DR: QSV 用每 token 一个单位四元数 q_i 替换注意力的 W_Q/W_K/W_V 三投影，相对四元数 r_ij 同时给出注意力 logit 与 sandwich 乘积特征传输，在同心 Fibonacci 球面的稀疏 kNN 图上传递消息。消融显示两个角色不对称：去掉传输使 CIFAR-10/100 测试精度降约 4 个百分点，而换成均匀平均几乎不变；参数对齐的标准注意力 (87.3%) 反超 QSV (85.9%)，同一模型放到平坦 2D 格点达 91.1%。

papers.title: Weather and Climate Without Fluid Mechanics
papers.abstract_en: Even if it were possible, attempting to model the motion of a fluid in a pipe by tracking each individual molecule would be an extraordinary waste of computation. The emergent laws of fluid mechanics accomplish the same goal on a laptop instead of a datacenter. But a sufficiently complex fluid such as in Earth's atmosphere again requires a datacenter, this time to resolve the many contortions in the fields making up our weather. Might there be some analogous set of emergent laws that would represent the effect of these perturbations without needing their explicit representation on a numerical grid? We argue that the existence of a symmetry principle implies such laws are likely to exist. The atmosphere is scale invariant, implying that the observed structure at one scale is nothing but a stretched version of that at any other scale, at least within the invariant regime. Though some emergent laws built on scale invariance exist, they are built on a challenging ontological foundation, making them hard to develop further. We propose a path forward, first by introducing a new fundamental building block of the atmosphere that we term a ``turbulon'', inspired by a lesser-known generalization of turbulence theory that accounts for buoyancy. We then construct the Superposition of Turbulons and Eddies Atmospheric Model (STEAM), and show that simulated atmospheric volumes are broadly plausible when compared to state-of-the-art hydrodynamic simulation output. Some aspects of STEAM clearly need improvement, though other statistics reproduce observations better than hydrodynamic models, and visualizations of simulated clouds are strikingly realistic. We estimate STEAM's computational cost to be up to a million times less than hydrodynamic models, suggesting that the Navier-Stokes equations may not, in fact, be required for simulation and prediction of Earth's weather and climate.
papers.comment: PhD dissertation, University of Utah, 2026. Advisor: Timothy J. Garrett. 174 pages. Chapters 2 to 4 reprint or adapt published and submitted papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张用尺度不变性导出的涌现规律替代 Navier-Stokes 求解来做天气与气候模拟：提出新的大气基本构件“turbulon”，并据此构建 STEAM（Superposition of Turbulons and Eddies Atmospheric Model）。与最先进流体动力学模拟输出相比，STEAM 模拟的大气体积总体合理，部分统计量比流体动力学模型更贴近观测，计算成本估计最多低一百万倍。
Motivation: 在大气网格上显式解析多尺度扰动需要数据中心级算力；若尺度不变性意味着存在无需显式网格表示的涌现规律，就可能用远低于 Navier-Stokes 求解的代价做天气与气候模拟。
Method: 从尺度不变性这一对称原理出发，引入受浮力修正的湍流理论启发的新构件“turbulon”，再把 turbulon 与 eddy 叠加成 STEAM 大气模型；将模拟结果与最先进流体动力学模拟输出及观测统计量对照。
Result: STEAM 模拟的大气体积与最先进流体动力学模拟输出相比总体合理；部分统计量比流体动力学模型更好地再现观测，云的可视化效果逼真；计算成本估计比流体动力学模型最多低一百万倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Navier-Stokes 方程可能并非模拟和预报地球天气与气候的必需前提，但也承认 STEAM 的某些方面明显需要改进。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: Encryptability As a Coordinate Choice: Depth-One Homomorphic Federated Learning of Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Encrypted training relies on keeping server-side updates low-degree. This constraint traditionally excludes models whose weights inhabit a compact Lie group (notably variational quantum circuits, where every trainable weight is an $\mathrm{SU(2)}$ rotation). Expressed in Euler angles or discrete alphabets, these updates appear transcendental, historically demanding prohibitive costs: one client--server round per gate, or upwards of $25{,}000$ operations per weight. This penalty is strictly an artefact of coordinates. In the unit-quaternion (spin) chart, group composition is exactly bilinear (degree two, with coefficients in $\{-1,0,+1\}$). Consequently, encrypted rotation updates cost one multiplicative level and federated averaging costs zero in any levelled homomorphic scheme, completely eliminating bootstrapping. This implementation-independent algebraic property is confirmed across two cryptographic backends, introducing only $0.0$ and $-2.0\times10^{-12}$ rad of aggregation error. Leveraging this reduction yields a non-interactive protocol for encrypted federated training of hybrid quantum--classical networks. It includes correctness proofs for aggregation and sign handling, plus a compilation lemma proving parameterised entanglers add only constant-factor overhead without altering the depth class. Empirically, a paired five-seed study confirms zero measurable utility tax ($Δ=+9\times10^{-6}$ MSE, $p=0.92$), and a noise-budget ablation falsifies the hypothesis that encryption noise regularises. These convergence trends replicate across datasets and scale to $20$ clients. Finally, hardware validation on a $156$-qubit processor achieves $0.9918$ fidelity against a $0.99957$ unencrypted control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把变分量子电路的 SU(2) 旋转权重改写到单位四元数 (unit-quaternion) 坐标下，群复合变成严格双二次（degree two，系数取 {-1,0,+1}），于是同态加密下旋转更新只需 1 个乘法层、联邦平均 0 层，完全免去 bootstrapping。相比 Euler 角/离散字母方案每轮每门一次通信或每权重 25,000+ 次运算，该代价是坐标系的人为产物。
Motivation: 加密训练要求服务端更新保持低次数 (low-degree)，而权重位于紧致 Lie 群的模型（如每个可训练权重都是 SU(2) 旋转的变分量子电路）在 Euler 角下更新呈超越函数，历史上代价高到不可行。
Method: 在单位四元数坐标下使群复合精确双线性，构造加密联邦训练混合量子-经典网络的非交互协议；给出聚合与符号处理的正确性证明，以及参数化纠缠门仅带来常数倍开销、不改变深度类的 compilation lemma；在两个密码学后端实现，并做噪声预算消融与五种子配对研究。
Result: 聚合误差仅 0.0 与 -2.0×10^-12 rad（跨两个后端）；五种子配对研究 Δ=+9×10^-6 MSE、p=0.92，无可测效用税；噪声预算消融否证了
Conclusion: 加密开销是坐标选择问题而非群结构问题：四元数图把旋转的同态代价降到 1 个乘法层，且在 20 客户端与 156 量子比特硬件上保持可用精度（fidelity 0.9918 对未加密对照 0.99957）。

papers.title: Energy-efficient operation of neural operators for virtual sensing
papers.abstract_en: Virtual sensing repeatedly reconstructs physical fields from changing observations, often on a fixed geometry. We investigate how shared spatial computation reduces the energy of these updates while retaining the selected checkpoint and its evaluated predictions. In a heat-exchanger service, standard compiler freezing and explicit trunk reuse give similar operating energy reductions relative to graph replay: approximately 1% at one request per second and 20% at forty requests per second. In 15 W mode with fixed clocks, reuse with graph replay completes the same request sequence with 22.0 to 22.5% less energy than eager execution, including preparation and waiting. DeepONet and Fourier neural operator (FNO) controls distinguish the effects of reusable arithmetic and launch overhead. Preparation, artifact construction, and worker replacement add costs outside repeated inference. These results connect operator structure to operating energy and show how update frequency and execution lifetime govern the benefit of computation reuse in physical-field virtual sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对固定几何上反复重建物理场的虚拟传感 (virtual sensing)，证明共享空间计算（compiler freezing 与显式 trunk reuse）相对 graph replay 能降低神经算子更新的运行能耗：每秒 1 次请求约省 1%，每秒 40 次请求约省 20%；在 15 W 定频模式下 reuse+graph replay 比 eager 执行完成同一请求序列少用 22.0–22.5% 能耗（含准备与等待）。
Motivation: 虚拟传感要在变化观测上反复重跑神经算子，重复推理的能耗随请求频率累积，而现有执行方式（graph replay、eager）在固定几何与固定检查点场景下重复做相同的空间计算，能耗被放大。
Method: 在换热器 (heat-exchanger) 服务场景上对比标准 compiler freezing 与显式 trunk reuse 相对 graph replay 的能耗；用 DeepONet 与 Fourier neural operator (FNO) 作为对照，分离可复用算术与 kernel launch 开销的贡献；能耗计量覆盖准备、artifact 构建与 worker 更换等推理外开销。
Result: 相对 graph replay，compiler freezing 与 trunk reuse 的运行能耗降幅相近：1 请求/秒约 1%，40 请求/秒约 20%；15 W 定频下 reuse+graph replay 比 eager 少用 22.0–22.5% 能耗完成同一请求序列（含准备与等待）。
Conclusion: 计算复用的收益由请求更新频率与执行存活期共同决定：频率越高、复用窗口越长，共享空间计算的节能越显著，且该收益需扣除准备、artifact 构建与 worker 更换的额外成本。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning of Communication in a Mesh of Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models gain accuracy from more compute at test time, but majority voting over independent samples saturates: as samples grow, the vote converges to the model's most frequent answer. Communication can add what sampling cannot: an agent that solves a problem can pass the key step to the others. We present TalkMesh, a decentralized mesh of small language model agents that learns when and what to communicate. Each agent samples a proposal and scores it with a trained confidence head. The most confident agent broadcasts a hint; agents below a confidence threshold revise, keeping each revision that outscores its proposal. Gossip consensus approximates the vote weighted by confidence without a coordinator. A talk policy, trained with group relative policy optimization on the change in correctness after revision, writes hints and revisions. With three agents, which together generate at most six outputs, the mesh reaches the accuracy of majority voting over 32 samples with each of three models. Trained with at most 8 agents and evaluated with 32, it raises accuracy from 0.568 under self-consistency to 0.705 (Qwen3.5-0.8B, GSM8K) and from 0.492 to 0.722 (SmolLM3-3B, MATH-500). When 4 of 8 agents collude on a wrong answer with fabricated confidence and poisoned hints, majority vote accuracy falls to 0.000 (Qwen3.5-0.8B, GSM8K). A defended mesh, whose agents rescore solutions with their own confidence heads, retains 0.507. Across reasoning, embodied coordination, and traffic signal control, messages improve a decision when the acting agent cannot observe the information it requires and another agent can send it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TalkMesh 让小型语言模型智能体在去中心化 mesh 中用 RL 学会何时、传什么消息：每个智能体采样提案并用置信头打分，最自信者广播 hint，低于阈值者修订，gossip consensus 近似置信度加权投票。在 GSM8K 上把 self-consistency 的 0.568 提到 0.705（Qwen3.5-0.8B），MATH-500 上从 0.492 提到 0.722（SmolLM3-3B）；面对 4/8 智能体合谋投错并伪造置信，多数投票跌到 0.000，带自置信重打分的防御版仍保 0.507。
Motivation: 测试时采样多数投票会随样本数增加收敛到模型最高频答案而饱和，无法补上单个样本缺的关键步骤；需要一种无需中心协调者、能决定何时通信传什么的机制。
Method: TalkMesh：每个智能体采样提案并用训练的 confidence head 打分，最自信者广播 hint，低于置信阈值的智能体修订并保留得分更高的版本；gossip consensus 近似置信度加权投票。talk policy 用 GRPO 训练，奖励信号是修订后正确性的变化；最多 8 个智能体训练、32 个评估。
Result: 3 个智能体、合计最多 6 个输出即可达到 32 样本多数投票的准确率；训练最多 8 智能体、评估 32 时，GSM8K 上 Qwen3.5-0.8B 从 self-consistency 0.568 升到 0.705，MATH-500 上 SmolLM3-3B 从 0.492 升到 0.722。8 智能体中 4 个合谋投错并伪造置信与投毒 hint 时，多数投票准确率降到 0.000（Qwen3.5-0.8B，GSM8K），防御版保留 0.507。
Conclusion: 通信只有在执行智能体观测不到所需信息而另一智能体能发送时才提升决策；用自置信重打分可让 mesh 在合谋投毒下保住非零准确率，而多数投票会完全失效。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: TalkMesh 让小型语言模型智能体在去中心化 mesh 中用 RL 学会何时、传什么消息：每个智能体采样提案并用置信头打分，最自信者广播 hint，低于阈值者修订，gossip consensus 近似置信度加权投票。在 GSM8K 上把 self-consistency 的 0.568 提到 0.705（Qwen3.5-0.8B），MATH-500 上从 0.492 提到 0.722（SmolLM3-3B）；面对 4/8 智能体合谋投错并伪造置信，多数投票跌到 0.000，带自置信重打分的防御版仍保 0.507。

papers.title: T-RoPE: Time-Aware Rotary Position Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale recommenders increasingly adopt the sequential generative recipe behind large language models, bringing the Transformer into recommendation along with design choices made for text, including Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE). In language models, RoPE encodes token indices for relative position reasoning, but in recommendation, an interaction index records only event order, saying nothing about elapsed time, behavioral cycles across scales, or calendar phase. We revisit this choice and propose T-RoPE, a time-aware RoPE for sequential generative recommendation that replaces index-only rotation with timestamp-based angles, learnable temporal coefficients, multiscale frequency banks, shifted query alignment, and non-stationary key rotation. We prove that standard RoPE, even on timestamps, remains time-translation invariant and cannot distinguish seasonal contexts, and that T-RoPE breaks this invariance while preserving the RoPE interface. Across five public benchmarks, T-RoPE achieves the best result on every metric on every dataset, improving over the strongest baseline by 78--130\% in HR@10 on the sparse PixelRec data and 8--12\% across metrics on Amazon Books. On an industrial-scale e-commerce dataset with more than 6B interactions, it improves every metric over the HSTU + Time RAB backbone by 13--82\%, with ablations attributing the largest gains to multiscale frequencies ($+56\%$ NDCG@50) and non-stationary keys ($+4\%$). An online A/B test in the Shop app yields positive lifts in conversion rate ($+0.33\%$) and order count ($+0.63\%$). We also provide forward and backward algorithms whose added cost is linear in sequence length and head dimension, keeping time-aware RoPE practical for large generative recommenders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-RoPE 把序列推荐里只编码事件顺序的 RoPE 换成基于时间戳的角度、可学习时间系数、多尺度频率库、shifted query 对齐与非平稳 key 旋转，从而打破标准 RoPE（即使输入时间戳）仍具有的时间平移不变性，能区分季节性上下文。在五个公开基准与 60 亿+ 交互的工业电商数据集上，各指标全面领先，稀疏 PixelRec 的 HR@10 提升 78–130%，线上 A/B 转化率 +0.33%。
Motivation: 推荐系统沿用了文本 LLM 的 RoPE，但交互索引只记录事件先后，不含真实流逝时间、跨尺度行为周期与日历相位，导致模型无法区分季节性上下文。
Method: T-RoPE 用基于时间戳的旋转角替代纯索引旋转，加入可学习时间系数、多尺度频率库 (multiscale frequency banks)、shifted query 对齐与非平稳 key 旋转，同时保持 RoPE 接口；并给出前向与反向算法，额外代价对序列长度和 head 维度为线性。
Result: 五个公开基准上每个数据集每个指标均最优：稀疏 PixelRec 上 HR@10 较最强基线提升 78–130%，Amazon Books 各指标提升 8–12%；60 亿+ 交互的工业电商数据集上较 HSTU + Time RAB 骨干各指标提升 13–82%，消融显示多尺度频率贡献最大（NDCG@50 +56%），非平稳 key 再 +4%；Shop app 线上 A/B 转化率 +0.33%、订单数 +0.63%。
Conclusion: 推荐中的位置编码必须编码真实时间而非事件序号：打破时间平移不变性可在保持 RoPE 接口与线性开销的同时，同时抬升离线指标与线上转化。

papers.title: Entropy Regularization: A Free Correction to Cross-Entropy for Verified Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are often post-trained on expert demonstrations using cross-entropy (CE), even when the downstream objective is not to imitate the demonstrated solution but to produce any output accepted by a verifier. This mismatch is seen in verifiable domains with multiple correct solutions, such as mathematical reasoning and code generation, where training data may contain only one expert solution per problem. We show that minimizing cross-entropy can be misaligned with minimizing verifier risk; two policies can assign identical likelihood to the observed demonstrations while placing different probability mass on incorrect outputs. This is formalized through a learning-theoretic counterexample in which CE minimization selects a suboptimal policy. We identify that controlling the support of the learned policy can solve this problem by preventing probability mass from spreading to unsupported outputs. Since support size is non-differentiable and computationally intractable, we propose entropy-regularized cross-entropy (ER-CE), using token-level Shannon entropy as a tractable proxy. Finally, across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, we find that entropy-regularized training consistently improves verifier accuracy over standard cross-entropy. Our results identify a simple failure mode of imitation-based post-training in verifiable tasks and provide a practical objective that is better aligned with producing correct outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可验证任务（数学推理、代码生成）上，用交叉熵模仿专家演示会与最小化 verifier risk 失配：两个策略对观测演示赋予相同似量，却把不同概率质量放到错误输出上。作者提出熵正则交叉熵 (ER-CE)，用 token 级 Shannon 熵代理不可微、计算上难解的支撑集大小，约束学到策略的支撑。在数学推理与代码生成基准上，熵正则训练相对标准 CE 一致提升 verifier accuracy。
Motivation: 可验证领域每题往往只有一条专家解，但下游目标是产出任意被 verifier 接受的输出；CE 最小化与 verifier risk 最小化并不一致，存在 CE 选出次优策略的学习论反例。
Method: 先给出一个学习论反例，证明 CE 最小化可选出次优策略；再指出控制学到策略的支撑可阻止概率质量扩散到未支持输出，因支撑集大小不可微且难解，改用 token 级 Shannon 熵作为可微代理，构成熵正则交叉熵 (ER-CE) 目标。
Result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，熵正则训练相对标准 CE 一致提升 verifier accuracy；反例中两个策略对观测演示似量相同但对错误输出的质量不同，CE 最小化选中次优策略。
Conclusion: 模仿式后训练在可验证任务上有一个简单失效模式：CE 会把质量摊到未支持输出；ER-CE 是一个更贴近产出正确输出的实用目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: HARDEN: Constrained Evolutionary Search for Harder, Answer-Preserving Evaluation Cases
papers.abstract_en: Language models are often evaluated on curated benchmarks that underrepresent the complexity of enterprise deployments. We introduce HARDEN, a constrained evolutionary search method to adapt the input of existing evaluation cases into more challenging variants while keeping their expected outputs fixed. HARDEN searches along generated domain-specific complexity axes while enforcing feasibility constraints such as preserving task semantics, realism, and execution validity. Across FinQA, PubMedQA, and ContractNLI and three Qwen3.5 model scales (35B-A3B, 122B-A10B, and 397B-A17B), HARDEN reduces task-model accuracy by 22.7% on average and by up to 49.9% relative to single-pass baselines using the same feasibility checks. These results show that evolutionary search can produce substantially harder valid evaluation cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HARDEN 用受约束的进化搜索改写现有评测样本的输入，沿生成的领域复杂度轴搜索，同时强制任务语义、真实性与执行有效性等可行性约束，使期望输出保持不变。在 FinQA、PubMedQA、ContractNLI 与三档 Qwen3.5（35B-A3B、122B-A10B、397B-A17B）上，相比使用同样可行性检查的单次生成基线，任务-模型准确率平均下降 22.7%，最高下降 49.9%。
Motivation: curated 基准无法代表企业部署的复杂度，模型在这些基准上分数偏高，难以暴露真实场景下的能力边界。
Method: 受约束的进化搜索 (constrained evolutionary search)：在生成的领域特定复杂度轴上变异评测样本输入，期望输出固定不动；每步用可行性约束过滤，保证任务语义、现实性与执行有效性不被破坏。
Result: 在 FinQA、PubMedQA、ContractNLI 三个数据集、三档 Qwen3.5 模型（35B-A3B、122B-A10B、397B-A17B）上，相对使用相同可行性检查的单次生成基线，任务-模型准确率平均下降 22.7%，最大下降 49.9%。
Conclusion: 进化搜索配合可行性约束可以批量产出更难且仍然合法有效的评测样本，说明现有基准的难度上限可被系统性推高。

papers.title: Atelier: Learning Local Self-Supervised Features for CryoEM Volumes via Hypernetworks
papers.abstract_en: CryoEM map interpretation requires features that are spatially localized, consistent across samples, and informative across spatial scales. Most deep learning methods for map annotation extract features from fixed voxel grids. However, implicit neural representations (INRs) are able to model volumetric data as scale-agnostic, coordinate-conditioned functions. INRs are therefore attractive for cryoEM, but fitting a separate INR for each map is too expensive for large-scale feature extraction and produces representations that are not aligned across samples. We introduce Atelier, a self-supervised framework that amortizes INR fitting for reconstructed cryoEM maps. Pretrained on 5,439 Electron Microscopy Data Bank maps, Atelier is a transformer-based hypernetwork that generates high-fidelity reconstructions across a wide range of protein structures, including large multi-subunit assemblies. Beyond reconstruction, the INR generated by the pretrained transformer exposes a continuous, local feature field through its intermediate activations at any spatial query point, a property that voxel grid and patch-tokenizer architectures do not naturally provide. Used as auxiliary channels to a 3D nested U-Net annotation head trained from scratch, these coordinate-conditioned features improve performance on eight voxel-level property prediction tasks over a volume-only baseline. Our results demonstrate that amortized implicit neural representations are an effective primitive for geometry-aware analysis of cryoEM data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Atelier 用 transformer 超网络 (hypernetwork) 一次性生成 cryoEM 图的隐式神经表示 (INR)，把逐图拟合 INR 的开销摊销掉，并在任意空间查询点暴露连续的局部特征场。该特征场作为辅助通道接入从头训练的 3D nested U-Net 标注头后，在八个体素级属性预测任务上超过仅用体数据的基线。
Motivation: 现有 cryoEM 图标注深度方法都从固定体素网格提特征，尺度固定；而逐图拟合 INR 对大规模特征提取太贵，且各样本表示互不对齐。
Method: 在 5,439 张 Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) 图上自监督预训练 transformer 超网络，由它直接生成 INR 重建；INR 中间激活在任意空间查询点构成坐标条件特征场，作为辅助通道送入从头训练的 3D nested U-Net 标注头。
Result: 预训练数据为 5,439 张 EMDB 图；生成的 INR 可高保真重建多种蛋白结构，含大型多亚基复合物；坐标条件特征在八个体素级属性预测任务上相对 volume-only 基线提升性能。
Conclusion: 摊销式隐式神经表示可作为 cryoEM 几何感知分析的有效基元，其连续局部特征场是体素网格与 patch-tokenizer 架构天然不具备的。

papers.title: Atlases Are Already Inside: Recovering Population Templates from Pretrained Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We present a new inference-time sampler for diffusion models that gives a pretrained model a capability it was never trained for: constructing the atlas of the population it synthesizes. The sampler converges from every random seed to the population's central anatomy, which we call the \emph{intrinsic atlas}. The advantage is threefold. (1) It requires no retraining. A diffusion model that has already learned a coherent population, including the released ones, yields its atlas in a single inference pass without involving deformable registration. (2) It applies to multiple domains, such as brain MRI, chest X-ray, faces, and 3D shapes. (3) It extends to subpopulations. One age-conditioned model gives an atlas at any age in its training range, and the resulting family reproduces the CSF expansion of healthy aging. Evaluated as a registration target, the intrinsic atlas is best or second-best on every dataset against classical and learned templates, and the most central template on held-out brain MRI cohorts. Atlas construction can be reframed as a byproduct of generative modeling: a diffusion model is a learned representation of population structure, and the atlas is what it already contains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种推理期采样器，让预训练扩散模型在单次推理中吐出其所合成人群的中心解剖图谱 (intrinsic atlas)，无需重训、无需形变配准，且从任意随机种子都收敛到同一中心解剖。作为配准目标在每个数据集上都取得最好或次好，并在留出的脑 MRI 队列上是最中心的模板；年龄条件化模型给出的图谱族复现健康 aging 的 CSF 扩张。
Motivation: 人群图谱构建传统上依赖形变配准或专门训练的模板学习，成本高且与生成模型割裂；作者要证明生成模型内部已含人群结构，图谱可作为推理副产物直接取出。
Method: 设计一个推理期采样器 (inference-time sampler)，作用于已训练好的扩散模型（含已发布的模型），单次推理 pass 收敛到人群中心解剖即 intrinsic atlas；支持多域（brain MRI、chest X-ray、faces、3D shapes）并可扩展到子人群，例如年龄条件化模型在训练年龄范围内任一年龄给出图谱。
Result: 作为配准目标评测，intrinsic atlas 在每个数据集上对经典与学习型模板均为最好或次好，并在留出的脑 MRI 队列上是最中心的模板；一个年龄条件化模型生成的图谱族复现了健康 aging 的 CSF 扩张。

papers.title: High-dimensional Gaussian Graphical Model Testing for Long-Memory Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world high-dimensional time series exhibit long-memory, but Gaussian graphical model testing in this regime remains understudied. We develop a direct, data-adaptive test statistic for assessing conditional independence in the graph structure of stationary Gaussian time series. We establish a finite-sample, Berry--Esseen type Gaussian approximation bound for the statistic, which applies to both short-memory and long-memory time series. The testing procedure is fully data-adaptive using block bootstrap method, on which we provide a finite-sample validity result including in the ultra-high-dimensional scenario, and can be extended to comparing graphical structures in two-sample tests. We also develop a consistency-empowered correction to the statistic and show that such tests attain asymptotic consistency in both size and power. Our proposed method is applied to a real-world fMRI data to understand functional connectivities within brain in different periods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对具有长记忆 (long-memory) 的高维平稳高斯时间序列，提出一种直接、数据自适应的条件独立检验统计量，用 block bootstrap 完成有限样本校准，并给出一致性驱动的修正，使检验在水平与功效上都渐近相合。方法可扩展到两样本图结构比较，并在真实 fMRI 数据上分析不同阶段的脑功能连接。
Motivation: 高维时间序列普遍存在长记忆，但高斯图模型 (Gaussian graphical model) 的条件独立检验在这一机制下研究不足，短记忆假设下的检验无法直接套用。
Method: 构造针对平稳高斯时间序列图结构条件独立的直接、数据自适应检验统计量；建立覆盖短记忆与长记忆的有限样本 Berry--Esseen 型高斯近似界；用 block bootstrap 实现完全数据自适应的检验流程并给出含超高维情形的有限样本有效性结果；再加入一致性驱动的修正项，并把框架扩展到两样本图结构比较。
Result: 给出有限样本 Berry--Esseen 高斯近似界（同时适用于短记忆与长记忆）；block bootstrap 检验具有有限样本有效性，涵盖超高维情形；修正后的检验在水平与功效上均达到渐近相合；在真实 fMRI 数据上用于比较不同阶段的脑功能连接。
Conclusion: 长记忆高维高斯序列的条件独立检验可以通过数据自适应的 block bootstrap 加一致性修正做到有限样本可用且渐近相合，并可迁移到两样本图比较与 fMRI 功能连接分析。

papers.title: Thinking Less to Simulate Better: Intuitive Prompting Improves LLM Agents Simulating Individual Social Media Reactions, Including Unfamiliar Content
papers.abstract_en: Platform policies are increasingly tested on artificial users, making agent fidelity important. Yet convincing fake profiles could also manipulate perceived public opinion before elections. Validation has concentrated on agreement with human behaviour and has paid little attention to whether an agent behaves in line with the profile it was given. The present study profiled eight Serbian participants through a questionnaire, a deep interview, and a written self-presentation, recorded their reactions to sixty-eight social media posts, and asked four language models to predict those reactions under five prompt conditions varying profile content and instruction style. Attitudinal content improved prediction over demographic backstories by a wide margin. Agents matched their stated profiles more closely than participants matched their own survey answers, and consistency proved unrelated to fidelity once profile information was present. Instructing models to respond intuitively and immediately rather than analytically gave the highest fidelity of any condition and cut the compression of individual differences from seven times the human level to three. The advantage held on posts about topics the questionnaire never raised, where that condition reached the highest fidelity of any setup and beat a crowd baseline by a wide margin, which suggests that agents prompted this way could serve as general-purpose simulated users rather than specialists on the topics they were profiled for. Results may bear implications for the development of language models, because intuition-based setups appear better suited to some tasks than reasoning-based ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 8 名塞尔维亚参与者的问卷、深度访谈与书面自我介绍建档案，让 4 个语言模型在 5 种提示条件下预测其对 68 条社交媒体帖子的反应。直觉式即时作答提示取得最高保真度，并把个体差异压缩从人类水平的 7 倍降到 3 倍；态度性档案内容远胜人口学背景故事。
Motivation: 平台政策正被人工用户检验，但验证只看与人类行为的一致性，不看代理是否忠实于给定档案；同时逼真的假档案可能在选前操纵舆论感知，因此需要可泛化的模拟用户。
Method: 对 8 名塞尔维亚参与者用问卷、深度访谈和书面自我介绍建个人档案，记录其对 68 条社交媒体帖子的反应；让 4 个语言模型在 5 种提示条件下（档案内容与指令风格不同）预测这些反应，并与 crowd baseline 比较。
Result: 态度性内容对预测的改善远超人口学背景故事；代理与其书面档案的一致性高于参与者与自身问卷回答的一致性，且在档案信息存在时一致性与保真度无关；直觉即时提示取得所有条件中最高保真度，把个体差异压缩从人类水平的 7 倍降到 3 倍；在问卷从未涉及的话题帖子上该条件同样取得最高保真度并大幅超过 crowd baseline。
Conclusion: 直觉式提示让代理成为可跨话题使用的通用模拟用户，而非只在被建档话题上有效的专用代理；对这类任务，基于直觉的设置比基于推理的设置更合适。
