papers.title: Probing Stability-Plasticity Tradeoffs in Agent Memory through Cognitive Experimental Paradigms
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems are increasingly used to maintain long-term user preferences, task states and evolving facts, but current evaluations often collapse memory behavior into final-answer accuracy. We introduce MemProbe, a cognitive-science-inspired framework for diagnosing stability-plasticity tradeoffs in agent memory. The framework is motivated by a core insight from cognitive memory research: memory is reconstructive and shaped by interference, source reliability, reinforcement, and reactivation. MemProbe turns this insight into four reusable experimental paradigms (interference, misinformation, consolidation strength, and reconsolidation window) that manipulate when a memory should be updated, preserved, or treated as uncertain. It further decomposes correctness into behavioral profiles that reveal how systems update, preserve, attribute, and temporally organize information. We instantiate these paradigms in a 56-episode diagnostic suite and evaluate six incremental memory systems under a unified protocol. Results show that systems with similar aggregate scores exhibit distinct behavioral profiles. MemProbe provides such a diagnostic lens, turning aggregate performance into interpretable profiles of memory maintenance over time. Code is available at https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe.
papers.comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Main, code is availble at https://github.com/jq-ding/MemProbe
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemProbe 用认知科学的四个实验范式（interference、misinformation、consolidation strength、reconsolidation window）诊断 agent memory 的稳定性-可塑性权衡，把整体正确率拆成可解释的行为画像。在 56-episode 诊断套件上统一评测六个增量记忆系统，总分相近的系统呈现截然不同的行为画像。
Motivation: 现有 agent memory 评测把记忆行为压缩成最终答案准确率，无法区分系统在更新、保留、归因和时间组织信息上的差异，稳定性与可塑性的取向不可见。
Method: 借鉴记忆是重构性的、受干扰、来源可靠性、强化与再激活影响这一认知结论，设计四个可复用范式来操控记忆何时应更新、保留或视为不确定；把正确性分解为行为画像，并在统一协议下实例化为 56-episode 诊断套件，评测六个增量记忆系统。
Result: 在 56-episode 诊断套件上以统一协议评测六个增量记忆系统，结果显示聚合分数相近的系统表现出不同的行为画像。
Conclusion: 聚合性能应被转写为随时间变化的记忆维护行为画像，单看总分会掩盖系统在更新与保留上的实质差异。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Auditing Latent-Space Monitors for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Runtime failure monitors can use a model's internal representations to anticipate failures. We audit this monitoring strategy across two autonomous-driving tasks: online vectorized map generation with LaneSegNet and end-to-end planning with VAD. We find that frame-level errors are predictable at inference in both tasks. For LaneSegNet, a supervised latent probe reaches Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) 0.780 for high Chamfer error; to our knowledge, this is the first post-hoc frame-level failure monitor for online vectorized map generation. For VAD, a supervised planning-latent probe reaches AUROC 0.868 for mean-ADE failure. Our audit shows that internal access is not necessary for strong failure prediction. A monitor using only LaneSegNet's prediction outputs reaches AUROC 0.825, while for VAD, ego state, driving command, and the planner's predicted trajectory reach 0.924 on the same mean-ADE endpoint. Adding latent features to either baseline yields no statistically resolved improvement. This observation persists across a broad suite of planning failure endpoints, including endpoints whose labels depend on geometry unavailable to the non-latent baseline. Thus, predicting failure from an internal representation does not establish that the representation provides useful information beyond observable inputs and outputs. We propose an evaluation protocol for testing the incremental value of latent access and release our per-frame failure endpoint labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自动驾驶的在线矢量地图生成 (LaneSegNet) 与端到端规划 (VAD) 两个任务上审计基于内部表征的运行时故障监控：监督式 latent probe 对高 Chamfer 误差达 AUROC 0.780、对 mean-ADE 失效达 0.868，但只用可观测输入输出的监控分别达 0.825 与 0.924，加入 latent 特征没有统计上可分辨的提升。结论是预测出故障并不等于内部表征提供了超出可观测信息的增量价值。
Motivation: 运行时故障监控常假设模型内部表征能提前预示失效，但缺少检验 latent 访问是否带来超出可观测输入输出的增量信息的评测方式，容易把可预测性误当作表征有用性。
Method: 在两个自动驾驶任务上做审计：LaneSegNet 的在线矢量地图生成与 VAD 的端到端规划；分别训练监督式 latent probe 与只用可观测信息（LaneSegNet 预测输出；VAD 的 ego state、driving command、planner 预测轨迹）的监控器，比较 AUROC，并提出一套检验 latent 访问增量价值的评测协议，同时公开逐帧故障端点标签。
Result: LaneSegNet 上监督 latent probe 对高 Chamfer 误差 AUROC 0.780（作者称是在线矢量地图生成的首个事后逐帧故障监控），仅用预测输出的监控达 0.825；VAD 上 latent probe 对 mean-ADE 失效 AUROC 0.868，而 ego state、driving command 与预测轨迹达 0.924。向任一基线加入 latent 特征均无统计上可分辨的提升，且这一现象在一系列规划故障端点上持续成立，包括标签依赖非 latent 基线无法获得的几何信息的端点。
Conclusion: 从内部表征预测故障并不能证明该表征提供了超出可观测输入输出的有用信息；评估故障监控时应显式检验 latent 访问的增量价值。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Dynamic Regret in Online Convex Optimization with Indicator Switching Costs
papers.abstract_en: We study dynamic regret in online convex optimization with an \emph{indicator switching cost}: a fixed penalty incurred whenever two consecutive decisions differ. This captures startup overheads such as server activation, model deployment, and cache updates, and on a bounded domain it recovers norm-based movement costs as a special case. Existing guarantees for indicator costs handle only static comparators. We show that a direct extension of these techniques to dynamic regret provably fails, motivating a different approach. We propose a meta-learning framework: a set of randomized lazy FTRL base learners restarted at dyadic time scales, aggregated by a movement-aware master that mixes their proposal densities and samples actions via maximal coupling of consecutive mixtures. The resulting algorithm satisfies, in expectation, $\mathcal{R}^{\mathbf{1}}_T \le \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{\sqrt{T(S_T{+}1)},T^{2/3}(P_T+1)^{1/3}\})$, where $\mathcal{R}^{\mathbf{1}}_T$ is the dynamic regret plus the cumulative indicator switching cost, $S_T$ counts comparator switches, and $P_T$ is the comparator path length. The bound holds simultaneously for all sequences and requires no prior knowledge of $S_T$ or $P_T$: it is minimax-optimal (up to logarithmic factors) for tracking piecewise-constant comparators, and also captures frequently moving comparators with small total path length.

Motivation: 既有针对指示器切换成本的保证只能处理静态比较器；直接把这些技术推广到动态遗憾会被证明失败，因此需要新方法来同时刻画比较器切换次数 S_T 与路径长度 P_T。

papers.title: Proportional Representation in Temporal Voting with Ranked Preferences
papers.abstract_en: We study proportional representation in temporal voting, where one candidate is selected in each round. While prior work has focused on approval ballots, we consider ranked preferences, which may change over time. A natural approach treats each voter's top candidates as approved, but the right cutoff may differ across voters and rounds. We therefore require proportionality to hold for every admissible choice of cutoffs, whether fixed and common, common but varying across rounds, or set individually for each voter in each round. Combining these interpretations with temporal versions of justified representation (JR), proportional JR (PJR), extended JR (EJR), and proportionality for solid coalitions (PSC) gives us a hierarchy of axioms. We ask which of these axioms can be guaranteed, and with how much knowledge of the future. Unlike with approval ballots, no version of EJR can be guaranteed, and for the other axioms, flexibility in the cutoffs comes at a price. With a fixed common cutoff, JR, PJR, and PSC can be guaranteed, but only by rules that see all preferences in advance. Once the cutoff may vary across rounds, even such rules cannot guarantee JR or PSC for groups that agree in only some rounds. For groups that agree in every round, however, knowing only the number of rounds suffices for PJR in polynomial time, and PSC needs no knowledge of the future at all. Under individual cutoffs, no version of JR or PJR can be guaranteed, yet a rule as simple as serial dictatorship achieves PJR up to an additive loss that no rule can improve on, however much it knows. Natural preference restrictions restore exact guarantees. Finally, we show that checking our axioms is often coNP-complete; but perhaps surprisingly, a stronger axiom can be easier to check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在逐轮选出一名候选人的时序投票 (temporal voting) 中，把每位选民的前若干名视为 approval，要求比例代表性对所有可接受的 cutoff 选择都成立。结论是：cutoff 越自由，可保证的公理越弱——固定统一 cutoff 时 JR、PJR、PSC 可保证但规则须预知全部偏好；cutoff 逐轮变化时，仅对每轮都一致的群体，知道轮数即可在多项式时间内保证 PJR，PSC 甚至不需要任何未来信息；cutoff 逐人逐轮时 JR 与 PJR 都无法保证，但 serial dictatorship 仍能达到 PJR，其加性损失无任何规则能改进。
Motivation: 时序投票中每轮只选一人，既有比例代表性工作只处理 approval 选票；改用会随时间变化的排序偏好后，把前几名当作 approved 的 cutoff 该取多少没有自然答案，需要弄清在不同 cutoff 灵活性与不同未来信息量下哪些公理还能被保证。
Method: 构造三类 cutoff 解释（固定统一、统一但逐轮变化、逐人逐轮设定），分别与 JR、PJR、EJR、PSC 的时序版本组合成公理层级；分析在不同未来信息量（预知全部偏好、仅知轮数、完全不知未来）下哪些规则可保证哪些公理，并给出公理判定的复杂度刻画。
Result: 与 approval 情形不同，任何版本的 EJR 都无法保证。固定统一 cutoff 下 JR、PJR、PSC 可保证，但规则必须看到全部偏好；cutoff 逐轮变化时，即使这类规则也无法对仅部分轮次一致的群体保证 JR 或 PSC，而对每轮都一致的群体，仅知轮数即可在多项式时间内保证 PJR，PSC 完全不需要未来信息。逐人逐轮 cutoff 下任何版本的 JR、PJR 都不可保证，但 serial dictatorship 仍可达到 PJR，其加性损失是所有规则的下界；公理判定多为 coNP-complete，而更强的公理反而可能更易判定。
Conclusion: 比例代表性的可保证性由 cutoff 灵活性与未来信息量共同决定：cutoff 越自由代价越大，但对逐轮一致的群体仍有多项式或无需未来的保证，且自然的偏好限制可恢复精确保证。

papers.title: Rank-Reliable Teacher-Guided Fitness Approximation for Expensive Evolutionary Optimization: A TinyML Architecture Search Study
papers.abstract_en: Expensive evolutionary search does not always need an exact fitness estimate for every candidate. It often needs a reliable answer to a simpler question: which candidate is better? We address this need through Teacher-Guided Learning NSGA-II (TGL-NSGA-II), a low-fidelity framework for constrained Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) neural architecture search. A pretrained teacher organizes samples into strata defined jointly by difficulty and class. Each candidate then undergoes KD-Lite, a short and capped knowledge-distillation procedure on a compact training set, before being scored on a separate stratified evaluation set. This teacher-guided score is fused with a Gaussian-process surrogate to select candidates for full evaluation. For a fixed candidate population, we analyse evaluation variance, score concentration, pairwise rank inversion, expected Kendall-$τ$, first-front identification, and hypervolume perturbation. We also derive a variance-aware fusion weight and a capacity-adaptive distillation rule. On keyword spotting and bird-call classification, the measured Kendall-$τ$ values are 0.74 and 0.62, exceeding the corresponding predicted lower bounds of 0.60 and 0.46. Joint stratification reduces proxy-score variance by 41% relative to random evaluation. Selective teacher mismatch, in contrast, increases differential bias and reduces Kendall-$τ$ to 0.41. Under a constrained evaluation budget, TGL-NSGA-II achieves the largest mean hypervolume and smallest generational distance on keyword spotting, records the lowest mean false-positive rate on BirdCLEF, and runs 2.2x faster than full NSGA-II. These guarantees apply to population-level low-fidelity evaluation and do not establish convergence of the complete evolutionary trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TGL-NSGA-II 用预训练 teacher 按难度与类别联合分层打分，再与高斯过程代理融合，替代昂贵进化搜索中的逐候选精确适应度评估。在 keyword spotting 与 bird-call 分类上实测 Kendall-τ 为 0.74 与 0.62，超过预测下界 0.60 与 0.46；联合分层使代理分数方差降低 41%，整体比完整 NSGA-II 快 2.2 倍。
Motivation: TinyML 神经架构搜索中每个候选的完整评估代价高，而搜索过程往往只需可靠回答“哪个候选更好”这一排序问题，而非精确适应度值。
Method: TGL-NSGA-II：预训练 teacher 按难度与类别联合分层组织样本，每个候选先在紧凑训练集上做有上限的短程知识蒸馏 KD-Lite，再在独立分层评估集上打分；该分数与高斯过程代理按推导出的方差感知融合权重结合选择候选做完整评估，并配有容量自适应蒸馏规则，分析涵盖评估方差、成对排序反转、期望 Kendall-τ、前沿识别与超体积扰动。
Result: keyword spotting 与 bird-call 分类上实测 Kendall-τ 分别为 0.74 与 0.62，超过预测下界 0.60 与 0.46；联合分层相对随机评估降低代理分数方差 41%；选择性 teacher 失配会增大微分偏差并把 Kendall-τ 降至 0.41；在受限评估预算下 TGL-NSGA-II 在 keyword spotting 上取得最大平均超体积与最小 generational distance，在 BirdCLEF 上取得最低平均假阳率，且比完整 NSGA-II 快 2.2 倍。
Conclusion: 低保真排序可靠性（Kendall-τ、前沿识别）可被分析并给出下界，方差感知融合与联合分层即可支撑受预算约束的进化搜索；这些保证只覆盖种群级低保真评估，不构成完整进化轨迹的收敛性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Benchy: towards a universal language for task-oriented AI benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Benchy is a semantic language and execution engine for benchmarking AI programs. A benchmark is completely specified by a program, a scoring function, and a dataset, B=(P,S,D), and is separate from the AI-system taking it; a run binds the two, R=(B,AI). Benchmarks are authored as canonical YAML in which each semantic concept has one valid syntax, classified by a shared task/domain/language ontology, and deterministically compiled into a canonical JSON intermediate representation that the engine executes. Compilation changes representation, not meaning: it does not repair invalid definitions or inject hidden defaults. Programs use fixed schemas of named input and output fields, the leaf output fields are the scoring dimensions, and the engine exposes one universal runtime contract --- a named-field input object in, a named-field output object out --- to which external AI-systems adapt at the boundary, so integration mechanics never propagate into benchmark semantics. This paper gives the semantic object model, the ontology and task-to-program validation rule, the scoring and failure semantics, the compilation and execution architecture, and the scope of the current language. An appendix fixes the normative engineering contract for the first engine implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Benchy 提出一套面向任务型 AI 基准的语义语言与执行引擎：基准被完全定义为 B=(P,S,D)（程序、评分函数、数据集），与被测 AI 系统解耦，运行时再绑定为 R=(B,AI)。基准用规范 YAML 编写、经确定性编译为规范 JSON 中间表示执行，编译只改表示不改语义，不修补非法定义也不注入隐藏默认值。
Motivation: AI 基准的定义、评分与系统集成常纠缠在一起，语义含糊和隐式默认值使基准难以复现、比较与审计。
Method: 规范 YAML 中每个语义概念只有一种合法写法，按共享的任务/领域/语言 ontology 分类并做 task-to-program 校验，确定性编译为规范 JSON 由引擎执行；程序用固定 schema 的命名输入输出字段，叶子输出字段即评分维度；对外暴露统一运行时契约（命名字段输入 in、命名字段输出 out），外部 AI 系统只在边界适配。
Result: 论文给出语义对象模型、ontology 与 task-to-program 校验规则、评分与失败语义、编译执行架构及当前语言范围，并在附录中固定首个引擎实现的规范工程契约。
Conclusion: 把基准写成与系统解耦、编译不改语义的规范程序，可让集成机制不渗入基准语义，使任务型 AI 基准可复现、可审计。

papers.title: Convergence guarantees for Muon: New parameter regimes and generalizations
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we establish the first asymptotic convergence guarantees for the Muon algorithm through a more accurate proxy for the Newton-Schultz iteration than the typical matrix sign function. We prove that, for appropriate choices of hyperparameters, the iterates satisfy $\lim_{k\to\infty}\|\nabla f(x_k)\|=0$, and, under a global Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, that the sequence of function values converges linearly. The key insight is that the regularization, implicit in Muon's Newton-Schulz implementation, induces a bounded preconditioner, exposing Muon as a \emph{preconditioned Polyak heavy-ball} method and enabling a classical Lyapunov analysis. This observation naturally motivates applying the same preconditioning structure to the Nesterov gradient evaluation. We formalize this idea by introducing \emph{Muesterov}, a Nesterov-based variant of Muon, and prove that it enjoys the same convergence guarantees, extending the theoretical framework beyond the heavy-ball setting. Numerical experiments on a scalar cross-entropy problem corroborate the theory and illuminate the joint role of the learning rate and the Newton-Schulz regularizer in controlling convergence. Preliminary numerical simulations training the nanoGPT dataset provide intuition regarding the relevance of the observations in this paper to practical applications.

papers.title: GyroNovo: Error-Guided Fragment Imputation with Mass-Aware Attention for \textit{De Novo} Peptide Sequencing
papers.abstract_en: De novo peptide sequencing from tandem mass spectra is essential for identifying peptides without relying on reference databases. Despite advances in deep learning, accurate sequencing remains challenging because experimental spectra are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete, leaving informative b- and y-ion fragments unobserved. Existing methods attempt to recover this missing evidence via latent-space imputation before autoregressive decoding. However, they typically treat imputation as a fixed reconstruction task, without considering which missing fragments are most relevant to decoder errors. Moreover, existing peak representations do not explicitly model mass differences between peaks, despite their fundamental importance. We introduce GyroNovo, a framework with two main contributions. First, we use decoder errors observed during training to adapt the imputation objective, prioritizing fragments associated with frequent decoding errors. We further use the decoder error distribution to construct easy and hard augmented views of each spectrum, enabling the decoder to learn under varying degrees of spectral corruption and missing-fragment severity. Second, we introduce a mass-aware inductive bias into self-attention by using rotary embeddings to encode pairwise mass differences between spectral peaks. Together, these components align missing-fragment recovery with decoder behavior while explicitly incorporating the mass relationships that underlie peptide fragmentation. At inference time, GyroNovo retains a standard encoder-imputer-decoder architecture and requires neither additional inputs nor auxiliary search procedures. Experiments on NovoBench show gains of about 9 percentage points in peptide-level precision and 7 percentage points in amino-acid-level precision over the state-of-the-art baseline. Code: https://github.com/UBC-NLP/gyronovo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GyroNovo 针对从头肽测序 (de novo peptide sequencing) 中缺失碎片峰的补全问题，用训练期解码器误差分布自适应调整补全目标并构造易/难谱图视图，同时以 rotary embedding 把峰间质量差编码进 self-attention。在 NovoBench 上较 SOTA 基线肽水平精度提升约 9 个百分点、氨基酸水平精度提升约 7 个百分点。
Motivation: 串联质谱实验谱图稀疏、含噪且不完整，b/y 离子碎片缺失；现有方法把补全当作固定重建任务，不区分哪些缺失碎片最影响解码误差，峰表示也不显式建模峰间质量差。
Method: 两项核心设计：一是用训练期观测到的解码器误差自适应调整补全目标，优先补经常出错的碎片，并据误差分布构造易/难两种谱图增强视图让解码器在不同缺失严重度下学习；二是在 self-attention 中引入 mass-aware 归纳偏置，用 rotary embedding 编码谱峰两两质量差。推理时保持标准 encoder-imputer-decoder 架构，无需额外输入或辅助搜索。
Result: 在 NovoBench 上，相对 SOTA 基线肽水平精度提升约 9 个百分点，氨基酸水平精度提升约 7 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把缺失碎片补全与解码器行为对齐、并显式注入肽碎裂的质量关系，能提升从头肽测序精度，且推理开销不变。

papers.title: AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing embedding systems for production recommendation pipelines demands systematic exploration that consumes disproportionate engineering effort at scale. We apply Andrej Karpathy's AutoResearch paradigm -- a large language model that iteratively edits a training script and retains modifications that improve a held-out scalar metric -- to automate this exploration. We report on twelve weeks of running this paradigm at production scale, where iterations consume hours of multi-GPU compute, evaluation involves competing criteria, and campaigns span weeks across many training jobs. Across two independently developed representation-learning systems for a book recommendation pipeline, we ran 220+ experiments and observed five recurring failure modes absent from the original setting: infrastructure fragility, agent memory decay, search-direction stagnation, iteration-cost asymmetry, and metric fixation. We contribute a three-principle scaffolding design -- prevent, persist, redirect -- that maps each failure mode to a structural remedy and whose instantiation scales with iteration cost. The framework produced a 1.82x Recall@6 lift and a 2.1x coherence lift over hand-tuned baselines, and the agent autonomously designed a text-only fallback that expanded catalog coverage by 5.8x. The two systems span nearly three orders of magnitude in per-iteration cost yet exhibit the same failure modes, suggesting these are structural properties of production-scale autonomous research rather than artifacts of either application.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at IEEE ICDM 2026 (Applied Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Karpathy 的 AutoResearch 范式（LLM 迭代改训练脚本并保留提升 held-out 标量指标的改动）搬到生产级推荐系统，连续运行 12 周、跑 220+ 实验后归纳出五种原设定中没有的失效模式，并给出 prevent/persist/redirect 三原则脚手架。在两套书籍推荐表示学习系统上，该框架相对人工调优基线带来 1.82x Recall@6 提升与 2.1x coherence 提升，agent 还自主设计了纯文本 fallback，把目录覆盖扩大 5.8x。
Motivation: 生产推荐管线的 embedding 优化需要大规模系统性试错，占用不成比例的工程投入；直接套用原始 AutoResearch 设定会遇到基础设施脆弱、agent 记忆衰减等新问题，且单次迭代耗时数小时多 GPU 计算、评测指标相互竞争、campaign 跨越数周。
Method: 在两套独立开发的书籍推荐表示学习系统上运行 AutoResearch：LLM 迭代编辑训练脚本，只保留能提升 held-out 标量指标的修改；针对观察到的五种失效模式（infrastructure fragility、agent memory decay、search-direction stagnation、iteration-cost asymmetry、metric fixation）设计 prevent、persist、redirect 三原则 scaffolding，其实现随迭代成本伸缩。
Result: 运行 12 周、完成 220+ 实验；相对 hand-tuned 基线，Recall@6 提升 1.82x、coherence 提升 2.1x；agent 自主设计的 text-only fallback 使 catalog coverage 扩大 5.8x；两套系统的单次迭代成本相差近三个数量级却呈现相同的五种失效模式。
Conclusion: 五种失效模式在成本相差近三个数量级的两个系统上重复出现，说明它们是生产规模自主研究的结构性属性而非某个应用的偶然产物；三原则脚手架可按迭代成本伸缩地把每种失效模式映射为结构性补救。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Replace MCMC in Split-Gibbs Diffusion Posterior Sampling via Deep Unfolding
papers.abstract_en: Split Gibbs sampling enables diffusion posterior inference for general nonlinear inverse problems by decoupling prior and likelihood computations, allowing a pretrained diffusion prior to be reused across measurement models. However, its likelihood update often relies on iterative MCMC, which can hinder parallelization, require algorithm-specific tuning, and incur substantial computational cost. In this work, we propose a learning-based framework to replace this MCMC step by reformulating both Gibbs updates as Gaussian denoising problems and implementing them through ODE diffusion. The prior step reuses a pretrained denoiser, while the likelihood denoiser exploits known likelihood structure through a lightweight deep-unfolded network. Experiments on nonlinear phase retrieval demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method as an alternative to MCMC-based split Gibbs at lower likelihood-update cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Split Gibbs 采样的两步 Gibbs 更新都改写成高斯去噪问题并用 ODE diffusion 执行，从而用一个轻量深度展开网络替代似然更新里的迭代 MCMC。先验步复用预训练 denoiser，似然步利用已知似然结构；在非线性相位恢复 (phase retrieval) 实验中，该方法以更低的似然更新开销成为 MCMC 版 split Gibbs 的替代方案。
Motivation: Split Gibbs 让扩散先验可跨测量模型复用，但其似然更新依赖迭代 MCMC，阻碍并行化、需要按算法调参且计算开销大。
Method: 把先验更新与似然更新都重构为高斯去噪问题，用 ODE diffusion 实现：先验步直接复用预训练 denoiser，似然步用一个利用已知似然结构的轻量深度展开 (deep unfolding) 网络。
Result: 在非线性相位恢复任务上验证了该方法作为 MCMC 版 split Gibbs 替代方案的有效性，且似然更新开销更低。
Conclusion: 扩散后验推断中的似然 MCMC 步骤可以被学习到的去噪算子取代，前提是把两步 Gibbs 更新都化成高斯去噪形式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Seeing Speech: Learning Visible Articulatory Dynamics for Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in speech-driven 3D facial animation has improved vertex-level reconstruction quality, but speech-consistent visible articulation remains difficult. This is because speech production follows structured and constrained articulators' coordination and the mapping from acoustics to motion is inherently one-to-many. Motivated by the structured patterns of visible articulation, we propose a novel articulation-aware framework that models visible speech through directional articulatory motions and composes them into surface-consistent 3D facial motion. To represent visible articulation with three directional articulatory motions, spreading, opening, and protrusion, we propose a Speech--Articulatory Memory (SAM) that captures the correspondence between speech and these motions under phonetic context through retrieval and decoding based on a key-value memory structure. Then, a Topology-aware Articulatory Composition (TAC) integrates the predicted directional articulatory motions under mesh topology to produce surface-consistent 3D facial motion. Experiments on VOCASET and TFHP show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard reconstruction metrics and improves visible articulatory distance and velocity errors for lip articulation, while a user study confirms clear preference in lip sync and realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语音驱动 3D 面部动画的发音感知框架：用 Speech-Articulatory Memory (SAM) 在音素上下文下检索并解码 spreading、opening、protrusion 三个方向的发音运动，再由 Topology-aware Articulatory Composition (TAC) 按网格拓扑合成表面一致的面部运动。在 VOCASET 与 TFHP 上达到重建指标的 state-of-the-art，并降低唇部发音距离与速度误差，用户研究在 lip sync 与 realism 上明显偏好该方法。
Motivation: 语音驱动 3D 面部动画的顶点级重建已有进展，但语音到运动的映射本质上一对多，且发音器官协同受结构化约束，导致与语音一致的可见发音 (visible articulation) 仍难保证。
Method: SAM 采用 key-value 记忆结构，通过检索与解码在音素上下文下建立语音与三向发音运动（spreading、opening、protrusion）的对应；TAC 在 mesh topology 约束下把预测的方向性发音运动合成为表面一致的 3D 面部运动。
Result: 在 VOCASET 与 TFHP 上，标准重建指标达到 state-of-the-art，唇部发音的 visible articulatory distance 与 velocity error 均有改善；用户研究显示 lip sync 与 realism 上的明确偏好。
Conclusion: 把可见发音拆成受结构约束的三向运动并按拓扑合成，可以在一对多的声学到运动映射下同时提升重建质量与唇形的语音一致性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Inquesto Score: A reliability Protocol For Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Voice agents are increasingly deployed in workflows where failed interactions can affect transactions, access, and other consequential outcomes, creating a need for reproducible and interpretable evaluation. We introduce Inquesto Score (IS), a protocol for measuring voice-agent reliability as the percentage of calls in a fixed, versioned evaluation population that achieve the caller's goal without a functional failure or worse. Rather than combining heterogeneous metrics, IS defines explicit failure events and severity levels and evaluates the deployed voice pipeline. Timing failures, including talk-over and delayed responses, are measured directly from audio, while semantic and state-dependent failures are evaluated using scenario predicates, tool traces, and a pinned open-model judge. Diagnostic views of behavior, acoustic robustness, identity handling, and speaker groups accompany the score without being combined into it. Inquesto Score v0.1 evaluates 30 scenarios, three acoustic conditions, four speaker groups, and 306 calls per agent across 13 configurations of a reference voice-agent system. Our evaluation shows that reliable measurement requires evidence beyond transcripts, explicit treatment of deployment conditions, and validation of the evaluators used to determine outcomes. We release the protocol, reference implementation, and evaluation records.

papers.title: Benchmarking the Connectomes of Caenorhabditis elegans within the Reservoir Computing Framework
papers.abstract_en: The aim of this work is to examine the connectomes of Caenorhabditis elegans through a computational lens using the reservoir computing framework. Connectomes are mappings of biological neural networks; C. elegans is the first organism for which physical connectomes covering the whole nervous system have been published. The connectomes of C. elegans used in this paper have been derived at different ages of the organism and are based on three different ways of measuring inter-cellular connections. They have, with minimal preprocessing, been implemented as reservoirs in the form of echo state networks, which are recurrent neural networks. In reservoir computing, the reservoir itself is not trained, rather the output of the reservoir is passed to a comparatively small read-out module in which training takes place. Training and testing is conducted in different neuro-inspired tasks, with the aim of using these tasks as a benchmark for the connectomes. This process has been repeated with different configurations of the reservoir and equally sized but randomized null models have been used for comparison. The results show that the biological wiring and a bio-informed configuration of input and output nodes of the reservoirs do not necessarily lead to better performance. Contrarily, the randomized null models are often outperforming the original connectomes on the chosen benchmarks. At the same time it becomes clear that the results depend a lot on the configuration of the reservoir and the way the connectome has been derived from the organism. Connectomes from different ages may produce varying outcome, without a clear trend becoming visible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 C. elegans 不同年龄、三种连接测量方式得到的连接组 (connectome) 经最小预处理直接当作 echo state network 的储备池，用神经启发任务做基准。结果是随机化的同规模 null model 往常胜过原始生物连接组，且表现高度依赖储备池配置与连接组的测量来源，不同年龄的连接组结果有差异但无清晰趋势。
Motivation: 生物连接组能否直接充当计算基底尚无系统检验：若随机重连反而更好，则连接组的计算价值不能由其生物真实性直接推出。
Method: 将 C. elegans 连接组实现为储备池计算中的回声状态网络 (echo state network)，储备池本身不训练、只训练小型 read-out 模块；在多个神经启发任务上训练与测试，并改变储备池配置，与等规模随机化 null model 对比。
Result: 生物布线加上生物启发的输入/输出节点配置并不必然带来更好表现；随机化 null model 在所选基准上常常超过原始连接组；结果对储备池配置与连接组推导方式高度敏感，不同年龄的连接组产出不同结果且无明显趋势。
Conclusion: 连接组的计算性能不是其生物真实性的单调函数，评估时必须同时控制储备池配置与连接组的测量/年龄来源。

papers.title: Federated Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation
papers.abstract_en: The evidence behind a scientific or operational decision is often held by hospitals, banks, or registries that cannot pool individual observations. Cross-silo federated learning moves computation to the data and exchanges agreed summaries. Targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE) refines a flexible initial fit, yielding plug-in estimators that respect the model and support efficient inference. TMLE itself, however, has remained a fully centralized procedure. To fill this gap, our paper introduces the first federated TMLE algorithm. We federate targeting itself, for an arbitrary target, loss, and fluctuation family, through two complementary frameworks. FedTMLE-G aggregates local gradients and reproduces centralized targeting step for step. FedTMLE-L lets each institution complete its own fluctuation fit before a single exchange of fitted updates, trading synchronized fidelity for local autonomy. For gradient aggregation, we develop a finite-precision protocol that transmits changes rather than values and certifies targeting accuracy within explicit bounds on exchanges and bits. A description-length analysis of the accepted updates then shows that this finite communication leaves numerical targeting error negligible against sampling uncertainty. The cost of computing an estimator is thus distinct from the complexity of selecting it. Our analysis also indicates that keeping data local is not itself a privacy guarantee of TMLE, since instability of full-record reconstruction need not prevent recovery of a specified sensitive attribute. For a personalized version of local averaging, institutions retain their own estimates and leave once local targeting is complete. A nonconvex convergence bound charges the improvement forfeited through averaging to disagreement among local fits and exposes a tradeoff between equal institutional influence and the sampling variability of small silos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个联邦 targeted maximum likelihood estimation (FedTMLE) 算法，把 TMLE 的 targeting 步骤本身搬到跨机构 (cross-silo) 场景：FedTMLE-G 聚合局部梯度逐步复现集中式 targeting，FedTMLE-L 让各机构先各自完成 fluctuation fit 再一次性交换更新。有限精度协议只传变化量而非数值，并给出交换次数与比特数的显式界，证明通信带来的数值 targeting 误差相对抽样不确定性可忽略。
Motivation: 医院、银行、登记库等持有决策证据却不能汇总个体观测；TMLE 能给出尊重模型且支持有效推断的 plug-in 估计，但此前完全是集中式流程，跨孤岛场景无法直接使用。
Method: 两条互补框架：FedTMLE-G 聚合局部梯度、逐步复现集中式 targeting step；FedTMLE-L 各机构本地完成 fluctuation fit 后单次交换拟合更新。针对梯度聚合设计有限精度协议（传变化量而非值），并对接收更新做描述长度分析；对 local averaging 的个性化版本给出非凸收敛界。
Result: 对任意 target、loss 与 fluctuation family 均可联邦化 targeting；有限精度协议在交换次数与比特数上有显式界，且数值 targeting 误差相对抽样不确定性可忽略。非凸收敛界把 averaging 放弃的改进记到局部拟合间的分歧上，暴露机构平等影响与小孤岛抽样变异性之间的权衡。分析同时指出数据留在本地本身不构成 TMLE 的隐私保证：全记录重建的不稳定性并不妨碍恢复指定敏感属性。
Conclusion: 计算估计量的成本与选择它的复杂度是两回事：TMLE 可以在不汇总数据的前提下保持集中式 targeting 的精度，但数据本地化不等于隐私，且局部平均要在机构平等与小样本孤岛的变异性之间取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Solve Bilevel Optimization with Nonconvex Lower Levels, We Need Second-Order Stationarity
papers.abstract_en: Although bilevel optimization (BLO) has emerged as a powerful framework for addressing many complex and nested machine learning problems in recent years, most existing studies are confined to the lower-level strongly convex (LLSC) or lower-level generally convex (LLGC) settings (i.e., the lower-level objective function is assumed to be, at least, convex). While the LLSC/LLGC assumptions render more tractable algorithmic design and theoretical analysis, they are too rigid to encompass many machine learning problems in practice. The limitations of LLSC/LLGC assumptions in BLO motivate us to investigate solving the BLO problem in the general lower-level nonconvex (LLNC) settings, which remains in its infancy. In the literature on LLNC-BLO, most of the existing works either require additional structures in the lower-level objective function for tractable theoretical analysis, or adopt the first-order stationarity reformulation as a lower-level surrogate problem, which is inherited from the LLSC/LLGC settings but could lose their effectiveness in the LLNC setting. To bridge this gap, we propose to reformulate the nonconvex lower-level problem using a second-order stationarity-based surrogate, the solution of which guarantees a local optimal solution at the lower level. Based on this reformulation, we propose the PROBE (Perturbed gradient algorithm for bilevel problem) and show that it overcomes the limitations of prior works by probing and escaping lower-level saddle points. We prove that PROBE achieves a finite-time convergence rate of $O(T^{-2/5})$, where T denotes iterations. To our knowledge, this work is the first to establish the finite-time convergence for achieving lower-level second-order stationary solutions in general LLNC-BLO. Our experiments on both a large language model-based data curation task and a meta-learning task also show that PROBE outperforms SOTA methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在下层非凸的双层优化 (LLNC-BLO) 中，用二阶平稳性 (second-order stationarity) 代理替代一阶平稳性代理来重构下层问题，提出扰动梯度算法 PROBE，通过探测并逃离下层鞍点求解。PROBE 的有限时间收敛率为 O(T^{-2/5})，是首个为一般 LLNC-BLO 建立下层二阶平稳解有限时间收敛的工作，在 LLM 数据筛选与元学习任务上超过 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有双层优化研究多假设下层强凸或一般凸 (LLSC/LLGC)，过于严格；而 LLNC-BLO 现有工作要么给下层目标加额外结构，要么沿用一阶平稳性代理，该代理在非凸下层可能失效。
Method: 用基于二阶平稳性的代理重构非凸下层问题（其解保证下层局部最优），在此基础上提出 PROBE（Perturbed gradient algorithm for bilevel problem），通过扰动梯度探测并逃离下层鞍点。
Result: PROBE 的有限时间收敛率为 O(T^{-2/5})（T 为迭代次数）；在基于大语言模型的数据筛选任务和元学习任务上的实验中，PROBE 优于 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 一般 LLNC-BLO 需要二阶平稳性而非一阶平稳性作为下层代理，PROBE 是首个为此类问题建立下层二阶平稳解有限时间收敛的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PolicyAttention: Softmax Attention Implements Policy Mirror Descent for Closed-Loop Control
papers.abstract_en: Can causal softmax attention implement policy mirror descent as a repeated controller rather than a one-step algebraic identity? Negative-entropy policy mirror descent (PMD) has the statewise update $\operatorname{PMD}_η(π,Q)=\operatorname{softmax}(\logπ+ηQ)$. Building on the known Q-TD-PMD recursion, we construct one fixed causal-softmax actor--environment--one-step-critic protocol with explicit actor, routing, sampling, and normalization residuals, and propagate them to the policy actually returned. The construction states the finite-logit/full-support domain, the external tokenization and sampling boundary, and the mean-zero LayerNorm carrier conditions required by the normalized compilation. Separately trained pre-LN Transformers recover the target computation empirically. A frozen one-step audit model is closest to PMD among the tested fixed rules; in a preregistered five-run $S=4$ repeated-control test, the learned actor with an exact one-step critic reaches median returned-policy loss $1.052\times$ the Exact PMD oracle and retains the criterion across four no-retraining shifts. The same checkpoints with their learned critic give descriptive median $1.050\times$ the oracle (no registered margin). At $S=8$, replacing the exact critic by the learned critic raises median $T=20$ loss to $0.0225$ yet leaves the Liang--Lai and Algorithm Distillation adaptations $20.2$--$24.2\times$ higher-loss; this is a one-sided sampled-critic bound because PolicyAttention consumes 144 generative transitions per round versus 20 on-policy transitions for the adaptations. The strict 20-transition comparison remains open. At $S=8,16$, the exact-critic common-harness comparison remains $17.7$--$28.2\times$ lower-loss than those adaptations, with the information asymmetry stated locally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolicyAttention 证明因果 softmax 注意力可作为重复控制器实现负熵策略镜像下降 (PMD)：把 Q-TD-PMD 递归编译成固定的 actor–环境–单步 critic 协议，并显式携带 actor、路由、采样与归一化残差。在预注册五次运行的 S=4 重复控制测试中，学到的 actor 配精确单步 critic 的返回策略损失中位数为 Exact PMD oracle 的 1.052 倍，且在四次无重训偏移下保持该判据；S=8 时换用学习 critic 后 T=20 损失中位数升至 0.0225，但仍比 Liang–Lai 与 Algorithm Distillation 改造低 20.2–24.2 倍。
Motivation: PMD 与 softmax 的等价此前只是单步代数恒等式，缺少在重复闭环控制中作为控制器运行的构造，以及把编译残差传播到实际返回策略的误差核算。
Method: 基于已知 Q-TD-PMD 递归，构造一个固定的因果 softmax actor–环境–单步 critic 协议，显式给出 actor、路由、采样、归一化残差并传播到返回策略；声明有限 logit/全支撑定义域、外部 tokenization 与采样边界，以及归一化编译所需的 mean-zero LayerNorm 载体条件；用独立训练的 pre-LN Transformer 恢复目标计算，并与冻结单步 audit 模型及 Liang–Lai、Algorithm Distillation 改造对照。
Result: 预注册五次运行 S=4 测试中，学习 actor 配精确单步 critic 的返回策略损失中位数为 Exact PMD oracle 的 1.052 倍，四次无重训偏移下保持判据；同批 checkpoint 配学习 critic 为 1.050 倍（无注册 margin）。S=8 时学习 critic 使 T=20 损失中位数升至 0.0225，而 Liang–Lai 与 Algorithm Distillation 改造高 20.2–24.2 倍（PolicyAttention 每轮消耗 144 条生成转移，对照为 20 条 on-policy 转移）；S=8、16 的精确 critic 同框架比较低 17.7–28.2 倍。
Conclusion: 因果 softmax 注意力可在重复闭环控制中实现 PMD，且残差可控到接近 oracle；20 转移严格对照仍待补，当前学习 critic 结论是单侧采样上界。

papers.title: Ordinary Nonconvex SGD under Distance-Dependent Moments: Finite-Horizon Stationarity and Nagaev Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Uniform noise-moment bounds exclude stochastic gradients whose variability increases with the iterate. We study ordinary, single-sample stochastic gradient descent for smooth, lower-bounded, possibly nonconvex objectives under distance-dependent conditional moments. Under second moments alone, a direct descent--displacement argument yields $T^{-1/3}$ expected average squared-gradient stationarity with a horizon-dependent stepsize. An explicit oracle-complexity corollary matches the known smooth Blum--Gladyshev (BG-0) lower bound, including the $Lb_2Δ^3\varepsilon^{-6}$ and $LΔσ^2\varepsilon^{-4}$ stochastic terms, where $Δ$ is the initial objective gap and $σ^2+b_2\|x-x_1\|^2$ bounds the variance. Thus unchanged SGD attains the minimax stochastic complexity in this second-moment class. For $p>2$, predictable localization and a Hilbert-space Fuk--Nagaev inequality yield a high-probability bound separating logarithmic variance and polynomial rare-shock contributions. The localization radius is derived from the recursion: no bounded-iterate assumption, clipping, normalization, momentum, or increasing batch size is needed. We also give increasing-confidence rates, an objective-gap-growth refinement recovering root-$T$ stationarity, and stochastic $L^p$-Lipschitz examples. The broad BG-0 optimality statement is distinguished from the smaller mean-square-smooth class, in which additional oracle structure permits faster algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究光滑、下有界、可能非凸目标上的普通单样本 SGD，允许梯度噪声方差随迭代点距离增长（σ²+b₂‖x−x₁‖²）。仅用二阶矩，带时域相关步长的下降-位移论证给出 T^{-1/3} 的期望平均平方梯度平稳性，其 oracle 复杂度匹配已知 Blum–Gladyshev (BG-0) 下界（含 Lb₂Δ³ε⁻⁶ 与 LΔσ²ε⁻⁴ 随机项），即未改动的 SGD 已达该二阶矩类的极小极大复杂度。
Motivation: 均匀噪声矩界排除了噪声随迭代点发散的随机梯度，覆盖不了方差随 ‖x−x₁‖ 增长的场景；需要在该更宽的矩条件下重新判定 SGD 的收敛速率与最优性。
Method: 对光滑下有界非凸目标做普通单样本 SGD，用下降-位移 (descent–displacement) 论证配合时域相关步长；p>2 时用可预测局部化 (predictable localization) 与 Hilbert 空间 Fuk–Nagaev 不等式做高概率界，局部化半径由递推导出，不需有界迭代、clipping、归一化、动量或增大批量。
Result: 二阶矩下得到 T^{-1/3} 期望平均平方梯度平稳性；oracle 复杂度含 Lb₂Δ³ε⁻⁶ 与 LΔσ²ε⁻⁴ 随机项，匹配 BG-0 下界；p>2 时高概率界把对数方差项与多项式稀有冲击项分离；另给出递增置信度速率、恢复 root-T 平稳性的目标间隙增长细化，以及随机 Lᵖ-Lipschitz 例子。
Conclusion: 在距离相关二阶矩类中，不改动的 SGD 已达极小极大随机 oracle 复杂度；但作者区分这一宽泛的 BG-0 最优性与更小的均方光滑类，后者可借额外 oracle 结构设计更快算法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Bias: Machine Learning-Enhanced Particle Filters
papers.abstract_en: Sequential inference estimates latent states from noisy and incomplete observations. Particle Filters (PFs), a class of Monte Carlo methods based on importance sampling, provide a flexible framework for this task, but often suffer from poor sample efficiency and unfavorable scaling with dimension, partly due to suboptimal proposal distributions. We address these challenges by integrating learned proposals into the PF framework. We introduce Neural Optimal Particle Filters (NOPFs), which learn an amortized approximation to the optimal proposal from offline simulated one-step conditioning tuples. The learned proposal is used as a drop-in replacement in standard PF updates, with samples corrected by standard importance weights so that the method asymptotically targets the same filtering distribution under standard support and density-evaluation assumptions. Across stochastic nonlinear benchmarks of varying inference complexity, NOPFs improve sample efficiency and distributional accuracy over standard PF baselines with modest computational overhead. The approach integrates data-driven proposal learning into classical inference without altering the underlying filtering objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离线模拟的一步条件元组 (one-step conditioning tuples) 训练出的 amortized 最优提议分布直接塞进标准 Particle Filter 更新，得到 Neural Optimal Particle Filters (NOPF)：样本仍用标准重要性权重校正，因此在常规支撑与密度可评估条件下渐近逼近同一过滤分布。在不同推理复杂度的随机非线性基准上，NOPF 相对标准 PF 基线提升样本效率与分布精度，计算开销仅小幅增加。
Motivation: Particle Filter 依赖次优的提议分布，导致样本效率差、且随维度恶化，限制了序贯推断在高维潜状态上的可用性。
Method: 从离线模拟的一步条件元组学习最优提议的 amortized 近似，作为标准 PF 更新的 drop-in replacement；样本由标准重要性权重校正，不改变底层过滤目标，仅替换提议分布。
Result: 在推理复杂度不一的随机非线性基准上，NOPF 相对标准 PF 基线改善样本效率与分布精度，计算开销仅为 modest（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把数据驱动的提议学习嵌入经典重要性采样框架，可以在不改过滤目标的前提下缓解 PF 的样本效率与维度扩展问题。

papers.title: Breaking Homogeneity: Diversifying Persona Sets for Creative LLM Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Language models often produce homogeneous responses to open-ended tasks; such homogeneity can spawn groupthink-the convergence of ideas toward a singular and potentially suboptimal decision. We formulate persona diversification as a set-level conditioning problem and study two orthogonal design choices: selecting versus generating personas, and space-filling versus frontier-seeking diversity. We instantiate this design space with four methods spanning coverage and dispersion subset selections, uniform-coverage sampling, and evolutionary persona generation. Evaluations on the Alternative Uses Task (AUT), Infinity-Chat, and Divergent Association Task (DAT) show the benefits of the proposed methods across tasks and creativity objectives. On AUT, evolutionary persona generation increases response diversity by 78.8%, originality by 26.1%, flexibility by 49.5%, and holistic creativity by 13.9% over task-only prompting, while maintaining 98.5% validity; on Infinity-Chat, it nearly doubles persona-induced response separation relative to random personas. Moreover, evolutionary personas compose with creativity-optimized prompting, further increasing its response diversity by 18.6% and creativity by 6.3%. These results establish persona-set geometry as a task-agnostic mechanism for eliciting divergent LLM outputs, and support persona diversification as a reusable complement to prompt optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 persona 集合的几何结构当作可优化对象：在选择式（覆盖/散布子集选取、均匀覆盖采样）与生成式（进化式 persona 生成）两类设计下，进化式 persona 生成在 AUT 上相对 task-only prompting 把响应多样性提高 78.8%、原创性 26.1%、灵活性 49.5%、整体创造性 13.9%，同时保持 98.5% 有效性；且与创造性优化 prompting 叠加后再增 18.6% 多样性与 6.3% 创造性。
Motivation: LLM 在开放式任务上输出高度同质，容易导致 groupthink（想法收敛到单一且可能次优的决策）；persona 使用缺少关于集合层面如何设计的系统刻画。
Method: 把 persona 多样化形式化为 set-level conditioning 问题，沿两个正交维度展开：选择 persona 还是生成 persona，以及 space-filling 还是 frontier-seeking 多样性；实例化四种方法，覆盖 coverage/dispersion 子集选取、uniform-coverage sampling 与 evolutionary persona generation，在 AUT、Infinity-Chat、DAT 上评测。
Result: AUT 上进化式 persona 生成相对 task-only prompting：响应多样性 +78.8%、原创性 +26.1%、灵活性 +49.5%、整体创造性 +13.9%，有效性 98.5%；Infinity-Chat 上 persona 引发的响应分离度相对随机 persona 接近翻倍；与 creativity-optimized prompting 组合后再提升响应多样性 18.6%、创造性 6.3%。
Conclusion: persona-set geometry 是一种任务无关的机制，可用于激发 LLM 的发散输出；persona 多样化可作为 prompt optimization 的可复用补充。

papers.title: BioEVAL: A global, multi-institutional benchmark of large language and multimodal models for bioengineering
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated historic breakthroughs in general reasoning with early successes in biomedical science. However, existing LLM benchmarking emphasizes factual recall, offering limited insight into model performance on frontier and multimodal tasks. We assembled BioEVAL (BioEngineering Validation of AI and LLMs), a global, multi-institutional initiative designed to assess experimental reasoning capability across bioengineering (BE) subfields. BioEVAL spans 11 major BE subfields plus a set of uncategorized items, bringing together 22 research groups to create a PhD-level benchmark comprising 608 evaluation items: 1) 380 multiple-choice questions (MCQs, 359 retained after audit), 2) 218 literature synthesis tasks, and 3) 10 multimodal problems with experimental image interpretation. Benchmark items underwent authoring-group expert review and centralized quality control before evaluation. Following evaluation, a blinded cross-group consensus audit of the highest- and lowest-accuracy MCQ items flagged 21 questions for revision or removal; these were withheld, and all reported MCQ results are computed on the 359 retained items. We evaluated diverse cloud-scale foundation/multimodal models (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok) and locally deployable models suitable for inference on consumer-grade GPUs. Models achieved the highest accuracy of up to 90% on MCQs, similarity score of 0.72 on literature synthesis, and accuracy of 80% on a small sample of multimodal reasoning questions, with substantial performance variation across subfields. Leaderboard rankings characterize current capabilities, limitations, and development priorities across the evaluated BE task categories. BioEVAL is maintained as an extensible benchmark with standardized protocols for continuing expert item contribution and model evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioEVAL 是一个面向生物工程实验推理的多模态 LLM 基准，覆盖 11 个生物工程子领域，由 22 个研究组共建 608 道 PhD 级题目。经盲审质控剔除 21 题后，模型在 359 道保留 MCQ 上最高准确率达 90%，文献综合任务相似度 0.72，小样本多模态题准确率 80%，且各子领域表现差异显著。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 基准偏重事实记忆，难以反映模型在前沿、多模态实验推理任务上的真实能力，生物工程领域尤其缺少跨机构的专家级评测。
Method: BioEVAL 由 22 个研究组共建 608 道题：380 道 MCQ（审计后保留 359 道）、218 道文献综合任务、10 道含实验图像解读的多模态题；题目经作者组专家评审与集中质控，评测后对最高/最低准确率 MCQ 做盲态跨组共识审计，剔除 21 题。评测对象包括 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok 等云端模型与可在消费级 GPU 本地部署的模型。
Result: MCQ 最高准确率 90%（359 道保留题），文献综合任务相似度 0.72，小样本多模态推理题准确率 80%；各子领域间表现差异显著。380 道 MCQ 中 359 道保留，21 题被标记修订或移除。
Conclusion: 当前大模型在生物工程实验推理上已有可观能力但子领域间不均衡，排行榜可刻画各任务类别的能力边界与发展方向；BioEVAL 作为可扩展基准持续接受专家供题与新模型评测。

papers.title: Geometric Feature Learning for Functional Data Valued on the Symmetric Positive Definite Manifold
papers.abstract_en: We here develop a functional neural network, termed MatFAE, for learning trajectories on the Riemannian manifold of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices. MatFAE features intrinsic layers that map manifold-valued functions to Euclidean vector-valued functions, followed by a functional layer that projects them into a finite-dimensional Euclidean space. Unlike most neural networks for discrete-time sequences, MatFAE treats each sequence as a continuous function and can therefore encode trajectory dynamics (e.g., first-order derivatives) in its latent representations. Additionally, the morphology of the functional weights in the functional layer offers interpretability by revealing the regions of the input functional data that contribute most to the latent representations. We justify the design principles and properties of each intrinsic layer and detail how matrix factorization is handled during backpropagation. We apply MatFAE to a range of fMRI datasets, demonstrating its ability to efficiently learn informative representations from high-dimensional SPD trajectories and its practical value for real-world neuroimaging analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatFAE 是一个在对称正定 (SPD) 矩阵黎曼流形上学习轨迹的函数型神经网络：内蕴层把流形值函数映到欧氏向量值函数，再由函数层投影到有限维空间，从而把一阶导数等轨迹动力学编码进潜表示。在多个 fMRI 数据集上展示了从高维 SPD 轨迹中高效学习有信息量表示的能力。
Motivation: 离散时间序列网络把序列当作一串独立样本，丢掉连续轨迹的导数结构；而 SPD 值函数数据（如 fMRI 协方差轨迹）既有流形约束又有高维性，需要既能保几何又能编码动力学的表示学习方法。
Method: MatFAE 由内蕴层（manifold-valued 函数 → 欧氏向量值函数）与函数层（投影到有限维欧氏空间）组成，把每条序列当作连续函数处理以编码一阶导数等动力学；函数层的函数型权重形态可指出输入功能数据中对潜表示贡献最大的区域，作者给出各内蕴层的设计原则与性质，并说明反向传播中矩阵分解的处理方式。
Result: 在一系列 fMRI 数据集上应用 MatFAE，展示了其从高维 SPD 轨迹中高效学习有信息量表示的能力及其在真实神经影像分析中的实用价值。
Conclusion: 把 SPD 轨迹当作连续函数而非离散序列来建模，配合可解释的函数型权重，可以在流形值功能数据上得到既含动力学信息又可定位关键输入区域的表示。

papers.title: Toward Actionable Predictability of Tropical Mesoscale Convective Systems through Large-scale Recurrent Environments in Northern South America
papers.abstract_en: Mesoscale convective systems (MCSs) produce much of the extreme precipitation, floods, and landslides that affect northern South America (NOSA), yet remain difficult to anticipate because they are strongly governed by local processes. On the night of 31 March 2017, an MCS triggered a catastrophic flash flood in Mocoa, Colombia ---an event whose severity was not foreseen with sufficient lead time for emergency action, which typically requires several hours to a couple of days. Motivated by this disaster, this study investigates whether such events emerge within recurrent environments that provide a source of large-scale predictability, rather than as isolated and inherently unpredictable occurrences. We combine a 21-year (2001--2021) MCS tracking dataset, ERA5 reanalysis, equatorial Rossby (ER) wave diagnostics, and a Self-Organizing Map (SOM) to identify recurrent environments associated with MCS occurrence in the Orinoco--Amazon basin. The Mocoa environment maps onto one of nine recurrent configurations characterized by enhanced low-level moisture, neutral Orinoco low-level jet conditions, favorable upper-level circulation, and strong ER-wave activity. We further trace convective precursors to an upstream source region over the Guiana Highlands up to 24~h before arrival in the Mocoa region. Together, these results show that the Mocoa event was not climatologically exceptional but a high-impact expression of a recurrent, partly predictable large-scale regime, demonstrating that portion of MCS predictability arise from recurring large-scale conditions that can be monitored hours to days in advance, and support hazardous weather forecasting in NOSA and other tropical regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 21 年 MCS 追踪数据、ERA5、赤道 Rossby 波诊断与自组织映射 (SOM) 证明，2017 年 31 月 31 日 Mocoa 致命山洪对应的中尺度对流系统 (MCS) 并非气候异常，而是落在九种可复现大尺度配置之一：低层水汽偏强、Orinoco 低空急流中性、高层环流有利、ER 波活动强。对流前兆可从 Guiana Highlands 上游源区提前最多 24 小时追踪到 Mocoa，说明这部分 MCS 可预报性来自可提前数小时到数天监测的重复大尺度条件。
Motivation: MCS 造成南美北部大部分极端降水、洪水与滑坡，但因强受局地过程支配而难以提前预判；2017 年 Mocoa 山洪的严重程度未在足够提前量内被预见，而应急行动通常需要数小时到一两天的提前量。
Method: 结合 2001–2021 年共 21 年的 MCS 追踪数据集、ERA5 再分析、赤道 Rossby (ER) 波诊断与 Self-Organizing Map (SOM)，在 Orinoco–Amazon 流域识别与 MCS 发生相关的重复大尺度环境，并把 Mocoa 事件映射到九种重复配置之一，同时回溯对流前兆的上游来源。
Result: Mocoa 环境对应九种重复配置之一，特征为低层水汽增强、Orinoco 低空急流中性条件、有利高层环流与强 ER 波活动；对流前兆可从 Guiana Highlands 上游源区在到达 Mocoa 前最多 24 小时被追踪。
Conclusion: MCS 的一部分可预报性来自重复出现的大尺度条件，可在数小时到数天前监测，从而支撑南美北部及其他热带地区的灾害性天气预报；Mocoa 事件是重复且部分可预报的大尺度型的高影响表现，而非气候上异常。
Relevance: 76

papers.title: Do LLMs Understand Context? A Knowledge Graph-Based Evaluation Framework
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable linguistic capabilities, a profound question lingers at their core: do these models truly comprehend context or simply excel at pattern matching on an unprecedented scale? Contextual understanding in LLMs refers to the ability to correctly extract relevant information from a given context, integrate it into a coherent internal representation, and reason over it to produce factually consistent and contextually grounded responses. However, traditional methods such as BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) and perplexity simply measure surface-level performance. This reveals a critical gap in question answering (QA), where responses must be contextually grounded rather than simply being memorized associations. To fill this void, we propose a novel knowledge graph (KG) based evaluation framework for LLM contextual understanding in QA. Central to this is Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure combining structural and semantic signals into a single score. In addition, a diagnostic analysis framework is developed to identify and categorize reasoning errors at the triplet level, enabling fine-grained analysis of model failures. Together, across nine benchmarks, S3KG achieves F1 gains of up to $+7.6$ points over the strongest baseline and AUROC up to $0.973$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于知识图谱 (KG) 的 LLM 上下文理解评测框架，核心是把结构与语义信号合成单一分数的 S3KG 相似度，以及在三元组层面归类推理错误的诊断分析框架。在九个 QA benchmark 上，S3KG 相对最强基线 F1 最高提升 +7.6 点，AUROC 最高 0.973。
Motivation: BLEU 与 perplexity 只测表层匹配，无法判断 QA 回答是否真正由上下文支撑，导致上下文理解与记忆性关联混在一起无法区分。
Method: 用知识图谱表示上下文与回答，提出 Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG)，把结构信号与语义信号融合为单一相似度分数；另建诊断分析框架，在三元组 (triplet) 层面识别并归类推理错误，做细粒度失败分析。
Result: 在九个 benchmark 上，S3KG 相对最强基线 F1 增益最高达 +7.6 点，AUROC 最高 0.973。
Conclusion: 以 KG 结构-语义混合相似度加三元组级错误诊断，可以把 LLM 的上下文理解从表层指标中分离出来并做细粒度失败归因。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AcoustiClaim: A Numeric Claim Benchmark with Instrument Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: Audio language models state numbers for acoustic quantities, and neither human opinion nor a judge model says whether such a number is true of the signal. AcoustiClaim extracts each numeric claim from free text, scores it against the instrument that defines the quantity, and classes each quantity by where its reference can be read. Four open-weight systems and one closed model, asked for ten quantities five ways on two corpora, fill 207 cells. Of these, 49 emit fewer than five distinct values, and eight of the 158 cells that can be ranked exceed a rank correlation of 0.3, the bar we set, three with an interval clear of it, five of them one closed model reading pitch. Error sits at or above a constant-predictor floor in every ranked cell but three. The reference decoder we train declines the five voice quantities in prose on 95% of mixtures, with nothing withheld, and states them on the clean twins, reproducing its targets' rule from audio alone. With a calibrated threshold, withholding lowers error on all ten quantities on the mixtures in the mean and on eight at every split, against at most 0.6% from a random selector. A linear baseline orders errors at least as well as ours. F0 s.d. and shimmer stay above the constant floor.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Siyuan Zhai and Chien-Liang Kuo contributed equally. Code and outputs: https://github.com/sheng-tse/acousticlaim
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AcoustiClaim 把音频自由文本里的数值断言逐条抽出，用定义该量的仪器读数做真值打分，并按参考可读位置给量分类，从而判定音频语言模型报出的数字是否真与信号一致。五个模型（四个开源加一个闭源）在两个语料上按五种问法回答十个量，填满 207 格：49 格连五个不同取值都凑不齐，158 格可排序中仅 8 格秩相关超过设定的 0.3 门槛，除三格外误差都不低于常数预测器下限。
Motivation: 音频语言模型会直接报出声学量的数字，但人类意见或 judge 模型都无法判断这个数是否真的对应信号本身，缺少以仪器读数为准的可核验基准。
Method: 从自由文本抽取每条数值断言，对照定义该量的仪器打分，并按参考可读位置给每个量分类；评测覆盖四个开源系统加一个闭源模型、十个声学量、五种提问方式、两个语料，共 207 格。另训练一个 reference decoder 从音频直接读出量值，并与随机选择器和线性基线比较。
Result: 207 格中 49 格少于五个不同取值；158 个可排序格里仅 8 格秩相关超过 0.3，其中 3 格置信区间不触及该线，5 格来自同一闭源模型读 pitch。除三格外所有可排序格的误差都达到或高于常数预测器下限。reference decoder 在混合音频上对五个语音量有 95% 的情况拒绝作答、干净孪生样本上则全部给出并仅凭音频复现目标规则；校准阈值下，拒绝作答使混合样本上十个量的平均误差全部下降、八个量在每个划分上都下降，而随机选择器至多带来 0.6% 改善。线性基线排序误差的能力与本方法相当，F0 s.d. 与 shimmer 仍高于常数下限。
Conclusion: 现有音频语言模型报出的声学数值大多不可靠，需以仪器真值加可拒绝的参考解码器来核验；F0 s.d. 与 shimmer 这类量即使有该机制仍无法稳定优于常数预测器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Shape of Events: Edge-Based Inductive Biases via Cross-Domain Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks trained on ImageNet are known to exhibit a strong preference for local high-frequency texture, an inductive bias that translates into fragile robustness against distribution shifts in real-world environments. Event cameras, in contrast, record only changes in scene brightness and are therefore well suited to capturing contour information; however, due to the absence of diagnostic benchmarks in the event domain, the inductive bias that event-camera data instills in vision models has remained underexplored. In this work, we use knowledge distillation from the event domain to the RGB domain so as to exploit the rich evaluation toolkit available in the RGB domain and systematically dissect this inductive bias. Our experiments show that distillation from the event domain induces, in the RGB domain, color invariance, shape bias, and robustness to high-frequency noise. We identify the underlying mechanism as the model suppressing its dependence on high-frequency texture while acquiring a stronger dependence on edge-based object shape. This hypothesis is supported by changes in how color and spatial information are processed at the early layers, together with a spectral trade-off in which robustness to the absence of high-frequency components coexists with vulnerability to contamination of the relied-upon frequency bands and to disruption of geometric structure. We further show that this inductive bias differs from existing robustification methods and that it functions as a useful prior for diverse downstream tasks in which shape and contour information contribute alongside other cues. The code is available at https://github.com/snskysk/event2rgb-distillation .
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. All authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/snskysk/event2rgb-distillation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用事件域到 RGB 域的知识蒸馏，把事件相机只记录亮度变化所携带的轮廓先验注入 ImageNet 训练的 CNN，使其抑制对高频纹理的依赖、转向基于边缘的形状判断。蒸馏后模型获得颜色不变性、shape bias 与对高频噪声的鲁棒性，但对所依赖频带被污染和几何结构被破坏反而更脆弱。
Motivation: ImageNet 训练的 CNN 偏好局部高频纹理，导致真实分布偏移下鲁棒性脆弱；事件域虽天然捕捉轮廓，却缺少诊断性基准，事件数据究竟注入何种归纳偏置一直未被系统解剖。
Method: 以知识 distillation 从事件域迁移到 RGB 域，借 RGB 域成熟的评测工具箱系统剖析该归纳偏置；通过早期层颜色与空间信息处理的变化，以及频谱上的 trade-off 来定位机制，并与已有 robustification 方法对比、检验其在下游任务中作为先验的作用。
Result: 蒸馏使 RGB 模型获得颜色不变性、shape bias 和对高频噪声的鲁棒性；机制表现为抑制高频纹理依赖、增强对边缘形状的依赖，早期层的颜色与空间信息处理随之改变。鲁棒性呈现频谱权衡：对高频成分缺失鲁棒，但对所依赖频带的污染与几何结构破坏敏感。该归纳偏置与已有 robustification 方法不同，并在形状轮廓有用的多样下游任务中充当有效先验。
Conclusion: 事件域蒸馏提供了一条不同于常规鲁棒化手段的路径：以牺牲所依赖频带的抗污染与抗几何扰动为代价，换取颜色不变性与形状主导的判别先验。

summary_sections.motivation: ImageNet 训练的 CNN 偏好局部高频纹理，导致真实分布偏移下鲁棒性脆弱；事件域虽天然捕捉轮廓，却缺少诊断性基准，事件数据究竟注入何种归纳偏置一直未被系统解剖。
summary_sections.method: 以知识 distillation 从事件域迁移到 RGB 域，借 RGB 域成熟的评测工具箱系统剖析该归纳偏置；通过早期层颜色与空间信息处理的变化，以及频谱上的 trade-off 来定位机制，并与已有 robustification 方法对比、检验其在下游任务中作为先验的作用。
summary_sections.result: 蒸馏使 RGB 模型获得颜色不变性、shape bias 和对高频噪声的鲁棒性；机制表现为抑制高频纹理依赖、增强对边缘形状的依赖，早期层的颜色与空间信息处理随之改变。鲁棒性呈现频谱权衡：对高频成分缺失鲁棒，但对所依赖频带的污染与几何结构破坏敏感。该归纳偏置与已有 robustification 方法不同，并在形状轮廓有用的多样下游任务中充当有效先验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 事件域蒸馏提供了一条不同于常规鲁棒化手段的路径：以牺牲所依赖频带的抗污染与抗几何扰动为代价，换取颜色不变性与形状主导的判别先验。

papers.title: Scaffold-Constrained Subset Dynamic Programming for Exact SSE Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Exact Euclidean \(K\)-means partitions \(n\) observations into \(K\) unlabelled clusters, but the unrestricted search is generally exponential. We use data-derived geometric graphs to precondition an exact subset dynamic program: as a result only connected vertex subsets are admitted as clusters, while sum-of-squared-errors (SSE) loss is unchanged. A remaining-set recurrence minimises fixed-\(K\) or penalised SSE, with exact factorisation over the connected components of each remaining set. The central question we study is how much computational support can be removed while preserving an unrestricted optimum. Graph inclusion gives monotone coverage and support relations, and a bottleneck threshold identifies the first covering graph in a nested hierarchy. For fixed \(K\) and dimension, under compact ball support and density bounds, retaining \(q=O(\log n)\) nearest neighbours per observation preserves an empirical SSE optimum with probability tending to one, using an \(O(\log n/n)\) fraction of complete-graph edges. Truncated Gaussian mixtures with unequal weights and covariances satisfy these conditions. The rate we provide is a sufficient upper bound rather than a result implying polynomial optimisation complexity. Objective-matched synthetic and full-data comparisons assess coverage, compression, and reference-label agreement. As a secondary application, we illustrate how the proposed scaffold preconditioning can be utilized to improve the efficiency of split-merge proposals that preserve unrestricted mixture posteriors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用数据导出的几何图做 scaffold 预条件，把精确子集动态规划限制在连通顶点子集上，SSE 目标不变，从而在保留无约束最优解的前提下大幅压缩搜索。固定 K 与维度、紧球支撑和密度界下，每点保留 q=O(log n) 个最近邻即可概率趋于 1 地保住经验 SSE 最优，只用 O(log n/n) 比例的完全图边；该速率是充分上界，不蕴含多项式优化复杂度。
Motivation: 精确 Euclidean K-means 的无约束搜索一般是指数级的，核心问题是能在多大程度上删减计算支撑（允许的簇结构）而仍保住无约束最优划分。
Method: 以数据导出的几何图预条件精确子集动态 program：只允许连通顶点子集作簇，SSE 损失不变；用 remaining-set 递推求固定 K 或带惩罚的 SSE，并对剩余集的连通分量做精确因子分解。通过图包含关系得到单调的覆盖与支撑关系，并用 bottleneck 阈值确定嵌套图层级中第一张覆盖图；再给出 O(log n) 近邻保留最优的充分条件，覆盖不等权不等协方差的截断高斯混合。
Result: 固定 K 与维度、紧球支撑与密度界下，每观测保留 q=O(log n) 个最近邻以概率趋于 1 保住经验 SSE 最优，仅用 O(log log n/n) 比例的完全图边（摘要原文为 O(log n/n) 比例）；截断高斯混合（不等权重、不等协方差）满足条件。用目标对齐的合成数据与全数据对比评估覆盖度、压缩率与参考标签一致性；次要应用中，scaffold 预条件被用于提升保持无约束混合后验的 split-merge 提案的效率。
Conclusion: 几何图 scaffold 可以在不改变 SSE 最优的前提下大幅削减精确 K-means 的搜索支撑，且 O(log n) 近邻是充分条件而非多项式复杂度的保证；同一预条件还能加速保持后验的 split-merge 混合提案。

papers.title: Mentored Decoding: Faster Inference meets Boosting
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is a successful technique speeding up inference of a target autoregressive language model via a fast drafter model. Lossy speculative decoding allows a drift with respect to the target to further improve speed. Interestingly, it has been observed experimentally that the resulting model can $\textit{also}$ beat the target $\textit{quality-wise}$. Our paper formally proves how such a feat is possible with a formal approach to lossy speculative decoding called $\textit{mentored decoding}$. To get there, we connect inference to a celebrated ML training theory, $\textit{boosting}$, and proceed via the generalization of mentored decoding to the whole set of $f$-divergences. We uncover key properties of mentored decoding, among which (i) the particularly appealing geometric nature of the total variation case, (ii) simple approximations for any $f$-divergence in direct relation with boosting compliance, and (iii) a $\textit{divergence independent}$ $O(n)$ space and $O(\mathrm{sort}(n))$ time data structure built on drafter and target outputs, which allows to query the optimal parameters of the dual problem in $O(\log n)$ time and constructing optimal mentored distributions in $O(n)$ time for any $f$-divergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 mentored decoding，把有损投机解码 (lossy speculative decoding) 形式化并与 boosting 训练理论打通，证明快草稿模型驱动的解码在质量上可以超过目标模型。对任意 f-散度给出与 boosting 兼容性的简单近似，并构造与散度无关的数据结构：空间 O(n)、时间 O(sort(n))，查询对偶问题最优参数 O(log n)、构造最优 mentored 分布 O(n)。
Motivation: 有损投机解码允许草稿偏离目标模型以换取速度，实验上还观察到质量反超目标模型，但这一现象缺少形式解释；同时缺少对任意 f-散度通用的高效最优参数求解手段。
Method: 将推理过程形式化为 mentored decoding，把该问题连接到 boosting 训练理论，并把方法推广到全体 f-散度；基于草稿与目标模型的输出构建与散度无关的数据结构，用于求解对偶问题的最优参数并构造最优 mentored 分布。
Result: 得到三项关键性质：total variation 情形具有几何结构；任意 f-散度都有与 boosting 兼容性直接相关的简单近似；数据结构空间 O(n)、时间 O(sort(n))，查询对偶最优参数 O(log n)，构造最优 mentored 分布 O(n)，且对任意 f-散度通用。
Conclusion: 有损投机解码在质量上超过目标模型是可被形式证明的，因为推理可由 boosting 理论刻画；最优参数求解不必依赖具体散度选择。

papers.title: Moment-guided edge sampling
papers.abstract_en: Edge sampling makes local decisions to achieve graph-level objectives, such as preserving structural properties. This creates a fundamental challenge: \textit{how can the effect of a local edge edit (i.e., edge addition or removal) on global graph structure be quantified and controlled?} We address this challenge with a \textit{moment-guided edge sampling framework} based on spectral moments of the random-walk transition matrix. We compute exact moment changes through two complementary methods: a combinatorial method with closed-form updates for low-order moments, and a low-rank method that exploits \textit{locality} and \textit{cyclic trace invariance} to compress computations to edited endpoints, supporting arbitrary moment orders and batched edits. For single-edge edits at fixed moment orders, the low-rank method reduces the cost from $O(mn)$ to $O(m)$, while the combinatorial method evaluates low-order changes in constant time given maintained local statistics. These moment changes provide \textbf{interpretable structural signatures} of local edge motifs that aggregate into graph-level fingerprints. This structural meaning motivates us to ask whether preserving moments also preserves the graph properties. We further derive and validate that moment-preserving sampling can \textbf{retain related structural properties}, including triangle-weighted clustering coefficient. These structural insights enable \textbf{analysis and improvement of graph learning}: different edge structures have distinct effects on supervised node classification, while moment-guided augmentation is competitive for graph contrastive learning. Together, these findings establish moments as an interpretable and controllable bridge from local edge edits to global graph structure and learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于随机游走转移矩阵谱矩的 moment-guided edge sampling 框架，用闭式低阶更新的组合方法与利用局部性和 cyclic trace invariance 的低秩方法，精确计算单条边增删引起的矩变化。低秩方法把单边编辑、固定矩阶的代价从 O(mn) 降到 O(m)，组合方法在维护局部统计量后常数时间求低阶变化；保留矩可保住 triangle-weighted clustering coefficient 等结构量，moment-guided 增广在图对比学习上具竞争力。
Motivation: 边采样只做局部决策却要达成图级目标，核心困难是无法量化并控制单次局部边编辑对全局图结构的影响。
Method: 以随机游走转移矩阵的谱矩为度量：组合方法对低阶矩给出闭式更新，低秩方法借局部性与 cyclic trace invariance 把计算压缩到被编辑端点，支持任意矩阶与批量编辑；矩变化被解释为局部边 motif 的结构签名，聚合成图级指纹，并据此设计边增广。
Result: 单边编辑、固定矩阶下低秩方法代价由 O(mn) 降至 O(m)，组合方法在维护局部统计量后常数时间求低阶矩变化；推导并验证保留矩可保住 triangle-weighted clustering coefficient 等相关结构属性；不同边结构对有监督节点分类影响不同，moment-guided 增广在图对比学习上具竞争力。
Conclusion: 谱矩可作为从局部边编辑到全局图结构与图学习的可解释、可控桥梁，且保留矩确实能保住相关结构性质。

papers.title: CARGO: Context-Aware Retrieval-Gated Evaluation of Agentic AI in Production
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based LLM-as-a-judge evaluation assumes the reference answer is the target. In deployed agentic systems that operate over dynamic entities (support cases, assets, accounts), the closest available reference typically applies the correct procedure to a different entity, so a literal judge penalizes different identifiers, dates, and statuses as errors or hallucinations. We name this failure mode reference-instance divergence (RID). We propose CARGO, a framework that (i) treats retrieved references as procedural exemplars and grounds factual judgments in the live instance's observed context, (ii) assigns each claim a three-way status (supported, contradicted, unverifiable) and penalizes only contradictions, and (iii) gates evaluation by retrieval confidence, casting production evaluation as selective prediction. We introduce CARGO-Bench, a perturbation-based diagnostic suite with ground truth by construction that separates leniency from discrimination. On CARGO-Bench (246 items, two judge models, 7,872 judgments), the standard reference-based judge penalizes 100% of correct entity-transplanted answers and is uninformative (discrimination index DI ~ 0); supplying the live facts without reframing changes nothing. CARGO eliminates these false penalties (0/50) while retaining near-complete contradiction recall (50/50 and 49/50), raising DI to 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]; a rubric-swap control attributes most of the effect to context-grounded dimension definitions. CARGO also exposes a limitation of its own design: the leniency that protects entity values suppresses detection of procedural corruptions (20% recall). A post-hoc fix does not close the gap, and an LLM-as-annotator study with written guidelines and adjudication shows the same blind spot. We release a preregistered protocol for extending the evaluation to expert agreement, risk-coverage, and cost on production traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARGO 把生产环境 agentic AI 的参考答案评判改造成选择性预测：检索到的参考只当程序范例，事实判断落在当前实例的实时上下文上，每条 claim 判 supported/contradicted/unverifiable 且只罚矛盾，并按检索置信度门控。在 CARGO-Bench（246 项、两个 judge 模型、7,872 次判定）上，标准参考式 judge 把 100% 正确的实体移植答案判罚、DI≈0；CARGO 把假罚降到 0/50，矛盾召回 50/50 与 49/50，DI 升到 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]，但对程序性破坏的召回只有 20%。
Motivation: 部署在动态实体（support case、asset、account）上的 agentic 系统里，最接近的参考答案往往是对另一个实体套用正确流程，literal judge 会把不同的标识符、日期、状态当成错误或幻觉，即 reference-instance divergence (RID)。
Method: CARGO 三件套：把检索参考当 procedural exemplar、事实判断 grounding 在 live instance 的观测上下文；每条 claim 赋 supported/contradicted/unverifiable 三态且只罚 contradicted；按 retrieval confidence 门控评估，把生产评估写成 selective prediction。配套发布扰动式诊断集 CARGO-Bench，ground truth 由构造保证，可分离 leniency 与 discrimination。
Result: CARGO-Bench 共 246 项、两个 judge 模型、7,872 次判定：标准 reference-based judge 对正确的 entity-transplanted 答案判罚 100%，DI≈0，直接补 live facts 不改框架也无变化。CARGO 假罚 0/50，矛盾召回 50/50 与 49/50，DI 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]；rubric-swap 对照显示效果主要来自 context-grounded 的维度定义。代价是程序性破坏召回仅 20%，事后修补未能补齐，LLM-as-annotator 研究（书面指南加仲裁）复现同一盲区。
Conclusion: 用实时实例上下文做 grounding、只罚矛盾并按检索置信度门控，能消除 RID 造成的假罚且保住矛盾检出；但保护实体取值的宽容度会压制程序性破坏的检出，作者据此发布预注册协议，计划在生产流量上补专家一致性、risk-coverage 与成本评估。

summary_sections.result: CARGO-Bench 共 246 项、两个 judge 模型、7,872 次判定：标准 reference-based judge 对正确的 entity-transplanted 答案判罚 100%，DI≈0，直接补 live facts 不改框架也无变化。CARGO 假罚 0/50，矛盾召回 50/50 与 49/50，DI 0.58 [0.48, 0.68]；rubric-swap 对照显示效果主要来自 context-grounded 的维度定义。代价是程序性破坏召回仅 20%，事后修补未能补齐，LLM-as-annotator 研究（书面指南加仲裁）复现同一盲区。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用实时实例上下文做 grounding、只罚矛盾并按检索置信度门控，能消除 RID 造成的假罚且保住矛盾检出；但保护实体取值的宽容度会压制程序性破坏的检出，作者据此发布预注册协议，计划在生产流量上补专家一致性、risk-coverage 与成本评估。

papers.title: Reliability-aware Cross-sample Enhancement for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to infer human emotions from multiple modalities such as text, audio, and vision. In practice, inputs are often corrupted by noise and missing modalities, which degrades performance. Existing methods typically address these challenges in isolation, limiting their effectiveness in realistic settings. To address this limitation, we propose a Reliability-aware Cross-sample Enhancement (RCE) framework. Specifically, RCE first introduces an adaptive variational information bottleneck to model modality-wise uncertainty and perform quality-aware information compression, thereby suppressing redundant noise in unreliable modalities. Furthermore, we design a reliability-aware cross-sample enhancement strategy that retrieves high-confidence, semantically consistent neighbors from a large candidate pool to enrich and calibrate current representations, effectively alleviating information deficiency caused by missing modalities. Building upon this, RCE integrates cross-modal interactions with a multilevel reliability-aware fusion mechanism to adaptively aggregate information across modalities and enhancement stages, leading to more robust multimodal representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across full, noisy, and missing-modality settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多模态情感分析 (MSA) 框架 RCE：用自适应变分信息瓶颈按模态不确定性做质量感知压缩以抑制噪声模态，再从候选池检索高置信、语义一致的邻居样本补足缺失模态信息，最后以多层可靠性感知融合跨模态与各增强阶段。在完整、含噪与缺失模态三种设定下均一致优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 实际 MSA 输入常被噪声污染或缺失模态，现有方法通常分别单独处理这两类问题，在真实场景中效果受限。
Method: RCE 框架三部分：自适应变分信息瓶颈 (adaptive variational information bottleneck) 建模各模态不确定性并做质量感知信息压缩；可靠性感知跨样本增强策略从大候选池检索高置信、语义一致的邻居来补足与校准当前表示；再用多层可靠性感知融合机制自适应聚合跨模态与各增强阶段的信息。
Result: 在完整、含噪、缺失模态三种设定下的实验中，RCE 均一致优于 state-of-the-art 方法。
Conclusion: 把噪声抑制与缺失补足统一到可靠性度量下、并用跨样本检索做增强，可得到对噪声和模态缺失都更稳健的多模态表示。

papers.title: Pretrained ASR Pseudo-labeling for Noisy Police Audio
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained ASR systems perform poorly on noisy Broadcast Police Communication (BPC), hindering efforts to understand police decision-making. Pseudo-labeling offers an unsupervised path to improve ASR without expensive human labels, but the efficacy of this approach on very noisy domains is not known. In this work, we systematically assess the opportunities and limits of pseudo-labeling to adapt foundation ASR models (Whisper and Qwen3-ASR) to noisy BPC domain corpora from Baltimore and Chicago. We demonstrate that existing internal confidence metrics (log-probabilities and STAR scores) fail to distinguish between high and low quality BPC pseudo-labels, and we introduce an external LLM-as-a-judge filtering paradigm that leverages parametric knowledge to discard contextually implausible transcripts. Our LLM-judging filters more aggressively than internal metrics and significantly reduces WER of the pseudo-labeled training sets across the Baltimore and Chicago BPC corpora, though a substantial gap remains relative to an oracle filter. We also introduce a new cross-model pseudo-labeling paradigm where one model is finetuned with pseudo-labels from the other, and we identify this method as a promising direction for future pseudo-labeling work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在极噪的警用广播 (BPC) 语音上，Whisper 与 Qwen3-ASR 的内部置信度指标（log-probability、STAR score）无法区分伪标签好坏；改用 LLM-as-a-judge 依据上下文合理性丢弃不可信转写，能更激进地过滤并显著降低 Baltimore 与 Chicago 两个 BPC 语料伪标签训练集的 WER，但仍与 oracle 过滤有较大差距。跨模型伪标签（一个模型用另一个模型的伪标签微调）被指认为有前景的方向。
Motivation: 预训练 ASR 在极噪的 Broadcast Police Communication (BPC) 上表现很差，而人工标注昂贵；伪标签是无监督适配路径，但其在极噪领域的有效性此前未知，且现有内部置信度指标在该域失效。
Method: 系统评估用伪标签适配基础 ASR 模型（Whisper、Qwen3-ASR）到 Baltimore 与 Chicago 的 BPC 语料；对比内部置信度指标（log-probabilities、STAR scores）与新提出的 LLM-as-a-judge 过滤范式，后者利用参数化知识丢弃上下文上不可信的转写；另提出跨模型伪标签范式，用另一模型的伪标签微调本模型。
Result: 内部置信度指标（log-probabilities、STAR scores）无法区分高质量与低质量 BPC 伪标签；LLM-judge 过滤比内部指标更激进，并在 Baltimore 与 Chicago 两个 BPC 语料上显著降低伪标签训练集的 WER，但相对 oracle 过滤仍存在较大差距。
Conclusion: 在极噪域中内部置信度不可靠，外部 LLM 判别式过滤是更有效的伪标签质量控制手段；跨模型伪标签被作者认定为值得后续投入的方向。

papers.title: A Benchmarking Framework for Context-aware XR Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Everyday Extended Reality (XR) systems aim to provide context-aware access to the right functionalities at the right time and place, with minimal manual reconfiguration as users switch context. Yet these interfaces are hard to evaluate: current prototyping and user-study workflows offer no systematic, repeatable way to compare adaptation methods across users and scenarios. We present ContextXR, a novel benchmarking framework for context-aware XR interfaces. ContextXR represents an XR application as a connected graph of functional facets, each a semantically coherent group of related capabilities that together support a shared user intent. On this representation, we build MineXR++, a dataset augmenting prior XR interface data with facet-level annotations, and formulate three canonical tasks of context-aware suggestion: context factor analysis, initial facet suggestion, and next facet suggestion. Our evaluation protocol scores suggestion methods by a simulated interaction metric, the navigation and search cost of reaching the desired functionality. Through experiments benchmarking global popularity, relational retrieval, and LLM-based methods, we demonstrate that ContextXR enables the systematic, reproducible evaluation of context-aware XR interfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextXR 把 XR 应用表示为功能切面 (facet) 连接图，据此构建 MineXR++ 数据集并形式化上下文感知建议的三项规范任务，用「到达目标功能的导航与搜索成本」这一模拟交互指标统一打分。对 global popularity、relational retrieval 与 LLM 方法的基准实验表明该框架可系统、可复现地比较上下文自适应方法。
Motivation: 上下文感知 XR 界面缺少跨用户、跨场景系统且可重复地比较自适应方法的评测流程，现有原型与用户研究工作流无法横向对比。
Method: ContextXR 将 XR 应用建模为功能切面连接图（每个 facet 是支撑同一用户意图的语义一致能力组），在其上构建带 facet 级标注的 MineXR++ 数据集，并定义 context factor analysis、initial facet suggestion、next facet suggestion 三项任务；评测协议用模拟交互指标——到达目标功能的导航与搜索成本——给建议方法打分。
Result: 以该协议对 global popularity、relational retrieval 和 LLM-based 三类方法做基准实验，证明 ContextXR 能对上下文感知 XR 界面进行系统、可复现的评估。
Conclusion: 把 XR 应用表示成 facet 图并以导航搜索成本为统一指标，上下文感知建议方法就能在固定协议下被重复比较。

papers.title: RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token but store the full expert pool. Expert pruning reduces this storage burden; at a fixed pruning budget, the goal is to preserve the original model's output distribution as closely as possible. Yet an expert's usage or contribution magnitude does not by itself determine the damage caused by its removal. What matters is whether the surviving computation can replace its function. We introduce RAZOR, a training-free expert pruning method that scores functional replaceability using consensus residuals: deviations of expert outputs from the original weighted mixture. An exact single-deletion identity at a fixed layer input accounts for survivor renormalization and router-selected refill, providing local scores aggregated over calibration tokens for budgeted pruning without gradients or recovery training. On GLM-4.7-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, and Hy3 at 25\% and 50\% expert removal, RAZOR achieves the highest nine-task macro average among the evaluated pruning methods in all eight settings. On the two backbones with matched REAP benchmark runs, it exceeds REAP by 2.12--5.59 points and wins all 36 paired task comparisons. It also lowers reverse KL relative to REAP in all four matched GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model--budget settings. Analysis of responses generated by Qwen3.6-35B-A3B nevertheless reveals changes in diversity, formatting, and termination, underscoring that task retention and predictive fidelity do not ensure generation stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAZOR 是免训练的 MoE 专家剪枝方法，用 consensus residual（专家输出相对原始加权混合的偏差）给专家的“功能可替换性”打分，并用固定层输入下的单删除恒等式同时计入幸存者重归一化与 router 重选填充，无需梯度或恢复训练。在 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Hy3 上按 25% 与 50% 剪枝共 8 种设置，RAZOR 的九任务宏平均在全部设置中最高；在两个有 REAP 对照的骨干上超出 REAP 2.12–5.59 分并赢下全部 36 组配对任务比较。
Motivation: MoE 每 token 只激活少数专家却存下整个专家池，专家剪枝要在固定预算下尽量保住原模型输出分布；但专家的使用频率或贡献幅度并不能预测删除它造成的损失，关键是幸存计算能否替代其功能。
Method: 训练无关的专家剪枝：以 consensus residual（专家输出偏离原始加权混合的量）度量功能可替换性；在固定层输入上给出精确的单删除恒等式，显式纳入幸存者重归一化与 router 选择的补位专家；在 calibration tokens 上聚合得到局部打分，按预算剪枝，全程不用梯度也不做恢复训练。
Result: 在 GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Hy3 四个骨干 × 25%/50% 专家删除共 8 种设置中，RAZOR 的九任务宏平均在所有被评估剪枝方法里均为最高；在两个有匹配 REAP benchmark 运行的骨干上比 REAP 高 2.12–5.59 分，36 组配对任务比较全部获胜；在 GLM-4.7-Flash 与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的全部 4 个匹配模型-预算设置上 reverse KL 均低于 REAP。对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 生成回复的分析显示多样性、格式与终止行为仍发生变化。
Conclusion: 按功能可替换性而非使用频率选剪枝对象，能在免训练条件下更贴近原模型分布；但任务保持与预测保真并不保证生成稳定性，输出的多样性、格式和终止仍会漂移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VkVIO: Cross-platform GPU Acceleration for Visual-Inertial Odometry with Vulkan
papers.abstract_en: Perception in robotics and XR fundamentally relies on good state estimation. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) are proven ways of achieving this goal in a cost-effective and accurate manner. Efficiency in these systems allows for smaller, cooler, and lighter devices. GPU acceleration is a natural approach for reducing latency, thanks to their wide availability in platforms like embedded computers, mobile phones, and XR headsets. However, previous works in the literature have limited themselves to the use of CUDA for this task, significantly reducing deployment options to a single vendor. We instead leverage the vendor-agnostic Vulkan API, originally designed for the strict performance requirements of 3D graphics applications. In this work, we present VkVIO, the first, to the best of our knowledge, cross-platform GPU-accelerated VIO method. We provide state-of-the-art accuracy with causal estimates required for real-time operation. We deploy VkVIO on a diverse range of devices spanning a workstation, a laptop, and an extremely inexpensive single-board computer, while outperforming CUDA-based systems on the same hardware. VkVIO enables possibilities for low-latency, low-power, and low-cost VIO in robotics and XR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VkVIO 用厂商无关的 Vulkan API 替代 CUDA 做视觉惯性里程计 (VIO) 的 GPU 加速，是作者所知首个跨平台 GPU 加速 VIO 方法，同时给出实时因果估计所需的 state-of-the-art 精度。在工作站、笔记本和极廉价单板计算机上部署，同硬件上超过基于 CUDA 的系统。
Motivation: VIO/VI-SLAM 的效率决定设备能否更小更冷更轻，但既有工作只用 CUDA，把部署锁死在单一 GPU 厂商，嵌入式、手机与 XR 头显的可选平台大幅受限。
Method: 以 Vulkan 这一为 3D 图形严格性能需求设计的跨平台图形 API 承载 VIO 的 GPU 计算，取代 CUDA 路径；输出面向实时运行的因果 (causal) 状态估计，并在工作站、笔记本与单板计算机三类异构设备上部署。
Result: 达到实时因果估计所需的 state-of-the-art 精度；在与 CUDA 系统相同的硬件上性能更优，覆盖工作站、笔记本与极廉价单板计算机三档设备。
Conclusion: 跨平台图形 API 可以在不牺牲精度的前提下把 VIO 加速从单一 GPU 厂商解耦，使低延迟、低功耗、低成本的机器人与 XR 状态估计成为可部署选项。
