papers.title: Spectral Feedback for Test-Time Alignment of Protein Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Reward maximization alignment methods for discrete diffusion models have primarily focused on steering the reverse process, either by influencing token logits or by selecting favorable sequences at intermediate steps. These approaches largely treat inference as a unidirectional process, lacking mechanisms for revisiting undesirable token selections. We introduce Spectral Feedback, an algorithm that selects edit-positions in a feedback loop, allowing the model to iteratively correct its own generations. This approach leverages the mask structure of discrete diffusion models by re-masking and re-sampling tokens, analogous to image editing methods that reintroduce noisy latents and re-run the reverse process. While prior alignment methods focus on what token labels to assign to maximize a target reward, we instead treat which tokens to revisit as the central alignment problem. Selecting edit-positions is challenging because edit effects are interdependent: the impact of modifying one token depends on which others are edited simultaneously. We define an edit-set as a set of token positions to re-mask and re-sample. Motivated by prior work on sparse interactions in biological systems, we find empirically that edit-set value functions for protein inverse folding admit sparse Fourier representations. This structure enables Spectral Feedback to efficiently learn and optimize the value functions for edit-position selection. Spectral Feedback is model-agnostic and can be applied to pretrained, test-time aligned, and fine-tuned diffusion models. For all of these models, the algorithm improves alignment performance without modifying the underlying generative process. Applied to inverse folding with a protein stability reward oracle, it achieves a 32.3% increase in stable proteins for a pretrained model, 24.8% for Best-of-10, and 5.8% for a state-of-the-art RL fine-tuned diffusion model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spectral Feedback 把离散扩散模型的测试时对齐从「选什么 token」改成「回访哪些 token」：在反馈循环中重掩码并重采样编辑位置，用编辑集价值函数的稀疏 Fourier 表示来高效学习与优化位置选择。在蛋白质反向折叠、以稳定性为奖励 oracle 的设定下，预训练模型的稳定蛋白提升 32.3%，Best-of-10 提升 24.8%，RL 微调的 SOTA 扩散模型提升 5.8%，且不改动底层生成过程。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散对齐方法只单向引导反向过程（改 token logits 或中间步选序列），无法回访不利的 token 选择；而编辑位置的选择本身困难，因为各 token 的编辑效果相互依赖。
Method: Spectral Feedback 以反馈循环选择 edit-position：把一组 token 位置定义为 edit-set，重掩码并重采样，类似图像编辑中重新注入噪声 latent 再跑反向过程。受生物系统稀疏交互启发，发现蛋白质反向折叠的 edit-set 价值函数经验上具有稀疏 Fourier 表示，据此高效学习并优化位置选择价值函数；算法 model-agnostic，可用于预训练、测试时对齐与微调的扩散模型。
Result: 在蛋白质反向折叠、蛋白稳定性奖励 oracle 下：预训练模型稳定蛋白增加 32.3%，Best-of-10 增加 24.8%，state-of-the-art RL 微调扩散模型增加 5.8%；对三类模型均提升对齐性能且不修改底层生成过程。
Conclusion: 把「回访哪些 token」而非「赋什么标签」当作核心对齐问题，并利用 edit-set 价值函数的稀疏 Fourier 结构，可在不改动生成过程的前提下对任意离散扩散模型做测试时对齐增益。

papers.title: Auditing System-1 Models on Biosecurity-Relevant Benchmarks: Calibration, Selective Prediction, and Permutation Instability in a Non-Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: Non-generative "System-1" models return structured probabilistic decisions in a single forward pass, without autoregressive decoding, at a small fraction of the inference cost of a generative model. This makes them of interest as inexpensive components in larger pipelines, but their reliability on biosecurity-relevant tasks has not been systematically examined. We audit one commercial System-1 model on 6,020 multiple-choice items drawn from the Weapons of Mass Destruction Proxy (WMDP), a paraphrase-robust WMDP-Bio variant, and six LAB-Bench subtasks, measuring accuracy, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, and sensitivity to the order in which answer options are presented. Accuracy is strongly task-dependent. Once the vendor's uncertainty field is correctly interpreted, the model is reasonably well calibrated (pooled expected calibration error 0.034) and its top-1 probability separates correct from incorrect predictions (pooled AUROC 0.820), though both degrade substantially on the weaker tasks. Under four cyclic rotations of the answer options, 37.4% of WMDP-Cyber items receive different answers; a control using byte-identical repeated calls attributes most of this to option order rather than run-to-run variation. Averaging probabilities across rotations improves WMDP-Cyber accuracy by 3.8 percentage points, and applying it only to low-confidence items recovers most of that gain at well under the cost of averaging every item.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对一个商用非生成式 System-1 模型在 6,020 道生物安全相关多选题上做审计：校准总体尚可（pooled ECE 0.034，top-1 概率区分对错的 AUROC 0.820），但答案对选项顺序高度敏感——WMDP-Cyber 在四种循环换位下 37.4% 的题目答案改变，且字节级重复调用对照表明主因是选项顺序而非运行随机。跨顺序平均概率可将 WMDP-Cyber 准确率提高 3.8 个百分点，且只对低置信度题目做平均即可拿到大部分增益。
Motivation: 非生成式 System-1 模型推理成本远低于生成模型、适合嵌入大管线，但其在生物安全相关任务上的可靠性此前没有被系统检验，尤其是校准、选择性预测与答案顺序敏感性。
Method: 审计一个商用 System-1 模型，题目取自 WMDP、抗改写的 WMDP-Bio 变体以及 LAB-Bench 的六个子任务，共 6,020 道多选题；测量准确率、校准、错误检测、选择性预测，以及对答案选项呈现顺序的敏感性（四种循环换位），并用字节级完全相同的重复调用作为对照分离顺序效应与运行间波动。
Result: 准确率强烈依赖任务；正确解读厂商不确定性字段后 pooled ECE 为 0.034，top-1 概率区分正确与错误预测的 pooled AUROC 为 0.820，但两者在较弱任务上明显退化。四种循环换位下 37.4% 的 WMDP-Cyber 题目得到不同答案，字节相同重复调用的对照显示大部分归因于选项顺序而非运行间变化。跨换位平均概率使 WMDP-Cyber 准确率提升 3.8 个百分点，且仅对低置信度题目施加即可在远低于全量平均的成本下收回大部分增益。
Conclusion: System-1 模型在生物安全基准上校准尚可但顺序不稳定是主要风险来源，按置信度选择性地做换位平均即可低成本恢复大部分收益。

papers.title: LensDesigner: A Self-Improving Agent for Optical Lens Design
papers.abstract_en: Optical lens design is a complex, non-convex optimization challenge that relies heavily on human experience and intuition. Existing optimized-based automatic lens design methods struggle to navigate this vast parameter space without meticulous manual tuning. In this paper, we present LensDesigner, an autonomous agent framework that mirrors the problem-solving workflow of expert opticians. To overcome the initial cold start problem, we construct LensLib100K, an extensive optical lens library, and employ Optics-Aware Retrieval to supply physically valid structural seeds. Within an interactive physical simulation environment, the agent executes macroscopic orchestration while receiving immediate optical feedback. Furthermore, we introduce a continuous self-evolving mechanism guided by a curriculum agent. By iteratively solving design tasks with progressively increasing difficulty, the agent autonomously extracts, accumulates, and reuses design heuristics, effectively evolving its optical lens design expertise over time. At the evaluation level, we introduce LensArena, a standardized evaluation benchmark comprising $120$ diverse optical design tasks, covering extreme configurations. Extensive experiments on this benchmark demonstrate that LensDesigner significantly outperforms publicly available baseline algorithms, achieving superior success rates and optimization efficiency. We hope this work sheds light on the emerging field of intelligent optics. The code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LensDesigner 是光学镜头设计的自主 agent 框架，用 LensLib100K 与 Optics-Aware Retrieval 提供物理可行的结构种子解决冷启动，在交互式物理仿真环境中做宏观编排并接收即时光学反馈，再由 curriculum agent 驱动持续自进化、积累可复用的设计启发式。在含 120 个覆盖极端构型的光学设计任务的 LensArena 基准上，其成功率与优化效率显著优于公开基线算法。
Motivation: 光学镜头设计是非凸优化问题，高度依赖专家经验与直觉；基于优化的自动设计方法在巨大参数空间中需要精细人工调参才能推进。
Method: 构建大规模光学镜头库 LensLib100K，用 Optics-Aware Retrieval 检索物理可行的结构种子以度过冷启动；agent 在交互式物理仿真环境中执行宏观编排并获得即时光学反馈；引入由 curriculum agent 引导的持续自进化机制，按难度递增迭代解题，自主抽取、积累并复用设计启发式。
Result: 提出标准化评测基准 LensArena，含 120 个多样化光学设计任务并覆盖极端构型；在该基准上 LensDesigner 显著优于公开可用的基线算法，取得更高的成功率与优化效率。
Conclusion: 模仿专家光学设计师工作流、配合检索种子与课程式自进化的 agent 框架，能在无人工精细调参的情况下提升光学镜头设计的成功率与优化效率。

papers.title: Predicting Transmembrane Protein Topology from 3D Structure
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel approach to infer protein topology using the state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN), SchNet. The model is trained on the same dataset used to develop the recent DeepTMHMM model with 5-fold cross-validation. Unlike the conventional approaches based on using only the protein sequences or the $α$-carbons as features, we have decoded our classifier in this way, so all atom-level embeddings are used. Without applying any pre-trained weight, the final results have shown great potential that GNNs can be used for topological predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用图神经网络 SchNet 直接从 3D 结构预测跨膜蛋白拓扑，训练数据与 DeepTMHMM 相同，采用 5 折交叉验证，且不加载任何预训练权重。与只用蛋白序列或 α-碳特征的常规做法不同，该解码方式让全部原子级嵌入参与分类，结果显示 GNN 在拓扑预测上具有潜力。
Motivation: 常规跨膜蛋白拓扑预测只依赖蛋白序列或 α-碳坐标，丢弃了 3D 结构中原子级几何信息，需要一种能直接吃全原子结构的预测方式。
Method: 以 SchNet 图神经网络为核心构建分类器，输入蛋白 3D 结构的原子级表征，解码时使用全部原子级嵌入而非仅序列或 α-碳特征；在 DeepTMHMM 所用的同一数据集上训练，采用 5 折交叉验证，且不使用任何预训练权重。
Result: 在与 DeepTMHMM 相同的数据集上以 5 折交叉验证、无预训练权重的设置下，最终结果显示 GNN 用于拓扑预测具有很大潜力。
Conclusion: 不依赖预训练权重、直接基于全原子嵌入的 GNN 可以用于跨膜蛋白拓扑预测，说明 3D 结构的原子级信息足以支撑该任务。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 不依赖预训练权重、直接基于全原子嵌入的 GNN 可以用于跨膜蛋白拓扑预测，说明 3D 结构的原子级信息足以支撑该任务。

papers.title: Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification for fMRI Functional Connectivity via Simulation-Based Inference
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing fMRI scan duration and spatial resolution is critical for experimental design, yet traditional correlation-based approaches cannot quantify uncertainty or disentangle scanner measurement noise from true neural variability across subjects. Without principled uncertainty bounds, researchers cannot know whether a protocol is long enough to reliably estimate connectivity, or whether between-subject differences reflect biological variation or noise. We present a Bayesian framework modeling BOLD dynamics as coupled Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes, using Sequential Neural Posterior Estimation to obtain connectivity posteriors while accounting for frequency-independent measurement noise across the BOLD spectrum. Applied to N = 28 healthy controls (55 scans) at 7T using a functional network atlas (65 DMN regions), the framework quantifies uncertainty across its sources: scanner noise, subject variability, and acquisition length. Spatial analysis identifies a mean of 46 voxels per ROI, roughly half of typical region sizes, as sufficient to achieve 90% of asymptotic precision. At the single-subject level, 7T reaches its within-session precision plateau in approximately 7 minutes versus 10 minutes for 3T, a 40% reduction in required scan time, providing the first direct, model-based quantification of the scan-time advantage conferred by higher field strength. At the population level, 3T requires roughly 37 times more per-subject scan time than 7T for the pooled curves to converge, confirming a consistent advantage of higher field strength at every timescale. Together these findings provide concrete, scanner-specific guidance for protocol optimization, with direct implications for reducing acquisition costs and improving the reliability of connectivity-based clinical biomarkers. We provide code enabling researchers to derive these bounds from their own data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 BOLD 动态建模为耦合 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程，用 Sequential Neural Posterior Estimation 给 fMRI 功能连接做贝叶斯后验，从而把扫描仪测量噪声与真实神经变异分开并给出不确定度。在 7T、N=28 名健康对照（55 次扫描、65 个 DMN 区域）上，单被试约 7 分钟即达 7T 会话内精度平台（3T 需 10 分钟，扫描时间减少 40%）；群体层面 3T 需约 37 倍的单被试扫描时间才能让合并曲线收敛。
Motivation: 基于相关系数的传统连接估计无法量化不确定度，也无法把扫描仪测量噪声与被试间真实神经变异分离，研究者因此无法判断扫描时长与空间分辨率是否足以可靠估计连接。
Method: 将 BOLD 动态表示为耦合 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程，用 Sequential Neural Posterior Estimation (SNPE) 推断连接后验，并在全 BOLD 频谱上显式建模频率无关的测量噪声；框架分别分解扫描仪噪声、被试变异与采集时长三类不确定度来源，并开源可让研究者在自有数据上推导这些界。
Result: 在 N=28 名健康对照、55 次 7T 扫描、65 个 DMN 区域的功能网络图谱上：空间分析给出每个 ROI 平均 46 个体素（约为典型区域大小的一半）即可达到渐近精度的 90%；单被试 7T 约 7 分钟达到会话内精度平台，3T 需 10 分钟，所需扫描时间减少 40%；群体层面 3T 需约 37 倍于 7T 的单被试扫描时间才能使合并曲线收敛。
Conclusion: 高场强在所有时间尺度上一致占优，该框架给出按扫描仪定制的协议优化量化依据，可直接用于降低采集成本并提升基于连接的临床生物标志物可靠性。

papers.title: WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning. We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model. To address this issue, we propose World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT), which learns a compact generative trajectory latent space by transferring information from a frozen pretrained driving world model without modifying the world model itself. Rather than directly generating raw waypoints, WALT maps them into compact representations through a dual-branch trajectory autoencoder and transfers semantic knowledge from the frozen visual world model into this trajectory space, encouraging the learned action representation to capture scene-level cues relevant to future motion and planning. Beyond our proposed formulation, we systematically study latent learning based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) and feature alignment following Representation Alignment (REPA) to investigate how trajectory-only representation learning affects downstream planning. We evaluate WALT on the NAVSIM benchmarks. Relative to the raw-waypoint baseline, WALT improves PDMS from 89.4 to 89.8 on NAVSIMv1 and EPDMS from 87.3 to 87.9 on NAVSIMv2 while reducing trajectory planner FLOPs by 30.5%. These results suggest that preserving world representations while extracting action-relevant information provides an effective interface for world-model-based trajectory planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WALT 把原始 waypoints 编码进紧凑的轨迹隐空间，并从冻结的预训练驾驶世界模型迁移语义，使规划器在保留世界表征的同时只读取与动作相关的线索。在 NAVSIM 上相对 raw-waypoint 基线，NAVSIMv1 PDMS 从 89.4 升到 89.8、NAVSIMv2 EPDMS 从 87.3 升到 87.9，同时轨迹规划器 FLOPs 降低 30.5%。
Motivation: 驾驶世界模型的视觉预测准确并不自动转化为有效的轨迹规划，瓶颈在于视觉世界状态与原始几何轨迹之间的表征错配，规划器难以利用世界模型中与动作相关的语义。
Method: 提出 World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT)：双分支轨迹自编码器 (dual-branch trajectory autoencoder) 把 waypoints 映射为紧凑表示，再从不作修改的冻结预训练驾驶世界模型向该轨迹空间迁移语义；同时系统研究基于 JEPA 的隐空间学习与基于 REPA 的特征对齐，考察纯轨迹表征学习如何影响下游规划。
Result: 在 NAVSIM 基准上，相对 raw-waypoint 基线：NAVSIMv1 PDMS 由 89.4 提升至 89.8，NAVSIMv2 EPDMS 由 87.3 提升至 87.9，轨迹规划器 FLOPs 降低 30.5%。
Conclusion: 在提取动作相关信息的同时保留世界表征，是世界模型驱动轨迹规划的有效接口；隐空间轨迹表示还能在小幅提升 PDMS/EPDMS 的同时显著削减规划器计算量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ProCAP: Probabilistic Cross-Attentive Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained vision-language models such as CLIP can recognize new categories via prompting, but they often struggle when labeled data are scarce or the test distribution shifts. Prompt learning adapts only a small set of parameters while keeping the backbone frozen, yet many existing multimodal prompt learners couple the visual and textual branches weakly and can be brittle in low-shot regimes. We propose ProCAP, a probabilistic cross-attentive prompt learning framework that improves cross-modal interaction and training stability without updating any CLIP weights: it learns both visual and textual prompt tokens and links them through stacked bidirectional multi-head cross-attention so the two branches refine each other across prompt depth. To reduce overfitting under limited supervision, we parameterize prompt tokens with Gaussian means and variances and regularize them with lightweight KL and L2 penalties, and we further add a compact symmetric InfoNCE head that aligns cross-attended image features with class-level text representations in a shared low-dimensional space. Across few-shot base-to-novel generalization on 11 datasets, cross-dataset transfer, and domain generalization on ImageNet shift benchmarks, ProCAP achieves strong aggregate base-to-novel performance and competitive transfer performance while keeping the CLIP backbone unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProCAP 在冻结 CLIP 的前提下做概率化跨注意力提示学习：同时学视觉与文本 prompt token，用堆叠双向多头 cross-attention 互 refine，并把 prompt 参数化为高斯均值与方差、加 KL 与 L2 正则及对称 InfoNCE 头。在 11 个数据集的 few-shot base-to-novel、跨数据集迁移与 ImageNet shift 域泛化上取得强的 base-to-novel 聚合表现与有竞争力的迁移表现，CLIP 权重全程不变。
Motivation: CLIP 等视觉-语言模型靠 prompt 识别新类时，在标注稀缺与测试分布偏移下容易失效；现有提示学习方法对视觉与文本分支耦合弱，在 low-shot 场景下脆弱、易过拟合。
Method: ProCAP 同时学习视觉与文本 prompt token，通过堆叠的双向多头 cross-attention 让两分支随 prompt 深度互相精化；prompt token 以高斯均值和方差参数化，配轻量 KL 与 L2 惩罚抑制少样本过拟合；再加一个紧凑的对称 InfoNCE 头，把跨注意力后的图像特征与类级文本表示对齐到共享低维空间，全程不更新任何 CLIP 权重。
Result: 在 11 个数据集的 few-shot base-to-novel 泛化、跨数据集迁移，以及 ImageNet shift 域泛化基准上，ProCAP 取得强的 base-to-novel 聚合表现与有竞争力的迁移表现，且 CLIP backbone 保持不变。
Conclusion: 把 prompt token 做成带概率参数化的跨注意力双向耦合，可以在完全冻结 CLIP 的条件下同时改善跨模态交互与训练稳定性，从而在低样本与分布偏移下站得住。

papers.title: Improving Molecular-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining using Deep-Learning-based Morphology Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in image-based profiling techniques have enabled the collection of high-volume cell morphology data, allowing new molecular embedding models to learn from the experimental phenotypic perturbations of a molecule in a cell. Previously, we developed Molecule-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining (MoCoP), a strategy for aligning small molecule embeddings to morphology fingerprints extracted through CellProfiler. The resulting molecular representation showed transferable performance for quantitative structure--activity relationship (QSAR) prediction tasks. Here, we extend the method by using a deep-learning-based cell image encoding pipeline to extract more feature-rich morphology profiles and align them to the molecular embeddings through contrastive learning. The new embeddings encode more accurate information on how molecules perturb cell morphology and enable improvements for QSAR predictions through either fixed-embedding linear probes or fully flexible fine-tuning. Morphology retrieval performance scales log-linearly with training data size, suggesting continued improvements as larger datasets become available. The improved MoCoP v2 also achieves superior performance on toxicity prediction and competitive results on ADME and activity benchmarks, when compared with existing molecular embedding models that use both cell morphology and transcriptomic data during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoCoP v2 把原先基于 CellProfiler 的形态指纹换成深度学习细胞图像编码管线，用对比学习把小分子嵌入与更丰富的 morphology profiles 对齐。新嵌入更准确编码分子对细胞形态的扰动，QSAR 预测在固定嵌入线性探针与全量微调两种方式下均提升，形态检索性能随训练数据量呈 log-linear 增长。
Motivation: CellProfiler 手工特征限制了形态指纹的信息量，分子嵌入与表型扰动的对齐不够紧，QSAR、毒性与 ADME 等下游预测受限。
Method: 用深度学习细胞图像编码管线提取形态 profile，替代原 MoCoP 的 CellProfiler 指纹，通过对比学习 (contrastive learning) 将其与小分子嵌入对齐；下游用固定嵌入线性探针或完全微调做 QSAR 预测。
Result: 新嵌入使 QSAR 预测在两种下游方式下均改进；形态检索性能随训练数据规模呈 log-linear 扩展；MoCoP v2 在毒性预测上优于现有同时使用细胞形态与转录组数据训练的分子嵌入模型，在 ADME 与活性基准上结果具竞争力。
Conclusion: 更深的图像编码管线加对比学习能产出更准确的分子-形态对齐嵌入，且数据规模还能继续带来检索与预测收益。

papers.title: Actively Resolving Contextual Uncertainty for Underspecified Tasks in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models provide robots with the ability to interpret natural language and reason about environmental context, yet most language-conditioned policies assume that goals are well-specified and that task-relevant information is provided upfront via a prior map. Operating in unfamiliar environments with underspecified tasks entails high contextual uncertainty: the robot must jointly infer what constitutes task success, what constitutes relevant information, and where (or whether) that information exists. We address these limitations via CLUE (Closed-Loop contextual Uncertainty rEsolution), a framework for actively resolving contextual uncertainty given underspecified tasks in natural language. CLUE uses an LLM-derived policy to hypothesize task-relevant concepts and potential plans. It then uses a language-embedded map, which is constructed online, to ground these hypotheses into actions. The policy sequentially evaluates hypotheses via closed-loop environment interaction and refines its plans as it gathers new information. We deploy CLUE on a Boston Dynamics Spot across three real indoor and outdoor environments spanning 15 tasks that require object disambiguation, functional inference, and occlusion reasoning. CLUE achieves a success rate within 7 percentage points of an oracle policy and outperforms an LLM-enabled planner without closed-loop feedback by a 4x margin. Supporting experiments demonstrate that simply building and then querying a language-enriched map is insufficient to resolve complex contextual planning tasks; these approaches achieve roughly one third the success rate of CLUE while requiring over 10x more VLM tokens. We provide additional information at https://zacravichandran.github.io/CLUE.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Symposium of Robotics Research (ISRR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLUE 让机器人在欠规约自然语言任务下主动消解上下文不确定性：LLM 生成任务相关概念与计划假设，用在线构建的 language-embedded map 把假设落地为动作，再通过闭环交互逐条验证并改写计划。在 Boston Dynamics Spot 上跨 3 个室内外环境的 15 个任务中，成功率距 oracle 策略仅 7 个百分点，比无闭环反馈的 LLM planner 高 4 倍。
Motivation: 语言条件策略默认目标已明确、任务相关信息已随先验地图给出；在陌生环境执行欠规约任务时，机器人须同时推断成功标准、相关信息及其是否存在，现有方法无法处理这种上下文不确定性。
Method: CLUE (Closed-Loop contextual Uncertainty rEsolution)：LLM 派生策略提出任务相关概念与潜在计划假设，用在线构建的 language-embedded map 将假设 grounding 成动作，随后在闭环环境交互中顺序评估假设并随新信息修正计划。

papers.title: Fake News Theories: Harnessing Disciplinary Insights for Computational Modeling, Detection, and Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Disinformation research has produced increasingly accurate automated fake-news detectors, but many systems remain difficult to interpret and are weakly connected to established theories of persuasion, credibility, and human judgment. In this paper, we develop a theory-informed computational framework that translates cross-disciplinary theories of fake news into measurable features for automated detection and explanation through statistical techniques and large language models. To that end, we conduct a structured cross-disciplinary review of theories from social sciences, psychology, economics, among other disciplines that reveal how fake news persuades and spreads, thereby establishing a broad theoretical foundation for computational modeling. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that theory-derived features are predictive and provide interpretable, theory-referenced diagnostic signals. Multi-feature models generally outperform individual features, although gains among the strongest small feature combinations are modest. Our work highlights the value of interdisciplinary perspectives in building robust and interpretable fake news detection systems, advancing the foundation for human-centered approaches in combating disinformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把社会科学、心理学、经济学等学科的假新闻理论翻译成可计算特征，用统计方法与 LLM 做自动检测与解释。基准数据集上理论衍生特征具有预测力，多特征模型普遍优于单特征，但最强的小特征组合之间增益有限。
Motivation: 自动假新闻检测器准确率在提升，但多数系统难以解释，且与说服、可信度、人类判断等既有理论脱节。
Method: 先做结构化的跨学科理论综述，把假新闻如何说服与传播的理论转成可测特征；再用统计技术与大语言模型基于这些特征做检测与解释，并在基准数据集上做实验。
Result: 基准数据集实验显示理论衍生特征具有预测性，并提供可解释、可回指理论的诊断信号；多特征模型普遍优于单特征，但最强的小特征组合之间增益不大。
Conclusion: 跨学科理论转成的特征能同时支撑检测性能与可解释性，是构建以人为本的假新闻对抗系统的有效路径。

papers.title: Understanding Perturbed Parameter Ensemble Sensitivities Using A Contrastive Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Perturbed parameter ensembles (PPEs) reveal how physics parameters affect climate simulations, but interpreting parameter sensitivities across multivariate, spatially structured outputs remains challenging, particularly when calibrating models against observations. We develop an explainable contrastive learning model that maps 5 monthly cloud and radiation fields into a shared representation space. We train the model on the fields of two 100-member Community Atmosphere Model version 6 (CAM6) PPEs, spanning 34 parameters, that only differ in the warm rain microphysics scheme: KK2000, the default bulk microphysics scheme, and TAU-ML, a neural network emulator of a bin microphysics scheme. The learned representations separates two PPEs with over 94\% linear classification accuracy while preserving the seasonal variability and ensemble spread due to parameter perturbations. In the shared representation space, the representations of satellite observations occupy the same low-dimensional manifold as the PPEs but are displaced from them most strongly during boreal spring and autumn. TAU-ML PPE has a lower distance to observations compared to KK2000 in the representation space. Integrated Gradients attributions highlights the contributions in subtropical low-cloud regions, Northern and Southern Hemisphere storm track regions, and tropical convection regions to differences between PPEs and observations. Regional attributions correlate most strongly with parameters associated with cloud microphysics, boundary layer turbulence, and deep convection. These results demonstrate that explainable representations of climate fields can attribute model differences to specific variables, regions, seasons, and physical parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可解释对比学习把 5 个云与辐射月平均场映射到共享表示空间，能以超过 94% 的线性分类准确率区分两套各 100 名成员、共 34 个参数的 CAM6 扰动参数集合 (PPE)，且保留参数扰动带来的季节变率与集合离散度。卫星观测落在与 PPE 同一低维流形上，但在北半球春季和秋季偏离最远；TAU-ML 方案到观测的距离小于默认 KK2000。
Motivation: PPE 能揭示物理参数对气候模拟的影响，但多变量、空间结构化的输出使参数敏感度难以解读，尤其在用观测校准模式时。
Method: 训练一个可解释对比学习模型，把 5 个云和辐射月场压入共享表示空间；训练数据为两套 100 成员 CAM6 PPE，覆盖 34 个参数，二者仅暖雨微物理方案不同（默认体微物理 KK2000 与 bin 微物理的神经网络仿真器 TAU-ML）。再用线性分类器检验表示的可分性，用 Integrated Gradients 做归因，并把卫星观测投影到同一空间。
Result: 学到的表示以超过 94% 的线性分类准确率区分两套 PPE，同时保留季节变率与集合离散度；卫星观测与 PPE 占据同一低维流形，但在北半球春、秋季偏离最强；表示空间中 TAU-ML 到观测的距离小于 KK2000。Integrated Gradients 把差异归因到副热带低云区、南北半球风暴轴与热带对流区，区域归因与云微物理、边界层湍流和深对流相关参数的相关性最强。
Conclusion: 气候场的可解释表示能把模式差异归因到具体变量、区域、季节和物理参数，并显示 TAU-ML 在表示空间中比 KK2000 更接近卫星观测。

papers.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Location Selection using Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI)
papers.abstract_en: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption increases, ensuring efficient and well-distributed charging infrastructure has become a critical challenge. While many EV charging station location problem (CSLP) studies focus on minimizing costs or travel distance, it is crucial to consider the surrounding geospatial characteristics of existing stations that influence operational performance. This study proposes a geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI)-based framework that integrates high-dimensional EV-related geospatial data, including EV usage, land-use, population, and traffic attributes. We incorporate a variational autoencoder (VAE) and a graph convolutional network (GCN) into the model to capture similarities among existing charging stations, and to identify suitable locations for future stations. The VAE compresses high-dimensional EV input data into a low-dimensional latent space, and the GCN uses this latent representation to predict locations suitable for charging stations. Using real-world data from Bryan-College Station, Texas, US, the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an F1-score of 0.87 in distinguishing existing station locations from non-station locations. The model also identifies 27 additional candidate locations that show geospatial characteristics similar to those of existing stations, based on a similarity score. We further evaluate two policy implementation scenarios, maximizing geospatial similarity and minimizing total travel distance, each yielding different outcomes aligned with distinct strategic objectives. The findings highlight the importance of incorporating spatial context into CSLP and provide valuable insights for future EV infrastructure planning, promoting both efficiency and accessibility in the rapidly growing electric mobility sector.
papers.comment: Electric vehicle charging station; Location optimization; Geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI); Variational autoencoder (VAE); Graph convolutional networks (GCN); Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 GeoAI 的充电站选址 (CSLP) 框架：用 VAE 把 EV 用量、土地利用、人口、交通等高维地理特征压到低维潜空间，再用 GCN 学习现有站点间的相似性并预测合适选址。在 Bryan-College Station, Texas 真实数据上区分现有站点与非站点的 F1 达 0.87，超过 SOTA 基线，并按相似度给出 27 个新增候选点。
Motivation: 现有 CSLP 研究多只最小化成本或出行距离，忽略既有站点周边影响运营表现的地理空间特征，选址与周边环境的空间上下文脱节。
Method: 整合 EV 用量、土地利用、人口、交通等高维地理数据；VAE 将其压缩为低维潜空间表示，GCN 基于该表示预测适合作为充电站的位置，并用相似度分数评估候选点与现有站点的地理特征接近程度。
Result: 在 Bryan-College Station, Texas, US 真实数据上，区分现有站点与非站点的 F1-score 为 0.87，优于 state-of-the-art 基线；识别出 27 个与现有站点地理特征相似的新增候选位置；另评估最大化地理相似度与最小化总出行距离两种政策实施情景，各自产生不同结果。
Conclusion: 把空间上下文纳入 CSLP 能同时服务效率与可达性两类目标，但最大化地理相似度与最小化出行距离两种策略导向不同选址结果，需按战略目标取舍。

papers.title: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, and propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying to any experience that decomposes into elements and relations among them. We also present \trellis/, an implementation of this theory, and illustrate its application to learning context-free grammars, which we adopt as a testbed because they involve both concept-like and chunk-like elements. In addition, we report experimental results on three synthetic grammars that demonstrate the system's ability to represent syntactic knowledge, use it to parse and generate sentences, and learn compositional structures from sample parses. We conclude by discussing related work on concepts and chunks, along with directions for future research in the area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把认知心理学中几乎分离的两类文献——概念/类别形成与 chunk（熟悉元素模式）——统一到 Cobweb 的扩展理论里，并给出实现系统 	rellis/。该理论对模态不做任何承诺，只要经验能分解为元素及其关系即可适用；在三个人工文法 (synthetic grammars) 上，系统能表示句法知识、用它做句子解析与生成，并从样本解析中学习组合结构。
Motivation: 概念与 chunk 两条研究线几乎互不往来，阻碍了统一认知理论的建立。
Method: 回顾 Cobweb 这一分类与概念形成的计算理论，提出纳入 chunk 及其习得的扩展理论；实现为系统 	rellis/，以 context-free grammars 作为测试床，因为文法同时包含概念式与 chunk 式成分。
Result: 在三个人工文法上报告实验：系统能表示句法知识，能用该知识解析 (parse) 与生成 (generate) 句子，并能从样本解析中学习组合结构。
Conclusion: 概念与 chunk 可以在一个对模态无承诺的统一理论中共同处理，且该理论可由 	rellis/ 实现并在文法学习任务上运作。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Value Control in LLMs via Causal Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where responses must reflect multiple, potentially interacting social norms and human values. Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to training-based alignment by modifying internal activations at inference time. However, prior human-value steering methods have largely considered values in isolation, while direct composition of multiple directions relies on fixed intervention strengths that cannot respond to the model's evolving internal state. Motivated by this key observation, we introduce AIMES, a framework for adaptive multi-value activation steering. AIMES constructs layer-specific bipolar directions for moral-foundation values and uses intermediate-layer vocabulary readouts as online observers. An observer-guided controller then adapts the strength of each requested value intervention at every decoding step based on its current observed state, without training a separate value-state estimator. Across multiple instruction-tuned model families, value combinations, and intervention depths, we find that multi-value controllability varies across both value combinations and intervention locations. Compared with fixed joint steering and prompt-based steering, AIMES shows depth-dependent advantages that are broadly supported across two independent evaluators, with some variation in the precise depth at which specific control effects emerge. These advantages come with smaller realized activation-space interventions than fixed-joint steering and comparable response quality. Overall, our results suggest that online observer feedback can provide lightweight, state-aware adaptation for single-pass multi-value steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIMES：为道德基础价值构造逐层双向 (bipolar) 激活方向，用中间层词表读出作在线观测器，由观测器引导的控制器在每个解码步自适应调节各价值干预强度。对比固定联合转向与提示词转向，AIMES 在多个指令微调模型族、价值组合与干预深度上呈现深度依赖的优势，且实际激活空间干预量更小、回复质量相当。
Motivation: 现有人类价值激活转向 (activation steering) 多把价值孤立处理，直接叠加多个方向又依赖固定干预强度，无法随模型内部状态变化调整。
Method: AIMES 为道德基础 (moral-foundation) 价值构造 layer-specific 双向方向，取中间层词表读出作为在线观测器，由 observer-guided 控制器在每个解码步按当前观测状态调节各价值干预强度，无需另训价值状态估计器；在多个指令微调模型族、价值组合与干预深度上与固定联合转向和提示词转向对比，由两个独立评估器评判。
Result: 多价值可控性随价值组合与干预位置而变；相对固定联合转向与提示词转向，AIMES 的优势呈深度依赖，且被两个独立评估器广泛支持，具体起效深度在不同控制效果间存在差异；其实际激活空间干预量小于固定联合转向，回复质量与之相当。
Conclusion: 在线观测器反馈可以在单次前向的多价值转向中提供轻量、状态感知的自适应调节，但优势依赖干预深度，具体深度因控制效果而异。

papers.title: What Improves Multimodal Misinformation Detection? Answers from a Large-Scale Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal misinformation is increasingly crafted to look convincing by pairing a textual claim with an image that appears to "prove" it. Yet in practice, building effective detectors often hinges on a small set of design choices that are rarely examined in a controlled way. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale study of multimodal design choices for misinformation detection with over 3,375 experiments- spanning three benchmark datasets and a broad range of pre-trained vision and language backbones. Through systematic comparisons and targeted robustness analyses, we distill practical guidance on which design choices help, when do they fail silently, and what aspects of the pipeline most strongly shape model behavior, answering 4 key Research Questions (RQs). We aim to provide a reliable foundation for designing stronger and more dependable multimodal misinformation detection systems, thus contributing to the broader research community.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Tenth Widening NLP Workshop (WiNLP), co-located with EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对多模态虚假信息检测的设计选择做大规模受控实证：3,375+ 次实验、覆盖三个基准数据集与多种预训练视觉/语言 backbone，系统比较并做针对性鲁棒性分析，回答 4 个研究问题，给出哪些设计选择真正有效、哪些会静默失效、流水线哪部分最影响模型行为的实践指引。
Motivation: 多模态虚假信息常以文本配图伪装成证据，而检测器效果往往取决于少数未被受控检验的设计选择，缺乏可复现的比较来判断哪些选择真正起作用。
Method: 在三个基准数据集上，对广泛的预训练视觉与语言 backbone 组合做大规模受控比较（累计 3,375+ 次实验），辅以针对性鲁棒性分析，围绕 4 个研究问题提炼设计选择的影响。
Result: 共完成超过 3,375 次实验，覆盖三个 benchmark 数据集与大范围视觉/语言预训练 backbone，通过系统比较与鲁棒性分析回答 4 个 RQ，产出哪些设计选择有效、何时静默失败、流水线哪部分最塑造模型行为的结论。
Conclusion: 多模态虚假信息检测的强弱主要由少数可系统检验的设计选择决定，作者据此给出可依赖的构建指引，作为该社区的设计基础。

papers.title: A Synthetic Ground-Truth Framework for the Evaluation of Explainable AI Methods
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods is a challenging task due to the lack of reliable evaluation procedures and, in particular, the absence of ground truth explanations. In the literature, existing evaluation approaches typically assess explanations by measuring their fidelity with respect to the predictions of a black-box model. However, such evaluation strategies only quantify the degree to which an explanation reproduces the model's output, without ensuring that the explanation correctly reflects the underlying decision process. As a consequence, different explanations may achieve similar fidelity scores while providing inconsistent or misleading interpretations of the model behavior. In this paper, we propose a framework for the evaluation of XAI methods based on synthetic ground truth. The proposed approach relies on controlled interventions to generate synthetic datasets in which the importance of input components can be determined by design. This enables the construction of ground truth explanations that are directly aligned with the behavior of the model under analysis. The framework is instantiated across three data domains, namely binary images, tabular data, and time series, allowing a comprehensive assessment of explanation methods in heterogeneous settings. Experimental results obtained by evaluating nine widely used XAI methods show significant limitations in current techniques and highlight the importance of synthetic, intervention-based benchmarks for a reliable assessment of explanation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于合成真值的 XAI 评测框架：用受控干预生成输入成分重要性由设计决定的数据集，从而构造与模型行为对齐的真值解释，替代只衡量保真度 (fidelity) 的评测。在二值图像、表格、时间序列三个领域实例化并评测九种常用 XAI 方法，结果显示现有解释方法存在显著局限。
Motivation: 现有 XAI 评测只度量解释对黑盒预测的保真度，无法保证解释反映真实决策过程，导致不同解释可拿到相近分数却给出互相矛盾甚至误导性的解读。
Method: 通过受控干预 (controlled interventions) 生成合成数据集，使各输入成分的重要性在设计阶段已知，据此构造与被分析模型行为直接对齐的真值解释；框架在二值图像、表格数据、时间序列三个领域分别实例化。
Result: 在三个数据域上评测九种广泛使用的 XAI 方法，结果显示当前技术存在显著局限，并凸显基于干预的合成基准对可靠评估解释质量的必要性。
Conclusion: 仅靠保真度不足以判断解释质量，合成、干预式的真值基准才是可靠评测 XAI 的前提。

papers.title: An End-to-End Pipeline for Causal ML with Continuous Treatments: An Application to Financial Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an end-to-end causal machine learning (ML) pipeline designed for real-world applications with continuous treatments. The proposed framework consists of six sequential steps: dimensionality reduction, causal identification, positivity assumption violation handling, estimation, refutation and evaluation, and policy optimization. We introduce practical contributions not currently available in existing causal ML toolkits, specifically: (1) a method for detecting and quantifying positivity violations in continuous treatment settings (2) a novel, scalable two-stage dimensionality reduction framework tailored for causal inference with high-dimensional data; (3) the adaptation of sensitivity analysis and estimation methods originally designed for binary treatments to the continuous treatment space and (4) an end-to-end integration of these components into a modular, reproducible workflow. These innovations address real-world challenges in causal inference that are often not covered in theoretical frameworks but frequently encountered in industrial applications. The methodology is validated with a synthetic dataset inspired in a real-world financial debt collection use case, however its design can be applied to analogous problems across different industries. Results demonstrate that the proposed methodology offers a more computationally efficient approach and produces less biased estimates compared to standard methods for problems with continuous treatment and high-dimensional data. A fully functional GitHub repository with documented code and numbered notebooks is made available ensuring reproducibility and practical implementation. The pipeline presented is intended to contribute to closing the gap between academic approaches and practical application in industry contexts where causal ML can be highly beneficial such as the financial sector.
papers.comment: Oral presentation at the 3rd Workshop on Causal Inference and Machine Learning in Practice, KDD 2025, Toronto. Code: https://github.com/javiermoralh/causal-pipeline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向连续处理 (continuous treatment) 的端到端因果 ML 流水线，含六步：降维、因果识别、positivity 违背处理、估计、refutation 与评估、策略优化。在受金融催收启发的合成数据上，比标准方法计算效率更高、估计偏差更小。
Motivation: 工业场景中连续处理与高维数据常同时出现，positivity 违背、敏感性分析等现实问题在现有因果 ML 工具包和理论框架中覆盖不足。
Method: 六步模块化流水线：(1) 检测并量化连续处理下的 positivity 违背；(2) 面向因果推断的两阶段可扩展降维；(3) 将原本为二值处理设计的敏感性分析与估计方法迁移到连续处理空间；(4) 整合为可复现工作流，附 GitHub 代码与编号 notebook。
Result: 在受真实金融债务催收用例启发的合成数据集上验证：相比连续处理与高维数据的标准方法，计算效率更高、估计偏差更小。
Conclusion: 该流水线旨在弥合学术方法与产业落地之间的差距，可推广到金融等行业的类似连续处理决策问题。

papers.title: CSCWD: Cross-Scale Channel-wise Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Tiny Object Detection on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Real-time tiny object detection in aerial imagery is constrained by the weak spatial evidence of very small objects and the loss of high-resolution detail in lightweight detectors. This study presents Cross-Scale Channel-wise Knowledge Distillation (CSCWD), a training-time framework that transfers high-resolution spatial representations from a YOLO11m-P2 teacher to a compact YOLO11n student without altering the student's inference architecture. Unlike conventional same-scale feature distillation, CSCWD transfers supervision from teacher P2 to student P3 after feature alignment while retaining same-scale distillation at deeper pyramid levels. Under the unified seven-sequence Drone-vs-Bird validation protocol, YOLO11n-CSCWD achieves 50.17% mean average precision at an intersection-over-union threshold of 0.5 (mAP@0.5) and 59.73% recall, improving the matched CA-YOLO11n baseline by 2.92 percentage points in mAP@0.5 and 3.55 points in recall. Cross-scale alignment further increases mAP@0.5 by 2.09 points over the corresponding same-scale channel-wise distillation configuration. In zero-shot evaluation on DUT-Anti-UAV, mAP@0.5 increases from 48.29% to 50.06% without target-domain fine-tuning. This domain was included because its challenging small targets make low-latency, computationally efficient detection particularly relevant. On Raspberry Pi 5 using NCNN-FP16 at 640x640 resolution, the 2.58-million-parameter student achieves 50.32% mAP@0.5 at 82.32 ms mean wall-clock latency, or 12.15 frames per second, while retaining essentially the same runtime and memory requirements as the matched baseline. The results support cross-scale distillation for improving tiny-target detection without increasing inference-time model complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CSCWD 把 YOLO11m-P2 教师的高分辨率空间表征跨尺度蒸馏到 YOLO11n 学生：教师 P2 对齐后监督学生 P3，深层金字塔仍保留同尺度通道蒸馏，推理架构不变。在 Drone-vs-Bird 七序列协议上 mAP@0.5 达 50.17%、recall 59.73%，比 CA-YOLO11n 基线高 2.92 和 3.55 个百分点；跨尺度对齐比同尺度通道蒸馏再高 2.09 点。
Motivation: 航拍图像中极小目标空间证据弱，轻量检测器在下采样时丢失高分辨率细节，导致微小目标检出率低；需要在不增加推理开销的前提下提升 tiny object 检出。
Method: 训练时知识蒸馏框架：以 YOLO11m-P2 为教师、YOLO11n 为学生，特征对齐后将教师 P2 的监督跨尺度转移到学生 P3，同时在更深金字塔层级保留同尺度通道级蒸馏；学生推理结构与运行时不变，部署用 Raspberry Pi 5 + NCNN-FP16、640x640。
Result: Drone-vs-Bird 七序列验证协议下 YOLO11n-CSCWD mAP@0.5 50.17%、recall 59.73%，较 CA-YOLO11n 基线分别 +2.92、+3.55 个百分点；跨尺度对齐较同尺度通道蒸馏配置 mAP@0.5 再 +2.09 点。DUT-Anti-UAV 零样本 mAP@0.5 由 48.29% 升至 50.06%（无目标域微调）。Raspberry Pi 5 NCNN-FP16 640x640 下 2.58M 参数学生模型 mAP@0.5 50.32%、平均延迟 82.32 ms（12.15 FPS），运行时与内存开销与匹配基线基本相同。
Conclusion: 跨尺度蒸馏可在不增加推理期模型复杂度的情况下提升 tiny target 检出，并具备跨域零样本迁移能力；收益来自把教师高分辨率 P2 特征对齐到学生更粗的 P3 层。

papers.title: LiTe-GS: Oracle-Efficient Next Best View Selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Selecting informative camera views is critical for efficient training and adaptive refinement in 3D Gaussian Splatting, where each observation significantly influences model parameters. However, information-driven view-selection strategies can require repeated evaluations of expensive information-gain oracles as the number of candidate views increases. We propose LiTe-GS, an oracle-efficient method for next best view selection in 3D Gaussian Splatting. LiTe-GS reduces the number of information-oracle evaluations by performing randomized subset evaluation of candidate views rather than exhaustively scoring the full candidate pool. The resulting approach achieves expected $O(M\log(1/ε))$ oracle complexity with respect to the number of candidate views $M$, independent of the selection cardinality $K$, while providing an explicit trade-off between oracle efficiency and approximation quality through $ε$. We provide theoretical guarantees on oracle complexity and approximation performance under the proposed selection scheme. Experiments on Blender and Mip-NeRF 360 demonstrate that LiTe-GS maintains reconstruction quality comparable to Fisher-information-based baselines while substantially reducing the number of Fisher-oracle evaluations across different acquisition settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiTe-GS 用随机子集评估替代对全部候选视角的穷举打分，把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的 next best view 选择做成 oracle 高效方法：期望 oracle 复杂度为 O(M log(1/ε))，只依赖候选视角数 M、与选择基数 K 无关，并通过 ε 显式权衡 oracle 效率与近似质量。在 Blender 与 Mip-NeRF 360 上，重建质量与基于 Fisher 信息的基线相当，同时大幅减少 Fisher-oracle 评估次数。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 中信息驱动的视角选择要反复调用昂贵的信息增益 oracle，候选视角数一多，穷举打分开销就成为自适应精化的瓶颈。
Method: LiTe-GS 对候选视角做随机子集评估 (randomized subset evaluation) 而非全池打分，用参数 ε 控制 oracle 效率与近似质量的权衡；作者给出该选择方案下 oracle 复杂度与近似性能的理论保证，并在不同 acquisition 设置下与 Fisher-information 基线比较。
Result: 期望 oracle 复杂度 O(M log(1/ε))，关于候选视角数 M，且与选择基数 K 无关；在 Blender 和 Mip-NeRF 360 上，重建质量与 Fisher-information 基线相当，同时在不同 acquisition 设置下显著减少 Fisher-oracle 评估次数。
Conclusion: 随机子集评估足以替代穷举视角打分：在保持与 Fisher 基线相当的重建质量前提下，把 3DGS 的 next best view 选择开销降到只随 M 和 ε 增长、与 K 无关。

papers.title: From Weak Data to Strong Policy: Q-Targets Enable Provable In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Existing in-context reinforcement learning methods mainly pretrain Transformers with supervised behavior-prediction objectives. This enables task inference from context, but makes the learned policy strongly depend on the quality of offline actions: when trajectories are weak or suboptimal, imitation itself becomes a biased learning signal. We propose Q-Target Pretrained Transformers (QTPT), which keeps the context-conditioned Transformer architecture but replaces behavior cloning with a Bellman-style Q-target objective. QTPT therefore learns to use rewards and transitions in the context to estimate action values, rather than simply imitating the behavior policy. We theoretically analyze QTPT in stochastic linear bandits and finite-horizon MDPs, showing stronger robustness to data quality than supervised pretraining. Empirically, QTPT improves over supervised behavior prediction on controlled RL benchmarks with random or suboptimal data, and we examine extensions to D4RL Kitchen and AntMaze. Supplementary experiments evaluate backbone robustness, meta-RL comparisons, task-coherent context, and unsupported-action value overestimation. These comparisons distinguish the benefits of Q-target pretraining from the remaining limitations of offline coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QTPT 把 in-context RL 的预训练目标从监督行为预测换成 Bellman 式 Q-target，使 Transformer 用上下文中的奖励与转移估计动作价值而非模仿行为策略。在随机线性 bandit 与有限时域 MDP 的理论分析中，它对数据质量的鲁棒性强于监督预训练；在含随机或次优数据的受控 RL benchmark 上改进，并扩展到 D4RL Kitchen 与 AntMaze。
Motivation: 现有 in-context RL 用监督行为预测预训练 Transformer，任务推断依赖离线动作质量；轨迹弱或次优时，模仿本身成为有偏的学习信号。
Method: 保留 context-conditioned Transformer 架构，把 behavior cloning 替换为 Bellman 式 Q-target 目标，从上下文中的奖励与转移学习估计动作价值；理论在 stochastic linear bandit 与 finite-horizon MDP 中分析，实验含 backbone 稳健性、meta-RL 对比、task-coherent context 与 unsupported-action 价值高估的补充检验。
Result: 理论显示对数据质量的鲁棒性强于监督预训练；在含随机或次优数据的受控 RL benchmark 上 QTPT 改进于 supervised behavior prediction，并检验了 D4RL Kitchen 与 AntMaze 上的扩展。
Conclusion: Q-target 预训练把学习信号从模仿偏差转为价值估计，因而在弱离线数据下更稳健；补充对比用于区分 Q-target 预训练的收益与离线覆盖度仍存的局限。

papers.title: Stealth Apart, Harm Together: Skill Cascading Attacks on Skill-Based Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: A skill is a modular package of natural-language instructions, executable scripts, and reference resources that an agent can load at runtime to extend its capabilities for a specific task. Skill-based agent systems therefore enable flexible reuse of third-party capabilities, but the openness of this skill ecosystem also opens up a new attack surface. Prior work has focused on vulnerabilities within individual skills, but little attention has been paid to risks that arise from interactions across skills. In this paper, we introduce skill cascading attacks, a threat paradigm in which a malicious objective is distributed across multiple skills so that each modification looks benign in isolation, yet their combined execution is harmful. For instance, in a prescription-review pipeline, the first skill weakens signals of recently discontinued medications in the extracted history, the second downgrades the severity of any drug interaction tied to them, and the third suppresses the resulting low-priority alert in the final summary, so that a severe drug-interaction warning silently disappears before reaching the physician. To systematically study this safety blind spot, we develop SkillCascade, an automated multi-agent red-teaming framework, and release SkillCascade-Bench, a benchmark of 213 validated cascading test cases across multiple agent systems and domains. Across representative agents (e.g., OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex) and LLM backbones, cascaded interactions reliably induce harmful behaviors while evading existing per-skill scanners and runtime monitors. Our findings highlight a gap between component-level integrity and system-level safety, and call for defenses that reason over cross-skill interactions rather than individual skills in isolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 skill cascading attack：把一个恶意目标拆到多个 skill 里，每个改动单独看都无害，合起来执行才产生危害，并给出自动化多智能体红队框架 SkillCascade 与基准 SkillCascade-Bench（213 个经验证的级联测试用例）。在 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex 等代表性 agent 与多种 LLM backbone 上，级联交互稳定诱发有害行为，同时绕过现有 per-skill 扫描器与运行时监控。
Motivation: skill 生态开放可复用第三方能力，但既有工作只关注单个 skill 内部的漏洞，跨 skill 交互产生的组合风险无人研究，形成组件级完整性与系统级安全之间的缺口。
Method: 定义 skill cascading attack 威胁范式（恶意目标分布在多个 skill，单看良性、合起来有害），开发自动化多智能体红队框架 SkillCascade 系统性生成此类攻击，并构建 SkillCascade-Bench 基准，含 213 个跨多个 agent 系统与领域的已验证级联测试用例。
Result: 在 OpenClaw、Claude Code、Codex 等代表性 agent 及多种 LLM backbone 上，级联交互可靠地诱发有害行为，且规避现有 per-skill 扫描器与运行时监控；基准含 213 个经验证的级联测试用例。
Conclusion: 组件级完整性不等于系统级安全，防御必须推理跨 skill 交互而非逐个 skill 孤立检查。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DanLing NestedTensor: Composable Multi-Ragged Tensors for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Variable-size inputs are common in deep learning, but dense batching allocates a shared envelope and spends computation on padding. The cost multiplies across varying axes: an explicit pair state allocates $BN_{\max}^2$ positions instead of $\sum_i N_i^2$. Packing removes that waste, but composing packed operations still requires the logical axes and sample boundaries a flat buffer no longer exposes. We present DanLing NestedTensor, a PyTorch tensor abstraction that makes multi-ragged structure a property of the tensor itself. Packed values carry tensor-backed partitions and logical dimension order, so broadcasting creates ragged axes, feature transformations retain them, and reductions consume them. The same representation carries through autograd and both eager and compiled execution. On an A100, the geometric-mean speedup over same-mode padding is 2.74$\times$ eager and 3.39$\times$ compiled across four BERT scales, and 1.97$\times$ eager across four FCN backbones. A four-block Pairformer-style workload runs 2.40-4.32$\times$ faster than a padded reference using native PyTorch kernels across square length regimes in eager execution, with peak allocation falling from 38.08 to 5.41 GiB on its high-variation batch. The tensor interface lets model code built from its supported operators compose efficient variable-size computation without managing offsets at any call site. Code will be released publicly upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DanLing NestedTensor 把多变长 (multi-ragged) 结构做成 PyTorch 张量自身的属性：打包值携带张量化的分区与逻辑维序，使广播生成 ragged 轴、特征变换保留它、归约消费它，并贯通 autograd 与 eager/编译两种执行。在 A100 上，相对同模式 padding 的几何平均加速为 eager 2.74×、编译 3.39×（四个 BERT 尺度），FCN backbone eager 1.97×；四块 Pairformer 式负载比 padded 参考快 2.40–4.32×，高变化 batch 峰值显存从 38.08 GiB 降到 5.41 GiB。
Motivation: 变长输入在深度学习中普遍，dense batching 为共享包络付出 padding 计算；显式 pair 状态在多变轴上按 $BN_{\max}^2$ 分配而非 $\sum_i N_i^2$。packing 消除了浪费，但扁平 buffer 不再暴露逻辑轴与样本边界，packed 算子的组合因此困难。
Method: PyTorch 张量抽象：打包值携带 tensor-backed partitions 与逻辑维序，广播产生 ragged 轴、特征变换保留、归约消费；同一表示贯穿 autograd、eager 与编译执行。评测用四个 BERT 尺度、四个 FCN backbone，以及四块 Pairformer 式负载对照 padded 参考（原生 PyTorch kernel）。
Result: A100 上相对同模式 padding 的几何平均加速：eager 2.74×、编译 3.39×（四个 BERT 尺度），FCN eager 1.97×。四块 Pairformer 式负载在各 square 长度区间 eager 下比 padded 参考快 2.40–4.32×，高变化 batch 峰值分配从 38.08 GiB 降至 5.41 GiB。
Conclusion: 把 ragged 结构内建进张量接口，模型代码用受支持算子即可组合出高效的变长计算，无需在调用点手工管理 offsets；代码将于发表时公开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Cost-Aware Best-LLM Identification using Dueling Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by the problem of identifying the best model from a collection of large language models (LLMs) with heterogeneous querying costs, we formulate and analyse a variant of the multi-armed bandit (MAB) with (i) dueling feedback, where pairwise comparisons between model responses provide robust preference signals, and (ii) heterogeneous sampling costs, reflecting the differing costs of querying different LLMs. Assuming the existence of a Condorcet winner, a condition we empirically validate across multiple real-world datasets, we propose a Track-and-Stop style algorithm for best-arm identification with prescribed confidence. We prove that the algorithm almost surely achieves the asymptotically optimal cost as the error tends to zero. Finally, we extensively evaluate our approach on both synthetic and real-world instances, demonstrating consistent improvements over classical cost-unaware algorithms and their cost-aware extensions.
papers.comment: We propose a cost-aware dueling bandit algorithm for best arm identification, prove its asymptotic optimality, and demonstrate its effectiveness in reliably identifying the best LLM with a minimum cost Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「从多个异构查询成本的 LLM 中选出最优模型」形式化为带 dueling 反馈与异构采样成本的多臂老虎机 (MAB)，提出 Track-and-Stop 风格的最优臂识别算法，在假设存在 Condorcet winner 的前提下证明误差趋于零时几乎必然达到渐近最优成本。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法相对经典 cost-unaware 算法及其 cost-aware 扩展表现出一致改进。
Motivation: 不同 LLM 的单次查询成本差异很大，逐一等量试错来挑最优模型代价高；现有最优臂识别算法多不显式建模采样成本，无法在给定置信度下最小化总查询开销。
Method: 将问题建为带 dueling 反馈（成对比较给出偏好信号）与异构采样成本的 MAB 变体，假设 Condorcet winner 存在（作者在多个真实数据集上做了经验验证），并提出 Track-and-Stop 风格的算法以在给定置信度下识别最优臂。
Result: 在合成实例与多个真实数据集上评测，相对经典 cost-unaware 算法及其 cost-aware 扩展取得一致改进；理论结果为误差趋于零时算法几乎必然达到渐近最优成本。
Conclusion: 把查询成本显式纳入带 dueling 反馈的最优臂识别，可以在保证置信度的同时最小化挑选最优 LLM 的总成本；Condorcet winner 假设被作者在真实数据上经验验证。

papers.title: AlphaEarth distinguishes cities but compresses urban variation
papers.abstract_en: Cities differ in built form, land cover and development history, complicating comparison across places and time. Satellite foundation models map Earth's surface onto common numerical representations. Yet the tasks and targets used to shape them typically do not focus on cities: globally consistent labels for urban function do not exist, and many datasets - especially land cover and land use classifications - collapse the built environment into few classes. Here we audit the representation, focusing on AlphaEarth but with broader applicability to other Earth embeddings, by probing the geometry and geography of embeddings for 1,000 urban areas in 162 countries. We find that cities occupy a shifted but overlapping region on the hypersphere, 62.7° from the global mean direction, and continent and climate predict 24.3% of variation among the mean directions of urban centres in excluded countries. Inside cities, degrees of urbanisation carry 8.9% of the variation, and what they leave holds shared directions whose local orientation varies, not one universal axis of urbanisation. Retained variation is itself unequal: dispersion within urban centres is 14.1% greater per standard deviation of national development, even after adjusting for population, land area and continent. Further controls suggest cities in developing countries present less contrast in vegetation and texture, and dispersion follows that contrast: full adjustment for it leaves at most 6.4% of the gradient. Annually, a city's representation moves nearly eight times more than redrawing its own pixels explains, and contracts where the 2022 loss of Sentinel-1B removed a pass direction. AlphaEarth's representations therefore support comparison across regions, while the differences between its annual layers are not yet validated for comparison over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 AlphaEarth 卫星基础模型在 162 个国家 1,000 个城市上的嵌入做审计：城市在超球面上整体偏移但相互重叠，距全球均值方向 62.7°；城市内部不存在单一“城市化轴”，年度层间变化主要不是像素重绘能解释的，因此该表征可做跨区域比较，但尚不能直接用于跨时间比较。
Motivation: 城市功能缺乏全球一致标签，土地覆盖/利用分类把建成环境压成少数类别，导致卫星基础模型的表征是否真能支撑跨城市、跨年份比较没有检验手段。
Method: 以 AlphaEarth 为主要对象、结论可推广到其他 Earth embedding，探测 162 个国家 1,000 个城市嵌入在超球面上的几何与地理结构：比较城市均值方向与全球均值、用被排除国家检验大陆/气候的解释力、分解 degrees of urbanisation 与国家发展梯度的方差，并对植被与纹理对比度做逐步控制，另追踪单个城市逐年表征位移与 Sentinel-1B 2022 年丢失导致的过境方向变化。
Result: 城市均值方向距全球均值 62.7°；大陆与气候可预测被排除国家城市中心均值方向间 24.3% 的变异；degrees of urbanisation 携带 8.9% 变异；城市中心内部离散度随国家标准差上升 14.1%（已控制人口、面积、大陆），对植被与纹理对比度完全调整后该梯度至多剩 6.4%；单个城市年度表征移动幅度接近其自身像素重绘所解释幅度的八倍，并在 2022 年 Sentinel-1B 丢失过境方向处收缩。
Conclusion: AlphaEarth 表征支持跨区域城市比较，但其年度层之间的差异尚未经过时间比较的验证，不能直接当作跨年变化信号使用。

papers.title: Strategic Self-Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Self-consistency has become a popular technique for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models by generating multiple reasoning paths and selecting the final answer through a majority vote. However, because model providers typically charge users in proportion to the number of reasoning paths generated, they have a financial incentive to artificially increase the path count. In this work, we show that an unfaithful provider can exploit this incentive using a simple, efficient algorithm while avoiding detection by an auditor: by generating and strategically reordering additional reasoning paths, the algorithm makes every path appear necessary to reach the majority. To validate our algorithm, we conduct experiments with multiple instruct models from the Llama and Qwen families, as well as reasoning models distilled from DeepSeek-R1, on benchmark datasets spanning mathematics, science, and question answering. Our results suggest that the distribution of additional reasoning paths generated by our algorithm is heavy-tailed and that substantial capacity to overcharge remains even under the best possible audit designed to keep the false-positive rate below $α= 0.1$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对按推理路径数计费的 self-consistency，提出一个可被不诚实服务商执行的重排算法：额外生成并策略性重排推理路径，使每条路径看起来都对多数投票不可或缺，从而在审计下仍能超额计费。在 Llama、Qwen 系列 instruct 模型与 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏推理模型、覆盖数学科学问答的基准上，额外路径分布呈重尾，即使审计把假阳性率控制在 α=0.1 仍有可观超额计费空间。
Motivation: 模型服务商按生成的推理路径数收费，存在人为抬高路径数的经济动机，而现有审计难以区分必要路径与灌水路径。
Method: 给出一个简单高效算法：生成额外推理路径并策略性重排，使多数投票的结果看起来必须依赖每条路径；在 Llama、Qwen instruct 模型与 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏推理模型上验证，并设计保持假阳性率低于 α=0.1 的最优审计进行对抗。
Result: 实验覆盖数学、科学与问答基准；算法生成的额外推理路径分布为重尾，在把假阳性率压到 α=0.1 的最优审计下仍保留 substantial 的超额计费能力。
Conclusion: 按路径数计费的 self-consistency 在对抗性服务商面前不可审计地脆弱：重排即可让灌水路径伪装成必要路径，且重尾分布使最优审计也难以拦截。

papers.title: Adaptive multi-resolution Gaussian processes: Scalable exact inference with naturally data-sparse covariance matrices
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian processes constitute a cornerstone of probabilistic machine learning, yet scaling them to large datasets typically forces a trade-off between computational efficiency and model fidelity. This work bridges this gap by presenting an adaptive multi-resolution Gaussian process framework that is both scalable and exact. Our key innovation is constructing a naturally data-sparse covariance matrix with adaptive multi-resolution basis functions. These basis functions are directly anchored to samples, eliminating the need for auxiliary points. By shrinking the support domains of multi-resolution basis, the matrix block sizes are limited, guaranteeing sparsity. The inverse of the data-sparse covariance matrix is computed exactly and efficiently via the sparse Cholesky inverse algorithm. To further improve predictive uncertainties, we construct an augmented basis function. Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrate that our model achieves exact inference with $\mathcal{O}(n \log^2 n)$ training cost and $\mathcal{O}(\log^d n)$ prediction cost, establishing a principled framework for scalable and high-fidelity Gaussian process regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自适应多分辨率高斯过程框架：基函数直接锚定样本、通过收缩支撑域限制矩阵块大小，构造天然数据稀疏的协方差矩阵，再用稀疏 Cholesky 逆算法精确求逆。理论与数值实验给出精确推断的训练代价 O(n log² n)、预测代价 O(log^d n)，并用增广基函数改进预测不确定性。
Motivation: 高斯过程扩展到大规模数据通常要在计算效率与模型保真度之间取舍，近似推断又会损失不确定性质量；需要一种既可扩展又保持精确推断的构造。
Method: 用自适应多分辨率基函数构造天然数据稀疏的协方差矩阵，基函数直接锚定样本、无需辅助点；收缩多分辨率基的支撑域以限制矩阵块尺寸保证稀疏性；用稀疏 Cholesky 逆算法精确高效地求矩阵逆，并构造增广基函数改进预测不确定性。
Result: 理论分析与数值实验表明模型实现精确推断，训练代价 O(n log² n)，预测代价 O(log^d n)。
Conclusion: 通过数据稀疏协方差与精确稀疏求逆的组合，高斯过程回归可以同时做到可扩展与高保真，无需在效率与精确性之间取舍。

papers.title: Coding Agents Aren't Enough! Evaluating an Enterprise Security Brain for Agentic Cloud Investigations
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-security investigation is dominated by population tasks: which identities can read a data store, how many resources fail a control, which assets are reachable from another account. These resolve against a complete inventory, not a named object. A partial answer to one is not a partial result. It is a different result. General-purpose coding agents can now be given read-only cloud credentials and asked to investigate directly, which raises the question of what a purpose-built security context layer still contributes. We evaluate the Sola Security Brain, a security intelligence layer whose relational substrate is resolved offline and whose security logic is evaluated against it at query time, against Claude Code operating the same live AWS environment through a read-only CLI, over 28 cloud-security investigation tasks. Answers are scored by a blinded, tier-weighted, grounding-gated relative recall over the joint claim pool, averaged across three independent grading draws. The Sola Security Brain reaches 0.693 coverage against 0.387, a gap of 0.306 that varied by $\pm 0.018$ across three grading draws, or a relative gain of $79.2\%$. It leads on 25 of 28 tasks from the weaker model tier, at $17.7\times$ lower reasoning cost per task and $31.6\times$ lower cost per unit of coverage. Beyond the aggregate, we describe an answer-level pattern we term sample-and-generalise: under a turn budget the live agent enumerates a fraction of a large population, asserts an unhedged universal negative, and discloses the sample size only in answer metadata rather than in the answer. In one task it reported that no bucket policies exist after checking four bucket families, in a sweep that sampled 40 of roughly 5{,}000 buckets, in an account where 65 buckets carry a wildcard-principal read grant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 28 项云安全调查任务上，把离线解析的关系型安全情报层 Sola Security Brain 与在同一只读 AWS 环境上操作的 Claude Code 对比：前者相对召回覆盖 0.693，后者 0.387，差距 0.306（±0.018），相对提升 79.2%，且单任务推理成本低 17.7 倍。论文还命名了通用 coding agent 的 sample-and-generalise 失效模式：在轮次预算下只枚举总体的一小部分就断言无条件全称否定。
Motivation: 云安全调查多为总体型问题（哪些身份能读某数据存储、多少资源不合规），需要对完整清单求解；通用 coding agent 拿只读凭证直接查，容易把抽样结果当成全称结论，而专用安全上下文层的增量价值尚不清楚。
Method: 评测 Sola Security Brain（关系型基底离线解析、安全逻辑在查询时对其求值）对比 Claude Code 通过只读 CLI 操作同一实时 AWS 环境，共 28 项云安全调查任务；打分用盲评、按层级加权、以 grounding 为门槛的联合声明池相对召回 (relative recall)，三次独立评分取平均。
Result: Sola Security Brain 覆盖 0.693 对 0.387，差 0.306，三次评分间波动 ±0.018，相对增益 79.2%；在较弱模型层级上 28 项任务中领先 25 项，单任务推理成本低 17.7 倍、单位覆盖成本低 31.6 倍。样例任务中 agent 只抽查约 5,000 个 bucket 中的 40 个便声称不存在 bucket policy，而该账户实际有 65 个 bucket 带通配符主体读授权。
Conclusion: 面向安全的离线关系型上下文层在总体型云调查任务上显著优于通用 coding agent 直连实时云 API，且成本更低；通用 agent 在轮次预算下会把抽样外推成无条件否定，并把样本量藏在答案元数据里。

papers.title: Learning coarse-step dynamics and internal mechanical response with graph networks
papers.abstract_en: Modern sensing records the motion of physical systems, but often leaves the forces and mechanical response governing that motion unobserved. Inferring these quantities from discretely sampled trajectories is especially difficult at coarse time scales, when mechanical response evolves between observations and interactions propagate across the system. Here we introduce Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN, a graph neural network-based framework that combines two structures inspired by computational mechanics. First, a semi-implicit update inspired by the Newmark-\b{eta} method uses learned momentum fluxes and matrix-valued response operators to advance the state over each observed interval. Second, an operator-weighted virtual hub provides system-wide coupling through a sparse set of connections. The learned quantities thus determine the predicted motion and remain accessible for mechanical analysis. Across a deformable beam, human motion and protein dynamics, Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN supports long-horizon prediction at time steps for which explicit learned simulators deteriorate. Without force, moment or constitutive relation supervision, forces inferred from walking kinematics track independently derived hip and knee joint moments, while response operators learned on the beam recover the relative spatial and directional structure of its finite-element stiffness tangent. Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN therefore links coarse-step prediction to the inference of mechanical quantities that were never observed during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Newmark-η-DGN 用图网络在粗时间步上同时推进系统状态并推断未观测的力与力学响应：半隐式 Newmark-η 式更新以学习到的动量通量和矩阵值响应算子跨观测区间积分状态，算子加权虚拟枢纽提供全系统耦合。在可变形梁、人体运动与蛋白动力学上支持长时程预测（显式学习型模拟器在此步长下退化），且无需力、力矩或本构监督，从步行动力学推断的力能跟踪独立导出的髋、膝关节力矩，梁上学到的响应算子恢复有限元刚度切线的相对空间与方向结构。
Motivation: 传感数据通常只记录运动轨迹，力与力学响应不可观测；在粗时间步上力学响应在两次观测之间演化、相互作用又跨系统传播，从离散轨迹反推这些量尤其困难。
Method: Newmark-η-DGN：图神经网络结合两个受计算力学启发的结构——(1) 受 Newmark-η 方法启发的半隐式更新，用学习到的动量通量与矩阵值响应算子在每个观测区间内推进状态；(2) 算子加权虚拟枢纽 (operator-weighted virtual hub)，通过稀疏连接实现全系统耦合。学习量直接决定预测运动且可用于力学分析，训练不使用力、力矩或本构关系监督。
Result: 在可变形梁、人体运动、蛋白动力学三个系统上，支持显式学习型模拟器会退化的粗时间步长的长时程预测；无监督条件下，由步行动力学推断的力与独立导出的髋、膝关节力矩一致；梁上学到的响应算子恢复其有限元刚度切线的相对空间与方向结构。
Conclusion: 粗步长预测与未观测力学量推断可以由同一套学习到的动量通量和响应算子联结，学习出的力学量在训练中从未被观测也仍可用于力学分析。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.method: Newmark-η-DGN：图神经网络结合两个受计算力学启发的结构——(1) 受 Newmark-η 方法启发的半隐式更新，用学习到的动量通量与矩阵值响应算子在每个观测区间内推进状态；(2) 算子加权虚拟枢纽 (operator-weighted virtual hub)，通过稀疏连接实现全系统耦合。学习量直接决定预测运动且可用于力学分析，训练不使用力、力矩或本构关系监督。
summary_sections.result: 在可变形梁、人体运动、蛋白动力学三个系统上，支持显式学习型模拟器会退化的粗时间步长的长时程预测；无监督条件下，由步行动力学推断的力与独立导出的髋、膝关节力矩一致；梁上学到的响应算子恢复其有限元刚度切线的相对空间与方向结构。
summary_sections.conclusion: 粗步长预测与未观测力学量推断可以由同一套学习到的动量通量和响应算子联结，学习出的力学量在训练中从未被观测也仍可用于力学分析。

papers.title: Low-Rank Friction for Memory-Efficient Transformer Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: iKFAD is a recently proposed optimiser that replaces adaptive learning rates with adaptive friction in the momentum dynamics, yet performs as well as Adam. Its limitation is that the full friction tensor $ξ\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ carries the same $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ memory overhead per layer as Adam's second-moment buffer. Here we replace iKFAD's friction tensor $ξ$ with a rank-1 outer-product factorisation built from row and column momentum statistics, resulting in Rank-1 iKFAD (R-iKFAD). This reduces the friction memory footprint from $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ to $\mathcal{O}(m+n)$ per layer, which approximately halves iKFAD's total optimiser state. Despite this reduction, R-iKFAD maintains parity in performance with iKFAD: experiments on GPT2-Nano, TinyViT, DistilBERT and GPT2-S confirm that it matches or exceeds iKFAD while nearly halving the memory footprint and remaining comparably robust to hyperparameters. We analyse the continuous-time dynamics in two damping regimes. For linear damping ($γ>0$) we prove exponential convergence under strong convexity. For $γ=0$, the preferred option in our experiments, the friction is generated entirely from past momentum and switches off as the momentum vanishes, so geometric convergence cannot be shown. We nonetheless prove convergence to the minimiser, together with matching upper and lower bounds on the energy: of order $t^{-1}$ when the regularisation scale $ε_{\mathrm{stab}}$ is zero, and of order $t^{-1/2}$ when it is positive. To our knowledge this is the first convergence rate for a rank-1 factored optimiser in continuous time, and the first such result that does not require positive damping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 iKFAD 的全摩擦张量 ξ∈R^{m×n} 换成由行、列动量统计构成的 rank-1 外积分解，得到 R-iKFAD，每层摩擦内存从 O(mn) 降到 O(m+n)，约减半优化器总状态。在 GPT2-Nano、TinyViT、DistilBERT、GPT2-S 上性能匹配或超过 iKFAD，超参鲁棒性相当；γ=0 时证明收敛到极小点，能量界为 ε_stab=0 时 O(t^{-1})、ε_stab>0 时 O(t^{-1/2})。
Motivation: iKFAD 用动量上的自适应摩擦替代自适应学习率、性能与 Adam 相当，但其摩擦张量每层占用 O(mn) 内存，与 Adam 的二阶矩缓冲同量级，抵消了内存优势。
Method: 用由行、列动量统计构造的 rank-1 外积分解替换 iKFAD 的摩擦张量，得到 R-iKFAD；在 GPT2-Nano、TinyViT、DistilBERT、GPT2-S 上做训练实验，并对连续时间动力学分两个阻尼 regime 分析：线性阻尼 γ>0 与 γ=0（实验首选，摩擦完全由历史动量生成、随动量消失而关闭）。
Result: 摩擦内存从 O(mn) 降到 O(m+n) 每层，约减半 iKFAD 的优化器总状态；在 GPT2-Nano、TinyViT、DistilBERT、GPT2-S 上匹配或超过 iKFAD，超参鲁棒性相当。理论：γ>0 且强凸下证明指数收敛；γ=0 下证明收敛到极小点，能量上下界同阶，ε_stab=0 时为 O(t^{-1})，ε_stab>0 时为 O(t^{-1/2})。
Conclusion: rank-1 摩擦分解可在几乎不损失性能的前提下把优化器内存近似减半；作者称这是 rank-1 分解优化器在连续时间下的首个收敛速率，也是首个不依赖正阻尼的结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bridging LLM Agents and Data Spaces: An Architectural Mediation Approach using the Model Context Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Data Spaces enable sovereign and governed data sharing across organizational boundaries, but their integration with AI agents remains challenging due to mismatches between probabilistic language model interactions and policy-driven data infrastructures. This article presents an architectural mediation approach based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), implemented through the Eunomia Agent, to enable controlled interaction between large language model (LLM) agents and data space services. The proposed mediation layer translates data space capabilities into structured, schema-driven tools that AI agents can discover and invoke while preserving governance constraints. A prototype implementation validates end-to-end interaction across catalog discovery, metadata retrieval, and data service invocation without modifying existing data space components. Results demonstrate that protocol-based mediation enables interoperable and standards-aligned integration of AI agents into data space ecosystems. The approach provides practical guidance for organizations seeking to introduce AI-driven automation into governed data-sharing environments while maintaining compliance, interoperability, and architectural separation of concerns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的架构中介层，通过 Eunomia Agent 把 Data Space 的能力翻译成 schema 驱动的结构化工具，让 LLM agent 可发现、可调用，同时保留治理约束。原型验证了目录发现、元数据检索、数据服务调用的端到端交互，且无需改动既有 Data Space 组件。
Motivation: Data Space 的策略驱动数据基础设施与概率性语言模型交互方式不匹配，导致 AI agent 难以接入跨组织的主权数据共享环境。
Method: 以 MCP 为协议基础实现中介层（Eunomia Agent），将 Data Space 能力转成 schema 驱动工具供 agent 发现与调用，在翻译过程中保留治理约束，并保持与既有组件的架构解耦。
Result: 原型实现验证了跨目录发现、元数据检索与数据服务调用的端到端交互，且不修改既有 Data Space 组件；结果表明基于协议的中介可实现与标准对齐、可互操作的 agent 接入。
Conclusion: 协议式中介可在不改动底层数据空间的前提下，把 LLM agent 合规地接入受治理的数据共享生态，兼顾互操作性与关注点分离。

papers.title: GAUDI: Geometry-Aware Diffusion for Calibrated Air-Quality Time-Series Imputation
papers.abstract_en: Air-quality sensor outages often create contiguous missing blocks, where side information useful for isolated missingness may be less reliable. We study a block-specific, GAUDI-aligned conditional diffusion imputer that retains temporal and feature processing, visible-value and mask conditioning, variable identity, and diffusion-step information, while suppressing absolute time-position side embeddings. On ItalyAir (13 variables, length-32 windows, nominal 50% block missingness; three archived seeds), this feature-side configuration achieves RMSE 0.340, versus 0.355 for full context and 0.355 for local CSDI. The experiment isolates a geometry-aware conditioning effect under block missingness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对空气质量传感器连续块状缺失（block missingness）中侧信息不可靠的问题，提出 GAUDI 对齐的块状专用条件扩散插补器：保留时间与特征处理、可见值与掩码条件、变量身份和扩散步信息，同时抑制绝对时间位置侧嵌入。在 ItalyAir（13 变量、长度 32 窗口、名义 50% 块缺失、三个存档随机种子）上 RMSE 0.340，优于完整上下文 0.355 与 local CSDI 0.355。
Motivation: 空气质量传感器中断常形成连续缺失块，此时对孤立缺失有效的侧信息（如绝对时间位置嵌入）反而不可靠，需要块状专用的条件设计。
Method: 块状专用、GAUDI 对齐的条件扩散插补器：保留时间与特征处理、可见值与掩码条件、变量身份与扩散步信息，抑制绝对时间位置侧嵌入；在 ItalyAir 上以 13 变量、长度 32 窗口、名义 50% 块缺失、三个存档种子做对照，隔离几何感知条件的作用。
Result: ItalyAir 块缺失 50% 设置下 RMSE 0.340，对比 full context 0.355 与 local CSDI 0.355（三个存档种子）。
Conclusion: 在块状缺失下抑制绝对时间位置侧嵌入、改用几何感知条件能降低插补误差，该实验隔离出这一条件化效应。

papers.title: Parameters vs. Context: TRACE Fine-Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates knowledge obsolescence and factual hallucination in large language models by introducing external context. However, when retrieved knowledge conflicts with the model's internal parametric knowledge, the model may either blindly follow misleading context or incorrectly rely on parametric knowledge, leading to unreliable responses. To address this issue, this paper proposes TRACE (Debate-TRace and Answer-Completeness rEgularized fine-tuning), a robust fine-tuning framework for RAG under knowledge conflicts. First, we propose a fine-tuning method that leverages multi-agent debate traces to extract correct candidates, incorrect candidates, and answer-shift patterns, providing fine-grained supervision for reliable knowledge-source selection. In addition, we design an answer completeness regularization mechanism to alleviate empty, overly short, and prematurely terminated responses via answer-tail token reinforcement and premature termination suppression. The fine-tuning objective combines correct-answer supervision, incorrect-candidate suppression, answer-tail token reinforcement, and premature termination suppression, enabling the model to use reliable external context, resist misleading or irrelevant retrieved content, and fall back to parametric knowledge when retrieved evidence is unreliable. Experiments across multiple knowledge-conflict scenarios and datasets show that TRACE improves robustness against misleading retrieved knowledge and reduces incomplete answers. These results demonstrate that multi-agent debate traces and answer completeness regularization jointly enhance knowledge-source selection, conflict robustness, and answer quality in RAG models. Our code is available at https://github.com/PHD-lanyu/TRACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是面向检索增强生成 (RAG) 知识冲突的微调框架：用多智能体辩论轨迹 (multi-agent debate traces) 抽出正确候选、错误候选与答案迁移模式做细粒度监督，再加答案完整性正则抑制空答、过短答与提前终止。在多个知识冲突场景与数据集上，TRACE 提升了对误导性检索内容的鲁棒性并减少不完整回答。
Motivation: 检索到的知识与模型参数化知识冲突时，模型要么盲从误导上下文、要么错误依赖参数化知识，导致回答不可靠。
Method: TRACE 微调目标由四部分组成：正确答案监督、错误候选压制、answer-tail token 强化、提前终止抑制；监督信号来自多智能体辩论轨迹中抽取的正确候选、错误候选与答案迁移模式，使模型在检索证据不可靠时回退到参数化知识。
Result: 在多个知识冲突场景与数据集上，TRACE 提升了对误导性检索知识的鲁棒性并减少不完整回答（空答、过短答、提前终止）；代码发布于 github.com/PHD-lanyu/TRACE。
Conclusion: 多智能体辩论轨迹与答案完整性正则联合使用，可以同时改善 RAG 的知识源选择、冲突鲁棒性与答案质量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What Will Remain Human in Software Architecture? A Focus Group Report
papers.abstract_en: AI development agents are increasingly used to support and partially automate software architecture tasks. To explore how practitioners perceive this shift, specifically what changes, what remains, and what new responsibilities emerge, we conducted a focus group at the 31st European Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs, People, and Practices (EuroPLoP 2026). Twenty-two participants from industry and academia discussed current practices, trust and validation strategies, the boundaries of AI autonomy, governance challenges, and implications for education. Among others, we found broad consensus that architectural decision-making, accountability, and the authoring of architectural guardrails remain fundamentally human tasks. A central emergent concept was harness engineering: the discipline of building the system that governs AI-assisted system creation, comprising validation mechanisms, knowledge lay- ers, and company-specific standards. The participants agreed that criticality, understood as the combination of uncertainty and cost of change, serves as the universal criterion for calibrating human oversight. A further concern was cognitive debt: the progressive erosion of human understanding of the system when AI-assisted decisions are accepted without full intellectual engagement. In this report, we present the findings of the focus group and describe directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EuroPLoP 2026 的一场焦点小组中，22 位业界与学界参与者就 AI 开发代理接管软件架构任务达成共识：架构决策、问责与架构护栏 (guardrails) 的编写仍是人的工作。提出两个新概念——harness engineering（构建治理 AI 辅助系统创建之体系的学科，含验证机制、知识层与公司标准）与 cognitive debt（未经充分智力投入即接受 AI 决策导致的系统理解侵蚀），并以 criticality（不确定性与变更成本之和）作为校准人类监督的通用判据。
Motivation: AI 开发代理正部分自动化软件架构任务，实践者需要弄清哪些职责会变、哪些不变、又会新生哪些职责，以及如何据此校准人类监督。
Method: 在第 31 届欧洲程序模式语言会议 (EuroPLoP 2026) 组织一场焦点小组，22 位来自业界和学界的参与者讨论当前实践、信任与验证策略、AI 自治边界、治理挑战及教育影响；报告归纳共识与新出现的概念。
Result: 22 名参与者达成广泛共识：架构决策、问责、架构护栏编写仍是根本上的人类任务；提炼出 harness engineering 与 cognitive debt 两个概念，并就以 criticality（不确定性 + 变更成本）作为监督校准准则取得一致意见。
Conclusion: AI 代理不会取代架构师的核心判断与问责，人的角色转向构建治理 AI 辅助创建的体系，并按 criticality 高低分配监督力度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Even Sharper Bounds for Transductive Learning and Its Applications
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sharper Transductive Local Complexity (STLC), a localized complexity method for transductive learning under uniform sampling without replacement. The construction starts from a Bernstein-type concentration inequality for the supremum of the test--train empirical process. Its proof uses the modified log-Sobolev inequality for the swap walk and a two-parameter entropy closure. A peeling argument with a surrogate localization functional then gives excess-risk bounds with the same fixed-point and confidence terms as the classical inductive local Rademacher-complexity bounds, without the additional logarithmic confidence factor in earlier transductive results. For realizable learning over a binary class of VC dimension $\dVC$, with training size $m$, test size $u$, and $u\ge m\ge\dVC$, STLC yields $\cO\{\dVC\log(me/\dVC)/m\}$. This matches the standard inductive rate and, when $m\ge9$, is within a logarithmic factor of the transductive minimax lower bound of order $\dVC/m$. For transductive kernel learning, STLC gives a spectrum-adaptive excess-risk bound without the multiplicative imbalance factors appearing in the earlier local-complexity bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sharper Transductive Local Complexity (STLC)，在无放回均匀抽样的 transductive 学习中给出与经典 inductive local Rademacher 界同形的 excess-risk 界，去掉早期 transductive 结果中额外的对数置信因子。可实现情形下界为 O{dVC·log(me/dVC)/m}，m≥9 时距 dVC/m 阶的 transductive minimax 下界仅差一个对数因子；核学习上给出无乘性不平衡因子的谱自适应界。
Motivation: 早期 transductive 局部复杂度界带有额外的对数置信因子与乘性不平衡因子，且未与 inductive 固定点形式对齐，使 transductive 学习的样本复杂度分析落后于经典 inductive 结果。
Method: 从 test–train 经验过程上确界的 Bernstein 型集中不等式出发，证明用 swap walk 的 modified log-Sobolev 不等式与双参数熵闭合；再用带替代局部化泛函的 peeling 论证导出 excess-risk 界，框架针对无放回均匀抽样。
Result: 可实现学习、二元假设类 VC 维 dVC、训练规模 m、测试规模 u 且 u≥m≥dVC 时，STLC 给出 O{dVC·log(me/dVC)/m}，与标准 inductive 速率一致；m≥9 时与阶为 dVC/m 的 transductive minimax 下界只差一个对数因子。核学习情形给出无乘性不平衡因子的谱自适应 excess-risk 界。
Conclusion: transductive 学习可以达到与 inductive 局部复杂度界相同的固定点与置信项形式，且在可实现情形逼近 minimax 下界；核学习中无需再付不平衡因子。
