papers.title: LightMIS: Ultra-Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Without a Stage-Wise Decoder
papers.abstract_en: We present LightMIS, a scalable family of ultra-lightweight convolutional networks for 2D binary medical image segmentation without a learned stage-wise decoder. LightMIS aligns the outputs of a five-level encoder to a common resolution using Scale-Aligned Projection blocks, aggregates them once, and refines the fused representation with an Adaptive Fusion Cascade. The cascade combines Adaptive Kernel Fusion with the proposed Progressive Receptive Fusion module, which uses temporary channel expansion, complementary depthwise receptive fields, and progressive cross-branch information transfer. We evaluate LightMIS-T, LightMIS-S, and LightMIS using five-fold cross-validation under a common nnU-Net v2.3.1 protocol on DRIVE, Kvasir-SEG, DSB18, BUSI, ISIC-2017, and ISIC-2018. Full LightMIS contains 0.131 M parameters and requires 0.575 GFLOPs for a $3\times256\times256$ input, achieving modality-macro Dice and IoU scores of 86.71% and 78.99%, respectively. Mobile U-ViT obtains 86.75% Dice and 79.07% IoU, so the observed differences are 0.04 and 0.08 percentage points. Relative to Mobile U-ViT, nnWNet, and nnU-Net, LightMIS reduces parameter count by 90.58$-$99.61% and GFLOPs by 82.54$-$96.14%. On an Arm Mali-G52 MC2 GPU, all LightMIS variants achieve full GPU delegation, with median delegated latency ranging from 53.31 ms for LightMIS-T to 138.31 ms for LightMIS. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off and on-device execution feasibility for the evaluated tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/AndreiiArhire/LightMIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LightMIS 是一族超轻量 2D 二值医学图像分割卷积网络，不用学习式分阶段解码器：用 Scale-Aligned Projection 把五级编码器输出对齐到同一分辨率，仅聚合一次，再用 Adaptive Fusion Cascade（Adaptive Kernel Fusion + Progressive Receptive Fusion）精修。在 nnU-Net v2.3.1 统一协议下五折交叉验证，0.131 M 参数、0.575 GFLOPs 达到 modality-macro Dice 86.71%、IoU 78.99%，与 Mobile U-ViT 差距仅 0.04 和 0.08 个百分点。
Motivation: 医学图像分割的高精度模型参数量与计算量大，难以在移动端 GPU 上部署；需要在几乎不损失精度的前提下把模型压到可全 GPU 委托执行的量级。
Method: 五级编码器输出经 Scale-Aligned Projection 对齐到公共分辨率后只聚合一次，再由 Adaptive Fusion Cascade 精修，该级联结合 Adaptive Kernel Fusion 与 Progressive Receptive Fusion（临时通道扩张、互补 depthwise 感受野、跨分支渐进信息传递）。在 DRIVE、Kvasir-SEG、DSB18、BUSI、ISIC-2017、ISIC-2018 上按 nnU-Net v2.3.1 协议做五折交叉验证，含 LightMIS-T/S/完整版三个变体。
Result: 完整版 LightMIS 0.131 M 参数、3×256×256 输入 0.575 GFLOPs，modality-macro Dice 86.71%、IoU 78.99%；Mobile U-ViT 为 86.75% Dice、79.07% IoU，差 0.04 与 0.08 个百分点。相对 Mobile U-ViT、nnWNet、nnU-Net，参数量减少 90.58–99.61%，GFLOPs 减少 82.54–96.14%。Arm Mali-G52 MC2 GPU 上全部变体实现完整 GPU 委托，中位委托延迟 53.31 ms（LightMIS-T）至 138.31 ms（完整版）。
Conclusion: 去掉学习式分阶段解码器、只做一次融合即可在 0.131 M 参数量级上达到与 Mobile U-ViT 基本持平的 Dice/IoU，同时把参数与 GFLOPs 压低一个数量级，说明这些任务上精度-复杂度权衡与端侧执行是可行的。

papers.title: Track2Art: Articulated Object Model Recovery with Visual-Geometric Track Representations
papers.abstract_en: Understanding articulated objects is fundamental for robotic interaction, requiring accurate rigid-part discovery and the recovery of their kinematic relations. Existing approaches often treat articulation as a by-product of reconstructed geometry or recover it through per-instance optimization. We instead build on the hypothesis that articulation is directly observable from persistent motion: points on the same rigid part move coherently, while relative motion between parts reveals their kinematic constraints. We present Track2Art, a motion-centric framework for recovering structured articulated objects from RGB-D interaction videos. Track2Art lifts tracked image points into persistent 3D trajectories and combines pretrained tracking features, visual descriptors, and explicit trajectory geometry. These representations are grouped into a variable number of rigid-part hypotheses and subsequently used to recover directed kinematic relations, joint types, and joint geometry through rotation-equivariant learned--analytic reasoning. On the aligned 20-object PartNet-Mobility suite, Track2Art achieves 0.695 Point IoU and 0.410 end-to-end J@20, while requiring neither ground-truth part counts nor test-time optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Track2Art 把 RGB-D 交互视频中被跟踪的图像点抬升为持久 3D 轨迹，用轨迹几何加预训练跟踪特征直接推断刚体部件与运动学关系，无需真值部件数也无需测试时优化。在 PartNet-Mobility 20 个物体上取得 0.695 Point IoU 与 0.410 端到端 J@20。
Motivation: 现有方法把铰接当作重建几何的副产物，或依赖逐实例优化来恢复部件与关节，既慢又需要额外监督。
Method: 从 RGB-D 交互视频跟踪图像点并抬升为持久 3D 轨迹，融合预训练跟踪特征、视觉描述子与显式轨迹几何；将表示聚成可变数量的刚体部件假设，再用旋转等变的 learned--analytic reasoning 恢复有向运动学关系、关节类型与关节几何。
Result: 在对齐的 20 物体 PartNet-Mobility 套件上，Point IoU 0.695，端到端 J@20 0.410，且不需要真值部件数与测试时优化。
Conclusion: 铰接关系可从持续运动中直接观测得到，用轨迹表示替代几何副产物加逐实例优化即可恢复结构化铰接物体。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Decomposed Subtasks
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related policy-gradient methods for training language model agents collapse an entire multi-turn rollout into a single scalar trajectory reward before it enters the policy update. When the task composes distinct skills, especially under sparse and delayed environmental feedback, this collapsing is lossy: the optimizer must implicitly infer which competency drove the outcome and how that should change behavior. We argue the right primitive is not a better scalar but a decomposition: trajectory reward should be split along subtasks before it enters the policy update. We introduce Reinforcement Learning with Decomposed Subtasks (RLDS), whose core is Subtask-Decomposed Advantage Estimation (SDAE): a replacement for the scalar GRPO advantage that splits trajectory reward into per-subtask shares on a fixed taxonomy, computes a group-relative advantage per subtask, and distributes per-token credit by weighting each subtask's advantage by its importance, concentrating it around the step where a reflection marks that subtask's execution as consequential. We evaluate on four agentic benchmarks: FrozenLake (sparse grid navigation), HotpotQA (multi-hop QA, one retrieval tool), ScienceWorld (long-horizon embodied science), and DeepResearch (long-form research, four tools, composite rubric reward). Heterogeneity diagnostics emitted during training show where decomposition pays off - gains scale with subtask heterogeneity, largest on the high-heterogeneity tasks ScienceWorld (+11.5 points, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]) and FrozenLake (+9.8 points, [+7.0, +12.8]), and within noise on HotpotQA and DeepResearch, where the diagnostics predicted little to recover. ScienceWorld is also more compute-efficient under RLDS than scalar GRPO (-10.9% wall-clock per step), as long rollouts amortize the fixed reflect-and-grade overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLDS 把 GRPO 的整条轨迹标量奖励按固定子任务分类拆成各子任务份额，分别算组相对优势再按重要性分摊到 token，并把信用集中到 reflection 标记为关键的步骤。在四个 agentic benchmark 上，增益随子任务异质性放大：ScienceWorld +11.5 点（95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]）、FrozenLake +9.8 点（[+7.0, +12.8]），HotpotQA 与 DeepResearch 落在噪声内。
Motivation: GRPO 等策略梯度方法把多轮 rollout 压成单一标量轨迹奖励，在任务由多种技能组成、环境反馈稀疏且延迟时，优化器只能隐式推断是哪项能力驱动了结果，信用分配有损。
Method: RLDS 的核心是 Subtask-Decomposed Advantage Estimation (SDAE)：在固定子任务 taxonomy 上把轨迹奖励拆成各子任务份额，逐子任务计算组相对优势，再按子任务重要性分摊 per-token 信用，并用 reflection 标记把信用集中到该子任务被执行为关键的步骤。
Result: 在四个 agentic benchmark 上评测：ScienceWorld +11.5 点（paired-bootstrap 95% CI [+9.8, +13.3]）、FrozenLake +9.8 点（[+7.0, +12.8]），HotpotQA 与 DeepResearch 的提升在噪声范围内；ScienceWorld 上 RLDS 每步 wall-clock 比标量 GRPO 少 10.9%，因长 rollout 摊薄了固定的 reflect-and-grade 开销。
Conclusion: 轨迹奖励应在进入策略更新前按子任务分解，收益随子任务异质性增长——异质性诊断可预测哪里值得分解，低异质任务上分解不带来可测收益。

papers.title: Beyond End-Task Success: How to Audit Visual Experience Retrieval in Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. Since robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining, a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of $K=3$, $10$, and $50$. Because every alternative's outcome is known, a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30-58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07-0.15 in success rate. (2) At $K\ge10$, visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5-3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience's quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at $K=50$ (AUROC 0.45-0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人经验复用系统普遍用视觉相似度选经验、只报被选经验的成功率，该分数衡量的是库而不是选择规则。作者提出穷举审计：在两个操作任务、三种复用机制、K=3/10/50 的库上把每条经验在每个查询场景执行一遍，发现事后固定的单条经验就能吃掉随机与 oracle 之间差距的 30-58%，而逐场景选择只再争 0.07-0.15 的成功率；K≥10 时视觉规则比 oracle 集中在单条经验上多 1.5-3 倍，且凡与保持选择率的 shuffle 显著不同的规则都更差。
Motivation: 按视觉相似度选经验的复用系统只报被选经验的成功率，该数字无法区分选择规则好坏与库本身好坏：反复用一条通用经验也能得高分，误导该领域下一步该改进选择器还是改进库。
Method: 审计方法为穷举执行：把库中每条存储经验在每个查询场景上跑一遍，覆盖两个操作任务、三种复用机制、K=3/10/50 的库，使每个候选的结果已知，从而把分数拆解为逐场景选择与库质量两部分；被审计规则是在从 raw pixels 到 CLIP 的五种视觉 embedding 上做最近邻距离选择，并与保持选择率、随机配对场景的 shuffle 对照。
Result: 事后选定的单条固定经验可捕获随机选择与 oracle 之间差距的 30-58%，逐场景选择在成功率上只再争 0.07-0.15；K≥10 时视觉规则比 oracle 集中于单条经验多 1.5-3 倍，其分数随之跟随该经验的质量；凡与 shuffle 显著不同的规则都更差，五种学习型图像策略全部如此；视觉距离预测单对是否成功可达 AUROC 最高 0.96，但在 K=50 时对同一场景内候选排序五种 embedding 中有四种不优于随机（AUROC 0.45-0.52）。
Conclusion: 端任务成功率不能审计选择规则，任何此类研究都应附两份廉价报告：被选经验的分布，以及事后最佳单条经验的成功率；穷举执行通常不可行，这两项是其可替代的缩减形式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MIND the Gap: A Geographic Implicit Neural Representation with Adjustable Spatial Scale
papers.abstract_en: Geographic measurements are often sparse, leaving large areas without labels for the quantities we want to map. Geographic implicit neural representations (INRs) provide coordinate-based embeddings that can be combined with sparse labels to predict at unsampled locations without satellite imagery at inference. Yet existing INRs are largely evaluated with random holdouts, leaving their ability to generalize across larger geographic gaps unclear. We introduce Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation (MIND), a geographic INR whose spatial granularity can be adjusted after training. MIND distills several pretrained geospatial models using nested supervision at increasing embedding dimensions, dividing the representation into contiguous chunks. Early chunks capture broad spatial patterns, while later chunks add increasingly local variation. Downstream models can retain only the leading chunks or use our Chunked Penalty to reduce reliance on later chunks without retraining the INR. We also introduce CoordBench, comprising $52$ datasets and $78$ targets with both random and regional holdouts at multiple spatial scales. Across CoordBench, fine-scale features help most when labels are nearby, while smoother representations generalize better across larger geographic gaps. MIND with the Chunked Penalty achieves the highest aggregate regression and classification performance among tested INRs and the highest overall performance under regional holdout. These results show that geographic representations should be evaluated and adapted according to the spatial separation between labeled and prediction locations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND (Matryoshka Implicit Neural Distillation) 把多个预训练地学模型蒸馏成嵌套分块的地理隐式神经表示 (INR)，前段块刻画大尺度格局、后段块补充局地细节，训练后无需重训即可通过只保留前段块或 Chunked Penalty 调节空间粒度。在含 52 个数据集、78 个目标的 CoordBench 上，细尺度特征在标签邻近时最有帮助，更平滑的表示在大尺度地理空隙上泛化更好；MIND 加 Chunked Penalty 在受测 INR 中取得最高总体回归与分类性能，并在区域留出 (regional holdout) 下总体性能最高。
Motivation: 地理测量稀疏，大量区域没有标签；现有地理 INR 多用随机留出评估，无法说明其跨越较大地理空隙时的泛化能力。
Method: 用嵌套监督在递增的嵌入维度上把表示切成连续块，蒸馏多个预训练 geospatial 模型；下游模型可只保留前段块，或用 Chunked Penalty 降低对后段块的依赖而不重训 INR。配套提出 CoordBench，含 52 个数据集、78 个目标，同时提供随机留出与多种空间尺度的区域留出。
Result: CoordBench 上细尺度特征在标签邻近时收益最大，更平滑的表示在更大地理空隙上泛化更好；MIND + Chunked Penalty 在受测 INR 中取得最高总体回归与分类性能，并在区域留出下取得最高总体性能。
Conclusion: 地理表示应按标签位置与预测位置之间的空间距离来评估和调整粒度，而不是只看随机留出分数。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: You've Seen Enough: Quality-Constrained Image Coding for Machines
papers.abstract_en: Visual data is increasingly consumed by machine-vision systems rather than by human observers. Image Coding for Machines (ICM) compresses images assuming the main observer is a computer vision application and that the human observer needs to inspect or validate the decisions. Inspired by just-noticeable distortion, we cap human-observed quality at a desired level and devote the remaining bits to machine performance. Specifically, joint compression-segmentation training is recast as a constrained optimization problem in which the codec must meet a predefined acceptable target visual quality while a task term consumes the remaining coding capacity. This paper proposes two variants of a penalty function that guides the quality toward the target: an absolute function and a bilinear function, the latter applying a steeper slope once the target visual quality is exceeded. Experimental results show that, under the quality constraint, the proposed method achieves BD-rates of $-22.82\%$ and $-29.81\%$ relative to an unconstrained joint rate--distortion--task optimization and a simple rate--distortion baseline, respectively, showcasing bitrate reduction with the same task performance. This is achieved while the codec also meets the target visual quality with a reasonable error and without adding any complexity overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向机器视觉的图像编码 (ICM) 把联合压缩-分割训练改写成带质量约束的优化：人眼可见质量被封顶在目标值，剩余码率全部让给任务性能。两种引导质量逼近目标的惩罚函数（绝对型与双线性型，后者越过目标后斜率更陡）在满足目标视觉质量的前提下，相对无约束联合率-失真-任务优化取得 -22.82% BD-rate，相对简单率-失真基线取得 -29.81%，任务性能不变且不增加复杂度。
Motivation: 视觉数据的消费者正从人眼转向视觉模型，而现有编码仍按人眼质量分配码率；需要在保证人可检查质量的前提下把码率省给机器任务。
Method: 受 just-noticeable distortion 启发，把联合压缩-分割训练重构为约束优化：codec 必须达到预设可接受视觉质量，任务项消耗剩余编码容量。提出两种惩罚函数变体——绝对函数与双线性函数，后者在超过目标视觉质量后施加更陡斜率。
Result: 在质量约束下，相对无约束联合 rate-distortion-task 优化 BD-rate 为 -22.82%，相对简单 rate-distortion 基线为 -29.81%，任务性能相同；codec 同时以合理误差达到目标视觉质量，且不增加复杂度开销。
Conclusion: 把人眼质量当作硬约束、把剩余码率交给任务项，可以在不损失任务性能、不增加复杂度的情况下显著降低码率；双线性惩罚用于在越过目标后更强地把质量拉回目标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CompAdapt: Adaptable Composite Motion Modeling for Physics-Consistent Text-to-Video Generation
authors: Wangmeng Zuo (1) ((1) Harbin Institute of Technology
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion-based text-to-video (T2V) models have demonstrated impressive capability in generating realistic and temporally coherent videos, they often fail to respect fundamental physical dynamics. Although recent physics-constrained methods incorporate explicit dynamics priors to improve physical plausibility, they remain limited to simple single-type motions, depend on manually specified parameters, and struggle to generalize to unseen physical laws. In this work, we propose CompAdapt, a physics-consistent T2V framework for adaptable generation across complex real-world scenarios. It extends neural dynamics modeling beyond single-type motions to encompass composite physical behaviors, including coupled motions, multi-stage transitions, and multi-object collisions. Furthermore, CompAdapt translates natural language prompts into structured physical semantics, enabling end-to-end specification of motion types, temporal relations, and initial physical parameters. To generalize to novel physical environments, CompAdapt introduces dynamics-aware prior matching, achieving one-shot adaptation without retraining the core dynamics module. In addition, a physics-aware latent feature fusion module improves visual fidelity under fast and complex motion. Experiments on physics-focused T2V benchmarks demonstrate that CompAdapt improves physical consistency over both general T2V models and physics-constrained baselines, while preserving high visual quality and adaptability to unseen dynamics. The project page is available at https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/ .
papers.comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Project page: https://makapic.github.io/CompAdapt/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompAdapt 把物理约束 T2V 从单一运动扩展到复合运动（耦合运动、多阶段转换、多物体碰撞），将自然语言提示解析为结构化物理语义（运动类型、时间关系、初始物理参数），并用 dynamics-aware prior matching 实现对未见物理环境的一次适应而无需重训核心动力学模块。在物理导向的 T2V benchmark 上，其物理一致性优于通用 T2V 模型与物理约束基线，同时保持视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有物理约束 T2V 方法局限于简单单一类型运动、依赖人工指定参数，且难以泛化到未见物理规律，无法覆盖真实场景中的复合运动。
Method: CompAdapt 用神经动力学建模复合物理行为（耦合运动、多阶段转换、多物体碰撞）；将 prompt 转为结构化物理语义以端到端指定运动类型、时间关系与初始参数；引入 dynamics-aware prior matching 做 one-shot adaptation（不重训核心动力学模块），并用 physics-aware latent feature fusion 提升快速复杂运动下的视觉保真度。
Result: 在物理导向的 T2V benchmark 上，CompAdapt 相对通用 T2V 模型与物理约束基线提升物理一致性，同时保持高视觉质量与对未见动力学的适应性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把复合运动建模、结构化物理语义解析与 one-shot prior 匹配结合，可在不重训动力学模块的前提下让 T2V 同时获得物理一致性、视觉质量和对新物理环境的适应力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Conservation Buys Stability and Factoring Buys Counterfactuals in Physical World Models
papers.abstract_en: A learned simulator can reproduce its training conditions accurately yet fail in two distinct ways once those conditions change. Over long rollouts, small errors accumulate until the trajectory drifts away from physically plausible behavior; under an intervention on a physical parameter, the model may continue to follow the law seen during training rather than the intervened one. We show that these two failures require different structural remedies. Evolving a learned energy with a symplectic integrator preserves the geometry of the conservative dynamics and keeps rollouts bounded and physically meaningful for up to $100\times$ the training horizon, while equal-capacity predictors, an energy-regularized predictor, and a tuned neural ODE diverge. By contrast, encoding the physical coupling through an explicit linear factorization enables the model to follow a never-seen sign of that coupling, whereas an unrestricted parameterization remains locked to the training law. Crucially, the two mechanisms are separable: removing the structure responsible for long-horizon stability leaves counterfactual transfer intact, while removing the factorized coupling destroys counterfactual transfer without eliminating stability. This double dissociation, established with matched controls that remove or replace one structural component at a time, persists beyond the headline three-body system and remains visible when the physical state must be inferred from pixels rather than provided directly. The result is a concrete design principle for physical world models: long-horizon stability and changed-law generalization arise from distinct structural commitments, and each can be imposed deliberately without requiring the other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 物理世界模型的两类失效需要不同结构修复：用辛积分器 (symplectic integrator) 演化学习到的能量可保持保守动力学几何，使 rollout 在高达 100 倍训练时长内保持有界且物理合理，而等容量预测器、能量正则预测器与调好的 neural ODE 都发散；把物理耦合显式线性因子化 (factorization) 则让模型跟随从未见过的耦合符号，无约束参数化仍锁死在训练规律上。两者可解耦：去掉保稳定结构不影响反事实迁移，去掉因子化耦合则毁掉反事实迁移但稳定性仍在。
Motivation: 学习型模拟器在训练条件下准确，但长时 rollout 会累积漂移、参数干预下仍沿训练规律走；这两种失效机制不同，需要分别归因的结构修复。
Method: 两条独立结构路线：一是以辛积分器演化学习能量以保住保守动力学几何，二是把物理耦合编码为显式线性因子化；用 matched controls 逐次移除或替换单一结构组件做双重分离 (double dissociation) 检验，并在三体系统之外、以及状态需从像素推断（而非直接给定）的设定下复核。
Result: 辛积分器版本 rollout 可保持有界且物理合理达训练时长的 100 倍，而等容量预测器、能量正则预测器与调优 neural ODE 发散；显式线性因子化使模型跟随从未见过的耦合符号，无约束参数化则停留在训练规律。移除长时稳定结构后反事实迁移仍在，移除因子化耦合后反事实迁移消失但稳定性保留；该双重分离在三体系统之外与像素输入状态下仍可见。

papers.title: Higher-order pruning of experts in mixture-of-experts language models
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models suffer from large parameter counts, which create a significant memory bottleneck. Expert pruning is the most direct approach for reducing this parameter count, yet existing methods make pruning decisions for each expert independently, and assume experts' contributions are purely additive. In reality, expert usage in MoEs is inherently cooperative. We derive HOPE (Higher-Order Pruning of Experts), a second-order pruning objective which provably minimizes an upper bound on the error resulting from pruning. We show that REAP (a state-of-the-art first-order pruning method) is a special case of HOPE where interaction terms are ignored. Across three frontier MoE models (up to 122B parameters), two distinct calibration sets, and multiple benchmarks (including math, instruction following, coding, and an agentic suite), we demonstrate that HOPE produces better pruning decisions than existing methods, and its advantage is most pronounced at high pruning rates and on challenging agentic workloads. At 50% pruning, HOPE outperforms all baselines and achieves an average rank of 1.58 out of 5 methods (versus 2.42 for the next-best method, REAP), with gains of up to +6.1% on agentic coding. Over all conditions, HOPE again achieves the best average rank and surpasses every other method in the majority of head-to-head comparisons. By preserving cooperative expert structure that first-order methods ignore, HOPE enables aggressive compression with minimal degradation, particularly on complex tasks where diverse expert combinations are invoked over long sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HOPE (Higher-Order Pruning of Experts) 用二阶剪枝目标刻画专家间的合作交互，证明其最小化剪枝误差的上界，并把一阶方法 REAP 证明为忽略交互项的特例。在三个前沿 MoE 模型（最大 122B 参数）上，50% 剪枝率时 HOPE 在 5 种方法中平均排名 1.58（次优 REAP 为 2.42），agentic coding 最高提升 +6.1%，优势在高剪枝率与困难 agentic 任务上最明显。
Motivation: MoE 语言模型参数量大造成显存瓶颈，现有专家剪枝方法逐个独立决定剪谁，假设专家贡献纯可加，忽略了专家使用本身是合作性的。
Method: 推导二阶剪枝目标 HOPE，显式纳入专家交互项并证明其最小化剪枝误差的上界；在两个不同 calibration set 上计算目标，跨 math、instruction following、coding 与 agentic suite 多个 benchmark 评测三个 frontier MoE 模型（最大 122B 参数）。
Result: 50% 剪枝率下 HOPE 在 5 种方法中平均排名 1.58，次优 REAP 为 2.42；agentic coding 最高 +6.1%。跨全部条件 HOPE 仍取得最佳平均排名，并在多数一对一比较中胜过其他方法。
Conclusion: 保留一阶方法忽略的专家合作结构，可以在高剪枝率下实现激进压缩而退化极小，尤其在长序列上调用多样专家组合的复杂任务上。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graph Matching Relaxations and Amortization for Supervised Graph Prediction
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end Supervised Graph Prediction (SGP) requires a permutation-invariant loss to compare predicted and target graphs with arbitrary node orderings. Such losses typically involve a costly graph-matching problem. We first study three Optimal Transport relaxations of this problem and show, theoretically and empirically, that the Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) objective is the most suitable for SGP. Then, to avoid solving the resulting inner optimization for every training example, we propose to amortize the graph matching (node alignment) problem. For each training sample, the loss function leverages a transport plan provided by a parametric matcher based on the differentiable Sinkhorn algorithm applied on empirical node distributions. The graph prediction module and the matcher are jointly learned. We showcase the efficiency of this approach on toy and real world SGP problems of increasing complexity including a novel Mass-spectra to Scaffold task that we introduce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对端到端有向图预测 (Supervised Graph Prediction, SGP) 中置换不变损失需反复求解图匹配的问题，论文比较三种 Optimal Transport 松弛，理论上与实证上认定 Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 目标最合适，并用基于可微 Sinkhorn 的参数化 matcher 摊销 (amortize) 节点对齐，与图预测模块联合训练。
Motivation: 端到端 SGP 需要置换不变损失来比较节点顺序任意的预测图与目标图，而这类损失通常要解一个代价高昂的图匹配问题，每个训练样本都解一次内层优化会拖慢训练。
Method: 先研究三种 Optimal Transport 松弛（含 Gromov-Wasserstein 目标）来替代图匹配；再为每个训练样本用参数化 matcher——作用在经验节点分布上的可微 Sinkhorn 算法——直接给出 transport plan，供损失函数使用，图预测模块与 matcher 联合学习，从而避免逐样本求解内层优化。
Result: 理论上与实证上均显示 GW 目标最适合 SGP；该摊销方法在复杂度递增的 toy 与真实 SGP 任务上展示效率，其中包括作者新提出的 Mass-spectra to Scaffold 任务。
Conclusion: GW 是 SGP 置换不变损失的首选 OT 松弛，而把节点对齐用参数化 Sinkhorn matcher 摊销并与预测器联合训练，可在保持损失质量的同时省掉逐样本的内层求解。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Nonmaximal sums of maximally monotone operators under Rockafellar's constraint qualification
papers.abstract_en: We construct counterexamples to Rockafellar's sum conjecture in which two maximally monotone operators satisfy the interior-domain condition but their sum is not maximally monotone, thereby providing the complete disproof of the conjecture. We establish a general construction theorem that computes the entire monotone polar of a class of graphs and characterizes their maximal monotonicity by the nonexistence of solutions to explicit equations in the continuous dual. We also prove a pullback theorem that transfers counterexamples through bounded linear surjections. These theorems provide a systematic mechanism for generating entire families of counterexamples and lead to further structural consequences for the resulting operators. Specifically, we obtain four classes of counterexample families: weighted constructions with different curves, first operators with prescribed affine value dimensions, second operators obtained by positive rescaling and norm-continuous monotone perturbation with full domain, and counterexamples on further Banach spaces. The last class yields counterexamples on every Banach space containing a closed subspace isomorphic to $c_0$ or $\ell^1$, or admitting such a quotient. We also give explicit constructions on $c_0$ and standard $\ell^1$ that realize the construction and pullback mechanisms, respectively. We further determine the domain geometry and exact radial bounds of the constructed operators, characterize reflexivity by a fixed rank-one test in two classical classes of Banach spaces, identify maximal monotone extensions under surjective pullback, and compute exact Fitzpatrick identities. The appendices further extend these constructions to additional parameter and product families, nonlinear scalar and strictly monotone second operators, normal-cone and subdifferential partners, and examples with prescribed radial bounds, and more counterexample families.
papers.comment: Substantially revised and reorganized around the general construction theorem and pullback result, which form the backbone of the paper, integrating the explicit counterexamples and several results that predate the general construction theorem and those counterexamples into a unified framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构造出满足 Rockafellar 内部域条件 (interior-domain condition) 但和不极大单调的两个极大单调算子反例，从而完整否证 Rockafellar 和猜想。给出一般构造定理（计算一类图的整个单调极并以连续对偶中显式方程解的不存在性刻画极大单调性）与 pullback 定理（经有界线性满射转移反例），据此生成四类反例族，并在含 c0 或 ℓ1 闭子空间（或以其为商）的每个 Banach 空间上给出反例。
Motivation: Rockafellar 猜想断言满足内部域条件的两个极大单调算子之和仍极大单调；该猜想长期未决，其成立与否决定了单调算子求和理论的适用边界。
Method: 以一般构造定理计算一类图的整个单调极 (monotone polar)，并把极大单调性归约到连续对偶中显式方程无解；pullback 定理经有界线性满射把反例搬运到其他空间；再在 c0 与标准 ℓ1 上分别显式实现构造与 pullback 机制。
Result: 得到四类反例族：不同曲线的加权构造、具指定仿射值维数的第一算子、经正重标度与范数连续单调扰动且全定义域的第二算子、以及其他 Banach 空间上的反例；最后一类在每个含 c0 或 ℻1 同构闭子空间（或具此类商）的 Banach 空间上给出反例。另确定所构造算子的定义域几何与精确径向界，用固定秩一检验刻画两类经典 Banach 空间的自反性，识别满射 pullback 下的极大单调扩张，并计算精确 Fitzpatrick 恒等式。
Conclusion: Rockafellar 和猜想被完整否证，且一般构造定理与 pullback 定理提供了系统生成整族反例的机制，反例存在于广泛的非自反 Banach 空间中。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MolLedger: An Additive Graph Neural Network with Chemically Grounded ADME Attributions
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) is an important part of small molecule drug discovery. Many machine learning models have been built to predict ADME properties to facilitate this optimization process, but explaining model predictions is challenging. We propose a new graph neural network architecture with built-in atom attributions. Our model MolLedger learns a global context vector for each molecule and a per-atom head to output atom scores that sum to the predicted property. The atom scores are regularized to align with relevant chemical properties. We prove that MolLedger is a universal approximator and demonstrate empirically that the new architecture obtains explainability with little effect on performance. We show that the interpretations from MolLedger are faithful, concordant with held-out physical properties, and align with the changes between matched molecular pairs. Our case studies comparing interpretations from multiple methods on molecular pairs reveal that MolLedger is much better at producing sensible explanations for predicted property changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolLedger 是一个自带原子归因的加性图神经网络：为每个分子学一个全局上下文向量和一个逐原子打分头，各原子分数之和即预测的 ADME 性质，并用相关化学性质对原子分数做正则。作者证明该架构是万能逼近器，实证显示可解释性几乎不损失预测性能，且归因与留出物理性质、匹配分子对 (matched molecular pairs) 的性质变化一致。
Motivation: 小分子药物发现中已有大量 ADME 性质预测模型，但解释这些模型的预测一直很困难，归因往往与真实化学变化脱节。
Method: 提出加性图神经网络 MolLedger：学一个分子级全局上下文向量与逐原子打分头，原子分数加和等于预测性质；原子分数以相关化学性质做正则对齐。理论上证明其为万能逼近器，并在分子对案例研究中与多种归因方法对比解释。
Result: 实证显示新架构在获得可解释性的同时对预测性能影响很小；归因忠实 (faithful)、与留出物理性质一致、并匹配分子对之间的性质变化；在分子对案例研究中，MolLedger 对预测性质变化给出的解释明显比多种对比方法更合理。
Conclusion: 把归因做成架构内的加和分解并用化学性质约束，可以在几乎不牺牲 ADME 预测性能的前提下得到忠实且化学上合理的原子级解释。

papers.title: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Addressing critical global challenges, from food security and disaster risk to disease outbreaks and socio-economic vulnerability, demands high-fidelity geospatial modeling. However, building predictive planetary models remains bottlenecked by a fragmented data ecosystem, requiring manual data retrieval, multimodal data curation and fusion along with iterative model selection. We present the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous AI system that executes this end-to-end workflow directly from natural-language queries. PPE synthesizes multimodal datasets on the fly, retrieving spatiotemporally relevant covariates across open-web and Earth observation platforms (Data Commons, Google Earth Engine) and fusing them with geospatial foundation model embeddings (PDFM, AlphaEarth). Simultaneously, it searches over task-tailored model architecture families with automated overfitting guards. Across diverse tasks, geographies, and scientific domains, PPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art or manually tuned expert baselines. For US spatial regression, PPE improves mean $R^2$ across 21 CDC health indicators (76.8% vs. 60.0%), FEMA national risk indices (64.9% vs. 60.0%), and the Social Vulnerability Index (66.2% vs. 58.6%). For spatial downscaling in data-scarce settings, PPE integrates localized proxies to double baseline accuracy in Nigerian food security indicators ($R^2$ of 66.1% vs. 31.5%). For epidemiological nowcasting of the 2026 DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, PPE achieves a Recall@10 of 83.3% (identifying 15 of 18 newly invaded health zones across five weekly forecasts), a +10.3 percentage-point improvement over the public state-of-the-art modeling (~73%). By combining autonomous multimodal planetary data discovery with targeted model optimization, PPE lowers the technical barrier to planetary-scale analytics, enabling rapid, customized, expert-level deployment.

papers.title: Towards Unified Dynamic Face Landmark Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although advancements in face landmark detection (FLD) methods continue to push performance boundaries, they overlook two major functional limitations: (1) different network parameters need to be trained independently for each ``$N$-point'' benchmark dataset, and (2) a model trained on an ``$N$-point'' dataset reliably outputs only the $N$ landmarks. In our work, we first conceptualize Face Part-Anchored Landmark Positions (FPALPs), wherein each landmark is treated as a progression value between zero (start) and one (end) along a face part's contour. Every landmark can be expressed in the FPALP format, irrespective of its source dataset, hence unlocking the ability to unify all ``$N$-point'' datasets into a single dataset. Secondly, we represent each landmark with an FPALP-based query, refine it progressively with a cross-modality decoder, and predict its coordinates based on the final representation. Our approach, called Unified Dynamic FLD, embodies these two design choices and streamlines the landmark detection pipeline by enabling (1) a single model to learn on any number of ``$N$-point'' datasets, and (2) yield any number of specific landmark predictions by loading the designated landmark queries at runtime. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our method delivers these benefits while remaining competitive with, and in several cases outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 6 figures in Main Paper. 13 pages, 3 figures in Appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Unified Dynamic FLD：把每个面部关键点表示为沿面部部件轮廓从 0（起点）到 1（终点）的进度值（Face Part-Anchored Landmark Positions, FPALP），从而把任意 N-point 数据集统一成一个数据集，并用 FPALP 查询经 cross-modality decoder 逐步细化后回归坐标。单一模型可在运行时加载指定关键点查询，输出任意数量的关键点，在多个基准上与现有 SOTA 持平并在若干情形下超过。
Motivation: 现有面部关键点检测 (FLD) 需要为每个 N-point 基准单独训练一套网络参数，且模型在 N-point 数据上训练后只能输出那 N 个点，跨数据集与跨点数不可复用。
Method: 先定义 FPALP：把每个关键点写成沿面部部件轮廓的 0–1 进度值，使任意来源的关键点都可统一表示并合并所有 N-point 数据集；再为每个关键点构造 FPALP 查询，用 cross-modality decoder 逐步细化查询表征，最后据其预测坐标，运行时按需加载查询即可改变输出点数。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持单一模型、可变点数输出这两项能力的同时，与现有 SOTA 持平，并在若干情形下超过 SOTA。
Conclusion: 用部件锚定的进度值统一关键点表示，可以让一个模型跨 N-point 数据集训练并在运行时决定输出点数，而不牺牲检测精度。

papers.title: DreamSat-Pose: Spacecraft Pose Estimation from Single-View 3D Reconstructions and Learned 2D-3D Feature Matching
papers.abstract_en: 6-DoF pose estimation is a critical task in autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations. In the case of an unknown target, this task becomes challenging as it shall be paired with the reconstruction of the target shape model. In this article, we propose a novel framework for single-shot shape and pose estimation of unknown spacecraft objects. Given a single image, we first reconstruct a 3D shape model of the target, then estimate the relative six-degrees-of-freedom pose by learning dense 2D-3D correspondences. The image features are extracted using a frozen DINOv3 vision transformer, while the geometric features are computed from the reconstructed point cloud using a trainable dynamic graph convolutional neural network encoder. A dual-stream transformer matcher refines descriptors through alternating self- and cross-attention, producing soft correspondences that are passed to a Perspective-$n$-Point solver for pose recovery. We evaluate the method on the SPE3R dataset and consider FoundationPose as a representative baseline for current state-of-the-art capabilities. Results show reliable pose estimates achieving 0.157 degrees mean pointing error using only a single image and reconstructed geometry, demonstrating strong generalization to unseen spacecraft.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DreamSat-Pose 在单张图像上同时完成未知航天器的 3D 形状重建与 6-DoF 位姿估计：冻结的 DINOv3 提取图像特征，可训练的动态图 CNN 编码重建点云，双流 transformer 匹配器经自注意力与交叉注意力交替细化出软 2D-3D 对应，再交给 Perspective-n-Point 解算位姿。在 SPE3R 数据集上以单图加重建几何达到 0.157 度平均指向误差，并展示对未见航天器的泛化。
Motivation: 自主交会与近距离操作中目标航天器往往未知，位姿估计必须与形状模型重建同时进行，而单视角下缺少先验几何使这一配对问题困难。
Method: 单图先重建目标 3D 形状模型；图像特征用冻结 DINOv3 vision transformer 提取，几何特征由可训练的动态图卷积神经网络 (dynamic graph CNN) 编码器从重建点云计算；双流 transformer matcher 用交替的 self-attention 与 cross-attention 细化描述子，输出软对应，再由 Perspective-n-Point (PnP) 解算器恢复位姿。
Result: 在 SPE3R 数据集上评测，仅用单张图像与重建几何达到 0.157 度平均指向误差 (mean pointing error)，并展示对未见航天器的强泛化；以 FoundationPose 作为当前 SOTA 能力的代表性基线。
Conclusion: 单视角重建几何配合学习式 2D-3D 特征匹配足以支撑未知航天器的形状与位姿单次联合估计，且能泛化到未见目标。

papers.title: Bringing Agentic Search to Earth Observation Data Discovery
papers.abstract_en: NASA and its data centers hold thousands of geoscience datasets and tools like Worldview, Giovanni, the Science Discovery Engine, and Harmony. Finding the right one is hard even for domain experts. We present an agentic search framework for geoscience data discovery that takes a natural-language research query and returns matching datasets and tools. We demonstrate that, in the era of large language models, the latent value of knowledge graphs (KGs) can be substantially amplified through agentic search. From the NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph (NASA EO-KG) we derive NASA-EO-Bench, an open benchmark of 47k query-dataset pairs (21k task-based queries). A neural scorer fine-tuned on NASA-EO-Bench beats cosine and BM25 baselines. Further combining it with BM25 via score fusion raises both Recall@10 (R@10) and MRR to over 5x the unadapted cosine baseline. On top of this supervised pipeline, a zero-shot reranking stage lifts MRR by 16%, significant under a paired bootstrap, with no additional training, and autonomous web and arXiv tool use adds a further gain, showing that LLM reasoning is complementary to supervised retrieval.
papers.comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026 (full research paper). v2: camera-ready version; LLM rerank model sweep extended from N=200 to N=600 test queries with paired-bootstrap significance tests; adds a fine-tuned cross-encoder (bge-reranker-v2-m3) as a supervised reranking baseline
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向地球科学数据发现的 agentic search 框架：从 NASA EO-KG 构建 NASA-EO-Bench（47k query-dataset 对，21k 任务型查询），用微调神经打分器加 BM25 分数融合做检索，再叠 zero-shot 重排与自主 web/arXiv 工具调用。融合后 Recall@10 与 MRR 达到未适配 cosine 基线的 5 倍以上，zero-shot 重排再把 MRR 提升 16%（paired bootstrap 显著）。
Motivation: NASA 及其数据中心有数千个地学数据集与 Worldview、Giovanni、Science Discovery Engine、Harmony 等工具，即便领域专家也难以找到合适的数据与工具，知识图谱的潜在价值未被充分释放。
Method: 从 NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph (NASA EO-KG) 派生开放基准 NASA-EO-Bench（47k query-dataset 对，含 21k 任务型查询）；在其上微调神经打分器，与 BM25 做 score fusion，再接 zero-shot reranking 阶段，并允许 LLM 自主调用 web 与 arXiv 工具；v2 扩展到 N=600 测试查询并加入微调 cross-encoder bge-reranker-v2-m3 作为有监督重排基线。
Result: 微调神经打分器胜过 cosine 与 BM25 基线；与 BM25 分数融合后 Recall@10 与 MRR 均超过未适配 cosine 基线的 5 倍；zero-shot 重排在 paired bootstrap 下显著地把 MRR 再提升 16%，无需额外训练；自主 web 与 arXiv 工具使用再带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 知识图谱的潜在价值可经 agentic search 被大幅放大，且 LLM 推理与有监督检索是互补的：监督管线打底，zero-shot 重排与工具调用在其上继续增益。

papers.title: Cross-Modality Structural Guidance in 3D Latent Diffusion for Robust FLAIR Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution (HR) MRI acquisition is often hampered by scan time constraints, resulting in anisotropic or low-resolution scans (e.g., thick-slice FLAIR) that limit diagnostic accuracy. While deep learning-based super-resolution (SR) methods show promise, they often hallucinate anatomical details, which can compromise brain structural integrity. To mitigate this limitation, we introduce MR-DiffuSR, a Multi-Resolution Diffusion-based Super-Resolution framework that incorporates HR T1w structural image priors to guide the restoration of thick-slice FLAIR scans and operates in the 3D latent space. Our architecture introduces cross-modality structural swin attention, which derives structural attention maps from the HR T1w and applies them to the low-resolution FLAIR latent features. This design disentangles anatomical structure from modality-specific contrast, effectively preventing hallucinations. Furthermore, we employ a mixed-scale degradation strategy, training the model on a continuum of downsampling factors to ensure robustness to varying slice thicknesses, while optimizing with a DINOv3-based perceptual loss to preserve high-frequency semantic details. Evaluated on the ADNI-4 and ADNI-2 datasets, MR-DiffuSR surpasses both CNN and 2D diffusion approaches, achieving an average PSNR of 32.46 dB, SSIM of 0.97, and LPIPS of 0.07 across all downsampling factors. In downstream white matter hyperintensity segmentation, our model demonstrates exceptional robustness. While baseline performance collapses at 10x downsampling (Dice: 0.51), MR-DiffuSR maintains a Dice score of 0.63, preserving utility even at 7 mm equivalent slice thickness.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted for oral presentation at MLCN 2026 (MICCAI 2026 workshop), Strasbourg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MR-DiffuSR 用高分辨率 T1w 结构像作为跨模态先验，在 3D latent diffusion 中通过 cross-modality structural Swin attention 把结构注意力图施加到低分辨率 FLAIR 潜特征上，以分离解剖结构与模态对比、抑制幻觉。在 ADNI-4 与 ADNI-2 上跨全部降采样因子平均 PSNR 32.46 dB、SSIM 0.97、LPIPS 0.07；10× 降采样（约 7 mm 层厚）下基线 Dice 崩到 0.51，本方法仍保持 0.63。
Motivation: 厚层 FLAIR 因扫描时间受限而各向异性、分辨率低，削弱诊断精度；现有深度学习超分又会幻觉解剖细节，破坏脑结构完整性。
Method: MR-DiffuSR 是多分辨率扩散超分框架：在 3D latent space 中，用 HR T1w 结构图导出结构注意力图并作用于低分辨率 FLAIR 潜特征（cross-modality structural swin attention）；训练采用混合尺度退化策略，在连续降采样因子上学习，并以 DINOv3-based perceptual loss 优化以保留高频语义细节。

papers.title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
papers.abstract_en: Video world models are moving toward preserving an observed world under controllable camera and object motion while allowing its environmental state to change. Yet these controls remain isolated, and weather generation typically relies on a source video or reconstructed scene that already specifies future structure. We study a first-frame-anchored source-to-state setting, where the model starts from a single image and follows explicit camera and object controls and an optional weather instruction, then generates a video that either preserves the source world or transfers it to a target weather state. To address these challenges, we first build HoloStateData, a state video dataset that turns diverse videos into unified control samples for camera, object, and weather supervision. Second, we introduce Holo-World, a unified controllable video world model that jointly controls the scene from a single image. Its Unified Scene Adapter factorizes world preservation and weather transfer into distinct parameter subspaces, using rendered background, geometry buffers, and object controls to maintain controlled scene structure while modeling weather-dependent appearance and particle effects. Additionally, Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG guides scene and weather residuals separately, strengthening target weather effects without over-amplifying the full condition. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that Holo-World maintains precise camera and object controls with consistent scene structure while transferring scenes into diverse target weather states, outperforming video-to-video weather editing baselines on weather-state generation. Our project page is available at https://xiangchenyin.github.io/Holo-World/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Holo-World 是首个以单张首帧为锚的可控视频世界模型：给定相机与物体控制信号加可选天气指令，从一张图生成既可保持原世界、也可迁移到目标天气状态的视频。其 Unified Scene Adapter 把世界保持与天气迁移分解到独立参数子空间，Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 分别引导场景与天气残差，在天气状态生成上超过 video-to-video 天气编辑基线。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型的相机、物体、天气控制彼此割裂，天气生成还依赖已含未来结构的源视频或重建场景，无法从单图出发同时做结构保持与天气迁移。
Method: 先构建 HoloStateData，把多样视频转成统一的相机、物体、天气监督样本；模型以单图为输入，用 Unified Scene Adapter 将世界保持与天气迁移分解到不同参数子空间，借助渲染背景、geometry buffers 与物体控制维持受控场景结构，再用 Scene-Weather Decomposed CFG 分别引导场景残差与天气残差。
Result: 定量与定性实验显示 Holo-World 在保持精确相机与物体控制、场景结构一致的同时，把场景迁移到多种目标天气状态，并在天气状态生成上优于 video-to-video 天气编辑基线。
Conclusion: 把场景结构与天气外观解耦到独立子空间并分开做 CFG 引导，可让单图驱动的视频世界模型同时保住源世界结构并完成目标天气迁移。

papers.title: Policy Regret for Embedding Model Routing: Contextual Bandits with Low-Rank Experts
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommendation systems increasingly rely on dynamically routing diverse queries to multiple embedding models. Despite its practical significance, this problem remains poorly understood under realistic conditions like adversarial queries, bandit feedback, and limited observability of models. We formalize embedding model routing as an adversarial contextual linear bandit with low-rank experts, where contexts are queries, actions are items, and experts are the embedding models working on low-rank latent representation spaces. We first establish that standard regret notions suffer from structural misspecification or statistical intractability, and we identify a log-quadratic policy class that is expressive enough to capture query-dependent model routing, yet structured enough to allow efficient online learning. Focusing on this log-quadratic policy optimization problem under bandit feedback -- which is of independent interest -- we propose a policy gradient algorithm called Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG). It provably adapts to the unknown low-rank structure under incomplete information and attains $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{M T})$ linearized policy regret -- where $s, M$, and $T$ are the intrinsic rank of the experts, the number of models, and the number of rounds -- thus avoiding a curse of dimensionality. We provide computationally efficient and parameter-free implementation of HPG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把推荐系统中的 embedding 模型路由形式化为带低秩专家的对抗性上下文线性 bandit（context=查询、action=条目、expert=各 embedding 模型），并提出 Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG) 在 bandit 反馈下做 log-quadratic 策略优化。HPG 可自适应未知低秩结构，线性化 policy regret 达到 Õ(s√(MT))，其中 s 为专家内在秩、M 为模型数、T 为轮数，从而避开维数灾难。
Motivation: 推荐系统需把查询动态路由到多个 embedding 模型，但在对抗性查询、bandit 反馈与模型可观测性有限的现实条件下缺乏理论刻画；标准 regret 概念存在结构性误设或统计上不可处理的问题。
Method: 将路由建模为带低秩专家的对抗性上下文线性 bandit，识别出既能表达查询相关路由又便于在线学习的 log-quadratic 策略类；在此类上提出 Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG)，并给出计算高效、免参数 (parameter-free) 的实现。
Result: HPG 在不完全信息下可自适应未知低秩结构，线性化 policy regret 达到 Õ(s√(MT))（s=专家内在秩、M=模型数、T=轮数），避免维数灾难；并给出计算高效且 parameter-free 的实现。
Conclusion: log-quadratic 策略类加 HPG 能在对抗性、bandit 反馈与低可观测条件下对 embedding 模型路由做高效在线学习，其 regret 对内在秩而非环境维度标度。

papers.title: Auteur: Language-Driven Cinematographic Framing for Human-Centric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative video models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and temporal coherence, yet intentional camera control remains elusive. Existing frameworks treat camera motion as a byproduct of pixel synthesis, producing trajectories that are stochastic, spatially inconsistent, and indifferent to the human subject driving the scene. In this work, we present Auteur, a method for language-driven, human-centric camera framing in generative video. Our core insight is that professional filmmakers conceive shots not as world-space trajectories but as framings defined relative to the actor, encoding shot size, angle, and composition as functions of human pose and motion. We formalize this intuition as a human-centric camera parameterization and introduce a Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that is convertible to standard 6-DoF camera parameters. A fine-tuned multimodal large language model then acts as a virtual director, mapping natural language descriptions and coarse human motion to sparse DSL keyframes that are deterministically interpolated into continuous camera trajectories, which are then provided as input to video generators. We train and evaluate Auteur on a new dataset of 34K aligned text, human motion, and DSL-annotated camera trajectories drawn from procedural synthesis and real-world movie footage from the CondensedMovies dataset. Auteur enables cinematographic framing of human-centered scenes, a capability largely absent in prior generative models. To assess this behavior, we propose new framing-focused metrics, and our experiments show that Auteur consistently outperforms existing methods. Project page is https://cyberiada.github.io/Auteur/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Auteur 把镜头语言从世界空间轨迹改写成以演员为参照的构图：微调多模态 LLM 充当虚拟导演，把自然语言与粗粒度人体运动映射为稀疏 DSL 关键帧，再确定性插值成连续 6-DoF 相机轨迹喂给视频生成器。在 34K 条文本-人体运动-相机轨迹对齐数据上训练评测，新提出的构图指标显示其一致性优于现有方法。
Motivation: 生成式视频的相机运动目前是像素合成的副产品，轨迹随机、空间不一致，也不跟随驱动场景的人体主体，导演式的镜头构图意图无法表达。
Method: 提出以人体为中心的相机参数化与一套可转换为标准 6-DoF 参数的 Domain-Specific Language (DSL)；微调的多模态 LLM 接收自然语言描述与粗粒度人体运动，输出稀疏 DSL 关键帧，再确定性插值为连续相机轨迹作为视频生成器输入。训练与评测数据为 34K 条对齐的文本、人体运动与 DSL 标注相机轨迹，来自程序化合成与 CondensedMovies 真实影片素材。
Result: 在 34K 对齐数据上训练与评测，并提出新的构图导向 (framing-focused) 指标；实验显示 Auteur 在这些指标上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 把镜头理解为相对于演员的构图而非世界空间轨迹，可以让生成模型获得此前基本缺失的人中心电影级取景能力。

papers.title: Attention Sinks and Outliers in Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: We propose OASIS, an outlier- and sink-aware method that stabilizes dual-normalized attention-residual architectures through explicit null routing and token-to-depth null coupling. AttnResidual introduces an additional depth-wise normalization channel that improves inter-layer routing flexibility but can also amplify attention sinks, activation outliers, and low-bit quantization error. OASIS builds on explicit Softmax1-based null routes at both the token and depth levels and uses token-level null evidence to downweight depth branches exhibiting stronger null behavior. Theoretically, we characterize a conditional mechanism for sink-like attention concentration under dual normalization, offering insight into the low-bit sensitivity observed in AttnResidual. Experimentally, we compare OASIS against five baselines on three language-model backbones and multiple language-modeling, reasoning, and long-context benchmarks and observe consistent improvements in both attention sink mitigation and post-quantization performance. Notably, relative to Vanilla AttnResidual, OASIS reduces maximum infinity norm by 81.75% and average kurtosis by 95.90%, lowers W8A8 perplexity by 82.00%, and improves W4A4 GSM8K Pass@1 by 42.11% on average across LLaMA-3.2-1B, Qwen3-0.6B, and Phi-4. Code is available at: https://github.com/robinzixuan/OASIS.
papers.comment: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 40 (NeurIPS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OASIS 用显式 Softmax1 空路由（null route）在 token 与 depth 两个层面抑制注意力残差架构中的 attention sink 与激活离群点，并用 token 级空证据下调空行为更强的深度分支。相对 Vanilla AttnResidual，最大 infinity norm 降 81.75%、平均 kurtosis 降 95.90%、W8A8 perplexity 降 82.00%、W4A4 GSM8K Pass@1 平均提升 42.11%。
Motivation: AttnResidual 增加的深度归一化通道提升层间路由灵活性，却会放大 attention sink、激活离群点与低比特量化误差，使双归一化注意力残差架构在量化后不稳定。
Method: OASIS 在 token 与 depth 两个层面引入基于 Softmax1 的显式空路由，并用 token 级空证据对空行为更强的深度分支降权；理论上给出双归一化下 sink 式注意力集中的条件机制，实验在三个语言模型骨干上对比五个基线，覆盖语言建模、推理与长上下文基准。
Result: 相对 Vanilla AttnResidual，最大 infinity norm 降低 81.75%，平均 kurtosis 降低 95.90%，W8A8 perplexity 降低 82.00%，W4A4 GSM8K Pass@1 平均提升 42.11%，以上均在 LLaMA-3.2-1B、Qwen3-0.6B、Phi-4 上平均得到；在三个骨干与多个基准上相对五个基线一致改善 attention sink 缓解与量化后性能。
Conclusion: 在双归一化注意力残差中显式建模并耦合 token 与 depth 层面的空路由，可以同时压低 sink/离群点强度并恢复低比特量化后的推理精度。

papers.title: Selective Off-Policy Reference Tuning with Plan Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards helps reasoning, but GRPO-style methods stall on hard prompts where all sampled rollouts fail. SORT adds a repair update for those failures without changing rollout generation: it derives a plan from the reference solution, compares token probabilities with and without that plan, and gives higher weight to tokens that become more predictable under plan conditioning. This turns all-wrong prompts into selective, structure-aware learning signals instead of uniform imitation. Across three backbones and eight reasoning benchmarks, SORT improves over GRPO and guidance baselines, with largest gains on weaker models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SORT 在 GRPO 全部 rollout 失败的难题上追加一次修复更新：从参考解导出 plan，比较带与不带 plan 条件下的 token 概率，对在 plan 条件下变得更可预测的 token 加权，把全错提示转成有结构选择性的学习信号。在三个 backbone、八个推理基准上优于 GRPO 与 guidance 基线，弱模型上增益最大。
Motivation: GRPO 类 RLVR 在难题上会停滞，因为所有采样 rollout 都失败，没有可用的相对奖励信号，只能退化成均匀模仿。
Method: SORT 不改 rollout 生成，只追加修复更新：从参考解导出 plan，用带 plan 与不带 plan 两种条件下的 token 概率差给 token 加权，权重给那些被 plan 条件变得更容易预测的 token。
Result: 在三个 backbone 和八个推理基准上，SORT 改进 GRPO 与 guidance 基线，增益在较弱模型上最大。
Conclusion: 对全错提示，用参考解 plan 构造选择性、结构感知的修复信号，比均匀模仿更有效，且模型越弱收益越大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Complex-Valued Phase-Coherent Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Complex-valued Transformers have largely inherited softmax attention from real-valued architectures. However, row-normalised token competition is not necessarily aligned with phase-preserving computation. In this paper, we introduce the Phase-Coherent Transformer (PCT), which applies a real-valued, element-independent, smooth gate to L2-normalised complex query-key similarities. PCT replaces token competition with token-non-competing attention and is designed to preserve phase information across layers. Across mid-scale benchmarks spanning long-range memory, hierarchical long-range reasoning, positional retrieval, phase-based memory and superposition, and image classification, PCT shows strong generalisation across task categories. Under parameter-fair comparison, PCT consistently outperforms both the standard softmax Transformer and its direct complex-valued counterpart. Moreover, even on tasks traditionally considered difficult for complex-valued neural networks, such as NIAH and LRA-Text, PCT remains competitive with Multiscreen, the strongest real-valued NN baseline in our comparison. Experiments introducing gates that deliberately violate the PCT conditions show that the design is not incidental: smooth gates that preserve negatively aligned phase components remain strong, whereas gates that delete such components collapse on long-range retrieval, and gates whose outputs become excessively large suffer clear performance degradation. PCT also shows no depth-related accuracy collapse across the tested depth range. These results support introducing multi-layer phase-coherent structure into attention as a promising design principle for achieving generalisation in complex-valued Transformers.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 17 tables (no figures). Companion Lean 4 formalization of Theorems 1 and 2 at https://github.com/leohio/phase-coherent-transformer-r-d
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Phase-Coherent Transformer (PCT)：对 L2 归一化的复数 query-key 相似度施加实值、逐元素独立的平滑门控，用 token-non-competing attention 取代 softmax 行归一化竞争，以跨层保持相位。参数公平对比下 PCT 一致优于标准 softmax Transformer 与其复数对应版本，并在 NIAH、LRA-Text 上与最强实值基线 Multiscreen 竞争；删除负相位对齐分量的门控在长程检索上崩溃，门控输出过大则性能明显下降。
Motivation: 复数 Transformer 直接沿用实值架构的 softmax 注意力，而行归一化的 token 竞争与保相位计算并不对齐，导致复数网络在长程任务上表现不佳。
Method: PCT 对 L2 归一化的复数 query-key 相似度施加实值、逐元素独立的平滑门控，替换为 token-non-competing attention；在长程记忆、层级长程推理、位置检索、相位记忆与叠加、图像分类等中等规模基准上做参数公平对比，并做门控消融（保留负相位对齐分量 vs 删除 vs 输出过大），另有 Theorems 1、2 的 Lean 4 形式化。
Result: 参数公平对比下 PCT 一致优于标准 softmax Transformer 与直接复数对应模型；在传统上对复数网络困难的 NIAH 与 LRA-Text 上与最强实值基线 Multiscreen 竞争；删除负相位对齐分量的门控在长程检索上崩溃，输出过大的门控出现明显性能下降；在所测深度范围内无随深度的精度崩溃。
Conclusion: 把多层相位一致结构引入注意力是复数 Transformer 获得泛化的设计原则：平滑且保留负相位分量的门控是关键，删除该分量或放大输出都会破坏长程检索。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Human-1 by Josh Talks: A Full-Duplex Conversational Modeling Framework in Hindi using Real-World Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems can model natural conversational behaviours such as interruptions, overlaps, and backchannels, yet such systems remain largely unexplored for Indian languages. We present the first open, reproducible full-duplex spoken dialogue system for Hindi by adapting Moshi, a state-of-the-art duplex speech architecture, using a custom Hindi tokeniser and training on 26,000 hours of real spontaneous conversations collected from 14,695 speakers with separate speaker channels, enabling direct learning of turn-taking and overlap patterns from natural interactions. To support Hindi text generation, we replace the original English tokeniser and reinitialise text-vocabulary-dependent parameters while retaining the pre-trained audio components. We propose a two-stage training recipe -- large-scale pre-training followed by fine-tuning on 1,000 hours of conversational data. Evaluation through the prompted dialogue continuation paradigm with both automatic metrics and human judgments demonstrates that the resulting model generates natural and meaningful full-duplex conversational behaviour in Hindi. This work serves as a first step toward real-time duplex spoken dialogue systems for Hindi and other Indian languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Human-1：首个开放可复现的印地语全双工 (full-duplex) 对话系统，改造 Moshi 架构并换用自定义 Hindi tokeniser，在 26,000 小时真实自发对话上先大规模预训练、再用 1,000 小时对话数据微调。用 prompted dialogue continuation 范式配合自动指标与人工评判，模型能生成自然且有意义的全双工对话行为，包括打断、重叠与 backchannel。
Motivation: 全双工语音对话系统能建模打断、重叠、backchannel 等自然对话行为，但在印度语言上基本未被探索，缺少开放可复现的基线系统。
Method: 以 Moshi 双工语音架构为底座，替换原英文 tokeniser 为自定义 Hindi tokeniser，并重新初始化依赖文本词表的参数、保留预训练音频组件；训练分两阶段：大规模预训练后在 1,000 小时对话数据上微调，数据为 14,695 位说话人、带独立说话人通道的 26,000 小时真实自发对话，可直接学习 turn-taking 与重叠模式。
Result: 在 prompted dialogue continuation 范式下，用自动指标与人工评判共同评测，结果显示模型在印地语中生成自然且有意义的全双工对话行为；训练数据为 26,000 小时、14,695 位说话人，微调用 1,000 小时对话数据。
Conclusion: 作者将此定位为迈向印地语及其他印度语言实时全双工对话系统的第一步，也是该语言上的首个开放可复现系统。

papers.title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish step -- with an agent-level verifier that cross-examines completion claims with decision rules, rejecting those lacking direct visual evidence. Second, a mandatory Loop Breaker provides multi-tier filtering: switching interaction mode after repeated failures, forcing strategy changes after persistent screen-state recurrence, and binding reflection signals to strategy shifts. Third, an on-demand Search Agent searches online for unfamiliar workflows by directly querying a capable LLM with search ability, returning results as plain text. We additionally integrate a Coding Agent for code-intensive actions and a Grounding Agent for precise action grounding, both invoked on demand when required. We evaluate VLAA-GUI across five top-tier backbones, including Opus 4.5, 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, on two benchmarks with Linux and Windows tasks, achieving top performance on both (77.5% on OSWorld and 61.0% on WindowsAgentArena). Notably, three of the five backbones surpass human performance (72.4%) on OSWorld in a single pass. Ablation studies show that all three proposed components consistently improve a strong backbone, while a weaker backbone benefits more from these tools when the step budget is sufficient. Further analysis also shows that the Loop Breaker nearly halves wasted steps for loop-prone models.
papers.comment: The first two authors contribute equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLAA-GUI 是一个 GUI 自动化智能体框架，用强制的 Completeness Verifier 在每步完成时核验 UI 可见证据、用多层 Loop Breaker 在重复失败与屏幕状态复现时切换交互模式与策略、并按需调用 Search Agent 联网查询陌生流程。在 OSWorld 与 WindowsAgentArena 上取得 77.5% 与 61.0% 的最佳成绩，五个骨干中三个在 OSWorld 单次通过超过人类的 72.4%，Loop Breaker 使易循环模型的浪费步数近乎减半。
Motivation: GUI 智能体有两个普遍失效模式：在没有可验证证据时过早宣布成功，以及反复执行同一失败动作陷入循环而无法恢复。
Method: 三个强制/按需组件：Completeness Verifier 在每个 finish 步骤用决策规则交叉核验完成声明并拒绝缺乏直接视觉证据者；Loop Breaker 做多层过滤，重复失败后切换交互模式、屏幕状态持续复现后强制换策略、把反思信号绑定到策略转变；按需的 Search Agent 直接向具备搜索能力的 LLM 查询并返回纯文本，另配 Coding Agent 与 Grounding Agent 处理代码密集动作与精确动作定位。
Result: 在五个顶级骨干（含 Opus 4.5、4.6 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro）上评测两个含 Linux 与 Windows 任务的基准，OSWorld 77.5%、WindowsAgentArena 61.0%，均为最佳；三个骨干在 OSWorld 单次通过超过人类 72.4%。消融显示三个组件对强骨干均有一致提升，弱骨干在步数预算充足时获益更多；Loop Breaker 使易循环模型的浪费步数近乎减半。
Conclusion: 把「何时停止、何时恢复、何时搜索」做成强制核验与策略切换的模块化控制，能同时提升 GUI 智能体的成功率并减少循环浪费，弱骨干更依赖这些工具但需要足够步数预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An AI Agent Execution Environment to Safeguard User Data
papers.abstract_en: AI agents promise to serve as general-purpose personal assistants for their users, which requires them to have access to private user data (e.g., personal and financial information). This poses a serious risk to security and privacy: an AI model may hallucinate or make mistakes, and adversaries may attack it (e.g., via prompt injection) to exfiltrate user data. This paper presents GAAP (Guaranteed Accounting for Agent Privacy), an execution environment for AI agents that guarantees confidentiality for private user data. Crucially, GAAP provides this guarantee deterministically, without trusting the agent with private user data, and without requiring any AI model or the user prompt to be free of attacks. Through dynamic and directed user prompts, GAAP collects permission specifications from users describing how their private data may be shared. GAAP then enforces that the agent's data disclosures comply with these specifications by tracking how the AI agent accesses and uses private user data. GAAP augments Information Flow Control with novel persistent data stores and annotations that enable tracking the private information flow both across steps of a single task and over multiple separate tasks. Our evaluation confirms that GAAP blocks all data disclosure attacks, including those that make other state-of-the-art systems disclose private user data to untrusted parties, with only a small impact on agent utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AI agent 执行环境 GAAP，通过动态收集用户权限规格并追踪私有数据在单步与多任务间的流动，确定性地阻止数据外泄。评测中 GAAP 拦截了全部数据披露攻击（包括让其他 SOTA 系统泄露私有数据的攻击），且对 agent utility 影响很小。
Motivation: AI 个人助手需要访问用户的私人与财务数据，而模型幻觉、错误以及 prompt injection 等攻击会导致私有数据被外泄，现有系统在这些攻击下会泄露数据。
Method: GAAP 通过动态且定向的用户提示收集权限规格（permission specifications），追踪 agent 对私有数据的访问与使用以强制披露合规；在 Information Flow Control 之上加入持久数据存储与标注，使私有信息流可跨单个任务的多个步骤、跨多个独立任务被追踪；保证不信任 agent、不依赖模型或用户提示无攻击。
Result: 评测确认 GAAP 拦截了全部数据披露攻击，其中包括能让其他 state-of-the-art 系统向不可信方披露私有数据的攻击，同时仅对 agent utility 造成很小影响。
Conclusion: 不信任 agent、也不假设模型或提示无攻击的前提下，靠信息流控制加持久标注就能确定性地保障私有数据机密性，代价只是轻微的 utility 损失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Endogenous Information in Routing Games: Memory-Constrained Equilibria, Recall Braess Paradoxes, and Memory Design
papers.abstract_en: We study routing games in which travelers optimize over routes that are remembered or surfaced, rather than over a fixed exogenous action set. The paper develops a tractable design theory for endogenous recall and then connects it back to an explicit finite-memory micro model. At the micro level, each traveler carries a finite memory state, receives surfaced alternatives, chooses via a logit rule, and updates memory under a policy such as LRU. This yields a stationary Forgetful Wardrop Equilibrium (FWE); existence is proved under mild regularity, and uniqueness follows in a contraction regime for the reduced fixed-point map. The paper's main design layer is a stationary salience model that summarizes persistent memory and interface effects as route-specific weights. Salience-weighted stochastic user equilibrium is the unique minimizer of a strictly convex potential, which yields a clean optimization and implementability theory. In this layer we characterize governed implementability under ratio budgets and affine tying constraints, and derive constructive algorithms on parallel and series-parallel networks. The bridge between layers is exact for last-choice memory (B=1): the micro model is then equivalent to the salience model, so any interior salience vector can be realized by an appropriate surfacing policy. For larger memories, we develop an explicit LRU-to-TTL-to-salience approximation pipeline and add contraction-based bounds that translate surrogate-map error into fixed-point and welfare error. Finally, we define a Recall Braess Paradox, in which improving recall increases equilibrium delay without changing physical capacity, and show that it can arise on every two-terminal network with at least two distinct s-t paths. Targeted experiments support the approximation regime, governed-design predictions, and the computational advantages of the reduced layer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把路由博弈中的可选路线改为由记忆与界面呈现决定的内生集合，提出两层设计理论：微观层是有限记忆 + LRU 更新 + logit 选择的 Forgetful Wardrop Equilibrium (FWE)，宏观层是把记忆与界面效应折成路线权重的 salience 加权随机用户均衡。B=1 时两层精确等价，任意内生 salience 向量都可由呈现策略实现；更大记忆走 LRU→TTL→salience 近似管线并带误差界。作者定义 Recall Braess Paradox：提升回忆程度会增加均衡延误而物理容量不变，且该现象可在任意至少含两条不同 s-t 路径的双终端网络上出现。
Motivation: 传统 Wardrop/用户均衡假设行动集外生固定，但真实出行者只在被记住或被界面呈现的路线之间优化，记忆与呈现策略本身成为设计变量，缺少把微观记忆机制与宏观可实现性连起来的理论。
Method: 微观层：出行者携带有限记忆状态、接收被呈现的备选项、按 logit 选择并在 LRU 类策略下更新记忆，得到平稳 FWE，温和正则性下证存在、收缩域内对约化不动点映射证唯一。设计层：用平稳 salience 模型把持久记忆与界面效应折成路线权重，salience 加权 SUE 是严格凸势函数的唯一极小点，并在 ratio budget 与 affine tying 约束下刻画 governed implementability，在 parallel 与 series-parallel 网络上给出构造算法。桥接层：B=1（last-choice memory）时微观模型与 salience 模型等价；更大记忆用 LRU→TTL→salience 近似管线，并给出把代理映射误差转成不动点与福利误差的收缩型界。
Result: B=1 时微观模型与 salience 模型精确等价，任意内生 salience 向量均可由适当呈现策略实现；Recall Braess Paradox 可在任意至少含两条不同 s-t 路径的双终端网络上出现。摘要称有针对性的实验支持近似区间、governed-design 预测以及约化层的计算优势，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把记忆与呈现当作可设计的内生变量后，salience 约化层既给出可实现性与优化理论，又保留微观记忆模型的近似精度；提升回忆并不总是改善均衡，反而可能在容量不变时抬高延误。

papers.title: At FullTilt: Real-Time Open-Set 3D Macromolecule Detection Directly from Tilted 2D Projections
papers.abstract_en: Open-set 3D macromolecule detection in cryogenic electron tomography eliminates the need for target-specific model retraining. However, strict VRAM constraints prohibit processing an entire 3D tomogram, forcing current methods to rely on slow sliding-window inference over extracted subvolumes. To overcome this, we propose FullTilt, an end-to-end framework that redefines 3D detection by operating directly on aligned 2D tilt-series. Because a tilt-series contains significantly fewer images than slices in a reconstructed tomogram, FullTilt eliminates redundant volumetric computation, accelerating inference by orders of magnitude. To process the entire tilt-series simultaneously, we introduce a tilt-series encoder to efficiently fuse cross-view information. We further propose a multiclass visual prompt encoder for flexible prompting, a tilt-aware query initializer to effectively anchor 3D queries, and an auxiliary geometric primitives module to enhance the model's understanding of multi-view geometry while improving robustness to adverse imaging artifacts. Extensive evaluations on three real-world datasets demonstrate that FullTilt achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance while drastically reducing runtime and VRAM requirements, paving the way for rapid, large-scale visual proteomics analysis. All code and data will be publicly available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FullTilt 把冷冻电子断层扫描 (cryo-ET) 的开放集 3D 大分子检测直接搬到对齐的 2D tilt-series 上做端到端推理，绕开重建体数据的滑窗子体积处理。倾斜序列图像数远少于断层体切片数，因而消除冗余体积计算，推理加速达数量级 (orders of magnitude)，同时大幅降低 VRAM 占用。
Motivation: VRAM 限制使现有方法无法整幅处理 3D tomogram，只能在提取的子体积上做缓慢的滑窗推理，且目标特异模型需针对每个靶标重训。
Method: FullTilt 为端到端框架，含四个组件：tilt-series encoder 融合跨视角信息以一次性处理整条倾斜序列；multiclass visual prompt encoder 支持灵活提示；tilt-aware query initializer 锚定 3D queries；auxiliary geometric primitives module 强化多视角几何理解并提升对成像伪影的鲁棒性。
Result: 在三个真实数据集上的评测中，FullTilt 取得 state-of-the-art 的 zero-shot 性能，同时大幅缩短 runtime 与 VRAM 需求，推理加速达数量级。
Conclusion: 直接在 2D tilt-series 上做开放集 3D 检测可绕过体积重建与滑窗开销，实现快速、大规模的视觉蛋白质组学 (visual proteomics) 分析；代码与数据将于发表时公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Below-ground Fungal Biodiversity Can be Monitored Using Self-Supervised Learning Satellite Features
papers.abstract_en: Mycorrhizal fungi are vital to terrestrial ecosystem functioning. Yet monitoring their biodiversity at landscape scales is often unfeasible due to time and cost constraints. Current predictions suggest that 90% of mycorrhizal diversity hotspots remain unprotected, opening questions of how to broadly and effectively map underground fungal communities. We show that self-supervised learning (SSL) applied to satellite imagery can predict below-ground ectomycorrhizal fungal richness across diverse environments. Our models explain over half the variance in species richness across ~12,000 field samples spanning Europe and Asia. SSL-derived features are the most informative tested predictor group, and outperform each of the established climate, soil, and land cover baselines. We achieve a 10,000-fold increase in spatial resolution over existing techniques, moving from 1km landscape averages to 10m habitat-scale observations. As satellite observations are dynamic rather than static, this enables temporal monitoring of below-ground biodiversity at landscape scales for the first time. We apply this approach across two UK National Park woodlands, where ancient forests are predicted to have high but declining ectomycorrhizal diversity, marking key areas for further field verification. These results establish SSL satellite features as a scalable tool for extending sparse field observations to continuous, high-resolution biodiversity maps for monitoring the invisible half of terrestrial ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把自监督学习 (SSL) 用于卫星影像，可直接预测地下外生菌根真菌 (ectomycorrhizal) 物种丰富度：在横跨欧亚约 12,000 份野外样本上解释了超过一半的丰富度方差，且 SSL 特征优于气候、土壤、土地覆盖三类既有基线。空间分辨率从 1km 景观均值提升到 10m 生境尺度（10,000 倍），使地下生物多样性的动态监测首次成为可能。
Motivation: 菌根真菌对陆地生态系统功能至关重要，但景观尺度上难以监测：现有预测显示 90% 的菌根多样性热点未被保护，而现有技术只能给出 1km 景观均值，无法定位生境尺度的热点。
Method: 对卫星影像做自监督学习得到 SSL 特征，用其预测外生菌根真菌物种丰富度；与气候、土壤、土地覆盖等既有预测因子组做对照，并将模型应用于英国两个国家公园林地。
Result: 在约 12,000 份横跨欧洲与亚洲的野外样本上解释超过一半的物种丰富度方差；SSL 特征是所测试中信息量最大的预测因子组，优于气候、土壤、土地覆盖各自基线；空间分辨率相对现有技术提升 10,000 倍，从 1km 景观均值到 10m 生境尺度观测；在英国两个国家公园林地中预测古老森林具有高但正在下降的外生菌根多样性。
Conclusion: SSL 卫星特征可把稀疏野外观测外推为连续、高分辨率的生物多样性地图，用于监测地下生态系统；古老森林的高多样性下降区被标为需进一步野外核实的关键区域。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Attribution Bias in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support search and information retrieval, it is critical that they accurately attribute content to its original authors. In this work, we introduce AttriBench, the first fame- and demographically-balanced quote attribution benchmark dataset. By explicitly balancing author fame and demographics, AttriBench enables controlled investigation of demographic bias in quote attribution. Using this dataset, we evaluate 11 widely used LLMs across different prompt settings and find that quote attribution remains a challenging task even for frontier models. We observe large and systematic disparities in attribution accuracy between race, gender, and intersectional groups. We further introduce and investigate suppression, a distinct failure mode in which models omit attribution entirely, even when the model has access to authorship information. We find that suppression is widespread and unevenly distributed across demographic groups, revealing systematic biases not captured by standard accuracy metrics. Our results position quote attribution as a benchmark for representational fairness in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出首个按作者名气与人口统计学平衡的引文归属基准 AttriBench，在 11 个主流 LLM 与多种 prompt 设置下发现：即使前沿模型，归属准确率在种族、性别及交叉群体间仍存在大幅且系统的差距；并定义新失败模式 suppression——模型在掌握作者信息时仍完全省略归属，且该现象在各人口群体间分布不均。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地支撑搜索与信息检索，若把内容错误归给原作者会损害可信度；现有评测无法在控制名气与人口统计变量的条件下考察归属偏差，也捕捉不到完全省略归属这类失败。
Method: 构建 fame- 与 demographically-balanced 的引文归属基准 AttriBench，用它在不同 prompt 设置下评测 11 个广泛使用的 LLM，量化归属准确率的人口统计差异，并引入并考察 suppression 这一独立失败模式。
Result: 在 11 个 LLM、多种 prompt 设置上，引文归属对前沿模型仍是难题；归属准确率在 race、gender 与 intersectional 群体间存在大幅且系统的差距；suppression 广泛存在且在人口群体间分布不均，是标准准确率指标捕捉不到的偏差。
Conclusion: 引文归属可作为 LLM 表征公平性 (representational fairness) 的基准；单看总体准确率会漏掉 suppression 这类按人口群体分布不均的系统性失败。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Sharp Norm Inequality and Buzano's Inequality via Determinants
papers.abstract_en: We give a short linear-algebraic proof of the inequality $$ \|x\|_1\,\|x\|_\infty \le \frac{1+\sqrt{n}}{2}\,\|x\|_2^2, $$ valid for every $x\in\mathbb{R}^n$. This inequality relates three fundamental norms on finite-dimensional spaces and has applications in optimization and numerical analysis. Our proof exploits the determinantal structure of a parametrized family of quadratic forms, and we show the constant $(1+\sqrt{n})/2$ is optimal. The inequality is a special case of Buzano's inequality, and the same method also proves Buzano's inequality for real vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出一个简短的线性代数证明：对任意 x∈R^n 有 ‖x‖₁‖x‖∞ ≤ (1+√n)/2·‖x‖₂²，并证明常数 (1+√n)/2 是最优的。证明利用一族参数化二次型的行列式结构，同时说明该不等式是 Buzano 不等式的特例，同一方法也能对实向量证明 Buzano 不等式。
Motivation: 有限维空间中 ℓ₁、ℓ₂、ℓ∞ 三种范数之间的乘积不等式需要一个简短、初等且能说明最优常数的证明，以服务于优化与数值分析中的界估计。
Method: 对参数化二次型族的行列式结构做线性代数分析，由此导出范数不等式并确定常数 (1+√n)/2 的最优性；再把同一方法推广到 Buzano 不等式（实向量情形）。
Result: 证明了 ‖x‖₁‖x‖∞ ≤ (1+√n)/2·‖x‖₂² 对一切 x∈R^n 成立，并证明常数 (1+√n)/2 是最优的；该式为 Buzano 不等式的特例，同一方法可对实向量证明 Buzano 不等式。
Conclusion: 借助参数化二次型的行列式结构，可以给出范数不等式与 Buzano 不等式的简短统一证明，并确定最优常数。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 对参数化二次型族的行列式结构做线性代数分析，由此导出范数不等式并确定常数 (1+√n)/2 的最优性；再把同一方法推广到 Buzano 不等式（实向量情形）。
summary_sections.result: 证明了 ‖x‖₁‖x‖∞ ≤ (1+√n)/2·‖x‖₂² 对一切 x∈R^n 成立，并证明常数 (1+√n)/2 是最优的；该式为 Buzano 不等式的特例，同一方法可对实向量证明 Buzano 不等式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 借助参数化二次型的行列式结构，可以给出范数不等式与 Buzano 不等式的简短统一证明，并确定最优常数。

papers.title: Layer-wise Target Propagation: Efficient Component Attribution through Target Centric Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the internal mechanisms of transformer-based large language models (LLMs) is crucial for their reliable deployment and effective operation. While recent efforts have yielded a plethora of attribution methods attempting to balance faithfulness and computational efficiency, dense component attribution remains prohibitively expensive. In this work, we introduce Layer-wise Target Propagation (LTP), a novel framework that faithfully traces information flow on the frozen transformer in one forward and one backward pass without requiring counterfactual examples. LTP analytically decomposes and linearizes the computational structure of the Transformers into distinct pathways along which it propagates a targeted unembedding vector to receive the effective representation at each residual position. This target-centric propagation achieves O(1) time complexity with respect to the number of model components, scaling to long input sequences and dense component attribution. Extensive experiments on standard interpretability benchmarks demonstrate that LTP achieves state-of-the-art faithfulness and unprecedented efficiency compared to existing baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Layer-wise Target Propagation (LTP)：在冻结的 Transformer 上用一次前向加一次反向、无需反事实样本地追踪信息流，把计算结构解析分解并线性化为若干路径，将目标 unembedding 向量沿路径传播到各残差位置的有效表示。相对模型组件数的时间复杂度为 O(1)，可扩展到长输入与稠密组件归因；在标准可解释性基准上达到 SOTA 忠实度并显著优于现有基线的效率。
Motivation: LLM 可靠部署需要忠实且高效的组件归因 (dense component attribution)，而现有归因方法在忠实度与计算开销之间难以兼顾，稠密归因代价过高。
Method: LTP 在冻结 Transformer 上做一次前向与一次反向，不构造反事实样本；解析分解并线性化计算结构为不同路径 (pathways)，沿路径传播目标 unembedding 向量，得到每个残差位置的有效表示。
Result: 相对模型组件数的时间复杂度为 O(1)，可扩展到长输入序列与稠密组件归因；在标准可解释性基准上相对现有基线达到 state-of-the-art 忠实度与前所未有的效率。
Conclusion: 目标中心传播 (target-centric propagation) 可以在不牺牲忠实度的前提下把稠密组件归因的开销降到与组件数无关，成为 SwiGLU-Transformer 等结构归因的高效路径。

papers.title: Demo: Generative AI helps Radiotherapy Planning with User Preference
papers.abstract_en: Radiotherapy planning is a highly complex process that often varies significantly across institutions and individual planners. Most existing deep learning approaches for 3D dose prediction rely on reference plans as ground truth during training, which can inadvertently bias models toward specific planning styles or institutional preferences. In this study, we introduce a novel generative model that predicts 3D dose distributions based solely on user-defined preference flavors. These customizable preferences enable planners to prioritize specific trade-offs between organs-at-risk (OARs) and planning target volumes (PTVs), offering greater flexibility and personalization. Designed for seamless integration with clinical treatment planning systems, our approach assists users in generating high-quality plans efficiently. Comparative evaluations demonstrate that our method can surpasses the Varian RapidPlan model in both adaptability and plan quality in some scenarios.
papers.comment: Best paper in GenAI4Health at NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 放疗剂量预测的生成模型不再以参考计划为真值，而是直接按用户给定的偏好风味 (preference flavors) 生成 3D 剂量分布，让计划师自行权衡危及器官 (OARs) 与计划靶区 (PTVs) 之间的取舍。对比评估显示该方法在部分场景下于适应性与计划质量两方面超过 Varian RapidPlan。
Motivation: 现有 3D 剂量预测深度学习以参考计划作训练真值，会把模型偏向特定的计划风格或机构偏好，而不同机构与计划师之间的放疗计划流程本身差异很大。
Method: 提出一个生成模型，仅以用户定义的 preference flavors 为条件预测 3D 剂量分布，使计划师可指定 OAR 与 PTV 之间的优先权衡；设计上可与临床治疗计划系统 (TPS) 集成。

papers.title: BabelCoder: Agentic Code Translation with Specification Alignment
papers.abstract_en: As software systems evolve, developers increasingly work across multiple programming languages and often face the need to migrate code from one language to another. While automatic code translation offers a promising solution, it has long remained a challenging task. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential for this task, yet existing approaches remain limited in accuracy and fail to effectively leverage contextual and structural cues within the code. Prior work has explored translation and repair mechanisms, but lacks a structured, agentic framework where multiple specialized agents collaboratively improve translation quality. In this work, we introduce BabelCoder, an agentic framework that performs code translation by decomposing the task into specialized agents for translation, testing, and refinement, each responsible for a specific aspect such as generating code, validating correctness, or repairing errors. We evaluate BabelCoder on four benchmark datasets and compare it against four state-of-the-art baselines. BabelCoder outperforms existing methods by 0.5%-13.5% in 94% of cases, achieving an average accuracy of 94.16%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BabelCoder 把跨语言代码翻译拆成翻译、测试、修复三个专职 agent 协作完成，在四个基准上对比四个 SOTA 基线，94% 的案例上提升 0.5%–13.5%，平均准确率 94.16%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代码翻译方法准确率有限，且未能有效利用代码中的上下文与结构线索；此前的翻译与修复机制缺少让多个专职 agent 协同改进翻译质量的结构化框架。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 BabelCoder，将代码翻译任务分解为三个专职 agent：生成代码的 translation agent、验证正确性的 testing agent、修复错误的 refinement agent，各自负责翻译流程的一个环节。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 数据集上对比四个 state-of-the-art 基线，BabelCoder 在 94% 的案例上超过现有方法，提升幅度 0.5%–13.5%，平均准确率 94.16%。
Conclusion: 把代码翻译拆成翻译、测试、修复的多 agent 协作流程，可以在多数案例上稳定超过单体 LLM 翻译方法。
