papers.title: HybridInfer: Thermal-Aware Reinforcement-Learning Tier Routing for On-Device, Edge, and Cloud LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: On-device inference with small language models keeps user data local, works offline, and incurs no per-query cost, so the on-device tier is preferred when it is adequate. It is thermally constrained, however, and I find the constraint is sharper than a slowdown: on a flagship Snapdragon device, sustained on-device generation destabilizes the GPU inference runtime, which crashes or silently wedges after a few consecutive queries. The failure lies in the current toolchain (OpenCL kernel compilation and long-prompt prefill on the mobile GPU), recurs even when the device is cool, and is worst for long generations. Multi-tier routers across on-device, edge, and cloud models can relieve this pressure, but existing routers are thermal-blind and typically evaluated in simulation or on non-mobile hardware. I present HybridInfer, a thermal-aware reinforcement-learning router for a three-tier hierarchy (on-device Llama 3.2 3B, edge Llama 3.1 8B with retrieval, cloud GPT-4o) that uses the phone's thermal headroom and a query-complexity estimate as state and selects a tier by an offline-trained Q-learning policy. Its reward trades quality against latency, cost, and a thermal penalty, plus a locality bonus crediting on-device execution. I show this bonus is a precondition for thermal-aware routing: without it the optimal policy offloads every query. On a real Android benchmark of 210 prompts, the learned router attains significantly higher quality than two hand-tuned heuristics (paired Wilcoxon, p < 0.02) at the lowest cost of any adaptive condition. Always-on-device conditions match per-query quality on servable queries but are three to six times slower and fail on long queries, so routing wins on latency, reliability, and coverage rather than quality. To my knowledge this is the first use of on-device thermal headroom to select among LLM inference tiers of differing capability on real hardware.

Android measurement harness and full routing/evaluation pipeline released for replication at https://github.com/SimranKoul2026/HybridInfer

TL;DR: HybridInfer 用手机热余量加查询复杂度作状态、离线 Q-learning 选 on-device/edge/cloud 三级推理层，奖励在质量、延迟、成本与热惩罚间权衡并加 locality bonus。在 210 条 prompt 的真机 Android 基准上，学到的路由质量显著高于两条手工启发式（paired Wilcoxon p < 0.02）且成本最低；always-on-device 质量相当但慢 3–6 倍并在长查询上失败。
Motivation: 端侧小模型受热约束，Snapdragon 上持续生成会让 GPU 推理运行时崩溃或静默卡死；现有三级路由器对热不敏感，且多在仿真或非移动硬件上评估。
Method: 三级层次：on-device Llama 3.2 3B、edge Llama 3.1 8B（带检索）、cloud GPT-4o。状态为手机热余量与查询复杂度估计，离线训练的 Q-learning 策略选层；奖励权衡质量、延迟、成本与热惩罚，并加 locality bonus 记录端侧执行。在 Samsung Galaxy S25+（Snapdragon 8 Elite）上用 210 条 prompt 与冻结 gold 参照评测。

papers.title: Persistent Homology of Time Series through Complex Networks
papers.abstract_en: We present a unified pipeline for univariate time series classification via complex networks and persistent homology. A time series is mapped to a graph through one of five constructions across three families (visibility (natural and horizontal visibility graphs), transition, and proximity) and the graph is converted to a dissimilarity matrix from which a Vietoris-Rips filtration yields persistence diagrams. These diagrams are vectorized into fixed-length features through persistence landscapes and topological summary statistics. By standardizing the downstream processing, differences in classification performance are attributable to the network construction and distance metric alone. Experiments on twelve UCR benchmarks show that (i) no single construction dominates: the optimal graph type depends on the signal's discriminative structure; (ii) the graph distance metric is a first-order design choice, with diffusion distance uniformly outperforming shortest-path alternatives; and (iii) persistence-based features degrade gracefully under noise, consistent with the classical stability theorem of persistent homology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把单变量时间序列先经五种复杂网络构造（visibility 的 natural/horizontal visibility graph、transition、proximity 三族）转成图，再算图间距离矩阵、做 Vietoris-Rips 滤得到 persistence diagram，最后用 persistence landscape 与拓扑摘要统计向量化成定长特征做分类。UCR 十二个基准上没有一种构造普遍最优，而 diffusion distance 一致优于 shortest-path 类距离；拓扑特征在噪声下退化平缓，与持久同调稳定性定理一致。
Motivation: 时间序列经复杂网络转持久同调的流程里，网络构造与图距离的选择常被混在一起，分类差异无法归因到具体设计环节。
Method: 统一流水线：时间序列→五种图构造（visibility 两族、transition、proximity）→图间距离矩阵→Vietoris-Rips 滤→persistence diagram→persistence landscape 与拓扑摘要统计向量化为定长特征；下游处理标准化，使性能差异只归因于网络构造与距离度量。
Result: 在十二个 UCR 基准上：无单一构造占优，最优图类型取决于信号的判别结构；图距离是首要设计选择，diffusion distance 一致优于 shortest-path 类；persistence 特征在噪声下平缓退化，与持久同调稳定性定理一致。
Conclusion: 做时间序列拓扑分类时，图距离（尤其 diffusion distance）与网络构造要一起按信号结构选，且拓扑特征具备噪声下的稳定性优势。

papers.title: A New Non-archimedean Metric on Persistent Homology
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we define a new non-archimedean metric structure, called cophenetic metric, on persistent homology classes of all degrees. We then show that zeroth persistent homology together with the cophenetic metric and hierarchical clustering algorithms with a number of different metrics do deliver statistically verifiable commensurate topological information based on experimental results we obtained on different datasets. We also observe that the resulting clusters coming from cophenetic distance do shine in terms of different evaluation measures such as silhouette score and the Rand index. Moreover, since the cophenetic metric is defined for all homology degrees, one can now display the inter-relations of persistent homology classes in all degrees via rooted trees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在持续同调类上定义了适用于所有同调维度的非阿基米德度量——cophenetic metric，并证明零维持续同调配合该度量与多种距离下的层次聚类算法，能在不同数据集上给出统计上可验证、彼此一致的拓扑信息。由 cophenetic 距离得到的聚类在 silhouette score 与 Rand index 等评价指标上表现突出，且各维度的持续同调类可用有根树展示其相互关系。
Motivation: 持续同调类之间缺少统一的度量结构，难以与层次聚类衔接并做统计验证，也无法跨同调维度比较。
Method: 在所有同调维度的持续同调类上定义 cophenetic metric（非阿基米德度量），将其与多种距离下的层次聚类算法结合，在不同数据集上做实验，并用 silhouette score、Rand index 评价聚类结果。
Result: 在不同数据集上的实验表明，零维持续同调 + cophenetic metric + 多种距离的层次聚类给出统计上可验证且彼此一致的拓扑信息；cophenetic 距离产生的聚类在 silhouette score 与 Rand index 等指标上表现突出。
Conclusion: cophenetic metric 把持续同调与层次聚类打通，并可跨所有同调维度用有根树展示持续同调类之间的相互关系。
Relevance: 1
